3|1|11, yat mūle ‘nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ’ iti śuddhamanuṣyapradhānakātithyādikarmāṅgatayā vidhiḥ iti pakṣāntaraṃ siddhāntatvenopanyastaṃ, tat upekṣitam |
3|4|1, dravyadānasyaiva yāgasādhanatvāt avaśiṣṭasya anuniṣṭannapratipattiḥ śeṣakāryāṇi iti bhāṣyakāraḥ |
vārtikakārastu aṣṭākapālaḥ kṛtsna eva haviḥ, prakṣepastu dravyadānasya prati- pattiḥ |
3|4|18, na tāvadatra (sautrāmaṇyāṃ surāyāḥ ) avaśiṣṭaḥ śeṣo'sti anavadyāyaiva homavidhā- nāt, vacanāgatasya hutaśeṣasya tu pratipattyantaravidhānena ātideśikapratipattitvāt |
yadā'pi vārtikoktarītyā devatāsaṃskārārthaṃ yāgāntarameva surāyodravyakaṃ vidhīyate, tadā'pi pūrvavadeva śeṣābhāvaḥ |
prakṛtau ‘hotā adhvataḥ sāmidhenīranvāha ’ iti varaṇāpūrvaṃ hotṛśabdaprayogāt satre'pi varaṇāpatteśca |

3|7|9, yadapi vārtike aśīpomīyādyadhvabhūteṣu praiṣāvacaneṣu ekapadārthatvena hotṛdhvaryoḥ asaṃbhavāt maitrāvaruṇavidhiḥ ityuktaṃ, tadapi yajetiśabdasya agnīṣomīyādau hautre eva pratyakṣa- paṭhitatvena samākhyāyā ātideśikādhvaryyādidhānena hotṛprāpteḥ, tasya ca hotaryaja iti liṅgena bādhe'pi tatpuruṣasya maitrāvaruṇasyaiva yajetiśabde tadekavākyatā''pannapadāntareṣu ca prāpteḥ upe- kṣitam |
3|7|22, ‘tarasāḥ savanīyāḥ puroḍāśāḥ ’ ityatra yadā tu ‘puroḍāśāḥ savanīyāḥ ’ iti bhava- devādiṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ, tadā prāthamikatvāt puroḍāśakāryasyaiva uddeśyatvaṃ spaṣṭameva |
3|8|23, yattu bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ viśiṣṭāyājitaṃ dravyamapi sarvaṃ ṛtvarthameva iti pūrvapakṣa- yitvā arjanaṃ tāvat puruṣārthaṃ niyamo'pi adhvarthatve'pi puruṣārtha eva iti siddhāntitaṃ, tat
pratigrahaniyamasya phalakalpanāyāt kratvarthatve hiraṇyadhāraṇāderapi kratvarthatvāpatteḥ tena gatārtha- tvācca upekṣitam |

4|1|2, yattu bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ liṅgamuktaṃ spaṣṭādhākārasya dravyadānena vikalatvāt pūrvapakṣe parihānīya karmaṇi yajñapātrakaraṇakadāhānupapattiriti, tat pūrvapakṣe uddavanādyarthapātrāṇāṃ pṛthak sattvāt teṣāṃ ca yajñasādhanatvābhāve'pi āyudhaśabdābhāvena prayojakatvaiva yajñapātratvopapattyā dāhopapatteḥ upekṣitam |

4|1|4, yattu bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ pūrvapakṣe vājināśe ābhikṣānāśe iva punardavyānayanena vājinotpattiḥ, siddhānte tu ājyena samāpanamiti prayojanamuktaṃ, tat paṣṭhe havirśādādinimitte ājyena samāpanasya vidhivalena vakṣyamāṇatvena pūrvapakṣe'pi tulyatvāt upekṣitam |
4|1|9, sūtrādau (samānayanaṃ tu ityatra ) tu samānayanapadaṃ tatkālīnaprayājadyaparaṃ ājya- saṃskārakasya samānayanasya ājyaprayojakatvāsiddhāntānupapatteḥ |
4|1|15, sūtrāṇi ca sudhībhiḥ asminevārthe (svaraḥ prokṣaṇāderna prayojakaḥ ityarthe ) vyākhyeyāni, na tu bhāṣyakārokte (svaraḥ utpatterna prayojakaḥ ityarthe ) |
4|2|1, ‘na ca vaimṛdhavata asya (agnimārutaśastrasya ) anupātivākyatvāt, utpatti- vākye ca phalāpekṣayā prakaraṇāt kratvarthatvakalpanā iti mūloktaṃ yuktam |
utpattivākye tadepe- kṣāyāmapi iṣṭasāmānyasya bhāvyatvamaṅgīkṛtya vākyāntareṇa viniyogopapattau durbalapramāṇena aṅgatva- kalpanā'nupapatteḥ |
4|3|2, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa paurṇamāsyāmādhāne kṛte agnimāvāsyāyāṃ darśeṣyabhāvāt pūrva- pakṣe akaraṇaṃ ityuktaṃ, tat dvādaśarātripatramāne'pikṣe ādhānottaradine paurṇamāsakālābhāve ca bodhyam |

4|4|8, tattatpadārthānantaraṃ tattatpadārthāḥ ityevaṃ anekapadārthavṛttipaurvāparyasamudāyarūpatireva kramaḥ iti tu mūloktaḥ pakṣaḥ aśābdatvāt vikṛtau kā cit ekapadārthalope tāvatpadārthavṛtti- paurvāparyasamudāyāsambhavāt vyuktameṇānuṣṭhāne'pi vaiguṇyānāpatteḥ upekṣitaḥ |

5|1|1, yattu mūle vitatirūpakramapakṣameṅgīkṛtya sarvasyāpyasya ekavākyatvamityuktaṃ, tat aśābdāyāḥ vitatervidheyatvāyogyāt anekadīkṣodeśena vidhāne ca vākyabhedāpatteḥ unetṛdīkṣāyāṃ kartṛvidherāvaśyakatvācca upekṣitam |
5|1|9, ṛṣyādīnāṃ anāditvāt saṃsārasya pravarakaraṇādau ṛṣyantarasyāpi saṃbhavāt adhi- kāro'styeva iti bhāṣyoktaṃ anadhikārapratipādanamanādaraṇīyam |
yattu bhāṣye dvādaśaśate ṣaṭpañcāśadekena apareṇāpi tāvadeva ityevaṃ vibhāgaḥ kathitaḥ, sa dvādaśaśatasya vihitatvāt tatrāpi ubhayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭatvopapatteḥ upekṣitaḥ |
6|1|4, ‘svargakāmo yajeta’ ityādyekavacanaśravaṇe mūle tāvat ekatvamavivakṣitaṃ svargakāma- padasya svargamātraparatvāt |

adhikāriparatve'pi vā tasyoddeśyatvena tadviśeṣaṇatvāvivakṣitatvāt... eko dvau bahavaḥ kartāraḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ kṛtaḥ, tat phaloddeśyakasya vijātīyasya puruṣaprayatnyā- prāptatvena vidheyatvena tatratatra sthāpitatvāt tadviśeṣaṇatvasya kartṛkatvasya vivakṣopapatteḥ svargakāmapade tadavivakṣāyāmapi tatsāmānādhikaraṇye bādhakābhāvāt upekṣitam |

6|2|2, pratinidhivicāre kartavye mūle tāvat dravyasya kriyātaḥ atyantabhedābhāvāt dravya- bhede karmabhedāpatteḥ ityādinā pūrvapakṣe jagatītalavartinī ekaiva karmavyaktiḥ abhivyaktimātraṃ tu bhidyate ityādinā siddhāntitaṃ, tat dravyāśritatve'pi kriyāstadbhedai vaijātyasya śaṅkitumaśakya- tvāt vyaktyasyasiddhānte ca apūrvīpahanavāpatteḥ, tasyābhivyaktijanyatve yajipade tallakṣaṇā''patteḥ upekṣitam |
6|3|2, mūle ubhayavidhapratinidhapacāre adhikaraṇadvayaṃ kṛtaṃ, tat mayā spaṣṭatvādupekṣitam |
ekadeśanāśādau yadi avadānagrahaṇottaraṃ pātrīsthasya kumbhīsthasya vā nāśaḥ, tadā bhāṣyakāramate tāvat dravyadānasya haviṣtvāt śeṣakāryābhāve'pi tenaiva yāgaḥ |
vārtikakāra- mate tu yāvaniruptatrīhipāramitapuroḍāśasya yāvaddugdhaṃ sāṃnāyyasya ca haviṣtvāt havirnāśatvena pātrīsthanāśe'pi anyenaiva yāgaḥ |

6|4|1, yattu mūle kriyāntarapakṣe adhikaraṇatvena dadhipayasorvidhānāt laukikasyaiva asaṃskṛtasya dadhno grahaṇāpatteḥ darśaurdhyāditasya prasaktyabhāvaḥ ityuktaṃ, tat ‘saha śrapayati’ ityasya vaiyarthyāpattestulyatvena haviṣtvenaiva vidhānasyāvaśyakatvāt upekṣitam |

6|5|1, yattu atra bhāṣyakāreṇa pakṣāntaramuktaṃ ‘vibhajet’ ityanena nāpanayavidhiḥ, kintu pūrvayāgīyaṃ haviḥ vaikṛtaubhyo devatābhyo dadyāt iti sāmānyato vibhāgarūpaṃ dānaṃ upāṃśuyājī- yājayasādhāraṇyena vidhīyate |

tatra viśeṣavacanāt dravyāntarāṇāṃ vyavasthāyāmapi ājyasya sāmānyavākyādeva trimyo'pi dānaṃ iti’ tat apanayavidhyābhāve prakṛta- havirgrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt sāmānyavākyasyāpi karmāntaraviṣayakasāmānyāvidhitvāpatteḥ upekṣita- tam |
6|5|2, some dīkṣāsaṃkhyāviṣaye bhāṣyakārābhiprāyaṃ vārtikakārāśayaṃ ca pṛthaguktvā ubhaya- syāpi yuktā sūcitā māhe |

yattu mūle atideśasiddhyarthaṃ yajiprayuktatvaṃ vā dharmāṇāṃ, apūrvaprayuktatvaṃ vā iti cintāntaraṃ kṛtaṃ, tat yajiprayuktatve'pi prakṛtayajiprayuktatvopapatteḥ ; itarathā apūrvaprayuktatve'pi tadanāpatteḥ nāvāmikena paunarukyatāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
itaraśabdasya saṃnihitavācitvavat pūrvoktetarasadṛśavācitvamapi lokasiddhaṃ, ‘caitra- maitrayoḥ kambalkauśeye pradeye, itarat viṣṇumitrāya’ ityatra saṃnihitasyevetaratatsaddaśatvādereva pratīteḥ |

‘pañcasaptareṣu’ ityadhikaraṇe ( 7|1|17-21 ) sūtrakārabhāṣyakārayormata- muktvā vastutastu ityādinā tadviruddhaṃ kiṃ ciduktyā ato bhāṣyamanādṛtya vyākhyāyeyaṃ ityupa- kramya “agnidhanādivākyānāṃ aucityena atideśavidhitvastulyatvāt ‘netararthatvāt’ iti sūtraṃ vidhāyakāritiktāstanakarūpaprayojanakathanārtham |
tadeva ca atideśavākyasyāṅgavidhitvale liṅgaṃ iti liṅgadarśanasūtrasyārthaḥ |
ryaṃtarādhikaraṇe ‘anye tu bhāṣyasthāḥ pakṣāḥ asaṃbhavaduktikatvāt na likhitāḥ’ ityuktam |

‘bhāṣyakāraḥ saptabhiḥ sūtraiḥ ( 7|1|19-22 [ 20-23 ke. ], 23-25 [ 24-26 ke. ] ) adhikaraṇadvayameva vyākhyāyau’ ityupakramya vyākhyāya ante ‘ataḥ bhāṣya- kārate'pi na vārtikoktadūṣaṇāvakāśaḥ’ ityupasaṃhṛtam |
vastutastu yūpakārye khallevālīvidhānāt yūpaśabdasya na saṃskārādiśaktatvaṃ, saṃskārā- tideśastu sthānāpatyā iti sūtroktayūpatanto'pi asaṃgata eva |
bhāṣyakāroktaṃ asya ( sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet-- prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti ityasya ) vacanodāharaṇatvamapi pañcamavidhaprakārāpatteḥ āyuktam |
bhāṣyakārasya tu etādṛśaviṣaye ( guṇakāmeṣu ) phalotpatti manyamānasya abhiprāyaṃ na vidmaḥ |

yattu pārthasārathinā vārtikasvarasyāt āgneyatvamabhyupagamya ( abhimarśana-) mantrayoḥ dvyarthatvena vikalpān ekasmin āgneye pradhānāntarasāhityānurodhena prakṛtau vyavasthāyā- mapi vikṛtau tadabhāvena vyavasthākāraṇābhāvāt avyavasthitavikalpo mantrayoḥ iti siddhāntitaṃ, tat mantravikalpacintāyāḥ dvādaśe saṃgatatayā atideśavicārābhāvena adhyāyasaṃgatavyabhāvāpatteḥ āgneya- bhedasya ca sthāpitatvena aikyānupatteḥ upekṣitam |

janakasatrātre ‘catvāri trivṛntyahāni’ iti catvāryanūdya trivṛttvavidhānena trivṛ- tvasya utpannaśiṣṭatvena durbalatvāt satānāmapi ahanāṃ dvādaśāhikāntargatasasāha- vikāratvaṃ iti bhāṣyakārāmiprāyaḥ |
yāni cātra mūle anekāni varṇakāni kṛtāni, tāni punaruktatvāt anupayukta- tvācca upekṣitāni |

yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa aśvamedhe ‘traidhātavīyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati’ iti vacanena dīkṣa- ṇīyākārye yajamānasaṃskāre vihitāyāṃ traidhātavīyāyāṃ pūrvapakṣe dīkṣaṇīyādharmaprāptiḥ, siddhānte tu prasiddhatraidhātavīyāyā dharmā eveti prayojanamuktaṃ, tanna, pūrvapakṣavat siddhānte'pi sthānāpattau bādhakābhāvāt |

yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa māsāgnihotre taddārambhake upāṃśutvasya ūhaḥ iti prayojanamuktaṃ, tat nāmātideśaprāptitasya viruddhavyāviruddha vā svarasya satve codanāliṅgātideśaprāpitopāṃśu- tvāprāpyanupapatteḥ upekṣitam |
yadapi vārtikādau ‘purastādupasadāṃ saumyena pracaranti’ ityādī upāṃśutvohaḥ ityuktaṃ, tadapi saumyamātrapuraskāreṇa kalpitasyātideśasya sāmānyavihitopāṃśutvāti- deśāpekṣayā prābalyādupekṣitam |

yattu mūle pūrvapakṣe ( yajñaṃ tanviṣpantau vācaṃ yacchataḥ iti ) yajñaśabdasya vistāra- viśeṣaṇatvamanaṅgīkṛtya bhāgadharmatvamuktaṃ, tat yajñaśabdasya vistāraṃ vinā anyatrānvayasya durupapāda- tvāt bhāgavācakapadāśravaṇācca upekṣitam |
vṛttikāreṇa tāvat evaṃ siddhāntitaṃ -- na agnyādhānamārambhapadārthaḥ; kiṃtu ‘idaṃ mayā kartavyaṃ’ iti saṃkalpaparaparyāyaḥ adhyavasāyaviśeṣaḥ |
tadarthā anvārambhaṇīyā anvādhāna- rahitāyāpi vikṛtau satvāt kartavyaiva |
prakṛtau ca āghānāttaraṃ sarvayāvajjīvikaprayogagāṇāṃ sakṛ- deva saṃkalpakaraṇāt sakṛdeva anvārambhaṇīyā iti |
tanna, tattatkālāvyavasthitatattajjīvanāsyanimitta- vaśena tattannimittakasarvayāvajjīvikaprayogagāṇāṃ tattatkāle evopasthitatvena adhyavasāyāpattau sarva- sādhāraṇādhyavasāye pramāṇābhāvāt |
tasmāt evaṃ bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ siddhāntitaṃ- adhyavasāyavācī ārambhaśabdaḥ |
tadarthā anvārambhaṇīyā kartāramārambhayogyaṃ karoti, iti darśapūrṇamāsodeśyakāpravṛttapravartanavidhirūpaprathamaprayogīyādyapadārthaṃ ārambhaṇīyā |
sā ca prakṛtyarthaṃ sakṛt kāryā iti |
yattu mūle prathamaprayogārambhe kriyamāṇā ārambhaṇīyā sarvaprayogaṇāmupakaroti, ataḥ prathamaprayogārambhe kṛtaiva sarveṣāmupakārikā ityuktaṃ, tat anvārambhaṇīyājanyasyopakārasya yāva-
jīvasattve vikṛtiṣvapi prasaṅgāt upakārakatvāpatteḥ, asattve dvitīyādiprayoge'pi upakārakatvā- nāpatteḥ upekṣitam |

9|1|11, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa (devasya tvetyādinirvāpamantre) gauṇyā aśviśabdaḥ ādhāne aśvadānakaraṇāt daṃpattiparaḥ ityādinā nirvāpaviśeṣatvamupapāditaṃ, tat vede āropakapuruṣā- bhāvāt āhāryāropābhāvamabhipretya |
9|1|12, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa 'barhiṣpiṭṭheṣu mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ' iti liṅgamapi pragrayane evo- papadyate |
atra hi na yathāśrutaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate bādhāt |

ato jaghanyamādhyaṃdinasavana- pade eva lakṣaṇāṅgīkṛtya mādhyaṃdinasavanasaṅghabhūtā yāḥ sāmavede samāmnātāḥ, tāḥ paṣṭhiḥ ityarthāvagatiḥ ityuktaṃ, tat lakṣaṇāyā āvaśyakatve lāghavāt mādhyaṃdinasavanastotrīyāṇāmeva lakṣaṇāt (dāśata- yībhyaḥ) ānītānāmapi tattvopapatteḥ upekṣitam |
9|1|6 varṇakaṃ 2, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa anyayorvā anuṣṭhumoḥ samānayanaṃ pragrayanaṃ vā iti cintitaṃ, tat paunaruktyāpatteḥ upekṣitam |

9|1|6 varṇakaṃ 2, bhāṣyakārīyaṃ naudhasagrahaṇaṃ naudhasasmārakabrāhmaṇācchaṃsitopalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tasya bṛha- tsāmapṛṣṭhatvena śyatasyaiva prasaktau naudhasaprasaktyabhāvāt, gavāmayane abhīvartasyaiva brahmasāmatvena viśiṣṭa vihitatvāt |
9|1|6 varṇakaṃ 4, mūle tatkāryakāritvarūpāṃ sthānāpattiṅgīkṛtya tasyāḥ pañcavidhatvamuktam |
yadyapi ca sarvatra vidhaureva sthānāpattau bījaṃ, tathāpi tatsahakārīṇi pañca iti pañcavidhatvam |
9|1|11, mūloktaṃ sthānāpannatvaṃ nirasya mūloktodāharaṇāmāpi āyuktatvaṃ pratipādya 'ato mūloktaprakārā- nupapatteḥ evaṃ vācyaṃ' ityuktvā prakārāntaraṃ uktaṃ udāharaṇāni ca vivṛtāni bhāṣye |
9|1|11, bhāṣyakāreṇa kaṇṭharaṃtere bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ aviruddhasaṃmīlanādidharmāṇāṃ samuccayaḥ viruddhacaiṣṇavādīnāṃ tu vikalpaḥ iti iṣṭāpatyaiva samāhitam |
vārtikakārastu saṃmīlanādīnāṃ aicchiko vikalpa eva (na samuccayaḥ) ityāha |
9|1|15, yattu mūle prakṛtāveva nāvatrātasya tattvena vidheyatā, api tu apūrvasādhanaviśeṣo- pāyatvena ityuktaṃ, tanna, tathātve prakṛtāveva vrīhiparyāyāṇāṃ vidalanādeśānuṣṭhāne vaiguṇyāpatteḥ |

yattu mūle etatpakṣasādhanārthaṃ (paḍviṃśatirasya vaṅkyaḥ ityatra śrutapadasyāvṛttiḥ iti pakṣasya) paḍviṃśatisaṃkhyāpaśumyasaṃbandhapradhānamidaṃ vākyaṃ pratipaśu bhedena tatsaṃbandhaṃ prakāśayituṃ abhyasanīyaṃ iti yuktirupapannatā, sā saṃvandhasya paṣṭhyarthasya guṇatvena prādhānyaśaṅkā'nupapatteḥ |
vākyārtharūpasya ca aśābdatvena sūtratāṃ tadanupapatteḥ, prādhānye'pi ca tasya pratipūhane'pi prakāśanopapatteḥ abhyāse pramāṇābhāvāt upekṣitā |
atra ca (9|1|7|21 sūtreṣu) sūtravyākhyā'nurodhena kiñcidailakṣyaṇyeṇa bhāṣya- kāreṇa aikādhikaraṇyaṃ vārtikakāreṇa ca adhikaraṇadvayamāśritaṃ, tat prameyamātralekhanapravṛttena mayā upekṣitam |

9|1|12, bhāṣyakārādibhireva samāhitaṃ (praśasā bāhū ityatra) pratyakṣavihitasvadhitisattve māntravarṇikaśāsavidhikalpanāyāṃ gauravāt praśāsāpadaṃ praśastatvaparameva iti, tacca svayameva 'daśa prayājāniṣṭvā āha śāsamāhara' iti vākyasya likhitatvāt śāsasyāpi paśau vihitatvena upe- kṣitam |

9|1|14, yattu mūle varṇakāntareṇa 'prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ' ityudāhṛtya kṛṣṇaleṣu vitṛptībhāvarūpaprayojanābhāvāt avaghātasya bādhaḥ ityuktaṃ, tat kṛṣṇalānāṃ pradeyacaruprakṛtitvaṃ kṛtvācintyā |
10|1|1, sautrāmaṇyāṃ āśvinādidevatyasya prākṛtameva kāryaṃ, aindrāgnādidevatyasya tu aprākṛta- miti sūtrabhāṣyakārayorbhiprāyaḥ |
vārtikakārastu guṇāt karmāntarameva prākṛtapaśupuroḍāśakāryapanaṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtikaṃ vidhīyate iti |

10|1|19, yattu mūle yatra yajamānasya guṇatvaṃ, tatra asnnāmeva śukrānvārambhādī anetanāmapi anvārambhānukūlasthiniṣṭhavyāpārāśrayatayā kartṛtvopapatteḥ asthibhaiva anvārambhādi kāryamityuktaṃ, tatredaṃ vācyaṃ, prakṛtau hi yajamānapadavācyo yāgakartā jīvātmaiva kartṛtvenogyate |
ātmanaśca kartṛtvaṃ kṛtvāśrayatvenaiva, na ca mṛtasya tādṛśakartṛtvāsaṃbhavaḥ |
ato varaṃ pradhāne eva anumatitaddārakaṃ mṛtātmakartṛtvamupapāya acyurṇaiva te kāryaḥ iti |
10|1|18, yattu mūle prākṛtaguṇakānāṃ mṛtādhikārapakṣe apravṛttirityuktaṃ, tat aṣṭame eva teṣāṃ vikṛtau apravṛtterityuktatvāt, kṛtvācintyā kathane prayojanābhāvāt upekṣitam |
bārhaspatye satadaśaśarāve saṃkhyānurodhāt sapādacatuḥśarāvaparimitaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā tena caturvāraṃ nirvāpaḥ ityarthaḥ bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ karkādimiśra sarvairnirṇitaḥ |
mama tu pratibhāti sākṣātsādhanībhūtāgnihotrahavaṇayāḥ muṣṭīnāṃ ca bādhāpekṣayā saṃkhyāyā ekaikasyāḥ muṣṭiparicchedadvārā nirvāpasādhanībhūtāyāḥ bādha ucitaḥ |
10|1|27, loke pūrvaṃ hi cidagrahaṇāṃ yavānāṃ bharjanottaraṃ punaravādhānalaprasiddheḥ prayojanānurodhena prākṛtakramaṃ bādhitvā'pi bharjanottaraprāptaṃ : sadharmakaṃ : kartavyaḥ iti bhāṣyabhiprāyaḥ |
ato yathāprakṛtyaiva avaghātasya bharjanāta pūrvameva anuṣṭhāno- papatteḥ nātra dhānā udāharaṇaṃ api tu manyaḥ iti |

10|2|33, yattu atra bhāṣyakāreṇa śyene 'nīvītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' ityājñātena prayogā- jhabhūtakartṛsaṃskārakeṇa nīvītena atideśaprāptasya sarvakarmārthatvena vihitasya copavītasya bādhamāśa- ṅkya adyarthatvāt samuccayaḥ iti siddhāntitaṃ, tacca asyādyarthatve śrāddhādāvapi prācīnavītena saha upavītasya samuccayāpatteḥ |

yadapi ‘saṃsthite ṣaḍahe maghāśayet’ iti vihitamaśvaśanena prākṛtapayotratasya tasminnahani nivṛtti- māśāṅkya adyarthatvādeva samuccaya ityuktaṃ, tat maśvaśanesya dehavṛttyanarhatvena payovratakāryakāri- tvānupapatteḥ pūrvapakṣotthānābhāvāt sutyāyāṃ payovratābhāvācca upekṣitam |

10|4|11, agnisāṃ dvirātre 'vaikhānasaṃ pūrvairhan sāma bhavati, ṣoḍasyuttare' ityatra vṛttikāreṇa ṣoḍasyuttare ityayamapūrvavidhiḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā 'ṣoḍasyuttare' ityanena 'uttarehan dvimātrasya' ityasyopasaṃhārāt dvimātrāntare ṣoḍaśigrahaṇavikalpasya bādhaḥ iti siddhāntitam |
bhāṣyakāreṇa tu upasaṃhāraḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā stāvakatvaṃ iti siddhāntitam |

10|5|13, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa aupadeśikīṃ tryanīkāmāmuktaiva ātideśikīṃ dvādaśāhikīṃ navāhaḥsaṃbandhinīṃ tryanīkāṃ gāvāmayanepūrvapakṣasi prāptāmudāhṛtya daṇḍakalitavadāvṛtyā pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā svasthānavivṛddhisiddhānto liṅgadarśanaṃ ca vyākhyātam |
dvādaśāhāntargatadaśāhapravṛ- ttereva sarvavikṛtiṣu sādhitatvena navāhaḥsaṃbandhinīkāmāprāpteḥ ayuktisahatvāt |
ataḥ yathā- vārtikaṃ aupadeśikīṃ tryanīkāmādāyaiva adhikaraṇaṃ yojyam |

etāvattu vārtikakārate'pi cinta- nīyaṃ- yatra prakṛtau nyūnabhāgavṛttidharmaḥ, vikṛtau ca sa bhāgaḥ adhikadinaghaṭitaḥ, adhikāni ca dināni na prākṛtatadbhāgaprakṛtikāni yathā atraiva aupadeśikatryanīkābhāve kṛtvācintayā, tatra tadbhāgadharmaprāptiḥ kathamiti |
10|5|25, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa (maśvaśasya) prakaraṇāt dvādaśāhāhvayamityuktaṃ, tat vaimṛdhe'pi tadāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
yadapi tena maśvaśasya yāṃ ca yāvatīṃ ca mātrāṃ tṛptijananāt taduttara- kartavyadarthopakārakatvapratīteḥ dvādaśāhāhvayaṃ ityuktaṃ, tadapi tathālye tādṛśadvitripadārthamātrā- jñāvāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
10|8|10, sūtrabhāṣyorapi asminnarthe (svāhākāraṣaṭkārayorvasthitavikalpaḥ ityarthe ) yojanā sudhībhiḥ ihonneyā |

yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa idaṃ 'savyā vā etarhi vapā0' iti liṅgaṃ akarmāntaratve prayāja- śeṣasya ṛtupaśuvāpyabhidhāreṇa riktatvāt anabhibhūtatvaṃ yujyate, karmāntaratve tu tadarthaṃ punaḥ prayājakaraṇāt tenaiva tadpā'bhidhāreṇopapatteḥ anabhibhūtatvadarśanaṃ na yuktamiti vyākhyātaṃ, tat karmāntaratvapakṣe'pi mādhyandinakālīnapaśupuroḍāśasavanīyahaviṣābhiva savanīyatantramadhyāpattivena prasāṅgatyā prayājapunaḥkaraṇānāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
11|2|11, bhāṣyakāreṇa tāvat agneḥ sarvārthatvāt sāṅgapradhānārthaḥ agniyogaḥ, ataḥ anervimokaḥ sarvānte eva kāryaḥ iti pūrvapakṣiśate pradhānānte eva vimokaḥ iti siddhāntitam |
vārtikakāraṇaṃ tu bhāṣyakārokyayuktyaiva pradhānamātrārthatvamabhiyogasya pūrvapakṣīkṛtya sāṅgapradhānārthatvasiddhānte eva sūtrāṇi vyākhyātāni |

11|3|19, yattu codakaprayogavidhyorubhayoḥ sattve'pi prayojanābhāvāt ( paśupuroḍāśe ājyabhāgādīnāṃ ) nānuṣṭhānaṃ iti prābhākaramataṃ, tat vidhinā vihitasya guṇaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasya prayājāderanuṣṭhāne vihitaguṇābhāvena prayojanalābhābhāvātpatteḥ upekṣitam |
yattu asminnadhikaraṇe mūle prayogavidhimaṅgīkṛtya codakalopena pūrvapakṣakaraṇaṃ, codakāṅgīkāreṇa prayogavidhimātrātlopena ca siddhāntakaraṇaṃ, tat niryuktikatvāt prayojanābhāvācca upekṣitam |

12|1|12, yattu atra sūtrakārādibhiḥ aṅgīkṛtyaiva dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ pradhānamātrārthatvaṃ pradhānadeva- tāyāṃ vaiśvadevagṛhītāyāṃ viśvaśandasya sarvavācitvaṃ sarvebhāmeva devānāṃ devatātvapratīteḥ aṅgedevatānāmapi tatparigraheṇa parigrahāt prasaṅgopapattiḥ iti samāhitaṃ, tat viśvadeva- śabdasya 'ādityaviśvevasaḥ' iti trikāṇḍīsmaraṇena gaṇaviśeṣe rūḍhatvāgateḥ dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ devatāparigrahāryatvapakṣe pradhānamātrārthatve pramāṇābhāvācca upekṣitam |

12|1|12, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa pañcadaśarātre agniṣṭuti prathamāhe bhūyo'nugrahāya aindrī kāryā ityuktaṃ, tat subrahmaṇyā''hvānasya devatāprakāśanārthatvāt indraprakāśana ca agniprakāśanarūpakārya- siddherevāt bhedenaiva ubhayadevatyasubrahmaṇyākaraṇāvagateḥ upekṣitam |

12|1|17, vṛttikārāntareḥ bhūyastvaṃ na mukhyatvasyāpavādakaṃ, kiṃtu paśukāmeṣṭyāmeva bhūyastvena pūrvapakṣamidhāya mukhyatvena siddhāntayitvā aikādhikaraṇyena sūtradvayaṃ vyākhyeyamityuktaṃ, tat loke prathamaṃ alpamūlyāvaruddhasyāpi durgasya paścādāgatairapi bahubhirbhāradharpaṇāt upekṣitam |

12|1|18, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa somānte 'saṃsthite yajñe prastaraṃ praharati savastraṃ' iti pāśuka- svaroḥ pratipattidarśanādapi savanīyapaśutantrasya vitatatvaṃ ityuktaṃ, tat svaroḥ paśutrayasādhāraṇatvādeva ante pratipattidarśanenopapatteḥ nāsādhāraṇaṃ savanīyatantravitatatve liṅgaṃ ityupekṣitam |
12|1|12, yattu sūtrakāreṇa evaṃvidhaṃ ( paśupuroḍāśatantreṇa sviṣṭakṛti nirguṇasyaivāgneḥ prāptau sviṣṭakṛcchandapratiprasavārthatvena 'agnaye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' ityasya sārthakyaṃ iti yaduktaṃ
tav ) uktvā dhātvartha evātra vidhīyate, sviṣṭakṛcchabdastu avivakṣitārthaḥ iti prakārāntaramuktaṃ, tat prauḍhimātram |

12|3|2, yattu atra bhāṣyakoraṇa sūryodayāt pūrvaṃ agnihotrahomākaraṇe prāyaścittadravyānnānu- dāhaṃtaṃ, tat uditahomināṃ kālātikramanimittadoṣanirvātārthatvopapatteḥ itarathā anuditahomināṃ sarvadā prāyaścittakaraṇāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
12|3|6. yadidaṃ śabarācāryeṇa vṛttikṛtāṃ, vārtikakāreṇa śabarācāryasya bhāṣyakārasya, bhāṭṭa- dīpikayā ca vārtikakārasyāpi kriyācidvanyākaraṇamudāhṛtaṃ, na tatra kiṃ chidrisamayāvaham |
ā ca mānavānāmutpatteḥ ā ca mānavānāmatāt prācīnaiḥ sākaṃ navyānāṃ kalahaḥ satatambhūt bhavati bhaviṣyati ca |
navyā hi prācīnamavagāhya tatra kāṃścit vidyamānān- vidyamānāni vā doṣān svasaṃmatasūkṣmekṣikayopalabhante |
tāṃśca doṣān pariharantaḥ navīnaṃ kaṃ cit siddhāntaṃ narvānāṃ vā kāṃ cidvacanāṃ saṃsthāpayanti pūrvasiddhāntasādhikāṃ vā yukti parivarta- yanti |
anenaiva nyāyena nāstikā āstikān āstikā vā nāstikān dūṣayanti |
nāstikā api parasparaṃ kalahāyante eva, evamāstikā api |
kāpilamataṃ kāṇabhujabhebhyo na rocate, kāṇa- bhujamapi akṣapādādibhyebhyaḥ sarvāṃśe na rocate, etat tritayamapi mīmāṃsakebhyo na rocate |
mīmāṃsake- ṣvapi prācīnān vṛttikārān bhāṣyakāro na sahate, bhāṣyakāraṃ vārtikakāraḥ, vārtikakāraṃ ca navyamīmāṃsakaḥ khaṇḍadevaḥ |
punaśca bhavadevaṃ pārthasārathiḥ nirasyati, pārthasārathiṃ ca khaṇḍadevaḥ, khaṇḍadevaṃ ca keṣu cidaṃśeṣu advaitanihantikāro murārimiśraḥ |
sarveṣveva hi śāstreṣu navyaprācīnayo- rnitya eva kalahaḥ |
na cedaṃ navyatvaṃ prācīnatvaṃ ca kiṃcikālāvacchedena rājamudrāmudritaṃ niśvi- tam |
ye adya navyāḥ, te śvaḥ prācīnā bhavanti |
ye pārisaṃvatsare navyāḥ, te parutsaṃvatsare prācīnāḥ, ye ca parut navyāḥ, te aiṣamo'bde prācīnāḥ |
kālacakraṃ hi yathāyathā parivartate tathātathā buddhayo'pi parivartante eva |
āścaryaṃ tu etāvadeva, yat parivṛmbhamadapi sarvamidaṃ sthiraṃ manyāmaha iti |
navyanavyamīmāṃ- sakaiḥ prācīnaprācīnamīmāṃsakamataparivartanamudāharatāsmākamayamevābhiprāyo yat mīmāṃsā'pi śāstrāntarīti nāstikāmatīti |
yajñānuṣṭhānādau ke cit padārthā mīmāṃsakaiḥ anyathā pratipādyante yājñikaistu anyathā |
yājñikāḥ kila svasvīyakalpasūtrānusāreṇa kiṃ cit svatantrameva nirṇayakaṃ śāstraṃ nirmimate, mīmāṃsāsiddhāntāśca na tathā manyante |
tatra kāni cit sthalāni bhāṣyādau nirdiṣṭāni |
tatra bhāṭṭadīpikākāreṇa anekatra yājñikasiddhāntāḥ dūṣitāśca ka cit bhūṣitāśca |
saṃkalpa- kāṇḍīyabhāṭṭacandrikāsthānyapi kāni cit tatpragrahake nirdiśyante |
tadetanna rocante yājñikāḥ ūhaṃ kurvanti 'anna āgaccha rohitāśca bṛhaddāno dhūmaketo vicarṣaṇe' iti |
bhā. 9|1|15|42-44. 'iṣe tvā' ityādi chinadmi ityādikaṃ padaṃ prayogakāle yājñikairnānuṣṭhīyate |
ke cittu avyāhatasyāpi uccāraṇamastyeva, yājñikānāṃ tu tadanuṣṭhānaṃ anāstaya iti |
yājñikānuṣṭhānaṃ cet tarhi tena astu saḥ |
( sarvatraiva ekapātre kartṛbhede iva eka- kartārī kāraṇabhede'pi yukto bhakṣaṇasya pṛthaganuṣṭhāne samuccayaḥ |
hāriyojane tu mā'stu samuccayaḥ iti prāguktam |
) bhāṭṭa. 3|5|10, antimasya camasabhākṣayituḥ nānujñāgrahaṇaṃ prayojanābhāvāt, yājñikāstu āca- ranti |
( mīmāṃsāyāṃ yadyapi samākhyābhakṣo na nirṇītaḥ saṃdehābhāvāt tathāpi na virodhaḥ |
vistare ca 3|5|11 adhikaraṇe pūrvapakṣāvasare ukta eva ) |
yājñikāstu dvigrādameva vadanti ( darśa palāśaśākhāyā āharaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ bhavati |
tatra vṛkṣasya prāgadeśabhavāṃ prācīṃ śākhāṃ āharati ityarthaḥ iti mīmāṃsā |
vihārāt prācyāṃ diśi yo vṛkṣaḥ, tasya śākhāṃ prācīṃ āharati ityarthaḥ iti yājñikā vadanti ) |
caruśrapaṇārthamapi praṇītāḥ kartavyā iti yājñikā vadanti ) |
4|2|5, yājñikāstu yatra sūryāvartanāt prāk pratipat pañcadaśī ca, tasminneva dine vikṛtayaḥ kāryāḥ, na tu pūrvadine pañcadaśyāṃ ityāhuḥ |
yājñikaiḥ dhūrtasvāmyādibhiḥ āvartana- tatpūrvasambandhoḥ prakṛtyanuṣṭhānānantaraṃ saṃvidhine eva vikṛtyanuṣṭhānaṃ ityādyuktam |
5|4|7, yājñikānāṃ sāṃnāyyasya somāt prāgapi anuṣṭhānaṃ yat, tat śākhāntare sāṃnāyyasya agnīṣomayoḥ prāgapi vidhānādavagantavyam |
5|4|8, yājñikāstu tāṃ ( mīmāṃsakamaryādāṃ ) na manyante ( aṅguppraparvyanunāvanayanīyātiriktā- vayavanāśe tu bhavatyeva ājyena yāgaḥ |
6|4|1, yājñikamate tu 'yadi prattadevataṃ ( haviḥ naśyet ) ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayet' ityāpa- stambavacanāt avadheyam |
( yadi agrattadevataṃ haviḥ vyāpayet, anyat haviḥ tadaivatyaṃ nirvapet' iti āpastambīyaṃ prāktanaṃ vākyam |
yājñikāstu darśapaurṇamāsayoścandrāmyudaye padārthaikadeśasyāpi ārthikavidhihitva- tatvamaṅgīkṛtya avaśiṣṭanirvāpaṃ vaikṛtībhya evānutiṣṭhanti |
6|5|5, yājñikācārāt yatra varuṇapraghāseṣu sugantarotpattiprasaktiḥ, tatraiva hiraṇmayatva- śamīmayavādeḥ vicchoyitayena dakṣiṇavihāre eva tanniveśāt aindrāgnaikapālayorapi na hiraṇmayatvā- tideśaḥ |
7|1|5, yājñikāstu paśuvandhavat ( madhyamaparvoragnipraṇayane ) saumikāneva dharmānanu- tiṣṭhanti |
( pūrvagranthastu asādhāraṇadharmāṇāṃ sādhāraṇadharmāṇāṃ ca navaprayājatvaprasūnamayatvādīnāṃ cātideśaḥ ityādiḥ cāturmāsyaviṣayako vicāraḥ |
vakṣyati ca ' patnyabhāve tejādi luṣyate ' iti |
karmacodanā api yaja- mānamedhādhikurvanti, na patnīṃ ' brāhmaṇo'gnimādadhīta ' ' yajeta svargakāmaḥ ' ityādayaḥ |
bahuvṛca- brāhmaṇe coktaṃ ' tasmātpatnīko'pi agnihotramāharet ' iti |
kiṃca udghāṭitametat kalpāntara- kāraiḥ patnyabhāve'pi agnibhāvaṃ vadādbhiḥ |
bharadvājāstāvata ' atha yadapatnīkaḥ syāt, ubhābhyāṃ tasya saṃskāraḥ aupāsanāgnihotrābhyām ' iti |
tathā talavakārakalpe jaiminiḥ ' āhitāgneścet putraṃ jāyā mriyeta, enāṃ nirmanthyena dahet saṃtapanena vā ' iti |
tathā ' āhāyeṃ anāhitāgniṃ patnīṃ ca ' ityāśvalāyanaḥ |
kiṃca ācāro'pyatra dṛṣṭaḥ śiṣṭatānāṃ pūrveṣāṃ yathā kaṇvavibhāṇḍaka- bhīṣmādīnāṃ, yathā ca bhagavato dāśaratheḥ |

kiṃca sahādhikāro'pi patnyāḥ yajamānasāmyaṃ tāvannā- styeva yathoktaṃ mīmāṃsakaḥ ' tasyā yāvaduktamāśīrbrahmacaryamatulyatvāt ' iti ( 6|1|24 ) tasmāt siddhaṃ abhāve'pi patnyāḥ, na karmaṇāṃ nivṛttiriti |
( etena mīmāṃsā- vārtikakāraiḥ : bhāṇḍakarāmacandrabhīṣmādīnāṃ yajñakaraṇe 1|1|3 adhikaraṇe sadācāraprāmāṇya- vicāre kṛtā carcā vyākhyātā |
āprayaṇaidya upadiṣṭavāsovasadakṣiṇayā prākṛtānyāhāryadakṣiṇāyāḥ bādhaḥ mīmāṃsāyāṃ ( 10|3|7 ) pratipāditaḥ |

baudhāyanena tu śyāmākāprayaṇe ' anvāryamāsāha vāso dadāti ' iti, brīhyāprayaṇe ca ' anvāryamāsāha prathamajaṃ vatsaṃ dadāti ' ityuktvā yavāprayaṇe ' samānaṃ karma yathā trīhyāprayaṇasya ' iti atideśaḥ kṛtaḥ |
tena vāsaso vatsasya ca yathāyathaṃ dakṣiṇātvena sattve'pi anvāryadakṣiṇāyāḥ samuccaya uktaḥ |
' dakṣiṇāsu samuccīyate vāsaḥ, śyāmāke ' iti liṅgāt |
ādhāre dhārāyāṃ cādisaṃyogaḥ iti na prasmartavyam |
mīmāṃsāyāṃ tu ādhāre 1|2|1|2 adhikaraṇe, dhārāyāṃ ca 1|2|1|1 adhikaraṇe karmādiḥ mantrādiśca saṃni- pātyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ, karmādirmantrāntaśca saṃnipātyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ kṛtaḥ |

ādhānasya somapūrvapakṣe ' yaḥ somena yajamānaḥ agnīnādadhīta, natu pṛcchet na nakṣatram ' iti vacanāt somasya kālabādhaḥ iti ' svakāle syādavipratiṣedhāt ' ( 5|1|5 19-6 ) ityadhikaraṇe mīmāṃsakaḥ pratipāditam |
rudradatta āha- somakālasya anena bādhaṃ manyante tadyuktaṃ, prakaraṇāt ādhānakālasya anena bādhavāgamāt, nakṣatragrahaṇācca |
nahi somasya kiṃ cit nakṣatramupadiṣṭaṃ yena tat niṣidhyeta |
ādhānakālaḥ ' varṇāṃśca rathakārasya ' ' ye trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ etat karma kuryuḥ ' teṣāmeṣa kālaḥ |
triṣu varṇeṣu antarbhūtā eva svarcikaśritāḥ ye rathaṃ kurvanti teṣāmayamādhānakālaḥ |
mīmāṃsāyāṃ tu rathakārādhikaraṇe ( 6|1|12 | 44-50 ) rathakāro na traivarṇikaḥ kiṃtu jātiviśeṣo'yam |
' māhiṣyeṇa karaṇāṃ tu rathakāraḥ prajāyate ' iti yājñavalkyaḥ |
vaiśyāyāṃ kṣatriyādutpanno māhiṣyaḥ, śūdrāyāṃ vaiśyādutpannā karaṇī |
iṣṭau ' svonaṃ te sadanaṃ karomi ' ityādiḥ ardharcadhyātmako mantraḥ pātrāyāṃ ājyo- pastaraṇājñatayā baudhāyanenoktaḥ ( 1|14 ) |
āpastambasatyāṣāḍhau tu ( satyā. 1|27|1 ) pūrvārdhamātreṇa upastaraṇāparaparyāyaṃ puroḍāśasya sadanakaraṇaṃ, uttarārdhamātreṇa ca puroḍāśasya tatra āsādanamāhatuḥ |
mīmāṃsāyāṃ ca balāvalādhikaraṇāntargate liṅgavākyādhikaraṇe vākyāt liṅgasya balīyastvena āpastambavadeva siddhāntitaṃ na baudhāyanavat |
' ājyahavirpāśuyājaḥ paurṇamāsyāmeva bhavati vaiṣṇavo'gnīṣomīyaḥ prājāpatyo vā ' |
baudhāyanādibhiḥ amāvāsyāyāmapi upāṃśuyājavidhānāt tannirāsārthaḥ : paurṇa- māsyāmeva ityevakāraḥ |
idaṃ sarvaṃ ' dharmādvā syāt prajāpatiḥ ' ityadhikaraṇe ( 10|8|17|51-61 ) pratipāditaṃ mīmāṃsāyām |
āpastambakalpe tu sa na kartavya ityanyadetat |
aikṣavyau ikṣuparṇe, kāśamūle iti ke cit iti rudradattaḥ |
ikṣuśalāke ikṣutvagātmike, ikṣupatrātmike iti ke cit iti jyotsnā |
mīmāṃsāvārtike tu ' aikṣavyau vidhṛtī ye ca te ikṣvavayavātmike |
loke siddhe, tathā kāśānāmeva mūlake ' iti kāśamūlatvameva siddhā- ntitam |
atra punargauttama ( satyā. 7|3|15 ) vākyaśeṣasya atrāmāvāt kāśamūlatve pramāṇa- bhāvena laukika evārtho grāhyaḥ iti satyāṣāḍhamatāśayaḥ |
āśvalāyasya kāśaparatve vākyaśeṣo yathā spaṣṭo'sti tathā aikṣavyaśabdasya kāśamūlatve vākyaśeṣo ( yadyapi ) nāsti, tathāpi anveṣaṇīyaḥ iti mīmāṃsakamatāśayaḥ |
' teṣāṃ ye vihārasaṃyuktāḥ āhitāgnestān pratīyat, ubhayo- ritarān ' |
teṣāṃ caturhotṝṇāṃ madhye ye vihārasaṃyuktā bhavanti yathā ' darśapūrṇamāsāvālabhamānaḥ caturhotāraṃ ' ityādayaḥ, te āhitāgtereva bhavanti |
ye tu vihāreṇa asaṃyuktāḥ yathā ' yaḥ kāmayeta prajāyeteti ' ityādiṣu daśahotrādayaḥ, te āhitāgneranāhitāgneśca bhavanti |
tatra āhitāgneḥ āhavanīye aupāsane vā homaḥ |
mīmāṃsāyāṃ tu ( 6|8|1|9-10 ) caturhotṛmoheṣu anāhitāgnerevādhikāraḥ iti siddhāntitam |
bharadvājasvāha so'yaṃ nāsaṃnayato vidhate ityekaṃ, vidhate ityaparaṃ iti |
mīmāṃsāyāṃ tu ( 6|5|1|21-24 ) ' sāṃnāyyasaṃyogātsaṃnayataḥ syāt ' iti pūrvapakṣayitvā ' auṣadhasaṃyogādubhayoḥ ' iti saṃnayada-
candramyuditeṣṭau kṛtāyāṃ 'punarijayāyāstu vikalpaḥ ; taduktaṃ 'ekāmeva yajeta, dve eva yajeta' iti |

" ityuktvā punarāha rudradatta: "nirastaviṣaye trayo'mī śāstrāntarakalpā uktā bhavanti yathā prakṛtimaiva avikṛtāṃ kṛtvā tathaiva punaryajeta, abhyuditeṣṭiṃ vā kṛtvā prakṛtyā punaryajeta, aupavasathyamātraṃ vā vardhayitvā paścāt yajeta iti |
śāstradīpikāyāṃ ca 'tasmānna vikalpo niyatamevābhighāraṇaṃ' iti siddhāntitam |
'yajño dākṣāyaṇasya' iti mānavavacanāt, sārvaseniyajñaḥ vāsiṣṭhayajñaḥ śaunakayajñaḥ ityādibhivairpyayogācca ityāha |
'etayaivavātā niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet' (niṣādo mṛgayātakattuḥ, sthapatirmahattaraḥ, niṣādasau sthapatiśca) |
saiva ca yāvadarthaṃ asyābhividhe api ākṣipyate |
palyāḥ yāvaduktameva karma sarvatra iti nyāyavidaḥ |
) bharadvājena tu uktaṃ 'ātmasaṃskārā vapana- varjaṃ palyāḥ' iti |
paśvekādaśinyāṃ 'pratipaśu vahnīṣi vapāśrapaṇyaḥ kumbhyaḥ hṛdayaśūlāśca' iti (āpastamba-) sūtram |

tatra rudradatta āha- nanu 'ekajātīye paśugaṇe kumbhyādīnāṃ tantraṃ, nānājātīye bhedaśca paribhāṣāpāyāmuktaḥ, nyāyavidviśrauktaṃ 'paśugaṇe kumbhiśūlavapāśrapaṇānāṃ prabhu- tvāt tantrabhāvaḥ syāt' iti (11|4|8|33 jai.) |
tathā 'jālmanteṣu tu bhedaḥ syāt pakti- vaiṣamyāt' (jai. 10|4|10|40) iti |
yatra ekajātīyā api paśavaḥ nānādevatā bhavanti yathā saptadaśa prājāpatyāḥ, tatrāyaṃ vidhiḥ |
yatra tu ekajātīyāḥ samānadevatā bhavanti yathā saptadaśa prājāpatyāḥ, tatra tantratvaṃ iti vivekaḥ |
punarādhāne paunarādheyikībhiradakṣiṇābhiḥ agnyādheyīkanāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ bādhaḥ iti mīmāṃsāyāṃ 'agnyādheyasya naimittike guṇavikāre' ityadhikaraṇe (10|3|5|20-23)
āpastambīye tu 'ubhayārdakṣiṇā dadāti agnyādheyīkīḥ paunarādheyīkaśca' iti vihitam |
'anūyamāne sūktavāke marutāṃ pṛṣatayaḥ stha iti saha śākhayā prastaraṃ āhavanīye praharati' |
sūktavāko nāma iṣṭadevatāsaṃkīrtanārthaḥ 'idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī' ityanuvākaḥ, tadanuvacanakāle prastaraṃ praharati |
'na svāhā karoti' marutāṃ pṛṣatayaḥ stha iti mantre svāhākāraṃ na karoti |
nanu ajuhotitvādeva aprāpte svāhākāre kiṃ pratiṣedhena ? satyaṃ na prāta:, tathāpi paramatena āśaṅkitaḥ pratiṣidhyate |
etaddhi mataṃ jaiminīnāṃ- asti yāgavidhiḥ 'sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati' iti |
tatra yājyāsthānīyaḥ sūktavākaḥ, prastaro dravyaṃ, māntravarṇikyo devatāḥ, praharatiśca yajatyarthaḥ iti |
prastarapratipattestu kālavidhiḥ iti sūtrakṛtaḥ (āpastambasya) abhi- prāyaḥ |
mīmāṃsāyāṃ sūktavāka- nyāye (2|1|5|11-15) 'sūktavāke ca kālavidhiḥ' ityadhikaraṇe idaṃ matamuktam |
āpa- stambamate ca 'anūyamāne śaṃyuvāke āhavanīye paridhīn praharati' ityapi samānamudāharaṇam |
apivā ekaṃ dvau trīn pañca' apivā yathāsaṃbhavaṃ mantrakṛto vṛṇīte, ekaṃ ekārṣeyasya, trīn tryārṣeyasya, pañca pañcārṣeyasyeti |
tathā cāśvalāyanaḥ 'yajamānasyārṣeyān pravṛṇīte yāvantaḥ syuḥ' iti (1|3|1) |
anye tu pañcārṣeyāṇāmapi trayāṇāmeva varaṇaṃ, ekārṣeyadvayāryeyayostu karmaṇi anadhikāra eva, 'ekaṃ vṛṇīte dvau vṛṇīte iti tritvavidhereva avayutyānuvādaḥ iti manyante |
tathā ca 'atryārṣeyasya hānaṃ syāt' (6|1|1|143) iti mīmāṃsākāḥ |
sūktā brūhi iti praiṣamuktvā 'taṃ (prastaraṃ) uparīva praharati' iti baudhāyanenoktam (1|19) |
tena sūktavākānuvacanakāle prastarapraharaṇaṃ iti sidhyati, na tu tayorlakṣaṇabhāve tatra kiṃ cit pramāṇam |
āpastambīyarāmakauśikakṛtabhāṣyaṭīkāyāṃ tu prastara āhutiḥ sūktavāko yājyā iti śrutidāhatā |
śākhāharaṇasya tu na sūktavākaḥ aṅgaṃ iti ca pratipāditam |
rudradattavṛttau tu etaddhi mataṃ jaiminī- yānāṃ "asti yāgavidhiḥ 'sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati' iti |
tatra yājyāsthānīyaḥ sūktavākaḥ, prastaro dravyaṃ, māntravarṇikyo devatāḥ, praharatiśca yajatyarthaḥ" iti |
( 'sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati' iti kālavidhiḥ iti āpastambasyābhiprāyaḥ) ityuktam |
atra satyāṣāḍhaḥ- 'sūktā brūhi iti saṃpreṣyati, sūktavākaṃ hotā pratipadyate (2|10|20) |
atra vaijayantī - " yadyapi jaiminimatamāśritya bhāṣyakṛtā uktaṃ ' svāhākārānto mantraḥ ' iti tadapi cintyam |
tasmāt sūktvākaḥ iṣṭadevatā- smārakaḥ iṣṭānāṃ ājyabhāgādidevatānāṃ svirakṛdantānāṃ saṃskārajanako dṛṣṭārtho yāgārthatvena adṛṣṭārthaḥ iti siddham " iti |
evaṃ ca sūktvāko na prastarapraharaṇāṅgaṃ, ' sūktvākena prastaraṃ praharati ' iti tu kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti baudhāyanāpastambasatyāṣāḍhānāṃ yājñikānāṃ matam |
sūktvākena prastaraṃ praharati iti kālavidhiḥ iti pūrvapakṣamupanyasya ' upadeśo vā, yājyāśabdo hi nāsmāt ' |
upadeśo vā prastaraprahaṇaṃ prati mantrasya syāt |
evaṃ ca kṛtvā yājyāśabdaḥ upapanno bhavati ' sūktvāka eva yājyā, prastara āhutiḥ ' iti |
some 'darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtīnāṃ ananvādhānaṃ, vratopāyanaṃ, āraṇyāśanaṃ, jāgaraṇam, anvāhāryasya dānaṃ, palyaḥ saṃhananaṃ vimocanaṃ iti na vidyante' somākhyaiva kaiścit siddhārtha- tvāt |
ajñāntaramapi yat prasaṅgādupajīvyaṃ, tadapi nivartate yathā tridhudasi ityapāmupasparśanaṃ, brahmavaraṇaṃ ityādi |
ānanvādhānaṃ tu dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ kriyata palyaśca saṃhananaṃ anyathāsiddhatvāt |
satyāṣāḍhabharadvājau tu avabhṛyottarakālāsu udavasānīyādiṣu vratopāyanaṃ pratiprasvāte |
nāyamācā- ryābhiprāyaḥ (āpastambasyetyarthaḥ :) patnīsaṃhananaṃ tu avabhṛyottarakālāsu arthasiddhaṃ, avabhṛye yokatrasya tyaktatvāt |
'haviṣkṛdehīti brāhmaṇasya, haviṣkṛdāgahi iti rājanyasya, haviṣkṛdādrava iti vaiśyasya, haviṣkṛdādhāva iti śūdrasya' |
atha saṃkarṣaṇakāṇḍīyādhyāyādivivaraṇam — saṃkarṣaṇakāṇḍe adhyāyāścatvāraḥ, pratyadhyāyaṃ caraṇāścatvāra iti saṃkalitākṣaraṇāḥ ṣoḍaśa |
saṃkarṣaṇakāṇḍasya śābarabhāṣyādikṛtā ullekhaḥ — saṃkarpe sviṣṭakṛdvikāraśca vanaspatiḥ iti vakṣyati ( 2|4|20 ) |
saṃkarpe 'ā naḥ prāṇa etu parāvataścāntarikṣāt divaspāri āyuḥ pṛthivyā adhya- mṛtamasi prāṇāya tvā iti hiraṇyamabhi vyaniti' ityantapratīkena viniyogasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
su. pṛ. 686. saṃkarpe 'aharaharvā coditatvāt' iti vakṣyamāṇanyāyena kauṇḍapāyināṃ homaḥ pratyahaṃ sakṛt kāryaḥ |
siddhānte tu karmaikyāt sāyaṃ prātaḥ ( ca ) prākṛtaḥ prakṛtivadabhyāsitavyaḥ |

saṃkarṣe dvitīye'dhyāye 'madhyamāyāmupasadyagniśrīyate prakṛtyupakṛtatvāt' ( 2| 126 ) ityadhikaraṇe kiṃ citta auttaravedikā dharmāḥ kāryā na vā iti saṃdigdhā, anuttaravedyoḥ bhinnakāryatvāgamana agneḥ uttaravedikāyāryapyabhāvāvagateḥ auttaravedikadharmānatideśaṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā, 'kratuṃ cittvottaravedyāmagniśrīyate' itivacanālocanayā samuccayāgame'pi cayananiṣpādita- sthalasya 'agniṃ cinute' iti dvitīyoktāgnisaṃskārārthatve asya yogyatayā agnidhāraṇātmaka- saṃskāratvātvāgamana 'uttaravedyāmagniṃ nidadhāti' iti agnidhāraṇātsyottaravedikākāryapyatvāt kāryabhede'pi ca 'vedyāṃ havīṃṣyāsādayati', 'barhiṣi havīṃṣyāsādayati' iti vedibarhiṣoriva sthalottaravedyorapi pākṣikaprāpyabhāvena niyamavidhayabhāvāt anyonyanairāpekṣyānavagateḥ samuccayāviro- dhāt uttaravedikāyāryapyasyā sthalasyāsyatantre : taddharmātideśaṃ siddhāntayituṃ 'uttaravedyā samuccīya- māne'pi cayane uttaravedikāyāryapyane uttaravedidharmā bhaveyuḥ' iti vadatā tantrabhāṣyakṛtā auttara- vedikadharmaprāptilakṣaṇasya taddhikāratvasya ataddhikāratvapūrvapakṣanirāsapūrvakaṃ upapādayiṣyate |
siddhavacca samuccayoktyā atrādharvarūpataddhikāratvanirāsena bādharūpasya ataddhikāratvaṃ tatra vakṣyate |

su. pṛ. 949. darśapūrṇamāsasiktyasyāpi anutaniṣedhasya taittirīyaśākhāyāmeva 'devānmyārohati ya eṣāṃ yajñamamyārohati' iti darśapūrṇamāsasyājinaṃ nirdiśya 'tasyaitad vrataṃ' ityupakramyāmnānāt paryudāsa- tvāpatteḥ saṃyogāttarasyāyogamāśaṅkya tasya saṃkarṣe ( 1|3|8 ) dākṣāyaṇayajñaviṣayatāyā vakṣya- māṇatvāt neha kaścit paryudāsaheturasti |

su. pṛ. 1393. saṃkarṣe ( 1|1|15 ) śāmitrasya ādyapūrvapakṣe prakṛtānāṃ ṛtvikkūcamasādhvaryūṇāṃ madhye, dvitīye ca ṛtvijāṃ madhye, tṛtīye ca camasādhvaryūṇāmeva madhye kena cit, siddhānte ca adhvaryūṇāṃ kāryatā vakṣyate |
su. 3|7 pṛ. 28. saṃkarṣaṇasūtraṃ tu 'ṛtvijaṃ vā cilyatve nopapadyate' iti kratvapūrvopayogābhiprāyaṃ vyākhyeyam |

bhāṭṭa. 4|3|15. somanāthastu 'cayenena agnisaṃskāraniṣpatyanantaraṃ agni- saṃskārasya cayananiṣpannasthaṇḍile agniṃvidhānarūpasya svarūpeṇa phalavatvābhāvena taphalatvātāḥ ṛtvarvaniṣpattiparyantatvāpanādeḥ saṃkarṣe sautrāmaṇyāḥ sābhikatvañcameva, na tu cayanajñatvaṃ, na vā agnyaṅgatvaṃ iti vyavasthāpanāt' ityāha |
4|3|18. saṃkarṣe ( 2|1|26 ) 'uttaravedyāṃ hmiśrīyate' iti vacanāt agnyuttaravedyoḥ samuccayo vakṣyate |

bhāṭṭa. 10|8|11. saṃkarṣe nānāpradānādhikaraṇasya ( 2|3|16 ) 'anyārthadarśanācca' iti guṇa- sūtre bhāṣyakāreṇa bhavasvāminā itthaṃ vyākhyātaṃ — “ yājyānuvākyāviniyogaparaṃ vacanaṃ pradānabhedaṃ prakāśayati |
manuṣya prathamayā yajet' evaṃ savā anuvākyāḥ sarvā yājyāśca bhavanti" iti|
parimalaḥ. 3|1|28|43 bra. sū. saṃkarṣasūtre 'acetanāstayāyogyānupāsyānyaphalatvaviparyayābhyām' iti atyantā'nupāstiniṣedhaparam|

advaita. 2|4|327. saṃkarṣakāṇḍe caturthasya tṛtīye ( ṣaṣṭhe'dhikaraṇe varṇakaṃ 2) 'yasya devatāyai havirgṛhītaṃ syāt tāṃ dhyāyet vaṣaṭkariṣyan' iti vākyamudāhṛtya itihāsapurāṇamantrārthavādapratyayitadevatā- svarūpadhyānamātra vivakṣitaṃ iti pūrvapakṣayitvā 'āgneyaṃ aindraṃ' ityādi devatāpratipādakasya anyā- diśabdaśravaṇāt tasya ca prathamopasthitasya tyāge pramāṇābhāvāt śabde kāryā'sambhave satyarthe kāryavijñānāt, iha ca śabde dhyānasambhavāt devatāśabdasyaiva dhyānaṃ iti siddhāntitam|

saṃkarṣakāṇḍe dvitīyasya caturthe ( 26 adhi0 ) 'ṛtāṣāḍḍhatāmeti yathārtha- viniṣkarṣo'rthapṛthaktvāt' ityadhikaraṇe 'ṛtāṣāḍḍhatāmā gandharvaḥ sa idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā, tasyauṣadhyo'psarasa ūrjaṃ nāma tā idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pāntu svāhā' ityevaṃ puṃvācakāḥ strīvācakāśca śabdāḥ pratihomaṃ viniṣkṛtya prayoktavyāḥ, uta yathāpāṭhaṃ iti vicāraḥ saṃgacchate|
ku. 2|1|14|42 pṛ. 150. 'tasmai svāhā tābhyaḥ svāhā' ityataḥ prāk paṭhitāḥ 'ṛtāṣāṭ ṛtadhāmā' ityādayaḥ paryāyāḥ; te ca 'bhuvanasya pate' ityataḥ prāk bhavanti|
tadetat tatraivābhimā- dhikaraṇe (saṃkarṣakāṇḍe 2|4|27 ) 'baḍbhirjuhotīti paryāyavādo yathā sāvitrāṇi juhoti' ityatra prapañcayiṣyate|
ku. 2|1|1|42. rāṣṭrabhṛnmantreṣu yathājñānameva anvito'pi kṣīparaḥ aṃśaḥ pūrvamantre prayujyate avi- rodhāt|

pūrvamantre prayujyamāne eva prayuktasya kṣīparasya aṃśasya uttarajuṣi ākāṅkṣāvaśenānvaya- sambhavāt, loke kāvyeṣu strīliṅgapadavyavahitānāmapi puṃliṅgapadānamanvayadarśanāt iti saṃkarṣakāṇḍe (2|4|26) devasvāmibhāṣye spaṣṭam|
ku 2|1|1|42. agneḥ mantrastyatvalakṣaṇadevatātvaṃ, samidādīnāṃ tu havirbhāṃjitvalakṣaṇaṃ devatātvaṃ ityubheṣāmapi devatātvena saṃkarṣakāṇḍe (2|1|2) vakṣyamāṇatvāt|
ku. 2|1|2|2. saṃkarṣakāṇḍe (2|1|2) dvitīyasya dvitīyādādhikaraṇe 'sa yatraitadadhvaryurāha samidho yajeti āgneyametadrūpaṃ parokṣaṃ āmr yajetyeva tadāha' iti śrutiḥ bhāṣye udāhṛtā|

ku. 2|1|2|2. saṃkarṣakāṇḍe dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyāde 'tatra devatānāmādeśo na vidyate'nāmanā- tvāt' iti pūrvapakṣasūtre 'yaja' iti yājyāpreṣe devatāmadheyaṃ nādeṣṭavyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣayitvā 'vidyate vā'nyārthadarśanebhyaḥ' iti sūtreṇa 'yattanūnapātaṃ yaja, iḍo yaja iti brūyāt jāmi syāt'

iti prayājeṣu devatā''deśasya nindyā taditaratra devatā''deśavidhiranumīyate iti siddhāntayitvā 'āmnātaḥ prayājeṣu devatā''deśastasya pratiṣedho vacanamitareṣu' iti guṇasūtreṇa śākhāntare 'tanūnapātaṃ yaja' ityādipratyakṣavihitasya devatā''deśasya 'yattanūnapātaṃ yaja, iḍo yajeti brūyāt' iti nindā, ataḥ prayājebhyo'nyatra na devatā''deśaḥ : 'āśrāvya brūyādindraṃ yajeti' 'āśrāvya brūyānmaruto yajeti' ityādi vacanābhāve sati ityākṣipya 'āmnāto vaikeṣāṃ tadartha- tyamuṣmā anubrūyam yajeti' iti sūtreṇa sarvatra yājyāpreṣādau devatā''deśaḥ kartavyaḥ iti śākhā- ntare pratyakṣavihitaṃ, ka cit 'indraṃ yaja' ityādi vacanaṃ tu anuvādaḥ iti samāhitam|
na ca 'ekaviṃśatimanubrūyāt' ityādau saṃkhyayālābhāt na saṃkhyāviśiṣṭhānuvacanā- ntaratriviṃsaṃbhavaḥ iti vācyam|
'prakṛti ityāśramaradhyaḥ' iti saṃkarṣacaturthadvitīyapādā- dhikaraṇanyāyena (1) anuvacanavasāmāt nityasāmidhenyuvacanaprakṛtilasya sattvāt|

saṃkarṣakāṇḍe dvitīyasya caturthe (2) 'adevatāsaṃyogena codyamāne'rhagṛhītā devatā, yathā bhojanodanāyāṃ manuṣyayogaḥ' ityadhikaraṇe devatāsaṃyogena vinā codyamāne 'upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' ityādau śabdaiḥ samadhigamyā devatāyā abhāvāt vinaiva devatā dravyamutsraṣṭavyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣayitvā, yajinā mantravarṇastha sāmānyaviśeṣarūpeṇa devatā'vagamāt devatoddeśena dravyatyāgaḥ saṃbhavati iti siddhāntayitvā, taduttarādhikaraṇe (3) 'sūktavāko yājyā, prastara āhutiriṣmaḥ prathama āhutīnāṃ hūyate ityetana vyākhyātam' iti sūtreṇa prastaraprahaṇaṃ idhmadhāraṇaṃ ca homarūpaṃ, 'sūktavāko yājyā prastara āhutiḥ' iti 'idhmaḥ prathama āhutīnāṃ hūyate' iti ca vākyaśeṣāt homatvāvagamāt, mantravarṇato viśiṣya devatālābhācca iti pūrvapakṣa- yitvā, 'praśaṃsā vā, saṃskāraḥ prastarasya, saṃnidhānāt, samindhanārtha idhmaḥ' iti sūtreṇa āhutitvena praśaṃsayā, yataḥ praharaṇaṃ prastarasya pratipattiḥ sughāragopyuphasya 'prastara' iti dvitī- yāntena upasthitatvāt, idhmadhāraṇaṃ ca agnidvayarthatvāt dṛṣṭārtha iti siddhāntitam|
'upadeśo vā yājyāśabdo hi nākasamāt' ( 3|4|12 jai. ) iti tu kṛtvācintā ityuktaṃ tadbhāṣye deva- svāmibhiḥ|
saṃkarṣakāṇḍe 'anuyajatītyanuvaṣaṭkāraścodyate' iti prathamādhikaraṇe ( 1|1|1 ) 'somayāge vīhītyanuyajati' iti vākyāntaravihitatvāt karmāntaraṃ somayāgāṅgatayā vidhīyate iti vakṣyate|

saṃkarṣakāṇḍe 'kṛtāpād‌datathā meti yathārthaviniṣkarṣāt‌ pṛthaktvatvāt‌' (2|4|26) iti pūrvapakṣayitvā 'yathāsamāmnātaṃ vā' iti sūtreṇa yathā mantrapāṭhameva vyatiṣaktatayā pūrva- pūrvamantrasya prayogaḥ 'tābhyaḥ svāhā' iti sarvanāmnaḥ pūrvapūrvamantrayatiṣaktatvāccakapadantaro- pasthitimādāya ākāṅkṣāśānteḥ iti siddhāntayiṣyamāṇatvāt‌ |
saṃkarṣakāṇḍe dvitīyasya caturthe (1) 'devatāsaṃyogena codyamāne pradāna āhutiryathā loke' ityatra prapañcayiṣyate (haviṣyaḥ agnau prakṣepaḥ kāryaḥ na tyāgamātraṃ juho- tyarthaḥ |
saṃkarṣakāṇḍīyabhāṭṭacandrikāyāṃ ālekhanāimarathyakāṣrṇājinīnāṃ prācīnācāryāṇāṃ yājñikānāṃ colekha upalabdhaḥ |
'tā vai gāyatryo bhavanti' iti prākṛtavidheḥ naimittikene vikāreṇa bādhaḥ |

āmarathyastu 'aṣṭāvetāni havīṃṣi bhavanti, adyākṣarā gāyatrī' ityāditvat‌ arthavādamātreṇa chandoviśeṣaparatvena niyamasya prākṛtabādhasya cāyuktatvāt‌ punarvidheḥ prakṛtiprāptaṃ tṛcāntarapari- saṃkhyārthatvena sārthakyāt‌ gāyatra eva prākṛtāstṛcā grāhyā ityāha |
saṃkarṣakāṇḍīyabhāṭṭacandrikāyāṃ sūtrabhāṣyayoryat‌ kiṃcit‌ nirasanādikaṃ kṛtaṃ, tat‌ saṃgṛhyate |
bhāṣye tu caturadhikaraṇī iyaṃ ekīkṛtya vyākhyātā |
'liṅgadarśanācca' iti caramasūtraṃ tu sarvasādhāraṇyāya 'śṛtaṃ haviḥ śamitaḥ' iti praiṣe sati 'śṛtamiti triḥ pratyāha' iti liṅgaṃ śamanaśrapaṇayoḥ samānakartṛkatāṃ bodhayati iti vyākhyātam |
śrapaṇasya prakṛtau adhvaryukartṛ- katvādiniścayāt‌ iti tadāśayaḥ |

'dakṣiṇāpavargāḥ paśavo bhavanti' iti āhavyavidhānena īśānādhānyanta- krameṇa paśuniyojane siddhe tad‌śeṣe yūpepi pradhānasannikarṣālābhena tathaiva samāne prasakte pravartamānaḥ udagapavargavidhiḥ (udagapavargo yūpā bhavanti) saṃbankasannikarṣāvirodhenaiva netavyaḥ |
tathā ca paśukrameṇa nava yūpā mītvā daśamasya sthānamatikramya vedyagnikoṇe daśamaṃ tadud‌gabhāge ekādaśaṃ minuyāt‌ |
evaṃ sati dvayoreva uttamapottamayoḥ kramoparodhaḥ syāt‌ iti bhāṣyakāraḥ |
'āvāpasviṣkṛtordvitīyaṃ pañcāvāttinaḥ' iti sūtre vāśabdaderabhāvena pūrvapakṣanirāse mānābhāvāt‌ ekeṣāmityasyābhāve'pi dvāvapi śākhābhedena siddhāntāveva |

'madhyādavadhati' iti vidhāya 'yadubhayato'vadhati' ityādinā pūrvapakṣārdhayoḥ avadānaṃ vinindya 'uttarādhardaveme avadhat‌' iti spaṣṭaṃ vidhānāt‌ sauviṣkṛtau avadānasyalā- deva dviravadānena haviṣyaḥ trivadānasiddhiḥ iti tu bhāṣyābhiprāyaḥ |
bhāṣye tu prastapraharaṇasyāpi kevalasaṃnipātivameva samarthya pūrvopakramāt‌ ārādupa- kārakatvaṃ kṛtācintayā ityuktam |

yattu bhāṣye 'puṇyāhe daivāni karmāṇi' 'te vā ete pūte medhye ahanī yajanīye' 'uttaramahardevatā yajate' iti śrutiṣu ahanāmeva kīrtanaṃ iha hetukṛtaṃ, tat‌ tantraprakramābhiprāyeṇa ahorātraparatvena ca 'anyathāsiddho rātriśabdaḥ' iti vadataḥ sūtrakṛtaḥ viruddhaṃ ahaḥ śabde'pi tadubhayasaṃbhavāt‌ |

bhāṣyakṛtā tu 'dvāviyākālo' (saṃkarṣa. 3|1|2 adhi0) itisūtreṇa 'yadahareva purastācca paścācca dṛśyate, tadaharupaset‌ , kṣobhūte yajeta' 'yā pūrvā paurṇamāsī sā'numatiḥ, yottarā sā rākā' ityādi vacaneḥ dvāvapi yāgakālaveva iti pūrvapakṣaṃ prāpya anena sūtreṇa (15| 16 adhi0 sthena) teṣāṃ pratyakṣataḥ kāladvitvoktatvā'bhāvāt‌ 'dvādaśa vai saṃvatsarasya paurṇa- māsyaḥ' ityādi liṅgācca ekaika eva kālaḥ iti siddhāntitam |
yattu bhāṣye varṇakāntaraṃ, tat‌ asyaivādhikaraṇasya punarapi vākyāntareṇa varṇanaṃ siddhāntasūtre pāṭhabhedapradarśanaikaphalakam |

yattu bhāṣye atigrāhyāṇāmapi grahatvāt‌ grahasamānadharmatā''vaśyakatayā savaṣaṭkāra- meva eṣāṃ pradānaṃ, na punardvirhomatavaṃ ityuktaṃ, tat‌ dadhigrahādiṣu vyabhicaritatvāt‌ uttarādhikaraṇānte eva 'prāṇāya tvā' ityādirūpasya mantrasya home sūtrakṛtaiva viniyogakathanena tadvirodhācca cintyam |

yattu bhāṣyakāraiḥ asatkāryavādanirāsena saṃskārātmanaḥ sataḥ svarūpāmanā satkāryavādaṃ samarthya somasya svarūpato'pi sattvena tatra mantrasya karaṇatvena vidhānāyogāt‌ somagrahādayaṃ mantraḥ utkṛṣyeta ityuktaṃ, tat‌ somotpādane yāgāntare'pi viniyogasaṃbhavena 'sāgaraṃ taret‌' ityādividheriva aprāmāṇyāpādakatvāt‌ upekṣitam |
bhāṣyakārastu atyārdhayasūtre (6|1|43 jai.) prakṛtasūtre ca (saṃkarṣa. 3|4|3) tripadaṃ pañcānāmapi upalakṣaṇam |
'parimāṇāccetyāsā' iti tripadaṃsaṃjñayopilakṣayiṣā itya- rthakaṃ iti vyācakhyau |
advaita-- advaitasiddhiḥ śrīmanmadhusūdanasarasvatīpraṇītā nirṇayasāgare 1917 sane mudritā |
atra paricchedaḥ, prakaraṇaṃ, sūtraṃ iti aṅkatrayam |
advaita.caṃ-- advaitasiddheḥ ṭīkā laghucandrikā brahmānandī nāma |
tredhā saṃyoge pṛthaktvavyākhyānasaṃbhede'pi 'yadi ekaikāmeva saṃtanuyāt' iti vidhyantara- |
sattvāt iti yattu bhāṣyakṛto vyākhyānaṃ, tat 'avācyatvān' ityākṣepanirāsasamarthatvāt |
alaṃkāraḥ-- bhāṭṭālaṃkāraḥ nāma mīmāṃsānyāyaprakāśasya ṭīkā anantadevaviracitā |
yattu bhāṣye devatā''sohaḥ havyayoddeśca ekatvena ābahnahavyavahanābhyāṃ sviṣṭakṛdyāga- |
saṃbandhāt asati sviṣṭakṛti sarvahute devatā''svāhanasyaiva lopaḥ iti, tanna |
ṛju-- ṛjuvimalā śābarabhāṣyavyākhyānarūpā bṛhattyāḥ ṭīkā śrīśālikanāthapraṇītā |
sugādāpanamantre śākhābhedena 'ime vayaṃ' 'smoṃ vayaṃ' iti pāṭhau, tayoḥ vikṛtau |
ṛsaṃ-- ṛgvedasaṃhitā paṇḍitasātavalekaraiḥ aundharājadhānyāṃ 1940 sane mudritā |
vaṣaṭkāre vāpaṭ -- vaṣaṭ -- vauṣaṭ -- ṣaṭ iti mantrabhedaḥ |
vākyānāṃ vaiyarthyasya ayuktatvāt bṛhaspatisava- rājasūya- vaiśyastomeṣu krameṇa ta eva śabdā |
'nāmāni gṛhṇīyāt' ityasya ekatvātiriktasaṃkhyāparatvena suvyākhyātvāt na yajñakāma- |
kau-- bhāṭṭakaustubhaḥ khaṇḍadevaviracitaḥ caukhambāyāṃ 1939 sane mudritaḥ |
tattvaprakāśikā— paribhāṣābhanduśekharasya yā ṭīkā mūrtināma, tasyāḥ ṭīkā |
tattvabodhinī— siddhāntakaumudyāḥ ṭīkā nirṇayasāgarīyā 1929 sane mudritā |
tautā— tautātikamatatilakaḥ bhavaprasādāparaparyāyaḥ granthaḥ bhavadevapraṇītaḥ mīmāṃsācārya- śrīcinnasvāmibhiḥ pariṣ
vṛ— mīmāṃsāsūtravṛttiḥ subodhinī kāśyāṃ 1923 sane mudritā |
vaijayantī— satyāṣāḍhaśrautasūtrasya vṛttiḥ ānandāśrame 1907 sane mudritā sasūtrā |
śaṃkara— śrīśaṃkarabhaṭṭapraṇītaḥ mīmāṃsāsārasaṃgrahaḥ kāśyāṃ 1904 sane mudritaḥ |
śā— śāstradīpikā pārthasārathimiśrapraṇītā nirṇayasāgare 1915 sane mudritā |
atra adhyāyaḥ, pādaḥ, adhikaraṇaṃ iti aṅkatrayam |
śekharaḥ— paribhāṣāśekharaḥ śrīnāgeśapraṇītaḥ kāśyāṃ 2001 vikramasaṃvati mudritaḥ |
ślovā— ślokavārtikaṃ bhaṭṭapādapraṇītaṃ tarkapādasthaṃ caukhambāyāṃ 1898 sane mudritam |
saṃkarṣa— saṃkarṣakāṇḍasya bhaṭṭacandrikā bhāskarabhaṭṭapraṇītā nāma vṛttiḥ |
samayamayūkhaḥ— śrī jagannātha raghunātha dhārapure ityetaiḥ mudritaḥ |
sāhasrayāṃ yo nyāyakramāṅko niveśitaḥ sa evāsmābhiḥ pradarśayate |
siddhāntacandrikā— tarkapādasthaśāstradīpikāyāḥ ṭīkā rāmakṛṣṇapraṇītā nirṇayasāgare 1915 sane śāstradīpikayā saha mudritā |
yatra ca ‘su. 3|7 pṛ.’ iti syāt tatra sudhāyāḥ tṛtīyādhyāyasya saptamādhma- pādātmake bhāge granthānte mudrite pṛṣṭhaṃ amukaṃ ityarthaḥ |
tatra bhāge kila pṛthageva aṅkā mudritā ādita ārabhya |
soma— somanāthī mayūkhamālikā śāstradīpikāyāṣṭīkā arthavādādhikaraṇamārabhya dvādaśādhyāyāntā |
atra adhyāyaḥ pādaḥ adhikaraṇaṃ iti aṅkatrayam |
oṃ aṃśāṃśinyāyaḥ— aṃśāṃśinyāyena tayoḥ (jīvabrahmaṇoḥ) bhedābhedo yuktaḥ |
śrīkara. 3|2|29. aṃśaḥ avayavaḥ, aṃśāḥ asyāstīti aṃśī avayavī, tayoḥ nyāyaḥ paddhatiḥ rītiḥ |
śarīrasya pañcayavāḥ, śiraḥ hastau pādau madhyaṃ ceti |
anayoḥ bhedena abhedena ceti dvividho'pi vyavahāro dṛśyate |
oṃ aṃśugrahaḥ— ‘parā vā etasyāyuḥ prāṇa eti, yo'śuṃ gṛhṇāti’ aṃśu ityatra yajateraśravaṇe'pi nāmaviśeṣabaladeva apūrvayāgavidhiḥ iti prāpte, grahasyaivātra vidhiḥ |
ci. 2|3|9. aṃśugrahaḥ jyotiṣṭome eva vidhīyate, na tu yāgāntaram |
bhā. 2|3|120. aṃśugrahaṇe vihitaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ‘stenaṃ mano'nṛtavādinī vāk’ ityanena stūyate |
tatra stenamiti pracchannaṃ rūpaṃ lakṣyate, anṛtavādinī iti prāyeṇa anṛtavadanasvabhāvatvaṃ lakṣyate |
manaḥ stenavat pracchannaṃ, vāk prāyeṇa anṛtavadanaśīlā, hiraṇyaṃ tu tadoṣadvayarahitaṃ iti |
oṃ aṃśvābhyagrhayoḥ saṃyogapṛthaktvena kāmyatvaṃ nityatvaṃ ca ||

aupāṃśuvākye vihitayoraśvābhyagrhayorvyākhyāyāṃ nyāyānusaṃdhānasāpekṣasyajyotiṣṭomopakārapekṣayā ‘bhrātṛvyatā''dāmbhyo grāhyo yubhupatā''śuḥ’ itivacanena vairibharaṇadevai phalasya jhaṭityupasthiteḥ kāmyāvevaitau grahau |
iti prāpte, ‘eṣa vai haviṣā haviryajate yo'dābhyaṃ gṛhītvā somāya yajate, parā vā etasyāyuḥ prāṇa eti yo'śuṃ gṛhṇāti’ iti vacanayorvaiyarthyāpatteḥ saṃyoga-pṛthaktvenaubhayārthatvam |
oṃ aṃśvābhyagrhau— aṃśvābhyagrhayoḥ utpatti-vākyasya anārambhādhītatve'pi viniyojakaṃ vākyaṃ jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇādhītam |
vi. 3|6|11. aṃśvābhyagrhadābhyāṃ some aparau grahyāvasau vidhīyete, na yāgāntaram |
bhā. 2|3|120. aṃśvābhyagrhau vidhīyamānau na karma bhinnaḥ |
yasmin karmaṇi bhavataḥ tatrāparau grahyāvasau vijñāyete, na karmāntare iti |
bhā. 10|6|138. aṃśvābhyagrhau ṛtudoṣaḥ, na tu savanaśeṣaḥ iti ādau sakṛdeva grāhyau, na pratisavanam |
bhā. 5|3|16-16. aṃśvābhyagrhyādīnāṃ yeṣāmanārambhādhītānāṃ prākaraṇiko viniyogaḥ, tatrāpi vidhipāṭhādavalādeva anuṣṭhānasiddhiḥ |
ata eva na tayorante karaṇaṃ, api tu prātaḥsavane eva dhārāgrahebhyaḥ pūrvameva |
bhāṭṭa. 5|3|16. ekadhanā-sādanottaraṃ adhvaryuḥ dadhi-aṃśu-adābhya-upāṃśu-antyā-magrahaiḥ kramāt pracarati |
aupāṃśuvākye ca prakaraṇe'vabhṛthātparataśraśvābhya-vidhidvayaṃ paṭhyate, tanmantrau tūpāṃśādibhyaḥ pūrvamāmnātau |
tasmā- dyavasthāntarameva pāṭhakramāttayoḥ pracāra iti prāpte, ‘bhṛyastvenobhayaśruti’ (1|3|1|10) iti nyāye- naupānāvākye eva guṇāvidhivihāvyatvātpradhānavidhirapi |
tatra ca prākṛtājjāntaraiḥ saha pāṭhakramābhāvādātaramyacāra- kāle eva tayoḥ pracāraḥ |

vastutastu aupānāvākye eva vidhisvīkāre'pi tasya prakṛtau ‘ante tu bādarāyaṇaḥ’ iti nyāyena (5|1|9|169) klaptakramagrahaṇāṃ parata eva niveśe prāpte prākaraṇikapunaḥpāṭhavyarthaparihārāya tasya kramātkalaṃ svīkṛtaṃ yuktamiti na pūrvottarapakṣayoḥ phalabhedaḥ |
yadi brāhmaṇapāṭhāyatvalena mantrapāṭhenopānā- ntthāmādigrahebhyaḥ pūrṇameva pracāraḥ ityucyate, tarhi tata eva pūrṇapakṣe'pi tatrāṇuṣṭhānaṃ sidhyati |
vastutaḥ ‘vyava- nīyāpo dadhigraheṇa carityāścābhyāṃ carati’ iti śrauta- krameṇaiva siddhiḥ prāptisutramevaitat |
bhāṣya—dūrāt yat śiṣyate jyotiṣṭomasya yathā aupasadānuvākyakāṇḍe aṃśadābhyau |
tatra saṃdehaḥ; kiṃ jyotiṣṭomasamāmnātā grahadharmāḥ kartavyā uta neti |
yathā ‘payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti’ iti vacanāt maitrāvaruṇasyaiva śrayaṇaṃ, na sarveṣām |
evamidamapi dharmajātaṃ prakaraṇa- sthānāmeva, na sarveṣāmiti |
tatra sthānaṃ bādhitvā prākaraṇikagrahāyāṃ grahadharmāḥ iti pratīyate : anārabhyādhītārthatvaṃ aśakyaṃ pratyutam |
yāvān graho jyotiṣṭomasyopakaroti tasya sarvasya bhavitumarhati |
vā—prakaraṇasya adhidopaktvāt jyotiṣṭomāpūrva- sādhanasyaiva ete ityevaṃ surāgrahādibhyo nivartamānāḥ prakaraṇe vyavasthityante |
yeṣāṃ tu akaraṇadharmātānāmapi tatdasti, te pūrvaiveva nyāyena vākyasaṃyogāt dharmavanto bhavitumarhanti |
bhāṣya—yaduktaṃ, yathā ‘maitrāvaruṇaṃ payasā śrīṇāti’ iti, tayuktam |
tatra sarveṣu aheṣu prakaraṇaṃ, viśiṣṭeṣu vākyam |
iha tu sarveṣu graheṣu vākyaṃ, viśiṣṭeṣu prakaraṇam |
dhītamiti yāvat, tat aṃśadābhyagrahadvayaṃ dharmairasaṃbaddhaṃ, teṣāṃ saṃnidhānāt ārabhyādhītasyaiva saṃbandhāditi (itareḥ saṃnidhānāt iti sūtre pāṭho'tra) |
bhāṭṭa—grahadharmāṇāṃ grahasvarūpe ānarthakyaprasaktau grahagāmyāsāpūrvasādhanatvameva grahapadena lakṣyate dīkṣaṇī- yāvādyaniyamanayena (1|1|2 varṇakaṃ 2) na tu jyoti- ṣṭomāpūrvasādhanatvam |

ataśca karaṇopāsthitatvātpūrvasādhanatva- syaiva lakṣaṇāt na anārabhyādhītārthatvādyathāsāpūrva- sādhanatvaṃ dharmāṇāṃ iti prāpte, prakaraṇādanyeyāmiha anu- jñānasādetyāt anārabhyādhītānāmapi upasthiteḥ vākyasaṃ- koce pramāṇābhāvādeva sarvārthatvam |
ata eva prabalena durba- lena vā pramāṇena sādhanatvenācagatānāṃ sarveṣāmeva haviṣāṃ vaiyādikamaṅgam |
vastutastu aṃśadābhyayoḥ anārabhyopa- cayorapi prākaraṇikena vākyenaiva klṛptatā iti tulyameva |
nyāyabinduḥ—grahadharmāḥ prākaraṇikagrahaṇāmeva iti prāpte, yāgasādhanatvāviśeṣāt anārabhyādhītānāmapi iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣya—na kasya cidapi prakaraṇe śrūyate ‘eṣa vai haviṣā haviryajate yo'dābhyaṃ gṛhītvā somāya yajate’ iti |
tathā ‘parā vā etasyāyuḥ prāṇa eti, yo'dābhyaṃ gṛhṇāti’ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ; kiṃ yāgāntarametat grahakaṃ uta jyotiṣṭomayāge grahavidhiḥ iti |
mā bhūt dravyadevataṃ, sākṣādeva yajatiśabdo vidyate |
tasmāt karmo- ntaraṃ adābhyasaṃjñakaṃ aṃśasaṃjñakaṃ (ca) yāgaṃ karoti ityevaṃ prāptam |
evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ : adābhyadevatā kevale nāmadheye śrayamāṇe brūmaḥ, jyotiṣṭome eva grahabhyāsaviśeṣavidhānaṃ iti |
kutaḥ ? etattāvat rahasya nāmadheyaṃ, na yāgasya, grahaṇena sākṣāt saṃbandhāt, vyavahitatvāt |
na ca dravyadevataṃ śrūyate, yato grahatiḥ yajimadracanau bhavet |
yadapyuktaṃ, sākṣādeva yajatiśabdo vidhāyaka iti, naiva śakyaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhātum |
aṃśadābhyabhyābhyāmāpi aparo grahabhyāsī vidhīyate iti siddham |
vā—anārabhyādhītayoḥ aṃśadābhyagrahayoḥ ālabhyā- divat (2|3|16) tredhā saṃdehaḥ |
tadeva ca pakṣa- dvayaṃ nirākṛtya yajīmatī codanā iti pratijñāyate |
’ na hyetannāmadheyaṃ prakṛtau kasya cit prasiddhaṃ, yasya punaḥśrutisāmarthyāt diryasyāsaḥ kriyate |
tasmāt grahaticodanāsāmānye jyotiṣṭoma- prakṛtiḥ (likaḥ) ekāhādyaṃ codyate iti manyāmehe |
ekatra yajateḥ pratyakṣatvāt anyatra ca abhyabhicāriṇyā saṃjñayā anyatve kalpite, gṛhṇātinā samastajyotiṣṭomadharmaprāpteḥ dravyadevatāsaṃbandha- siddhiḥ |

’ devatā tāvat dūrapradhaiva (sudhā—‘somāya yajate’ ityasya anuvādya- yāgaviśeṣopalavyāt, paścāt śrutatvāt somāya gṛhītvā soma somāya svāhā’ iti mantravarṇaprāptadevatānuvādopa- patteśca devatāvidhivyāyogāt dūrapradhaiva uktā) |
yat graha- mārgaṃ dravyaṃ, tadapi na kena cidupapattam |
nahi jātyā guṇena ca vinā dravyamupalakṣituṃ śakyam |
na ca yoge'- nyatradhārite jyotiṣṭomadravyo'sti, yena somagrahaṇeta iti vijñāyeta |
na ca gṛhṇātiḥ jyotiṣṭomaṃ na vyabhi-
na caite yāganāmanī, yena taṃ bhindyātam |
dravyadevatāsaṃgrahe'pi ca evaṃ- jātīyānāṃ yajimatvaṃ nirākṛtaṃ 'acodakāśca saṃskārāḥ' (2|2|18) iti |
yo'pi adābhyavākye yajatiḥ, so'pi revatīvāravantīya- pūrvapakṣanyāyena (2|2|27) saṃkrāntavidhidhātkinā pratyayena vidhīyate |
aṃśoḥ kathaṃ yāgasaṃbandha iti cet ? gṛhṇāti- sāmānyopasthitena jyotiṣṭomena iti cet |
asyeva tu anyoḥ taittirīyāṇāṃ jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe (taisaṃ. 6|1|9-10) punaḥśravaṇam |
' [§] akāmasya kriyā kā citta dṛśyate neha kahiṃ cit |
anena puṃsaḥ sakalakarmacaraṇakaraṇaṃ sarvārtharavījaṃ kāma eveti bodhi- tamiti |
yogapratyayayogatvavicāramantareṇa vastu dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ ca kāmayati pumāṃsamiti kāmaḥ |
ata evoktaṃ bhagavatā—'kāma eṣa krodha eṣa rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ |
viśvajiti yāge bhūmidānamiva aśraddhānamapi na kartavyaṃ iti caśabdārthaḥ |
tataḥ gomuvarṇavidhānāt punaḥ aśraddhānasya akāryatvāt 'na kesariṇo dadāti' iti akartavyatvābhidhānāt hetoḥ viśeṣaḥ syāt |
tatra ca ' stutīnāṃ vidhyadhīna- tvādunādava lakṣaṇa |
' vidhīyamānaṃ hi sautavyaṃ, na tu stutyaṃ vidheyaṃ, aprāptārthaśca vidhiḥ; iti na śrautārthāta pracyavate |
yadyapi tāvat arthavādopakramatvaṃ bhavet, tataḥ prathamajñānānurodhena kadā cit vidhiḥ vaśīkriyeta, vidhyu- pakramaṃ tu idaṃ ' aktāḥ śarkarāḥ ' iti |
tasmāt nirdiṣṭa- sāmānye yadi arthavādo na tadarthya pratipadyate, tataḥ ana- rthako bhavati ityaśaktaḥ svatantrībhavituṃ, vinā'pi cārthavā- dena vidhyudeśaḥ samathaitvāt na yuktaḥ tadasyaḥ kartum |
arthavādastu agatitvāt vidhibalena vadeta, viśeṣaśca sāmānyaṃ anabhicārāt śaknoti lakṣayituṃ, na sāmānyaṃ vyabhicārāt viśeṣam |
' kāmaṃ vā so'thavāde'stu sāmānyastho ghṛte vidhiḥ |
5|1|9 yadi hiraṇyaṃ na vindet śarkarā aktā upadadhyāt tejo ghṛtam' |
sāvitracayane idaṃ vākyam, caturhotṛcayane iti kecit |
ke. vākyaśeṣasya kratu- viśeṣopasthāpakatve'pi vidhau sarvavipayatvapratīteḥ saṃdehābhā- vena aktādhikaraṇanyāyābhāvāt na vākyaśeṣasya vidhi- saṃkocakatvakalpanāyavasaraḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 5|1|12, vākyaśeṣe ekastomakānāmeva saṃkīrtanāt teṣāmeva anyaśabdena graha- ṇāt tatraiva uttarakālatvavidhiḥ aktādhikaraṇanyāyena ucitaḥ iti cenna, vākyaśeṣasya anyathāpyupapatteḥ |
5|1|15 saṃdigdhepu vākyaśeṣāt ' ityatra ‘aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhyāt' ityupakramagataṃ saṃdigdhaṃ aktapadaṃ vākyaśeṣagatena ghṛtapadena nirṇīyate, na tu bādhyate iti cenna |
vidhau saṃdigdhaṃ arthavādena avadhāryate iti hi tatra vyutpannaṃ, na tu upakrame saṃdigdhaṃ upasaṃhāre ava

bhāṭṭa— somakrayārthe ekahāyanīṃ vidhāya krayadeśe tatra- ne kriyamāṇe 'tasyāḥ ṣaṭ padāni anuniṣkrāmati, saptama- padaṃ sthyena vilikhati, hiraṇmayantāṃ pade juhoti, tataḥ saptamaṃ padaṃ acyutaṃ añjalinā gṛhṇāti, vahiṃ havirdhāne prācī pravartayet'; tarhi tena akṣamupādhyāt' iti śrutam |
tatra akṣabhyañjanamapi krayavat ekahāyanīnayanasya prayojakaṃ, janyalavat aṅgalasyapi ubhayatra samatvāt |
akṣabhya- ñjane hi tacchabdenaiva padapāṃsavo nirdiṣṭāḥ iti te tada- ṅgam |
padasya ca ekahāyanīnirūpitatvaṃ tasyāḥ saptamaṃ padaṃ ityanupaṅgāt śāstrāntaravacanāt avagataṃ iti sā'pi tadaṅgam |
ataśca niyamanasaṃskārārthasya nayana- syāpi ubhayārthatvāt ubhayaprayojyatvam |
na ca krayaṇādeva ekahāyanīlābhāt tacchabdasya anuvādakatvaṃ, parikrayaprāpteḥ pūrvapravṛjyasvīkāreṇa prayojakatvaphalakāṅgalavidhupapatteḥ |
na ca tathāpi krayaprayuktatvaviśiṣṭaikahāyanā eva tacchabdena parāmarśāt puroḍāśakapālanyāyāpattiḥ |

iti prāpte, vidhīgauravaprayo- jakaśaktikalpanāgauravābhyāṃ tacchabdasya pūrvaparā- marśitvasvabhāvena upajīvyaprakraṇapadānānuvādakatvāvagate ta- ekahāyanyāḥ krayamātrāṅgatvasāvasāyāt tadaṅgabhūta- nayanasyāpi tanmātrārthatvapratīteḥ akṣabhyañjanaṃ padahomā- dikaṃ vā krayaprayuktaikahāyanīnayanalamena kriyārthe, na ekahāyanyāḥ tayanasya vā prayojakam |
ataśca eka- hāyanyāṃ krayārthe nīyamānāyāṃ daivāt trāvaṇe saptamapadapāte akṣabhyañjanārthe punarna tadayanam |
akṣabhyañjanārthe tu ye ke cit pāṃsavo grāhyā eva, guṇalope mukhyalopānu- patteḥ |
yathā- śaktiprayoge tu āh‌vanīyye nirādhikaraṇakaḥ eva vā ityanya- detat |

nyāyabinduḥ— 'ekahāyanyā krīṇāti' ityupakramya 'padaṃ padyānu niṣkrāmati, saptamaṃ padamabhyurñjalinā gṛhṇāti, tenākṣamupājyāt' iti ca śrutaṃ, tatra krayākṣā- bhyañjanayordvayorapi ekahāyanīnayanasādhyatvāt tatprayojakatvaṃ iti prāpte, krayārthatvena ekahāyanīśravaṇāt tatsaṃskārārthaṃ nayanamapi krayārthameva, akṣabhyañjanaṃ tu krayārthīyamānaika- hāyanīpadapāṃsūna upajīvati iti tadabhāve yatkiṃcidyāṃ- subhiḥ kārye iti siddhāntaḥ |
yathā darśe bahiḥ saṃsahanī rajjuḥ vedyāṃ akṣaṇyā prasāryate nairṛtakoṇamārabhya aiśānakoṇāmi- mukham |
tathā ca satyā- ṣāḍhaḥ 'ṛtasya tvā devahaviḥ pāśenārabhe iti dakṣiṇe pūrvapāde adhiśirasi ca pratimuñcati' (4|1|8) iti |
pūrvakāye dvau pādau aparakāye ca dvau pādau |
tatra dakṣiṇe pūrvapāde artha ca śirasi pāśapratimokaḥ |
evaṃ- rītyā ca paśuśarīre pāśapratimoke kṛte akṣaṇyā bandho bhavati |
oṃ akṣayāmye sūtraudanabhojanaṃ nivātadyāya ceti nilaṃ śayyāsanaṃ bhojanaṃ ca vikaroti |
oṃ akhaṇḍatvādyaḥ amilāsanabhūteṣṭakadharmāḥ, na tu prathamacitidharmāḥ |
tasmāt amilāsanabhūtāsu citriṇyā- dīṣṭakāsvapi te santi |
oṃ akhyātivādaḥ— saṃprati sarvavijñānānāṃ yathārthatvaṃ pratipādyate |
yathā bhavatāṃ jñānaviśeṣe'pi kiṃ citryathāte, kiṃ cidyathāte tathā yathārthatve'pi bhrāntā- bhrāntavyavasthopapattiḥ |
kāraṇadoṣāvadhakatvāt vyavasthāsiddhiriti cet, tarhi tenaiva bhrāntābhrāntavyavasthā'stu |
bhavatāṃ yathārthatve jñānasya bādho nāstīti cet, bhavatāṃ vā jñānaviśeṣe kathaṃ bādhopapattiḥ ? jñānaviśeṣe'pi 'nedaṃ rajatam' iti jñānoyadaśanāt kalpyate iti cet, yathārthatve'pi
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ-bhavatāṃ jñānasvarūpādhayā ayathārthatvaṃ, asmākaṃ tu vyavahāravādhayā, ato vaineva kāraṇena yathārthāyathārthavivekaḥ, tenaiva kāraṇena bhrāntābhrāntavivekaḥ iti samānam |

nanu yadi yuktikāyāṃ rajatajñānaṃ na jāyate, tarhi yuktikāyāṃ rajatapravṛttiḥ kathamupapadyate ? nāvartyaṃ yuktikāyāmeva rajatajñānamāsthe- yaṃ, rajate rajatajñānāmātradeva yuktikāyāṃ rajatapravṛttya- patteḥ |
anyaviṣayajñānānyatra pravṛttirna dvayeti cet, satyaṃ, anyāvabhāsino jñānasyānyatra jananamapi na dṛṣṭam |

yuktau rajatapravṛttyanyathānupapattyā kalpyate iti cet, tarhi tathaivānupapattyā anyaviṣayajñānasyānyatra pravṛttihetutvamātraṃ kalpyatāṃ, kimathārthavacanasena ? yathārthajñānasyānyatra- pravṛttihetutve'pyavasthite cet, bhavatāmanyathāvabhāsino jñānasyānyatrotpāde'pyavasthā samaiva |
kāraṇadoṣāvadhakapratya- yatvena vyavasthāsiddhiriti cet, asmākamapi tathaiva vyavasthā'stu |
samyagjñāne'pi rajatajātirupativyaktīgrahaṇāt 'idaṃ rajatam' iti pravṛttiḥ, na saṃvandhagrahaṇāt |
ata eva 'vivekagrahaṇānna pravṛttau yugapat pravṛtti- nivṛttī syātām' iti coyasyānavakāśāḥ, nirantarabhānāt pravṛtteḥ |
śuktikāyāmindriyaprayogānna- bhāvitvena śuktikāviṣayatvamiti cet, rajatasmṛtitve'- pyuddeśāpekṣayā caturūpeṇopapatteḥ |

loyādāvapyudde- prasaṅgaḥ iti cet, bhavatāṃ loyādau rajatajñānaṃ kimivi na jāyate ? sādṛśyābhāvāditi cet, 'tatrajatam' iti syāditi cet, śuktikāviṣayatve dā śuktikāviṣayaṃ iti kiṃ nānusaṃvīyate ? kāraṇadoṣādeva tadanusaṃdhānaṃ na jāyate iti cet, asmākamapi kāraṇa- doṣādeva 'tat' iti nānusaṃdhānamiti samameva sarvamanu- papattijātam |
viṣayavyavasthayā bhāsamānatayā vācyaṃ, na vyavahārayogyatāpattiviparpala, nirvikalpasya nirviṣayatva- prasaṅgāt |
bhāsa- mānatvaṃ cet, idameva jñānaṃ tāvadyathārthanirūpaṇam |
tato yada- yathārthe bhrāntātvāt pravṛttihetutvādityatastvaṃ dharmigrāhaka- pramāṇavirodhadevādepāsāt, rajatajñānāmiti nirdeśadeva rajataviṣayatvāṅgīkārāt, śuktiviṣayatvapratijñāsyāstenaiva bādhāt |
yathārthatve ca jñānatvād vyavahārahetutvādyaprakāśa- kaladityanumānaṃ nirdoṣam |
evamarthāpatyupanyāse'pi yathārthatve'pi sarvamupapadyate, iti pūrvoktanyāyenaivānyatho- papattistyā |
kāraṇadoṣādeva jāyate iti cet, doṣāṇāṃ kāryavighāta- hetutvameva, na tu kāryāntarajananam |
dagdhādrevabījāt kadalyāṅkurotpattiriti cet, drāvya tatra sāmagrītvāt |
doṣasyāpi sāmagrītve doṣa eva na syāt |
kiṃca ayathārthatve sarvatrānāsakta eva syāt, asalyātiprasaṅgaśca, rajatasya śuktirūpeṇāsatvāt saṃśaya- jñānasyāpi yathārthatvaṃ smṛtirūpatvāt |
akhyātivādakhaṇḍanam— guruvastu śuktirajata- jñānādau na saṃsargagraho mānābhāvāt |
kiṃtu saraṇānubhava- viṣayayoḥ rajatatvahyattoḥ asaṃsargāgrahamātraṃ, nānyathā- khyātiḥ |
evaṃ ca asaṃsargāviṣayatvatkarajñānasya pravṛttau vyavahāre ca hetutvāt atilaghavāmityāhuḥ |
asaṃsargāviṣayatvatvarajataprakārakatvayoḥ jñānaviśeṣe- paṇayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve vinigamakābhāvena kāryakaraṇa- bhāvadvayakalpanāgauravāt |

evaṃ sāmānyataḥ pravṛttau kārya- tājñānasya hetutve yatra kāryatābhramāt pravṛttiḥ, tatra asaṃsargā- viṣayatvakāryatvaprakārakatvayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve vini- gamanāvi raheṇa hetuhetumadbhāvadvayakalpanam |

jñānābhāvaviśiṣṭakāryatvaprakārakasya hetavena yatra aprā- māṇyagraho bhramarūpaḥ, tatra apramātvāt saṃsargāviṣayakatva- kāryatvaprakārakatvayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve vinigamanāvira- heṇa hetuhetumadbhāvadakalpane atigauravāpattiḥ |
ataḥ atra asaṃgrāhyatva pravṛttyavyavahārahetutvānupapatteḥ nāsyā- tisaṃbhavaḥ |
na caivaṃ ' caitro rajata- jñānavān kāryatājñānavattvāt ' iti jñānāt maitrasya pravṛttyāpattyā - bhrāntabhrāntisaṃkarapattiriti vācyam |
parakīya rajatatva- prakārakajñānajñānataḥ kṣaṇavilambena rajatatvaprakārakajñānā- deva pravṛttyaṅgīkārāt, jñānāviṣayakajñānatvena pravṛttyaṅgī- kārādvā na doṣaḥ |
yadvā rajataviṣayakapravṛttitvāvacchinnaṃ prati rajatatvaprakārakānirūpitarajataviṣayatāyāścālli- jñānatvena hetutvāt na kā''pyanupapattiriti |
kiṃca sarvatra pravṛttau nāsaṃgrāhyatvo hetuḥ, sarvadā pravṛttyapatteḥ |
kiṃtu pramājanyapravṛttau tatkāryakāraṇaniścayo hetuḥ, abhramanya- pravṛttau ca asaṃgrāhyatvaḥ, iti kāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanā- gauravam |
mama tu (mīmāṃsakasya) sarvatra pravṛttau tatkāraka- niścayatvena hetutvaṃ iti lāghavaṃ iti dik |
yatra anyathā gatiḥ nāsti tatra asaṃtatamapi svīkriyate |
mahatā mārgeṇa gacchan yadi kathaṃ cit rūḍhaḥ syāt tadā padapathe- nāpi gantumīhate |
ke. tulyavikalpatve hi tāvat adoṣatvāt agatika- gatinyāyena ka cidevāśrīyate |
agamyāgamanamanācāraḥ—(agamyā anupa- bhogyā parastrī, tasyāṃ gamanaṃ tadupabhogaḥ |
tatra cakārādubhayatra sarvāsaાં viniyogasya spaṣṭatvāt pañca- daśānāṃ samuccayena sāmidhenītvam |
yājyānuvākyārtha- tvena catasṛṇāmevāpekṣitatve'pi pañcadaśānāṃ vikalpena vini- yogaḥ |
iti prāpte, ka citsarvopadeśaḥ ka cidekadeśopadeśaḥ :- iti vidhivairūpyasyāyuktatvāt prathamojttamā'

agni citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta iti saṃyogasya kālyathaivābhāvāt agnihautrarūpadravyatvamarādupakārakāṇā- mapi pavamānahavīṣāṃ dravyāścadarśanāt|

śyenaciti citvāta svargakāma: iti phalārthāśritakriyāyā ākāṅkṣayā tadaṅgameva vā iti prāpte, saṃnipātino: sthāṇḍilacayanayorādupakārakāṇākāṅkṣatayā tatva- yogān kratugatatva: iti nyāyena (2|3|1|23) sānicityakratoriva cinotyarthatvāt kratvaṅgaṃ sautrāmaṇī vaimyadhat kratoranantaramevānuṣṭheyā|
ṣoḍaśina citutvātta dakṣiṇābhī rādheyat ityāmnātaṃ dakṣiṇābhi: rādhanamapi varadānavat cayanāṅgaṃ iti prāpte, dakṣiṇāyā bhṛtitvenānarthatvāt tasyāśca prayogaprayuktatvāt dṛṣṭārthatvācca kratvaṅgam|
yadgni hotrāyāvahati sviyakṛtaṃ tadāvahati iti śrutvā hotrārthe odhyamāno'gni: sviya- kṛtyāgadevatārūpa: sviyakṛtaguṇo'gni: evetyavagama|

yadāhavanīye juhoti tena so'syāgnī: prīta: iti śrutyantare cāhutisaṃyogādi: prītaśca bhavati - ityeka- tvayamānaṃ sviyakṛtamāhavanīyāgnereva pratiyate, ityeka- syāveṣṭitvamarthyaṃ ceti dvayamapi saṃpannam|
taccau- pādhikabhedāgnīnāṃ supapādamityāhavanīya: eva mī. ko. 3
sviyakṛtagni:; ityavaśrutye agni hotrāyāvaha iti nigade apa: ityuha:|
yat bhāṣye devatāvorhavyevoddeśa- katvenāvahahavyavahanābhyāṃ sviyakṛtyāsaṃjñakatvāditi sviya- kṛti sarvahute devatāvāhanestvaiva lopa iti|

sviyakṛtyā- lope'pi tattavyogalopābhāvena devatāvāhanalopāyāgāt iti prāpte, abhītyupasargayogāt iṣitāto: icchārthakā- triṣpaveṣṭyavadhāryakartṛtvasyāhavanīya eva upādāne'pi supasṛṣṭa- jyihātunippannasviyakṛtyābhedāt ekasyaiva aupādhikabhedā- ṅgīkaraṇobhayanirvāhakopādheraśravaṇādāhavanīya evā- gni: sviyakṛta:|
vā - ye punarāhavanīyādaya: teṣāṃ sarvārthatvamaprastuta- meva, na ca (sa) prasaṅgāducyate svakālasya hetorapi asamarthatvāt|
na ca tasya uttarapakṣe kaścit pakṣasya hetorvā parāmarśo'sti|
yadi ca laukikakāryāpekṣayā sarvā- rthatvamabhidhīyate, tato vihāro laukikānāmartha sādhayet prabhutvāt ( 1|2|1|1 ) ityuktvā ‘nirdaśādvā vaidi- kānāṃ syāt ’ ( 1|2|1|3 ) ityatra nirṇitatvādvicā- ryam|

yadapi vedavihitāgnikāryasarvārthatvaṃ prakṛtivikṛtyo: tadapi ‘agnimupanidhāya stuvate ’ ityādṛtya ‘viśaye laukikaṃ syāt sarvahyetat ’ ( 7|3|1|30 ) ‘na vaidikamyanirdeśāt ’ ( 31 ) ‘tathopacitireṣāṃ sama- tvāt ’ ( 32 ) iti nirṇitatvādvicāryam|
tathyau, kimāhavanīyādayaḥ prakṛtyarthāḥ āhoṣit sarvārthā iti |
tatra 'tat prakṛtyartha yathā'nyenārambhavādāḥ' (3|6|154) 'prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt' (3|6|152) ityevaṃ prāpte, abhīdhīyate |
tadetat varṇitaṃ 'sarvāthai vā''dhānasya svakā- latvāt' (3|6|155) ityatra |
na tu etat sarva- viṣayaṃ sarvārthatvamavakalpate |
prāpyantīdaśā bhāvā na svatantrāḥ kathaṃ cana ||
śāstreṇa coditā ye hi davihomāḥ svarūpataḥ |
tena avaśyaṃ āhavanīyacodanayā tāvat pratīkṣitavyaṃ, yāvat 'caturastraṃ juhoti' 'yad grahān juhoti' 'yaccamasān juhoti' iti cātideśena saṃtratvāt dvāraṃ prāptam |
tathā ca 'tāsāmadhiḥ prayātavat' (3|6|166) iti siddhavat prakṛtyarthatvaṃ darśitam |
tathā vaikṛtacapuroḍā- śānāṃ pratyakṣahaviḥśravaṇāt gārhapatyamāsiddāraṃ nāsti ityadayaṃ sargāhapatyameva śravaṇaṃ prakṛtitaḥ prāpnuvata apekṣitavyam |
vi— 'prakṛtyarthasya sarvārtho vahi, rātro'stu parṇa- vat |

' yathā 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati, na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' ityasau parṇavidhiḥ (palāśavṛkṣavidhiḥ) prakṛtyarthaḥ, evaṃ ādhānasyāpi anārambhāvītatvāt āhitaḥ āhavanīyā- agniḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ, iti cet, maivam |
sā ca juhūḥ prakṛtāveva vihitā vikṛtiṣu sarvatrātidiśyate |
sa ca cit prakṛtāveva vihitaḥ san vikṛtau atidiśyate, tadyathā prajānāriṣṭhā- dihomāḥ |
tādṛśe viṣaye 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti vākyena agniḥ prakṛtāveva vidhīyate, vikṛtau tu homena saha ati- diśyate, tasāttatra parṇanyāyaḥ |
yastu homo vikṛtau upadiśyate tadyathā sāṃgrahaṇyādīta āmanhomāḥ, tatra dvārabhūtasya homasya vikṛtau upadiśyamānatayā dvāriṇo'pi prakṛtāviba vākyena vikṛtāvāpi vicāritumimaśakyaḥ |
bhāṭṭa—āhavanīyādayaḥ agnayaḥ anārambhādhītavacanaiḥ homādyanuvādena vihitāḥ parṇatānyāyena prakṛtihomāyarthī eva |
atideśena prāpyante, teṣu prāsikālavaiṣamyāt spaṣṭameva dviruktatvam |

ye'pi āmanhomādayaḥ apūrvāḥ, teṣāmapi vikṛti- saṃbandhadho'vyatirekeṇa aṅgātmakatvānupapatteḥ, vikṛteśca klṛptopakārāṅgagrahaṇārthaṃ prathamamatideśakalpanātsarvabhāvāt, tasya ca prakṛtau āhavanīyaprāptimanatareṇa anupapatteḥ teṣvapi dviruktatvam |
atasteṣu nopadeśena, nāpi yūpāvaṭastaravatrārthaṃ atideśena āhavanīyaprāptiḥ |
ataḥ adhikaraṇaṃ vinaiva te iti prāpte, satyaṃ atideśa- prāpteṣu āhavanīyādyupadeśaḥ |
apūrveṣu tu asya anāra- mbhādhītatvāt upadeśena prāptirividdhā |
nahi āman- homādīnāṃ vikṛtisaṃbandhaṃ vinā nāṅgātmakatvaṃ, utpattivākye iṣṭasāmāmyasya bhāvyatvenāpi śābdabodhasya paryavasanatayā
agniḥ auttaravedikaḥ śālāmukhī yasya eka- deśa eva, na kutsnaḥ ||

some samāmnātaṃ 'prāgmagniṃ praṇayanti' iti praṇayanaviśeṣatvāt sarvasāhavanīyasya auttaravedikasya ita ārabhyāhavanīyatvena tasyaiva sarvahomādhikaraṇatvāt iti śrutau āhavanīyasyāpādana- tvaśravaṇāt, tasya cānyāpāye dhruvena asyevāviśeṣaḥ |
ata eva 'pūrvo yat sannaparo bhavāti' iti mantraliṅgaṃ 'pūrvamagnimanvetīti' ityādi pūrvāparaśabdena śālāmukhī- yāhavanīyayorbahvaśca saṃgacchate |
agniḥ jyotiṣṭome tadapavarge evaṃ laukikaḥ syāt na dīkṣaṇīyāpavarge ||

some dīkṣaṇīyāpavargettaraṃ vidyamāno'pyāhavanīyo'diruktanyāyena laukika eva iti prāpte, 'devatā ebhyaḥ bhavataḥ parigṛhya yajamāno'rumbhe' iti vacanena somāyāgīsakaladevatāparigrahasaṃskārasya aniṣṭattvāt tadapagame tadapagamātpate'gnimādhiyaiva ā anantaṃ dhāryeta |
vastuto dīkṣāyāḥ saumikatvena tadapagayana- syāpi tadarthatvāt somāpavarge eva laukikatā, na dīkṣaṇīyā- samātau |
ata eva 'na vede patnī vācyati nainaṃ stugātya- saṃsthita iva vā atra yajño yatsaumyo'dhvaraḥ' iti śrutiḥ somāpavargābhyavandanadvārā agneralaukikameva dhvanayati |
agniḥ sviṣṭakṛt gārhapatyādhiṣṭhātā devatā- viśeṣa eva ||
sa āhavanīyatvena miśrito devatā rūpa eva kaścidagniḥ syāt |
sviṣṭakṛtṇe devatāyā eva sāmarthyāt iti prāpte, 'gārhapatyaḥ sviṣṭakṛt' iti vacanātsāpi katipayāhutisaṃyogena sviṣṭakṛt- saṃbhavādārhapatyānyapiṣṭhātṛdevatāviśeṣa eva sviṣṭakṛt |
tacca paśau vitatya patan yaḥ śyenaḥ, tadākāraṃ prāyaḥ kurvanti |
anye'pi ca bhūyāṃsaḥ kūrmākārāḥ vede uktāḥ |
tatra prathame cayanaprayoge anekākārāḥ sahasramiṣṭakā bhavanti, jānudaghnā ca vediḥ |
tatra pañca prastarāḥ pratiprasta- rottaraṃ purīṣaṃ iti pañca purīṣāṇi, iti pañcacitikaṃ cayanaṃ kriyate |
prastaradvayaṃ ekaṃ ca purīṣaṃ iti ekā citiḥ, evaṃrītyā pañcaiva citayaḥ |
evaṃ ca daśa prastarāḥ pañca purīṣāṇi, nābhimadhnā vediḥ |
tṛtīye tu prayoge sahasratrayaṃ iṣṭakāḥ, pañcadaśa prastarāḥ, pañca purīṣāṇi, āsyadaghnā vediḥ |
tatra prastaratrayaṃ ekaṃ ca purīṣaṃ iti ekā-citiḥ, evaṃ pañca citayaḥ |
caturthāda'pi prayogā bhavanti, tatra iṣṭakā- parimāṇaṃ adhikādhikādhikameva syāt |
atha aṣṭau ṛtvijo vṛtvā sāvitrahomaṃ itarāśva kāścidāhutīrhutvā abhimādāya aśvaṃ gardabhaṃ ca gṛhītvā nakhalavanasthāne gacchanti |
anyā mṛdaṃ khanitvā kṛṣṇājine- nāveṣṭya gardabhapṛṣṭhe sthāpayitvā ānayanti, aśvastu bhūmyādyākramaṇāt |
mṛdi armakapālaveṇvādigādicū- rṇāni saṃmidya jalenārdrā kṛtvā piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā agni- sthāpanārthaṃ caturasrāṃ ukhāṃ kṛtvā pacanti |
tataḥ puruṣasya aśvasya ṛṣabhasya mepasya vatsya ceti pañca paśuśīrṣāṇi sidvāni kurvanti |
sāmidhenīranūcya sucya- mādhāramādhāya dīkṣaṇīyāmiṣṭiṃ kṛtvā paṭ ādhvarikīḥ, paṭ āgnikīḥ śrauti dvādaśa dīkṣāhutīrjuhoti |
tataḥ pūrvoktā- yāmukhāyāṃ saṃtāpena ukhyaṃ nāma agniṃ utpādayāti |
tatra saṃmidha ādhāya śiṣye sāgnimukhāṃ nidadhāti |
vakṣasi rukmaṃ pratimucya tat viśiṣṭaṃ śikhyaṃ skandhaṭe prati- muñcati |
viṣṇukramādi kṛtvā śikhyaṃ kaṇṭhādunmucya āsandyāṃ sādayati |
tato gārhapatyamiti kṛtvā tadupari udyamagniṃ nipavati |
tato dūraṃ naiṛtyāṃ diśi naiṛtīḥ tisra iṣṭakā upadadhāti |
akṛṣṭapāce sata āraṇyā iti caturthe opadhīrdhapati |
svarthaśabdena (2|3|188) iti dvaitikādhikaraṇe upakramasya nairākāṅkṣyāt vākyaśeṣasya devatāsamarpakatvaṃ nirākṛtya bṛhaspatipadasya brāhmaṇaparatvāṅgīkāreṇa munyanatayā nīvārastutiparatvanirṇayāt |
kimatra carūyāgārthaḥ, yāgaṃ kṛtvā avaśiṣṭaḥ upadhātavyaḥ, uta upadhānāyaiḥ evetivicāre upadhānārthaḥ evāyaṃ, na yāgārthaḥ iti nirṇayaḥ |
sā ca ādimanmanato na grāhyā, kiṃtu prakaraṇena kramaṃ bādhilā nijecchayā prathamato manyataḥ anto vā upakramya sā pūrṇāyā |
kṛte (akṛte ca) abhiṣekre nānāvījānāṃ āvaraṇaṃ kriyate |
vi. 10|5|6 agnicayane paṭhitānāmādhānārthānāṃ vapanārthānāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ śrutasaṃkhyāsattve aniyamenopadānaṃ, nādimā- nāmeva |
bhā. 10|1|14| 14 'pañca citayo bhavanti' iti citiśabdena ekataḥ prastara ucyate, na sarvā vediḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|17 'prāṇa- bhūta upadadhāti' atra liṅgakaraṇaprāptamantrānuvādena iṣṭakopadhānaṃ vidhīyate |
prāṇabhūtaṃ ca yadyapi prathame eva mantre, tathāpi tatsahacaritāḥ sarve mantrāḥ prāṇabhūtacchandena lakṣyante |
na tu 'lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇa' ityanenaiva |
ye tu adhikā mantrāste prayogāntare upayujyante |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|15 nyūnapūraṇaṃ, yasyāṃ citau ye mantrāḥ prakāntāḥ teṣu samāpteṣu 'lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇa' iti mantrāvṛttyā iṣṭakopadhānaṃ kartavyaṃ, na tu prakāntānāmeva āvṛttyā |
tena tāḥ sakṛdupa- dhātavyāḥ, na tu praticiti |
3|6|12|35 citriṇyāḥ cayanaṃ prati anaṅgatvān nāsti āvṛttiḥ |
vi. 5|1|6 bhūteṣṭakāḥ satyāpādena tatīyasyāṃ citau upadheyatvoktāḥ |
ke. iṣṭakānāṃ brāhmaṇa- vihitānāṃ madhyamacitau upadhānam |
tathā ca mantrāvādī sṛṣṭiśabdo'yaṃ, na guṇavidhāyakaḥ |
1|4|17 iṣṭakādharmāḥ raudre gāvīdhuke carau sarvopadhe ca na kartavyāḥ, anārabhya eva sthaṇḍile sarvopadhāpanasya, samāpte ca carunidhānasya kriyamāṇatayā tatkāryāpyabhāvāt |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|10 devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi agnau śrūyante 'agnīpomīyasya puroḍāśamana devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati' iti |
tatra paśuparoḍāśasya tantraṃ kartavyaṃ (tasmāt anuni- rvāpyeṣu paśupuroḍāśatantrasya prasaṅgaḥ) |

bhā. 12|1|2 1-8 sāgninicaye vikṛtikṛtau 'svargāya vā eṣa lokāya cīyate yadagnirvaiśvānara ekādaśinī, yadagnāvekādaśinīṃ minuyāt vajñaivaitan svargāllokādantardhāt, yanna minuyāt svarubhiḥ paśūn vyarthayedūpaṃ minoti, nainaṃ vajreṇa svargā- lokādantardhāti, na svarubhiḥ paśūn vyarthayati' iti ekayupo ekādaśa paśavo niyojyāḥ iti |
tatra pratipaśu racanā kāryā yadi pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

bhā. 4|4|24 agnicadratāni- agniṃ citvā saṃvatsaraṃ na kaṃ cana pratyavarohet (amyutthānaṃ na kartavyam), na pakṣa- ṇḍo'gniryāvajjīvaṃ varṣati na dhāvet, na rāmāmupeyāt (dharmapatnīṃ tu upeyāt), na dvitīyaṃ citvā anyasya striya- mupeyāt, na tṛtīyaṃ citvā kāṃ canopeyāt, bhāryā vā upeyāt |
satyāṣāḍhaḥ 12|1|15-17 guṇakāmānāṃ yadi agniḥ tadā pravṛttiḥ |
dupa. 10|8|11|127 citiḥ pañca naimittikī agnicayanottara apratiṣṭhāyāṃ nimitte ekaiva aṣṭārthā, cayanādyathā prayogabhedena pratiṣṭhāphalārthaṃ vā vidhīyate |
bhā. 4|4|3 citiḥ ṣaṣṭhī 'saṃvatsaro vā enaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayate, yo'gniṃ citvā na pratiṣṭhiti, pañca pūrvāścitayo bhavanti, atha pañcīṃ citiṃ cinute'
itiśrutyuktā na nityā, kiṃtu pratiṣṭhā'bhāvanimittena naimittikī |
tathā ca pañca citayo nityāḥ, pañcī ca citi- rnityā, iti pañcacitiko'gniḥ kartavyaḥ |
agnicayana upasadineṣveva, na tu tataḥ pūrvam |

mantrabrāhmaṇayoścottarameva cayanapāṭhādupasadyaḥ pūrva- mevāmiśritavyaḥ; iti prāpte, 'yadaharagniṃ ceyyamāṇastadaharamaṃ samasyet' ityanyupasadorekāhakriyamāṇarūpasamāsavidhā- nādupasadine evāmiśritavyaḥ |
agnicayanaṃ trivārameva kartavyamiti na niyamaḥ, caturthyāhārasaṃbhavāt |

trivāramevāmiśritavyo nādhikāraṃ, 'jānudaghnaṃ cinavīta' ityādikāvyairvicāra- māhiṣyamāṇāneva svandilaparimāṇe'kāsaṃvidhānāṃ vidhā- nāt, iti prāpte, yathākāmyena bahuvāraṃ prātavya tadāhārasya parisaṃkhyārthatve gauravāpatteḥ, prathamāhārānimittakaguṇamātra- vidhānaparatvenāpi teṣāṃ vidhīnāmapatteḥ; 'uttaramuttaraṃ jyāyāṃsaṃ' ityasya 'nāsadyaṃ citvā kanīyāṃsaṃ cinavīta' ityasya 'bṛhatamamaparitaṃ svargākāmaścinavīta' ityasya cārthavattvāya santi caturthyāhārāḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ - tasminneva ukhye cintā, kimayaṃ nityaṃ dhāryo na vā, athavā naiva dhāryateti |
nityadhāraṇe vikalpaḥ, dhāryo vā na vā |
'na pratisamidhyet, yat pratisamidhyati bhrātṛvyamasya janayati' (samidhyet, samidhyet ityatra saminvīta iti pāṭho'nyaḥ) iti śrutiḥ |
yathā, 'na gantavyaṃ, na bhoktavyaṃ' iti sati gamanaprasaṅge bhojanaprasaṅge ca bhavati |
na ca śrutintareṇa prasaṅga upapadyate, iti nityadhāraṇasya vidhāyikā śrutirnumīyate, tathā prāptiḥ; pratiṣedhena nivṛttiḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ - yadi kadā cit pratyakṣayā śrutyā prasaṅgo na syāt tatrānyā'numīyeta |
asti tu nityadhāraṇasya prasaṅgikā gataśriyaḥ śrutiḥ 'ghāyo gataśriya āhnīyaḥ' iti |
ato nityadhāraṇasya avidhānāt kāryābhāvācca adhāraṇameva syāt |
jñā--kāmyāgniprasaṅgaṃ (prasaṅgagataṃ vicāraṃ) samāpya punaḥ nityamevāvāgnimupakramya cintayati, kimukhyasya nitya
'pratisamindhet' ityāhavanīyādhāraśravaṇabalena kathaṃ cidāhavanīyādhāragocarasāmānyavacanaṃ hṛdayamāgamamya paryudāsatatvaṃ samarthanīyam|
' bhāṭṭa— nitye tūkhye gataśrītve nimitte āhavanīya- tvādeva prāptamapi ajasradhāraṇaṃ 'na pratisaṃdedhyāt' ityanena paryudastatvāt na kartavyameva ityapi prāsaṅgikameva|

nyāyavinduḥ—ukhyesya vikalpena nityadhāraṇaṃ 'na pratisaṃdedhyāt' iti dhāraṇaniṣedhasya prāptipūrvakatvena dhāraṇavidhividhumānāt, iti prāpte, āhavanīyasthānā- pannatvāt tadat gataśrītve dhāraṇaṃ ukhye'pi prāptamanena pratiṣidhyate iti nāśṛtavidhumānāt, tasmādadhārya eva ukhyeḥ iti siddhāntaḥ|
bhāṣyaṃ—asti agnau ukhye'gniḥ 'saṃtatāpenāgniṃ jana- yati' iti|
taṃ prakṛtya śrūyate 'vṛkṣāgrājjvalato brahmā- varcasakāmasya āhatvāvadadhyāt, āghrādadhyātkāmasya, vaiyatād vṛṣṭikā masya' iti|
tatra vicāryate, kiṃ kāmyasya nityasya vā'gneḥ samuccayāḥ, athavā kāmyena nityo'gniḥ vikriyate iti|
nanu 'naimittikaṃ tu prakṛtau tadvikāraḥ saṃyogaviśeṣāt' (3|6|13|10) ityanena nyāyena kāmyo'gnirnityasya vikāro bhaviṣyati|
ame- rnibhojane ayaṃ kāmaḥ śrūyate 'āhatvāvadadhyāt brahmavarcasa- kāmasya' iti, na brahmavarcasakāmasya ayamagnihomārthā bhavatīti|
dupū— 'vṛkṣāgrājjvalato brahmavarcasakāmasya āhatvā- vadadhyāt' ityatra vicāryate, kiṃ ukhyesya vārdhāgneśca samuccayaḥ, uta vārdhāgneya ukhye āvadhyate iti|
'brahmavarcasakāma- syāhatvāvadadhyāt' iti avadhānāt kāmaḥ śrūyate nāgnyantarāt|
evaṃ cet avadhānaṃ kṛtvā kṛtārthaḥ śabdaḥ nāgnyantaraṃ nivartituṃ śaknoti, tasmādavadhānānmātrāt phalam|
bhāṣyaṃ—yadi ca kāmyena nityo'gnirvikriyeta, sa naiva syāt|
yadi so'gniḥ ukhye'nyeta tato devatā aparigṛhītā bhaveyuḥ|
tadetadu- khetu 'naimittikaṃ tu prakṛtau tadvikāraḥ' (3|6|13|10) iti|
'vṛṣṭikāmo vaiyatāt' iti viśeṣeṇa, tena sāmānyaṃ bādhyate|
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? svāśrayeṣu anyāvṛttaviṣayasya sāmā- nyasya tato'nyāpi vṛttisaṃbhavāt|
viśeṣasya cānyapari- cchinnasya etrāvasāyinaḥ tadasaṃbhave vipayābhāvaprasaṅgāt upadeśavaiyarthyaṃ mā bhūt iti|
atha yaduktaṃ niyoge kāma- darśanāditi, tatra brūmaḥ|
'āhatvāvadadhyāt' iti nityasyaiva homārthasyāvadhānasya ayaṃ viśeṣakāgamayogaḥ; āghrādāhavya atrāpyakāmasyeti|
yadi avadhāne kāmaśrutiḥ syāt, avadhānaṃ vidhī- yeta, nāvidhīyamānaṃ kāmasya sādhanatvena yujyate|
tasmiṃśca vidhīyamāne viśeṣaśca sa ca, ityanekārthatvāt vākyaṃ
kiṃ tarhi? homā- yaivāyaṃ nityo niyogaḥ: aviśeṣeṇavidhānārthamanūdyate|
yāvadaktaṃ syāt, vaiyṛtamagniṃ homārthe kuryāditi, tāvade- vedam|
