evaṃ cet, naimittikaḥ tasmistasmin kārye nitya- magniṃ vikriyate ityupapannam|
dupū— 'svāśrayeṣu avyāvṛttaviṣayasya sāmānyasya tato'nyāpi vṛttisaṃbhavāt' iti (bhāṣyam)|
'brāhmaṇe- bhyo dadhi dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya' ) svāśrayeṣu brāhmaṇa- piṇḍeṣu avyāvṛttaviṣayasya sāmānyasya aparicchinnaviṣa- yasya viśeṣāpekṣayā tato'nyāpi vṛttisaṃbhavāt|
tasmāt viśeṣāt kauṇḍinyāt anyatrāpi brāhmaṇapiṇḍeṣu vṛttiḥ saṃbhavatyet|

'viśeṣasya cānyataḥ paricchinnasya tadavasāyinaḥ tadasaṃbhave vipayābhāvaprasaṅgāt upadeśavaiyarthyaṃ mā bhūt iti' (iti bhāṣyam) viśeṣa punaḥ: kauṇḍinyādeḥ anyebhyo brāhmaṇapiṇḍebhyaḥ avacchinnasya tadavasāyinaḥ tadasaṃbhave tasminsaṃbhave vipayābhāvaprasaṅgāt upadeśa- vaiyarthyaṃ syāt|
yat kāraṇaṃ, śāstrānugrahaḥ dadhidāne kṛte anugṛhītaṃ śāstraṃ, ityubhayatra dadhidānam|
tasmāt ya eva bādho'sābhirvarṇitaḥ: nityanaimittiko, sa eva|
bhāṣyaṃ—yaceduktaṃ, asati cāsaṃskṛteṣu karma syāditi, tatra brūmaḥ|
bhāṣyaṃ—api ca yadi samuccayaḥ syāt, prādātyena saha saṃsargaḥ syāt vaihārikasya|
śucaye'ṣṭakapālaṃ nirvapet, yasyāgniḥ prādātyena saha saṃsṛjyate, aśucitara eṣa yo'gniḥ prādātyaḥ' (iti)|
evamubhayatra vācanikatvāt doṣābhāve sati naimittikatvāt vikāra āśrīyate, na samuccayaḥ|
bhāṣyaṃ—atha yaduktaṃ tasya devatārthatvāditi, tatra brūmaḥ|
utsarge'pi nityasyāgnerdevatāpiragraho na viruddhaḥ, karmaṇaḥ kṛtatvāt|
evaṃ śrūyate 'yaḥ pūrveṇagniṃ gṛhṇāti, sa vai śrobhūte devatā abhyajete' iti|
vikalpasamuccaya- vicāre samāte samuccayaḥ evāsti nāsti iti cintyate iti saṃgatiḥ|
soma—jāvanīnāmekārthatvāt vikalpe'pi ukhyesya vārdhāgdeśa bhinnakāryatvāt samuccayaḥ ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ|
' bhāṭṭa—agnau ukhye'gniḥ 'saṃtatāpenāgniṃ jana- yati' ityanena ukhyaḥ āhavanīyābhidhāraṇa- pātraṃ yajamānagale śikyena avyamātraṃ dhriyate|
tatra dīkṣottara- kālatvāt agnihotrādhyākaraṇe'pi kṛtavaryā homāḥ kriyante|
taṃ prakṛtya 'vṛkṣāgrājjvalato brahmavarcasakāmasya āhatvāvadadhyāt, āghrādadhyātkāmasya' iti śrutam|
tadiha kāmyaprayoge nityasya āhavanīyasya bādha- vidhayā prasaṅgasiddhirasti na vā iti cintāṃ, nātra ukhyādhikaraṇakavadhānāśrito āghrādibhiḥ phaloddeśena
vidhīyate, yena godohaneneva camasasya prasaṅgasiddhirāśa- ṅkyeta, avadhānasya vidhyantaravihitatvābhāvena āśra- yatvānupapatteḥ |
ato'vacanameva agni viśiṣṭaṃ ukhādhi- karaṇakaṃ phaloddeśena vidhīyate |
utyasya āhava- nīyāgneḥ agmyantarasaṃsargo'pi ca vācanikatvātra duṣyati |

ataśca phalārthe agmyantarāvadhānamātrakaraṇe'pi āhavanīya rūpasya nityasyosya bādhābhāvāt atraiva homādīni iti prāpte, vidhyantaravihitatvābhāve'pi homāthameva dhāraṇāsthāvadhānasya arthāptatvena upasthita- tvāt āśrayalopapatteḥ, lāghavāt guṇaphalasaṃbandhaḥ evāyaṃ, iti nityasyosya nivṛttyā prasaṅgasiddhiḥ |
nyāyacinduḥ— agnī ( cayane ) uvāyāṃ sthāpyamagniṃ prakṛtya śrutaṃ 'vṛkṣāgrājjvalto brahmavarcasakāmasya āhavatvādyāt, āghrādagnyāyakāmasya' iti |
tatra nityakā- myayoḥ samuccayaḥ, nityasya homārthatvāt kāmyasya (ca) ava- dhānamātratvena homārthatvābhāvāt iti prāpte, homāthī- vadhānamātraśca agmyantarāmātrasya phale vidhiḥ |
' agnicayanaprakaraṇe śrutasya jvaladvṛkṣakṣā- dyāhatasya kāmyāgneḥ āhavanīyatvaṃ nāsti |
bhāṣyaṃ— yakṣāsau vaihāriko'gniḥ sa āhavanīyaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ— anyo vā āhavanīyāt syāt, nāyamā- udghṛtya āhūyate 'āghrādāharet' 'prādāvyādāharet' iti |
āhavanīyaśabdaśca saṃskāranimittaḥ saṃskāreṣu tatsa- dvāt, abhāvācca prāk tebhyaḥ |
yacca āhutisaṃyogā- diti, siddhe āhavanīyatve āhutayo vidhīyante 'yadāhava- nīye juhvati' iti |
siddhena tena āsāṃ (āhutīnāṃ) vidhānāt na tatkṛtaṃ tat bhavati |
śā— so'yaṃ kāmyo'gniḥ āhavanīyaśabdavācyaḥ syāt, āhūyate asminniti |
naivaṃ, ādhānajanmanaḥ saṃskāraviśeṣasya vācakaḥ ayaṃ āhavanīyaśabdaḥ, nāsati tasmin saṃskāre vartitumarhati |

homādhāratayā āha- vanīyatve tu 'āhavanīyaṃ juhoti' ityāhavanīyasya sato home vidhiḥ; homādhāratvañca āhavanīyaṃ, iti parasparā- śrayaprasaṅgāt, homādhāratve'pi padādiṣu tatprayogābhāvācca rūḍha evāyam |
vi— so'gmirāhavanīyo no vā, ''ya āhuti- yogātaḥ |
bhā— so'yaṃ kāmyāgniḥ āhavanīyapadavācyaḥ syāt homāsādhanatvāt |
atastatra āhavanīyadharmāḥ gataśrīdhā- raṇādyāḥ kāryā iti saṃbhavamātreṇa āśaṅkā |
ādhāna- janyasaṃskāraviśeṣavācakāḥ āhavanīyaśabdāḥ nāsati tasmin saṃskāre vartitumarhanti |
śā- 'vājapeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' iti vājapeyāṅgatvena codyamāno bṛhaspatisavaḥ kiṃ pradhānakāle śāradi tena saha ekaprayogaḥ kartavyaḥ, uta atideśaprāpte svakāle vasante, iti saṃśayaḥ |
' ('aṅgāni tu vidhāna- tvāt0 11|2|17 ityekādaśe deśakālakartṛṇāṃ sāṅga- pradhānasaṃbandhasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt iti bhāvaḥ |

nahi vājapeyaḥ śāradi kartavyaḥ codyate, kintu vājapeyakaraṇaṃ yaḥ phalārtho vyāpāraḥ prayogaḥ: phalabhāvanāyāḥ, tasyāyaṃ kālavidhiḥ, 'śāradi vājapeyena' iti tṛtīyānirdeśāt, tasyaiva phalasāmagrībhūtasya cikīrṣitasya kālapekṣāyāt |
sa ca vyāpāraḥ aṅgapradhānanyāyasaktaḥ, iti tulyaḥ pradhāna- svāṅgānāṃ
soma--'anantaraṃ vrataṃ tadbhūtatvāt' (5|3|9|22) iti pūrvādhikaraṇoktaguṇasūtre yadagnihotrādidaivabhyena ādhānānaṃtarakartavyatvaṃ āhitāgnistokaṃ tad dṛṣṭāntena pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ|
'karmaṇi' (pā0 3|2|1) 'bhūte' (pā03|1|84) iti karmaṇi agnau upapade cinoterdhātoḥ kvippratyayavidhānāt agnikarmikā cayanakarmikā bhāvā bhūtā satī nimittaṃ, na tu cayanakarmikā|
bhāvanā ca phalaniṣpattyā bhūtā bhavati, kriyāyāḥ phalapavargītvāt|
tena sāṅgatyakasamāptiparyantaṃ cayanakaraṇakāgnisaṃskāramādhyakabhāvanāniryuktibhāvena nimittabhāvāt 'cayananānantarameva vratapravṛttiḥ' iti na yuktitam|
ādhānasya tu cayanavat kṛtvalatvābhāvena kalpapūrvasādhanasaṃskāratvābhāvāt svatantrameva agnigatamadṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ, iti nāhitāgniteṣu kalpantaptīkṣā|
agnicidvratāni tu cayananenāgniṃ saṃskṛtavato vidhīyamānāni cayananāntarakāryya-syāṇḍilasthāpanādimātreṇāgnicittvābhāvāt kravante eva pravartante iti vaiṣamyam|
sūtrārthastu agnicitsaṃyuktaṃ vrataṃ citamātre eva syāt nimittasya prāpteḥ iti|
vi--'na dhāved varṣatītyādi citau satyāṃ kṛtā-buta|
bhāṭṭa--'varṣati na dhāvet' ityādīni agni-cidvratāni āmaraṇaṃ varṣamātraṃ vā cayane nimitte puruṣārthatayā, āghāne nimitte āhitāgnivratadeva vihitāni|

tadida-magnicidvrataṃ bhūtavayanamātrasya bhūtāgnavat nimittatvāt cayanamātre kṛte kartavyaṃ āhitāgnivratavat iti prāpte, 'karmaṇi', 'bhūte' iti cānuvartamāne 'agnau ceḥ' iti sūtreṇa kartari cinoteḥ kvippratyayavidhā-nāt karmatvādanyathā''nupapattyā ca bhāvanā''kṣepāt agnikarmakacayanakaraṇakabhāvanāyā eva bhūtatvāḥ nimittatvāgateḥ, agnicidvācyasya ca jvalanāravyasyāneḥ svarūpeṇa cayanakarmatvābhāvāt cayananiṣpāditaṇḍilā-dhāradvārā karmatvāvagateḥ, ādhāratāyā sāṅgatya-yāgasamāptiṃ yāvat agnipceḥ kravante eva agnikarma-kacayanakaraṇakabhāvanāyāḥ bhūtatvāvagateḥ tadante eva agnicidbhavatvāni|
āhitāgnipade tu yadyapi ktapratyayena tathaiva lakṣaṇayā bhāvanāgateḥ tasyā eva bhūtāyāḥ nimittatvāvagamaḥ|
tathāpi jvalanāravyasyāgneḥ ādhānakarmalasya svajananyātparapūrvādhāratvenaiva vācyatvāt, tādṛśasya ca ādhānānte eva niṣpatteḥ tadante eva āhitāgnibratāni|
nahi atra āhavanīyādinā karmatvaṃ śrutaṃ, yena pacamāne-ghyante tanniṣpattiḥ śakyeta|
nyāyabinduḥ--'varṣati na dhāvet' ityādīni agnicidvratāni cayananānantarameva kāryāṇi āhitāgni-vratavat iti prāpte, cayanakriyāyāḥ phalaparyantatvāt tannimittakaṃ tadantarameva kāryyam|
phalaṃ cayanakriyāyāḥ: agnyupakāraḥ homasādhanāgnerdhāraṇam iti tasmātpyanantaraṃ naimittikam|
ādhānaphalaṃ tu agnigataṃ adṛṣṭaṃ anantara-meva bhavati iti viśeṣaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ|
upadhānakaraṇa-tāyāḥ 'tadanāsām' (pā04|4|125) iti smṛtyā'vagame-'pi etā iti padenāhutikaraṇatayā apratītena māntravarṇika-devatāsiddhiḥ|
devatā tu sāmānyaparibhāṣānusāraṇaiva kalpyatā iti prāpte, etā iti padeneṣṭakānāṃ parāmarśaṃ anyādeśā enā ityāpatyā āvaśyakya ṛcāṃ parāmarśena tāsāmāhutipadasāmānādhikaraṇyenyānupapattereva etā-
na tu varṇaśabda eva tatparaḥ; 'śabdasaṃyogāt' iti sūtrasvarasāt |

'varṇaṃ tu cākṣare' iti kośena napuṃsakatvāpa-teśca iti prāpte, 'ṛjurekhāḥ paścācca purastāt, vyāli-khitā madhye' ityantena nānārekhāvatīnāmiṣṭakānāṃ deśavi-śeṣavidhānāt sarvān varṇānityasya pāṭhena sarvavarṇaśabdasya pūrvaprakāntavidhidhairevāparatvātsāyāt, sati tātparya-grahe tadanupapattyā lakṣaṇāyā api nyāyyatayā, yāvadiśe-pāṇāṃ viniyogavidhivi
agnicayane kūrmacitau prāṅmukhamiti karturmukha- vādaḥ pratyakṣamiti tu kūrmavādaḥ |

kūrmopradhānaṃ prakṛtya 'prāṅmukhamupadhāti' ' purastāt pratyakṣamupadhāti' iti śruteḥ karturiva karmaṇe'pi prāṅmukhatvasaṃbhavād aniyamena kūrmaḥ kartā vā prāṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā iti prāpte, vikalpasyānyāyyatvādeva prāṅmukhati karturmukhavādaḥ |
'ghṛteṣṭakā upadadhāti' ityā- dāvapi 'ghṛtaṃ mimikṣire' ityādimantrairupadhānaṃ mantrayī- nāmeva prāṇabhṛnyāyena (1|4|123) vidhīyate iti prāpte ghṛtadravyasyopadhānaṃ, ghaṭe pūraṇena tatsaṃbhavāt |
agnicayane caturasrāṇāmiṣṭakānāmeva 'maṇḍa- leṣṭakā upadadhāti' iti nāmāntaram |
'maṇḍale- ṣṭakā upadadhāti' ityādinā śrutā maṇḍaleṣṭakā nāmno'nyathatvāya parimaṇḍalatvākārā bhaveyuḥ iti prāpte, cayanarūpakāryārthāvirodhāccaturasrāṇāmevetāni nāmāni |
caturthīhāhāreṣu punaḥ prathamatvādi- vakṣyā ekadvitrisahasrā evaiṣṭakā bhaveyuḥ |
kanīyaso niṣedhād trisāhasratvevābhyāsaḥ saṃkhyāntarasyānāmnāt iti prāpte, prakṛtānāṃ saṃkhyānāṃ naimittikatvānimitta- mantareṇa tadapravṛtteḥ saṃkhyāntaramevāśrayaṇīyam |
agnicayane citimāneṣu yajamānagataṃ adhva- yuṃgataṃ vā mānaṃ grāhyam |
tatra karmaṇyadhvaryoḥ pravṛttatvāt aniyamābhimyamasya yuktatvācca tasyaiva mānyo grāhyaḥ |
'śūrpeṇa juhoti' ityatra karmāṅgattvasya grahaṇadarśanāt iti prāpte, yajamānasaṃmānatvasya tasya (adhvaryoḥ) codita- tvāt aniyamaḥ |
agnicayane citiśabdo na prastaraparaḥ, kiṃtu tadavayavaparaḥ |
'pañca citayo bhavanti, pañcabhiḥ purīṣairabhyuhati' ityatra karmaṇi ktinnantena citiśabdena- kaikaḥ prastara ucyate |

tasyā ekatvācca 'agniṃ cinute' iti vidherabhyāsādya- bhāvāt prastarapañcakavidhānādeva puṣkaraṇapuruṣasya- mātrūṇāṃ ca cana niveśe prasakte teṣāṃ pūrvapūrvordhvaparotta- ravidhānaṃ vācanikaṃ saṃgacchate, iti taiḥ saha prastarāḥ iti prāpte, cayanakriyāyā ekatve'pi purīṣavyavadhānakṛta- bhedena tadavayavānāṃ pañcadhāvibhāgāt kaikadeśapara- ścitiśabdaḥ |

ata eva 'svayamātṛṇṇāṃ ca vikarṇī cottame upadadhāti' ityuktvā 'nānyāniśrakāmyuttarāmupa- dadhyāt' ityādinā sarvopari iṣṭakāntaranidhānaniṣedhaiva- dhryāpatteḥ puṣkaraṇādicatuṣṭayasya tvaniyamena niveśe prasakte niyamaviśeṣārthaṃ vidhinaṃ virudhyate |
agnicayane citisamudāyasyaiva vedidharmoḥ, na tu tadādhārabhūmeḥ |

cayanadhārabhūmeḥ uttaravedidharmāḥ kāryāḥ iti prāpte, prakṛtau madhyamapadavihitāyā uttaravedeḥ sthāne eva vikṛtau agnervidhānena tatkāryāpa- nnatā dareṣviva abhāveva uttaravedidharmāḥ, na tadadhobhuvo bhavanti |
tatra idaṃ samadhigataṃ, madhyamāṃ citau upadheyā uta madhyamāyamiti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? prāk loka- praṇāyāḥ, uta paścāditi |
prāk lokapraṇāyāḥ, tasyāḥ saṃpūrṇārthatvāt saṃpūrṇārthatā śrūyate 'yadevāsyornaṃ, yacchidraṃ, tadetayā pūrayati, lokaṃ pṛṇa, chidraṃ pṛṇa' iti |
apūrvātvācca arthasya vidhivaiyarthaṃ, saṃstvo na, iti gamyate |

nanu tatsiddhipeṭikāyāṃ (1|4|23-28 sūtrāṇi vi-śā) 'sṛṣṭīrupadadhāti' ityatra 'ke cittu mantra- vidhimeva samarthayante' ityupakramya 'ekayā''hvata ityādi- mantrāṇāṃ upadhānekāntikaliṅgābhāvāt upadhānārthatayā asti vidhivaiyarthaḥ' ityuktvā 'satyāmupadhānaprāptau madhyamamitisaṃntrārthamapi pratyakṣavidhānamarthavat' ityuktam |
tataśca mantrasya pratyakṣabrāhmaṇavidhānamātreṇa tanmantropa- dheyekānāṃ madhyamacitisaṃbandhāṅgīkārāt kathamiha iṣṭakāyā madhyamacitivipayatvābhāvāvadhāraṇa iti cet |

tathāpi na mantrasya pratyakṣabrāhmaṇavidhāna- mātreṇa iṣṭakāyāḥ pratyakṣabrāhmaṇavat, kiṃtu pratyakṣabrāhmaṇe tanmantropadheyatā iṣṭakāyā nirdeśenāpi bhavitavyaṃ, 'citriṇīrupadadhāti' ityādi citriṇyādiśabdaiḥ iṣṭakānāmabhidhānasyāpi satvāt |

evaṃ ca 'sṛṣṭīrupada- dhāti' ityatra sṛṣṭiśabdena sṛṣṭiśabdamantropadheyeṣṭakā- vacanena viśeṣaṇabhūta mantravidhāne'pi viśeṣyabhūtānāmiṣṭa- kānāmi pratyakṣabrāhmaṇe nirdeśāt upapanno madhyamaciti- saṃbandhaḥ |
iha tu 'lokaṃ pṛṇa, chidraṃ pṛṇa' iti mantramā- trasyaiva pratyakṣabrāhmaṇe śravaṇaṃ, na tu tanmantropadheyatā iṣṭakāśravaṇaṃ, iti na kā''pyupapattiḥ |
vi—'lokaṃ pṛṇa ūrdhvaṃ svācittriyuta tataḥ purā, |
' bhāṭṭa—madhyamāyāmapi prākaraṇikeṣṭakopadhānānantarameva upadhānaṃ citriṇyādīnāṃ, na tu prāk lokapraṇāyāḥ; āgantukatvāt |
na ca 'yadevāsyornaṃ, yacchidraṃ, tadetayā pūrayati, lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇa' iti vacanena lokapraṇāyāḥ pūraṇārthatvāt tasyā ante niveśyate; tataḥ prāk niveśyaḥ citriṇyādīnāṃ (iti vācyam) |
liṅgādeva mantrasya chidrapūraṇārthatve asya vacanasya tadarthavidhivyākhyātvābhāvāt, kathaṃ cit mantrasya tadvidhāyakatve'pi iṣṭakāyāḥ tadarthatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
astu vā mantre chidrapūrakatvasya iṣṭakāyāstatpūrvakaṃ vinā anupapatteḥ |
tasyā api tat, tathāpi tasya (mantrasya) cityantare'pi sāvakāśatvāt na citriṇyādīnāmantenive- śanāyasa (5|1|9) niravakāśasya bādhaḥ |
na ca lokapraṇāyā api pratyakṣabrāhmaṇavat madhyamacitimātra- viṣayatvaṃ, itikaraṇavinivṛttyantena asya mantrasya iṣṭakā- vācitvapadaviniyuktatvābhāvāt |
na ca tathāpi tattaccityantaraparatvapaṭhitatve tatraiva niveśāpatteḥ, cayanamahāprakaraṇapaṭhitatve ca antimacitauve niveśāpatteḥ; kathaṃ sāvakāśatvamiti vācyam |

pūraṇārthatve liṅgādeva dvāreṇa bhedopapatteḥ sarvaviṣayatvāt iti prāpte, citriṇyādīnāṃ ante niveśe lokapraṇāyāḥ chidrapūraṇarūpa- phalasyaiva bādhāpatteḥ varaṃ pūrvapaṭhiteṣṭakopadhānottarakrama- bādhena citriṇyādīnāṃ lokapraṇāyāḥ prāk niveśaḥ |
nyāyavinduḥ— citriṇyādīnāmante niveśo'pi lokapraṇāyāḥ prāgeva niveśaḥ 'yadevāsyornaṃ, yacchidraṃ, tadetayā pūrayati' iti vacanāt lokapraṇāyāḥ saṃpūrṇārtha- tvāt iti siddhāntaḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ, kimetābhyāṃ citau upadheyā uta madhyamāyamiti |
bhāṣyaṃ— 'āpanaṃ vā uttamā citiḥ anyā iṣṭakā upadadhāti' iti |
kutaḥ ? brāhmaṇavatyaḥ etā iṣṭakāḥ, tāsāṃ madhyamā citirāmnāyate |
'yāṃ vai kāṃ cid brāhmaṇavatīmi- ṣṭakāmabhijānīyāt, tāṃ madhyamāṃ citāupadadhyāt' iti |
kiṃ citrī- yādīnāṃ samāyāmupapradhānaṃ uta madhyamāyāmiti |
yāṃ kāṃ ciditi vākyaṃ tu vidheyaṃ na bhavatalam ||
soma-- ameḥ ābhipūvaryārthakatvāt viṣayābhimu- khyasya anyāsaṃbhāvat abhipūrvo jānātiḥ pratyakṣajñā- rthakaḥ |
vākyaṃ ca iti (śā.) evaṃ ca vākyārthasyāvādhe pratyakṣa- prāptikatvādvādhaparatvameva vācyamiti bhāvaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- citrīyādīnāṃ tu 'yāṃ kāṃ cana brāhmaṇava- tīmiṣṭakāmabhijānīyāt tāṃ madhyamāṃ citāupadadhyāt' iti vacanena madhyamacitau upadhānam |
atra hi abhipū- rvasya jānāteḥ pratyakṣajñānavācitvāt vākyasyārthavattvācca pratya- kṣabrāhmaṇavihiteṣṭakoddeśena madhyamacitirūpadeśavidhānam |
pratyakṣabrāhmaṇavattvasya kāvācitśrutadviniyuktamadhyamopadheyatvaṃ ityuktameva bhūmā- dhikaraṇe (1|4|17 bhāṭṭa.) |
na ca pratyakṣabrāhmaṇavattvasya uddeśyaviśeṣaṇatā, tacchabdena viśiṣṭaparāmarśakena viśiṣya- deśopapatteḥ |
nyāyabindu-- citrīyādīnāṃnte niveśaḥ iti prāpte, 'yāṃ vai kāṃ cana brāhmaṇavatīmiṣṭakāmabhijānī- yāt tāṃ madhyamāṃ citau' iti vacanāt madhyamāyāyāṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |

'rudro vā eṣa yadagniḥ, tasya tisraḥ śaravyāḥ pratīcī tiraścyanūcī, tābhyo vā eṣa āgneyatve yo'gniṃ ciṇute, agniṃ citvā tisṛṣvanyamāvitaṃ brāhmaṇāya dattvā''tmānameva namaskaroti, atho tābhya evātmānaṃ niṣkrīyaṇīte' iti śrutaṃ tisṛṣvanya- dānamapi pūrvvanyāyena ṛtvijaṃ iti prāpte, sthaṇḍilasyaiva rudratvāccadīyaraśyābhirabhimitaḥ āśrayaṇametaddāname, tāmya ātmano niṣkayavādasya kriyācce evopapadyate |
na ca saṃnipātino'ṅgasyājñāntaṃ vipratiṣiddhaṃ, rathaṃtarāṅgasya vara- dānasya darśanāt |
asita (ca) agnihotrasyāgne prāyaścittaṃ 'agnaye jyotiṣmate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet, yasyāgni- dagdho'hute'gnihotra udāyate' iti |
tatraipo'rthaḥ sāṃśayikaḥ, yadā dhāryo'gniḥ anugacchati tadā kimidaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kartavyaṃ neti |
etāva- diha nimittaṃ, agniḥ agnihotrārthe udghṛtaḥ |
yadi sarvakarmasamudāyārthaṃ tat kevalasyārthe na bhavatītyucyate |
yastu ekaikasmai ityevaṃ sarvāthai, tat sarve'yo'pi prayuktaṃ agnihotrāya prayuktaṃ bhavati |
na cedaṃ sarvakarmasamudāyārthaṃ, samudāyasya acco- ditatvāt, sādhanāni prati ākāṅkṣā'bhāvaḥ |
tasmāt sarvārthamapi sat agni- hotrārthe bhavati |
yathā paryukṣaṇaṃ parisamūhanaṃ tṛṇāpacayaḥ ityevamā- dayaḥ padārthāḥ dhārya'gnau ahaṇyahani kriyante, evaṃ prāyaścittamapi kriyate evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
śriyaḥ anugamane idaṃ prāyaścittaṃ na kartavyam |
nahi tadā agnihotrārthamuddharaṇaṃ, yasmin kāle bhavatyasau gataśrīḥ |
na ca dhāraṇe agnihotrārthe anugamane prāyaścittaṃ vihitam |
dup-- pūrvaṃ pākṣikasyopakāralakṣaṇaṃ tādarthya iti kṛtvā pratyekasamudāyasyabandhanābhiprāyaḥ devadattayajñadattabhojana- vat |
tattu samudāyārthaṃ parṇodajanamiva, tat anyatarāyeti na śakyate vadi- tum |
siddhāntastu śrutyādilakṣaṇaṃ tādarthyaṃ, gataśrīśca noddharaṇaṃ prayojayati |
tasmāt nānyārthe uddhṛte, agnihotrārthe prāyaścitta- miti |
yadi punaḥ sāyamihotrārthe uddhṛte gataśrīyo dhāraṇaṃ bhavati, prātaragnihotrakāle coddhānaṃ, tataḥ kiṃ prāya- ścittaṃ bhavati na vā ? bhavatīti brūmaḥ |
bhāṣya-- atha yaduktaṃ parisamūhanaṃ paryukṣaṇaṃ ityevamādayaḥ padārthāḥ dhārya'gni kriyante, evaṃ prāyaścittamapi, atro- cyate |
yuktaṃ tat parisūhanādīni kriyante, coditāni hi tāni saṃskārātvena, śakyāni ca, akṛtaprayojanāni ca |
dhāryasya cāsti tādarthyaṃ sarvārthe dhāryate dhasau ||
' 'na hi gata- śrītvena puruṣasya agnuddharaṇaṃ śrutaṃ, yena uddharaṇaṃ ud- dhṛto vā'gniḥ sarvārthaḥ syāt, kiṃtu dhāraṇamātram |
tena yadā yatkiṃcitkarmaviśeṣamadhikṛtya agnimuddharati, tadā tasya dhāraṇamātraṃ gataśrītvena karoti |
yasmin karmaṇi upasaṃprāpte agniruddhṛtaḥ, tadarthamevoddharaṇaṃ, uddhṛtaścāgniḥ tadartha eva |
nimittavaśādadhāryamāṇaḥ prasaṅgāt agnihotra- syopakaroti, iti na taduddhrāne prāyaścittam |
soma-- pūrvvaṃ tādarthyābhāvāt darśārṇāgnuddhrāne prāyaścittābhāve'pi iha tādarthyasya sattvāt yuktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ityuthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
gatā prāptā śrīryena sa gataśrīḥ, tasyāhavanīyo dhāryaḥ |
'trayo vai gataśriyaḥ śuśruvān grāmaṇī rājanyaḥ' itiśrutau gataśrīḥ prasiddhaḥ |
satyaṃ agnihotrā- rthatvamanneḥ, tathāpi na tanmātreṇa uddhānasya nimittatvaṃ, kiṃtu 'yasyāgniruddhṛtaḥ' iti śruteḥ |
vyākhyātampi ('trayo ha vai gataśrībhyaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ śuśruvān, āmanīḥ, rājanyaḥ' iti śrūyate |
'aurvo gautamo bhāradvājaḥ' iti kalpasūtrakāraḥ iti vi. 9|4|8 ) tantraratne prāptaśrīlaṃ iti vyākhyātam |
tadiha yadā tannimittake āhavanīyādhāre kṛte agnihotrakāle sa udgāyet, tadā tadupasthatyai jyotiṣmatītiḥ kartavyā na veti cintāyāṃ, nimittasaṃskārayoḥ sattvāt kartavyā |
na ca dhāraṇe kṛte tayoyogopayogyuddharaṇābhāvāt akaraṇaṃ, anu- ddhṛtasya dhāraṇāyogena tataḥ pūrve kariṣyamāṇasyaibhi- hotrayogārthaṃ tantreṇa samantrakoddharaṇākṣepāt |
idaṃ dhāraṇaṃ na gataśrītve nimitte puruṣasaṃskārārthe phalakalpanāpatteḥ, dhāryaḥ iti yadyatyena āhavanīyasya karmatvāvagataiśca |
ṣaṣṭhīśrutisu nimittaphalakatvā kartṛtvāvacanādepi 'vaidyasya' ('satadaśa vaiśyasya' sāmidhenyaḥ 3|6|3 bhāṣya. ) itivat nānupapannā |
āhavanīyasya ca dhāraṇavyatirekeṇa jātānatvāt svarūpe ānarthakya- prasaktau abhyabhicaritakratusaṃsthopasthitikaraṇamāsatvaka- lapūrvasādhanībhūtāhavanīyasaṃskārakavāsiddhiḥ |
evaṃ ca dhāraṇasya puruṣārthatvoktiḥ tantraratnīyatā nirastā |
ata eva kariṣyamāṇakarmaṇāṃ yāvajjīvaṃ sattvāt gataśrītvottaraṃ punardhāraṇe'pi yāvajjīvaṃ dhāraṇasiddhiḥ |
puruṣārthatvapakṣe tu yāvajjīvatāyāṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ mṛgyaṃ syāt |
sarvakarmā- rthenāpi ca dhāraṇena ākṣipta uddharaṇaṃ kāsyabhojinyāyena ( 1|2|14|134 ) agnihotropakārakatvā samanvakmevā- 'kṣipyate |
na ca yatkiñcitkarmārthamuddhṛtasyāntareva gataśrītve nimitte dhāraṇopapatteḥ, na svatantroddharaṇākṣepakatvaṃ iti vācyam |
madhyāhādau yadā kasyāpi karmaṇo na karaṇaṃ, tadaiva gataśrītvarūpanimittaprāptau dhāraṇasyāvaśyakatvena tadanurodhena uddharaṇākṣepāvaśyakatvāt |

iti prāpte, yadā karma- madhye gataśrītvaṃ tadā uddharaṇākṣepakatvāt, anyathā cākṣe- pakatve vairūpyāpatteḥ, lāghavena paraprayukteddharaṇopayogijinā dhāraṇavidhinā yatkiñcitkarmārthamuddhṛtasya gataśrītve nimitte dhāraṇavidhānam |
ata eva tadanurodhena nimitta- syāpi ahiṃtāmityādineva jīvanasya saṃkoco na viru- dhyate |
ato dhāraṇavidhinā agnihotravidhinā vā paramayuktāgnilena uddharaṇākṣepāt kariṣyamāṇāni- hotrāṅgābhūtāgnināśe uddhṛtatvāvacchinnapratiyogitāka- nāśarūpanimittābhāvāt naimittikākaraṇam |

na ca anyakarmārthaṃ praṇītasya dhāraṇe nimittābhāve'pi agni- hotrārthameva uddhṛtasya dhāraṇe nimittasattvāt, kathaṃ prayogāntare tantrādau prāpyaśrittābhāvaḥ ? kapālanāśādivat yadyayogavaktyupayoginī yā uddharaṇākhyatiḥ, tatsaṃskṛtatvāt- cchinnanāśasyaiva tadyayogavaktyupayogamisaṃpādakatā jyotiṣmatītirnimittatvāt, itarāthā atiprasaṅgāpatteḥ |
api tu sāmānya- vihitaṃ manasthīhomāceva iti siddham |

tatra agni- hotrakāle etaduddharāne'pi kartavyeṣṭiḥ iti prāpte, anyā- rthamuddhṛtasya gataśrītvena nimittena dhāryamāṇaḥ prasaṅgāt agnihotrasyopakaroti ityato'gnihotrārthoddhṛtasya uddhānā- bhāvāt neṣṭiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
agnicayane purastādanyāḥ pratīcīḥ, paścādanyāḥ prācīḥ iti vidhī apavarganiyāmārthe ||

paścācciriti padasya prayuktā- dhikaraṇe nirṇītārthatvāt saṃnidhānācca, iti prāpte, brahmavādinākāmapavarganiyāmārthatvena vidhī 'tasmātprācī- nāni pratīcīnāni ca nakṣatrāṇyāvartante' iti nakṣatra- maṇḍalenekāvinyāsastutidarśanāt |
tatra cintyate, kiṃ pṛṣṭhadharmāḥ kartavya uta neti |
sāmānyadharmāḥ hikārādayaḥ, viśeṣadharmāḥ 'rathaṃtare prastunya- māne pṛthivīṃ manasā dhyāyet, bṛhati samudraṃ' ityevamā- dayaḥ |
etat tāvatḥ parīkṣyaṃ kimayaṃ pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ karmaṇo vācakaḥ, uta dravyasya iti |
nanu siddhametat karmanāmadheyaṃ pṛṣṭhaśabda iti 'yasmin guṇopa- deśaḥ pradhānato'bhisaṃbandhaḥ' ( 1|4|12|13 ) ityatra |
tāsveva codanāsu etaduktaṃ 'satadaśati pṛṣṭhāni' 'vairūpaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ', 'vairājaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ' iti |
yathābhūtaḥ sa upadeśaḥ, yatrāyaṃ pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ karmanāma abhidhātaḥ, tathābhūto'yamapi |
tasmāt ihāpi tad- canaḥ evāvagatanyo viśeṣabhāvāt |
yadi atra anyathā kalpyeta, ekaḥ śabdaḥ anekārthaḥ syāt |
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? dvandve uccarite saṃśayaḥ syāt, na arthapratyayaḥ |
yadā karmanāma, tadā yadi tāvat tāni karmāṇi iha upadiśyante, tatra upattirevāmanarthikā |
atha mā bhūta eṣa doṣaḥ iti etadupasthānaṃ tatra vijñāyate, tata idaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |
'abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ' ityevādīnāṃ ṛcāṃ vācakaḥ |
kathaṃ punarayaṃ upasthānavacanaḥ abhidhānārthaḥ śakyo vijñātum ? ucyate |
yadi pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ karmasu kalpyate, ātma- nepadaṃ bādhyate |
pṛṣṭhaśabdo hi lakṣaṇāyā pṛṣṭhasādhanaṃ mantraṃ bruvan arthavān |
ataḥ pṛṣṭhasā- dhanārthatā hi śrutyā upatiṣṭhateḥ |
abhidhānaṃ nirvartayituṃ agnisamīpe tiṣṭhet iti tiṣṭhatirāha, ātmanepadāt |
āha, evamapi abhidhānasya mantraḥ karaṇaṃ, nopatiṣṭhateḥ, tatra asaṃvanya eva upasthānasya mantreṇa |
abhidhānaṃ abhinivartayan mantraḥ upasthānasya karaṇaṃ bhavati, yato'sya prayojanaṃ nirvartayati |
tatra mantrakaraṇaṃ nābhimadhānantareṇa saṃbhavati ityabhidhātā dhātuḥ anumīyate parastasmāt |
yasyopasthānaṃ kriyate, tasya samīpe eva sthitvā tat kriyate, nānyathā |
tasmāt upagrahāt pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ ātmīyān mantrān lakṣayati |
pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ śrutivatte gṛhyamāṇe atyantāya ātmanepadasya syāt |
āha, upasthānavacanaḥ kathaṃ abhidhāne vartate ? dhātusambandhīyorarthaḥ, so'bhidhānasāmarthya- labhyatvāt na virudhyate |
yathā dīkṣaṇī- yādayaḥ puruṣasaṃskārāḥ phalapratigrahayogyaṃ puruṣaṃ kurvantaḥ yāgakārye vartamānāḥ tadarthāḥ; evamihāpi upatiṣṭhateḥ abhidhānaṃ kāryam |
evaṃ ca tadvyāpāraṃ kurvantaḥ tadarthatāṃ pratipadyante |
' tadarthamarthaḥ (pṛṣṭhe'tiṣṭhate ityasya ) pṛṣṭhasādhane rathatarādibhiḥ samīpe sthitvā agniṃ abhidadhyāditi |
soma-- arthavādagatapūpaśabdesya anatideśakatave'pi vidhyudeśagatapṛṣṭhaśabdasya atideśakalatvamastu ityucyanāt saṃgatiḥ |
atra bhāṣyādau 'upānmantrakaraṇe' iti mantrakara- ṇārthe vartamānāt upapūrvāt tiṣṭhateḥ ātmanepadavidhānāt upatiṣṭhate ityāmanepadaṃ pṛṣṭhaśabdakarmavidhiḥ iti pūrva- pakṣe nopapadyate |
tathā ca tatra 'vyatyayo bahulaṃ' (pā0 3|1|85 ) iti vyatyayaḥ aṅgīkāryaḥ; sa cānyāyyaḥ |
'bṛhadrathaṃtarābhyāṃ pakṣau, yajñāyajñiyena pucchaṃ' ityādau asyeva 'upatiṣṭhate' itipadasya anupajanīyatvena akarmakatvābhāvāt |
iti ātmanepadasya sarvathā anupapatyā tallādeva pṛṣṭha- sādhanamantrakaraṇakābhidhānavidhiḥ iti siddhāntam |
tadanupapannam, pūrvapakṣe'pi pṛṣṭhaśabdakarmāṇi śrutirūpā- ṇyeva aṅgīkartavyāni, anyeṣāṃ pṛṣṭhasādyasādhantvāt |

tathā ca śrutīnāṃ guṇiniṣṭhaguṇābhidhānarūpatayā tāsāṃ mantrakaraṇatvaniyamena tadarthasamīpasthitipadātkasya upatiṣṭhateḥ siddhānte iva mantrakaraṇārthe vṛttisaṃbhavena ātma- nepadasyānupapatyābhāvāt |

iti matvā granthakāreṇa (śāstradīpikākāreṇa) ātmanepadaṃ aspaṣṭavaiva pūrvapakṣe jaghanyagauṇīprasaṅgaḥ itya- bhiprāyeṇa siddhāntamuktvā upatiṣṭhateḥ abhidhānalakṣaṇāṃ pariharata upatiṣṭhatinā abhidhānamanumīyate iti pratipāda- yituṃ ātmanepadamupayojiṃta, na tu ātmanepadātpattiḥ siddhāntayuktitayā iti dhyeyam |
ādyasūtrārthastu pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ karmaṇi syāt stotramarmāvācakaḥ; pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ syāt, tathābhūtasya 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityādī stotra- vācakasyāpi upadeśāt iti |

tatra pṛṣṭhaśabdena kiṃ vidhīyate iti cintāṃyāṃ, pṛṣṭhaśabdasya stotraviśeṣavacanatvāt tasya ca bahutvābhāve cayanasyā- tayā vidhānānupapatteḥ pratyayābhihitabhāvanātrāpyeva pṛṣṭha- dharmakāṇi dhātupāttasamīpāvasthānetarakaryatāni vidhī- yante |
dhātupā- ttamapi ca samīpāvasthānaṃ akṣalatakāryatvāt karmāntarā- jñameva |
athavā pāṭhādhikaraṇanyāyena (9|1|7 ) bahu- vacanānurodhena pṛṣṭhapratipādake gauṇyaṅgīkārasya ayuktatvāt bahuvacanena ekatvādi lakṣayitvā cayanagatayā jyoti- ṣṭomapṛṣṭhavidherevāyam |
vastutastu pṛṣṭhavahutvasyāpi jyoti- ṣṭome sādhitatvāt sarvoṇyeva pṛṣṭhastotrāṇi cayana- nā''gatāyā vidhīyante |
na tu pṛṣṭhamantrāṇāṃ rathatarādi- sāgnāṃ vā vidhānaṃ, upakramasthapṛṣṭhapade lakṣaṇaprasaṅgāt |
evaṃ ca jaghanyaṃ ātmanepadameva bāhulakatā (pā0 3| 1|85 ) sādhutvāthe vyākhyeyam |

iti prāpte, pṛṣṭha- śabdasya śarīravācave'pi satvena tatkaraṇakasamīpāvasthi- terapi vidhisaṃbhavena stotravidhāveva niyāmakabhāvena saṃdigdhatvāt niḥsaṃdigdhaātmanepadānurodhena pṛṣṭhapadameva anyathā netumucitatvāt |

tathāhi, 'upānmantrakaraṇe' (pā0 1|3|16 ) iti smṛtyā ātmanepadalāt samīpā- vasthāne mantrakaraṇatvāgateḥ sākṣātsaṃbhavena abhi- dhānātirikte vyāpāre mantrasya karaṇāsaṃbhave'pi samī- pāvasthānaprayojanībhūtābhidhānadvārā samīpāvasthānaṃ prati karaṇatvāṅgīkārāt tadanurodhena pṛṣṭhaśabdasya mantraparatvāva-
ata eva samīpāvasthānajanyābhidhānajanakatvasaṃsargeṇa mantrāṇāṃ samīpāvasthānaṃ prati karaṇatvaṃ, na tu nābhivāna- lakṣaṇā'pi |
vastutastu aindrādhikaraṇakastaubhbhokanyāyena (3|2|2 ) lakṣaṇayā abhidhānameva prakṛtābhikarmakaṃ dhātunā vidhīyate |
tatraiva pṛṣṭhapadārthasya karaṇatvaṃ, samīpāvasthānaṃ paraṃ atra 'abhi tvā' ityādimantraliṅgādeva prāptaṃ anu- yate |
pṛṣṭhapadena tu ātmanepadānurodhena pṛṣṭhastotrāsanībhūtā mantrā lakṣyante |

vastutastu pāḍahikeyu rathatarādiṣu pṛṣṭheṣu sāmasu pṛṣṭhaśabdānvāyārthavādavaśene niruḍhalakṣaṇayāḥ citrādhikaraṇa- ( 1|4|3 ) kaustubhe vyavasthāpitatvāt tānyeva abhidhānaṃ prati karaṇatvena vidhīyante |
saṃbhavati ca stotre ihābhidhānaṃ prati sāmnaḥ karaṇatvaṃ ṛgakṣarābhi- vyaktidvārā |
ata eva tadādhārabhūtānāṃ yonikracāmapi abhidhānāttvaṃ, uttaratrokta 'ekaṃ sāma tatra kriyate stotrīyaṃ' iti stotre eva viniyogāt nābhivānāṅgala- prasaktiḥ |
ataśca yonyādhārarathatarādipāḍahikasāmavi- śiṣṭābhidhānamevātra sthaṇḍilasaṃskāratvena vidhīyate iti siddham |
sāmāṃśe upadeśo'pi ayaṃ anyāṅgasya pūrvā- vagamamātreṇa iha cintitaḥ |

nyāyavindu-- agno 'pṛṣṭhe'tiṣṭhate' ityatra abhi- samīpaṃ tiṣṭhan pṛṣṭhasahaiḥ karmabhiḥ kuryāt iti apūrvakarma- vidhānaṃ, iti prāpte, pṛṣṭhasādhanaiḥ rathatarādibhiḥ abhi- samīpe sthitvā tamidadhyāt iti abhidhānābhidhānaṃ 'upānmantrakaraṇe' iti smṛteḥ; iti siddhāntaḥ |
' agnicayane pradhānādau abhiyogaḥ pradhānānte ca agnivimokaḥ ||
agniyogaḥ somakāle tadarthatvāt saṃskṛta- karmaṇaḥ pareṇu sādhyasya tasmāt sarvaparvage vimokaḥ syāt |
bhāṣya-- agno śrūyate 'agni yunajmi śavasā ghṛteneti juhoti agnimevaitadyunakti' iti |
punaḥ 'imaṃ staṃ madhumantaṃ dhayāpāṃ ityanvivimokaṃ juhoti' iti |
tatra vicāryate kimaṅgapradhānārtho yogaḥ; sarvāpavarge vimokaḥ kartavyaḥ; uta pradhānādau yogaḥḥ pradhānāpavarge vimoka iti |
aṅgapradhānādau yogaḥ; sarvāpavarge ca vimokaḥ syāt |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ? aviśeṣeṇa śrūyate 'agni yunajmi śavasā ghṛteneti juhoti agnimevaitadyunakti' iti |
na ca śrūyate tasmai asmai vā karmaṇe iti |
api ca tasmin yukte agnī aṅgāni pradhānāni ca kriyante |
dup-- ( likhitapāṭhyaṃ tantraratne tulitaḥ ) ; sarvāpavarge vimokaḥ kartavyaḥ |
kutaḥ ? 'agnimeva tayunakti' ityanena tāvat viśeṣo na gamyate 'pradhānādau yogaḥ; nājñānī' iti |
agno ca ( yogāravyasaṃskārasaṃsthe ) pradhānaṃ aṅgāni ca kriyante |
ityehagahaviṣāṃ pradhānahaviṣāṃ ca veyāmāsādanaṃ, na pradhānahavibhirviśeṣyate |
yathā āhavanīye kriyamāṇaḥ ( saṃmārga ) nāṅgānāṃ vadau'gniṃriti |
evamihāpi agne- raviśeṣāt yogaḥ : sarvārthaḥ; prakaraṇasya aviśeṣakatvāt ityuktaṃ ( tathā ca sarvārtha yoge tadvimoko'pi sarvārthaḥ ) |
bhāṣya-- na vā sarvāpavarge vimokaḥ syāt |
pradhānayogena hi śrūyate 'pañca- bhiryunakti pāṅkato yajñaḥ, yāvāneva yajñastatamālabhate' iti |
pradhānārthaścet, tadapavargaṃ yogakāryamavasitaṃ bhavati, tasmāt tatra vimokaḥ |
aviśeṣavidhānaṃ yajñasaṃyogena viśeṣe- ṇa yujyamānaṃ vimokārthaṃ bhavati |
kutaḥ ? 'pañcabhi- ryunakti pāṅkato yajñaḥ' iti śrutatvāt yajñasaṃyogena |
tena ( tadekavākyatvāt ) saṃkhyāyā evāyamarthavādaḥ ( na yogasya ) |
tasyā evāyamarthavādaḥ (pākkto yajñaḥ iti), na tu agniyogasya |
(kena tarhi yāgavidhirata āha-) agniṃ yunajmi śavasā ghṛteneti juhoti iti karma ucyate |
(na guṇavidhva- vasyāṃ na votpadyasvare ) tatra yat prakaraṇena vākyena vā (prayojana-) saṃtrandho dīyate, tena nirākāṅkṣī bhavati |
iha tu vākyenaivāsya prayojanaṃ dīyate agni- yogaḥ (agnimeva tat yunakti iti) |
tasmiṃśca vākye yajñasaṃyogo nāsti (yena pradhānārthatā syāt) |
yadyapi tu yajñasaṃyogo bhavet (utpattivākye eva), tathāpi yajña- śabdo yāgamātravacanaśca aṅgayāgāni vadati pradhāna- yāgānapi |
avabhṛthe ca tadaṅga pradhānārthasya pratiṣedho'pa- thukathattvāt ||
atra abhi- niṣpanna yogajanyasya adṛṣṭasya svāntyakāryatvāya prasaktatve etadamināyatvaṃ arthavādavaśādavagamyate|

ataḥ svāntyakāryatve eva agnirvimokaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe 'pañca- mibhaktiḥ pādyato yajñaḥ' iti vākyaśeṣeṇa yathārthatvāva- gamāt 'dakṣiṇā somasya' itivat sarvārthatvena pradhāna- mātrārthatvāvagamāt pradhānānte eva vimoka iti siddhā- ntitam|
evaṃ ca saumikamapi varaṇaṃ 'yadvṛto vaṣaṭ kuryāt bhrātṛvyameva yajñasyāśīrgacchet' iti yajñasyogāt agni- yogatulyanyāyatayā kevalapradhānārthe bhavati|
tataśca somā- ṅgabhūte'vabhṛthe atideśaprāptaṃ hotṛvaraṇaṃ 'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' ityanena paryudasyate|
saumikasya varaṇasya aṅga- pradhānārthatve tu apadeśikena ātideśikasya bādhenaiva aprāptatvāt paryudāsānupapattiḥ|

'etadvā ṛṣīṇāmāmeyaṃ chando yadājñasenī:' iti vākya- śeṣeṇa vivaraṇāt, iti prāpte, dāśatayyā: 'agnimīḻe madhu- cchandā' ityādinā aitapaṃtyena ṛṣīṇāṃ saraṇārthatvenaiva vākyaśeṣeṇa vivaraṇāt evāneyā: |
kiṃca 'sūktenopa- dadhātyuksāvacchedāya' iti sūktasya karaṇatvena vidhā- nāt sūktaprasiddeśa dāśatayīto'nyatrābhāvācca yājñasenya: karaṇāni |
🜂 agnicayane ruksapratimocanādi; dīkṣita- saṃskārebhya: parastāt kartavyam ||
bhāṣyaṃ--agni dīkṣaṇīyāyā: parata: ruksapratimo- canādi ānnāyam |
tasminneva krame codakena dīkṣita- saṃskārā: prāptā: |
tatra saṃdeha:, kiṃ aniyama:, uta pūrvaṃ ruksapratimocanādi, uta dīkṣitasaṃskārā: iti |
athavā yathā pratyakṣapāṭhakramāt dīkṣaṇīyāyā: purata: ullāsaṃbharaṇādaya: evaṃ ruksaprati- mocanādīni iti |
kuta: ? dīkṣaṇīyāṃ prati ya: pāṭhakrama:, yathā ca codaka:, tathā ubhaye'pi parastāt dīkṣaṇīyāyā: kāryā: |
yasteṣāṃ parasparapekṣa: krama:, tatra na kaścit ullāsaṃbharasya pratyakṣa: pāṭhakrama: pūrvatvaṃ sādhayati |
asti tu saṃskārāṇāṃ prakṛtau pūrva: pāṭha:, vikṛtau ruksapratimocanasya uttara: |
tena yathokta eva krama: syāt, ante vaikṛtaṃ iti |
atha kimarthaṃ saṃnipāta: āśaṅkyate, nanu ayaṃ saṃnipāta eva vyakta: |
śāstrāṇi cet pramāṇaṃ syu: prāptāste paramāṃ gatim |
dup-- dīkṣaṇīyānantaraṃ dīkṣitasaṃskārā: kṛtā:, codakena tathaiva prāpnuvanti |
nanu ruksaprati- mocanādau dīkṣaṇīyāyā: pare śrūyante, teṣāṃ codakaprāptānu- ṣṭhānanvayitānāmapi paratvaṃ naiva bādhyate |
nityasaṃtāyavidheḥ anāmnātāt anāśvāsaḥ, tadā astu tat kāmyameva |
taittirīyaśākhāsthaṃ 'vasordhārāṃ juhoti' iti sāmānyavacanaṃ tu sāmānyato dvādaśānāṃ vidhānārtham |
tatrayojanaṃ ca avāntarakaraṇasiddhidvārā dvādaśānāmapi homānāṃ sāṃtatyaśrutyalasiddhiḥ |

tadiha sāṃtatyaśabdasya sāhityāvācitvāt mantrakarmaṇoḥ sāhityapratīteḥ nātra mantrāntane karmādisaṃnipātaḥ, iti prāpte, avicchede'pi saṃtataśabdasya loke prayogāt karmaṇāmeva avicchede'pi sāhityavidhānāpatteḥ na nyāyāvagatamantrāntottarakāla- tāvādhakatvena anupasthitamantrasāhityavidhāyakatvam |
na caivaṃ nityaprayoge tatsāhityasya prayogavidhivyatiprayoga- prāśubhāvatvenaiva prāpteḥ tadvidhivaiyarthyamiti vācyam |
nyāyabinduḥ -- 'saṃtatāṃ vasordhārāṃ juhoti' ityatra sāhityarūpasaṃtatatvasya mantrakarmasaṃbandhitvāt tayoryogapathena prayogaḥ, iti prāpte, saṃtatatvasya aviccheda rūpatvāt na sāhityapekṣā |
tadapekṣāyāmāpi 'dvādaśaitāni juhoti' iti saṃkhyā karmamedāt teṣāmeva avicchedaḥ saṃtata- śabdārthaḥ |
🜸 agnicayane vṛṣabhamupadadhāti iti 'tvāmagne vṛṣabhaṃ' iti mantropadheyaikāparo vṛṣabhaśabdaḥ |

'vṛṣabhamupadadhāti' iti śruto vṛṣabhaśabdaḥ paśupa- kurmādivat tasyāpyupadheyatvasaṃbhavāt, iti prāpte, cityāṃ- cityāṃ tadupadhānaśravaṇeṇa pañcasu citiṣu tadupadhāne jānu- dantvavirodhārta 'tvāmagne vṛṣabhaṃ' iti mantropadheyaikā- paro'yaṃ vṛṣabhaśabdaḥ |

'divyaṃ suparṇa' iti mantrasya vidhāyakatvāt 'vayasāṃ vai' iti vākye leṭaḥ śravaṇāttasya 'śyenacitiṃ cinvīta svargakāmaḥ' iti vidhineopasaṃhārasaṃbhavāt svargakāmopa- bandhāt dyenākṛtirnityakāmyā aindravāyavāpratāvat, iti prāpte, śyenakaḍakādyākṛtiviśeṣāṇāṃ sāmānyato'nuvāda- mātreṇāpyupapattau leṭtvakalpane mānābhāvāt kevalakāmyaiva śyenacitiḥ |
🜸 agnicayane śrutasya svaladavṛkṣaprāmāhyatasya kāmyāgneḥ ādhānādisaṃskārāṇāṃ lopaḥ |
bhāṣya -- tasmin vaihārikeḍamau ādhānikāḥ saṃskārāḥ kartavyāḥ; śiṣṭatvāt |
yadi na kriyeran, tat karma tenāṅgena hīnaṃ aphalaṃ syāt |
tasya saṃskṛtasyāme sthāne ayama- saṃskṛtaḥ śrutaḥ |
sa cennivṛttaḥ, kimarthaṃ saṃskārāḥ kariṣyante ? saṃskṛtaḥ syāt ityevamarthaṃ te kriyeran |
śa -- saṃskārāstatra (ādyaṣṭamau) ādhānādikāḥ kartavyāḥ hobhārthatvāt saṃskārāṇāṃ, asya cāgehomasādhana- tvāt |
satyaṃ homasādhano'yamagniḥ, tathāpi asaṃskṛta evāyaṃ saṃskṛtatvāpanna iti nātra saṃskārāḥ kartavyāḥ |
na hi vṛkṣādāhṛtasya araṇimantrādijanyaḥ saṃskāraḥ śakyate ādhātum |
soma -- kāmyāgneḥ āhavanīyamapyasti, gataśrī- dhāraṇāyadaḥ saṃskārāstatrāpi kartavyāḥ iti pūrvapakṣeāt saṃgatiḥ |

yadyapi ādhānamāhavanīyārthe, tathāpi 'āhava- nīyaṃ juhoti' ityāhavanīyaśabdatvāt ādhānapavamāna- janyādṛṣṭasaṃskārāṇāṃ home viniyogāt, saṃskārāṇāṃ ca sākṣāt homādhāratvānupapattyā homādhārabhūtāgnertvāva- gamāt kāmyasyāpi homādhāratvāt tatrāpi saṃskārāḥ kartavyāḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
saṃskārā vidhīyeran, tadā kāmyasādhāraṇā bhaveyuḥ; na tvetadasti, kintu 'āhavanīyaṃ juhoti' iti vākyameva saṃskāraṃ vidadhat saṃskṛtasyāmepi homārdhatvamāpādayati |
tataśca saṃskṛtāgnicayane kāmyo'gnirviniviśamānaḥ kathaṃ saṃskārān labheta |
prathamasūtrārthastu, tasmin kāmye'mau saṃskārāṇāṃ kriyā syāt, teṣāṃ sarvahomārdhatayā śiṣṭatvāt vihitatvāt iti |
bhāṣya -- ata eva kāmye'mau nādhānādayaḥ saṃskārāḥ; asaṃskṛtasyaiva tasya āṣṭrādipadavācyatvāt tasmin maya- nādyasaṃbhavāt, ādhānasya kṛtyatvābhāvena tasmin prāpya- bhāvācca |
nyāyabinduḥ -- tatra ādhānādisaṃskārāḥ kāryāḥ; homārdhatve'pi, iti prāpte, homasādhanatve'pi vṛkṣādāha- tasya mantranādisaṃskārākṣateḥ nātra saṃskārāḥ; iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣya -- asyāgniḥ, 'ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute' iti |
'ākṛti- mantri prayujaṃ svāhā, mano medhāmagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā, cittaṃ vijñātamagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā, vāco vibhūtimagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā' iti prākṛtyaḥ |
tathā vaikṛtyaḥ, 'ākṛtyai prayuje'gnaye svāhā, medhāyai manase'gnaye svāhā, dīkṣāyai tapase'gnaye svāhā, sarasvatyai pūṣṇe'gnaye svāhā, āpo devī- bṛhatīrviśverdhuvo dyāvāpṛthivī urvanatarikṣam |
viśve rāya iyudhyasi yumnaṃ vṛṇīta puyase svāhā' mī. ko. 7
kiṃ vaikṛtīnāṃ prayogaḥ, prākṛtīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ, athavā samuccayaḥ prākṛtīnāṃ vaikṛtīnāṃ ceti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ṣaḍbhirdīkṣayatīti tāsāṃ prākṛtīnāmāhutīnāṃ mantravi- kāraḥ syāt |
tasmāt prākṛtānāṃ bādhaḥ na samuccaya iti |
bhāṣya -- tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati prākṛtānāṃ bādha iti |
yatra hi prākṛtavaikṛtayoryugapatsaṃbhava saṃbhavaḥ, tatra vaikṛtena prākṛtaṃ bādhyate |
yatra punarāvṛttiḥ śrutā kartavyaiva, tatra naiṣa doṣo bhavati, āvṛttiḥ prāpnotīti |
iha cāssSSśrutiḥ śrūyate pradhā- nasya homasya, 'dvādaśa juhoti' iti |
atha yaduktaṃ, saṃbhave sati na bādhitveti |
katham ? vaikṛtāḥ ṣaḍ mantrā agnau prākṛteṣu homeṣu pratya- kṣeṇa śravaṇena vidhīyante |
prākṛtā api mantrārthatvena prāptāḥ, vaikṛtā api śravaṇena |
sarvāṅga- grāhī ca prayogavacanaḥ; ubhayān saṃgṛhṇāti |
samuccayā- saṃbhave ca bādhavikalpau, na saṃbhavati samuccaye |
na ca homanirvṛttau niṣkṛṣṭā vaikṛtāḥ śrūyante |
homaprayogavacanastu pradānā- rthān svāhākārāntān sannihitān gṛhṇāti|
tasmāt vini- gamanāyāṃ heturasti, imān gṛhṇāti ityaneti|
na ca pradhānānuṣṭhire hi doṣo bhavatītyuktameva|
sakṛtsaṃpādite tairdikṣite, kṛte'rthe, punarabhyāso na nyāyyaḥ|
na ca vaikṛtānāṃ kevalanāmabhyastamānāṃ pūrvāparatopapatte, naimi- ttikatvāt|
bhāṣyam--itaśca padayāmo na nivṛttiḥ, samuccaya iti|
yathumayeṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ samuccayastathā''gnidatvātsvikāritvānna bhava- tyeva nirdeśaḥ|
vyapadeśo bhavati ‘adhvarasya pūrvama- thāgneḥ; upāgni hotatkarma yadagnirma’ iti|
pūrvamadhvarasya, athāgneriti vyapadeśaḥ samuccaye'vakalpate, nāsati viśeṣe|
‘iti prāpte, brūmaḥ, ‘na pratyakṣavacanena homārtha vaikṛtāḥ śrutāḥ|
soma--yadyapi agnijyotiyomeyāgaḥ na prakṛti- vikārabhāvaḥ, tathāpi āgnikadīkṣaṇīyeṣṭeḥ saumikadīkṣaṇī- yeṣṭivikāratvaṃ, dīkṣāhatasya ubhayadīkṣaṇīyeṣṭereva aṅgaṃ ityadhikaraṇaprabhṛtimupapādayanti|

( vaikṛtānā- meva pratyakṣavacanavihitānāṃ codakena prāptaprākṛta- mantrādhena homāṅgatvāt taireva abhyastaiḥ dvādaśāpi hotavyāḥ iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣānā tatrāha-) bhavedevaṃ yadi pratyakṣavacanena āhattya prākṛtamantrakāryaṃ mantrāntaravidhānaṃ syāt, na tvetadasti, vacanena dīkṣārtha- tasyaiva bodhanāt|
na ca svāhāntamantrāṇāṃ sākṣāt dīkṣārthatvānupapattyā ‘dīkṣayati’ ityasya prākṛtamantrakārya- lakṣyakatvamuktaṃ iti vācyam|
evaṃ ca āhattyavacanābhāve ārthī- kameva āhutyarthatvaṃ vācyaṃ, tacca āhutiṣu mantrānvaya- mātreṇopapannaṃ iti mantrābhyāse pramāṇabhāvāt āhutya- bhyāsatvena samuccaya eva nyāyyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ|
prathamasūtrārthastu, ‘ṣaḍbhirdīkṣayati’ iti tāsāṃ prākṛtī- nāmāhutīnāṃ mantravikāraḥ syāt śrutyā mantrāntaravidhānāt iti|
samuccitaṃ vā, bādhaḥ syāt kāryaikyāt tacca vākyataḥ!!, agnau homājñātkallairitidīkṣena tulyatā|
vinā''ssvṛtti- dvādaśasiddhaye syāt samuccayaḥ!!’ bhāṭ--some ‘ājyasyālyāḥ suveṇopaghātaṃ dīkṣā- hutīrjuhoti’ iti śrutam|
mantrapaṭhakāmnānāt uttaranyāyena ( 1|1|1|9|147-52 ) karmapaṭhakāvagataḥ na kapi- ñjalādhikaraṇanyāyaḥ ( 1|1|1|8-46 ) |
cayana- prakaraṇe ca mantraṣaṭkāntaraṃ paṭhitvā ‘ṣaḍbhirdīkṣayati’ ityanena teṣāṃ dīkṣārthatvaṃ samāmnātam|
teṣāṃ sākṣāt dīkṣārthatvayogāt tadaṅgabhūtahomadvāreṇa tat ityavivādam|
tadanantaraṃ ca ‘dvādaśa juhoti’ ityanena pūrvopasthitadīkṣāhutyanuvādena dvādaśatvavidhānāt sāgnike jyotiṣṭomaprayoge prayājaikādaśavat tadabhyāsaḥ|

tatra kiṃ dvādaśapi abhyāseṣu agniprakaraṇamāptā viśeṣa- vihitā eva mantrā dvirāvṛttyā sāmānyavihitamantraṣṭaka- vācena syuḥ, uta anāvṛttā eva samuccayena iti cintyāṃ, viśeṣeṇa sāmānyabādhe'vagate pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛtti- nyāyena mantrāvṛttisvīkāre'pi na kaścidoṣaḥ; iti prāpte, dīkṣārthatvamātraṃ teṣāṃ śrutaṃ, na tu homārthatvam|
tasya ca anāvṛttyā avagame- pyupapattau bādhādyanuṣṭheyaḥ svīkāre pramāṇābhāvāt sāmānyavi- hitamantraṣaṭkena samuccaya eva|

yadi hi dīkṣāhatyanuvāde naite mantrā vihitāḥ syuḥ; tadā ‘apasavyena caranti’ - ityatra prākṛtasarvahomeṣu agniprābhavat syādapi sāmānyavi- hitamantrabādhaḥ, na tvetadasti, dīkṣārthatvasyaiva śrutatvāt|
nyāyabindu--cayane prakṛtito dīkṣāhatuyaḥ paṭa- tanmantrāśca ‘ākṛtyai prayuje'maye svāhā’ ityādayaḥ prāptāḥ|
atra ca ‘ākṛtimi’ ityādiḥ ṣaṇmantrā dīkṣāyāṃ viniyuktāḥ ‘ṣaḍbhirdīkṣayati’ iti|
tena tairaivābhyastaiḥ dvāda- śāpi hotavyāḥ; iti prāpte, sakṛtprayogadeva homadvāreṇa dīkṣārthatvopapattau nāmyāsaḥ prākṛtabādho vā iti siddhāntaḥ|
bhāṣyam--saṃkhyā ye vidhīyante mantrāḥ, yathā agnau ‘caturbhirādatte, dvābhyāṃ khanati, ṣaḍbhirāharati’ iti, teṣu samuccayaḥ syāt|
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? saṃkhyā śabdeno- cyate, sā aṅgīkartavyā|
na ca samuccayādṛte sā śakyā aṅgīkartum|
āha, samuccaya'pi yaḥ karmaṇā saṃnipātitaḥ, tena tat karma kṛtaṃ bhavati, ye vyavahitāḥ na taiḥ, asaṃ- nipātāt|
tathā sati na saṃkhyā karmaṇi aṅgīkṛtā bhavati|
evamapi anantareṇa rūpaṃ kriyate, itare japavatat aharhyā bhavanti|
bhavati hi karaṇārthasya mantrasya asakṛt prayogaḥ, yathā ‘kuru kuru karavāṇi’ iti|
tatra yathā abhidhānā- rthasya mantrasya āmnānasāmarthyāt abhihitamabhyadadhakaraṃ bhavati, evaṃ ‘caturbhirādatte’ iti vacanāt caturbhihitaṃ kṛtamanudyakaraṃ bhavatīti|
śa--ye tu saṃkhyāyuktā mantrāḥ ‘caturbhirmā- datte’ ityevamādayaḥ; teṣāmapi pūrvavat vikalpaḥ, saṃkhyā- vaśāttu samuccayaḥ|
catuḥsaṃkhyā hi karmāṅgabhūtā nāsati samuccaye saṃdhyeta|
tatra pūrvaprayuktānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ saṃskāra- dvāreṇa karaṇatvaṃ, caramasya tu sākṣāt, iti saṃkhyāvacana- sāmarthyādavyavasīyate, tasmāt samuccayaḥ|

soma--samuccaye sati yenaiva mantreṇa saṃnipatitaṃ karma, tasyaiva karaṇatvaṃ nirvahet, anyeṣāṃ tu adṛṣṭārthataiva syāt, iti sarveṣāṃ karaṇatvāvagamādāpattyā catuḥsaṃkhyāyāḥ na vidhiḥ; kiṃtu ye ete catvāro mantrāḥ, tairādatte, iti pratyaya- śiṣṭasaṃkhyānuvādaḥ; evāyaṃ caturbhiriti śabdaḥ; iti ‘devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ gāyatreṇa chandasā’ ityādīnāṃ liṅgādeva abhyāsāne viniyogasiddheḥ|
sūtrārthastu-ye mantrāḥ saṃkhyā vihitāḥ, teṣu samuccayaḥ syāt, teṣāṃ saṃkhyāvidhitvena sarveṣāṃ karmadisaṃnipātā- bhāve'pi samuccayopapatteḥ iti|
‘prati mantraṃ pṛthak karaṇatvaṃ nāsti, catuḥsaṃkhyā samūhe karaṇatvapratīteḥ|

bhāṭṭa-ye tu saṃkhyāyuktavacanaviniyuktāḥ; yathā 'tāṃ caturbhirmādatte' ityādī, teṣāṃ samuccaya ityuktaṃ mantrādhikaraṇakaustubhe (1|2|4|31-45) ! na ca ekena smṛte punaḥprakāśanānupapattiḥ, smṛtasyāpi saṃskāra- dādarthyāt punaḥsmaraṇasaṃbhavāt |
ata eva vacanabalāt pūrvaiṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ saṃskāradvārā, anyasya tu sākṣādevā- nuṣṭhānopayogaḥ iti vaiṣamyakalpane'pi na doṣaḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ-'caturbhirmādatte' ityādī saṃkhyā- vaśāt samuccayaḥ; tena vinā karmāṅgattvaḥ saṃkhyāyā asaṃbhavāt |
tatra mantrasya saṃskāradvāreṇa karaṇatvaṃ, caramasya tu sākṣāt, iti vacanasāmarthyāt niścīyate iti siddhāntaḥ |

bhāṣyaṃ-asti agniḥ 'ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute' iti śrūyate 'yo vai saṃvatsaramagnimu- cyā'gniṃ cinute, yathā sāmidhmoṃ vicite tāgeva tadārtimācchet, vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ purastānnirvapet, saṃvatsaro vā agnirvaiśvānaraḥ, yathā saṃvatsaramāptvā kāla āgate hi jāyate evameva saṃvatsaramāptvā kāla āgate- 'gniṃ cinute, nārtimācchet' iti |
'eṣā vā agneḥ priyā tanūrvaiśvānaraḥ, priyāmevāsya tanumavarundhe' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ nityo vaiśvānaraḥ, atha naimittikaḥ iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? atrāpi nitya evāthavādaḥ 'ulkhalasya saṃvatsarabharaṇeṇa kṛto doṣaḥ; vaiśvānareṇa vihanyate' iti |
'śrīyate'ti havīṃṣi bhavanti, traya ime lokāḥ, eṣāṃ lokānāmarohāya' iti |
yadi yathā lokā nityāḥ, evamimāni havīṃṣi nityāni śrīṇa, evaṃ lokaiḥ saṃstvo ghaṭate |
atha yaduktaṃ, lokaiḥ samāna- saṃkhyatvaṃ nityatve upapadyate nānyatheti, tatra bhramaḥ |
tritvāt lokānāṃ haviṣāṃ ca sāmānyādarthavādo bhaviṣya- tīti |
soma-'yo vai saṃvatsara' iti yacchabdaḥ noddeśya- samarpakaḥ, yaḥ saṃvatsaramagvā agniṃ cinute, sa ātiṃ prāpnoti ityevamanvitasya yacchabdasya uddeśyasamarpakatvāyo- gāt iti pūrvapakṣasyāśayaḥ |

aprāptasyābharaṇasya anuvādā- yogāt ālasyādinā prāptasya amaraṇasya abhutvā itya- nenānuvāde sati, yo na vibhuyāt sa nirvapet ityarthaparyava- sānena yacchabdasya uddeśyasamarpakatvaṃ saṃbhavati iti siddhāntaḥ |

prathamasūtrārthastu, 'śrīyante'ti havīṃṣi bhavanti, traya ime lokāḥ, eṣāṃ lokānāṃ rohāya' iti nityairlokaiḥ amāvāsyādityavaiśvānarāṇāṃ haviṣāṃ samāna- saṃkhyalokatvā lokadeva haviṣāṃ nityatvāgata vaiśvā- naro nityaḥ syāt iti |
ci-'nityo naimittiko vā syād yāgo vaiśvā- naraścitau |

bhāṭṭa-agnau 'yo vai saṃvatsara..... nirvapet' iti śruto yāgāstu ālasyādinā saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ ulkha- dhāraṇāsaṃbhave prāyaścittarūpo naimittika eva, kartṛsamānā- dhikaraṇena yacchabdena kriyākartṛtvasya uddeśyatvāvagamāt nimittatvapratīteḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ-agnau śrutaṃ 'yo vai. nirva- pet' iti |
tatrāpi pūrvavat arthavādamātraṃ saṃvatsarabharaṇaṃ, iti nityatāṃ manyate |
yacchabdastu kartṛsamabhivyāhṛto nimittatāṃ saṃvatsarabharaṇasya pratipādayati, iti naimittika- taiva sthitā |

samāropaṇavidherupāyantarādupakattvena samarthasyaiva sāmi- cittvakṛtau adhikaraṇe ulvavat gārhapatyāderapi pratyakṣaṇayanaṃ syāt, iti prāpte, āyatanācchanamantareṇa bahinirgatasya laukikatvāvaśyaṃbhāvāt, samāropyasya tu vācanikatvāt, samākhyāviśeṣābhāvāt samāropyaiva nayanam |
bhāṣyaṃ-yatra tu dṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ na vartate, yathā agnicitāṃ 'audumbaramūlakhalaṃ sarvoṣadhasya pūrayitvā'va- hanti, atra tadupadadhāti' iti |
tatra taṇḍulanirvattyā nāsti prayojanaṃ, taṇḍulakāryasya puroḍāśādeḥ atodi- tattvāt |
tasmāt sakṛtkriyā kṛtaḥ śabdārthaḥ iti na syādabhyāsaḥ |
yeṣāṃ tu 'taṇḍulaphale eva musalasya udyamananipātakarmaṇi avahanti-śabdaḥ pravartate' itya- bhyupagamaḥ; teṣāṃ ā taṇḍulanirvṛttereva abhyāsaḥ prāpnoti |
yat kāraṇaṃ, vinā'pi taṇḍulaiḥ prayogo dṛśyate 'kaṇvamavahanti' 'kiṇvama- vahanti' iti |
śā-sarvoṣadhāvaghāte tu dṛṣṭasaṃbhavāt adṛṣṭārthe śabdārthamātraṃ kartavyam |
soma-atra 'dharmamātre tvadarśanāt śabdārthenā- pavargaḥ syāt' iti sūtraṃ sarvoṣadhāvahanteḥ adṛṣṭārthatva- siddhayarthe adhikaraṇatvena paryavyākhyāta, na tattvā, pūrvapakṣabhāvāt |
bhāṭṭa-yatra tu dṛṣṭasaṃbhavāt adṛṣṭārthaḥ avaghātaḥ, tatra anāṣṭittveva |
yathā cayane 'audumbaramūlakhalaṃ sarvoṣadhasya pūrayitvā'vahanti, atra tadupadadhāti' iti |

atra vitupasya sarvoṣadhasya agre viniyogābhāvāt, pratyuta avaghātasaṃskṛtasarvoṣadhapūraṇasya upadhānopayogyuddha- khalasaṃskārārthatvapratīteḥ, avaghātasya adṛṣṭavidhayā sarvoṣadhasaṃskāratve'pi vaituṣyaprayojanakatvābhāvena āhu- tyanāpattiḥ |
oṃ agnicayane sahasraṃ cinvīta iti sahasra- śabdaḥ na ṛtuparaḥ ||
'sahasraṃ cinvīta prathamaṃ cinvānaḥ' ityādi- vākyeṣu sahasrādiśabdāḥ sahasradakṣiṇaṛtuparāḥ |

'saha- kṣeṇa ījānaḥ' ityādī ṛtuṣu sahasrapadaprayogadarśanāt, iti prāpte, sahasrapadasya cinotidhātuviśeṣaṇatvāvagamāt sahasradakṣiṇakratau prāthamikaṃ cayanaṃ kuryāditi vyākhyāne lakṣaṇā''padyate : 'jānudaghnaṃ cinvīta' ityādiva ca sthaṇḍila- syaiva sahasratvam |
oṃ agnicayane 'sahasrasya pramā asi' iti mantraḥ sarvacityam ||

'sahasrasya pramā asi' iti mantrasya prakaraṇād dvitrī- sahasreṣṭakacitiṣvapi prāptamantratvaṃ mantraliṅgena sahasreṣṭake eva saṃkocyate, iti nānyatra tatrayogaḥ; iti prāpte, sahasrapadasya stutyarthatvena guṇavādenāpyanekaparatvā upapatterliṅgaprakaraṇa- yoravirodhāt sarvacityaṃ mantraḥ |
oṃ agnicayane sāṃvatsarike 'gāyatraṃ cinvīta brahmavarcasakāmaḥ' ityādi tattatphalakā- mukānāmeva, akāmānāṃ tu taditaracchandaskā eva ṛcaḥ ||

āgamamānānāmuccāmaviśeṣeṇa viniyoge prāpte, 'gāyatraṃ cinvīta brahmavarcasakāmasya' 'triṣṭuppucitaṃ vīryakāmasya' ityādīnāṃ kāmasaṃyogāt tattatkāmakānāmeva tattacchandaskā ṛcaḥ; akāmānāṃ taditaracchandaskā eveti vyavasthā |
agnicayane sāṃvatsarike dāśatīyabhī ānītānāmāmeyasūktānāṃ cayanātirikte upasthā- nādau nopayogaḥ ||

trisāhasrapekṣā kiṃcilaṃsyādhikye vā iṣṭakāme- kavidhāvekaśatavidhatvāntāmataparimāṇādhikye vā jyāya- stvasaṃbhavāt sūktānāṃ katipayānāmanyapusthāne viniyogaḥ kāryaḥ; iti prāpte, 'yajñīyam' iti vākye 'tena cinvīta' iti cayanayogatāt cayanātirikte na teṣāmupa- yogaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāmāme sati tāvatya iṣṭakā abhyabhidharva- nīyāḥ sāmīdhenīviddhau kāṣṭhābhivṛddhidarśanāt |
iṣṭa- kālpatve'pi mantrabhyastvanyāyena (saṃkarṣa. 2|1|4) ekāryatvāt vikalpasaṃbhavaḥ; iti prāpte, 'saktenasūktenopa-

prakṛtitaḥ prāsadakṣiṇāḥ etā dakṣiṇā bhinnā eva vidhīyante iti cenneva prākṛtīnāṃ bādhāḥ, iti prāpte, rādhanasya prītyutpādanatvāt guṇāvidhareyaṃ, kalpa- sūtramūlabhūtaśrutau adhikadakṣiṇāvidhānādubhayasamuccaye siddhe, yā'dhikā dakṣiṇā, sā yathā prītijanikā syāttādṛśī deyā ityarthaḥ |
saṃkarṣe. 1|1|18. oṃ agnidharmaḥ pratīṣṭakaṃ saṃghātāt paurṇamāsīvat |
agnicayane 'hiraṇyaśakalasahasreṇa agniṃ prokṣati' 'dadhnā madhumiśreṇāgniṃ prokṣati' iti |
tathā 'vetasa- śākhayā'vakāmibhra agniṃ vikarṣati' 'maṇḍūkenāgniṃ vika- rṣati' iti ca śrūyate |
ime prokṣaṇāvikarṣaṇe kiṃ pratīṣṭakaṃ iṣṭakāyāmiṣṭakāyā kartavye, uta iṣṭakāsamudāye sakṛdeva kartavye |
tathā agniśabdaḥ kiṃ iṣṭakāsamudāye pravartate, uta samudāyātirike dravyāntare iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
agnidharmaḥ cayanadharmaḥ prokṣaṇavikarṣaṇarūpaḥ pratīṣṭakaṃ iṣṭa- kāyāmiṣṭakāyām syāt |
tasmāt agnidharmānāṃ cayana- samudāyopalakṣitānāṃ agmyamāne viśeṣe sarvāṃsāmeva prokṣaṇaṃ vikarṣaṇaṃ ca kartavyam |
yathā 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvānmā- vāsyāṃ yajate' iti paurṇamāsīśabdena amāvāsyāśabdena ca āgneyādaya eva kriyante tadvat |
yathā vā 'caturhotrā paurṇamāsīmimaṃmiśret' iti agnidharmaṃ samudāyasya asaṃbha- vāt tadupalakṣitānāṃ āgneyādīnāṃ haviṣāṃ bhavati tadvat |
evaṃ ca agniśabdaḥ samudāye, pratīṣṭakaṃ ca prokṣaṇavikarṣaṇe iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
hiraṇyaśakalasahasrādinā prokṣaṇaṃ vetasaśākhādinā ca vikarṣaṇaṃ agneḥ iṣṭakānimitta- dravyāntarasya syāt, na tu pratīṣṭakam |
dravyaikatvāt iṣṭa- kābhiḥ avayavaiḥ ārabdhasya avayavinaḥ agneḥ dravyasya citipañcakarūpasya ekatvāt |
itarāsāṃ iṣṭakānāṃ ca tadarthatvāt avayavavidravyatvāt 'iṣṭakābhiragniṃ cinute' iti iṣṭakānāṃ agneśca sādhanasādhyabhāvavagamāt |
tasmāt sakṛdeva prokṣaṇaṃ vikarṣaṇaṃ ceti siddhāntaḥ |

codanānāṃ āgneyāmīṣo- mīyapaurṇamāsyājānāṃ yāśabdenāḥ, tāsāṃ samudāyaṃ paurṇamāsī- śabdena upalakṣaṇīkṛtya tadupalakṣitānāṃ haviṣāṃ anuṣṭhānaṃ agnidharmāṇaṃ vā yuktaṃ, ityataḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsīśabde tu tathātvaṃ samudāyavācakatvena samudāyatvaṃ syāt |
amau tu dravyāntaramasti, iti na tathātvaṃ, iti vaiṣamyam |
tasmāt agniśabdaḥ avayavidravyāntaravācī, tasyaikatvāt sakṛdeva prokṣaṇavikarṣaṇe iti siddhāntaḥ |
dup. 8|1|2|18 pṛ. 1584. agninā kṛtrimeṇa yācittena vā karmaṇi agnihotrādīni nānuṣṭhātavyānīti gamyate |
tena akṛ- trima eva kevalo'gnisteṣāṃ sādhaka iti niścityate |
vi. 1|2|10. agnipādaḥ nāma saṃkarṣe tṛtīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ |
12 āhavanīyasya śālāmukhī yasya praṇayanottaraṃ gārhapatyatvaṃ saumike karmaṇi |
18 dhiṣṇyāmiṣu savanadvaye somena, tṛtīyasadhane tu ājyena vyāghāraṇam |
23 paśau prathame'gniṣṭome aiṣṭikau'gniḥ ā anta dhāryaḥ |
daivāt karmaṇa utkarye tu satyāṃ prasaktau tatraiva karaṇaṃ iti kalpaḥ |
varuṇapraghāseṣu āpa- stambamate śālāmukhīyeḥ nāsti, baudhāyanamate tu asti |
bhā. 7|3|8|9. agnipraṇayanaṃ cāturmāsyeṣu madhyamayordvayoḥ parvaṇoḥ, na pramamacaturthayoḥ |
7|3|12-35. agnipraṇayanaṃ cāturmāsyeṣu madhyamaparvaṇoḥ laukikameva, tacca darśapūrṇamāsataḥ 'codakaprāptam |
bāla. pṛ. 132. agni- praṇayanaṃ some dharmavat, darśapūrṇamāsayośca adharmakam |
bhā. 7|3|18. agnipraṇayanaṃ some na sarvatraivāhavanīyasya, kiṃtu ekadeśasyaiva |
cā. 2|1|2|16 pṛ. 550. agniprayuktaṃ ādhānaṃ, na karmadhuktam |
bhā. 3|6|15. agniprayuktaḥ pavamāneṣṭi- saṃskāraḥ, na darśapūrṇamāsaprayuktaḥ |
agnibhedena araṇibheda āvaśyakaḥ, ekanā'rope saṃsargāpatteḥ; 'sahāraṇibhirataranti' iti nadītaraṇavidhau araṇibahutvaśravaṇāt |

'araṇibhyāṃ saha taranti' iti śālāāntarāt dvitvabahutvayorvikalpaḥ; iti prāpte, 'rathā- ṅgena taranti' ityādiviva nadītaraṇe'raṇisāhityamātrāvi- dhānena dvitvabahutvayoruttarādharāraṇibhedābhiprāyeṇānuvāda- mātram |
'agnimama āvaha' ityatra bāhyatvaṃ vāhyatvaṃ caika- syaiva pratīyate, ubhayorabhipedena vyapadeśāt |
yuktaṃ caitat, 'svaṃ mahimānamāvaha' iti svābhidhasya samahimnaḥ svenaiva vahanapratīteḥ |

'agnimama āvahatyāha tadagneyājyabhāgā- yāmināhayati' iti śruteḥ, iti prāpte, vahanakartṛkarma- tayorekasmin virodhāt svamahimapadasyāpi kaupītake vāyuparatvena vyākhyānāt 'sāmidhenībhiritvā'gnimupasthāya agnimama āvaha' iti śravaṇādāhavanīyasya pratyakṣo'gni- reva āvoḍhā |
tenāhavanīyabhede'pi sthāyitvaikatvāt aupā- dhikadvitvasyāprayojakatayā āmantrita vacanohābhāve'pi avabhṛthe 'agnimāpa āvahata' ityādirūhaḥ |
bhā 12|1|2|13. vā-dāśikaḥ sūktavākyaiḥ agnīṣomīye paśau 'agnimadha hotāramavṛṇīta' ityevaṃ vikṛtaḥ |
punaḥ savanīye paśau vikriyate 'agnimadha hotāramavṛṇīta yajamānaḥ sutāsutī' iti |
yadi pauro- ḍāśikaṃ tantraṃ syāt, tat idaṃ nityadābhānaṃ pākṣikaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt |
tasya ca maitrāvaruṇena kartrā kriyamāṇasya paśoḥ sādguṇyaṃ bhavati |
(tataśca pākṣikaṃ tantraṃ puroḍāśeṣu prasajyate, na vikalpaḥ |
oṃ abhiyoga: somakāle tadarthatvāt saṃskṛta- karmaṇa: paredhu sāṅgatya tasmāt sarvapavarge vimoka: syāt |
‘agniṃ yunajmi śavasā ghṛtena’ iti mantreṇa homa: abhiyoga: |
‘imaṃ ratnaṃ madhumantaṃ dhayāpāṃ’ iti mantreṇa homa: abhivamoka: |
somakāle somayāge sāmricatye ya: abhiyoga: kriyate, sa sāṅgatya pradhānasya kṛte syāt |
saṃskṛtakarmaṇa: abhiyogena saṃska- reṇa saṃskṛtasya agnikarmaṇa: sakāśāt paredhu karmasu viśeṣaprāvaṇāt |
nahi pradhānāduttareṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛte nāyaṃ abhiyoga: |
tasmāt sarvapavarge pūrvāṅgottarāṅgatvasahitasya pradhā- nasya samāptau abhrevimoka: syāt |
sarvādau abhiyoga:, sarvānte ca abhivamoka: kartavya: ityartha: |
idaṃ bhāṣyamate pūrvapakṣasūtraṃ, vārtikamate tu siddhāntasūtraṃ, akṣarārthastu sa eveti dhyeyam |
na sarvapavarge vimoka:, kiṃtu pradhā- nāpavarge syāt, pradhānādau ca yoga:, |
‘pañcabhi- ryunakti pāṅko yatho yāvāneva yajñastamālabhate’ iti pradhānasaṃyogena yogasya śravaṇāt |
avabhṛthe ca tadvat pradhānārthasya pratiṣedho'- pavṛtyarthatvāt |
āryavvaraṇasya hotṛvaraṇasya ca pradhānatvena pratiṣedho yukto bhaviṣyati |
pradhānārthasya hotṛvaraṇasya pradhānāpavarge apabhṛtyārthatvāt kṛtārthatvena samāptatvāt, apabhṛthata: samāpta: artha: prayojanaṃ yasya hotṛvaraṇasya tādṛśatvāt |
avabhṛthe codakaprāptasya hotṛva- raṇasya pratiṣedha: kartavyo bhavati, kṛtaśāsī ‘na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte nārṣeyaṃ’ iti |
pradhānādau yoga:, pradhānānte ca vimoka: kartavya: |
ahargaṇe dvādaśāha pratyahaṃ yogo vimokaśca syāt |
tasmāt pradhānādau yoga: pradhānānte ca vimoka: iti siddhānta: |

oṃ abhiyoga: somakāle ityatra agne: sāṅgatya- pradhānārthatvena abhiyogasyāpi tadvārā sāṅgatyapradhānārthatvā- vasāyāt sāṅgatyapradhānaparvaṇa: abhrivimokaṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā ‘pradhānāpavarge vā tadarthatvāt’ ityanena ‘pañcabhirayunakti pāṅko yaśca’ iti śrute: yajñasya ca pradhāna- yāgatvāccāvasāyāt abhiyogasya pradhānayāgamātrāthatvāva- gate: pradhānamāpavarge abhrivimoka iti siddhānto bhāṣye vakṣyate |
oṃ abhirudraghṛta: apabhṛte karmaṇi laukika: saṃpa- dyate |

karmāpavargottaramapi abhridarśanāt tasya ca gārha- patyāduddhṛtatvena ‘saiva sāṅpre: saṃtati:’ iti nyāyena vaidikatvanāpāyāt saṃskāralakṣaṇaṇāṃ guṇānāṃ- mantareṇapraṇāyāt tajjāgaraṇasyābhāve katipayaghaṭikottaraṃ tannāśe sati ‘sa tarhi gata:’ iti śrute: uddharaṇabhute- śraupapatte: yāvacchāmāpabhṛthe'pi karmaṇi dīkṣaṇīyāpavarge iva vidyamānaṃ jyoti: vaidikameva, iti prāpte, araṇismā- ropaṇottaraṃ paridravyamānasyāpi jvalanasya karmapavarge'pi tathālopapatte:, saṃskārāṇāṃ kāryārthatvena yāvakāryameva tada- vasthānasya śāstravadavagamāt, ‘sa tarhi gata:’ ityanena homāvyahitottarameva gamanaśrute: paridedyamāno'pi āya- tanastho'pi jvalana:, saṃskārāpāyāt apabhṛthe karmaṇi laukika: saṃpadyate |
ata eva ‘yasyoddhṛto'gnihṛte'gnihotre uddāyate’ ityādinā ‘tānyevāvakṣaṇāni saṃnidhāya manyet’ ityanena agnihotrāpavargāt prāk agnyādāne eva punarmaṃthanamuktam |
oṃ ‘abhiyogyatijyoti: sūrya: svāheti sāyaṃ juhoti, sūryo jyotijyotirtimi: svāheti prātarjuhoti’ iti miśraliṅga mantravidhirāpi ka cit |
su. pṛ. 436. oṃ ‘agnidevatā iti ityukte jvalanasaṃpratyaya: |
bhā. 3|2|12 pṛ. 746. oṃ ‘agnidevo hotā devān yakṣat’ iti āha- vanīyavāda: |
adhyupravaranigade ‘agnidevo hotā devān yakṣat’ ityatra hotṛlayadvayorubhayasādhāraṇyaniyame prāpte, utta- ratra ‘brahmapadvā ca vakṣat’ ityovoddhṛlakṣaṇaliṅgādāhavanīya- vāda eva |
oṃ abhrimāṇavaka: iti tu na abhriāvinābhāvena māṇavaka: pradīpte |
’ vā. 1|4|12|23 (1) pṛ. 354. guṇā- depa vāda: svārthābhidhānena |
bhā. 1|4|12|23 (1), oṃ abhrimāṇavaka: iti śabde evoccārite māṇavake saṃpratyaya: ; abhriābda eva māṇavakasyāmidhātā iti |
anādṛtya māṇavakapratyayaṃ jvalanaṃ abhriābdāt pratiyanto dṛśyante |
na tu anādṛtya jvalanapratyayaṃ māṇavakaṃ abhriābdāt pratiyanti |
kuta etat ? yoyo'gnisadṛśo vivakṣyate tatratatra abhriābdo niyata iti |
ata eva vigatasāha- davyati tu ayaṃ na dṛśyate |
na ca jvalane apratīte tasmādayaṃ pratīyate |
atyantamedāt sādṛśayena śabda: pravartamāna: pratyayaillakṣa- ṇyāt nāmidhātā iti sarvatra jñāyate |

satyapi tāvat māṇavakasāmānādhikaraṇye sati sādṛśaye abhi- dhānāt, asati cānamidhānāt, anyatra asādṛśya- vati vṛttidarśanāt asati cārthadarśanāt, viśeṣaṇatvāt avasrdhamāviprathamapratyāyane sādṛśyameva prathamaṃ pratyāyaya- vyam |
na cānavagate'mau tat tat pratīyate iti prathamataramagne- rabhidhānam |
oṃ abhrihotā vettu iti sugādāpananigade āhavanīyavāda: |

sugādāpananigade ‘abhrihotā vettu’ ityatrāpyaniyame prāpte, ‘abhrihotyāhāgrirdevānāṃ hotā taṃ vṛṇīte’ ityuktvā ‘yo'gniṃ hotāramuthā ityahavanīyaṃ punarvṛṇīte’ iti śravaṇāt punarititena pūrvavṛttasya hotura- greāhavanīyatvaṃ gamyate |
jvalanasya devatāyāśca parasparā- medena bruhado vyavahāradarśanāt |

sūtravāke ‘agne tvaṃ sūktavāgāsi’ iti saṃrodhasya svābhimukhāvahavanīyaparatvena sūktavāgāsīti sūtravacanasaṃbandhena hotṛtvādhyavasāyāt, ‘abhrihotriṇedaṃ havirajuṣata’ ityatra sahāyyatṛtīyā hotṛkarmasahitatvamātra- pratīte:, tāvanmātrasya ca ‘tūrṇihaṃgvyatvāt’ ityādivāvau- pacārikokte: āhavanīyo'pi saṃbhavadāgnihotriṇetyapi tasyaiva vāda:, iti prāpte, itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇatṛtīyā sthānādgārhapatyatve vāda: |
agnīnāṃ yathā prayogāt bahi: ādhānena saṃskṛtātāṃ puna: prayogamadhye saṃskāro na kriyate tadvat |

yathā ‘athā- to'gniṃ agnihotramevānu yajati, tamukthena, tamati- rātreṇa, taṃ caturātreṇa, taṃ pañcarātreṇa, taṃ saptarātreṇa, tamaha- rātreṇa, taṃ navarātreṇa, taṃ daśarātreṇa, tamekādaśarātreṇa’ eteṣu cayanaṃ kartuṃ śakyate tadvat |
yathā agne: sakṛt ādhānena saṃskṛtasya na puna: karmaṇi saṃskāra ekasya kriyate, tadvat |
oṃ agnivimokaḥ nāma homaviśeṣaḥ ' imaṃ stanaṃ madhumantaṃ dhayāpāṃ0 ' iti mantreṇa sāgnicitye kratau pradhānānte (sāgnipradhānānte vā) uktaḥ |
vividhaṃ haraṇaṃ alpa- nāmatvanāmagrahaṇadvārāgnīnāṃ āgnīdhrāt sakāśāt gṛhī- tānāṃ agnīṣu śiṣyeṣu sthāpanam |

hotṛḥ, maitrāvaruṇasya, brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ, potuḥ, neṣṭuḥ, acchāvākasya iti praṇṇā- mṛtvijāṃ paṭ, āgnīdhrasya saptamaṃ, mārjālīyaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ ityaṣṭau dhiṣṇyāni agneḥ sthānāni laghvedikā rūpāṇi, tatredaṃ viharaṇam |
ke. agniviharaṇapreṣe ' agnī- damīna vihara ' iti mantraḥ anvitaḥ, na tu utthāne |
tathā ca ' uttiṣṭhanvāha ' atra vidhau kālalakṣaṇayā utthānakāle agniviharaṇapreṣaḥ kartavyaḥ, iti kāle vidhīyate |
oṃ agniśabdaḥ ' agniṃ cinute ' iti śrutaḥ citi- pañcaka rūpe dvyantare vartate, na tu iṣṭakāsamudāye |
bhā. 9|1|26-27. agniśabdaḥ jātimātramupasthā- payan laukikavahnimātreṇa caritārthaḥ, āhavanīyādi- saṃskāravācake viśeṣaṇaṃ vinā na vaidikopasthāpako bhavati |
3|3|10. agniśabdaḥ sāmānyavacano'pi san ' agniṃ cinute ' ityatra prakaraṇavaśāt cayanasaṃskṛte vartate pravartate |
vā. 2|3|10|22. agniśabdasya ' agni- rdhutrāṇi jaṅghanat ' iti vaidikasya vṛtrahanasamartha- vastuvācitvāvagamaḥ |

laukikadhutyagniṣadvācyasya ca jvalanasya tadasāmarthyāt arthāntare ca avyutpannasyaiva śakyantarakalpane gauravāpatteḥ, gatyarthasya agādhitoḥ ' ahagnerlepaśva ' ( uṇādi 4|99 ) iti sūtreṇa auṇādike niṣpatye kṛte agniśabdasyopadhāraṇāt na prakṛtipratyayākhyānabhedena avyutpannasya laukikāt agniśabdāt vyutpannasya vaidikasyāgniśabdasya rūpānyatā abhipretā |
oṃ agniśikhānyāyaḥ-yathā svabhāvataḥ agniśikhā ūrdhvaṃ gacchati |
evaṃ hi sarvadarśanasaṃgrahārthadarśane abhihitam, tathā hi- ' kulālacakravat vyapagatalepālācavūt eraṇḍa- bījavat agniśikhāvat iti ' |
ata eva paṭhanti ' gatvāgatvā nivartante candrasūryādayo grahāḥ |
itaretarayoge tu vyāsa- jyavṛttivibhaktyarthe parasparasāhityenānyaḥ, yathā agniśca somaśca devatā ityādī (agnīṣomau) |
sa ca pṛṣṭhastotre trivṛtstomomayuktatayā trivṛdi- tyucyate |

' trivṛdbhi- ṣṭudagniṭomaḥ, tasya vāyavyāsu (ṛkṣu) ekaviṃśaṃ agniṭoma- sāma kṛtvā brahmavarcasakāmo yajeta, etasyaiva revatīṣu (ṛkṣu) vāravantīyamagniṭomasāma kṛtvā paśukāmo hotena yajeta ' iti karmāntaravidhiḥ, na tu vāravantīyāderguṇāt phalam |
bhā. 2|1|127. agniṭut nāma āgneyīsubrahmaṇyāpravartakaṃ, jyotirādināmnā aindrīsubrahmaṇyā- pravartakena bādhyate pañcadaśarātre |
bāla. pṛ. 132. agniṭut pañcadaśarātre prathamamahaḥ ekāhāgniṭuto vikṛtiḥ |

vi. 1|2|13. agniṭutḥ pūrvasya vidhvantaḥ revatyādirāgeṣu uttareṣu pravartate, sādyaskāḥ itye- kena śabdena yugapadupādānalakṣaṇasarvasaṅkhyānyavatāṃ agniṭudādīnāṃ ekāhānāṃ nikāyitvāvāntarasāmānye sumahadatvāt iti vakṣyate (8|1|2|19 ityatra ) |
tatra prākṛtayoḥ stotraśastrayoḥ yathādevataṃ ūho na kartavyaḥ, kiṃtu adhikāra eva |
bhā. 10|4|24|9, agniṭuti graheṣu ' āgneyā grahā bhavanti ' iti devatāvidhānaṃ bhavati |
yadyapi trivṛcchabdaḥ avayavaprasiddhā loke traiguṇyaṃ brūte, tathāpi vede rūḍhyā stomavācī |
stotrīyāṇāṃ navānāmuccāṃ anukrameṇa stomaviṣayameva trivṛ- ttvam |
vi. 10|6|7, agniṭuti pañcadaśarātrasya prathamāṣṭe upastakālinā subrahmaṇyā codakaprāptā'pi āgneyī na kāryā, kiṃtu bahūnāmanugrahāya aindrī eva kartavyā |
dvitīyādicaturdaśasu ahaḥsu aindrī evaite ( vastutastu prathamāṣṭe ubhe api subrahmaṇye paṭhitavye, ubhayoḥ prakāśanaṃ kartavyaṃ iti bhāṭṭa - bhāṣyaṭīkayorāśayaḥ ) |
1|2|17. agniṭuti pṛṣṭhastotre revatīṣu ṛkṣu agniṭomasāma ekaviṃśastomayuktaṃ gātavyam |
bhā. 2|1|127. agniṭuti brahmavarcasakāmena revatīṣu vyāsu ṛkṣu agniṭomasāma ekaviṃśastomayuktaṃ gātavyam |
agniṭome tu tat āgneyīṣu ṛkṣu gīyate |
bhā. 2|1| 127, agniṭuti subrahmaṇyā āgneyī bhavati, tena indraśabdasya sthāne agniśabdasya ūhaḥ ' ama āgaccha ' iti kartavyaḥ |
' hariya āgaccha ' ityādi tu nohaḥ; kiṃtu yathāśruta eva subrahmaṇyā''hvānamantro grāhyaḥ |
yājñikāstu ' ama āgaccha rohitāśva bṛhadāno dhūmaketo jātavedo vica- rṣaṇe ' iti ūhaṃ kurvanti |
vā. 2|1|127 pṛ. 553. oṃ agniṭuti śrutasya trivṛttvasya stotrīyānvaka- rūpasya stotrāntarastomamātrabādhakatvam |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ trivṛtsaṃkhyā'gniṭomasya sādhanamātre, uta stomaviṣayā niyamyate iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? trivṛcchabdo loke trisaṃjñe prayuktaḥ, yathā ' trivṛttruḥ ' ' trivṛ- nmaṇiḥ ' iti |
ihāpi ' trivṛdagniṭomaḥ ' iti trisaṃ- baddho'gniṭomaḥ kāryaḥ |
tatra triyamagniṭoma- sādhanaparicchedadvāreṇa tatsaṃbaddhamityucyate, na sākṣāt, guṇatvāt saṃkhyāyāḥ |
na ceha saṃkhyaiva viśeṣaḥ kaścitdīya upādīyate |
tadaviśeṣaprāda yāvān kaścidagniṭomasaṃbaddhaḥ saṃkhyayā paricchedyastasyaḥ, sarvai paricchedyeta |
yathā ' dadhivṛttaśālibhirdai- datto bhojayitavyaḥ, devadattavat yajñadattastailena ' ityukte snehasāmānyāttailaṃ snehanakāryaṃ eva viniyujyate, naudana- kāryaṃ iti |
yathā, ' trivṛdahivvamānaḥ ' ityatra stomaviṣayatā paricchinnā, evaṃ ' trivṛdagniṭomaḥ ' ityatrāpi sa eva śabda uccaritaḥ tameva sarvavidhamanu- mānāt buddhau saṃnidhāpayet |
te hi yenayena saṃbadhyante saṃkhyayena, taṃtaṃ parisaṃkṣate |
tasmādviṣva- mānena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt stotraṃ parisaṃkṣate, anyatrāpi yoyaḥ parisaṃkhyātvo bhaviṣyati, taṃtaṃ parisaṃkhyāsyatīti |
ayamiha trivṛcchabdo'dvitīya laukikamarthe viśiṣṭasaṃkhyaye ācaritaḥ, yathā, ' trivṛdahivvamānaḥ ' iti stomaviṣa- yiṇyāṃ navasaṃkhyāyām |
' trivṛdahivvamānaḥ ' ityabhidhāya nava stotrīyāḥ ucyante, tena tāsu vartate iti gamyate |
tathā parisaṃkhyāpi dṛśyate ' tryambikālābhirvṛtā stomena saṃmitāḥ ' iti navānāṃ kapālānāṃ trivṛttā stomena samānaṃ vadan trivṛcchabdasya tatra prasiddhiṃ darśayati |
loke'pi sāmānādhikaraṇyaprayogadā- cārāccārthavaśān bhavati, yathā ' ayaṃ devadattaḥ ' iti |
tasmādayaṃ trivṛcchabdo viśiṣṭasaṃkhyāsyevaviṣayo'- nyatra dṛṣṭaḥ, itīhāpi prayujyamāno yatra hyastameva liṅgāt buddhau saṃnidhāpayati, ityataḥ stomaviṣayo niyamyate |
yaduktaṃ, saṃkhyā hyaniyataviṣayā sarvatra saṃbandhamupapāti, etat avayavārthanirākaraṇāt samudāyāṅgīkaraṇācca

śā--yatra 'trivṛdagniṣṭut' ityādau vākyaśeṣāt arthavi- śeṣo nāvagamyate, tatra vicāryate (yadyapi aktāditat vākyaśeṣāt na viśeṣatārthamātraniścayaḥ; kiṃtu stotrīyā- navakalakṣaṇārthantare śaktireva vākyaśeṣāṇuguṇyena kalpyate, kalpitāyāṃ ca tasyāṃ vākyaśeṣābhāvatve'pi tasyā ana- pāyāta vākyaśeṣābhāvaḥ ārkicitkaraḥ, tathāpi traiguṇya stotrīyānavake ca śakteraviśeṣatvāt vākyaśeṣābhāvasthale stotrīyānavakaparūpārthaparatvasiddhayarthaṃ nyāyāntaranyupādānasthāva- śyakatvāt na aktādhikaraṇena [14|1|3] gatārthatvam |
) kiṃ traiguṇyavacanaḥ san sarveṣāṃ ṛtusādhanānāṃ saṃkhyāvi- kāraḥ, uta stotrīyānavakavacanaḥ san stomasyaiva vikāraḥ iti |
tatra śāstrasya mahāviṣayatvalipsayā sarvadravyāṇāṃ (prakṛtau yāni dravyāṇi saṃkhyāyuktāni, teṣāṃ sarveṣa
śā- pūrvapakṣaparapakṣau vā indrasya harī' ityā- iti tatphalatvāṅgīkāreṇa vacanasārthakyāt |
ata evai- dibhiḥ ete guṇā indre santīti gamyate |

santi cet, tadacanarūpatātparyagrāhakānurodhena prakṛtāvāpi na savanīya- svaguṇadvāreṇa indrameva prakāśayituṃ amīṣāmuccāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭārthaṃ havirarthatvaṃ, api tu savanamukhīvyatikramāntyapracārārthala- bhavati |
tena agnirāpi svaguṇadvāreṇa prakādyate iti hari- meva subrahmaṇyānigadasyeti pade dhyeyam |
'satveteṣu guṇeṣvevaṃ, tatsa- ke cittu savanamukhīye camasaireva homaḥ dbhāve tu na pramā |
vākyaśeṣāstvaduktā ye stutimātra- indradevatākaḥ, na tatrāgniṣṭuti agnidevatākatvaṃ, graheṣveva parā hi te ||
vaca- guṇaiḥ saṃbandhī indraḥ prakādyate, iti agnirāpi tairaiva guṇaiḥ nena tu agnidevatyagrahāgyāsāṅgatayā āgneyī subrahmaṇyā saṃvaddhavyaḥ iti ūhaḥ |
tatra, soma- yajamānapadavat ihāpi ūhaḥ ityucyateḥ savanamukhīyehome'pi śukrāmantrātmakatvena sakala- saṃgatiḥ |

atra tantraratne nyāyena anūhe'pi abhiṣṭuti yāśikaprasiddhatvāt, vacanena agnidevatyagrahābhyāse haridādipadayuktanigadāntarapāṭhatvāt tasyaivānuṣṭhānaṃ, na aupadeśikasubrahmaṇyāvidhāne'pi savanamukhīye atide- prākṛtasyāvikṛtasya iti idamadhikaraṇaṃ nyāyyatayāpanara śikendrasubrahmaṇyābhāve pramāṇābhāvāt, subrahmaṇyāyāstau- ityuktam |
ato'sa- haridādiṣu asogāt teṣāmasamavetattvāt iti duḥṣprakāra eva śreyān |
tadviśiṣṭaṃ haridādiviśiṣṭameva pratīyeta, na tu uhitavyamiti |
irda tu cintyate- kimindrapade iva haridādipade'- vi- 'haricchandra ūhaḥ syānno ve, ntre samavā- pyūho bhavet neti |
'indra ndrasametatvāt abhiṣṭuti agniprakāśanārthe rohitatvādi- āgaccha hariya āgaccha' ityādindraprakāśakaḥ |

indra- padanāmamūhaḥ, iti prāpte, devatādhikaraṇanyāyena (9|1|4) devatyaśca yāgyāsāvadaśabhirmasaiḥ saha śukrāmantrābhyāṃ mantrādīnāṃ tatparatve pramāṇābhāvāt haridādipadnāmasa- kriyamāṇaḥ savanamukhīyesaṃjñakaḥ |
tanmātrādeva tu mevetyarthakena āhārīyatvenāstutitvat abhiṣṭuterapyu- subrahmaṇyānigadaḥ liṅgāt, na tvanyadevatyāsāṅgaṃ, papatternohaḥ |

'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' iti vacanāt prākṛtagrahī- yadā tu chandogasūtre'gniṣṭuti 'agra āgaccha rohi- yadevatāvāgnenadevatāvidhānāt savanamukhīye'pyagnide- tāśca brahmajñānī dhūmaketo jātavedo viccapanne' ityu- vatā |
tataśca tadbhūtā subrahmaṇyā indrapade'ne'dri- tasyaiva pāṭhaḥ samāptaḥ, tadā'syāḥ smṛternyāyopanyāsapūrva- padaniṣedhenohyate eva |
na caivaṃ nyāyadevāhosiddhau katvābhāvenāgneyādismṛtitvat śrutilakṣaṇatvāttvaṃbhāvāt, 'āgneyī subrahmaṇyā' iti vacanavaiyarthyāpattiḥ |
prakṛtau tathā caitadadhikaraṇanyāyasyābhāsīkṛtapāṭha eva savanamukhīyevat savanīyahaviṣāmāpīndradevatyatvāt vedi- yuktaḥ |
tadā ca mantrāntarasyadevatāviśeṣāvaṣayamidamadhi- barhiṇyena (3|7|1) subrahmaṇyānigadasyetivat tasyaiva karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |

ata eva yatraiva nyāyopanyāsapūrvikā prakṛtau vikṛtāvi tadarthe bhedenābhedena vā'nūhitasubraha- smṛtistatraiva śrutilatve nyāyopanyāsavaiyarthyāpatteḥ mīmāṃ- hmaṇyānigadapāṭhasakteḥ, 'āgneyyeva subrahmaṇyā kāryā' sāsyanyāyavirodhe ābhāsalaṃ smṛterityuktaṃ kalpasūtrādhi- karaṇe (1|3|16) |
nyāyabinduḥ- jyotiṣṭome devatāprakāśanāthaḥ subrahmaṇyānigade; 'indra āgaccha hariya āgaccha' ityādi |
harivadādiśabdā api devatāguṇāthā rohitavadādirūpeṇohitāḥ, iti prāpte, devatādharmatve pramāṇabhāvāt stutimātreṇāhyatvāt nohaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
tatra śrūyate 'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' iti tatra saṃdehaḥ; kiṃ prākṛtayoḥ stotraśastrayoryathādevatve'tūhaḥ, utāvikāra iti |
grahāṇāṃ devatānyatve stutaśastrayoḥ karmatvād- vikāraḥ syāt |
iti pradhānakarmatvāditi kasya punareṣā buddhiḥ syāt yaṃ nivarttayeta ? yo mandadhī- manyate'bhidhānaṃ setsyatīti |
api ca kiṃ cidapekṣya sarve mandadhiyaḥ |
atha tu na paritoṣa evaṃ, tato'nyathā varṇyate |
yattadaṣṭamadhikaraṇaṃ dvitīyadhyāye (2|1|13-29) tasyedaṃ prayojanasūtraṃ, grahāṇāṃ devatānyatve stutaśastrayoḥ karmatvād-vikāraḥ syāditi |
yadi saṃskārakarmaṇi stotraśastre, kiṃ bhavati prayojanam ? agniṣṭudekāhe yathā- devatvamuhaḥ, atha pradhānakarmaṇi, tato grahāṇāṃ devatānyatve stutaśastrayoḥ karmatvād-vikāraḥ syāditi |

' bhāṭṭa- agniṣṭuti 'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' ityanena prākṛtagrahāvādena devatāntaravidhau stotraśastrayoḥ artha- karmatvasya dvitīyaiḥ sādhitatvāt prākṛtau nānādevatya eva ṛcaḥ stotraśastrayoḥ paṭhanīyāḥ |
idaṃ ca 'āgneyīṣu stuvate' ityetadvacanamātraṃ kṛtvā cintyā, sthalāntaraviṣayaṃ vā |
nyāyabinduḥ- agniṣṭuti śrutaṃ 'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' iti |
tatra prakṛtastotraśastrāṇāṃ adṛṣṭārthatvāt anūhaḥ iti spaṣṭam |
miśrati prayogaḥ, kiṃtu 'āgneyīṣu stuvate' 'āgneyīḥ śaṃsati' iti vacanena āgneyīnāmeva prayogaḥ |
yatra vikṛtau devatāntaraṃ, vacanācca tadevatākaṛcāṃ na prāptiḥ, sa viṣayaḥ |
ata eva sūtre 'grahāṇāṃ devatānyatve' iti sāmānyenoktaṃ iti dhyeyam |

atra śrutaśastrayoḥ saṃskārakarmatve'pi vikṛtau devatā'nyatve ūhaḥ, iti pūrvapakṣopavarṇanaṃ anupapannaṃ, 'pūyati vā etaccho'kṣaraṃ yadenamanuhati, tasmāda nohat' iti ṛcāṃmūniṣedhena devatāvidhānārthatve'pi udāhasa- jñātaṃ, kiṃtu devatāvidhānārthatve vikṛtau devatātve prākṛ- tīnāmṛcāṃ tadevatā''bhidhānasamarthā ṛco udāhasrabhāvācca tāsāṃ vikṛtau devatāprakāśanāsamarthā ṛco dāśatīyamānīya stutiḥ karttavyā iti pūrvapakṣo varṇa- nīyaḥ |
ata eva ca stutaśastrādhikaraṇe (2|1|13 -29) devatāsaṃskārārthatvapakṣe agniṣṭuti āgneyīnāṃ svata eva prāpteḥ : 'āgneyīḥ śaṃsati' iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt |
'anarthakaṃ ca tadvacanam' iti guṇasūtre (2|1|26) bādhakatvopapatteḥ, tatsvabhāvaṃ ca ācāryaiḥ (vārttikakāraiḥ) ṛcāmanuhyahetukaiva upapāditam |
anūhatve ca uktani- pedhavacanameva nyāyasudhāyāṃ (pṛ. 664) pramāṇikṛ- tam |
tasmāt yathāśrutaṃ kṛtvācintayā ūhapadaṃ prākṛtani- vṛttyabhiprāyaparaṃ, iti nyāyyameva |

' bhāṭṭa- agniṣṭuti 'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' ityanena prākṛtagrahāvādena devatāntaravidhau stotraśastrayoḥ artha- karmatvasya dvitīyaiḥ sādhitatvāt prākṛtau nānādevatya eva ṛcaḥ stotraśastrayoḥ paṭhanīyāḥ |
idaṃ ca 'āgneyīṣu stuvate' ityetadvacanamātraṃ kṛtvā cintyā, sthalāntaraviṣayaṃ vā |
nyāyabinduḥ- agniṣṭuti śrutaṃ 'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' iti |
tatra prakṛtastotraśastrāṇāṃ adṛṣṭārthatvāt anūhaḥ iti spaṣṭam |
atyagniṣṭoma:, ukthya:, ṣoḍaśī, atirātraḥ, atoryāmaḥ, vājapeyaśceti pañca saṃsthā: āgantūkāraviśeṣaḥ |
vi. 5|1|13. agniṣṭoma: nitya: kāmyaśca saṃyogapṛthaktvāt dadhyā- divat |
ke. agniṣṭoma: sa ucyate, yasmin kratau agnidevatāyā: stutidhamānā: ke cit stomā: santi |
agniṣṭoma: saḥ, yo hi agniṣṭomastotre (yajñā- yajñīye) samāpyate |
vi. 10|1|3. asti sarvasāra: kratu: śuna: karṇo'gniṣṭoma: |
'maraṇa- kāmo hatena yajeta, ya: kāmayeta anāmaya: svargaṃ lokamiyāmiti' |
bhā. 10|2|3|127. agniṣṭomaṃ apekṣya ukthyādiṣu saṃsthāsu dīpsoma:; agniṣṭomastu na dīrghasoma: |
3|3|1|28. agniṣṭoma sapatnīko yajamāna: ṣoḍaśānāmṛtvijāṃ sāhāyyenānu- tiṣṭhati |
atra somasya homa: pradhānaṃ, itarāṇi sarvāṇyaṅgāni iṣṭipraśvādīni |
ke. agniṣṭomāt prāk atyagniṣṭomādaya: saṃsthābhedāḥ, ekāhāhīnasvarūpāśca somavikṛtirūpā: sarve yāgā: nānuṣṭheyā: |
somavikṛtinā- mevāyaṃ niyama:, na tu iṣṭipraśnām |
vi. 5|1|14. agniṣṭomasya guṇavikārā ukthyādaya: iti na sarvasaṃsthāsādhāraṇaṃ prakaraṇam |
3|6|16. agniṣṭomasya pañcakṛtvo'bhyāsena jāyamāno gaṇa: pañcāgniṣṭomo nāma |
stotrāṇi tu jyotiṣṭomādeva grāhyāṇi, na dvādaśāhat |
6|1|14. agniṣṭomasya 'saumyasyādhvarasya yajñakrato: saptadaśa ṛtvija: ' iti kartṛṇāṃ niyamavidhi:, na tu anuvāda: |
bhā. 4|2|123- 24. 'tasya (agniṣṭomasya) ekaśataṃ prajājanuyājā:, na ca samidyajūṃṣi juhoti, prahlaya paridhīn juhoti hariyojanam' iti |
kathaṃ ? trivṛt bahiṣpavamānaṃ, pañcadaśānyājyāni, tāni catvāri, sā ekonasaptati: |
sapta- daśāni pṛṣṭhāni, tāni catvāri, sā aṣṭaṣaṣṭi: |
catu- raśītyā saha dvipañcācchataṃ (152) saptadaśa ārbhava: pavamāna:, tena ṣaḍadhikaṃ śataṃ nava ca |
eka- viṃśaṃ yajñāyajñīyaṃ iti tadetannavatiśataṃ agniṣṭomasya |
vi. 10|3|1. agni- ṣṭome adhipavaṇaphalakasaṃstadaṃtasya vādha: śrūyate 'han vā ete yajñasya, yadadhipavaṇe, na saṃtṛṇatti, asaṃtṛṇaṇe hi han' iti |
3|3|16. agniṣṭome eva 'viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe grahītavyā apyāgniṣṭome' iti vacanena ati- grāhyā vidhīyante |
saṃkarṣe. 3|3|2. agniṣṭome cayanaṃ kartuṃ śakyate 'ayāto'gniṣṭomenaivānu yajati' iti vacanāt |
bhā. 10|1|2|38. agniṣṭome tṛtīyasavane ārbhavapavamānasyopari yajñāyajñīyaṃ sāma gīyate |
ata eva yajñāyajñīyaṃ sāma agniṣṭomasya ityucyate |
vi. 2|1|2. agni- ṣṭome trivadādyaśvaralā: stomā vidyante, trivṛt pañcadaśa: saptadaśa: ekaviṃśeti |
mādhyaṃ- dine mādhyaṃdinapavamāna: nāma ekaṃ, pṛṣṭhastotrāṇi ca catvāri |
tṛtīyasavane ārbhavapavamāna: nāma ekaṃ, yajñāyajñīyasāmasādhyaṃ agniṣṭomāṃ dvitīyam |
8|3|5. agniṣṭome pañcadaśāni bhavanti, pañcadaśo mādhyaṃdina: pavamāna:, saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni, sapta- daśā ārbhava:, ekaviṃśamagniṣṭomasāma' |
saṃkarṣa. 1|4|19 (17). agniṣṭome pañcadharmā: upākaraṇaṃ, upānayanaṃ, akṣatayā bandha:, yūpe niyojanaṃ, nayanaṃ, saṃjñapanaṃ, viddhasanaṃ ityevamādaya: aupavasathye'hani paṭhitā: agniṣṭomīyasyaiva |
bhā. 3|6| 7|18-27. agniṣṭome prakṛtau prāta:savane bahiṣpava- mānasyānuviddhastamo bhavati |
vi. 10|1|9. agniṣṭome prathamoditasa aindrāvāyavasa, paścāt uktānāṃ maitrāvaruṇādīnāṃ ca samuccaya: |
10|4|3. agniṣṭome 'prahlaya paridhīn juhoti hariyojanaṃ' etasmin kāle iti lakṣaṇaṃ paridhigrahaṇam |
bhā. 11|3|15|18. agniṣṭome bahiṣpavamāne stoma- viddhau na sāmāntarāgama:, kiṃtu ṛgāgama eva |
vi. 10|5|10. agniṣṭome mādhyaṃdine savane pañca stotrāṇi |
ekaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ pavamānaṃ, catvāri pṛṣṭhastotrāṇi ceti |
8|3|5. agniṣṭome mādhyaṃdinapavamānasya ayastṛcā: ! gāyatrīchandaska: 'uccā te jāta0' iti |
tena svāyājyā: pūrvārdhānte vasā hutā bhavati |
bhā. 2|1|4|133. agniṣṭome rājanyasya, dvirātrādau ca (sarveṣāṃ) ṣoḍaśī grāhya: |
vi. 11|5|9. agniṣṭome ṣoḍaśī ukthyagrahottaraṃ āgrayaṇapātrāt grāhya: |
10|5|10. agniṣṭome ṣoḍaśī graho gṛhītaścet sastṛtaścata eva |
10|5|12. agniṣṭome ṣoḍaśī rājanyasya tṛtīyasavane eva āgraho na tu prātarma- dhyaṃdinasavanayo: |
10|5|11. agniṣṭome savanīya: ṛtupaśu: eka eva 'āgneya: paśurāgniṣṭome ālabhya: ' ityukttatvāt |
vi. 10|4|2 varṇaka 2. agniṣṭome hotṛvarvaraṇaṃ 'agni- hotā sa me hotā hotastvaṃ me hotā'si iti hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' ityuktam |
bhā. 12|1|2|8|137. tāvāneva hi tatra (saṃsthāsu) soma: 'daśa supūrbhīrmeti' iti vacanāt, yāvānevāgniṣṭome soma: ; tāvāneva ukthyādi- ṣvapi saṃsthāsu |
'triparvā iti parvasaṃkhyāniyamato na śakyo bahuparvā grahītum |
tatra ṛtvarthā agniṣṭomasaṃsthayā purupārthā- mukhyādisaṃsthānāṃ aicchiko vikalpaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 5|3|13, atirātraprathamāhārottaramapi agniṣṭomasaṃsthāṃ kṛttvaiva udbhi- dādayaḥ kāryāḥ |
5|3|13, agniṣṭomasaṃsthā ke eva jyotiṣṭome navatiśataṃ stotrīyāḥ |
5|3|12. agniṣṭomasaṃsthe ukthasaṃsthe ca ṣoḍaśī grahītavya iti 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt apyukthye' iti vacanenocyate |
agniṣṭoma- saṃsthe jyotiṣṭome trayaḥ paśava āgnātāḥ : agnīṣomīyaḥ, savanīyaḥ, anubandhyaśceti |
vā. 3|6|178. agni- ṣṭomasaṃsthama prakalpa 'dhivyamān jyotiṣṭomaḥ kuryāt' iti vidheḥ caturthavihārasiddhiḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|16. agniṣṭomānuṣṭhānāt prāk ekastomakā anekasto- makā vā somavikṛtīrūpāḥ kratavo nānuṣṭhātuṃ śakyante |
bhāṣyaṃ— 'athānyene' iti kiṃ saṃsthānāṃ vādaḥ, atha jyotiṣṭomavikārāṇāmeva ekāhādīnāṃ iti (saṃdehaḥ ?) |
tasmāt agniṣṭomasaṃsthaṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ kṛtvā ukthyādayaḥ kartavyāḥ |
( atha utsūtrabhāṣyaṃ adhikaraṇāntaram ) ' ya etenāniṣṭvā'nyena ' iti dvāvapīmau padārthau vicāritau |
kima- gniṣṭomasya prāthamyaṃ nāma dharmo vidhīyate, uta uttareṣāṃ prāthamyapratiṣedhaḥ, athavā anyaḥ prakāraḥ |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? jyotiṣṭomasya prāthamyaṃ vidhīyate prakaraṇāt, ita- reṣāṃ na prāthamyapratiṣedhaḥ |
tatra evaṃ hi jyotiṣṭomasya dvitīyādau prayoge prāthamyābhāvāt aphalatā prasajyeta |
kaḥ punarasau ? 'ya ete- nāniṣṭvā' iti svādhyādasya pūrvakālavācitvāt pūrvamagni- ṣṭomasya kartavyatāmāha, paścāt gavādīnām |
tena tadbhā- vyamaṃ gavādīnāmanena vākyena coyate, vākyāntareṇa svargaḥ, ato dvitīyādiprayoge phalaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ iti |
bhāṣyaṃ— yadyevaṃ na tarhi tadadhikāraṇāṃ vādaḥ |
yadi te gavādisu vidhīyeran, prakaraṇādīni vācye- ran |
yadyapi āpattivihārau na vidhīyete tathāpi codakena vidhīyete |
ye prakṛtau karta- vyāste codakavacanāt vikṛtāvapi kartavyā gamyante |
tadā āpattivihārāviva yatra bhavataḥ, tenānyena iti gamyate |
yo'sāvanyaḥ sa kathamanayā praśaṃsayā lakṣyata, ityevamarthā praśaṃsā |
śā— 'saṃsthā evānyaśabdena kathyante prakṛtā hi tāḥ |

' ( yadyapi saṃsthānāṃ śāstrasyajyotiṣṭomasaṃsthānvidhāyabhāvāt kratoreva prakaraṇaṃ, na saṃsthānāṃ, tathāpi saṃnidhilakṣaṇamevātra prakaraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣo'bhimataṃ, tasyaiva 'anena' iti sarva- nāmnā parāmarśaḥ prayojakatvāt |
tataśca 'ya etena' iti pūrvaprakṛtāgniṣṭomasya ukthyādaya eva saṃnihitāḥ, na ṛtvantarāṇi, iti pūrvaprakṛtāditarat yat saṃnihitaṃ, tadbhāvinā anyaśabdena saṃsthānāmeva nirdeśaḥ iti pūrva- pakṣaḥ |
siddhāntamāha—) 'na tvevaṃ saṃsthānā- masti prakaraṇaṃ yataḥ |
yajñānāmiti śabdena sarve saṃnihitā hi te |
' ( nanu jyotiṣṭomaśabdena anyaśabdānvaye agniṣṭomānyena jyotiṣṭomena ityevamukthādisaṃsthajyoti- ṣṭomasyaiva nirdeśaḥ syāt, na tu ṛtvantarāṇāṃ ityata āha— jyotiṣṭometi |

ayaṃ bhāvaḥ; jyotiṣṭomaśabde'yaṃ ete- netyanyena nirākāṅkṣatvāt nānyaśabdena saṃbadhyate, yena uktarītyā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ syāt, kiṃtu kasmāda- danyena ? ityapekṣāyāṃ prakṛtāgniṣṭomādanyena ityevaṃ saṃni- hito jyotiṣṭomaḥ pratiyogitayā saṃbadhyate |
tataśca agni- ṣṭomasaṃsthāt jyotiṣṭomāt anyatvaṃ sarveṣāmiti sarva- nirdeśa evāyaṃ iti |
na caivaṃ sati saṃsthānāṃ yāgatvābhāvāt yajamānānādhikṛtatvāt yajamānānādhikaraṇopapatteḥ |
ata evoktaṃ tantraratne 'yajñānāmagniṣṭomasyopadeśya- tirātrāgniṣṭomāhīnasatrāṇāṃ madhye eṣa prathamaḥ prayo- gaḥ' |
dṛṣṭaśca 'prajāpatiryajñamasṛjata' 'yajñaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ' ityādi śrutikalpasūtrayoḥ saṃsthāsādhā- raṇo yajñaśabdaprayogaḥ iti |
vāda: iti sarveṣāṃ teṣāṃ jyotiṣṭomāt paścādbhāve'ṅgaṃ anena vākyena vidhīyate |
anyaśabdasya pūrvaprakṛtāditarat yat saṃnihitaṃ, tadācitvāt saṃsthānāṃ ca saṃnihitatvena tāsyeva agniṣṭo- mottaratvasya vidhiḥ, iti prāpte, na tāvat saṃsthānāṃ prakaraṇe saṃnidhānaṃ, vikṛtitvāt |
adhikāro'pi jyoti- ṣṭomasya ‘eṣa vāva’ ityādivākyaśeṣe tasyaiva saṃkīrtanācca, yajñānāṃ jyotiṣṭome'dināṃ madhye agniṣṭomasaṃjñaka eva prathamaṃ ityukte anyeṣvāpi udbhidādīnāṃ yajñapadenopādānāt |
śā-- kravantarāṇāṃ nāsti kramaniyamaḥ iti sthitam|
tatrāviśeṣataḥ sarvasaṃstho'nena (ya etena iti sarvanāmnā) vimṛśyate |
' jyotiṣṭomasya hi agniṣṭomasaṃsthā naijaṃ rūpaṃ iti tādṛśa eva pratīyate, na saṃsthāntaryuktaḥ; teṣāmāgantukatvāt |
api ca 'etena' iti karaṇanirdeśāt jyotiṣṭomakaraṇikā bhāvanā iṣṭvā iti śabdena kathyate |
(nanu saṃsthāsu āśrayamānasyāpi jyotiṣṭomasya svaphalabhāvanākaraṇatvaṃ na hīyate, sarvatra paraprayuktasya karmaṇaḥ kāmyaguṇo āśrayatvāt |
tathā ca saṃsthāntaryoge'pi na karaṇanirdeśānupapattiḥ ityata āha-) na ca saṃsthānāṃ ṛtubhāvanāntarbhāvaḥ phalārthatvāt |
agniṣṭomasaṃsthā tu ṛtubhāvanāntargatā iti tatsaṃsthasyaiva parāmarśaḥ (itikartavyatāyuktasya karaṇatvāt yatsaṃsthā itikartavyatāntargatā, tatsaṃsthasyaiva karaṇanirdeśagrahaṇaṃ nyāyyamiti bhāvaḥ) |
sūtrārthastu- eteneti agniṣṭomasaṃsthā nirdiśyate tatsaṃsthasyaiva karaṇatvāt iti |
bhāṭṭa-- sthite bhinnaprayogaparigṛhītānāṃ kramāniyame, ka cit vacanāt paurvāparyaṃ, yathā 'eṣa vāva...gartapatyameva tadvati' iti |

tatra etacchabdo yadyapi jyotiṣṭomamātraparāmarśī, tathāpi na sarvasaṃsthā grahaṇaṃ, api tu agniṣṭomasaṃsthaiva, saṃsthāntarāṇāṃ anyadyodenanābhidhānasya agniṣṭomādhikaraṇe vakṣyamāṇatvena tāsyapi jyotiṣṭomottaratvasya āvaśyakatvāt, pariśeṣādeva agniṣṭomasaṃsthasya pūrvaṃ karaṇasiddheḥ |
ata eva atirātrasaṃsthasya 'atirātrameke prathamamāharanti' iti vacanādeva prathamaṃ karaṇam |
agniṣṭomasaṃsthākajyotiṣṭome eva hi tāvatḥ stotrīyāḥ, na saṃsthāntaryukte |
evaṃ ca atirātraprathamahārottaramapi agniṣṭomasaṃsthāṃ kṛttvaiva udbhidādayaḥ kāryāḥ iti draṣṭavyam |
nyāyabindu-- 'eṣa vāva...anyena yajeta' ityatra etacchabdena sarvasaṃsthajyotiṣṭomāntarviśeṣapāt, iti prāpte, agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyāḥ nityatāt tatsaṃsthasyaiva parāmarśa iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣya--asti kharaḥ 'yūpasya kharaṃ karoti' iti śruta: |
sa kiṃ sarvaśrutāṃ tantraṃ bhedena veti |
kiṃ prāptam ? kharaḥ khalu tantre'nyadapyucyate, asyakālatvāt |
karmakāle'yamupādīyate, 'svarūpā sthitānā vā paśuṃ samanakti' iti |
yasya paśoḥ samañjanakāle upāttastadartho'sāviti gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ |
tasmāt : nanu 'yūpasya kharaṃ karoti' iti svakālatvāyotpattiḥ |
yatkāraṇaṃ, kharaṃ jñāyate, kharakāryaṃ tu jñāyate paśo- rañjanam |
