nanu ṛtvante svaroḥ pratipattirdṛśyate, 'saṃsthite some prastaraṃ praharati, svaraṃ cāyaśavaisāya' iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? idameva praharaṇasyotpattivākyaṃ, 'somānte prastaraṃ praharati, svaraṃ cāyaśavaisāya' iti |
sa yadi sādhāra- ṇaḥ, tataḥ sarvaśrutāṃ kṛtārthe karmaṇi asyotsargaviśeṣa- paśyāgro praharaṇasya darśanamupapadyate |
atha tu pṛthak syāt, tato'gmīpomīyasyānte eva dṛśyeta |
atha vacanamidaṃ kasmānna bhavati, agmīpomīyānte prāptasya somānte vacana- nāt |
vacanena drāvulasasya viśeṣau ucce- yātāṃ, agnī ca praharaṇaṃ, somānte ca |
prastarasya darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ praharaṇa- muktaṃ, 'āśīrbhiḥ prastaraṃ praharati' iti |
...ityekasmin yūpe eka eva prathamaḥ śakalaḥ, iti tantratvam |
yūpacchedanakāle eva cāsya vyāmohanirvṛttyarthe nāśāpahāra- parihārārthe copādānaṃ kartavyaṃ ityudyamāṇaviśeṣatvādi tantratvam |
soma-- yūpārthābhāvāt na saṃskāravat tantratā ityutthitiḥ saṃgatiḥ |
upāttasya ca gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvena tadapavargo'pavargādreva iti vācyam|
upādānakālāntāvāpi 'yaḥ prathamaḥ śakalaḥ prāpatet sa svaruḥ' iti vacanena prathamaśakalasya svaru- tvāt, tasya caikatvena medānupapatteḥ |
na ca ekasmin praharaṇe 'yaḥ prathamaḥ' iti vacanena prathamaśakalanā- mapi nānātvopapattiriti vācyam |
kiñca, yūpacchedanakāle eva vyāmohanirvṛttyarthaṃ nāthāpahāra- nivṛttyarthaṃ ca, svarūpādānaṃ kartavyamityagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣa- tvādipi tatra svaruḥ |
ata eva 'saṃsthite some prastaraṃ praharati svaruṃ ca' iti ante pratipattividhānamapi saṃgacchate |
na cāyamanuvandhyāṅgabhūtasya kālavidhiḥ, nyāyena svarutvatatvāgatau saṃkoce pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva yatra nyāyenaiva bhedāvagatiḥ yathā prastare, tatra saṃkoca iṣṭa eva |

nyāyabinduḥ— pañcajñāpavarge svaropavargāt añja- nāntare'nyasyopādānaṃ, iti prāpte, 'yaḥ prathamaḥ śakalaḥ sa svaruḥ' iti vacanānāntyaśakalaikādānaṃ, yūpacche- nakāle eva vyāmohanirvṛttyarthaṃ tadupādānamiti na viśeṣa- grahaṇaṃ, atastantrataiva siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyam— yūpasaṃskārā ye paśutantramadhye kriyante, yathā prokṣaṇamañjanamukhyaṃ paribhyāṃ ca, teṣu cintyate |
kiṃ tattatsva paśorbhedena kartavyāḥ, athavā tantramiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? saṃskārāstāvateran yūpasya, na yathā yūpastantraṃ tathā syuḥ |
tatkālāstu yūpakarmatvāt tasya dharmavidhānāt sarvārthānāṃ ca vacanādanyakālatvam |
yūpaḥ etaiḥ kriyate, yūpo niyojanārthāḥ, sa ca dīkṣāsu kartavyaḥ |
nanu chedanamātraṃ tatra yūpasya śrūyate, na yūpakriyā |
na kiṃcit dravyaṃ yūpyamasti, yasya chedanamucyate |
yatkāraṇaṃ, nāsau chedanena kevalena yūpo bhavatīti |
sarvā- rthānāṃ ca satāṃ vacanāt keṣāṃ cidanyakālatvaṃ kṛtam |
yathā vājapeyena samrāṭ sakṛt śrute, tasya punaḥ kriyā nirarthikā |
nanvevaṃ sati niruddhapaśāvapi kāmaṃ sa eva yūpaḥ kartavyo bhavet |
vāḍaṃ bhavet, yadi niriekena yāgapratiṣedho na syāt |
bhāṣyam— 'trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya savanīyaṃ paśumupā- karoti' iti parivāṇe yūpadharmānukramam |
soma— yūpatantratvaṃ vinā tatsaṃskāratantratvāprasakteḥ pūrvādhikaraṇoktayūpatantratvopajīvanena tatsaṃskāratantratve vicārapravartanāt saṃgatiḥ |
chedanavidhivayo hi paraspara- napekṣāḥ pratyekaṃ chidrādikādyāgataṃ dṛṣṭamahaṇaṃ vā saṃskāraṃ bodhayanti |
te ca saṃskārāḥ militā eva yūpaśabda- vācyāḥ, na pratyekaṃ, tāvatsaṃskārasiddhayanantaraṃ 'yūpe
paśuṃ niyuñjīta' iti niyojane saṃskāraviniyojaka- vākye yūpacchedanaviśeṣeṇa sarvaimupādānena yūpaśabdasya nānātvānyāpatteḥ militānāmeva teṣāṃ tacchabdādyarthakalpanāt |

evaṃ ca tāvatsaṃskārasamudāyayūpotpattau tatsaṃskārajanakānāṃ takṣaṇādīnāmekameṣitatvāt, kevalena ca chedena yūpo tyasyasaṃbhave, 'dīkṣāsu chedena yūpaṃ kuryāt' ityukte yāvantaḥ padārthā yūpotpatyatvenāgatāḥ teṣāṃ sarveṣā- mapi chedanamupalakṣaṇamāśritya chedenādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ padārthaiḥ dīkṣāsu yūpamutpādayet iti vākyārthaparyavasānena sarvaipāmeva padārthānāmenāpakarṣo bodhyate |
' tasmāt trivapi paśu yūpacchedanavat takṣaṇapūrvāgaṇādayaḥ tantreṇānuṣṭheyāḥ |
bhāṭṭa— yūpatantratve tatsaṃskārāṇāṃ takṣaṇajoṣapraprokṣa- ṇādīnāmapi tantratvam |

na ca 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti' ityanena chedanamātravyāpakavidhivināt takṣaṇādīnāmagnī- pomīyakāle eva karaṇenānuṣṭhānasadeyāt tanmātrārthatva- pratīteḥ : gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvena tadapavargo'pavargāvṛttiriti vācyam, yūpacchedanoddeśe viśiṣṭe'patteḥ, chedanamātro- ddeśe atiprasaṅgāt, yūpoddeśenaiva kālavidhiḥ |

china- ttistu tadutpādakasaṃskāramātropalakṣaṇaṃ, tadutpādakāśca saṃskārāḥ bodhāyanādikalpaparyalocanayā yājñika- prasiddhyā ca yūpāhlāyaṅgacchedanavyāghāścīraṇātā eva, agrerivādhānādayaḥ, na tu prokṣaṇājñanādayo'pi |
tadedaṃvyavasthā- yāmapi, ye tāvadutpādakāsteṣāṃ bhinnakālatvenāgṛhyamāṇavi- śeṣatvādeva tantratvaṃ yūpavat |

ye tu prokṣaṇādayaḥ utpanna- yūpasaṃskārāḥ, teṣāmapakarṣavacanābhāvena deśakāle evā- nujñeyatvena gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatve'pi ātithyādyaiḥ prokṣaṇa- nyāyena (12|1|16) yūpayajñairekatvāt tatra kṛtānāṃ prokṣaṇādīnāṃ prasaṅgenapakārakatvopapatteḥ teṣāmapi nāvṛttiḥ |
athaitadasvarasasyaiva lakṣaṇānyupagamena chedana- mātrāpakarṣa iti pakṣāntaramyupagamaḥ, tato viśiṣṭede- śādyāpattirdurddharaiva |
na ca tatparihārārthaṃ 'yūpaṃ kartuṃ khadiraṃ chinatti' iti padadvayādhyāhāraḥ, tadapekṣayā lakṣa- ṇāyā laghutvāt |

nyāyabinduḥ— yūpacchedanasyaivāpakarṣāt itarasaṃskā- rāṇāṃ pradhānakālatvāt viśeṣagrahaṇena paśantare punaḥ prayogaḥ, iti prāpte, yūpaṃ chinattītyasya chedanena yūpaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ, yūpasyāsiddhatvāt |
na ca chedanamātreṇa tatraṇasaṃbhavati takṣaṇādīnāmapi chinattītyupalakṣaṇaṃ, chedanamātrārpakaṇe'pi vā dvārasya yūpasya sādhāraṇatvāt, teṣāmapi tantramiti siddhāntaḥ |
' oṃ agniṣṭomokhyayoḥ ṣoḍaśī gṛhītavyeta sastantraśca eva |
bhāṣyam— ṣoḍaśini prakṛte idamāmnāyate, 'agni- ṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyādapyukthye grāhyaḥ' iti |
tatrā- yamarthaḥ : saṃdāyikaḥ, kimastottraśaḥ : ṣoḍaśī, uta sastotraśastra iti |
ukthyāgniṣṭomasaṃyogo bhavati, 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyādapyukthye grāhyaḥ' iti |
agniṣṭomasaṃsthe ukthyasaṃsthe ca ṣoḍaśī grahītavyaḥ ityucyate |
evamagniṣṭomasaṃstho'sau kraturbhavati, yadyatra saha graho gṛhyate, yadi ca na tatra stotraṃ dātraṃ vā kriyate |
sati hi stotre śastre vā ṣoḍaśinā stotreṇa saṃtiṣṭheta, tatrāgniṣṭomasaṃstho na syāt ukthyasaṃsthaśca, tatredaṃ vacanamupapadyate, 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyādapyukthye grāhyaḥ' iti |
nahi yāgaḥ stutaśastrayoraṅgaṃ bhavati, phalavatvāccāgasya, aphalatvāccetarayoḥ |
dup-- 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt' iti sati agniṣṭome ṣoḍaśigrahaṇam|
yadi sastomaśastraḥ kriyeta, agniṣṭomasaṃsthā na syāt|
asatyāṃ ca (agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyāṃ nimittābhāvāt) ṣoḍaśigrahaṇameva na prāpnoti|
tasmāt stotrālaṃbaṃ yatra nimittavighāto na, tadapimata|
kathaṃ ca sastomaśastro bhavet, yadyagniṣṭomastotrasya ṣoḍaśī aṅgatvena vidhīyate|
na cāyamagniṣṭomastotrasyāṅgatvena vidhīyate, ṣoḍaśiyāgā- bhyāsasya phalavatvāt|
katham? 'grahaṃ vā gṛhītvā camasaṃ vonīya stotramupākaroti' ityupasaṃprāpte nimitte bhaviṣyat naimittikena|
yadi (agnāni) na kriyen (tathā sati ṣoḍaśī) svakāryaṃ naiva sādha- yet|
kriyamāṇe tu agni- ṣṭomasaṃsthā na syāt|
katham? 'ūrdhvā vā anye yajñakratavaḥ saṃti- ntyatiryajño'nye, ye hotā rambhasiṃtṛpyante ta ūrdhvāḥ, ye vā'cchavākaṃ te tiryajñaḥ|
dve eva yajñakratavo bhavanti, ye hotārma- bhisaṃtitiṣṭhante, ye cācchavākam|
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ, sati hi saṃsthānyatvamiti|
agniṣṭomāntaṃ yaduktaṃ, tasya vaca- nādanyaṃ anyo'nto vidhīyate|
śā-- ṣoḍaśyeva yadvā 'apyagniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇī- yāt apyukyye grāhyaḥ' ityādivacanādagniṣṭomasya- yogbhrate|
tadā kiṃ asustomaśastraḥ syāt, uta tadā'pi sastomaśastraḥ:, iti saṃśaye, 'ukyāgniṣṭomasaṃyoge nāsya stotrādikaṃ bhavet|
rājanyasya tathā nāsau kimu ṣoḍaśi- saṃsthitaḥ|
tadaṅgatvena hi stotraṃ śāstraṃ cāhatya coditam|
'eka- viṃśaṃ stotraṃ bhavati pratiṣṭhe haricchastre' iti vihitaṃ stutaśastraṃ, asati virodhe hi ukyāgniṣṭoma- saṃsthasya na kriyeta? tasmāt sastomaśastraḥ|
soma-- ṣoḍaśiśaprasaṅgāt bādhaprasaṅgācca tadastotra- śastramātrādyau cintyate iti tantraratnam|

iha agni- ṣṭomādisaṃsthāṃ nimittatayā upādāya ṣoḍaśiśaṃśā na vidhīyate, kiṃtu yaḥ kratuḥ agniṣṭomasaṃsthākaḥ ukyyasaṃsthā- kaśca vihitaḥ, sa kratuḥ rājanyasya na tatsaṃsthākaḥ, kiṃtu ṣoḍaśiśastraḥ kartavyaḥ: iti rājanyameva nimittīkṛtya pūrva- saṃsthopamardena saṃsthāṃntaraṃ vidhīyate|
' bhāṭṭa-- 'ṣoḍaśino vaikṛtatvaṃ' (10|1|134) ityatra ṣoḍaśiśaṃsthāyāḥ prakṛtyaṅgaṃ 'apyagniṣṭome rājanyasya
nahi atra rājanye nimitte ṣoḍaśiśaṃsthāyāḥ agniṣṭomāṅgatvena vidhiḥ|
agniṣṭomādi- padavācyā saṃsthaiva bhavet tadviśiṣṭo jyotiṣṭomo vā? nobhayathā'pi saṃbhavaḥ; ekasaṃsthāyāṃ aparasaṃsthā- saṃbhavāt|
saṃsthā hi tatstottottaraṃ tasmin kratuprayoge stotrāntarābhāvaḥ|
na ca agniṣṭomastotrāderantimatve ṣoḍaśiśotrasya antimatvaṃ saṃbhavati|
ata eva pūrvapūrva- saṃsthopamardena saṃsthāṃntaravidhiḥ iti siddhānto'pi asaṃ- gataḥ|
nāpi agniṣṭomādipadeḥ śuddhaṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ lakṣayitvā taddeśena ṣoḍaśiśaṃsthāvidhiḥ, vākyadvayavaiyarthyāpatteḥ|
ato javanya anupakate ṣoḍaśiśapade eva grahaṇamātraṃ ṣoḍaśiśaṃsthābhūtaṃ lakṣayitvā tadeva agni- ṣṭomādisaṃsthodeśena tadviśiṣṭakratudeśena vā vidhīyate|
tasya pradhāna- bhūtāgniṣṭomādisaṃsthopamardāpatyā bādhāt, iti prāpte, na tāvan saṃsthāviśiṣṭajyotiṣṭomoddeśena grahaṇavidhiḥ|
nāpi saṃsthāmātrodeśena saṃsthāṅgatvasya, prakaraṇātprāptatayā pratiprasavārthāpiṣaddānu- papatteḥ|
nāpi saṃsthāyāṃ nimittabhūtāyāṃ 'jyotiṣṭomā- ṅgatvena vidhiḥ, rājanyasyāpi nimittatvena uddeśyānaikatvā- patteḥ|
ataḥ prathamapasthite'pi agniṣṭomādipade eva stotralakṣaṇā tadabhyāsalakṣaṇā vā|
tathā ca agniṣṭomābhyāse kṛte sati ityarthā''kārāta tadabhyāsottarakālatvāviśiṣṭaṣoḍaśiśaṃsthaiva rājanye nimitte jyotiṣṭomāṅgatvena vidhīyate|
arthāta tasya nityā agniṣṭomasaṃsthā, kāmyā ca ukyyasaṃsthā nivartate|
kāmyā tu ṣoḍaśiśaṃsthā sarvaiṣāmeva iti viśeṣaḥ|
ata eva 'taṃ parāṅmukhavyebhyaḥ' iti ukyyaparabhāvo'pi ṣoḍaśinaḥ, kāmyaprayoge atirātrasaṃsthāyāṃ ca ityapi boddhavyam|
iyaṃ hyatra sthitiḥ prāmāṇikī, agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyāṃ na agniṣṭomastotrottaraṃ ukyyādi kiṃ cit|
ukyyasaṃsthāyāṃ tu taduttaraṃ ukyyastotrāṇi, na tu tasyāpyuttaraṃ ṣoḍaśyādi|
ṣoḍaśiśaṃsthāyāṃ tu taduttaraṃ ṣoḍaśiśastotraṃ, na tu tasyāpi uttaramatirātrādi|
tadiha kāmyāyāṃ ṣoḍaśiśaṃsthāyāṃ atirātrāntargata- ṣoḍaśyābhyāse ca yathāsthita eva ukyyaparabhāvaḥ|
agni- ṣṭomasaṃsthopamarde tu agniṣṭomābhyāsottaratvasya vācanika- tvāt ukyyastotrāṇāṃ lopa eva|
etasyaiva ca 'atyagni- ṣṭomaḥ' iti saṃjñā, 'atyagniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇī- yāt' iti śā''ntaravacanāt|
ukyyasaṃsthopamarde tu tatra ukyyastotramāvasya pratiprasavāt, na tatra ukyānāṃ lopaḥ|
ukyyasaṃsthāyāśca kāmyāyāḥ eva prāptiḥ: tadupamarde rājanyasya tannirvṛttiḥ|
ataḥ sastomaśastraḥ eva ṣoḍaśī saṃsthārūpaḥ ukyāgniṣṭomasaṃsthopamardena rājanyasya syāt iti siddham|
yāni tu 'atirātre brāhmaṇasya gṛhṇīyāt' ityā- dīni vacanāni, teṣu na pūrvasaṃsthopamardena saṃsthāntara- vidhiḥ, pratiprasavātkapidhātvābhāvena agniṣṭomādivākya- vailakṣaṇyātpratīteḥ|
tasya ca atirātrasaṃsthodeśena tasaṃsthākajyotiṣṭomoddeśena vā vidhānaṃ, saṃsthāyāḥ prāk- tādgyaireva nirākāṅkṣatvāt|
ata eva brāhmaṇasya nitya- vat tatra tasya prāptau 'nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityanena pākṣikatvasiddhayarthaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ|
ataśca brāhmaṇasya vikalpaḥ, anyeṣāṃ prāpakapramāṇābhāvādeva sa naiva iti dhyeyam|
yatu 'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti ka- cit likhyate vacanaṃ, tat 'atirātre brāhmaṇasya' ityete-
nanu cāyaṃ nāgnisaṃskāraḥ; kratvarthāgnirnirrṇā- yate, tathāpyuttaravākye 'agnimanuyajati' ityatra karma- pravacanīyadvitīyāyāḥ |
evaṃ ca sati cayanasya kratvartha- tvāt 'agniṃ cinute' ityatrāpi kratvarthatvādāhavanīya- viṣayatvameva cayanasya niścīyate |
na cātra vākyadvaye'pyagniśabdasya mukhyārthatve'pi kā cidanupapattirastīti na yāgavidhānaṃ, kiṃtu prakṛtivikṛtyorivānyeṣāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ vidhānamiti |
na ca vācyaṃ 'prakṛtāveva saṃskāro vidhīyatām, atideśatastu vikṛtau prāptamiṣyatīti vyarthaṃ vikṛtau vidhāna
'madhyāt pūrvādhaucca dviḥ avacati' itivat avivakṣita- guṇārthā kāryavaśeṇa abhiprārthān lakṣyantī pravartate |
tataśca agreḥ prādhānyaṃ ekatvasya ca guṇabhāvaḥ ityādi pūrvadeva yojanīyam |
tṛṇāni ityetadapi bahutvena avi- vakṣitamiti dhyeyam |
agnihotre anugdaramantraḥ 'vācā tvā hotā, prāṇenodgātrā, cakṣuṣā'dhvaryuṇā, manasā brahmaṇā, śrotreṇa- mīdhā, etastvā pañcabhirdevairṛtvigbhirhuradāmi' iti |
ayaṃ mantraḥ darśapūrṇamāsārthe vaheruddharaṇe na paṭhitavyaḥ |
vi. 1|4|9, agnihotre udayakāle astamayakāle vā āhavanīyagārhapatyarūpāmidravaṇāśe eva punarādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ, na tu ekanāśe'pi |
6|4|8, agnihotre gārhapatye śrapaṇaṃ vihitaṃ, māsāgnihotre ca prājahite śrapaṇam |

jīrṇasyāpi sahāyopādānena anuṣṭhānaṃ śakyasa jīvanāvadhiḥ kālaḥ; asahāyasya jarā avadhiḥ, pravinnriprajoḥ triṃśadvarṣaparimitaḥ iti jīvanādikālānāṃ vyavasthitavikalpavat atyantaviraktasya śīghraṃ pravinnriprajoḥ māso'pi vā vyavasthitaviṣayatayā vidhātuṃ śakyaḥ |
su. pṛ. 190. agnihotrādinityakarmaṇi śrutadvayāpacāre pratinidhinā samāpanīyatā |
vā. 2|6|1244 pṛ. 616. agnihotrā- diyāvajjīvakarmāṇāṃ svasvakāle anuṣṭhānaṃ na sāta- tyena |
bhā. 6|3|24-27. agnihotrādividhayaḥ traivarṇikepu vidvatsu labdheṣu caturvarṇasya vidyā nākṣipanti |
śā. tarkapāde pṛ. 6. dīkṣitasya anyatra gamane prasakte agnihotrā- bhāve'pi samāropyaiva agnihotravyaḥ |
saṃkalpaḥ. 3|131. agnihotrārtha udvṛtasyaivāgneḥ uḍāne jyotiṣmatīṣṭiḥ prāyaścittaṃ, na tu darśapūrṇeṣṭyutpattiḥ |
vā. 2|1|126 pṛ. 650. agnihotreṣṭisomayāgānāṃ apṛtharthatvāt ūhavicāraḥ kartavyaḥ |
( 7|3|11-14 ) dvādaśāhe prathamasyāhaḥ prāyaṇīyaṃ iti nāma tathā gavāmayane'pi |
tatra agnihotranāmanyāyena atideśaḥ iti cet maivam |
ihedānīṃ saṃdihyate, kiṃ sātatyena hotavyaṃ uta asatyatveneti |
kiṃ prāptam ? puruṣaṃ prati upadiṣṭatvāt sātatyena |
‘pradoṣamagnihotraṃ hotavyaṃ’ ‘vyuṣṭāyāṃ prātaḥ’ iti śrūyate ‘paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta’ ‘amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyā yajeta’ iti |
bhāṣyaṃ—na caitadasti, yajjuhūmarthāvirudveṣu kāleṣu satataṃ hotavyamiti |
kāla epa śrūyate ‘pradoṣamagni- hotraṃ hotavyaṃ’ ‘vyuṣṭāyāṃ prātaḥ’ iti |
āha, nanu viguṇasyāpi prayogaśca kāla ādaraṇīya iti |
bhāṣyaṃ—liṅgaṃ ca bhavati, ‘apa vā eṣa svargā- llokāccyavate yo darśapūrṇamāsāyājī san paurṇamāsīmmā- vāsyāyāṃ vātipātayet’ iti |
yadi sarvasmin kāle homastadā kasyātipatteḥ syāt ? tasmādapi na satatam- bhyāsaḥ |
tatra saṃśayaḥ: kiṃ sātatyenānuṣṭhānaṃ uta sāyaṃprātaragnihotraṃ, paurṇamāsyāmāvāsya- yośca darśapūrṇamāsau iti |
tatra jīvane nimitte karmavidhā- nāt, naimittike ca asaṃbhavāttyāgasye'pi avaigu- ṇyāt, kālasya nāṅgatvat, tallopena saṃtatānuṣṭhānaṃ nyāyyam |
eṣā hi tatra vacanavyaktiḥ, asmin kāle prāte karma kartavyamiti |
tataśca arthāttatkāla- meva jīvanaṃ nimittaṃ bhavati iti na kālāntare anuṣṭhāna- miti |
tayorapi adhya- yanādhānavidhisiddhayoḥ svīkāraṇāt, prayogavidhinā ana- nuṣṭhāpyatvāt |
eṣā vacanavyaktiḥ, agnimān vidvānna adhikriyeta iti |
pratyakṣameva ca vidhāvataḥ adhikāra- śravaṇaṃ ‘ya evaṃ vidvānagnihotraṃ’ ityevaṃ sarvatra śravaṇāt |
tasmāt tatkāle prāpte viduṣaḥ agnistva aṅgantarāṇi yathāsaṃbhavaṃ upasaṃhṛtya anuṣṭhānam |
soma — smṛtibalāt upanītādhikāritvavat yāva- jjīvaśruteḥ saṃtatānuṣṭhānaṃ iti pratyavasthānaṃ saṃgatiḥ |
na prayoga- vidhividheyatāmātreṇa yathāśaktyapanyaḥ; kiṃtu prayoga- vidhinā yat kartavyatā bodhyate tatraiva |
kartavyaṃ hi yathāśakti kuryāt iti vaktuṃ śakyate, nārkatavyam |
tataśca prayogavidhinā yat puruṣakartavyatā bodhyate, tadaiva yathāśaktyapanyāt kālasya cātathātvāt na tatra yathā- śaktyapanyaḥ |
nāyama- bhyāsaḥ akarmaśeṣatvāt, kiṃtu niyamaḥ puruṣārthaḥ |

’ bhāṭṭa— jīvanādinimittakāgnihotrādau nimittasya pratikṣaṇaṃ bhedāt pratinimittaṃ naimittikādṛṣṭyā saṃtatānu- ṣṭhānapratīteḥ, tadanurodhena ca aśakyātyāgasya vakṣyamāṇa- tvāt, kālasyāpi cāṅgatvena tyāgopapatteḥ, kāmyaviṣayatvena tasya sārthakyācca, sātatyānuṣṭhānam |
ata eva some vasa- ntasya nimittatvāt tatra ekaikasmin sakalakaraṇapratīteḥ amāvāsyādikālānugrahe'pi na kṣatiḥ |
iti prāpte, āhāravihārādyanuparodhena nimittaśruteḥ avaśyaṃ saṃkocanīya- tvāt agnividyābhyāmivā kālenapi sā saṃkocyate |
nahi kālasyāṅgatve'pi yathāśaktyupapannaviṣayatvaṃ, yasyaiva hi prayogavidhiviṣayeṇa śaktau anuṣṭhānaprasaktiḥ, tasyaiva aśaktau nimittaśrutyanurodhena tyāgaḥ |
tataśca yathaiva agnihotrayoḥ vidhvantaraprayuktyapajīvitvena prayoga- viṣayaprayogyatvāt na tat, tathā kālasyāpi svarūpeṇa anuṣṭheyasya prayogavidhiviprojyatvāt yathāśaktyapanyavipa- yatvāt |
ata eva ‘yo darśapūrṇamāsāyājī san amāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ vā'tipātayet’ iti kāle naimittikātikrame eva prāyaścittam |

nyāyavinduḥ— ‘yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhoti’ ityā- dijīvananimittakaṃ sāyaṃprātarguṇamāsādikālaṃ vinā'pi kāryaṃ, naimittike aśakyātyāge avaiguṇyāt, ataḥ saṃtatānuṣṭhānaṃ, iti prāpte, aṅgakālasya kṛtyasādhyatvena yathāśaktyanyāyaviṣayatvāt tatkālameva jīvanaṃ nimittaṃ bhavati, iti na saṃtatānuṣṭhānaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
na ca kālavidhau sati nāmadheyatvaṃ nāmadheye ca sati tadanuvādena kālavidhiḥ iti itaretarāśrayāpattiḥ |
( paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā ityādī ) agnihotranyāyena pūrvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyena nāmadheyatve avadhārite paścāt tadanusāravihitakālayogena pravṛttinimittatvāvadhāraṇapyate |
śrute vaṣaṭkāraśabdaḥ rājasūyate vaiśvade trikapāle agni- hotraśabdavat navakapāladharmātidiśati iti pūrva- pakṣaḥ |
‘pṛṣṭhepati- ṣṭe’ iti pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ agnicayanoṣṭhānakarmaṇi prayujya- mānaḥ : agnihotraśabdanyāyena pṛṣṭhastotradharmāṃ upasthāne atidiśati |
— ‘agnihotrahavaṇī ca śūrpaṃ ca’ iti yajñāyudhaviśeṣa: nirvā- pasādhanaṃ kāṣṭhapātram |
yathā pava- māneṣu agnihotrahavaṇī nirvāpeṇa bādhyate |
bāla. pṛ. 132. a yathā agnihotraṃ hutaṃ sā agnihotrahavaṇī |
śā. 10|2|17. a agnihotrahavaṇyā havīṃṣi nirvapati ’ 10|2|163. a ‘agnihotrahavaṇyā havīṃṣi nirvapati’ darśādau |
a agnihotrahoma: sāyaṃstana: paśuyāgādine'pi nauttaravedike, daivāt paśukarmaṇa: utkarṣe tu auttara- vedike, eva ||
nāsau yajamānasya, na vādhvaryuḥ kartā ( vidhīyate ), sarvasya codakena prāptatvāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? dīkṣākramo'niyamana prāptaḥ san niyampate |
' apūrvaprayuktatve tu tadīyaviśeṣe vidhīyamānā anya- sminnapi tadviśeṣepāpadye bhaviṣyanti |
tasmāt dvayorapi bhāgyamānena saṃnnvayaḥ ākāṅkṣitatvāt, bhāvyaṃ cāpūrvam |
na cāga iti kartavyatā vinā na sidhyati, nisāṃtopāyatvāt ( yāgasya loke |
tadīyeṣu dravyeṣu yajato yaḥ saṃskāraḥ, so'pūrva- prayuktaḥ |
tadarthāste iti kṛtvā kriyante, na yajyarthena teṣāmamisaṃcandhaḥ |
yaduktaṃ, apūrvasya prayojakatvaṃ nimittabhāvaśca nopapadyate, vacanavyaktibhedāditi |
prayojakatvaṃ vācanikaṃ, nimittabhāvaśca naiva vacanā- dravyasthitī |
yadi yena prayujyate, bhavati tasya nimi- ttam |
yathā, ārāmapoṣakasya ārāmo vetanadāne prayojako nimittaṃ ca |
nahi āgneyatvāvacchinnaṃ prati prokṣaṇādyati kā citsāmagrī klṛptā'sti, yena tajjanyatvakau āgneya- tvāmiṣyatirbhavet |
prokṣaṇādeva tu vidhānabalena tatsābhagrītvāt, tadyatirekena tadupapattau pramāṇābhāvena, na yāgasvarūpārthatve ānarthakyaṃ prokṣaṇādīnām |

ata evārādupakārakāṇāmapi yāgasvarūpārthatvenānarthakyaṃ, iti prāpte, yadyapi vijātīyayāgasādhanatve'pyeva prokṣaṇādīnāmuddeśyatā'vacchedakaṃ, tathāpi apūrvasādhanatve iva vakṣyamāṇarītyā na tatra vrīhitvādiṃ praviṣṭhamiti śyāmāke'pi tatsādhyasiddhiranivāryaiva |

vastutastu, na vijātīyayāgasādhanatvaṃ uddeśyatā'vacchedakaṃ, vijātī- yayāgasyaināmapi vyāpakībhūtayāgatvāvacchinnasyetyanta- rgatatvāt tadvacchinnaṃ prati dravyatvāvacchinnasya lokata eva kāraṇatvāvagateḥ, sāmagrīvaśeṇa vrīhādiṣvapi vinā'pi dravyantareṇa kadā cit vijātīyayāgasyaināmaḥpattau bādhakābhāvena ānarthakyasya tadavasthatvāt |
na ca sāmānyasāmanyā viśeṣakāraṇasamavetitāyā eva kāryajanakatvaniyamaḥ, anyatra tathā'pi prakṛte tathākalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt, 'tadeva yādṛk tādṛk ca hotavyam' iti liṅganupapatteśca |
ata eva anyaiva rītyā pakṣaprāptimupapāya phalto niyamavidhivaṃ vrīhādividhī- nāmupapāyate, pratinidhiṣva |
vyāpakībhūtāpūrvatvāva- cchinnaṃ prati dravyatvādanā kāraṇatvasya lokataḥ akalpatvena niruktapratiyanāpatteḥ |
ārādupakārakāṇāmapyaiva rītyā apūrvajananatānukūlayogyatāsaṃpādakatvaṃ dravyaṃ, na tu yāgārthatvaṃ, ānarthakyapatteḥ |

yattu vrīhitvāvacchinnenaiva prokṣaṇādividhiḥ śābdabodhe lakṣaṇayā anaṅgīkārāt, paścāt nipādasthapati- nyāyena (6|1|13) prokṣaṇādiviśiṣṭavrīhīṇāṃ yāgāntar- kalpanayā apūrvārthatvakalpanāmityuktaṃ, tat prokṣaṇādesta- nyādaṣṭasya vā vrīhitvāvacchinnabhāvyatve ayogyatāniṣka- yasya pratibandhakatvāt śābdabodhasyaivānupapatterlakṣaṇayāṅgīkara- ṇāt pratyuktam |
ato vrīhādipadairevasādhanatvāvacchinna- lakṣaṇāt taduddeśyenaiva prokṣaṇādividhiriti te apūrva- prayuktā eveti siddhaḥ śyāmākādau ūhaḥ |
na caivamapi dharmāṅgatāne vrīhādīnāmi nāmapi anuprapattayā nimittatvāt vikṛtau tadabhāve bhedābhāve iva dharmalopāpattiḥ |
vastutastu, phalecchāyā anuṣṭhāpakatve'pi phalasyā- siddhasyānuṣṭhāpakatve pramāṇābhāvāt phalībhūtapūrvamapi na nimittam |
anaiva ca diśā yāgatvasyārādupakāraka- sthale nimittatvaṃ pratyuktam |
yāni cātra mūle anekāni varṇakāni kṛtāni, tāni punaruktatvādinuptatvāccopekṣitāni |

nyāyabinduḥ - avaghātādīnāṃ vrīhādidvārā apūrvārtha- tvāt dvārābhāvena nīvārādipu nohaḥ, iti prāpte, apūrva- sādhanatvena vrīhādīnāṃ dvāratvātpūrvasādhanatvasya ca vikṛtau nīvārādiṣvapi satvāt tadvārā prāptitvadapūrvopakārakatva- syātideśāvagatatvādbahasiddhiḥ |
evaṃ 'prokṣitābhyāmul- khalamusalamyāmahavanti' iti prokṣaṇasya navanirbhincarau nakhegrahaḥ |
evaṃ 'agniṃ suvaḥ' ityādisvargaprakādakamantra- syānvayatvāt vikṛtau ūha iti siddhāntaḥ |
ekanaiva īdṛśe guṇe śrūyamāṇe vidhiśśaktiḥ saṃkrā-
bā. 2|1|6|17 pṛ. 5.10. satyāṃ gatau ekaiva vidhiśaktyupagamasya nyāyatvāt guṇe vidhiśaktiḥ saṃkrāmati iti agnihotrādhikaraṇe abhihitamityarthaḥ |
agnihotrābhāve'pi dīkṣitasya anyatra gamane prasakte samāropya agnirnatavyaḥ |
dīkṣānirmokāt pūrvaṃ prayāṇaprasaktau agnīnāṃ pātrāntare sthāpanana saha nayanaṃ sādhya samāropaḥ |
'prātaragnihotraṃ hutvā samāropayet' iti vidhinā samāropasya sautrāma- ṇyāmnyāyena (4|1|12) agnihotrāṅgatvāt |
dīkṣitasya cāgnihotrābhāvena tadyogāt, iti prāpte, samāropasyā- gninayanāpāyatvena ānantaryāmātreṇa vāstausthatīyahomasya agnihotrāṅgatve pramāṇābhāvācca agnihotrābhāve'pi samāropyaivāgnineyaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ - asyāgnihotre uddharaṇamantraḥ 'vācā tvā hotrā, prāṇenodgātrā' ityevamādiḥ |
tatrāyamarthaḥ sāṃśa- yikaḥ, yat darśapūrṇamāsārthoddharaṇaṃ kriyate, kiṃ tatraiva mantraḥ kartavyo neti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? darśapūrṇamāsārthamapi uddhṛte'gnau agnihotraṃ hūyate eva |
tatra cenmantro na kriyate, amantroddhṛte agnihotraṃ pravartate |
parārthamyuddhṛte- 'gnau yasyāgnihotraṃ pravartate - codaneti karma brūmaḥ - na tatra mantraḥ kartavyaḥ iti |
ucyate, nanuktaṃ vigu- ṇamuddharaṇaṃ agnihotrasya bhaviṣyati, na guṇābhāve pradhānā- bhāve'pīti |
na guṇaḥ kālaḥ, nimitta- mattau bhavatītyetaduktam |
ato nimittābhāve kriyamāṇaṃ aśrutaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati |
na ceduddharaṇamagnihotrasya, tasmādya mantro na kartavyaḥ |
śā - darśapaurṇakrame agnyuddharaṇe kriyamāṇe kiṃ agni- hotrāṅgabhūtaḥ uddharaṇamantraḥ 'vācā tvā hotā' ityādiḥ prayoktavyo neti saṃśayaḥ |
' tena agnihotrāṅgabhūte'pyuddharaṇe tadupakārakatvamātreṇa yāgārthoddharaṇaviṣayatoḥ praṇītādharmī iva kartavya eva mantraḥ kālamānāya |

iti pakṣāntara- māha - ) athavā uddharaṇamapyetat agnihotrasyāṅgaṃ akāle'pi kriyamāṇaṃ, anyathā agnihotrasya praṇayanalo- pāt vaiguṇyaṃ syāt, iti prāpte'bhidhīyate, 'kāle tvalvanupādeye prāpte karma vidhīyate |
sāṅgaṃ, tasmāt kālāt prāk nādhikāro'sti karmaṇi |
tasmānnāprāpte kāle agni- hotrāṅgamuddharaṇaṃ tanmantro vā kartavyaḥ |
soma - anyārthoddhṛte'gnihotrādau prāyaścittābhāve'pi anyārthoddharaṇe mantraḥ syāt ityucyate : (pratyudāharaṇa - ) saṃgatiḥ |
tataśca kāle prāpte tatsaṃyoginaṃ puruṣamadhikṛtya karma codyate |

karmanodanayā cājñāni prayujyante, iti kālāt prāgādhikārābhāvāt anadhikā- riṇā kriyamāṇamanarthakaṃ, iti aprāpte kāle kriyamāṇasyā- jñātvābhāvāt uddharaṇasya aṅgatvābhāvāya mantrāpyanupādako dvitīyapakṣaprakāro'nupapannaḥ |
tathā ca aṅgābhāvena upakārakamātreṇa sādhananiveśī mantraḥ prāpyate, iti prathamapakṣo'pi anupapannaḥ |
kālabhāve ca uddharaṇe iva tadaṅgabhūtantre'pi adhikārābhāvāt adhikāriṇaṃ prati aṅgabhūtamananuṣṭhā-
anupādeyatvena kālalāgāyogāt akālakṛtasya niṣphala- katvātsaṃbhavena akāle mantrayogāprasakteḥ |
tvāt nāyihotrāṅgamaddharaṇaṃ tanmantro vā iti siddhāntaḥ |
' trasya codanā, tatra mantro na syāt, aprāptakālatvāditi |

ataḥ puroḍāśo'pi tatraiva śrapayitavyaḥ paśutantropajīvita- tvāt ', iti śaṅkāyā, paśuśrapaṇena puroḍāśasyopakārā- labhāt pṛthak śrapaṇe kāryaṃ, gārhapatye eva tat kāryaṃ, anyathā vaiguṇyāt iti siddhāntaḥ |
' śaṃkara—' śāmitro na puroḍāśe ' agnīṣomīyapaśupuroḍāśaviṣṭakṛt ttayāge nigameṣu ca sviṣṭakṛdalopaḥ |
tatra śrūyate ' agnīṣomīyasya paśau pracaraye agnīṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśa- manu nirvapati ' iti |
tatra sviṣṭakṛt guṇalopaḥ śrūyate ' agne yajati ' |
tadatra saṃśayaḥ; kiṃ yāge eva sviṣṭa- kṛtaḥ guṇalopaḥ avaśiṣṭeṣu nigameṣu yathāprakṛtibhāvaḥ, uta sarvatra guṇalopa iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? sviṣṭakṛto'gneḥ saguṇasya guṇalope śrūyamāṇe brūmaḥ |
yāge guṇalope ucyamāne yadi sarvanigameṣu guṇalope'vyava- sīyate, aśrutaṃ kalpyeta |
tasmāt yāge eva lopaḥ syāt, na sarveṣu nigameṣviti |
bhāṣyaṃ— sarvasya vā nigamasyāpi sviṣṭakṛto'gni- śabdasya guṇe lumyeta |
naiva sviṣṭa- kṛdāge eva guṇe lumyeta |
tatra coda- kaprāptasya sviṣṭakṛto guṇalopaḥ śrutaḥ ' agne yajati ' iti |
kimayaṃ pradhānamātre guṇalopaḥ : uta sarveṣu nigame- ṣviti |
pradhānamātre yajatīti lopaśravaṇāt avaśiṣṭeṣu nigameṣu prakṛtivat sviṣṭakṛdaguṇayuktamabhidhānaṃ, ( iti prāpte, ) prayoge eva nirguṇavidhiḥ iti sarvatra guṇalopaḥ |
soma— pūrvatra sviṣṭakṛcchabdatve'pi iha asaviṣṭa- kṛcchabdakaṃ nigameṣvabhidhānaṃ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |

na ca ' tathottarasyāṃ tatau0 ' ( 104|9|125 ) ityatra vaikṛtasyādi śabdasya prayogānyamukhena sarvanigameṣu vakt- vyasyoktvāt ihāpi prayogārthasya tat eva siddhatvāt kathaṃ pradhānamātrārthatvādāśaṅkā iti vācyam |
bhāvanān- yato hi prayogānyatvastokataḥ; iha ca bhāvanānyatva- kāre bhāvanedeśanāvidhiḥ dhātoḥ atyantatātparyaprasa- ṅgāt dhātvarthānupāye evābhividhivattvatyaḥ |
dhātvartharūpānvaye sati ānarthakyāt pārā- rthyamapi aṅgīkṛtya bhāvanānuṣṭhidveya vidhānaṃ svīkṛtavyaṃ ityādyanena siddhāntaḥ |
sūtrārthastu-prakṛtau saguṇasya vikṛtau guṇalope nigameṣu madhye yāvaduktaṃ yatraiva pradhāne
guṇalopaḥ tatraiva syāt, na tu sarveṣu iti ( pūrvapakṣaḥ ) |
vi— ' sviṣṭakṛdguṇo lopyo yāga evākhileṣu vā |
' yajati- śabdasya prayogavacanatvāt akhileṣu nigamaprayogeṣu alau lopyaḥ |
bhāṭṭa— daikṣe paśupuroḍāśāvāntaraprakaraṇe ' agniṃ yajati ' iti śrutam |
tatra bhedapramāṇābhāve yāgānu- vādena devatāmātravidhī āvaśyaka, na tāvat prākṛta- tadaṅgatāmātroddeśena vidhānaṃ, āgneyājyābhāge tasyā- prāptatvāt saumye tasyāḥ vidhau apūrvavidhivāpateḥ |

so'pi ca devatāyāḥ dravyavata utpannayitvāt yadyapi yāge eva, na tu niga- meṣvapi, teṣu tasya saṃskāryatayā guṇatvena vidhyayogāt, tathāpi yāge eva vihitāyāstasyāḥ prākṛtakāryapannatā vikṛtavāpi sarvatatvāt nirguṇasyaivārmebhidhānam |
yadyapi ca prakṛtau āvāhanādinigameṣu nirguṇasyaivārmebhidhānaṃ tathāpi ādhvaryaveṣu haitraiṣyāpi ca yājyāyā adyau saguṇa- syaivārmidhānāt, iha tu tatrāpi nirguṇasyaivārmidhānam |
siddha eva cāyamarthaḥ śiṣyahitārthe ukta iti vedita- vyam |
nyāyabinduḥ—paśupuroḍāśe sviṣṭakṛdguṇalopaḥ śrutaḥ ' agniṃ yajati ' iti |
tatra yāgamātre tallopaḥ; na tu nigameṣu, iti prāpte, prayoge eva nirguṇavidhiḥ: sarvatra guṇalopaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
deśasaṃbaddhamupāṃśutvaṃ teṣāṃ syācchutinirdeśāt tasya ca tatra bhāvāt |
bhāṣyaṃ— jyotiṣṭome samāmnāyate ' tsarā vā eṣā yajñasya, tasmāt yatkiṃcit prācīnamagnīṣomīyāt tenopāṃśu caranti ' iti |
tadatra etadarthaḥ : saṃśāyikaḥ; kiṃ prāga- gnīṣomīyāt yāni karmāṇi tatyuktamupāṃśutvaṃ, uta paramā- pūrvaprayuktamiti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? prāgagnīṣomīyāt yāni aṅgā- pūrvāṇi ārādupakārakāṇi, yacca pradhānadravyasaṃskārakaṃ, tatpa- yukko'yaṃ dharmaḥ; yo'yaṃ deśasaṃbaddhaḥ |
maryādā deśalakṣitayā ye padārthāḥ, te śrutyā etena dharmeṇa saṃbaddhāḥ |
( ye etasmin deśe padārthāḥ, tairupāṃśu carantīti |
nanu vākyenaiva dharmo viniyuktaḥ, na śrutyā |
kiṃ tarhi ? śrutena alpaikavākyatā, na prakṛtena lakṣitena kalpitena tadaṅgatāmātroddeśena vidhānaṃ, na prakṛtena lakṣitena kalpitena veti |
yallima etadaṅgāpūrvāṇāmayaṃ dharmaḥ iti, na tu pradhānadravyasya saṃskārakaṃ yadapūrva, tasyāpīti |
katamaṃ tat ? yat pradhānadravyasaṃskārakaṃ pūrvasmin deśe'- stīti |
tasya etaṃjā- tīyakasya pūrvasmin deśe bhāvāt |
asti hi somaprava- haṇīye nāma sūktaṃ ( bhadradami0 iti aitrā. 3|21-26 ) |
yathā ' praṇeṣyan vācaṃ yacchati, tāṃ sahaviṣkṛtā visṛjati ' iti |
asmin deśe ye padārthāḥ teṣāṃ dharmo vāyamaḥ; na pravā- nāpūrvasya |

samudāyaprasaṅgena anyo yaḥ samudāya iva lakṣyate grahayajñabhyāsasamudāyaḥ : iti, tatra vicāryate, kiṃ tatprayuktaṃ ( jyotiṣṭomāpūrvaprayuktaṃ ) upāṃśutvaṃ, uta tatpadārthaprayuktaṃ ( agnīṣomīyāgniprāptādarthejanyopatya- pūrvaprayuktaṃ ) iti |
athavā saṃskāroho vicāryate prakṛtau vikṛtau nirṇayāya ( iti saṃgatiḥ |
tatra yadi somayāgena saṃbandhaḥ kriyate, prakaraṇāgnānānumitena saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
yadi agnīṣomīyena saṃbadhyate, śrutena saṃbadhyamānaḥ : agnīṣomī- yāt ye karmāṇi prāgabhāvināḥ padārthāḥ, taiḥ sarvairgrahyamāṇaviśeṣa- tvāt saṃbadhyate |
' tasya ca tatra bhāvāt ' iti sūtrā- vayavena apūrvavatto ye padārthāḥ iti bravīti |
teṣu yo dharmo vidhīyate nāsau anarthakaḥ |
athavā padārthapūrveṇa saṃbadhya- māno lakṣaṇayā, paramāpūrvaveṇa tu lakṣitalakṣaṇayā saṃvadhyate|
prathamaṃ padārthai: (svāpūrvāṇi lakṣaṇīyāni) tai: (lakṣitai: svāpūrva:) apūrvāṇi, tai: paramāpūrvamiti|
athavā agniṣomīya: padārthai:, sa ca uccarita: prāgbhāvina: padā- rthān buddhau upasthāpayati, na yajñabhāgam|
'tsarā vā eṣā yajñasya yat prācīnamagnīṣomīyāt' iti|
tasmāt dīkṣa- ṇīyādiṣu pradhāneṣu vikalpaḥ prāpnoti |
' uccaiḥ pravaryyeṇa ' iti karaṇavibhaktinirdeśa- dāt sāṅgatyam ubhayatram |
yadetat prayojanaṃ varṇitaṃ, deśaprayuktatve asyopāṃśu- tvasya māsāgnihotrādiṣu prāsiriti |
teṣāṃ nāmnā anyaḥ svaraḥ prāpnoti, codakenopāṃśutvam |
' purastādupasadāṃ saumyena pracaranti, antarā tvāpreṇa, upa- riṣṭād vaiṣṇavena ' iti |

śā— kimidamupāṃśutvaṃ somayāgasya yaḥ prāgbhāgaḥ taddharmaḥ san parampūrvaprayuktaṃ, tattha vikṛtiṣu tadgāgāra- mbhake aprākṛte'pi padārthe uhitavyaṃ, uta agnīṣomī- yāt padyoḥ ye prācīnāḥ padārthāḥ dīkṣaṇīyādayaḥ, teṣāṃ dharmaḥ tadavāntarapūrvaprayuktaṃ, tattha aprākṛte padārthe yūpā- vatsvaranardhāhitatvaṃ nohitavyaṃ iti saṃśayaḥ |
agnīṣo- mīyāt prācīnānāmajñānāṃ upāṃśutvaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
soma-- saṃnipātināṃ apūrvaprayuktatve vyavasthāpite tadyasaṅgāt saṃnipātiviśeṣe avāntarapūrvalakṣaṇā- pūrvaviśeṣaprayuktatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate iti saṃgatiḥ |
ayamarthaḥ, prācīnā- śabdaḥ sākāṅkṣatvāt avayavārtha nirākāṅkṣīkartavyaḥ |
tatra yajñaśabdena nirākāṅkṣīkaraṇaṃ na saṃbhavati, tsarā- śabdasaṃnihitatvāt |

tataśca agnīṣomīyasya anvayatvena prācīnaśabdasya avayavalakṣaṇabhāgaparatvāt bhāga- vartitapadārthaparatvābhāvāt taddharmaṃ upāṃśutvaṃ tadapūrva- prayuktaṃ tasyāpūrvasya teṣu bhāgasaṃnidhipadārtheṣu bhāvāt iti |
bhāṭṭa— some ' tsarā vā eṣā yajñasya tasmāt yatkiñcitprācīnamagnīṣomīyāt tenopāṃśu caranti ' iti śrutam |

tatra upāṃśutvaṃ kiṃ jyotiṣṭomasaṃjanyagnīṣomīya- prāgbhāgadharmaḥ san tadīyaparamāpūrvaprayuktaṃ, uta agnīṣomīya- prāgbhāgavartitatpadārthadharmaḥ san tattajjanyāvāntarapūrva- prayukta iti cintāyāṃ, vidheye upāṃśutve uddeśe'samarpaka- tvāttat tacchabdaḥ ityavivādam |

sa ca pūrvaprakrāntāgnīṣo- mīyaprāgbhāgameva parāmṛśati, na tu padārthān, prācīna- śabdasya ākṛtyādhikaraṇanyāyena (1|3|9) prāgbhāga- mātravācitvāt, ekavacanaprayogeṇa bhāgasyaiva taduktasya tacchabdena parāmarśaḥ |
ata eva ekenaiva tacchabdena uddeśyasamarpaṇāt pūrvapakṣe siddhānte vā agnīṣomīyādervi- śeṣaṇatve'pi na viśiṣṭadeśaḥ |
tatra ca bhāgaṃ prati agnīṣomīyaḥ avadhitvena viśeṣaṇaṃ, yajñaśca prayogadvārā saṃvandhitvena |
ata eva yajñapadaṃ na tsarāśabdaviśeṣaṇaṃ, aprasaktiviśeṣopakaralāpate |
astu vā tasmātpadena vyava- dhānāt yajñasya chadgātiḥ ityevamarthāṅgīkāreṇa tsarā- śabdasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ yajñaśabdaḥ |
tatra ca padārthānāṃ- manukteḥ lāghavācca agnīṣomīyāvadhikayajñaprāgbhāgameva uddeśyatā'vacchedakaṃ, tadavacchinnadeśena upāṃśutvavidhiḥ |
bhāge ca upāṃśutvasya sākṣāt asaṃbandhāt, tadārambhaka- padārthānmantrāṇāṃ dvāratvaṃ yogyatāvallatvam |

uddeśyasya ca bhāgasya svarūpe ānarthakye prasakte, bhāgajanyapūrvasadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt dīkṣaṇīyāṅganiyamānyāsaṃbhavena (1|1|2 varṇake 2) bhāgasaṃnvayajanyaparamapūrvasādhanatvameva bhāga- nirdeśaṃ lakṣyate iti bhāgapūrvaprayuktatvaṃ tadapūrvaprayuktatvaṃ niściṃta lakṣyate iti bhāgapūrvaprayuktatvaṃ tadapūrvaprayuktatva
atideśakalpanena prakṛtirāhityarūpāpūrvatvasya avaśye siddhānte'pi iyamāṇatvāt, nodāharaṇaṃ prakṛtādhikaraṇasya |
śiṣṭāṇāṃ ca (agniṣomīyādīnāṃ prākṛtena) vidhyantena (vākyaśeṣatayā kalpitena) dharmāḥ prāpnuvanti |
yat prākṛtamaṅgaṃ vikṛtau śrūyate, tadeva vikṛtiḥ nirākāṅkṣatvāt svīkaroti |
adhi- kānāmupattiḥ (sa sūtre) iti, prākṛtānāṃ nivṛttiḥ itya- bhiprāyaḥ pakṣontyaḥ |
ka upa- rodhaḥ ? prakṛtitvat iti kalpanā |
sa codakaśabdo na dūre satīmāṃ anekavākyavahitāṃ prakṛtiṃ ape
' soma— pūrvatra pādadvaye bādhaḥ prādhānyena vyutpāditaḥ |
iha tu vikṛtau śrutena prākṛtatvāt prādhānyena vyutpāyate iti pādāntaratvaṃ ānantaryaṃ cetyāhaḥ |
yat aprākṛtaguṇayuktaṃ prākṛtaṃ śrūyate tadevodāharaṇaṃ, na tu prābhākararītyā aupadeśikātsvat vaikṛtamātram |

prathama- sūtrārthastu—vikṛtau pradhānamātrasya śabdavatvāt śravaṇāt guṇānāṃ prajādādīnāṃ adhikotyatiḥ saṃsvāntarādiva- śiṣṭatayā utpattiḥ; na kevalaguṇāvidhiḥ, saṃnidhānāt saṃnihitaistaireva vikṛtyākāṅkṣāyānteḥ nātideśaḥ iti |
agnīṣomīye paśau ātithyā 112 agnīṣomīye paśau darśiko

bhāṭṭa-tadeva barhi: ātithyopasadarthaṃ prāgvaṃśe 'ūrṇā- mṛdaṃsa tvā' iti mantreṇa vedyāmāstṛtaṃ punaragnīṣomīyārthe apareṇottaravediṃ stīryate, deśabhedena tattvasaṃskārasya tatrāsāmānādhivārādhārabhūtabarhi: saṃskārakasya vā āstaraṇasya āvṛtte: prayojanānurodhena āvaśyakatvāt |
ata: prākta- tasya staraṇasyāvṛttau taddbhuto mantro'pi āvarttate iti na tatra prasaṅgastantraṃ vā, ātithyākālapāṭhitamantrajanya- smṛte: agnīṣomīyakālīnastaraṇavelāyāṃ avidyamānatvāt |
nyāyavindu:--ātithyārthe prāgvaṃśe stīrṇaṃ tata ānīya apareṇottaravediṃ punaragnīṣomīyārthe barhi: stīryate |
tatra 'ūrṇāṃmṛdaṃsa tvā stuṇāmi' iti staraṇamantra: pūrvakṛta eva prasajyate barhi:sādhāraṇatvāt, iti prāpte, staragasya 'barhiṣā vediṃ stuṇāti' iti vyarthatvāt tasyāśca bhedāt mantrāvṛtti: |
barhirvaidave'pi staraṇāvṛtte: taddbhamantrāvṛtti:; anyathā tadguṇāpatte: iti siddhānta: |
maṇḍana--teṣāṃ tu mantrān ( mantraṃ ) staraṇe puna: paṭhet |
bhāṣya--paśau agnīṣomīye cintyate kiṃ darśapaurṇa- māsiko vidhvanta:, uta saumika: iti |
jñā--paśau agnīṣomīye taddhitena devatāniveśa: ālambhiśca darśapaurṇamāsāhyam |
agnīṣomīye paśau darśiko 113 agnīṣomīye paśau pratiprasthātṛ
soma--nanu yuktamiṣṭiṣu darśapaurṇamāsayo: pravṛtti- riti liṅgasadbhāvāt, paśau tu liṅgasadbhāvāt naiṣṭika- vidhvantaprāpti: |
na ca taddhitena devatāniveśa iṣṭiliṅgaṃ, upāṃśuyāje atastattvasya iṣṭiliṅgatvāyogāt |
yatrāyaṃ paśupuruṣa: krayasannidhau, na tatra dharmā āmnātā:, kiṃtu aupavasathye'hani |
tatopyau tti- kartavyatākāṅkṣāyāṃ: pradeśāntarāttamarthairdāntai:, tadarthe aiṣṭikavidhvantapravṛtti: apratyūhā |
sūtrātstha- mādhāyaṃ paśuṃ samanakti' ityādi liṅgadarśanātpohali- tāt codanāliṅgāt aiṣṭikavidhvanta: iti |
vi--' na patrāvaiṣṭika: syāt, na kapālādyabhāvata: |
' 'agnīṣomīyaṃ paśuṃ' iti dravyadevate, 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati' iti prayājavattvaṃ, 'sucyamāghārya juhvā paśumanakti' ilā- ghārāgne ālambhaśca iti liṅgāni |
tatratvaṃ tu prakṛtāthi- karaṇaviṣayakamudruhya gṛhyate'tra ) evaṃ paśāvapi agnīṣo- mīye daikṣasaṃbandhe taddhitapadavihitadevatākatvādeva ( darśa- paurṇamāsāvikāratvam ) |
na ca tatra yūpādidadhutaradharma- vidhānādeva nirākāṅkṣatvāttanatideśa: |
kiṃca krayasannidhau āmnāto nirdharmako daikṣa: prathamaṃ tāvadidaṃ kalpayatyeva |

tataśca prākṛtairdhamairnirā- kāṅkṣasya 'sa eṣa aupavasathye'hani' ityanena aupa- vasathye'hani anuṣṭhāne'vagate anuṣṭhānasādedyāt upahoma- nyāyena ( 5|2|9 ) yūpādidhame'pi nātideśakalpanā- pratibandha: |
'ekādaśa prayājān yajati' 'juhvamāghāra- māghārya paśumanakti,' ityādi liṅgaiṣvapi evamupapadyate |
bhāṣya--agnīṣomīye paśau pratiprasthātā nāma ṛtvik śrūyate |
taṃ prati saṃdeha:; kiṃ tasya śeṣabhakṣo bhavenneti |
kuta: ? vapāṃ hi śrapayan adhvaryuṃ karma karoti 'pratiprasthātā vapāṃ śrapayati' iti |
akṣo vā karmabhedāt, tasyā: sarvapradāna- svāt |
kuta: ? yasmin yāge asau adhvaryordhikāra:, tasya dravyaśeṣo nāsti |
yatra śeṣo'sti hṛdavā- diṣveṣu, na tatrāsau adhvaryordhikāra: |
codakena ca yasyāpūrvasya śeṣa: pratipādyate, tasya tatkarmakare bhakṣa: |
agnipomīye paśau pratiprasthātṛ 114 agnipomīye paśau pratiprasthātṛ
śā—nanu agneyomīye paśau hṛdayādibhyaḥ ayaṃ (prati- prasthātā) avadānaṃ kurvan bhakṣaṃ labheta 'dakṣiṇato nidhāya pratiprasthātā'vadyati' iti vacanāt |
tatrāyāmaha-) yasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ adhvaryorevāvadānaṃ tadiyamadhikaraṇam (yasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ hṛdayādiṣu pratiprasthātṛkartṛkāvadāna- vacanaṃ nāsti, tadiyamidamadhikaraṇamiti |
tataśca yasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ adhvaryoḥ avadānavacanamasti tadiya- madhikaraṇaṃ ityevaṃparaṃ bhāṣyam |
(dvitīyaṃ parihāramanyatra drakṣyati-) yattu aprākṛtamida- mavadānaṃ, aprākṛtatvaṃ ca pradānārambhatvāt ityuktaṃ (bhāṣye) tadyuktam |
yadyapi 'daivatānyavadāya na tāva- tyeva hotavyaṃ, sauviṣṭakṛtānyavadyati' iti madhye padārthā- ntaravidhānāt nāyaṃ pradānārambhaḥ, tathāpi pradānārtha- mevedabhavadānaṃ, nādṛṣṭārtham |
(pratiprasthātṛḥ avadānakartṛ- tvamastu, tathāpi nāsti prākṛtamadhvaryoḥ karoti, madhye sauviṣṭakṛtādantyavahitasyāvadānasya pradānopakramatvā- bhāvena pradānopakramaprākṛtatvādanyathāvirodhāt |
tataśca prākṛtaṃ haviḥsaṃskārakāryaṃ yadavadānaṃ tadadhvaryauṇaiva kartavyaṃ, na pratiprasthātrā; iti na tasya bhakṣaprasaktirityarthaḥ |
tṛtīya- parihārastu samādhyādinā tasyāpi śāstrīyasamarthanena tantraratne eva nirākṛtaḥ |
tantraratnaṃ cetthaṃ - 'nahi ārthikaṃ prakṛtau adhvaryorevādātvaṃ avattahomavidhinā arthādvidhīyamānasyāvadānasya pradānaikekartṛkatvāt samā- gyānācca adhvaryukartṛtvaṃ śāstrīyameva |
adhvaryvavadānapakṣe tu nāsya (pratiprasthātuḥ) bhakṣaḥ, vapāyā niḥśeṣatvāt ityetāvān adhikārārthaḥ |
soma— maitrāvaruṇat pratiprasthātṛpi kāryamayukto bhakṣaḥ ityuktānāt saṃgatiḥ |
vi—' pratiprasthātṛrāsti bhakṣo no vā, vapāmasau |
pacyato'sti, no pakā vapā sarvā hutā yataḥ ||
' bhāṭṭa— tatraiva (agnipomīye paśau) pratiprasthāturapi bhakṣo bhavenna veti saṃśaye tasyāpi kartṛtvāt kartṛsaṃskā- rārtho bhakṣo bhavet |

nahi yaddhaviḥsaṃskārakaṃ yat bhakṣaṇaṃ tat tadviryāgasaṃvedhanipadāryakartṛsaṃskārakaṃ ityatra pramāṇa- masti, prajāpateṣābhidhāraṇanyāyena (4|1|14) haviḥsaṃskārakasya sataḥ kartṛsaṃskārakatvamātrakalpanāt |

ataśca vapāśrapaṇakartṛpi pratiprasthātṛḥ hṛdayādihaviḥ- śeṣabhakṣakatve na kiṃ cit bādhakaṃ, iti prāpte, yatkici- tkartṛsaṃskārakatve atiprasaṅgāt āvaśyake viśeṣaṇe svavākye upasthitatvāt yaddhaviḥsaṃskārakaṃ yat 'bhakṣaṇaṃ tat tadviryāgasaṃvedhanipadāryakartṛsaṃskāraṃ, tadviryāgasaṃvedhandhi- kariṣyamāṇapadārthavipaye valādhānarūpaṃ vā saṃskāraṃ janayati ityeva kalpanāt, pratiprasthātṛśca vapāśrapaṇakartuḥ vapāyāṃ sarvahomena śeṣabhakṣaṇāprasakteḥ, hṛdayādigasaṃvedhandhiprākṛta- padārthakartṛtvābhāvena ca taddhaviḥśeṣabhakṣāprasakteḥ na tasya bhakṣaṇam |
ata eva hṛdayādigasaṃvedhandhiprajātānāṃ tena karaṇe'pi teṣāṃ prākṛtatvābhāvāt na tasya tadbhakṣaḥ |
nanu 'dakṣiṇato nidhāya pratiprasthātā avadyati' iti vacanāt hṛdayādyavadānasyāpi pratiprasthātṛkartṛkatvāvagateḥ taccheṣa- bhakṣaprasaktiḥ |

nahi idaṃ aprākṛtaṃ avadānāntaraṃ prākṛtava- dānānuvādena prākṛtakāryārthāvadānānuvādena vā prati- prasthātṛmātrasya prākṛtahavyutrādhena vidhānāt dakṣiṇato nidhā- nasya ca prakṛtito dakṣiṇaśroṇāprāptyaivānuvādāt |

yadyapi pārthasārathilekhanāt śāstrāntare vaikalpika adhvaryukartṛka- mapi hṛdayādyavadānaṃ bhavet tathāpi adhvaryukartṛpakṣe'pi vapāśrapaṇamātrakartṛḥ pratiprasthātṛḥ āpastambāyuktale- mādibhakṣo na virudhyate |
ato hṛdayādyavadānasya ubhayakartṛkatve'pi pratiprasthātṛḥ bhakṣopapattiḥ, iti cet satyaṃ, tathāpi prakṛtau na ānatirūpaḥ kartṛsaṃskāraḥ, tasya dakṣiṇaniyamena tathaiva siddheḥ |
na cāsau pratiprasthātṛkartṛkatve'pi hṛdayādyavadānasya bhakṣaṇottaraṃ pratiprasthātṛḥ kaścidasti |
agnipomīye paśau pratyajñaṃ 115 agnipomīye paśau pratyajñaṃ
yadi tu yājñikānāṃ tathā ācaraṇaṃ, tadā bhakṣottarakālīnaḥ prākṛtaḥ kaścit padārtho'nusṛteyaḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ - vapāśrapaṇasya adhvaryvakāryasya karaṇāt pratiprasthātṛḥ iḍābhakṣaḥ syāt, iti prāpte, yasya yaduparvakartṛtvaṃ tasya tacchepabhakṣaṇam |
tatra pratiprasthātaḥ vapāyā niḥśeṣomāt na bhakṣaprasaktiḥ |
na ca 'dakṣiṇato nidhāya pratiprasthātā'vadyati' iti vacanāt hṛdayādyavadānakāritvena tadbhakṣaḥ syāditi vācyam |
etadadhikaraṇaṃ tu yacchākhāyāṃ adhvaryoreva avadānaṃ tadiyamiti jñeyam |
tena adhvaryoreva avadānakartṛpakṣe na pratiprasthāturāḍābhakṣaḥ, iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ - asti jyotiṣṭome paśurgrīpomīyaḥ 'yo dīkṣito yadagnipomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ kṛtsnaḥ paśoraikaṃ haviḥ, uta pratyajñaṃ havirbheda iti |
samasto hi paśuḥ agnipomī prati codyate, na pṛthagjñānāṃ agnipomīyatā |

tacca darśayati 'atho khalvāhuḥ kāpeyā dakṣiṇasya pūrvaṃ padasyādeyaṃ, tatsarvasya paśoravattaṃ bhavati' iti, 'atho khalvāhurpāyanā dakṣiṇasya pūrve padasyādeyaṃ, tatsarvasya paśoravattaṃ bhavati' iti kṛtsnasya paśoravadānaṃ darśayati |
ḍup - dvitīya'dhyāye (2|1|6|17) 'hṛdayādya- ādyavadyati' ityevamādīni na yāgaṃ codayanti iti sthitam |
kiṃ hṛdayādīni havīṃṣi, uta paścākṛtitvena vyaktiḥ haviriti |
tatra pūrvapakṣaḥ, padoḥ : agnipomīyasaṃbandhaḥ śrūyate, na hṛdayādīnām |
tena madhyāt pūrvādhrdhacca avadāne prāpte hṛdayādideśā vidhīyante |
naitadasti kṛtsnaḥ paśuḥ ekaṃ haviḥ iti |
pṛthagjñānāṃ prakalpante 'hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati (atha) jihvāyā avadyati, (atha) vakṣaso'vadyati, doṣṇoravadyati, pārśvayorvadyati, gudasyāvadyati' |
tāṃ paścākṛtitamantardhāya ca na śakyate sākṣāt yāgadravyaṃ paricchettum |
tasmāt praṇāḍyā sā ākṛtirūpa- kartṛmahati iti paścākṛtikasya dravya
padārtho vidhīyate, 'jihvāyā avacāti' ityemādayaśca, tathā sati ayaśabdo'nuvādaḥ syāt |
yadā ca pūrvo- caro padārtho avagatau, tadā ānantaryam |
yadā tu tau na staḥ, kasyāntareyaṃ brūyāt |
avagatau cet, pāṭhādevā- vagataḥ kramaḥ, tatrāthaśabdo'nuvādaḥ |
na ca bhavatā padārtha- vidhānamiṣyate, yena athaśabdaḥ agraśabdaśca anuvādau syātām |
evaṃ ca yasmāt dravyādadhīyate taddha- viriti |
yathā 'aindrāyāvaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti vākyaiḥ dravyaṃ pṛthak kalpyate, tadeva mukhyaṃ haviḥ, evamihāpi |
paśunodanā- 'pi lakṣitalakṣaṇā hṛdayādīni lakṣyantī agnīṣomāmyāṃ saha saṃbadhyate |
evaṃ ca yeṣāmaṅganāmavatiḥ śrūyate, tānyeva yāgasādhanāni, nāṅgāntarāṇi |
kutaḥ ? paśa- śabdo'yaṃ hṛdayādīni vākyāni dṛṣṭvā tato lakṣaṇāyā kalpitaḥ |
anyegāmaśrūyamāṇānāṃ kaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, yena tāni haviṣṭvena lakṣayet |
' (soma- haviṣṭvaṃ devatoddeśena tyajyamānalakṣaṇaṃ yasya devatā- saṃyogaḥ tasyaiva vaktuṃ yuktaṃ, 'sā'sya devatā' iti sūktahaviporeva devatātādvidhānāt |
ata eva 'somena yajeta' iti utpattau śrutāyā api latāyā na haviṣṭvaṃ, kiṃtu 'aindrāyāvaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityādivākyeṣu devatāsaṃyogāt somasyeva śravaṇāt tasyaiva haviṣṭvam |
tathā ca devatāsaṃyogāt paśaureva devatoddeśena tyāgaḥ |
yathā 'aindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyāṃ' iti devatā- saṃyogāt kṛtsnasya payastyāgaḥ, na hyavadānamātrasya tadvat iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
' hṛdayādiṣvā hi māṃsaviśeṣavacanāḥ, na yuktaṃ yat paśupradeśalakṣaṇārthatāṃ nīyante, hṛdayādīnāmeva avadānopapatteḥ |
avadānaṃ ca prakṛtau haviḥsaṃskārārthaṃ, iti ihāpi avadānaṃ havipa eva yuktaṃ, tacca hṛdayādiṣu dṛśyate, iti hṛdayādīnāmeva haviṣṭvaṃ niśrīyate |
na ca utpattiyākyaśeṣapaśuhaviṣṭvoḥ, tasya hṛdayādi- prakṛtitvena yāgasādhanatvenāpi devatāsaṃbandhopapatteḥ |
) yadi hi praṇāḍyāṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt, tataḥ paśureva sākṣāddeyate |
asti tu pramāṇaṃ hṛdayādiṣu avadānavacanaṃ viśāsanavacanaṃ ca |
tasmāt hṛdayādīni havīṃṣi devatāyai deyāni, tebhya eva ca havadānaṃ gṛhṇīyā hūyate, tatprakṛtitva paśūḥ |
soma-- somayāgaviṣayavādyutpādanānantaraṃ tadaṅga- bhūteṣu paśvādiṣu madhyapūrvādidhāvau vicāryate iti pādāntaratvaṃ ānantaryaṃ cetyāhuḥ |
paśaurhaviṣvā- bhāvāt 'paśuhyahaṃ karomi me' iti yājñikānāṃ ūhaprakāra- śrinyaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- paśoḥ kṛtsnasya devatāsaṃ- bandhicena coditatvāt sa eva ekaṃ haviḥ, iti pūrva- pakṣaḥ |
vi- 'paśuḥ kṛtsno haviḥ kiṃvā pratyaṅgaṃ havira- nyatā |
bhāṭṭa- 'agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālameta' ityatra yadyapi utpattivākye paśaureva puroḍāśavat devatāsaṃtrandhitvena haviṣṭvapratītiḥ |

ataśca tenaiva etaddevatāprāyatopapattau ityābhāti, tathāpi 'paśuṃ viśasati, lohitaṃ nirasyati, śaktaṃ saṃpraviṣyati, vapāmuddharati, kumbhāmājñjāni pacati, hṛdayaśūlena hṛdayaṃ ( pacati )' ityādisaṃskāravākyaparyā- locanayā somasyeva sādhyavadadvārā sādhanatvaṃ ityavasīyate |
yuktaṃ ca kāṣṭhādīnāṃ jvāladvāreṇa sati tātparyagrāhakapramāṇa- paraṃparayā sādhanatvam |
nahi viśasanādau paśaurpratyakṣaṃ pratyabhijñāyate, yena tatsattve'pi tasyaiva sādhanatvaṃ kalpyeta |
ato'tra viśasanādivākyānurodhāt paśoḥ pradeyaprakṛtitvameva, na tu sākṣāddeyatvaṃ, tat svāyaya- vādīnāmeva, iti ta eva payovādhakāḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ- 'agnīṣomīyaṃ paśuṃ' ityatra taddhitana paśoreva devatānvayabodhanāt samastasya paśoḥ puroḍāśa- vat tyāgaḥ |
tasmāt paśureva haviḥ, iti prāpte, avadīyamānatvāt hṛdayādīnāmeva haviṣṭvam |
tasmāt hṛdayādīnyeva devatāyai deyāni, tebhya eva ca havadānaṃ gṛhṇīyā hūyate, tatprakṛtitva paśūḥ |
agnīṣomīye paśau 'prāptasyaiva varddhate samathaiva paśoravacāti' iti śrutaṃ prāśrānāmayaṃ vahiḥ |
saṃnihite savanīyapaśau ukthyeta uttarapadaviśeṣaṇena savanīyapaśora- vopasthiteḥ, 'yadādityāvahistadagnīṣomīyasya' iti vākya- syāvāntaraprakaraṇādalītyatvāt |

pañcāvattāvacchede jāmadagnya- prayoge asaṃbhavaniveśasya prākaraṇikasyāpi caturavattasyo- tkarṣadarśanāt, iti prāpte, uttaraśabdasyottarapadatve lakṣa- ṇāpatteḥ uttaravākye eva tasyāvadānādhāratvena viniyoga- vidhānāt bhinnakāryayorvādhyavādhakābhāvābhāvānadutkarṣaḥ |
taṃ prati saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ tasya nodaka- prāptaḥ śeṣamakṣo'sti neti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? aprākṛto'sau, na tasya bhakṣe kriyamāṇe prakṛtitvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati |
praipe hi asau adhvaryuvikāraḥ ; anuvacaneṣu hotṛḥ ; 'tasmānmai- trāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cāha' iti |
atastasya tayoḥ karmābhisaṃbandhāt arthāpatyā (saḥ) bhakṣaṃ labhate |
śā- adhvaryuhotṛsaṃskārārthatvācca maitrāvaruṇe praipakaraṇāt adhvaryukārye, anuvacanakaraṇācca hotṛkāryaṃ kurvāṇe asti bhakṣaprāptiḥ |
soma- yathā vaniṣṭhunā agnīdhaḥ iḍābhakṣavādhaḥ evaṃ maitrāvaruṇasyāpi iḍābhakṣavādhaḥ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |

[yadyapi 'vaniṣṭhunāgnīdhe' iti dvitīyāsaṃyogāt haviḥpratipatyarthaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ, tathāpi tatra adhvaryādikartṛniyamābhāvānnātra niyamāṃśe tatsaṃskārārthamapi bhavati, yathā 'prayājaśeṣeṇa harviṣyabhighārayati' ityabhighāraṇasya prayājaśeṣapratipatyartha- syāpi havirādhāratāniyamāt haviḥsaṃskārārthatvaṃ tadvat |
evaṃ ca yathā haviḥsaṃskāro mā vilopi iti saṃnihitasarva- haviḥṣu abhighāraṇaṃ, na tu ekasmin, evamihāpi kartṛsaṃ- skāro mā vilopi iti maitrāvaruṇasyāpi bhakṣaṇam |
dvitīyāyā śeṣapratipatyarthaṃ api prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇanyāyena ( 4|1|14|33-39 ) kartṛsaṃskārārthā api ityuktaṃ paṣṭhe ( 6|4|13 ) |
kartṛśca tatkāryārthapūrvasādha- natvena uddeyatā, na tu adhvaryādisvarūpeṇa |
sa hi tatkartṛkapraipatuvacanasaṃjñānāṃ 'hotā yakṣat' ityādipraipāṇāṃ prākṛtadhvaryukartṛkayajetyādipraipakāryārthatvā adhvaryukāryā- pannāt |
ājyabhāgādyanuvākyānāṃ ca hotṛkartṛkānāṃ maitrā- varuṇena pāṭhāt hotṛkāryārtho'pi |
nyāyabinduḥ- paśau maitrāvaruṇasyāpūrvatvāt neḍā- bhakṣaḥ, iti prāpte, maipātuvacanarūpadhvaryuhotṛkārya- kāritvāt kartṛsaṃskārārtho bhakṣo bhavatīti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣya— athedānīṃ maitrāvaruṇameva prati bhavati saṃdehaḥ; kiṃ dvibhāgo maitrāvaruṇaḥ, uta ekabhāga iti |
adhvaryuvikāratvāt adhvaryubhāgaṃ prāpnoti, hotṛvikāratvāt hotṛbhāgaṃ prāpnoti |
yadi hi ubhau śrūyetām, ekena bhāgena kṛte
agniṣomīye paśau yāgasamāptyuttaraṃ 120 agniṣomīye paśau vapāyāmica

māśaṅketa, tato niṣedhasyāpi ṛtumadhyasaptagamanagama- nādiprayuktayūpasparśaviṣayatvena 'nāntaṃ vadet' 'na striyamupe- yāt' ityādivat kṛtvadgalopatve : sparśasa kratuvaiguṇyā- pādakatvātsāyāt tanmāyaścittatvena ayaṃ mantravidhiḥ kratvartha eva |
evaṃ ca yūpānaikatve nyāyādeva 'etau te' ityādyuho mantrasiddhayarthaṃ punaḥ paṭhyate |

na caivamapi uhitamantrā- ṭhamātrasya prayojanālābhe'pi 'yadi dvau' ityādi viniyogapra- yojanābhāvaḥ, daikṣasaṃnidhipāṭhānāṃ trayāṇāmeṣāṃ pāṭhādhikaraṇyānaye (9|3|5|15-20) tatraiva vikalpaprasaktau utkarṣasiddhayarthatvāt |

iti prāpte, vastuto yajñasya pāpāparaparyāyadu- riṣṭajanakatvāme'pi nindārthavāde yajñaprayogajanyayūpaniṣṭa- duriṣṭasya yūpasparśakartari saṃcārasaṃkīrtanena asya niṣedhasya yajñaprayogasamāptyuttarakālīnatvamāgamāt puruṣārthatvāt |
asyāpi tadoṣanivāraṇārthasya prāyaścittasya liṅgena prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā puruṣārthatvameva |
ata eva sūtrabhāṣya- syārasyāt yūpakāryāpavargettaramevedha prāyaścittaṃ, na tu vārtikādisvārasyāt kratumadhyagatalaukikasparśa'pi iti dhyeyam |
ata eva yajñasya yūpaniṣṭojanakatvāt yajñāt pūrve kāraṇābhāvena avyavahitapāraṃparyavādābhāvāt kratu- madhyagatalaukikasparśa'pi na doṣaḥ |
ata eva 'yūpavi- tyādyupasparśane syāyāt' iti smārtamapi prāyaścittaṃ bahiḥ- ṛtuviṣayameva, niṣedhasya mūlāntarākalpanāt |
astu vā tasya sāmānyaviṣayatvāt antaḥkratugatalaukikaviṣayatva- mapi |
tadā tu ṛtvikartṛko tamitikramya pravṛttasya ālvi- jyavidhānopapatteḥ |
ata eva niṣedhavākyaprāptamantrā mantra- trayamidaṃ svatantrameva tattvatastathākalpyate tajjanyadoṣa- nirṇayārthe vidhīyate, na tu kaścit kasya ciduha iti siddham |

nyāyabinduḥ — 'yadyekaṃ yūpamupaspṛśet epa te vāyo iti brūyāt' iti yūpasparśāyaśrute laukike vaidike- cāviśeṣāt, prakaraṇadvā vaidike eva phalakalpanāla- -dhavāt, iti prāpte, sparśaniṣedhasya laukikaviṣayatvāt tadoṣaparihārāya prāyaścittamapi tatraiveti siddhāntaḥ |
' oṃ agniṣomīye paśau vapāyāmica sarveṣvaṅgeṣu pañcāvattatvam ||
bhāṣyaṃ — asti jyotiṣṭome paśuragnīṣomīyaḥ : 'yo dīkṣito yadagnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatredammā- yate 'yadyapi caturavattī yajamānaḥ pañcāvattaiva vapā kāryā' iti |
tatra eṣo'rthaḥ : sāṃśāyikaḥ kiṃ vapāyāṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ pañcāvattaṃ aṅgāpūrve caturavattaṃ nivartayati, uta neti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? iti cet saṃśayaḥ ; neti |
kutaḥ ? yasmin śrūyate pañcāvattaṃ tatraiva caturavattaṃ nivartayati, nānyatra |
yathā ṛtvantare na nivartayati, evamaprāpte'pi pañcāvattaśrutirna nivartayitumarhati |
kimatra vidhīyate tvalpakṣe, yena aṅgeṣvapi manyase ? nahi atra avadānādeśena saṃkhyā vidhīyate, kiṃtvapadeśena pañcā- vadānam |
itarathā grahasyāpi avivakṣitatvāt camaseṣvapi saṃmārgaḥ syāt |
ekā hyeṣā codanā 'yo dīkṣito yadagnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tena cet pañcāvattaṃ saṃbadhyate, tadā aṅgeṣvapi bhavitumarhati |
nanu ca vapāsaṃrvataiva caiva pañcāvattā, nāṅgānāmiti |
na cāviśeṣeṇa yā pañcāvattatā'stiḥ sā śakyā vapā-
api ca evaṃjātīyakeṣu aṅgeṣu pañcāvatte jñāte tato'parā codanā 'tāni dvardvirha- viṣyati' iti |
vapāgrahaṇaṃ tatra havirlakṣaṇārthe prāthamyāda- saraprāptaṃ śrūyate |
avattenanena nitāntena dravyamavadānasaṃ- yuktaṃ klīvaliṅgaṃ ekasaṃkhyeyāyuktaṃ cocyate |
tasya cānūdyamānasya yadi liṅgasaṃkhyāṃ vivakṣyeta, vapayā ca viśiṣyeta, vākyabhedaḥ syāt grahavidhi- karaṇanyāyena (2|1|3) |
sā ca vidhīyamānā prakaraṇāt yāgena gṛhyate |
yathā 'pañcaviṃśatireva brūyāt' iti caturviṃśatidvayāvṛttyarthaṃ, na pañcaviṃśatividhānārthe, evamihāpi caturavadānanivartakamidaṃ, na pañcāvattatā- vidhāyakam |

pañcāvattaiva vidhīyate (pañcāvattasya prāpyabhāvena anuvādāsaṃbhavāt tad-grahaṇaṃ pramādapatitaṃ syāditarathā) tasyāṃ ca vidhīya- mānāyāṃ codakaprāpto naiva bhavati ityathādikāryau labhyate, so'nuvādaḥ |
yatra tu saṃkhye prāpnutaḥ; tatra evakāraḥ anyatarat nivartayate |
' tasmāt sarvaivipayaṃ pañcatvaṃ, tacca aṅgeṣu dvavadānavacanāt upastaraṇādivṛddhyā abhighāraṇavṛddhyā vā saṃpadyate |
soma — yavānāṃ vāghe'pi hṛdayādiṣu na caturavadāna- bādhaḥ |
vapāyāmiha hiraṇyaśalkrena aṅgavadāne pañcatvaṃ iti pakṣāntaramuktaṃ tanmatraste |
(na ca vapoddeśena avadānasya saṃkhyāyā vidhāne vākyabheda- prasaktiḥ, vidhivyāpāraṃ vinaiva samāsādeva saṃkhyāvadāna- mī. ko. 16

) vastutastu nātra pañcasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭāvadānavidhirastiḥ, kiṃtu vapodeśena śabdataḥ pañcasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭāvadānavidhirevātāvi prāptāprāptavivekrena pañcasaṃkhyāmātre viceḥ paryavasānaṃ, yathā 'lohitoṣṇīṣāḥ' ityādau |
evaṃ ca tātparyagatyā avadāne saṃkhyāvidhiviṣayasāne'pi śabdataḥ tattvābhāvāt na prasarabhedapattiḥ |
uklītathā ca 'tāni dvardvirhaviṣyati' iti vākyānarthakyaprasaṅgāt, vapāgrahaṇasya pādyukahavirmātropalakṣaka- ṇārthatvāt hṛdayādiṣu pañcāvadānasiddheśca |
sūtrārthastu- yathāśruti yat pañcāvattaṃ śrūyate vapāyāṃ, tatraiva prākṛtaṃ caturavattaṃ nivartayati, nānyatra iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
' sarveṣāṃ yajamānānāṃ caturavattaiva pañcāvattatvaṃ ca gotrabhedena smṛti- kāraiḥ paṭhyate 'jāmadagnyā vatsavadā vārṣṭipeṇāśca te trayaḥ |
) bhāṭṭa — daikṣe paśau 'yadyapi caturavattī yajamānaḥ pañcāvattaiva vapā kāryā' iti śrutaṃ pañcāvadānaṃ vapāyā- meva, uta aṅgeṣvapi iti cintāyāṃ, nātra avadānānuvā- dena pañcatvavidhiḥ |
tathātve hṛdayādivākyaiḥ teṣāmevā- dānasaṃbandhena haviṣtvāt, vapāyāḥ itarāṅgatvat tadabhāvena avadānāprāpteḥ ; vapādhraṇasya anuvādāttupatteḥ |
eka- smin pade uddeśyavidheyabhāvāṅgīkāre ekaprasaratā- bhaṅgāpatteśca |
ato'tra avadānameva hṛdayādivākye iva vapodeśena haviṣtvasiddhayarthaṃ vidhīyate, pañcatvaṃ tu jāma- dagnyādīnāṃ atideśenaiva prāptatvāt pākṣikānuvādaḥ |

vastutastu ekāraśravaṇāt yadyapi 'caturavattī' ityanu- vādāt jāmadagnyājāmadagnyāsādhāraṇyena nityasiddhayarthaṃ pañcāvattasyāpi vidhirevetividhividhiraivāyaṃ, tathāpi cama- sādhikaraṇanyāyena (3|1|8|16-17) vapāyāsādhurvasādha- natvasyaiva lakṣaṇāt nāṅgeṣu pañcāvadānaprasaktiḥ |
agniṣomīye paśau vapāyāmica 122 agniṣomīye paśau vāgvisargaḥ
iti saṃkhyāviśiṣṭāvadānameva vidheyaṃ, vapāgrahaṇaṃ ca eva- syaiva vaiyarthyāpatteḥ, tatparihārāya vapāgrahaṇasyaiva ekasya |
marthavat hṛdyādivyāvartanārthaṃ, tathāpi evaṃ sati prakṛtahavirmātropalakṣaṇatvaṃ iti vācyam |
' ekādaśa vai paśoravadānāni, tāni dvirdviravadyati' iti palakṣaṇatvābhāve'pi aṅgeṣu jāmadagnyapakṣe pāśvadāna- |
vacanaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt, prakṛtita eva prāpteḥ, pañcāvattasya vapā- prasakteḥ tatsaṃpaাদকtayā prāptitvenaiva dvitvivyapatteḥ |
ataḥ aṅgeṣu hyavadānavacanatvāt upastaraṇavicchidyā abhi- pūrvapravṛttavyayīkaraṇena vā prākṛtāvadānasyaiva pañcāvatti- |
' tvārye nityatvasiddhayarthaṃ vidhiḥ, avadānāṃśe ca havi- |
na ca vaiparītyameva kiṃ na syāditi |
ṇavat) cintā, kiṃ pāṅktakarmārthaṃ haviṣkṛdāhvāne kāle saṃskārāntaranuparodhena viniyogāttarakaraṇe bādhakābhāvāt |
ayamapi adhikaraṇapradeśa ataśca vapāsaṃskārāvadānasyaiva hṛdyānudeśena vidhānāt, |
tasya ca pañcāvattaviśiṣṭatayā, hṛdyādiṣvapi nityaṃ pañcā- |
dasti haviṣkṛdāhmānaṃ, paśau api astīti kṛtvā vidhānāt avadānasya ca prakaraṇaprāptasyānuvādāt iti |
cintyate, kiṃ prathame paśukāle vāgvisargaḥ puroḍāśa- kaustubhe vistaraḥ |
prāsaṅgikatvāt paśupuroḍāśasya pāṅktenaiva nyāyabinduḥ—agniṣomīye paśau śrutaṃ ' yadyapi |
tasmāt paśu- caturavattī yajamānaḥ, pañcāvattasya vapā kāryā' iti |
vāgvyamo'yaṃ vapāyāmeva paśvāvadānaṃ na hṛdyādiṣveṣu casamādhikaraṇa- |
tasmāt vapā'pūrvamedācca, iti prāpte, avadānasya prāptatvāt tadu- |
soma—pāṅktenaiva kāryasiddhau pauroḍāśikapadārthānāṃ vivakṣitā, tena vapāgrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam |
dharmalopābhāvāt pūrvavat eva vāgvisargaḥ ; ityutthā- vattā' iti samastakapadena uddeśyavidheyabhāvaḥ ayuktaḥ, |
agniṣomīye paśau vāgvisargaḥ 123 agniṣomīye paśau saptanāmapi
oṃ agniṣomīye paśau 'sapta vṛṇīte' iti vaṣaṭ- papattiḥ |
daikṣe śrutaṃ ' daivaṃ ca mānuṣaṃ ca hotārau vṛtvā śrāvamātrāvaṃ iti yāvat |
yadidamutvidvaraṇaṃ karma- vi—' maśukāle puroḍāśakāle vā vāgvisargan, |
' sapta vṛṇīte ' iti tu ' daśa gṛhṇante ' itivadavayutya- bhāṭṭa—paśau agniṣomīye paśupuroḍāśaḥ śrutaḥ |
vādaḥ, iti prāpte, ' yadavṛtā vaṣaṭkuryurṛtvijo yajñasyā- paśau ca praṇītāpraṇayanahaviṣkṛdāhmānayorbhāve'pi tadupa- |
śīrcchedya yadyete dhṛtā vaṣaṭkurvantyeva yajamānaṃ yajña- lakṣitakālavadhikatvasya ca saṃbhavena, kathaṃ cidasaṃbhave'pi vā |
syāśīrgacchati ' iti vacanenākṛtānāṃ vaṣaṭkāranindayā vāgvyamasya prakṛtau viśiṣya tatttatpadārthadharmatvāt, katipaya- |
ata eva ' ṛtvijo taddharmāṇāṃ ca paśau sattvena taddharmatvānyopapattiḥ |
vṛṇīte ' ityuktvā ' kṛtikcchandāsyeva vṛṇīte yaddhotāraṃ asti ca pṛṣṭhyāstarādāvitra yajñogādipadārthajāta praṇī- |
' vācaṃ tada vṛṇīte ' ityantena katipāyānāmeva gaṇanaṃ ataśca tasya paśrāvapi atideśāt yukta eva taddharmā- |
saṃgacchate, vaṣaṭkartṛttvena prasaktau ' nācchāvākaṃ vṛṇīte ' gyamātideśaḥ |
tvena uddeśyatayā, yena paśau haviṣkṛdāhmānābhāvāt vāgvyamā- |
oṃ agniṣomīye paśau 'sapta vṛṇīte' iti vaṣaṭ- tideśo na bhavet |
' tisro vṛṇīte ' ityādiṣiva ' sapta vṛṇīte ' ityatra mukhaiva |
dhātvartha eva saṃsyānyayaḥ, ṛtvijāṃ bahutvena saptapadasya paśupuroḍāśe na pṛthak vāgvyamānuṣṭhānam |
saṃkhyepyaparatvāt , ' agnidaivatyam ' ityanena yajamānā- vidhayā pūrvapakṣakaraṇe adhyāyāsaṃgatiḥ |
tataśca vaṣaṭkartṛttveva varaṇamiti tato'stu paśupuroḍāśe tantratvakalācintayā ayaṃ vicāraḥ |
niyamena pūrvoktavaraṇasya kartṛsaṃskārārthatve'pi etadvacanavihi- sarvathā na vāgvyamasya pṛthagnuṣṭhānaṃ, iti prāpte, manaḥpraṇi- |
tavaraṇāntarāṇāmārādupakārakatvāṇāṃ tadatiriktā ṛtvijaḥ dhānadvārā vāgvyamasya dṛṣṭopakārakatve saṃbhavati prajāyādi- |
pariśeṣāt karmakārakatvā'nyīyeran, iti prāpte, pūrvokta- vat ārādupakārakatvasya anyāyatvāt, pūrvasaṃjātamanaḥ- |
varaṇe yajamānetareṣāmaṣṭāṃ madhye adhvaryupratīprasthātrore- praṇidhānasya ca vāgvisargottarakriyamāṇapauroḍāśikatapa- |
kena mantreṇa dvivacanāntena varaṇāmiprāyeṇa ' saptarṣijo dāryeṣu anuprayogāt na tantraṃ prasaṅgo vā |
oṃ agniṣomīye paśau saptanāmapi varaṇaṃ lauki- kṛtvā cintyate |
vāgvyamena kāryasiddheḥḥ paśukāle eva vāgvisargaḥ, iti |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : ' agnidaivo hotā ' iti mantrasya śaṅkāyā, vāgvyamasya kartṛsaṃskāratvāt visṛṣṭavācā kriya- |
hotṛvaraṇe samāmnātasya codakataḥ prāptatvāt hotṛmaitrāva- māṇāḥ pauroḍāśikā viguṇāḥ syuḥ, ataḥ puroḍāśakāle |
ruṇayostaidiktvā vācyā, anyeṣāṃ laukikatvā varaṇamiti vāgvisarga iti siddhāntaḥ |
dvayorvarṇaṃ paśūdhamaḥ ; itarattu somadharmaḥ ; iti prāpte, sarve'pi maṇḍana—' pauroḍāśo vāgvisargaḥ paśau cet |
' sapta vṛṇīte ' ityekavidhivihite eka- śaṃkara—' paśukāle sa nātra cit |
agniṣomīye paśau sviṣṭakṛt 124 agniṣomīye paśau sviṣṭakṛt yate' ityekavidhidheyasyāpi savanabhedena vairūpyaṃ tu dakṣiṇādānottaraṃ tatprāsanavidhivirodhādaṅgīkṛtam |
oṃ agniṣomīye paśau sviṣṭakṛt anijyāśeṣe- ṣtribhiraṅgaiḥ kartavyaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ - asti jyotiṣṭome paśurdīkṣaṇīyaḥ 'yo dīkṣito yadagnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ ijyādoṣebhyaḥ tribhyo'ṅgebhyaḥ sviṣṭakṛtā yaṣṭavyam, uta anijyāśeṣebhyaḥ iti |
śrīṇyaṅgāni yāni ijyāśeṣabhūtāni, tebhya ijyāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ triśabdo'pi anugṛhīto bhavati |
teṣāṃ ca sviṣṭakṛdyāgaṃ prati guṇatvena vidhāne'pi prakṛtau pradhānahaviḥ- ttarārdhasyāpi tyāgaṃ prati guṇatvāt tatra tāvat samāna- viṣayatvāt bādhakatvaṃ sulabhameva |
pakṣepādāṃ prati prakṛtau tasya saṃskāratvamapi ca, arthāt tannirvartakatvena prakṣepā- dhanatvasyāpi sattvāt samānaviṣayatvopapatteḥ upadeśena ati- diṣṭasya vācaḥ |
vastutastu ihāpi prakṣepasya upayuktasaṃskāra- tvātsaṃve'pi niruktayajñānāṃ paśununiṣpannatvena ākī- rṇakaratvāt lohitanirasanādivat tatsaṃskāratvopapatteḥ |
prakṛtauaiva ihāpi śrūyamāṇavidhinā prakṣepārthaṃ prati guṇatvena dravyavidhāne'pi arthikena vidhinā prakṣepārthaṃ prati pradhānatvopapatteḥ na tṛtīyāyā lakṣaṇā'pi |

nanu (iti cet ityantaṃ śaṅkā) evamapi sviṣṭakṛtprakṣepāṃśasya prakṛtau dvyantarasaṃskārārthatvena viniyuktasya iha dravyāntarasaṃskāratvena viniyoge'pi pratyuddeśyamāgatvya tanveva vā saṃskāropapatteḥ nopadiṣṭena atidiṣṭasya bādhāpattiḥ |

na hi atra aindrīmantrasya śrutyā gārhapatyāṅgatvena viniyuktasya prayojanākāṅkṣānteḥ indrādyuccopakalpakatvenava iha sviṣṭakṛtḥ agnyā- śeṣasaṃskārārthatvena nirākāṅkṣasya ijyārthopāyatvakalpakatvena iti vaktuṃ śakyam |

ijyārthopāyatvasya prakṛtāveva klṛptatvena iha akalpyatvāt , pradeyottarārdhapratipatti- rūpopakārasya ihānatideśe kāraṇābhāvena taduṣṭhabhāvena tajjanakībhūtasviṣṭakṛtprakṣepāsyātideśe bādhakābhāvācca |
na ca tajjanakalatvena prāptasya iha dravyāntarasaṃskāratvena viniyoge prākṛtasaṃskārasya bādhaḥ |
nahi atra prākṛtasaṃskārasya pratipatyapekṣāśānīḥ, yena tajjanakalatvena prakṣepo nāpanīyata |

na caivaṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ paśupuroḍāśe devatāntaravidhānena aprākṛtakāryakalpane'pi prākṛtakārya- syāpi atideśāt punaḥ paśupuroḍāśāyāgakaraṇapattiḥ, prākṛtakāryasya surādidravyakarmāntarajanyatvavidhānenaiva janakānākāṅkṣatvāt |
prakṛte tu takāryāsthānayathāsiddha- tvāt yuktaṃ tantreṇa sviṣṭakṛtprakṣepakaraṇaṃ iti cet, satyam |
prakṛtau hi 'haviḥśeṣān bhakṣayanti' iti haviḥ- śeṣabhakṣaṇaṃ aviśeṣeṇa śrutampī uttarārdhadakṣiṇādhārdhau sviṣṭakṛdādidāpratipatyantarāmnānāt saṃkucitam |
prakṛte ca sviṣṭakṛtaḥ kāryāntarasaṃbandhena prayojanākāṅkṣatvāt tatsaṃkocābhāvena śeṣabhakṣaṇasyapratipatyarthe pradeyottarā- rthaṃsaṃskāropapatteḥ na sviṣṭakṛtprakṣepaikatvam |
yadyapi ca gudasya ijyāśeṣatvamasti, tathāpi na tanmadhyabhāgasya sviṣṭakṛt atideśataḥ prāpyate, api tu gudatṛtīyottarā- rthasyaiva, iti tathāpi saṃskārāntaratā |

nyāyabinduḥ — sviṣṭakṛdbhayato hṛdayādima eva kāryāḥ, 'yadvaiḥ sviṣṭakṛt yajati' iti vacanaṃ tu teṣāmeva tritvavidhayarthe, iti prāpte, ekaprasaratābhaṅgena aṅgānuvādena tritvavidhayogāt 'dvoḥpūrvādhryasa gudamadhyataḥ, śrīṇojahanāti' iti vākyaśeṣe anyeṣāṃ kīrtanāt tairaiva tribhiḥ sviṣṭakṛdādyaiḥ |
ākīrṇakaratvena tatripatyarthe vacanena sviṣṭakṛdviniyogāt hṛdayādivādhaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
' agneḥ sviṣṭakṛt - āvāhane - havyavahanārtha- meveti tatraiva abhi hotrādyeti nigadaḥ ||
hotrāśabdasya homaparatvāt, katipayahomādhikaraṇatvasya tatrāpi sattvāt, 'yasminvaitadasāvāhatuyo hūyante' ityādinā homārthatva- vaṇācca, iti prāpte, hotṛḥ karma hotraṃ, tacca havyaprāpaṇam |
'havyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya' 'yathā vo yena pathā havyamā vo vahāni' ityādimantraliṅgena tathānirṇāyāt, hotrādyeti tadarthavattvyā ca havyavahanāmnayojanakatvapratīteḥ |
ataḥ śyenatāsu patnīsaṃyājābhāve'pi bhavedevāgniṃ hotrādyeti nigadaḥ |
ātmasamāropeṇa vidherātmano'mervā saṃskāramātrarūpatvena ātmanyaraṇyāśca samāropo'pi samuccayeyātā, iti prāpte,
agnernopāyorekārthatvena samuccayāyogādityapaḥ; ātma- samāropasya saṃskāramatve ca mānābhāvāt |
aprakaraṇe cayanaprakaraṇabhinne sthale sāmātrātāśritityā- dayaḥ iṣṭakāḥ agnyaḥ pañcacitisamudāya rūpavedeḥ agnemeva syāt |
anāgneya paṭhitāḥ upāṃśvadājyādyo grahā yathā jyotiṣṭo- māṅgaṃ, tathā iṣṭakā api agnyaṅgamiti |
agniḥ agnicayanaṃ ca atigrāhyāsteṣāṃ samāhāraḥ agniṣṭomādyam |
tasya kasyāṃ cideva vikṛtau dvirātrādau upadeśāt sarvasyāṃ vikṛtau agniṣṭomāt syāt pravṛttiḥ syāt |
tadvat anyatigrāhyasya vikṛtau upadeśavat 'māsi- māsigrāhyā gṛhyante' ityatra māsi itipadagrahaṇamapi codakābhāve sādhakam |
māsi grahaṇaṃ māsigrahaṇaṃ iti saṃbhāvanāpavedhaḥ karmadhārayaḥ |
vikṛtiṣu agnicayanasya atigrāhyāṇāṃ ca codakena grahaṇaṃ syāt, agniṣṭyāhe itareṣu cāṅgeṣu codakasya tulyatvāt |
'kaṅkacitaṃ cinvīta' 'śīrṣacitaṃ cinvīta' vāja- peye 'pañcadantānatigrāhyān gṛhṇāti' iti liṅgadarśanāt agniṣṭyāhasya vikṛtiṣu codakena prāptirjñāyate |
agnicayanaṃ atigrāhyāśca vikṛtau upadiśyante tasyāṃ vikṛtau prakṛtau ca teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ samānavidhānaṃ syāt |
avaśi- ṣṭasya ca vikṛtiṣu codakena prāptiḥ agniṣṭyāhāṇām |
anena pūrvapakṣe 'vikṛtau upadeśāt' (sū. 23) iti yaduktaṃ tat parihṛtam |
'māsimāsitigrāhyā gṛhyante' iti gavāmayane māsidoccāraṇaṃ ahannahani abhyāsasya pratiṣedhārthaṃ, na codakābhāvasādhakam |
tasmāt agnicayanasya ati- grāhyāṇāṃ ca vikṛtiṣu codakena pravṛttiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

'ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute' itivākyavihitaṃ agniṃ, 'upaṣṭambhanaṃ vā etadyajñasya yaditigrāhyāḥ' iti vākya- vihitāna atigrāhyāśca agniṣṭyāhāt vikṛtau atidiśyante na vā iti saṃdigdhe, agneḥ 'tamukthyena'
tatra saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ agnyatigrāhyaṃ vikṛtau prāpyati, uta neti|
kiṃ prāptaṃ? agnyatigrāhyaṃ vikṛtau apra- vṛttiḥ iti|

vikṛtau hi tadupadiśyate 'athāto'gnimagniṣṭomenānu yajati, tamukthyena, tamatirātreṇa, taṃ ṣoḍaśinā, taṃ vājapeyena, taṃ ṣaḍahena, taṃ saptarātreṇa, tamapyarātreṇa, taṃ navarātreṇa, taṃ daśarātreṇa' iti|
tathā 'yat pṛṣṭhyeṣutigṛhītāt prājñaṃ yajñaṃ pṛṣṭhāni saṃgṛhṇīyuḥ, yadukthyeṣutigṛhīyāt' iti|
na nūnaṃ agnyatigrāhyaṃ codakaḥ prāpayati, yat sākṣāt kasyāṃ cit vikṛtau codyate iti|
bhāṣyaṃ-- idaṃ cāmnāyate 'māsimāsi atigrāhyā gṛhyante' iti|
yadi codakaḥ prāpyeta, na 'māsimāsya- tigṛhyante' ityupadeśaḥ syāt|
anyānyaṅgāni gṛhṇāti, etanna gṛhṇāti, iti naitadavakalpate|
bhāṣyaṃ-- liṅgaṃ svalpi dṛśyate 'kañcit cinvīta' 'śīrṣacitaṃ cinvīta, yaḥ kāmayeta suśīrṣā asmin loke saṃbhaveyaṃ' iti|
kañcākāratāṃ aindrāṃ ca viśeṣaṃ bruvan agnyati- grāhyasya vikṛtau prāptiṃ darśayati|
bhāṣyaṃ--atha yaduktaṃ vikṛtau upadiśyate iti, tat parihartavyam|
yasyāṃ vikṛtau upadi- śyate tasyāṃ, prakṛtau ca samānaḥ sa vidhiḥ|
kathaṃ? prakṛtau vaikalpika 'traḥ uttaravedyāṃ nighātāvyaḥ sthale vā|
yadi agniḥ dviātrā- dīnāṃ prakaraṇe āmnāyeta agniratra kartavya iti, evaṃ niyāmakaṃ syāt, yathā 'khādiro yūpo bhavati' iti|
ayaṃ tu agniḥ anārabhya setikartavyatāko vihitaḥ|
taṃ vidhāya abhiprāyaiḥ tasya ṛtusaṃbandhaṃ kriyate|
tatra ca dviātrādīnāṃ prakaraṇaṃ na viparīvarttate, yena dviātrādipu codakena prāptasya niyāmakaṃ syuḥ|
punarvacanaṃ tu yadā agniḥ, tadā guṇakāmānāṃ pravṛttiriti|
bhāṣyaṃ-- atha māsigrahaṇaṃ kathamiti? tadabhyāsa- pratiṣedhārtham|
na ahaṇyahani gṛhyante, māsimāsi gṛhyante iti|
śā-- so'yamagniḥ yāsu vikṛtiṣu vākyena nopa- diṣṭaḥ yathā ṣoḍaśiṣu vājapeye ca, tatra kiṃ codakaprāpyā kartavyo neti saṃśayaḥ|
tathā atigrāhyāḥ nāma grahāḥ prakṛtau śrutāḥ, vikṛtiṣvapi kāsu cit upadiṣṭāḥ 'ukthya gṛhṇīyāt, pṛṣṭhye gṛhṇīyāt, viśvajiti pragṛhṇītavyāḥ' iti|
' yāsu vikṛtiṣu vidhī- yate tāsu, prakṛtau ca samānaṃ vidhānaṃ bhavati|
vikṛtya- ntareṣu tu codakataḥ prāptiḥ iti na prakṛtitulyaṃ vidhā- nam|
samānavidhānatve ca prayojanaṃ agnyatigrāhyāṃ guṇa- kāmānāṃ vikṛtiṣu pravṛttiḥ|
yāsu vidhinasti, tāsu na guṇakāmāḥ pravartante 'nivṛttirvā karmabhedāt' iti nyāyāt (8|1|14|24)|
tadevaṃ guṇakāmapravṛttyai vikṛtiṣu kāsu cicchravaṇaṃ iti na tadvalana atideśābhāvaḥ śakyate kalpayituṃ, tasmādasti atideśaḥ|
atra ke cidāhuḥ-- anārabhyādhīto'gniḥ prākaraṇikottarayedividhātu prakṛtau na labhate niveśam|
aprākṛtaśca na vikṛtiṣu atidiśyate, tena upadeśenaiva asya vikṛtiṣu prāptiḥ, iti anupadeyataḥ ṣoḍaśivājapeyayoḥ|
(agnivākyenaiva ṛtusaṃbandhavācagāt yuktaḥ prakṛtau niveśaḥ ityāha--) tadayuktam|
na tu vikṛtyagni- mābhiprāyaṃ tat bhaviṣyati, prakṛtau prākaraṇikottarayedivi- rodhāt|
kiṃca prakṛtairevāgnibhiralaṃ ananyāpekṣaṃ, vikṛtīnāṃ tu atideśā- pekṣaṃ iti prakṛtirevānenābhidhīyate|
agniṣṭomaśca ṛtumevābhidhatte iti tatsaṃbandho vākyakṛta iti na prakaraṇena bādhamarhati|
tasmādasti prakṛtau agniḥ, iti vikṛtiṣvapi atidiśyate|
tatra sādhyākṣepe (ekadina- sādhyatvāt) sārasvateṣu ca satreṣu (pradhānayāgānāṃ anudinaṃ anyānyaśyāmāprasadeṣu kartavyatvāt) adyakyatvāt kāmamagniṃ cīyatāṃ, ṣoḍaśivājapeyayoścetavyaḥ|
moma--svāhākārasyopasaṃhārabhāvena punaḥ śravaṇarahita- davīrhimeṣu bādhābhāve'pi agneḥ punaḥśravaṇarahitavikṛ- tiṣu bādhāḥ ityucitaḥ: saṃgatiḥ|

yaduktaṃ vidhirasā- yane 'yadi anyāśritaguṇaphalavidhivipravṛtteḥ pūrva agniprakaraṇe tattatkratuprakaraṇeṣu vā upadeśenātideśena vā ṛtvanvayitvena siddha evāgniḥ śyenākṛlyādi- guṇaphalavidhiṣu āśrayatvena anuvādyaḥ syāt, tadā prathamaṃ buddhayapārūḍhe aupadeśike evāgnau āśrayatve- nānvite caramapratītātideśikāgneḥ āśrayatvenānvayo na bhavet, iti tasyāpi tadavyatvenānvayārthaṃ punaḥupadeśaḥ saphalaḥ syāt, na tvevaṃ agniṣṭomādivākyaiḥ ṛtvanvaya- karaṇāt prāgeva 'ya evaṃ vidvān' ityupapannasya śuddhasyāgneḥ āśrayatvenānudāsaṃbhavena ṛtvanvayina eva āśrayatve pramāṇābhāvāt, śuddhasya cāgneḥ āśrayatvenānyatara agneḥ ṛtusaṃbandhe sati arthāttat ṛtvanvito'gniḥ āśraya iti paryavasyati|
yeṣu agneḥ aupadeśikamapūrvīyatvaṃ, yeṣu cātideśādhīna, teṣu sarveṣvapi aviśeṣeṇa sidhyati|
bhavedevaṃ yadi śuddhasyāgneḥ āśrayatvayogyatā syāt, na tvevaṃ, śuddhasya siddharūpatvena kriyānupraveśaṃ vinā āśrayatvāyogyatvāt|
uktaṃ ca caturthe tantraratne (4|3|1|9) 'audāsīnya- pratyayāko dvayāśrayaḥ, kriyā ca tathā, na dravyaṃ' iti|
agneḥ siddharūpatvaṃ ca vidhirasādhane eva 'paśu- kāmaścinvīta' ityādinā phalārthatvenāvagatasyāgneḥ āśrayā- rthāni 'athāto'gnimagniṣṭomena' ityādivākyāni iti pratipādanāvasare āśritam|

evaṃ ca yathā siddharūpasya svataḥ- phalasādhanatvasaṃbhavena tadarthamāśrayāpekṣā, tathā siddharūpasya āśrayatvasaṃbhavena tadarthaṃ ṛtvanupraveśāpekṣāyāṃ agniṣṭo- mādivākyaiḥ kratvanvito yo'gniḥ, sa evāśrayaḥ: svāṃ- kāryaṃ:, na tu śuddhaḥ iti guṇakāmaprāptiḥ punaḥśravaṇaprayo- janamupapadyate iti|
nahi uttaravedyā saha vikalpita- syāgneḥ niyamārthatayā kāsu cidvikṛtiṣu punaḥśravaṇopapatteḥ na guṇakāmaprāptiḥ|
dviātrāditatkratuvikṛtodakaprāpyalobhyatallobhyatvenādiprāpya- pekṣāgnyamiprakaraṇagatadāśritaguṇakāma- prāpteḥ saṃnihitatayā tasyā eva prayojanavaucityāt|
yatra tu saṃnihitaprayojanalābhaḥ, yathā ṣoḍaśigrahavidhi- viṣaye 'uttare'han dviātrasya gṛhyate' ityādī, tatra tattaccodakādhīnaprāptisāpekṣo'pi niyamaḥ phala agnyā svīkriyate|
iha tu saṃnihitaprayojanalābhāt na niyamaḥ prayojanamiti|
, prakṛtervi- kṛtīnāṃ ca sāmyayā syāt punarvacaḥ|
bhāṭṭa--'ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute' ityanena upa- sthasya cayanarūpasyāgneḥ 'athāto'gnimagniṣṭomenānu yajati' iti anārabhyādhītena jyotiṣṭomākhyena vidhiḥ iti sthitaṃ dvitīyai (2|3|10|12-23)|
prākaraṇikena ‘upastambhana vā etasyagrāhyāḥ’ ityetadvacanena jyotiṣṭomāṅgatvena vidhiḥ|

evaṃ sthite kāsu cit vikṛtiṣu agnyatigrāhyayoḥ ‘tamukthyena, tamatirātreṇa’ ‘ukthye grahītavyāḥ’ ityādinā punaḥśravaṇaṃ na tāvat ājyabhāgaśravaṇavat apūrvatvārthe prakṛtisamānakālīnasyāsya vidhānasya klṛptopakārakatvābhāvena codakaparilopakānupapatteḥ, agniṣṭomādyarthe atideśasyāvaśyakatvācca|
iti bhrāme, asyāṃ vikṛtau tadvidhānena vikṛtyantare etadviṣaye atideśaparilokyānupapatteḥ prātaparisaṃkhyā vācyā|
na ca vaiyarthyabhiyā etasya tātparyagrāhakatvamaṅgīkṛtya vikṛtyantarātideśasya tadvidhāyakatvakalpanā iti vācyam|
tathāhi, prakṛtāviha vikṛtiṣvapi kāsu cit tulyatvopadeśāḥ agnyāśritānāṃ ‘yenacitaṃ cinvīta svargakāmaḥ’ ityevamādīnāṃ śyenādyākārakakṣaṇaguṇāmānāṃ tāsu vikṛtiṣu pravṛttyarthaḥ|
anyathā hi prakṛtyupasādhanībhūtacayanasyaiva tatrāśrayatvāpatteḥ ātmikanyāyena (215) tatra teṣāmaprāpteḥ|
sati tu asmin vidhau prakṛtyapūrvasādhanībhūtacayanasyaiva tattadvikṛtyapūrvasādhanībhūtacayanasyāpi āśrayalatvāviśeṣāt guṇakāmaprāpyupapattiḥ|
evaṃ ca cayanasya prakṛtau vaikalpikātvāt tanniyamo'pi prayojanam|
yadyapi hi ‘uttaravedyāṃ agniḥśrūyate’ iti vacanāt abhyuttaravedyoḥ samuccayaḥ saṃkarṣe vakṣyate (21126)|
tathāpi ‘yadyajñi cepyamānā bhavanti’ ‘agniḥ somādyaṃ cecchatām’ iti śrutikalpasūtraparyālocananayā agneḥ svābhāvapratiyogiko vikalpa iṣṭa eva|
ata eva uttaravedyāmātreṇa niragniko'pi jyotiṣṭomaprayogaḥ ‘uttaravedyāmagniṃ nidadhāti’ iti vacanāt iṣṭaḥ|
ataśca vikṛtiṣvapi tathaiva prāptau kāsu cit punaḥ śravaṇaṃ niyamamapi saṃpadyate|
nāhi ayaṃ atideśaprāptyuttarakālaṃ śabdo niyamaḥ, yena prakṛtisamānakālīnatayā atideśataḥ pūrvapravṛttatvāt asyaḥ ājñāṅkyeta|
cayane paścādapi pravṛttasyātideśasya tadvidhāyakatvena tadabhāvaviṣayatvasyāpi akalpanāt|
ata eva vikṛtyantare iva gatyamayānādirūpasatre'pi pratyahaṃ atigrāhyāprāptau ‘māsimāsi atigrāhyā gṛhyante’ iti viśeṣavidhirupapadyate|
vikṛtiviśeṣe ca kakacitkathaṃcidvidhividhānaṃ ‘pañcadaśarātrāt atigrāhyān gṛhṇīyāt’ ityādi ca viśeṣavidhānamapi upapadyate|
nyāyabinduḥ—anārabhya vihitaḥ sthaṇḍilarūpo'gniḥ ‘athāto'gnimimagnimenānu yajanti, tamukthyena, taṃ dvirāvatreṇa’ ityādinā prakṛtau vikṛtau ca kacit viniyuktaḥ|
iti prāpte, ka cit punaḥśravaṇasya samānavidhānatvāt nātideśanivṛttiḥ, guṇakāmapravṛttyarthe ca samānavidhānam|
‘yenacitaṃ cinvīta svargakāmaḥ’ ityādinā agnyāśritatvāt tasya vikṛtisādhāraṇatve tatra kāmapravṛttiḥ|
tatra sādhyakeṣu sārasvateṣu ca satreṣu aśakyatvāt na cayanaṃ, vājapeyādau tu bhavatīti śeṣam|
evaṃ vidhāya śrūyate ‘athāto'gnimimagnimenānu yajati, tamukthyena, tamatirātreṇa’ ityevamādi|
tatra saṃdehaḥ, kimagniśabdo yāgavacanaḥ jyotiṣṭomādibhyaḥ karmāntaraṃ cinute ityākhyātena vidhīyate, uta dravyavacanaḥ jyotiṣṭomādiṣu guṇavidhānamiti|
liṅgaṃ hi dṛśyate, ‘agneḥ stotraṃ’ ‘agneḥ śastraṃ’ iti|
yasya stotraśastraṃ upasadaśca, tasya agniśabdo vācaka iti gamyate|
kiṃ apūrvayāgavidhiḥ, uta cayanamātravidhānaṃ, uta prakṛtivikṛtiṣu guṇavidhānaṃ iti|
tatra aṃśadvayavat prakaraṇe punarsaṃkīrtanāt saṃskāramātrasya ca kevalasya prayojanāsaṃbhavāt saṃjñayaiva ṛtvantaraṃ kalpyate|
na ca guṇāt phalamiti śakyaṃ vaktuṃ, prakṛtāthyānupapatteḥ|
tathā ca aikāntikasomayāgacihnāni upasādādīni ubhayatra saṃbrahmaṇi śrūyate|
tatra ‘agniṃ yajati’ iti ‘samidho yajati’ ivitavat ‘tatprakhyaṃ cānyaśāstraṃ’ ityevaṃ siddhanāmadheyaviśiṣṭāvagāvidhānaṃ vijñāyate|
yadvā agniṃ agniṣṭomādisaṃsthaiḥ yāgaiḥ anu yajati ityukte yadi agniyāgaḥ, evamasau anuyaṣṭuṃ śakyate|
sarvatra hi tulyarūpatāṃ tulyadharmāṇāṃ vibhāge paurvāparyaṃ bhavati|
paścime tu vyākhyāne agniṣṭomādibhyaḥ paścāt kriyamāṇo'yaṃ tadaṅgameva bhavati iti phalaśrutiryarthavādaḥ syāt|
pūrvatra tu svatantratvāt ‘phalamātreyo nirdeśāt’ (4|3|18) iti phalavidhitvāt puruṣārthamiti viśeṣaḥ|
cinute ityeṣā hi codanā yathā, cayanaṃ enaṃ saṃskurute, citau sthāpayati iti|
anuśabdaśca paścādartho bhaviṣyati, cayane nirvṛtte paścāt agniṣṭomena yāgena yajati iti|
yattu tadapyamastītyuktaṃ, bhavettat, yadi ṛtvaṅgatvena agni-śrūyate|
na ca tādūpyena kutaścit prāptaḥ, iti tadvyākhyāntarābhāvaḥ|
siddhāntavādī tu ‘vrīhīnavahanti’ ivitavat vaiyadhikaraṇyāt saṃskārasaṃskārasambandhopapatteḥ-virodhaṃ matvā''ha—‘yadetat jvalanaḥ’ iti|
tasmāt agniśabdaḥ prasiddhārthagrāhitvāt cinoteśca yāga-vidhānāntaḥ: dravyadevatā'bhāvācca, agniṃ cayanena saṃska-roti ityetāvāneva codanā'rtho'vadhīyate|
syāt tato duḥśraṃ nīyeta, yadi vaiṣā karmaṇi dvitīyā syāt |
ayaṃ tu vyadhikaraṇaḥ ; karmapra- vacanīyayukte dvitīyā |
agniśabdaśca sāmānyavacano'pi san atra prakaraṇavaśāt cayanasaṃskṛte vahnau pravartate |
codakenaiva prātānāṃ vikṛtiṣu punaḥśrutiḥ kimartheti cet ? daśame vakṣyate 'grahaṇaṃ samā- navidhānaṃ syāt' (10|8|11|27) iti |
na cāvaśyaṃ tulyajātīyayoreva paurvāparyaṃ bhavati, atulya- jātīyorapi paurvāparyaṃ bhavati yathā 'pākamanu bhuṅkte' ityavirodhopapatteḥ |
yat 'devadatto yajñadattamanu gacchati' ityetat tulyakarmatvaṃ gamyate iti, yuktaṃ tat kartṛmātra- pādāne sati kriyāntarānupādānāt |
iha punaḥ agni- saṃskārodyataṃ cayanameva vidyate ityasamānam |
tatsaṃtogāt kratustadākhyaḥ syāt, tena dharma- vidhānani |
bhāṣya— yattu liṅgadarśanamuktaṃ yāgavacanaḥ agni- śabdaḥ iti |
tat teṣveva liṅgasaṃyukteṣu vacaneṣu, na sarvatra, teṣu cityāgnisaṃyogāt yāge lakṣaṇaśabdaḥ |
vā— 'agneḥ stotraṃ' ityādiṣu agnayā āśraya- tvam |
jvalanena saṃbaddhaṃ sthalaṃ lakṣyate, nāpi tadgan kratuḥ |
na caikatra lakṣaṇā''śrayamiti sarvatraiva sā āśra- yitavyeti |
yastu atraivādhikaraṇe bhāṣyakārāntareṇa agreḥ phalavada- phalatvādyakṛtatvanityānityalottaravedivikārāvikāratva- vicāraḥ kṛtaḥ, sa udāharaṇāntareṇa adhikaraṇtarasiddhaḥ |
tasmāt naivajātīyako guṇo bhedakaḥ iti siddham |
p. 419. śā— kiṃ 'agniṃ cinte' iti yāgavidhiḥ ; uta agnisaṃskāramātraṃ svatantraṃ vidhīyate, kivā jyotiṣṭo- mādiṣu guṇo vidhīyate |
tadarthaṃ ca kiṃ agniśabdaḥ yāganāmadheyaṃ, uta dravyavacanaḥ iti saṃdehaḥ |
siddhānte 'athāto'gnimagnimemānu yajanti' ityā- dīni vākyāni agniṣviniyojakāni |
tatrāgniṣṭomasaṃsthayāḥ kalpyatvāt amestadāśrayasaṃbhavāt agniṣṭomasaṃsthena yāgena iti tatraiva yāgalakṣaṇā |
ukthādivākyeṣu tu ukthādiśabdānāmukthādisaṃsthāmātraparatvameva na tu tacchakyatayāgaparatvaṃ, tāsāmeva saṃsthānāṃ phalavatvena agni prati śeṣitvasaṃbhavāditi dhyeyam |

agneḥ stotraṃ ayaḥ channaṃ' iti stotraśabdayuktatayā nirdeśarūpaliṅgadarśanāt stotraśabdayoḥ ṛtvekasaṃbandhitvāt iti stotraśabdavākye anupapattivatvāt lakṣaṇayā agniśabdasya tadyuktakratuparatva- mātreṇa vidravākye (ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute ityatra) yāganāmatvamivādravyasya nābhyupeyaṃ iti siddhāntāśayaḥ |
vi— 'agniṃ cinuta ityatra yāge vā saṃskṛti, ryajiḥ |
bhāṭṭa— anārabhyaiva śrutaṃ 'ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute' iti |
tamatirātreṇa, taṃ dvātriṃśena' ityādyuttaravākyeṣu agniṣṭomādisaṃsthānāṃ agnyanuyajanarūpaguṇānām |
nahi agnyanuyajanatvaṃ agneryāgatve avakalpate, 'devadatta- manugacchati yajñadattaḥ' ityādi tulyakriyāyoge eva anuśabdadarśanāt |
ataśca agniśabdasya yāgasya tasminneva vidhau gauravāt, vidvadvākye eva cinotinā lakṣaṇayā tadvidhānam |
'iṣṭakābhiragniṃ cinoti' ityanena ca cayanasya prāptatvāt cinotiḥ nirvapatiyat anuvādaścayanasya |
iti prāpte, 'pākamanu bhuṅkte' ityādi tulyakriyāyogābhāve'pi anuśabdadarśanāt na tadanurodhena agniśabdasya cayana- śabdasya ca yāgaparatvakalpanā yuktā |
agniśabdena ca yadyapi śakyā jvalanaḥ evāgnidhīyate |
tathāpi tadarthatve vaiyarthyāpatteḥ niruḍhalakṣaṇayā āhavanīyādipara- tvāvasāyāt taduddeśena cayanaṃ saṃskārakatayā vidhīyate |
sthāpitasyāgneḥ upayogāpekṣāyāṃ 'athātaḥ' iti vākyena tasya jyotiṣṭomāṅgatvena vidhānam |
agniṣṭomaśabdaśca jātinyāyena saṃsthāvacana'pi vyaktinyāyena jyotiṣṭomameva pracuraprayo- gādabhidhatte, pārthaśabdād ivā'rjunam |
ataśca jyotiṣṭoma- tvameva lāghavāt uddeśyatā'vacchedakaṃ, na tu agniṣṭoma- saṃsthātvamapi |
yadyapi cayanasya jyotiṣṭomaprayojanatva- tattvāt anuṣṭhānasadeyādeva tadbhavasiddheḥ, tathāpi 'paśukāmā'nvīta' ityādivākyaiḥ agneḥ kāmyayāgamātraṃ ṛtvaṅgatvapratiprasavāya tantra virudhyate |
ayaṃ cāgniḥ prakṛtau 'agniḥ somād vecchatāṃ' ityādi- vacanād vaikalpikaḥ |
abhiṣake ca 'uttaravedyāṃ hyagniṃ śrayate' iti vacanāt uttaravedyā samuccayaḥ |
ataśca 'tamukthyena' ityādivākyāni vaikalpikatvān vikṛtiviśeṣe tanniyamārthāni cayanāśrita- syenākārādiphalārthaguṇānāṃ prāpyatvārthāni ca iti daśame (10|8|11|23-28) vakṣyate |
nyāyabindu— 'ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute' ityatra agnisaṃjñakayāgavidhiḥ, cinotistu 'iṣṭakābhiragniṃ cinute' iti vākyaprāptyānuvādo nirvapatiyat |
agni- śabdasya yāganāmatvaṃ ca 'athāto'gnimimiyamenānu yajanti' iti vākye yadagniṃ yajati tadagniṣṭomena ityagnisaṃjñakayāgānuvādena agniṣṭomasaṃsthāvidhānadagamyate |
evamanuyajanti ityapi gamakaṃ, agneryāgarūpatvābhāve tamanu yāgāntarayogāsaṃbhavāt, 'devadattamanugacchati yajñadattaḥ' ityādivat ekajātīyayoreva tathā vyapadeśāt |
tasya 'athā- to'gniṃ' ityādivākyaiḥ ṛtusaṃbandhaḥ kriyate, na tu agniśabdaḥ aśrutanāmadheyam |
anuyajati iti tu cayananantareṇaivāpi upapadyate, 'pākamanu bhuṅkte' iti vijātīye'pi prayogāt |
' agnyadhānaṃ jyotiṣṭome dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu devatāparigrahārthamapi na kartavyam |
bhāṣya— pūrvoktaṃ agnyadhānaṃ saumikaṃ prasaṅgāt aiṣṭi- keṣu kārye sādhyatītyuktam (12|1|10|19) |
kiṃ tarhi ? dhāraṇyārthaṃ ca devatāpari- grahārthaṃ ca |
evaṃ hi darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'mamāgane varco vihaveṣvastu iti pūrvamagniṃ gṛhṇāti, devatā eva tat pūrvairguhītāḥ śrobhūte yajate' iti |
tatra yadyapi dhāraṇyārthaṃ saumikena prasaṅgāt sidhyati, (tathāpi) deva- tāparigrahārthaṃ tat dāśīpaurṇamāsikaṃ aiṣṭikaṃ katrta- vyam |
some'pi śakalapādiḥ devatāparigrahārthā śrūyate 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekāda- śakapālaṃ nirvaped dīkṣaṇīyām, agniḥ prathamo devatānāṃ, viṣṇuḥ paramaḥ; yadāgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati,
devatā yajñaṃ ca tadubhayataḥ parigṛha dīkṣate' iti |
saiva devatāparigrahārthā, prasaṅgāt aiṣṭikānāṃ kāryaṃ sādhayiṣya- tīti |
dup - ( anvādhānasya devatāparigrahārthatvamabhyupe- tyāpi dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ bādhitaḥ |
vastutaḥ anvādhānasya devatāparigrahārthatve na kiṃ cit pramāṇaṃ iti paramārtha- māha-) na devatāparigrahārthamanvādhānaṃ vastuto'vagamyate |
' mamāgne varca viśveṣvastu iti pūrvamapi parigṛhṇāti, devatā evaṃ pūrvairguhītvā śobhate yajate ' ityayaṃ śabdo devatāparigrahārthatvamavabodhayet |
na ca īdṛśena śabdena devatāparigrahārthatvaṃ pratipādayituṃ śakyate, arthavādatvāt vākyasya |
evaṃ ca adṛṣṭa- kalpanā na bhaviṣyati |
mantro'pi khasāmarthyena agrima- middhāti, nānyat kiṃ cit |
yadyuktaṃ, dīkṣaṇīyā devatāparigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ iti, etadapyayuktam |
kathaṃ ? ' dīkṣyamāṇaḥ ' iti jñānavā kartā'bhidhīyate, laṭā bhaviṣyatkālaḥ |
tasya vidhīyamānasya ' sarvāśraiva devatāḥ pari- gṛhṇāti ' ityarthavādo'yaṃ āgnāvaiṣṇavasya stutyarthaḥ |
devatāpari- grahārthatāyāṃ ca satyāṃ puruṣasaṃskārikā, devatāparigrahārthā, iti vākyabhedaḥ syāt |
anena tatpa- rigrahārthena aiṣṭikeṇa agnyādhānena nārthaḥ |
nanu viśve devā ijyante iti parigṛhītāḥ |
vyapadeśo bhavati ' agnirvasubhiḥ, somo rudraiḥ, indro marudbhiḥ, varuṇa ādityaiḥ, bṛhaspati- viśvedevaiḥ ' iti vasvādivyaḥ |
yadi ca sarve devā ucceran, viśva- devaśabdena tebhyo''ntarabhūtā na syuḥ |
nāmena vyapadeśena gaṇo vaiśvadevaḥ śakyaḥ kalpayitum |
guṇāryairvyapadeśo vyahaspatiprabhṛtiśaḥ : agnyādayo vasvādiviḥ kevalaiḥ sametāḥ, bṛhaspatiḥ sarvadevaiḥ taiścā- nyaiścaiti |
yathā senāpatirbhūyatvena sahāgataḥ samāhartā nijena balena, rājā tu sarvairbalaiḥ taiścānyaiścaiti |
api ca vaiśvadevo gaṇaḥ kalpyaḥ, sarve tu devāḥ śabdādevāva- gamyante |
tathā ca dīkṣaṇīyā aṅgadevatāparigraho'pi prasaṅgāt sidhyatīti na kartavyaṃ darśapaurṇamāsikaṃ aiṣṭikepu agnyādhānam |
śā-- yadyapi ( agnyādhānaṃ ) devatāparigrahārthe, tathāpi prāyaṇīyādiṣu na kartavyam |
dīkṣaṇīyāyā api hi vākyadoṣe devatāparigrahārthatā śrūyate |

yadyapi ' dīkṣā somasya ' iti vacanāt pradhānārthā dīkṣaṇīyā pradhānade- vatā evaṃ parigṛhṇāti, tathāpi vaiśvadevagrahe sarvadevatāsamavā- yāt tatparigrahaṃ kurvantī dīkṣaṇīyā prasaṅgāt aṅgadevatā api gṛhṇāti |
