nahi viśvedevaśabdaḥ kasya ciddevatāgaṇasya vācakaḥ prasiddhyāvayavārthasya śakyatvantarakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |
tasmāt sarvadevatāvacanatvāt tatparigrahe ca sarvāntargatānāmaṅgadevatānāmapi prasaṅgataḥ parigrahāt akartavya-
yadvā tatrābhyupagamapakṣe dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ karta- vyamevānvādhānaṃ tataḥ paraṃ tu na kartavyam |

devatāpa- rigrahadṛṣṭarūpatve'pi devatāsaṃskārakatvāt saṃskṛtāyā eva tasyāḥ karmopayogena paśupādyo'śe bhāvyanūyājādṛṣṭa- pakārojīvanavat bhāvyupajīvyatāsaṃbhavāt dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ devatāparigrahārthamanvādhānaṃ kartavyam |
sūtrārthastu- pūrvamanvādhānaṃ grahaṇārthamapi nivarteta dīkṣaṇīyāyā api tadarthatvāditi |
' bhāṣya-- yadyuktaṃ anvādhānasya dhāraṇāryatvāt somā- dveṣṭyādiṣu anvādhānaṃ na vidyate iti, tadākṣipya samādhīyate |
nānvādhānaṃ agnidhāraṇārthe, api tu ' devatā eva pūrvagṛhītvā śobhate yajate ' ityarthavādavaśāt devatāparigrahārtham |
ata eva ' mamāgne varca iti pūrva- magniṃ parigṛhṇāti' ityeṣā ' iṃdhānāḥ ' iti mantravarṇaiścāt parigrahalakṣitānvādhānena prathamaṃ agnidevatopalakṣitāḥ |
ataśca ānuṣaṅgike agnidhāraṇe jāyamāne'pi tadarthatvābhāvāt somāgneṣṭyādiṣu devatāparigrahārthaṃ kartavyameva anvādhā- dhānam |

iti prāpte, yadyapi devatāparigrahārthe tat, tathāpi tatpuṇyanayatayā ' āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirdhayet dīkṣyamāṇaḥ :, agnirvāmamo devatānāṃ viṣṇuḥ paramaḥ, devatā eva tadubhayataḥ parigṛha dīkṣate ' iti dīkṣaṇīyāvākyaśeṣe tathāpi devatāparigrahārthatvāgateḥ yuktastathaiva prasaṅgaḥ |
' dīkṣyamāṇaḥ ' ityatra ca uttara- kālatvāmātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ, na janyatvaṃ iti tatrāpi kathaṃ cit vyākhyānopapatteḥ |
na ca ' dīkṣāḥ somasya ' iti vaca- nāt tasyāḥ pradhānamātratvāvagataḥ taddevatāparigrahamātreṇa nāṅgadevatāparigrahaḥ prasajyate, iti vācyam |
dīkṣāyāḥ pradhānamātratve'pi tajjanakībhūtadīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ āgneyā- dikadevatātve'pi pramāṇābhāvena aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇa- devatāparigrahārthatvāt |
yattu atra sūtrakārādibhiḥ aṅgīkṛtya dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ pradhānamātrārthatvaṃ pradhānadevatāyāṃ

vaiśvadevagrahītāyāṃ ' viśvaśabdasya sarvavācitvāt sarvameva devānāṃ devatātvapratīteḥ aṅgadevatānāmapi tatparigraheṇa parigrahāt prasaṅgopapattiḥ iti samāhitaṃ, tat viśvadevaśabdasya ' āditya- viśvavasavaḥ ' iti trikāṇḍīsmaraṇe gaṇaviśeṣe rūḍha- tvāvagateḥ dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ devatāparigrahārthatve pradhāna- mātrārthatve pramāṇābhāvācca upekṣitam |
ato devatāpari- grahārthapakṣe'pi yukta eva prāyaṇīyādiṣu prasaṅgaḥ |
dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ tu tasyāmavasthāyāṃ devatāparigrahasya ajñāta- tvāt kartavyameva tadevatāparigrahārthe prākṛtamanvādhānam |

vastutastu dārśikānvādhānavākye agnidevatopalakṣaṇārthatve pramāṇābhāvāt liṅgopapadyaśūnyā agnyādhānasyāgnidhāra- ṇamātrārthatvapratīteḥ; dīkṣaṇīyāyāśca lṛptaśrutyā dīkṣotpāda- katvāvagateḥ nobhayorapi devatāparigrahārthatvam |
arthavādastu ubhayatrāpi evakāropavadatvāt aṅkaraṇena ca pradhāna- devatāyāḥ saṃbandhāyasattvāt tatraiva parigrahalopekṣayā stutimātram |
ataśca somāgnīdhrāraṇena dīkṣaṇīyāyā- mapi prasaṅgasiddheḥ tasyāmapi nānvādhānam |
nyāyabinduḥ - agnyādhānaṃ devatāparigrahārthamapi ' mamāgne varca iti pūrvamapi gṛhṇāti devatā eva tata pūrvagṛhītvā śobhate yajate ' iti śruteḥ |

ataḥ prāya- ṇīyādipārthaṃ tadarthamanvādhānaṃ kāryaṃ ityuktākṣepe prāpte, agnidhāraṇasyeṣṭaphalasaṃbhave sati adṛṣṭadevatāpari- grahārthatvasya arthavādatvāt kalpanāyā asaṃbhavāt, saṃbhave'pi vā dīkṣaṇīyaiva tatsiddhiḥ |
' agnirvāmamo devānāṃ, viṣṇuḥ paramaḥ, devatā eva tadubhayataḥ parigṛha dīkṣate ' iti tadarthavādaśravaṇāt |
yadyapi ' dīkṣā somasya ' iti vaca- nāt somamātrārthā dīkṣaṇīyā pradhānadevatā eva gṛhṇāti, tathāpi tatra viśvadevadevatātvāt aṅgadevatā api gṛhṇāti |
āsmiṃśca pakṣe dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ kartavyameva anvā- dhānaṃ svadevatāparigrahārthe, tataḥ paraṃ tu na kārye iti viśeṣa iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ-- some dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu codakaprāptamagnyādhānaṃ kiṃ kartavyamuta neti |
na ca kṛtasya mantratve punarāvṛttirasti tasmānna kartavyam |
soma--pūrvavat aprāpi pṛthak kartavyatā ityutthitaḥ saṃgatiḥ |
anvādhānaṃ nāma viharaṇādanantaraṃ ādyo yo dhāraṇārthaḥ kāṣṭhairvilevakaraṇarūpaḥ sammindhanavyāpāraḥ, tadarthaḥ kāṣṭhādhānātmakamavyāpāraḥ, na tu sammindhanārthakādhāna- mātram |
viharaṇādanantaraṃ ādimavyāpāraścaiva, itya- nvādhānasya na punaḥpunaḥkaraṇasaṃbhavaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ praṇayottaraṃ prāduṣkarottacaraṃ vā agnīnāṃ samantrakaṃ ādyaṃ sammindhanaṃ vihitam |
tat atideśena some'gniṣṭuyanvādau dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu prāpta- mapi na kāryaṃ, tatḥ pūrvameva sāṅgomakāryeṇapraṇayā- ttaraṃ sammindhanasya kṛtatvāt |
yadyapi tadamanatrakaṃ arthaprāptaṃ ca, tathāpi tādaronaiva kāryasya jātatvāt na dīkṣaṇī- yādiṣu pṛthagganuṣṭhānam |
na ca ekavāraṃ sammindhanaṃ punardā- rthyate samantrakasamindhanopapattiḥ, ' mamāgne varca iti pūrvamagniṃ parigṛhṇāti ' ityanena praṇayāyuttarakālīnapratha- māgnyādhāne eva mantravidhānāt |

na ca pūrvapadasya agnipadasāmānādhikaraṇyena āhavanīyaparatvāt pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttyāyena pratidhāraṇaṃ mantrāvṛttiḥ, bodhāyane- nāsya gārhapatyānvādhāne viniyuktatayā pūrvapadasya kriyā- viśeṣaṇatvamaṅgīkṛtya prathamānnādhānavidhiriparatvāt |

ata eva ' devatā eva pūrvairyurdhailītvā śrobhūte yajete ' ityartha- vādānurodhāt pūrvapadaṃ pūrvaiḥ kālaparaṃ ityapi keṣāṃ viduktaṃ parāstaṃ, lakṣaṇā''patteḥ, pūrvaiḥ kālīnānekasamindhane mantrāvṛttiprasaṅgācca, prakṛtau sadyaḥkālāyāṃ sammanyanvā- dhānakaraṇānāpatteśca, dīkṣaṇīyādeḥ sadyaḥkālatayā prasaṅga- siddhikathanasya anuktisahatvācca |
ataḥ asadukarītyaiva ādhyānvādhāne mantravidheḥ yukta eva dīkṣaṇīyādau prasaṅgaḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ-- somāgneṣu aiṣṭikeṣu anvādhānaṃ kāryaṃ, iti prāpte, tasya dhāraṇatvāt somārthadhāraṇenaiva ca prasaṅgasiddheḥ na kartavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
idaṃ anvādhānaṃ ityucyate, anvāhitaḥ iti ca |
ke. anvādhānaṃ aiṣṭikaṃ jyotiṣṭome saumikaviharaṇena prasaṅgasiddhatvāt pṛthak na kāryam |
anvādhānaṃ jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu devatāparigrahārthamapi na kartavyaṃ, pradhānade- vatāvatat ajñadevatānāmapi gṛhītatvāt |
bhā. 12|1|12 | 24-28, anvādhānaṃ yadi devatāparigrahārthaṃ, tadapi nirśauṣṭau medena kartavyam |
prākṛtena agnya- nvādhāne amāvāsyādevatāḥ parigṛhṇītāḥ, na ca rakṣohā''dibhiḥ parigṛhṇītaḥ |
anvādhānaṃ ye yājñikāḥ yajamānakartṛkameva pakṣe vadanti, teṣāṃ ita eva mantravarṇāt ( mamāgne varcaḥ ) bhrāntiḥ |
atha tu kiṃ cidacanamupayasyanti tathāpi kiṃ karmavikalpavat phalaṃ adhvaryuyajamānayorvikalpate kiṃvā nityameva yājamānaṃ iti vicāraḥ |
' mamāgne varco'stu ' ityapi yajamā- nasya varco mameti vyapadiśati lakṣaṇayā |
evaṃ śrūyate ' yaḥ pūrvaiyuḥ agniṃ gṛhṇāti sa vai śrobhūte devatā abhi- yajete ' iti |
12|4|125, anvādhānasya devatāparigrahārthatā vākyaśeṣe śrūyate ' mamāgne varco videveṣvastu iti pūrvamagniṃ parigṛhṇāti devatā eva tat pūrvaiyuḥ parigṛhṇītāḥ, śrobhūte yajete ' iti |
anvādhānādīnāṃ kariṣyamāṇaṃ pradhānaṃ nimittaṃ, svitkṛtādādīnāṃ tu kṛtam |
anvādhānādi prāgupākara- ṇāt sādhāraṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ sakṛt kṛtam |

' agne''nubrūhi ' ityādiva ' agniṃ yaja ' ' ye yajāmahe'gniṃ ' iti tattaddevatānāṃ yoge samadaśāstrasva- bhaṅgapatteḥ niyamādṛṣṭaviśeṣāt ayuktakalpane mānābhāvāt ākāṅkṣitakarmapadasya ' chinadmi ' ityādivat arthā- dhyāhāro'pi upapatteḥ agnipadasyāhāre'pi tasya praipādau prativacanānte eva niyame'pi mānābhāvāt dvayakṣarapañcākṣarāveva tau prayojyau, iti prāpte, sarvadevatā- padasādhāraṇaṃnvādhāyāpi samadaśāstratvopapatteḥ |
arthā- dhyāhārasya nirastatvācca devatāviśeṣapadamanantareṇa tyāga- viśeṣaprapattirabhāvena anantarādhikaraṇasiddhadṛṣṭārthatvabhaṅga- patteśca devatānāmādeśaḥ |
ata eva śāstrāntare ' amuṣmā anubrūhi ', ' amuṃ yaja ' ityādidhvanyaḥ devatānāmaviśeṣopalakṣakaḥ adaḥśabdaḥ śrūyate |
' asāvehi ' ' avadhiyā'muṃ ' ' idamahamamuṣya ' ityādivacanaiḥ devatāpadārthaparyanīyamo'pi etadalladeva |

yattu liṅgadarśanamuktaṃ mūle ' yat tanūnapātaṃ yaja iḍo yajeti brūyājmi syāt yajayajetyeva brūyāt ' mī. ko. 18 ' mārutasyādhvanya marudbhyo'nubrūhītyāśrāvya maruto yajeti brūyāt ' ityādijñāpakāt anyatrāpi devatā- padaprāptiḥ ' iti tanna śāstrāntare ' tanūnapātaṃ yaja ' ityeva pāṭhāt tanniṣedhārthatvena pūrvasya, itarasya tu vidhirūpatvenāpi upapatteḥ viparītasādhakaṃ iti tatraivauktam |
sapatnīkasya saputrasya gṛhasthasya agnihotradarśapūrṇa- māseṣṭijyotiṣṭomādisarvaśrautakarmānuṣṭhānārthaṃ prathamaṃ trayaḥ pañca vā agnayaḥ vidhinā sthāpanīyāḥ |
anena karmaṇā saṃskṛtatve āhavanīyādiṣu śrautāni karmāṇi bhavanti |
idameva ādhānaṃ, anvādhānaṃ, agnyā- dheyaṃ iti śabdairucyate |
agnyādheyaṃ na pavamāneṣṭyathaṃ kiṃtu pavamāneṣṭaya eva agnyārthāḥ |
agnyādheyasya naimittike guṇavikāre dakṣiṇādānamadhikaṃ syād vākyasaṃyogāt |
ādhāne ' ekā deyā, ṣaḍ deyāḥ, dvādaśa deyāśrutivi- śatideyāḥ, śataṃ deyaṃ, sahasraṃ deyaṃ, aparimitaṃ deyaṃ ' iti dakṣiṇā śrutā |
atha ' yo'gninādhāya bhāgyajyāni putrajyāni vā jīyeta sa punarādadhīta ' ( jyāniḥ hāniḥ nāśaḥ ) iti naimittikaṃ punaragnyādheyaṃ śrutam |

' puna- niṣkṛto rathau dakṣiṇā ', ' punarastyutaṃ vāso dakṣiṇā, punarasyute''naḍvān ' iti vākyena vikāre bādhe prāpte'pi, dakṣiṇādānaṃ adhikaṃ syāt vākyasaṃyogāt ' ubhayīdadāti agnyādheyikīśca punarādheyikīśca ' iti |
tasmāt punarādhāne prathamānnyādheyikāḥ punarādheyikā- śceti ubhayordakṣiṇayoḥ samuccayaḥ, na tu agnyādheyikāḥ punarādheyikā vā iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
yathāsthānaṃ sthānaṃ kramamana- tikramya kramānusāreṇa itarāsāṃ vaikṛtībhyo bhinnānāṃ
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtrābhyāṃ prāptaṃ tuśabdena vyāvartayan siddhāntamāha |
yadi 'punaralubdho rayo dakṣiṇā, punaralubdho vāsaḥ, punaralubdho'naḍvān' iti punaralu- bdhānaṃ ādhānaprakaraṇe bhavet, tataḥ tat ādhāna- dakṣiṇāṃ na bādheta |
apakaraṇe tu ādhānaprakaraṇānā- bhāve yat punarādhāne punaralubdhatvādi vidhīyate, tat kāmyānāṃ prākṛtaṃ nityaṃ vādhānameva niviśate |
evaṃ ca punarādhānadakṣiṇā ādhānadakṣiṇāyā bādhaḥ, na samuccayaḥ |
apakaraṇe hi yasmāt kāmyāni paṭhitāni iti sūtra- padānyatra |
hi yasmāt kāmyāni punarādhānadakṣiṇā- dravyāṇi apakaraṇe ādhāna

iha tu aindrayāyavādivadevatāviśiṣṭagrahaṇasvarūpasya alaukikadevatāghaṭitatayā śnādiratvādiṣat lokaprasiddhatvā- bhāvena tatsvarūpajñāpanāyatayā dvādaśādhyāyakaṇe vyūhāmnāna- syaiva prakaraṇamānānasthārthatvena ānarthakyānmānāt na tanmātreṇa ṛtvarthatvasyāpi lābha: |
eva- mapi 'aindrayāyavaṃ' ityādidvitīyasaṃyogāt yāgīyadravya- saṃskārārthatvāvagamane tadralādeva ṛtvarthatve'pi tadvākya- syaiva tātparyakalpanāaucityāt |
kevalasvarūpajñāpanārthatve tu vyūhāmnānavat svaprādhānyenaiva grahaṇāmāmnānaṃ syāt, na tu ṛtvarthadravyasaṃskārakatvena |

tasmādiha saṃskārakatvāmnāna- tvāt aindrayāyavādiprāptikavidhividhīnāṃ ṛtvarthatātātparyeṇa pravṛttānāṃ pratyakṣaṃ svarūpajñāpanadvārā kāmasaṃyogavākye'pi upakārakatvamātraṃ, na tu etāvatā kāmārthatvameveti |
kiṃca 'vāgyai' ityādisāmānādhikaraṇyāpi na sākṣāt ṛtusaṃyoga:, kiṃtu prātisvikavidhisiddhānāṃ punarāmnānārthakatvāt kalpanīya: |
tat varaṃ saṃskārakatvabalāt ṛtvarthatvakalpanaṃ, punarāmnānamapi ca uktarītyā upaśantvarthāmayo: kāmya- śukrāgratvādiguṇaṃ prati āśrayatvavyāvartanena arthavadeva, iti kathaṃ tadānarthakyam |
sūtrārthastu- aindrayāyavāt purastāt upaśantvarthā- mayordhvaṃ śukrāderapakarṣa: syāt dhārāgrāhakādhikāreṇa tasyaiva kāmyāpratādeśatvena kṛtatvāt iti |
' sa pūrvokta: pratikarṣa: sarvādā upaśaṃropi purastāt, aindrayāya- vādau vā syāt iti saṃśaya: |
dhārāgrahaṇāmāmnāyāt 'dhārayeyustaṃ' iti dhute: uttatvāt aindrayāyavādau pratikarṣa iti siddhānta: |
bhāṭṭa- pratikarṣo'pi grahapadeśako pramāṇābhāvāt mahāprakaraṇena sarvagrahaṇāmevāśrayalopapatte:, 'vāgyā eṣā' ityasya ca prayojanāntarasadbhāvena mahāprakaraṇatvādhakalpyānu- papatte: |

iti prāpte, tanvaranāyuktaprayojanasya dūṣitatvena prayojanāntarasyāpi avāntaraprakaraṇasaṃvādanadvāreva prayojanatvāt, tatlāpaṭane ca tena dhārāgrahaṇāmevāśrayatvopapattesteṣveva pūrve śukrāde: pratikarṣa: |
nyāyabindu: - aviśeṣātsarvādāita: śukragraha:, iti prāpte, aindrayāyavādvidhārāgrahaṇāṃ prakṛtatvāccāśrayaiva śukrāgratā phale vidhīyate iti na sarvādāita: pratikarṣa: |
idamaiva vakṣyamāṇānāṃ 'aindrayāyavā grāhā gṛhyante' iti kīrtanasya prayojanaṃ yattepāmāśrayatvalābha iti siddhānta: |
jyotiṣṭomādau ye dhārāgrahā gṛhyante, teṣu ko graha ādau grāhya: ityatra sāmabhedena bheda ukta: |
'yadi ratha- tarasāmā soma: syāt aindrayāyavān grahān gṛhṇīyāt, yadi vahnisāmā śukrāgrān, yadi jagatsāmā āgrayaṇa- ān' ityādinā |
bṛhatsāmatve śukragraha: ādau gṛhyate tata: aindrayāyavādaya: evaṃ sarvatra |
ke. amṛtāyā eva deśo vijñāta:, yat upaśantvarthāmābhyāmpūrve purastācccandrāvavasya |
puruṣārthalakṣaṇe'pi kāmyakāle upanayanādyāśritapañcamavarṣādau, kāmyajātau ca dadhivādi- rūpāyāmatīḥ; tayorananuṣṭheyatvāt |
kiṃca ādhānādhyayana- yorubhayabhinnatvena tannarannokteḥ tatra katvarthatvalakṣaṇāti- vyāptiḥ |
etenetikartavyatātvenānvitatvaṃ katvarthatvaṃ, tadvicchatvaṃ puruṣārthatvamiti śāstradīpakoktamapi parā- stam |
tasyāpi vyāpārādiṣviti itikartavyatātvamiti yadi vibhāvyate, tadā dagdhaḥ ubhayārthatvāt tatra tadvicchatvābhāvāt puruṣārthalakṣaṇasyāvyāptiriti dhyeyam |

(bhāṭṭadīpikācaturthādhyāyasthamanudya dūṣayati - ) ke cit svaprārthitatvacyutadeśatayānirūpitavidheyatāśālitvaṃ puruṣārthatvaṃ, svaprārthitabhinnavṛttayuddeśatayānirūpitavidheya- tāśālitvaṃ katvarthatvam |
uddedyatāvidheyate ca svarūpasaṃbandharūpe, na tu sādhyatvā- nuṣṭheyātmike |
na vā puruṣārtheṣu abhyanujñāvidhiṣu doṣābhāva- ddeśena tattatkriyāvidhāne'pivyāptiḥ |
ādhānādhyayana- yostu svaprārthitabhinnārthajñānoddeśena vidhānāt katva- rthatvasvīkāre'pi na doṣaḥ |
'phalaṃ ca puruṣārthatvāt' (3|1|315) ityatra tu phale puruṣārthatvavyavahāraḥ aṅgatva- vyavahāravadvākta ityāhuḥ |
'agnam' iti mantrasya liṅgakalpitaśrutyā svaprārthita- svargoddeśena vidhānāt tatra puruṣārthatvalakṣaṇasyātivyāptiḥ |
kiṃca 'hīṣpati vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt' ityādau vṛṣṭyāyuddeśena svāsādhanasaubharīnidhanādhāratvasaṃbandhena vidhīyamāneṣu hīṣpādiṣu lakṣaṇasyātivyāpyavyāptī ( puruṣārthalakṣaṇa-

śāstrābhāvena saubharīnidhanādhā- ratayā vihitānāṃ hīṣpādināmaniyamena vṛṣṭyarthasaubharīya- nidhanādhāratvaprāptau 'hīṣ iti vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt' 'ūrgityagniāmāya' 'ū iti svargakāmāya' ityādi- vākyaiḥ tattatphalārthasaubharīnidhane hīṣpādīnāṃ niyamamātra- karaṇāt |
ata evoktasaṃbandhena vṛṣṭyāyuddeśena hīṣpāderapi vastutaḥ tattatphalārthasaubharīnidhane ādhāratayā hīṣpādi- yameva eva tattacchritāparyam |
na caivamapi vṛṣṭikāmādipadena vṛṣṭyādisādhanasaubharalakṣaṇā tadīyanidhanādhārasaṃbandhena hīṣpādividhirastu |
tathā coddeśyasaubharīsvaprārthita- tvābhāvāt nānyāpyatyevāstīti iti vācyam |

auttara- kālikaniyamavidhilāghavānurodhena gurudharmāvacchinne lakṣa- ṇāyā anyāyyatvāt, tadapekṣayā apūrvavidhitvāpādakasya saubharādhikaraṇāpūrvapañcamabhūmitasta (2|1|3) phalāntarodde- śena hīṣpādividhereva yuktatvena tadadhikaraṇasiddhāntānupa- patteḥ |
ato niyamavidhilāghavena tatratyasiddhāntasyoktaprakāre eva tātparyamiti sa eva tadadhikaraṇe pratipāditam |

vastutaḥ 'hīṣpati vṛṣṭi- kāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt' ityādī na vṛṣṭyāyuddeśena nirukta- saṃbandhena hīṣpādividhiḥ, tathātve hīṣpikāmapuruṣaviśeṣaṇatayā śrutāyā vṛṣṭeruddeśyatayā anvayāyogāt, vṛṣṭikāmapade vṛṣṭi- lakṣaṇāpatteśrutyāḥ karmatvalakṣaṇā''patteśca |
ato lakṣaṇā- dvayāpatterapekṣayā ekasminnidhanapade vṛṣṭiyojakanidhana- lakṣaṇāyā taduddeśenaiva hīṣpādividhiryuktaḥ |
na cāsmanmate vṛṣṭikāmādipade karmadharāyāṅgīkārān lakṣaṇāntaramaṅgīkarituṃ vācyam |

tathāpi caturthyāḥ svaśakyatāvacchedakatvānavacchinnakarmatvalakṣaṇayā nidhana- padena svaśakyatāvacchedakatvānavacchinnaniruktanidhanalakṣaṇayā ucitatvāt, vidhisaṃnihitasya padasyoddeśyasamarpakatve saṃbhavati viprakṛṣṭapadasya tathātvāyogyāt |
api ca bhava- nmata nidhanapadānuvādo niṣprayojanaḥ |
na ca saṃbandha- tātparyagrāhakatvayā tadupayogaḥ, niyamavidhilāghavānugṛhīta- bhinnāṅgatvameva katvarthatvamiti na katvarthatvalakṣaṇe pūrvoktāvyāpyatyevāstīti cenna |
asti cedaṃ svargāddeśena vidhīyamānajyotiṣṭomādau, anirdiṣṭa- prakārasvargādirūpe ānarthakyābhāvena tanniṣṭhoddeśyatāyāḥ svargatvādinevāvacchedatvāt |
tatra svargādiniṣṭhoddeśyatāyā apūrvīyatvāvacchinna- tvasya nanva ( 1|1|3 ) pratipāditatvān doṣaḥ |
ā i- vanīyādirūpe ānarthakyābhāvena āhavanīyatvāderevodde- śyatāvacchedakatvena apūrvīyatvānavacchinnoddeśyatānirūpita- vidheyatātvaviśeṣaṇam |
ata eva hīṣpādītyādyasaṅka- prakāre nidhanādiniṣṭhoddeśyatayā vṛṣṭiyojakanidhanatvāva- cchinnā apūrvīyatvānavacchinnatve'pi svaprārthitatvṛtti- tvābhāvāt nātivyāptiḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsasvarūpe ānarthakyena apūrvīyatve- naiva tayoruddeśyatvatvāt svaprārthitatvitvābhāvāt |

apūrvīyatvānavacchinnatvābhā- mātroktau 'yūpaṃ chinatti' 'hiraṇyakalaśasahasreṇa prokṣati' ityādau yūpadirūpe ānarthakyābhāvena apūrvī- yatvalakṣaṇābhāvāt yūpadāderupadāderupaderupadeśyatayā cheda- nādau atyāptiḥ |
nanu 'tate payasi dadhyanayati' ityatra paya uddeśya dadhyanayanaṃ vidhīyate iṣṭame (8|2|4) |
etadvākyapra- vṛtteḥ pūrvaṃ payasa apūrvasādhanatvānavagamena payaḥpadena lakṣa- ṇā'yogāt |

nahi 'vrīhinevahanti' ityādivākya- nirapekṣapravṛttikena 'vrīhibhiryajeta' ityādivākyena vrīhīṇāmiva prakṛtavākyanirapekṣeṇa kena cidvākyena paya- so'pūrvasādhanatvamavagataṃ, yena lakṣyatāvacchedakasya pūrva- mupasthitatvāt tadavacchinne avaghātādivākyasthavrīhipada- syaiva payaḥpadasya lakṣaṇa bhavet |

prayogagrāhibhūtatvāgamāt vājapeyasvarūpe iya tajjanyaparamāpū- rvasvarūpe'pi ānarthakyāt prakaraṇakalpitavākyena, vaibhratha- nyāyena (4|3|11) vā bṛhaspatisavasya nāpūrvasādhanībhūta- vājapeyoddeśena vidhānaṃ, api tu svārājyabhūtaphalasādhanī- bhūtavājapeyoddeśena tatra ca vidhiyoddeśena vidhāne'pi viśeṣaṇoddeśena vidhānasya āvaśyakatvāt svārājyo- ddeśenāpi bṛhaspatisavavidhiriti sarveṣveva svaprārthita- vattuyaddevatāghaṭitalakṣaṇeṣu bṛhaspatisavasya navyoktahīprādi- sthalīyaprakāre hīpādī nātivyāptiḥ |
apūrvāvacchinnatvaghaṭi- tatkatvarthatvalakṣaṇe cātivyāptiḥ sūkṣmamīkṣyate tadā puruṣā- rthatvalakṣaṇe svoddeśyatā'navacchedakatvaṃ svaprārthitatvaviśeṣa- ṇam |
'aganyaṃ' ityasya ca apūrvīyasvargoddeśena vidhau apūrvoddeśena vidhiravadavyakatvāt apūrvaniyogedevatāmādāya sarvametana- vyam |
kriyārūpakatvarthaṃ ca dvividhaṃ saṃnipatyopakārakaṃ, ārādupakārakaṃ ceti |
'agnīṣomīyasya vapathā prancaryāgnīṣomīya paśupuroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapeta' itya- nenotpannaḥ paśupuroḍāśāgo hi strītvoddeśena paśu- yāgīyadevatāsaṃskārārtha ityuktaṃ dadyāme (10|1|9) |
atra 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati' ityādau parṇatādeḥ siddharūpa- katvarthasya dravyaniṣṭhoddeśyatānirūpitavidheyatāśālitvā- tivyāptirata: karmalopādānam |
anyathā puruṣoddeśena vidhīyamānadīkṣaṇīyāderiva svarga- kāmapuruṣādyuddeśena vidhīyamānajyotiṣṭome'pi saṃni- patyopakārakatvāpatterityāhuḥ |
bhāvanāyā bhāvyakāṅkṣāyāṃ siddharūpasya bhāvyavāyogena svargakāmādipadasya lakṣaṇayā svargādiparatvāt |
yadvā tu uddiṣṭādeḥ padavādidravyoddeśena vidhānāttrātivyāptiriti vibhāvyate, tadā astu prakṛtalakṣaṇe katvarthatvaniveśaḥ |
eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇānāmākaroktalakṣaṇasyānugatananu- gatī sudhībhirbhāvanīya ityalaṃ pallavitena |
tādṛśaṃ ca vikṛtau arthāntare tatkāryapārthe uhitavyaṃ bhavati |
yatra punaḥ svarūpamaṅgasya dharmasaṃnbandhe kāraṇaṃ bhavati, tat svarūpamaṅgakam |
tatra yadyapi tena dharmavatā apūrva sādhyatvānamapūrva na dharmasya prayogahetubhūtaṃ bhavati, na tat prayojakam |
tasya svarūpaṃ vidyate iti na dharmaḥ prayujyate |
tatra vikṛtau arthāntare tadpābhāvāt ūho nāvakalpate |
vakṣyati hi (3|4|14|13) na cāvihitamaṅgaṃ bhavati iti |
nahi anupakurvat kiṃ cidapi aṅgaṃ kasya cit bhavet |
ke. nahi pradhānaṃ pradhānana aṅgaṅgena saṃtrayaṃvaṃ yāti |
bhā. 10|8|17|19, aṅgāni aveṣṭipaśu na tantraṃ, rājasūye |
bhā. 11|4|18|10- aṅgāni itaretarayuktāni anūpa- kāraṃ kurvanti iti pūrvasminnadhikaraṇe (11|1|15-10) avagatam |
aṅgāni kāni cit ārādupakārakāṇi, kāni cit saṃnipatyopakāra- kāṇi |
‘aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt’ iti antarāgarbhitanyāye aṅgajñānāṃ pradhānakālatauktā |

su. pṛ. 736, ‘aṅgāni tu’ iti ekādaśādhikaraṇasiddhānte ya eva pradhāne deśa- kālakartāraḥ, ta evāṅgeṣu iti yat aṅgapradhāneṣu kartṛtvanvābhidhānaṃ, tat dakṣiṇāyāḥ sarvārthatve sati upapadyate nānyathā |
‘aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt’ ( 11|1|12 ) iti nyāyasya svarūpa-’cikīrṣitasya hi kasmin kāle kartavyaṃ iti kālāpekṣā |
phalārthinaśca phalasāmagrībhūta- sāṅgapradhānagocaraḥ phalabhāvanākhyo vyāpāra eva cikī- rṣito na pradhānamātra, aṅgānuṣṭhānābhāve phalānivṛtteḥ |
ataḥ ākāṅkṣāvaśāt sāṅgapradhānasyaiva kālasaṃbandho na pradhānamātrasya anākāṅkṣitatvāt ' iti soma. 4|3| 18 pṛ. 393 |
nanu yāvanmātrādhānasya yajurveda- vihitaṃ tanmātrasyaivāpāṃśutvamityavagataṃ naiva sāma- gānasya prāpnoti, pradhānamātraṃ ca aṅgāntrāṇi ca yājurvedikāni, tena teṣāṃ kevalamupāṃśutvamiti |
samastaviṣayakavyāpārātmakaprayoge eva kartṛsaṃbandhaḥ iti ' aṅgāni tu ' ityadhikaraṇe vyavasthāpiyate |
bhā. 11|4| 11-3, aṅgāni dvividhāni ārādupakāra- kāṇi sāmavātrikāni ca |
ārādupa- kārakeṣu tu prakṛtena parokṣeṇa ekavākyatā syāt |
10|4|19|38, aṅgāni na tantraṃ rājasūyatājñā- vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ pṛthagdakṣaṇāyuktānām |
'pañca prayājān yajati' iti saṃkṣepeṇa, 'samidho yajati' ityevamādinā vistareṇa |
aṅgāni pradhānavedapadeśaṃ labhante iti guṇamukhyavyatikrame ( 3|1|2|9 ) ityatra vyākhyātam |
aṅgāni pradhānasavyadṛṣṭetāni, yatra pradhānaṃ tatra vijñāyante |
yadya pradhānaṃ tasya akālānyaṅgāni, yat śraḥ tasya śraḥ kālāni |
bhā. 11|4|16|23, aṅgāni pradhānāni ca kartṛtulyāni 'darśapūrṇamāsayoścāvara ṛtvijaḥ' iti |
11|1|10|16, aṅgāni pradhānena phalasiddhau upadiśyamāne saha upadiśyante |
aṅgāni prayājāyāgādīni karaṇe bhinnopakārān saṃpādayantīti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
dvārabhede'pi upakāraḥ eka eva iti siddhāntaḥ |
dṛṣṭameva tu arthe aṅgāni kurvanti pradhānasaṅgatatvāt |
bhā. 11|1|17|35, na ādhāra: kutamātra eva pradhānamupakaroti |
yat kāraṇaṃ tasmin kāle pradhānanye na santi |
yadā tu sarvāṇyaṅgāni kṛtāni, tadā tajjanya- pūrvāṇi saṃbhūya pradhānanyūpakurvanti |
du.pa. 11|1|4|11 pradhā- nāyana hi aṅgāni upadiśyante |
bhā. 11|1|10|54 śrutiliṅgādi- ṣaṭkasahitena viniyogavidhānā samidādimadhikṛtya 'darśa- pūrṇamāsyāṃ yajeta' ityevarūpeṇa yāni viniyujyante tānyaṅgāni |
kriyārūpāṇi ca dvividhāni guṇakarmoṇi pradhānakarmāṇi ceti |
kāni cidvijñāni samuccayena anuṣṭheyāni iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
sarvāṇyajñānāṃ samuccaya ekopakārajananena karaṇākāṅkṣāṃ pūrayanti iti sarvāṇyeva ajñānāṃ samuccayena anu- ṣṭheyāni iti siddhāntaḥ |
vi. 11|1|3 ajñānāṃ kālasya ekādaśanyāyena (11|2|13-10) prayogā- nvayaḥ |
soma. 5|1|17 ajñānāṃ keṣāṃ cit vaca- nādanyakālatvaṃ sarvārthanāmapi |
ajñānāṃ tu śabdabhedāt ṛtuvat syāt phalānyatvam |
yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pradhānānāṃ samavetānāṃ phalaṃ naivamajñānām |
bhāṣyaṃ--idaṃ vicāryate kiṃ agnihotrādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ ekadeśāṅgyuktānāmapi prayogaḥ, athavā sarvāṅgopasaṃhāre- ṇaiveti|
atha tatra kiṃ vṛttaṃ 'sarvaśaktau pravṛttiḥ syāt' (6|1|1) iti, tatra naiyamikamārgamaṃ prati cintā kṛtā|
'yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityanayā codanayā yo'yaṃ yāvajjīvikaḥ prayoganiyama ucyate, kiṃ tatra sarvāṅgopasaṃhāraḥ; uta neti|
'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityanayā codanayā yo'yaṃ svargārtha ārambhaḥ, tatrāpi kiṃ naiyamikameva prayogaḥ; uta sarvāṅgopasaṃhāra iti|
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ? 'ekenāpi samāpyeta kṛtārthatvād yathā krvantareṣu prāpteṣu cottarāvata syāt|
ke. tri - 'upakāraḥ sa ekena kaiścidvā nikhilaista |
ajñānāṃ tu śabdabhedāt katuvana syāt phalānyatvam |
bhāṣya - agneyu idānīṃ cintā kimjñānā saṃbhūya kāryaṃ kurvanti, uta bhedeneti |
yathā pradhā- nānāṃ sametānāmekaṃ phalaṃ, naivamajñānām |
tasmin ākāṅkṣitatvāt saṃnidhā- nācca etat bhavati, ayamasmin vyāpāraḥ, yena yāgaḥ svarge karotīti|
athavā pradhānānāṃ phalaṃ prati, aṅgānāṃ ca pradhānāni prati vidhiriviruddhaḥ|
yathā ‘etasyaiva revatīṣu vāravantīyamagniṣṭomasāma kṛtvā paśu- kāmo hyena yajeta’ iti |
tasmāt pradhānaprayogavacane- naiva aṅgānāṃ prayogo vidhīyate iti |
kathaṃ ? ‘yajeta’ ityasmin bhāvanācacane uccarite'tiśa ākāṅkṣā jāyante |
tatra kimarthaṃ bhāvyo yaḥ puruṣārthaḥ, sa upanipatati |
yā tu utpattivākye viniyoga- vākye ca ekaikasyāsya nirapekṣasya sādhanatā, sā utpattivākye pradhānānāmiva antarakāryanirūpitā iti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
ata eva tatra prayogaśākyāvagata- samuccyānurodhena avāntarakāryeṣu vaijātyakalpanā |
para- māpūrvasthānāpanna akhaṇḍakaraṇarūpa apūrve yadi pradhānaissyāta, tadā aṅgeṣvapi āvadyakaṃ, anyathā tatrāpi na, iti kāstvabhe vistaraḥ |
avāntarakāryaṃ tu yatra prayogavidhitaḥ pūrvaṃ naikāva pramāṇāntareṇāvadhāritaṃ, tatra prayogavidhinā samuccayaivāvagamāt bhedakalpanaiva |
yatra tu ekatvameva sāmarthyādinā avadhāritaṃ yathā vrīhyādau, tatra vaikalpikopyeṣa prayogavidhinā prayogavidhāne'pi na samuccayaḥ |
yatra vā eka- paśvādyarthacitrādīnāṃ dṛṣṭārthānāmapi naikaprayogavidhiviṣayatā, tatra samuccayagrāhakamamāṇābhāvena vikalpa eva sāmye, vaigamye tu phalabhūmā iti dhyeyam |
bhāṣyaṃ- jyotiṣṭome dīkṣaṇīyā 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekā- daśakapālaṃ nirvapet dīkṣaṇīyāḥ' iti |
tayoḥ parvakālaḥ 'ya iṣyā paśunā somena vā yajeta so'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā yajeta' iti vacanāt |
yadā 'ekā dīkṣā, tisra upasadaḥ' ityeva- mādayaḥ kalpāḥ, tadā virodhaḥ |
tatra cintā kiṃ dīkṣā parvaṇi kartavyā aparvaṇi sutyā, uta viparyaya iti |
aṅgaguṇe pradhānaguṇasya virodhe etasmin aṅgaguṇo bādhyeta |
aṅgaṃ guṇavat kriyate pradhānaṃ saguṇaṃ syāditi |
taccet aṅge guṇavati kriyamāṇe viguṇamāpadyate, ko- ''ṅgena guṇavatā kṛtam |
tasmāt parvaṇi sutyā kartavyā, aparvaṇi dīkṣā |

sudhā- 'ya iṣyā paśunā somena vā yajeta so'- māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā' iti dīkṣaṇīyeṣyādīnāṃjñānāṃ pradhānasya ca somasya bahudinavyavadhānane ubhayoḥ parva- kālasaṃpādanādyataḥḥ kiṃ parvaṇaḥ somaḥ : aparvaṇi dīkṣā, viparītaṃ vā iti saṃdigdhe, prābhyāt dīkṣyāḥ parvakālave prāpte, 'pradhānasādaguṇyārthatvād‌aṅgānuṣṭhānasya pradhānasyaiva parvakālataḥ' iti vyavasthā |

śā- dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ somasya 'ya iṣyā paśunā somena' ityādi vacanena ekakālatve prāpte sati, ekādi- dīkṣāpakṣe dvayoḥ kālasambhavāt kasya kālo'nugrāha iti vicāre aniyamaḥ, mukhyatvādā dīkṣaṇīyādharmāṃnugrahe prāpte, pradhānadharmatvāt sutyākālānugrahaḥ |
sarvāṇi aṅgāni tada- jñāni ca pradhānasādaguṇyāya kriyante |
na tu paroktarityā aṅgakālānugrahe sa eva kālaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- aṅgaguṇena pradhānaguṇasya virodhe pradhānaguṇānugraha eva nyāyyaḥ |

bhāṣya- yatra tu mukhyamaṅgaṃ yathā dīkṣaṇīyā prathama- dinakartavyā, yatra vā bahunyaṅgāni yathā aupasatthe ahni upasad‌gopīmīyapaśupuroḍāśādi, pradhānaṃ tu jaghanyaṃ ekaṃ ca, somayāgaḥ pañcamadinakartavyaḥ; tatra 'ya iṣyā' ityādivākyena vihitaparvakālavirodhe pradhānasyaiva dharmān- grahaḥ, aṅgānāṃ tu pradhānasādaguṇyārthatvena tadirodhe aṅga- sādaguṇyasya akiṃcitkaratvāt, loke prathamaṃ bahubhiravaruddhe sthale paścādāgatena ekenāpi rājñā tad‌grahadarśanāt |
atastatra somayāgasyaiva pāṭhataḥ anuṣṭhānataśca jaghanya- syāpi pradhānatayā parvakālakatvam |
dīkṣaṇīyādestu pāṭhataḥ anuṣṭhānataśca prathamoṣitatve'pi ekādīkṣāpakṣe na parvā- nugrahaḥ |
ataśca tatra sutyādināvādhikatattaddinakartavyatāyoktavacananimita- tattatkālatvena prasaṅgasiddhiḥ parvakālasya, iti prasaṅgānu- papannabādhaprasaṅgena vā bādhavicāraḥ prāsaṅgikaḥ |
nayacindu- dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ somasya ca parvakālatvaṃ 'ya iṣyā paśunā somena' ityādivacanāt |
tatra dvayoḥ tadasaṃbhavāt mukhyatvena dīkṣaṇīyā'nugrahaprāptau pradhā- natayā somāṅgānugrahaḥ |
pūrvapakṣe prāpte, cakāreṇa tuśabdasthānīyena pūrvapakṣa- nirāsaṃ sūcayan siddhāntamāha |
aṅgaguṇena pradhānaguṇasya virodhe sati aṅgasya pradhānārthatvāt |
tasmāt parvaṇi sutyā apa- rvaṇi dīkṣā kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
tathā ca pradhānaguṇena aṅgaguṇasya virodhe sati iṣyarthayojanā |
su. pṛ. 167. yadi guṇamukhyavyatikramaḥ aṅgapradhānadharmavirodhe vyā- khyāyate, tataḥ 'aṅgaguṇavirodhe ca tādarthyāt' ityanena saha apaunaruktyaṃ saṃpradhāraṇīyam |

vā. 3|1|21 pṛ. 814. tadidaṃ bhāṣyakārīyamādhikaraṇaṃ (guṇamukhyavyatikramādhikaraṇaṃ 3|1|218) aṅgavedatvasyāpi uccaistvasya pradhāne śrutasya aṅgadvārā pradhānopakārakatvāt tad‌yade'pi pradhānavaiguṇyasya durvāratvāt 'aṅgaguṇavirodhe ca tādarthyāt' iti dvādaśādhi- karaṇena gataprāyatvāt pradhānavidhiśritasya pradhāne śrutasya aṅgaguṇo anuṣṭhānakalpanāsya gurutvāt |
ku. 3|1|218. 'nartaṃ pratīkṣeta' ityādinā ādhānaprakaraṇāt tasya kālaḥ pratiṣidhyate na somasya, aprakṛtatvāt |
evaṃ ca aṅgagu- ṇaguṇanyāyasya avirodho bhavati |
somāṅgaṃ hi abhayaḥ, teṣāmapi aṅgapradhānaṃ iti tasyaiva kālavādho yuktaḥ |
(pūrvapakṣe) ratna. 5141. aṅgaguṇanyāyaviro- dhādapi liṅgasya prātipadikavācyatāmabhyupetya jātervācya- tvanirāso na yuktaḥ |
bahuvrīhijñāpakatva vaidikeḥ paṭhyamānatvāt bahuvrīhitvāvagateḥ, sambhave vaiguṇyāpādkāṅgayāgāyogāt ayuktā |
tatpuruṣasvīkāre ca antodāttatvāpatteḥ, kathaṃ tatpuruṣasvīkaraṇaṃ su. pṛ 1483. aṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyena āhavanīyā- |
satyapi bahuvrīhipakṣe svare pradhāna- bhāve laukike'yamau hoyamānāṃ kartuṃ śakyatvāt |
bhūtasvārthānugrāhakāt tatpuruṣāvadhāraṇāt śabdadharmasya svarasya pūrvapakṣe ) ku. 3|4|13|2. aṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyena |
‘supūtituṣprahaliṅganānāṃ’ ityevaṃ upakārake ādhane eva ‘nartaṃ pṛcchenna nakṣatraṃ ’ ityanena |
samantrakarmavidhivattvāt, parvani adhyayananiṣedhācca mantrāṇāṃ 5|4|15. anunirvāpyāṇāṃ devasuvāṃ haviṣāṃ agnyarthatayā |
mantradharmaparityāgena mantraprayogasya nyāyyatvāt, ‘parvaṇi ḍāśamanu nirvapati’ iti kālārtha eva saṃyogaḥ, na tu ‘vaimṛdha- |
nādhyeyaṃ’ ityasya smārtatvena grahaṇaadhyayane sāvakā- manu nirvapati’ itivat aṅgābhiprāyaḥ, tena aṅgaguṇa- |
śatvena ca, karmāṅgatvena mantravidheḥ śrautatvena niravakā- virodhanyāyena puroḍāśadharmasya grahaḥ kiṃ na syāt iti |
yatra ārlijyasaṃskārayorvirodhaḥ, tatra dvividhasyāpi punaḥprayogasya prāyaścittatvā pūrvaprayogāṅgatvān ‘tatra tad |
ko. 214|12|195.216. aṅgaguṇavirodhaviruddhayoḥ śrutyoḥ pradhānaśrutiḥ aṅga- guṇaśruteḥ balīyasī |
aṅgaguṇavirodhakārananyāyena aṅgabhūtabrahmaśabdārthakedaśaṃ jīvābhedaṃ tyaktvā pradhāna- vidhyāpekṣitasya kartukarmabhedasya grahaṇaucityāt (pūrvapakṣe) |
aṅgaguṇavirodhā- dhikaraṇanyāyena jatrādīnāmapi aparvakālatvāt dīkṣaṇīyā- dīnāmapi aparvakālatvam |
dṛṣṭa. 4|1|3|48 pṛ. 1224. aṅgaguṇena pradhānaguṇasya virodhe aṅgaguṇo bādhyeta |
bhā. 1|2|125. aṅga- guṇasya pradhānaguṇasyetyasya parvakālādeḥ pradhānaguṇa- virodhe sādṛguṇyārthanyā
nāpi vihitatvaghaṭitaṃ tat, pañcabhūtaprayājahomenādīnāṃ puro- ḍāśapravaṇatānupakāratvena tadaṅgatvāpatteḥ |
prayājādīnāṃ puroḍāśayupakāraka- tve'pi puroḍāśādyanyūpakārakatvāccāṅgatvaprasaṅga iti cet, uttānāṃ pañcatvanāpatteḥ |
prayājādīnāṃ pañcaḍāśayupakāra- katve'pi tadaprayuktatvāvyāptiḥ, puroḍāśādyanyūpayukta- tvācca na puroḍāśādyaṅgatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti cet, prakṛti- prayuktānāmajñānāṃ vikalpatvajñānāpatteḥ |
nanu yadyanyamātrāprayuktatve sati yadupakārakaṃ yat, tattadaṅgam |
yadanyamātrāprayuktatvaṃ ca yadaprayuktatve sati yadanyaprayuktatvam, lāghavāt |
yadaprayuktatvasya niveśe apra- yojyakāladeyādyaṅgeṣu avyāptiḥ, ato viśiṣṭābhā- saṃparye yadanyaprayuktatvarūpaṃ viśeṣyam |
(evaṃ yadanyaprayukta- tvasya niveśe vikṛtyubhayaprayuktapānāmajñānāṃ vikalpatva- jñānāpatteḥ, ato yadaprayuktatve sati iti viśeṣaṇaṃ bodhyam |
) evaṃ ca prākṛtājñānāṃ vikṛtyanyaprayuktatve'pi vikṛ- tyaprayuktatvābhāvāt viśeṣaṇābhāvamaprayuktyabhāvasattvena yadanyamātrāprayuktatvam |

'puroḍāśapālena tupāpūpati' ityatra hi 'kapāleṣu puroḍāśaṃ śrapayati' ityanena puroḍāśaprayuktatvenāgatatva kapālasya tupopā- pājtvena vidhānāt puroḍāśapālasya na tupopāpayu- kālmityuktaṃ caturthe (4|1|12|16) |
atastūpa- vāpānāṃ puroḍāśamātrāprayuktatvān puroḍāśapālasya tupopa- vāpāṅgatvajñānāpatteḥ |
yadi tu yadanyaprayuktatvānaccheda- kakārakatvā'vacchedakarūpavat tat tadaṅgamiyanavaccheda- katvaghaṭitaṃ tat, tathā ca prākṛtājñānāṃ vikṛtyanyūpa- pattiḥ |
prākṛtājñānāṃ tāvadvikṛtyupakāraka- na prakṛtiprayuktatvāvacchedakasamidhādinā, samitvāderadanu- gatatvena pratyekatādeśakalpane gauravāpatteḥ |
api tu darśa- pūrṇamāsasaṃbandhasya sarvānyānyanugamasya darśapūrṇamāsa- saṃbandhairvikṛtimupakuryādityekātideśakalpanāyā nirukta- rūpeṇopakārakatvam |

ataśca vikṛtyanyaprayuktatvānacchedakaprakṛtisaṃbandha- tvarūpavikṛtyupakārakatvā'vacchedakadharmatvena prākṛtā- jñānāṃ vikṛtyajñatvāpattiḥ, na vā puroḍāśapālasya tupopāpājtvājñānāpattiḥ, kapālasya puroḍāśaprayuktatvāva- cchedakatvena puroḍāśīyatvasya ca tupopāpakārakatvā'- vacchedakatvena puroḍāśaprayuktatā'navacchedakapuroḍāśīyatvarūpa- tupopāpakārakatvā'vacchedakarūpavattvādi vibhāṣyate |
na ca prakṛte'- nyaprayuktatvaṃ anyaniṣṭedeyatāni rūpakatvividhayam |
(anupādeyapañcāsādhāraṇaṃ ca, kṛtisamavāyāghaṭita- saṃbandhena prakṛtabhāvānā'nvitatve sati prakṛtividhivaprayuktyavi- payatvarūpaṃ jñeyam |
'deśaḥ kālo nimittaṃ ca phalaṃ saṃskārya- meva ca |
kartustadekatvasya copādeyatvenābhimatasya vidhiyuktyavi- yatvena tatrātivyāptivāraṇāya kṛtisamavāyāghaṭitasaṃbandhene- tyādyaṃ viśeṣaṇam |
yāgādāvativyāptivāraṇāya prakṛtividhi- bodhitānuṣṭhānāviṣayatvarūpaṃ prakṛtavidhiyuktyaviṣayatvamiti ca bodhyam |
) tathā ca medādirūpe nimitte uktavidho- homale'kṣamiti vācyam |
tathāpīndriyādiprayuktatvāva- cchedakatvādinaiva homopakārakatva dadho homājñā- nāpatteḥ |

kiñca vijātīyasvarga- prayuktatvāvacchedakadarśapūrṇamāsātvādine pāpakṣayopakāraka- tvā'vacchedakadarśapūrṇamāsādīnāṃ pāpakṣayopakāraka- tvā'vacchedakatve'pi nahi svargaprayuktatvāvacchedakavaijātyatiriktaṃ pāpakṣayopakāra- katā'vacchedakaṃ vaijātyamasti, tathātve svargadharmanuṣṭhita- yogena nityasya prasaṅgiddhatvanāpatteḥ |
api ca darśapūrṇa- māsaprayuktatvāvacchedakayāgabhāgatvenaiva gṛhamedhīyopakāraka- tvāt ājyabhāgayorgṛhamedhīyājñānāpattiḥ |

tantare'tideśaprāpitājñānāṃ prakṛtisaṃbandhatvena vikṛtyapa- kārakatvadihā''jyabhāgayordarśapūrṇamāsasaṃbandhatvena gṛha- medhīyopakārakatvaṃ, yenānyaprayuktatvānacchedakadarśapūrṇamāsa- saṃbandhavyañjarūpagṛhamedhīyopakārakatvā'vacchedakarūpavattvāt ājyabhāgayorgṛhamedhīyājñatvaṃ bhavet, 'ājyabhāgau yajati' iti gṛhamedhīyaprakaraṇasthaprayatnavacanena ājyabhāgatvenai- vā''jyabhāgavidhānāt |
vastuto darśapūrṇamāsasaṃbandha- tvamapi vikṛtyuttaraprayuktatvāvacchedakaṃ bhavatyeveti satyapi tasya gṛhamedhīyopakārakatvā'vacchedakatve nā''jyabhāgayo- stadaṅgantvanivāhaḥ |

ata eva prākṛtājñānāṃ vikṛtyajñā- nāpattirapi pūrvoktā tadavasthaiva, tattadvikṛtibhedena lakṣaṇa- bhedādekavikṛtyupakārakatā'vacchedakadarśapūrṇamāsasaṃbandhatvā- derapi vikṛtyuttaraprayuktatvāvacchedakatvāt |
ata eva noktakṛtisamavāyāvityapi, kartari lakṣaṇasattve'pi prayājādāvavyāpteḥ |
yena kenāpi saṃbandhenoktakṛtitvaṃvidhilokau nimittādāvativyāptirdurvaraṃ parārthatvamiti cet |
nirūpakatvasaṃbandhena yanniṣṭhadeyatāvi- śiṣṭakṛtikārakatvena vihitaṃ yat, tattaṃ tadaṅgatvam |
evaṃ 'samidho yajati' ityādivākye'pyasthitadarśāpūrṇamāsayore- vodeyatvenānvayāt darśapūrṇamāsādestathāviśiṣṭakṛtikāraka- tvaṃ prayājādīnāmatesteṣāṃ tadaṅgatvam |
evaṃ dravyaguṇajātā- dīnāṃ karaṇatvena, kartuśca kartṛtvena, kāladeradhikaraṇatve- nānyatvaṃ vyāpyavyāptiḥ |
atra yattvatadavacchedakatvamanugamāt svarganiṣṭhadeyatāviśiṣṭakṛtikārakatvena vihitaṃ svargāṅga- tvamityevarāṃtā udeyatā'vacchedakabhedena lakṣaṇabhedo bodhyaḥ |
na lakṣatvāvacchedakabhedena, tasya lakṣaṇe aprave- śāt |
ata eva svargāṅgasakalasādhāraṇamekalakṣaṇaṃ, na tu āgneyādīṣomīyatvādibhedena lakṣaṇabhedaḥ iti dhyeyam |
prakāratayā nirūpakatvaniveśe gauravāt (nirūpakatvasya prakāratayā praveśe prakāratā'vacchedakasaṃbandhasyāpi praveśanīya- tayā gauravam |
saṃbandhavidhayā praveśe tu saṃbandhasya saṃbandha- natarāpekṣaṇāt lāghavam ) nirūpakatvasaṃbandhenokte- śyatāviśiṣṭakṛtikārakatvena vihitatvamityevaṃ saṃbandhavidhayā tanniveśaḥ |
tatyojanaṃ tu svāśrayaprayojakatvasaṃbandhena, antata ekajñānaviṣayatvādisāhacaryeṇa ca svarganiṣṭhodeyatā- viśiṣṭaprayājādyanukūlakṛtikārakatvasya prayājādau satvādi- tivyāptivāraṇam |
atra śuddhakṛtikārakatva — uddeśyatāva- śiṣṭakṛtikārakatva — niṣṭhodeyatāviśiṣṭakṛtikārakatvānāṃ prayājādau svargānadhanatvapradhāne ca satvādātivyāptirato viśi- ṣṭupāttam |
uddeśyatāvacchedakodeyatā tu na nirūpakatva saṃbandhena sannikṛṣyojyatāviśiṣṭaprayājādyanukūlakṛtikāra- katvaṃ prayājādīnāmattastadupādānam |

na ca 'svargodeyako yāgaḥ' ityādipratītyā svarganiṣṭhodeyatāni rūpakatvasya darśapūrṇamāsādāvapi satvāt, tatkārakatvasya ca tajanaka- dravyādāvapi satvāt, tatrātivyāptivāraṇameva tadyojanamiti vācyam |
svarganiṣṭhatvaṃ ca deśikā- likaviśeṣaṇatvatiriktarūpasaṃbandhena, ityatra kālika- saṃbandhena prayājādikaraṇakṛtyudeyatāyā api svargavṛtti- svarūpasaṃbandhena |
itthaṃ codeyatātvenodeyatvasyānupādāne- 'pi na kṣatiḥ, prayājādikaraṇakṛtyaprayojyatāyā viṣaya- līyasvarūpasaṃbandhena svarganiṣṭhatvābhāvāt |
ata eva nimittatvārthakasaptamyāḥ upapadavi- bhaktitvamuktaṃ tatratatra |
na coktakṛtikārakatvasya svarge'pi satvāt tasya svāṅgatvamiti vācyam |
kathaṃ karmakārakabhedirūpasyā- ṅgabhedasya tataḥ pratītiriti vācyam |

nanu kriyājanyaphalaśālitvarūpakarmatvāvacchinna- pratiyogitākabhedaniveśe gauravāt karmatvasā- khaṇḍopādhirūpatve'pi ca sāmānyataḥ karmatvāvacchinnaprati- yogitākabhedasya prayājādhikaraṇakakṛtikarmadarśapūrṇamāsā- dāvapi bhāvena svargoddeśyakakṛtikarmatvāvacchinnaprati- yogitākabhedaniveśe gauravādvādhavena svargatvāvacchinna- pratiyogitākabhedasyaiva sarvāṅgalakṣaṇe niveśo'stu |
'sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ' ityādivākyopāttaphalānāṃ paścādīnāṃ svargāṅgatvāpatteḥ; svargātvāvacchinnabhinnatve sati ukta

yadi tu yāgakaraṇikā bhāvanaityādipratīteḥ prakāratayā karaṇatvāvagāhitvāt tṛtīyāntanāmapadasāmānā- dhikaraṇyācca dhātullakṣitakaraṇatvasya bhāvanā'nvayaḥ, dhātva- rthasya tu karaṇatve evānvayātproktāyāmiti vibhāvyate |

tathāpi liṅgasaṃvyāptiprasaṅgamātrasya bhāvanā'nvaya- niyamena ( nipātopasargaprātipadikatiriktācchabdamyo yaḥ supāttulliṅgasaṅkhyāvyatiriktaḥsthaiḥ, tatyakāraśabdabuddhi- tvācchaccaṃ prati liṅgasanvayibhāvanāvācipādajanyaupasthi- tirviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena kāraṇaṃ, ityevaṃ prakāratāniyāmaka- vyutpatti mīmāṃsakairarthavādagadaṅgīkṛtāmanurudhya |
) ' bhinne juhoti ' ityādi satamyarthanimittatvādapi tadanyātpada- nvite nimittatvādityāditeti cenna |
vibhaktyarthatvaṃ ca vibhaktiśaktyagamyato na nimittatvādikamādāya nimittā- dāvityarthāḥ, saptamyā adhikaraṇatvārthatvena nimittatve śakyatvābhāvāt |

tathā ca nimittatvasya saptamīnirūpita- śaktiviṣayatvābhāve'pi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ ' ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe ' ityanuśāsa- nāt sambandhasāmānyārthakatvena tadantargatanimittatve'pi ṣaṣṭhīnirūpitaśaktiviṣayatvāvabhāvāt tādātmya nimi- ttādātmyattiāpattistadavasthaiveti vācyam |
ṣaṣṭhīśaktyā'vacchedakaṃ hi saṃbandhatvameva, ato na doṣaḥ |
ata eva ' saptadaśa vaiśyasya ' ityādī ṣaṣṭhīto nimittatva- tvena nimittatvapratītirlakṣyateveti bodhyam |
' svargakāmo yajeta ' ityādi karaṇatvasya dhātullakṣyatve'pi vastuto vibha- ktiśakyatvānapāyācca doṣaḥ |
evaṃ ' sakkan juhoti ' ityā- dāvapi viniyogabhaṅgāṅgīkāreṇa dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatvalakṣaṇā- yāmapi vastutastasya vibhaktiśakyatvānapāyāt sakkanāṃ homāṅgatvavirodhaḥ |
anayaiva rītyā ' somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirva- pet kuṇānāṃ vrīhīṇām ' ityādau karaṇatvasya ṣaṣṭhīlakṣya- tve'pi śrīhīṇāṃ yāgāṅgatvamupapādanīyam |
etena ' utta- re'han dvirātrasya gṛhyate ' ityādī liṅgasaṃvyāptivyatirikta- sutramātrasya bhāvanā'nyaniyamana pañcayasaṃvandhasyāpi bhāvanā'nyayāparorativyāptiḥ |
nāhi tatra dvirātrīyottarāho- ddeśena ṣoḍaśigrahaṇaṃ vidhīyate, viśiṣṭoddeśe vākyabhedāt |
na ca ṣaṣṭhīsthale parasparānvayasya vyutpanna- tvādavākyabhedaḥ |
tathātve'pyabhya haviriticat ' uttare- 'han ' ityatra ahanyuttaravaiśiṣṭyāyogena vākya- bhedāt |
vastuto liṅgasaṃvyāptibhinnadharmātrasya lāghavena bhāvanā'nyāt ṣaṣṭhyarthasyāpi bhāvanātirekeṇānvayaḥ acyutapanna eva |
ato dvirātrasaṃbandhinī ṣoḍaśigraha- karaṇikā bhāvanā uttarapadārthabhāgedeśena vidhīyate |
' aindravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ ' itivat ahanityanuvāda ityeva bodhyam |
tathā ca kriyā'nvitavibhaktyarthānvitatvena dvirātre'ti- vyāptiriti apāstaṃ, vibhaktinirūpitasaṃbandhalava- cchinnaśaktiviṣayatvaniveśenādoṣāt |
vastutastu lāghavāt ṣaṣṭhyāḥ karmatvalakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya dvirātroddeśena ṣoḍaśi- grahaṇavidhiḥ |

dvirātrīyottarāhe eva cātirātrasaṃsthākatvena tatraiva vikalpitaṣoḍaśigrahaṇaniyamavidhilāghavānuro- dhasya dvirātrasaṃbandhyuttarabhāgoddeśena ṣoḍaśigrahaṇavidhiḥ, dvirātrasaṃbandhyuttarabhāgasya cāhorūpatvāt ahanityanuvāda ityapi, uparītyeva laghubhūtadeśatā'vacchedake saṃbhavati gurubhūtoddeśyatā'vacchedakayogāt ayuktam |
na cokta- prakāre dvirātrasyoddeśyatā'vacchedakatvāt auttarakālika- niyamavidhilāghavānurodhena vidhestattarāhātraviṣayatvā saṃkocorūpadhātvakalpanāmanupamamiti vācyam |

dvirātrarūpe ānarthakye prasakte dīkṣaṇīyāyāinniyamanayena (9112) atrāntarāpūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇāyā dvirātranyaikāttarāpūrvā- bhāvanāsaṃbhave'pi uttarapadasahakṛtāpūrvāvyabhicārarūpatātparya- grāhakānurodhenottararājanyajātīyapūrvakarūpasādha- uddeśyatā'vacchedakatve'pyanupapattatvāt |
āvaśyaka ceyamānarthakyabhiyā apūrvasādhanatvāvacchedalakṣaṇā, dvirātra- saṃvandhyuttarāhoddeśena ṣoḍaśigrahaṇavidhisamupagacchatāṃ
paraṃtu dvirātrasaṃbandhyuttararūpavākyārthasaṃvandhe- noktaparamāpūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā, asanmate tu dvirātramātra- saṃvandhenoktaparamāpūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇe viśeṣaḥ |

kiṃca tvanmate uttare'hanniti saptamyā adhikaraṇatvāvacchinnāḥ svaśakyatāvacchedakatvenavibhaktyarthakarmatva lakṣaṇa, asanmate tu saṃvandhasāmānyavācinyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ svaśakyatāvacchedakā- vacchinne lakṣaṇetyapi bodhyam |
na caivamapi caturthyāḥ saṃpradāna- tvaśaktatvena devatātvasya vibhaktyarthatvāt ' yadyame ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti ' ityādī devatā homāṅgatva- nāpattiriti vācyam |
tyajyamānadravyoddeśyatve sati pratigrahītṛtparūpasaṃpradānatvasya caturthyarthatvena tadyadatakalpya- mānadravyoddeśyatvarūpadevatātvasyāpi tadarthatvānapāyāt |

yadi ca ' viprāṃ gāṃ dadāti ' ityādau saṃpradānībhūtaviprādau devatātvavyavahārābhāvena tatra pratigrahītṛtvābhāve'pi 'pyadhiko niveśyate, abhīṣṭomayorasyāvṛttidevatātvāttuna vā atropadādhilapameva devatātvamucyate |
evaṃ ca pūrvokta- karmakārakabhedasya lakṣaṇe aniveśe'pi na kṣatiḥ; karmatvasya kartṛtvādyanyatamatvāntargatatvena tadanvite svargādāvityavyā- bhāvāt |
vihitatvaṃ ca pravartanā rūpavidhinyatvaṃ, pravartanā- jñānasyaivedhasādhanatvajñānadvārā pravṛttiprayojakatvena pravṛttāveva tadabhāve tatkārakeṣu sutarāṃ tasmātbhāvāt |
tasya nityatvena vidhiprayojyatvābhāvāt, anityānāmapi somādīnāṃ siddharūpatvena vidhiprayojyatvābhāvāt |
asti cedaṃ yāgādau pravartanāniṣṭhaprakāratāni- pitārthabhāvanāniṣṭhaviśeṣyatā'vacchedakatvaṃ karaṇatvādī, tadavacchedakatvasya tatra sattvāt |
nanvidaṃ dhātu- lakṣitakaraṇatvāderbhāvanāyāṃ prakārateti mate saṃbhavati |

karaṇatvādisaṃsargeṇa dhātvarthasyaiva bhāvanāyāṃ prakārateti mate tu arthabhāvanāniṣṭhaviśeṣyatā'vacchedakatvasyaiva yāgādau sattvāt svaniṣprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatā'vacchedakatā- 'vacchedakasaṃbandhena vidhiviśiṣṭatvābhāvātnoktavihita- tvasya tatra saṃbhava iti cenna |

yadyapi dhātvarthasyaiva karaṇatvādisaṃsargeṇa bhāvanāyāmanvaya iti mate yāgādāvapi noktakṛtikārakatvaṃ saṃbhavati, tathāpi kartṛtvādyanyatamatvasaṃbandhena kṛtyanvitatva- kṛtikārakatvānyatamatvānvitatvenatadanvayameva tanmate kṛtikārakatvam |
sutrārthe nirūpakatvādi saṃbandhena kṛtyanvitatvasyetyādipatti- vāraṇāyā kartṛtvādyanyatamatvasaṃbandheneva |
ata eva ' dadhneṃdriyakāmasya juhuyāt ' ityādāvāśrayatvadisaṃba- ndhena homasya kṛtyanvitatve'pi nendriyādyanvayaprasaṅgaḥ |

vastutaḥ pūrvoktarītyā dhātullakṣitakaraṇatvasyaiva prakāra- tayā bhāvanā'nvayāt laghubhūtaṃ kṛtyanvitatvakartṛtvādyanya- mānatvaṃ kṛtikārakatvaṃ, svaniṣprakāratānirūpitaviśe- ṣyatā'vacchedakatā'vacchedakasaṃbandhena vidhiviśiṣṭaṃ vihitatvamityetat jyāyaḥ |

vihitatvaṃ cedaṃ nirviṣayaka- bhāvanāyāḥ : prayojyatāsaṃbandhena pravartanā'nvayāyogāt prathamataḥ kṛtau sakalakārakatvānvayaḥ, tataḥ sakalakāraka- viśiṣṭāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ prayojyatvasaṃbandhena pravartanā'nvayaḥ, iti ' ekaviśiṣṭe aparavaiśiṣṭyaṃ ' itirītyā śabdabodha- maprimeyoktam |
ata eva tantraratne saptame ' pañcasapta- reṣu ' iti sūtre (7|1|13) vikṛtau arthavādāti- deśe'pi viśvajidādau na saptadhādikalpaneti prati- pāditamuktam |
' vidhirhi yaṃśaparipūrṇamanuṣṭhānayogyāṃ bhāvanāṃ prāpya paścāt puruṣaṃ pravartayituṃ pravartamānaḥ apekṣā- vaśāt prāśastyajñānamukhenaivādān yatrakacana sthitavān-
vidheyabhāvanā tu tataḥ prāgeva svāṃśān gṛhṇāti |
tasyāṃ velāyāmupadeśenātideśena vā arthavādasārdhanidhānāt tadupapattaṃsahitaphalabhāvāt svargameva gṛhṇātīti na svarganyāyaḥ |

yadā tu yogyatājñānaṃ vinā'pi ayogyatā- niścayābhāvātreṇa śābdabodhasya ānubhāvikatvāt 'ekatra dvayaṃ' iti rītyā yugapadeva bhāvanāviśeṣaṇatāmanayaḥ; samānābhidhānādirūpaprayāsasyānugraheṇa vā prathamaṃ pravartanā- dīnāmeva tatrānyatastata itarakārakānvayaḥ, bhāvyabhūtārthabhāva- nāyāṃ kārakatvānvayaḥ pūrvai bhāvyaviśeṣatvātkathañcitpittavena pravartanāyāḥ vispaṣṭamitikartavyatā''kāṅkṣā''natatvāt nārthavādātideśaḥ, iti na viśvajiti ārthavādikaphala- kalpanā''pattirityanyat |
saṃbhavati coddeśyatā''tmikā viṣayatā, tatrāpi prayojanānāṃ 'pākāya kāṣṭhāni jvalanti' 'dhānyāya jalaṃ pralavati' iti vyavahārāt |
vyavahāre cācetanaśabdakartṛkatve'bhidhāvyāpāre vyaktīnāmuddeśyatvaṃ iti bhavadevaḥ, prakṛtikartṛkavyāpāre ca prayojyadedavyatvaṃ iti kapilaḥ |
tadapi ca yāgādya- duddeśyakavyāpārakartṛ śrudādapi yāgādyaṅgatvapāteḥ |
tādarthyaṃ, prayājādīnāṃ vā vinā prakaraṇeṇa kṛtvarthatvam |
tāmeva tu viśiṣṭāṃ viṣayīkurvan tadviśeṣaṇāṇyapi arthāt vidhatte |
yatrāpi ca sāmānyataḥ prātā, tatrāpi viśiṣṭe- viṣayatvena pratīyamāno vidhiḥ prātāprāptavivekena viśe- ṣaṇaparo bhavati ; viśeṣaṇatvaṃ ca śrutyādhīnam |
samānapratyayābhidhānopapādanāllakṣaṇayā hi śrutvā kartṛtsavyā- dīnāṃ bhāvanāviśeṣatvaṃ, phalaśrutyā dhālarthasya |
padā- ntaropapātānāṃ tu paścādīnāṃ tatsaṃkhyāliṅgādyośca vibhakti- śrutyādyunīyam |
tadevaṃ śeṣiviśeṣapratipādanena śeṣa- viśeṣapratipādanena ca aṅgavat bodhayato vidhaiḥ sāhāyakaṃ kurvanti śrutyādini viniyoge kāraṇānyamīdhīyante itya- navyadham |
vā. 2|2|13 pṛ. 473. aṅgapradhānayo: ekakālatvaṃ, kālasya prayogāparanāmadheyāṅgapradhānabhāvanāyā anvayāt iti ekādaśe vakṣyate |
aṅgeṣu ca tadabhāvaḥ pradhānaṃ prati nirdeśāt yathā dravyadevatvam |
kiṃ teṣāṃ samā- daya eva deśakālakartāraḥ, athavā aniyamaḥ iti |
codanāvidhiśeṣatvena āgneyādīni pradhānāni prati samādayo nirdiṣṭā nānyatra bhavanti |
yathā dravyadevataṃ yat pradhāneṣu na tadaṅgeṣu, evaṃ deśadayo- 'pi |
) aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt pradhānānopadidyere- stasmāt syādekadeśatvam |
bhāṣyaṃ- yaduktaṃ aṅgeṣu deśādīnāmanīyama iti, tatra, aṅgeṣu samādiniyama iti |
kutaḥ ? yataḥ aṅgā- nyapi pradhānena phalasiddhau upadiśyamānena saha upadiśyante |
pradhānānāṃ phalaṃ sādhyatāṃ vidhānametat, yaduta aṅga- prayogaḥ |
ato ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta ' ityatra aṅgavān prayogaḥ pradhānānāmuktaḥ |
yathāvidhiḥ : tatroktaḥ, tathāvidhena punaḥ śrutyā samādīnāṃ vidhiḥ |
ataḥ aṅgānāmapi pradhānaiḥ saha ekadeśakālakartṛkatvaṃ syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ- atha yaduktaṃ, yathā dravyadevataṃ pradhānānā- maṅgānāṃ ca bhedena bhavati, evaṃ deśadayo'pi sphuriti |
iha agniḥ puroḍāśaśca, iha āyanaṃ abhīṣṭaumī ceti |
tathā aṅgeṣvapi ājyena prayājān yajati, śeṣāt sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati |
tasya ca prayogaḥ sādhāraṇāt tantrabhāvaḥ ityadiṣṭho hetuḥ |
teṣu samavetānāṃ samavāyāttantramaṅgāni, bhedastu tadbhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
prayoge syāt, teṣāṃ pradhāna- śabdatvāt, tathā cānyārthadarśanam |
bhāṣyaṃ- yadi ca samānaṃ dravyadevataṃ aṅgānāṃ pradhā- nānāṃ syāt, tattatteṣu dravyadevateṣu samavetānā- maṅgānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ca samavāyāt tadavasthaḥ aviśeṣaḥ, iti tantramaṅgiyā syāt |
atha tu bhedo dravyadevatvasya, tataḥ tadbhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
tathā ca anyārthadarśanaṃ yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati ' caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāmāhuto hūyante, trayodaśāmāvāsyāyāṃ ' iti |
śā- yadā caivaṃ utpattivākyaśeṣatvaṃ kālādīnāṃ, tadā utpattivākye pradhānamātrāṇāṃ niraṅgānāṃ vidhānāt
tanmātrāṇāmeva amī kālādayaḥ, nāṅgānāṃ pradhānadeśakāla- kartṛkatvam |
... yadā caivaṃ prayogavākyaśeṣatvaṃ kālādīnāṃ, tadjñānāmāpi tatkālatvaṃ sidhyati |
tathāhi, sādhyasādhanāṃśāvukatā avagatā bhāvanā kathamiti itthaṃbhāva- mapekṣate |

tena prakārāpekṣāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ tatprakāratvena prayājādiṣu avagateṣu sāmastya- rūpeṇa bhāvanāsya vyāpāre prayogāparaparyāye avagate tacche- ṣatvena kālādayo vidhīyante iti aṅgānāmapi ta eva deśādayo bhavanti |
dravyadevataṃ tu punarna samastaprayogasaṃ- ndhitvena vidhīyate, anapekṣitatvāt ayogyatvācca |
nāpi tanniṣiktau dravyadevataṃ samarthe, kiṃtu phala- bhāvanā'vayavayāgaparopaniṣādena dravyadevataṃ apekṣitatvāt yogyatvācca saṃdhyate |
kāladayastu āgneyādikaraṇiyā phala- bhāvanayā samagrarūpayā saṃdhyamānāḥ |
soma- atra bhāṣye aṅgeṣu kiṃ samādeśakāla- kartāraḥ, uta aniyamaḥ iti antarāci-tantram |

yadyapi amāvāsyādiśabdānāṃ pradhānamātravācitve'pi 'amāvā- syā yajeta ' ityādidvitīyanirdeśa tatakaraṇakabhāvanā- pratīteḥ tadanvitātāṃ deśādīnāṃ ' ubaiḥ pravargyena ' ' apsu avabhṛthena ' ityādināmiva aṅgapradhānārthatvamyana- siddhaṃ, tathāpi yatra deśādividhānena tṛtīyayā pradhāna- nirdeśaḥ, tatrāpi deśādīnāṃ sāṅgapradhānārthatvasādhanāya antarāvicāra āvaśyaka iti dhyeyam |
vi- ' aṅge ye ke'pi deśādyāḥ kiṃvā te, deva- tādivat |
ananvayāt ke'pi, maivaṃ prayogeṇa parigraha- hāt |
aṅgapradhānayo: yatra vacanaṃ tatra anyakālatvamapi bhavati yathā ' pūrvedyuramāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti ' iti |
bhāṣyaṃ- aṅgānāṃ mukhyakālatvaṃ mukhyadeśatvaṃ mukhya- kartṛvaṃ coktam (11|2|18) |
yatra vacanaṃ tatra anyakālatvaṃ anyadeśatvaṃ anyakartṛtvamapi bhavati |
yathā ' pūrvedyura- māvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti ' ' apsu avabhṛthena caranti ' |
yatra tu āhya aṅgasya bhinnadeśakālatvaṃ vacanenaivoktaṃ tatra tathā bhavati, iti suhṛd bhūtvoktavān |
soma- pūrvasmin pāde kālādīnāmaṅgādhaneṣu tantratā prādhānyena nirūpitā |
idānīṃ tadapavādatayā ka cidaṅgapradhāna- yorbhinnakālatvaṃ prastutya bhinnadeśakālānamaṅgānāṃ tantratvaṃ vyutpādyate iti pādāntaratvamānantaryaṃ ca |
' avabhṛ- thena caranti ' ityādī bhinnadeśatvaṃ, ' pūrvedyuramāvā- syāyāṃ vediṃ karoti ' ityādī bhinnakālatvaṃ, agrau sautrā- maṇyāṃ ca ' vaḍavā dakṣiṇā ' iti dakṣiṇā
ci— 'vedyādirmūlyakāle syāt śaṃkāle ve, tatrāṅga- vat |
' bhāṭṭa— ajñānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ca ekaprayogavidhipari- gṛhītānāṃ ekadeśakālakartṛkatvaṃ ityuktam |
yathā 'pūrvadhruvāmāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti', 'agnu abhyūthena caranti', 'vaḍavā dakṣiṇā' iti |
ka cit mahāprayogāntaḥpāte'pi paracāraviprakarṣamātreṇa, ka cit prayogagahivabhāvenaiva, yathāpramāṇāntaram |
agnyādheyatrā- maṇyādau ca dakṣiṇābhedāt kartṛbhedo vakṣyate (1|1|4|1 |
idaṃ ca siddhameva suhṛd bhūtvā uttaraviṣayārthaṃ smārthate |
( 1|2|1|16|32) yadā hi aścapratigrahavataḥ karmaṇaḥ vāruṇīṣṭiḥ aṅgamevetyavadhāritaṃ, tadā aṅgapradhānānāṃ |
nyāyāt yaḥ kratoḥ kartā, tenaiva iyamapi kartavyā |

saṃskāre añjane abhyañjane ca prākṛtena saha samu- ccayaḥ syāt |
pravṛtte kārye sulākālaṃ gauggulavena abhyañjanaṃ virūddhī- karaṇārtham |
pratyakṣaṃ kāryāntaraṃ vartate, iti na prākṛtaṃ nivartayitumihati |
soma- pūrveṇa bhinnakāryatvāt anivṛttāvapi ihaike- kāryatvāt nivṛttiḥ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- saṃskāre abhyañjane ( gauggulavādīnāṃ navanītena ) samu- ccayaḥ bhinnakāryasaṃyogāt iti |

[ yattu somanāthena gauggu- lavena 'yantrādyupāyasadigatagugguludravyeṇaitye' ityukte tanna, gauggulavādidravyeṇa tattatkṣalāmeva vivakṣita- tvāt iti dhyeyam : ke. ] vi- 'athyaṅkte navanītaḥ kiṃ bādhyo gauggulavā- dibhiḥ |
atarkyā kuṭṭanīkuṭṭaracanā hi vidherapi' iti nyāyaḥ |
tathāhi - 'caturbhiḥ prakārairatasminsa ityetadvati - tāstyāt, tādarthyāt, tatsāmīpyāt, tatsāhacaryāt iti |
vyahe samāsānurodhenaiva vairājādikālaniyamanāt, 'upa- stambhana vā atimāhyāṇāśca pṛṣṭāni' iti pṛṣṭhabahutyasyo- gācca, vairājasāmastomairatimāhyāṇāṃ sāmanvatvena stavanācca |
oṃ atimāhyāṇāṃ māhendrabhamānantarameva homaḥ, na tu saha |
atimāhyāneva prakṛtya 'māhendramanuhūyante' iti śrutau anuśabdaḥ sahatvavacanaḥ, gāmanu vatsyarthīti sāhi- tye'pi prayogadarśanāt |
tadvyavahaditottarakālasyānuyāgāva- ruddhatvāt vācanikatvādeva anyadevatyasyāpi māhendragraha- yājyatveva te hūyeran |

iti prāpte, ' agre tejasvin' ityādīnāṃ mantrāṇāṃ homakaraṇatvenāmāntaranā- kāṅkṣatayā māhendrayāgāvyahitottarakālapara evānuśabdaḥ, anujyayatīti vicaritarāgeṇama lubdhāvakāśatvena prakṛte ānanatvaraudha bādhasya yuktatvāt |
(sa ekasmin ekasmāt) atideśa: ekasmin karmaṇi ekasmādeva karmaṇa: na tu sarvakarmabhya: |
tataśca akhilapadārthaviśiṣṭākhaṇḍopakārātideśo upakāra- rāt pṛthagbhāvena padārthānāṃ svatantreṇa anupasthitatvāt niyojanasya svarūpeṇa buddhau viparivarttinnāsti |
soma. 1|2|1 pṛ. 11. upakārasya tatpṛthagbhāvena padārthānā- mevātideśa: na tu padārthabodhakaśāstrāṇām |
anumita- vacanātideśo'pi trividha: sādṛśyakalpitavacanātideśa:-, sthānāpatikalpitavacanātideśa:-, āśrayopasthitikalpita- vacanātideśaśceti |
7|11. atideśa: trividha: pratyakṣavacanāt nāmadheyāt codanāliṅgamitvavacanā- cceti |
(iṣau, pañcasaṃvareṣu, vaiśvadeve kāye ekakapāle aindre dvāda- śa-kapāle ca, sākamedhīye, kavalādiṣu ceti) |
(agni- hotraṃ, prāyaṇīyaṃ (na), sarvapṛṣṭha: , avabhṛthaḥ, vaiṣṇava: (na), nirmanthya: (na), praṇayanaṃ (na), kharasāmā) 7|11, karmanāmadheyānāṃ agnihotrādiśabdānāṃ uttama- tideśatvam |
yaugikānāṃ prāyaṇīyādiśabdānāṃ guṇa- vidhināṃ ca vaiṣṇavādiśabdānāṃ guṇavidhitvāt liṅgaviśeṣa- śūnyānāṃ nāsti atideśanimittatvamityuktam |
karmanāma- deva saṃskārāṇāṃ yūpādīnāṃ siddhameva atideśatvam |
7|121, gato nāmātideśa:, idānīṃ ānumāni- kena vacanena atideśa ucyate |
( prathame pāde pratyakṣavacanāt, nāmadheyāt tṛtīye pāde, anumitavacanācca caturthe pāde) soma. atideśa: pratyakṣavacanāt 'samānamitaracchayenena' iti iṣau |
7|12, 'etadbrāhmaṇa aindrāma etad- brāhmaṇa ekakapāla: ' iti sākamedhepu |
7|14, jyoti: gau: āyu: eteṣu tu dvādaśāhiko nāsti, kintu ekāhika: |
8|1|19-9, gavāmayana- gatasvarasāmadharmāṇāṃ 'pṛṣṭhayaḥ paḍaho dvau svarasāmānau' ityatra |
gaṇa: evaṃ saṃghātadhamai: gaṇamanugrahītuṃ samartha: naikahā: |
'dvābhyāṃ lomāvatyati, dvābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ' ityeta- dārabhya dvādaśīpasaccaṃ dvādaśāhikaṃ dharmaṃ gavāmayane darśa- yati |
śā—dvirātrādiṣu ahargaṇeṣṣu avyaktatvaṃ gaṇatvaṃ ca adhikaṃ vidyate |
evaṃ ca 'patnīsaṃyājāni ahāni saṃtiṣṭhante' ityādayo gaṇadharmā labhyante |
sauma—nanu dvirātrādiṣu avyaktatvāt saumika eva vidhyantaḥ |
tathātve gaṇatvāviśeṣāt paśugaṇalakṣaṇakadāśinīvidhyanta- syāpi prasaṅgāt iti ucyate: saṃgatipūrvapakṣa: |
avya- ktatve sati gaṇatvaṃ liṅgaṃ, tacca na saume, naikadaśinyāṃ, ityāśaya: |
na ca ahurūpahito'nyathā gaṇo dvādaśāha: rātryupahito'nyathā gaṇa: dvirātrādi:; iti vāsaidvādaśyāt kathaṃ tadvikāratvaṃ iti vācyam |
aha:śabda: rātri- śabdasya ca ahorātraparatvena ubhayorapi ahorātranimitta- gaṇatvena vaisādṛśyābhāvāt |
' bhāṭṭa—gavāmayanādisetreṣu dvirātrādyahargaṇeṣṣu ca sutyā- gaṇeṣṣu dvādaśāhikāratvam |
ata eva gavāmayanādau 'dvābhyāṃ lomāvatyati' ityādinā dvādaśopasattvāndāvo vidhyantara- sutyartha: saṃgacchate |
sthite ca dvādaśāhikāratve prathamo- ttamo varjayitvā daśāhasyaiva pravṛtti: iti vakṣyate |
tatrāpi satreṣu satrātmakasya, ahīneṣu ahīnātmakasya ca dvādaśāhasya avāntarasāhaśyāt ityapi vakṣyate (8|2|
sarvasādhāraṇā: santaḥ śyenasyāpi bhavanti ityanuvādo yujyate |
apivā yathāpūrvatvādidataradhikārārthaṃ jyautiṣṭomi- kādviśeṣatadvācakaṃ samānaṃ syāt |
kuta: ? apūrvatvāt, evaṃ apūrve arthe vidhāsyati |
na kevalaṃ ayaṃ saṃnihitavacana: eva, pūrvoktasahadharmāṃtanihitamapi brūte, avaśiṣṭaṃ ca |

yadā hi lakṣaṇaṃ anukramya itaraśabda: prayujyate 'deva- dattāya kambalau dīyatāṃ, viṣṇumitrāya kauśeyaṃ, yajñadattāya kṣaumaṃ, itarat caitrāya' iti tadā vallabhameva pratīyate, na hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ vā |
iha jyautiṣṭomikamebhya: adhikān lohitoṣṇīṣādīn dharmān anukramya itaraśabda: prayukta:, tena atrāpi adhikāratve vaktumarhati, tathā adhika- vacanato bhavati |
atha jyautiṣṭomikaṃ brūte, tathā saṃni- hitavacana: |
yadi adhi- kārārthaṃ hitvā saṃnihitārthatā āśrīyate, anuvādamātra anarthakaṃ bhavati |
atha saṃnihitārthatāṃ hitvā adhikārārthatā gṛhyate, na kaścit doṣo bhavati |
ato jyautiṣṭomikāt vidhe: adhikā: śyenavaiśe- ṣikā: ye, te iha atidiśyante |
ṭup—(bhāṣyasiddhāntākṣipiti—) itaraśabdo nādhikye loke prasiddha: (tādṛśaṃ sāhaśyamasya na vācya- mityartha: |
) kiṃ tarhi ? upayuktatvāt yat itarat saṃni- hitaṃ tat prasiddha: |
) iṣau vaṣaṭkāra- nidhanaviśrutisatahaṃ bhavati ityuktvā samānamitarat śyena iti |
(pūrvākye 'vaṣaṭkāranidhanaṃ bhavati, iṣau viśruti karoti, satahaṃ bhavati' ityatra prākṛte sanni vaṣaṭkāranidhanatvaṃ, codakaprāptā viṣṭute: |
ihākāratvaṃ, satahatvaṃ ca sāma stotrasya vihitam |
tatra—) jyautiṣṭomāt codakena yat prāptaṃ, tat itaraśabdena parāmṛśya (śyena- saṃbandhī—) vikāro vidhīyate |
yat itara jyautiṣṭomāt prāptaṃ, tat śyenana samānam |
(sūtre itara iti 'samānamitarat śyenana' iti vacanaṃ nirdiśyate |
'apivā yadi' iti yadyapivā iti viparyasya pañcamyāvṛttau vyākhyāyam |

tadayamartha:—'yadi apūrvārthavidhilābhāya 'samānamita- rat' iti vacanaṃ jyautiṣṭomāt codakamāptādidhe: adhikāravikāravidhānārthaṃ, tadā tadvācakaṃ samānapadaṃ syāt jyautiṣṭomikanāmatideśaprāptānāṃ śyenavat vikāra: kartavya: |
tenā- yamartha:—'itarat iti padena vikārārthikyavidhānārthaṃ jyautiṣṭomikā atidiśyante, tasya ca vikārasya samānapadaṃ vidhāyakaṃ' iti |
evaṃ ca codanāsāmānyāt jyauti- ṣṭomikāra eva iṣu:, na śyenavikāra: |

bhāṣyakārapakṣāt asmin pakṣe anuṣṭhānaviśeṣaṃ darśayati—) adhikārārthe (adhika- vācini ) itaraśabde varṇyamāne ye'pi aprākṛtakāryā: (padārthā: śyena vihitā: ) kaṇṭakavitodanādaya: teṣāmapi atideśa: syāt bhāṣyakāravyākhyāne yat (śyenana ) samānaṃ tat itarat ityarthīyamāne |
(assa- tvakṣe puna: itaraśabdasya saṃnihitavācitvāt tena jyauti- ṣṭomikānuddiṣya śyenana samānaṃ ityanena vikāramātraṃ vidhīyate iti na kaṇṭakavitodanādiprāpti: iti viśeṣa: |
śā—satyaṃ itarat-śabda: saṃnihitaṃ abhidhatte na tu tanmātram|
kiṃtu pūrvarnidiṣṭasattvaṃ saṃnihitaṃ na yat tat, tadabhidhatte |
tadiha yat saṃnihitaṃ jyotiṣṭomikaṃ, na tat pūrvoktasadṛśaṃ, aprākṛtānāṃ saptahādīnāṃ pūrvamuktatvāt |

yattu aprākṛtaṃ lohitoṣṇīṣādi tenyanaiṣapikaṃ, tat yadyapi asaṃnihitaṃ tathāpi sādṛśyamasti, iti avaśyaṃ hātavye anyatarasmin, vacanāttvacāya saṃnidhi hitvā sādṛśyaparigraheṇa śyenavaiṣopikāṇāṃ vāda: |
yadā codakaprāptānāṃ viṣṭuvādīnāṃ vikāra: 'iṣuṃ viṣnuti' ityādinā pūrva vihita:, tat itarat codaka- prāptaṃ itaracchabdena uddiśya, tasya lohitoṣṇīṣādi- vikāra: śyenāt atidiśyate |
evaṃ ca saṃnihitatva- natvaṃ arthavattvaṃ ca vacanasya bhaviṣyati (iti vārtika- matam) |
soma—kiṃciddharmapuraskāreṇa buddhisyamye ekasmin upayukte tadavaśiṣṭaṃ yat, tat itaraśabdavācyam |
tasya ca yaddharmapuraskāreṇa prathamaṃ buddhisyattā, taddharmamādāya sādṛśyaṃ saṃnihitatvaṃ ca asti iti |
bhāṣyakāreṇāpi 'itarat iti prayogatāt vaiṣopikān anukramya 'itarat iti prayogatāt vaiṣopikāṇāṃ saṃnihitena ca bhavitavyam |
tatra ca ubhayāsaṃbhavāt anyatarapari- grahe vacanārthavattvāya sādṛśyaṃ parigṛhyate ' ityuktam |

vārtikakāramate tu codakaprāptāmye viṣṭuvāde: vikāra- vidhānārthaṃ upayuktatvena tat itarat yat jyotiṣṭo- mikaṃ, tat śyenena samānaṃ kartavyaṃ, śyene yādṛśa- vikārayuktaṃ tādṛśavikārayuktaṃ kartavyaṃ, iti saṃni- hitasadṛśavacanatopapatte: saṃnihitatvaṃ na parityājyaṃ iti |
sūtrārthastu- samāne 'samānamitara' iti vākye utpannādhikāra: codakāvagatanideśa: syāt |
tatra prākṛte sāmina vaṣaṭkāranidhanamāmanāt, prākṛtavi- dhutau ca iṣyākāratvaṃ, stotre prākṛte saptahādīnāṃ sāma (saptahaṃ iti pāṭha: bhā. vā.) |
tat kim anuvāda:, uta ati- deśavidhi: iti cintāyāṃ itaraśabdasya saṃnihitavacana- tvena loke prasiddhatvāt nāsya asaṃnihitadyenavaiṣopika- dharmavācitvaṃ, teṣāmasaṃnihitatvāt |
api tu jyoti- ṣṭomātideśena saṃnihitā: tatparatvameva |
teṣāṃ ca śyene- 'pi atideśaprāptatvena śyenasādṛśyopapatte: anuvāda: evārthaṃ, iti na śyenavaiṣopikāṇāṃ vacanātideśa: |
iti prāpte, itaraśabdasya saṃnihitavācitvavat pūrvoktetarasa- haśāvācitvamapi lokasiddham |
'caitramaitrayo: kambala- kauśeye pradeye itarat viṣṇumitrāya ' ityatra saṃni- hitapūrvoktetarasattvaśabdādeva pratīte: |
ataśca vārti- kakārīyā pūrvoktasādṛśyasya avācyatvokti: upekṣa- ṇīyaiva |
tataśca yat saṃnihitaṃ prākṛtaṃ, na tat pūrvokta- sadṛśaṃ aprākṛtānāṃ saptahādīnāṃ pūrvoktatvāt |
yacca sadṛśaṃ śyenavaiṣopikaṃ aprākṛtalasādharmāt, na tat saṃnihitam |
tataśca avadyahatvāt anyatarasmin, vaca- nasya arthavattvāya, saṃnihitaṃ hitvā sādṛśyaparigraheṇa śyenavaiṣopikāṇāmeva itaraśabdena grahaṇam |
nahi anyathā vidhvantarāropabhṛtasya anuvādasya arthavattvaṃ saṃbhavati |
tataśca śyenasādṛśyavat yat pūrvoktasadṛśaṃ tat pūrvokta- bhinnaṃ, tat iṣau kuryāt iti vākyārtha: |
bhavati hi śyenanigrāhyāṃ kaṇṭakavitodanādīnāṃ ye dharmā: kaṇṭakavitodanatvādya: tatsamānajātīyā: ta eva, tadvattvaṃ tu yathāśrutam |
nahi śyenapratiyogikaṃ sādṛśyaṃ kaṇṭaka- vitodanādau saṃbhavati |
ataśca phalata: śyenadharmā eva pūrvoktasadṛśā: pūrvoktabhinnāśca kāryā: iti paryavasito-
pūrvoktasādṛśyaṃ ca aprākṛtatvena, prākṛtāṅgamuddiśya vihitatvena vā |
tena śyene ye apūrvā dharmā: kaṇṭaka- vitodanādaya: te ihāpi atidiśyante, ye vā śyene prākṛtānuvādane vihitā: lohitoṣṇīṣādaya:, ta eva atidiśyante |
yattu asmin pakṣe naitepāmeva niyama: iti tantra- ratnoktaṃ, tat avāntarasādṛśyatyāge pramāṇābhāvāt upe- kṣitam |
asmin pakṣe iṣuprāgodadeśena anekapadārtha- vidhānāyogāt padadvayena lakṣaṇayā śyenīyaprākṛtāsaṃbandhi- vikāramātrasya iṣṭadeśena vidhānam |
yadā itarapade saṃnihitatyāge pramāṇābhāvāt, prākṛtājñānāmapi ca uddeśyatayā pūrvamuktatvāt, pūrvokta- prākṛtābhinnasadṛśaprākṛtāntarāṇāmeva itarapadena graha- ṇam |
tepāmatideśena saṃnihitatvāt tādṛśaprākṛtāṅgo- ddeśenaiva ca śyenasādṛśyavidhi: |
sa ca dharma: śyenaprākṛtānuvādane vihito vikāro lohitoṣṇī- ṣādi: |
ata eva sādṛśyaṃ na śyenanirūpitaṃ, api tu śyenīyaprākṛtāṅnirūpitameva |
upamānatā'vacchedakasaṃ- dhyena śyenavṛttidharmasya lohitoṣṇīṣāde: tenaiva saṃbandhena prākṛteṣu abhāvāt upamānatā'vacchedakasaṃndhena upameyavṛttitve eva upamāniyāmat |
ata eva asmin pakṣe śyenapadaṃ śyenīyaprākṛtāṅparam |
tataśca phalata: tādṛśadharmā eva iṣuparvasādhanībhūtatādṛśaprākṛ- tāṅgoddeśena vidhīyante |
ata eva vidheyasāmarthyāt śyena ye vikāro yatprākṛtāṅge vihita:, tatyākṛtāṅge eva so'tra vidhīyate |
ata: asmin pakṣe vivakṣitagatyā iṣusaṃbandhi venaiva tādṛśaśyenīyavikāravidhi: |

na caivaṃ asyātideśasya 'kalpitatvābhāvāt ānumānikavacanātideśāpekṣā prā- lye'pi śyenena samānaṃ iti padadvaye tādṛśavikārala- ṇāyāśca āvaśyakatvāt nāmātideśāpekṣā prātye mānā- bhāva:, nāmātideśasthale abhiśotrapadena anabhitānāmeva dharmāṇāṃ lakṣaṇā, vacanātideśa tu samānapadena uktānāmeva tādṛśadharmāṇāṃ vidheyatā'vacchedakabhūtadyenīyaprākṛtāṅga- vṛttivikāratvāvacchinnasiddhayarthaṃ lakṣaṇā iti tasya tada- pekṣayā prābalyāt |
nyāyacindu:— iṣusaṃjñake ekāhe 'samānamitara- cchyenena' iti śrutam |
tatra jyotiṣṭomadharmāṇāmati- deśāt śyene iva ihāpi prāpte: anuvādo'yam |

iti prāpte, itaraśabdasya saṃnihitasadṛśaparatvāt jyotiṣṭo- mānāṃ saṃnihitatve'pi pūrvoktāprākṛtāsādṛśyāt tatsada- śasya ca lohitoṣṇīṣāde: śyenavaiśeṣikasya asaṃnihita- tve'pi vacanāttvacāya sādṛśyamātraparigraheṇa śyenavaiśe- ṣikavidhi: |
yadā itaraśabdena atideśaprāptamuddiśya tasya lohitoṣṇīṣādivikāra: śyenādatidiśyate |
bhāṣyaṃ—idaṃ śrūyate 'abhijitā yajeta' 'viśva- jitā yajeta' iti |
teṣu vidhyantacintā kiṃ epa saumiko vidhyantaḥ; uta darśa- paurṇamāsika: iti |
etāsu avya- ktāsu saumiko vidhyantaḥ syāt |
tathā ca 'śyenena yajeta' iti avyaktacodite dīkṣaṇīyādīni somajñāni darśayati ' dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ dvādaśamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā, caturviṃśatimānaṃ prāyaṇīyāyāṃ ' iti |
śā—'viśvajitā yajeta' ityādiṣu ekāheṣu dvādaśāha ca kiṃ darśapaurṇamāsiko vidhyantaḥ, uta saumika: iti saṃśaye viśeṣābhāvāt aniyame prāpte
( naca viśeṣaniyāmakābhāve'pi darvihomavadapūrvatvaṃ kiṃ na syāditi vācyam |
iha tu ' yajeta ' ityetanmātraṃ śrūyate śrūyate dravyadevatā- nirvāhāḥ |
tathā ca kutaścit prakṛteḥ dravyadevayoralābhe yāganirvahābhāvāt śāstramaparyavasitaṃ syāt iti tātparyā- vasānāya aniyamasyaiva yuktatvāt iti bhāvaḥ ), ucyate, saumikaḥ syāt avyaktatvasāmānyāt |
( somayāge ca na svārthatayā viniyuktā devatā ' aindrāvayaṃ gṛhṇāti ' iti grahaṇārthatayaiva viniyogāt |

nanu idamayuktaṃ grahaṇāthryā api devatāyā yāgāpekṣā vartate, yāgādanyatra devatāyā asaṃbhavāt, ' somena yajeta ' iti yāgāsyāpi devatā'- pekṣā vidyate, tayośca naṣṭāśvadagdharathavat parasparasaṃbandhā- vaśyaṃbhāvāt ityata āha-) yatra taditchattṛbhirmantravarṇaiḥ yāgārthatayaiva devatā viniyuktā tad vyaktaṃ, itarastu avyaktam |
tathā ca taddhitādibhirgāthārthatayā prathamaṃ devatāviniyo- garāhilatvaṃ avyaktatvaṃ, tacca somayāge'pyastyeva |
evakāramadṛṣṭvā śakyate-) nanu ' aindrāvayaṃ gṛhṇāti ' iti tadvitenaiva devatā'pi some vihitā |
( evakāraṃ gṛhītvā uttaramāha-) na yāge devatā anena ( prathamaṃ utpattivākye ) vidhīyate, kiṃtu grahaṇe |
tadlatā- yāstu paścāt ārthako yāgasaṃbandhaḥ, na prathamameva yāgā- nvaye iti avyaktatvam |
( ke cittu grahaṇāthryā deva- tayāḥ prasaṅgāt yāge upakārakatvaṃ na tādarthya ityāhuḥ |
tathā sati godohanādivat vikṛtiṣu atideśā- bhāvaprasaṅgāt ) |
soma-- iṣṭiṣu prakṛticintāntaraṃ svāṅgadīkṣaṇīyā- diṣu tadapekṣayā jaghanyasya somasya vikṛtiparāṃ cintyate iti peṭikāsaṃgatiḥ |
vi-- ' iṣṭeḥ somasya vā dharmā viśvajitmukheṣṭivat |
bhāṭṭa-- udbhidādiṣu tu adhyuktatvasādṛśyāt jyoti- ṣṭomavikāratvam |
ataśca avyaktatvena tadatideśe siddhe ādideśikagrahaṇā- caṅgabhūtadevatayā udbhidādyupakārakatvakalpanena apalāpaḥ sulabhaḥ |
ata eva dhyenaṃ dīkṣaṇīyādiprāptau ' dīkṣaṇī- yāyāṃ dvādaśamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā, caturviṃśatimānaṃ prāya- ṇīyāyāṃ ' iti dakṣiṇādānavidhiḥ saṃgacchate |
( 8|1|3 sthaṃ bhittvā gṛhītamidam ) maṇḍana-- ' avyaktayoge tu somadharmāḥ |
' oṃ atideśaḥ ekādaśineṣu paśuṣu saghanīya- paśudharmāṇām |
bhāṣyaṃ-- ekādaśināḥ paśava udāharaṇaṃ ' kṛṣṇa- śīrṣa āgneyaḥ ' ityārabhya āmnātāḥ |
anyeṣāṃ ca ( śākhināṃ ) ' āgneyena vāpayati, mithunaṃ sārasvatyā karoti, prajananayati saumyena ' iti |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ amīprīyamīyavat, uta savanīyavidhanta iti |
' abhigrāt dve raśne ādāya dvābhyāṃ raśanābhyāṃ ekaikaṃ yūpaṃ parivyayati ' iti |
atha vacana- midaṃ kathamatra bhavati ' abhigrāt dve raśne ādāya ' ityetat |
yadi raśanādīnāmapi vidhī- yate, tadā vākyaṃ bhidyate |
soma-- nanu ekādaśineṣu dvaisthaiva vidhyantaḥ, na savanīyasya, tasya svayamapadharmakatvāt ityucyateḥ |
sutyākālatvaṃ ca ṛtupaśavaḥ ekādaśināśca vikalpyante ' iti vikalpavidhānāt avagamyate |
savanīye ' trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya ' ityekā racanā, daikṣavikāratvāccāparā iti dvairaśanyam |
ihāpi ' dve raśane yūpamṛcchataḥ ' iti dvairaśanyadarśanāt savanīyavidhanta: |
vi-- ' syādekādaśine dīkṣāt sauyāddhā, ''yo'stu pūrvavat ?, raśanādvaisavanīyaviśeṣālliṅgato'ntimaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- ekādaśineṣu tu sutyādinastvasya ādhi- kyāt pracāraviprakarṣārdādupadharmādhikyācca savanīyapaśu- vikāratvam |
' abhigrāt dve raśane ādāya dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ raśanābhyāmekaṃ yūpaṃ parivyayati ' ityetadapi dvairaśanyapa- savanīyadharmānuvādakamupapadyate |
nahi ayaṃ vidhiḥ, ' abhi- grāt dve ' ityasya vidheyatvāt, vidhyantaraikavākyatvādvā liṅgopapatteḥ |
( 8|1|3 madhyasthaṃ bhittvā gṛhītamidam ) maṇḍana-- ' sautyasya ekādaśineṣu dharmāḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ-- idhya udāharaṇaṃ ' aindrāmekādaśa- kapālaṃ nirvapeta prajākāmaḥ ' ityevamāyāḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsiko vā saumiko vā vidhyantaḥ, uta darśapūrṇamāsika eva eveti |
kiṃ punastat prakṛtiliṅgaṃ ? taddhitatvena devatopadeśaḥ, kapālavattā, nirva- piśabdaśca ' aindrāmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapeta ' iti |
prakṛtiliṅgena ca vidhyantaviśeṣa uktaḥ : ' yasya liṅgamartha- saṃyogāt ' ( 8|1|12 ) iti |
tacca darśayati ' prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti ' iti |
śā-- ' sautye caruṃ nirvapet ' ityādiṣu iṣṭiṣu nirvapatyādisāmānyen darśapūrṇamāsavidhantopadeśānāt tasyātideśaḥ |
itthaṃ ca ' yasya liṅgaṃ ' ( 8|1|12 ) ityasya prapañcaḥ, iti nātīvapūrvapakṣe yatitavyam |
vi-- ' aindrāmādau saumikaḥ syādedhiko vā, dvayo- riha |
' bhāṭṭa-- sauryādiṣu iṣṭisāmānyātteṣu iṣṭisāmānyāttva- sāmānyāt, nirvapattiādāmadharmākhyasaṃbandhatvāt, taddhita- padavihitadevatākatvācca darśapūrṇamāsavikāratvameva |
ata eva ' prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti ' iti liṅgam |
oṃ atideśaḥ aindre puroḍāśe āgneyapuroḍāśa- dharmāṇām |
bhāṣyaṃ-- idaṃ śrūyate ' aindremekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet ' iti |

tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ deva- tāsāmānyāt aindrapuroḍāśe sāṃnāyyasya vidhyantaḥ, āgneye ca payasi aupadhasya, devatāsāmānyāt valavattaraṃ; atha haviḥsāmānyāt uttaratra sāṃnāyyasya, pūrvatra aupadhasya, haviḥsāmānyāt balīyaḥ iti |
iti, jaghanyaniyantritaṃ haviḥ, tayorvirodhe mukhyānugraho nyāyyaḥ, mukhyasyāviruddhapravṛttitvāt, jaghanyasya tu mukhyena viruddhā pravṛttiḥ |
vipratipattau etasyāṃ havirdevatvaḥ haviṣā vidhyanto niyamyeta |
karma devatāṃ prati dravyasya saḥ ca haviḥgu upākhyāyate upalabhyate ityarthaḥ |
nanu devatā'pi yāgena saṃbaddhā, na tathā vinā yāgo bhavati |
bhāṣyaṃ— tena ca haviṣā saṃyujya karma coyate |
kimataḥ ? ato haviratra buddhau saṃnihitaṃ, tat liṅgaṃ bhavati |
yathā dhūmo buddhiviṣayatāmāpannaḥ ameyliṅgaṃ, na vidyamānaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ— nanu devatā'pi atra śrūyate aindraṃ āgneyaṃ iti |
viśeṣyaṃ ca buddhau saṃnihitaṃ bhavati, na viśeṣaṇam |
yathā 'rājapuruṣaḥ pūjyaḥ' ityukte puruṣaḥ pūjyo gamyate, na rājā |
aindraṃ paya ityukte haviḥ buddhau saṃnihitaṃ, na devatā |
yacca buddhau saṃnihitaṃ, tat liṅgaṃ ityuktam |
evaṃ śrūyate 'tṛta evainamindraḥ prajayā paśubhistarpayati' iti |
yasya indrasya prasādopāyaḥ iti jñātaḥ, punarapi indraṃ prasāditavye sa eva āstheyo bhavati |
yat 'tṛta evainamindraḥ' iti, tanedamucyate, guṇatvena devatāśrutiḥ |
yathā 'amātyena me grāmo dattaḥ' 'senāpatinā me grāmo dattaḥ' |
iti na ca amātyaḥ senāpatirvā grāmasya prabhavati |
tasmāt yathoktenaiva nyāyena haviḥsāmānyameva balīya iti |
śā— mukhyatvaprādhānyābhyāṃ devatāyāḥ prāvalyaṃ manyā- nasya uttaraṃ 'haviṣyasyamānatvāt pratyāsattirhi karmaṇi |
soma— yadi sauryādau devatāsāmānyāt āgneya- vidhyantaḥ, tadā aindrapuroḍāśādau api ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu— devatāsāmānyahaviḥsāmānya- balābalavipratipattau haviḥ sāmānyena vidhyanto niyamyeta karmaṇo havistyāgasya tyajamānahavirvidhyatvāditi |
vi— 'devo balī havirvinde puroḍāśe, dvimimo yataḥ |
devo mukhyo, 'ntaraṅgaṃ tad haviḥ karmaṇyato bali ||
bhā— evaṃ sādṛśyasya niyāmakatve nirūpite adhunā tayorvirodhe balābalaṃ cintyate |

tatrāpi dravyaghaṭita- devatāghaṭitasādṛśyayoḥ yatra vipratipattiḥ yathā 'aindraḥ puroḍāśaḥ' 'āgneyaṃ payaḥ' ityādī, tatra kasya bala- vattvaṃ iti cintāṃyāṃ, devatāyāḥ prathamoristhitatvena mukhya- tvāt pradhānatvācca tatsāhacaryameva balavat |
'tṛta evaina- mindraḥ prajayā paśubhistarpayati' ityādyayāvadadevatāda hi yāgo devatā'''rādhanārthaḥ |
ārādhitā ca sā phalaṃ dadāti iti tasyāḥ pradhānatvam |
devatāsādṛśyaṃ ca yadyapi niruktai- kadevatākatvarūpaṃ ( 8 | 1|17 bhāṭṭa. ) dravyasādṛśyavirodhe, tathāpi samānaśabdārthatvarūpaṃ tadvirodhe iti tasya bala- vattvam |
iti prāpte, prathamoristhitatve'pi karmavidhyuttara- kālaṃ atideśakalpanāt, tadā ca dravyasyaiva pratyāsannatvena śīghroristhitatveḥ, tatsādṛśyasyaiva balavattvam |
tatra dravyasya pradhānabhūte tyāge viśeṣaṇatvaṃ, devatā'stu viśeṣaṇabhūte
yadyapi ca deva- tāmasādasyaiva arthavādavaśāt yāgasya phalasādhanatve dvāratvaṃ kalpyate, tathāpi devatāyāḥ śābdabodhe yāgaṃ prati dravyaṃ prati vā prādhānye pramāṇābhāvāt |
pratyuta dravyasyaiva pārthi- kānye viśeṣyatvena prādhānyāvagateḥ |
vastutastu 'na devatāprasādasya dvāratvaṃ' iti jaiminimataṃ vakṣyate eva ( 9 | 1|4|6-10 ) |
evamanyatrāpi antaraṅgatvādinā sarvatra sādṛśyayoḥ balavatvaṃ draṣṭavyam |
yatra tu nyāyena anyādṛśaṃ balavatvaṃ, kalpasūtrayajñā- kānāñca anyādṛśāḥ, tatra tanmūlabhūtaśrutirūpavaca- nātideśena nyāyakalpanātideśasya bādhaḥ ityevaṃ draṣṭavyam |
ata eva 'saumyaśruḥ' ityādau śabdārthagatasamānatva- rūpasādṛśyasya niruktadevatātvarūpasādṛśyapekṣayā anta- raṅgatve'pi na anīyomīyavikāratvaṃ, api tu āgneyikā- ratvameva |
evaṃ 'āgneyemakadāśakapālaṃ' ityādau deva- tāsāmānyasya kapālasaṃkhyāsādṛśyāpekṣayā antaraṅgatve'pi āgneyavikāratvaṃ, api tu agnīṣomīyādivikāratvameva |
ke citu etādṛśaviṣaye kapālaikādaśādīnāṃ dravyaniṣṭha- sādhanatā''vacchedakakoṭipraviṣṭatvāt dravyasādṛśyaghaṭakatva- meva iti agnīṣomīyavikāratvaṃ samarthayante |
nyāyabinduḥ— aindrapuroḍāśe āgneye ca payasi mukhyalaprādhānyābhyāṃ devatāsādṛśyāt sānāyyasya aupa- ghasya cātideśaḥ |
iti prāpte, tyajamānatvena haviḥ karmapratyāsatteḥ tatsāhacaryādevatādeśāḥ |
devatā tu prāti- padikārthatayā mukhyā''pi bahiraṅgam |
prādhānyaṃ tu nāstyeva yāgaguṇatvāt, aupadhe sānāyyadharmāṇāṃ sānāyye cauṣadha- dharmāṇāṃ saṃbhavācca |
bhāṣyaṃ— 'prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇa- lamāyuṣkāmaḥ' iti śrūyate |
tat hiraṇyaṃ ājyadharmaṃ syāt upāṃśuyājavidhivantastatra bhavet |
hiraṇyamaśanāṃ tejaḥ, ājyamapi gavāṃ, sāra ityarthaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ— hiraṇye ca vahaya ājyadharmā anugṛhyante avekṣaṇādayaḥ |
kiṃ punaranayoḥ sāmānyayorviśeṣaḥ ? na khalu kaścit |
kiṃtu viśadatvasya kāraṇadravyaṃ ( viśadatvaṃ catvaṃ ceti ) upodvalakam |
bhāṣyaṃ— tasmiṃścājye śrapaṇaṃ śrūyate 'ghṛte śrapa- yati' iti |
kimataḥ ? ata etadbhavati, auṣadhavidha- ntena śrapaṇaṃ prāpyate, tatra kevalamājyaṃ vidhāpyate |
āha, sākṣādeva ājyaṃ śrūyate, tasmāt tasya vidhyantaḥ iti |
guṇagataṃ tat sāmānyaṃ, havirgataṃ tu vaiśadyaṃ caruśabdaśca |
soma— yadi dharmevāprasaṅgāt na aindrapuroḍāśe sāṃnāyyaviyantaḥ, tarhi kṛṣṇalacaraupi tatra eva nauṣadha- vidhyantaḥ ityukte : saṃgati: |
caśabdasya odana- gatatvena prathamopasthitatvāt tadupodlitena viśadatvena prathamaṃ auṣadhavidhyante niścitaṃ paścādvādhidharmācco nyāya- prāptatvādepa: |
viśadaṃ vibhaktatvāvayaṃ iti 'bhakṣyena miśrīkaraṇaṃ' ( pā0 2|1|35 ) ityatra haradattaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa— dravyaniṣṭhāsādṛśyayo: parasparavirodhe tu devatā- sādṛśyopaṣṭabdhasyāpi dravyasādṛśyasya śrautaliṅgopaṣṭabdha- dravyasādṛśyatvād durbalatvam |

yathā 'prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāma: ' ityatra kṛṣṇalānāṃ dīptimattvalakṣaṇatejasvitvasādṛśyasya prajāpatidevatākatvāsā- dṛśyopaṣṭabdhasyāpi kaṭhinatvāparaparyāyaviśadatvāsādṛśyasyā durbalatvam |
api tu kaṭhinatvasādṛśyāt āgneyavikāra eva, caruśabdaprayogāt, 'ghṛte śrapayati' iti śrapaṇa- vidhānāt |
yadyapi nāyaṃ viklittibhāvena mukhyaśruḥ :, tathāpi acarī caruśabdānuvāda: caruvarmayogādupapadyate iti auṣadhadharmāpakaṃ bhavati liṅgam |
na ca āgneye caru- rabhāvāt āgneyadharmāṇāṃ carugatatvābhāvena kathaṃ caruśabda: tatra auṣadhadharmāpaka: iti vācyam |
sauryacaro: āgneya- vikāratvena āgneyadharmāṇāmapi carugatatvāt caruśabdasya tathāpakatvasaṃbhavāt |

yadyapi na śrapa- ṇānuvādena ghṛtavidhi:, śrapaṇasya āgneyavikāratve'pi viklittirūpaprayojanābhāvena bādhāt, ghṛtasyotpattivākye prāptatvāt, tathāpi amiśrayogamātrarūpaśrapaṇaṃ śakyā lakṣaṇayā vā pratiprasavavidhayā vidhīyate |
tacca ghṛtaviśiṣṭaṃ śuddhaṃ vā ityetadetat, ka viśiṣṭavidhir ityatra niyāma- kābhāvāt |
utpattivākye ghṛtasya paraṃparayāsaṃbhavena yāgānyatve tasya vilambopasthitikatvāt atraiva viśiṣṭavidhi: iti tu yuktamulyadhāma: |
yadyapi ca śrapaṇasya upāṃśuyāja- vikāratve'pi pratiprasavavidhitvaṃ yujyate eva, ājyeṣvapi amiśrayogasadbhāvāt, tathāpi dravyantarasaṃyogasya atyantāprāptasya upāṃśuyājavikāratve vidheyatvāpatte: |
āgneyavikāratve dravyāntarasya jalasya prāptau tatra ghṛtavidhāne laghavaṃ iti liṅgavopapatti: |

etadaparastanaiva vā bhāṣyakāreṇa 'tasmiṃśca śrapaṇaśrute:' iti sūtrasya ( 39 ) ghṛta- dravyakatvāsādṛśyāt upāṃśuyājavikāratvamādāya ghṛtasya adhikaraṇaśrute: pradeyatvābhāvāt iti vyākhyānāntaraṃ kṛtam |
sarvathā śrautaliṅgopaṣṭabdha sādṛśyasya balavattvāt hiraṇyayāga: auṣadhavikāra etra |
evaṃ ca yatra hiraṇyayāgā- ntaure liṅgabhāva: tatra devatāsādṛśyāt, tadbhāve'pi vā ājyadharmāṇāṃ bhūyasāmanugrahāt tejasvitvasādṛśyena ājyavikārameva |
caruśabdasya vā sthālīpulakanyāyena ( 7|4|12 ) gamakatvāt auṣadhavikāratvaṃ kṛṣṇa- leṣṭivikāratvaṃ vā |
nyāyavindu— kṛṣṇale carau dīptimattvasāmyāt ājyātideśe prāpte, viviktāvayavatvāt caruśabdācca auṣadhātideśa iti siddhānta: |
bhāṣyaṃ— 'prajākāmā gavāyamanamupeyu: ' iti satraṃ vidhāya āmnāyate 'jyotirgaurāya: ' iti |
gavāyamane dvādaśāhiko vidhyantaḥ iti vakṣyati 'gaṇeya dvādaśā- hasya' iti ( 8|1|10 ) |
tatra codakena dvādaśā- hikā dharmā: prāpyante |
ye tatra dvādaśāhikā: ekāhākai: avi- ruddhā:, te yathāprāptaṃ kriyante |
viruddheṣu saṃśaya: kiṃ dvādaśāhiko dharma: kartavya:, uta ekāhika iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? tatra sūtreṇopakrama: 'dvādaśāhikamahaṇe tatprakṛti- tvāt' |
ye jyotiṣṭo- mitebhya: adhikā: stotraśastravikārā:, tadāgamāt |
yathā tasminneva jyotiṣi ekāhe jyoti:- śabda: adhikāgamāt bhavati, satsu jyotiṣṭomiteṣu jyotiṣṭome abhāvāt adhikadharmā'yaṃ śabda: |
tasmāt dvāda- śāhikaṃ dharmajātaṃ viruddhaṃ kartavyaṃ iti |
adhikāgamāt tadākhyaṃ syāt ekāhavat itye- tasya aparā vyākhyā |

ye dvādaśāhe adhikā ekāhi- kebhya: ke cit dharmā ucyante 'abhiprada: anvahaṃ bhavati' 'gaurivītaṃ anvahaṃ bhavati' iti, teṣāṃ adhi- kānāṃ āgamāt tadākhyaṃ etat dvādaśāhikaṃ aha: jyotirākhyaṃ āyurākhyaṃ vā |
yathā tasminneva ekāhe ayaṃ jyotirādiśabda: jyoti- ṣṭomitebhyo'dhikeṣu vaiśeṣikepu dharmeṣu āgateṣu bhavati, evamihāpi adhikāgamātsāmānyāt gauṇo bhaviṣyati |
yathā pāḍahikānāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ bhāvāt ekāha: 'viśvajit ṣaḍaha: ityukte 'tamekāhaṃ ṣaḍaha ityācakṣate' iti |
athavā codaka- prāptebhyo yat adhikaṃ jyotiṣṭomāddharmajātaṃ (stotraśastrādi) āmnāyate, tadapekṣya gau: āyu: ityevādyā: (saṃjñā:) pravṛttā: |
ihāpi nāmadheyaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ tān viśiṣṭān dharmān atidiśati |
bhāṣyaṃ— liṅgācca etajjñāyate yathā dvādaśāhikaṃ kartavyamiti |

kiṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati ? 'dvābhyāṃ soma avadyati, dvābhyāṃ tvacaṃ, dvābhyāṃ tvacaṃ, dvābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ (dvābhyā- masthi, dvābhyāṃ majjānaṃ) ityevaṃ ṣaṭ dvikān anukramya āha 'yad dvādaśapado bhavanti ātmā- nametanniravadyate' iti dvādaśāhikaṃ dharmaṃ dvādaśopasattvaṃ darśayati, tadupapadyate yadi dvādaśāhikaṃ dharmajātaṃ virodhi kartavyam |
atha yat dvau dvau paśū sama- syeyu:, kanīya āyu: kurvanti |
yaccete brāhmaṇavantaḥ paśava ālabhyante nāpriyaṃ bhrātṛvyamatiricyeta, na kanīya āyu: kurvate' iti ekādaśinyāṃ vihāraṃ dvādaśāhikaṃ dharmaṃ darśayati |
kathaṃ ? vihāre sati atireka: paśūnāṃ āpadyate |
bhāṣyaṃ— na vā dvādaśāhikaṃ kāryaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ? ekā- hikam |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ? codakena dvādaśāhikaṃ prāpnoti, nāmadheyena ekāhikaṃ, nāmadheyaṃ ca codakāt balīya: |
satyaṃ, prakṛtau pratyakṣo vidhyantaḥ; vikṛtau tu ānumānika: |
yattu 'adhikāgamāt tadākhyaṃ syāt' (13 sū.) iti, tatra brūma: |
yattu teṣu asatsu śabdasyābhāva iti, naite kadā cit āyurā- diṣu na santi |
yattu jyotiṣṭome nāsti jyotirādi: śabda iti, karmāntaratvāt jyotiṣṭome āyurādi: śabdo nāsti, na dharmābhāvāt |
tasmāt ekāhikaṃ viruddhaṃ dharma- jātaṃ kartavyamiti |
‘adhikāgamāt tadātmyaṃ syādekāhavat’ ityetasya dvitīyavyākhyāparihāraḥ. gauṇaḥ san anuvādāmātramarthakaṃ syāt |
tasmāt pūrvoktena nyāyena nāmadheyaṃ dharmāṇāṃ prāpakamiti |
tatra asmin (utpatti-) vākye nāmadheyaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ lakṣaṇayā śaknoti itikrtavyatāmavagamituṃ ātmīyām |
yadyapi adhikasāmānyāt iti, tatra kiṃcit (anu- vādamātrānarthakyāt) |
bhāṣya— atha yalliṅgamupadiṣṭaṃ dvādaśopattvadarśanaṃ, tasya kaḥ parihāraḥ ? ucyate |
āyu: kurvīran, yadete brāhmaṇavantaḥ nava paśava āla- bhyante nāpriyaṃ bhrātṛmyatiricyate, na kanīya āyu: kurvīta' iti |
gavāmayane hi sampūrṇaikādaśinyā dvātriṃśa- dāramāvṛttau dvipañcādādadhikaśatatraya ahāni pūryante, ava- śiṣṭāni nava, tatra punarekādaśanīkaraṇe atireka: samāso vā āpadyeta |
tat yadi codanālliṅgātideśena jyotirādisyāsvapi vihāra: prāpyeta, tat eva talliṅgamupapadyeta |
yadi tu nāmātideśa- prābalyaṃ, tadā talleina jyotirādisyāsu sampūrṇayā ekā- daśinyā eva prāta: vihāradarśanonupapatti: |
iti cenna, ekādaśanīvihārasya anārabhyādhītasya gavāmayane aupa- deśikatvena tadaṃśe nāmātideśabādhāt |
tathāhi, 'yathā hi prabhava: sthu: tānetānanucīnānālabheran, āgneyameva prathame'hanyālabheran, sārasvatī meṣī dvitīye,
kauṇḍapāyināmanaye śrūyamāṇaṃ naiyamikāgnihotradharmāṇāṃ buddhau nāsti (eṣāṃ) pramāṇaṃ (guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt 3|
kimatò'tra ? etadato bhavati, apūrṇa 1|1|22 iti nyāyāt |
ekārthasaṃbadhanādupamākatvamiti yaṃdākyaṃ yāti, yathā ‘darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta’ cettatrāha—) yatra nirvāpādayo na śrūyan, tatra agnyāvā- iti vidhyādiḥ|

kathamiti vidhyāpekṣaḥ agnyādhānā- dhānādīnāmavacobho na syāt (yathā ‘ādityaḥ prāya- dividhānakāṇḍena pāṭhāt buddhau saṃnihitena ekavākyatāṃ ṇīyaḥ payasi caruḥ’ ityādi) yathā dhūmābhāve agnyāva- yāti, darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta itthaṃ iti |
athocyeta, karma asābhiḥ pekṣo vaikṛto vidhyādiḥ, so'pi vaidikena vidhyāntena itikartavyatāyuktaṃ phalasādhanaṃ dṛṣṭam |
pūrvasminna sāhastre sahastraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ āmnāya uttarasmin darśayati ' yāvadasya sāhastrasya uttarā gau: samāhitā bhavati, tāvadasyāhastra asau loka: ' iti|
tathā pūrvasmin sāhastre ' saṇḍali- saṃvatsara: somakrayaṇa: spardhamānānāṃ' ityāmnāya uttara- sminnapi tameva darśayati ' strī gau: somakrayaṇī, vyākhyātā hyeṣā spardhatā ' iti|
soma- pūrvavat viśeṣaniyāmakābhāvāt avyakta- tvena saumikavidhavat iti iti udita: saṃgati:|
vi- ' sādṛśastre saumika: pūrvadharmā vā, 'vyakta- bhāvata:|
bhāṭṭa- ye tu sāhastrā: sādṛśyā: ityevaṃ ekasaṃjñā yogino yāgā:, te saṃghātarūpanikāyayogāt nikāyina ucyante|
teṣāṃ ya eva eko dharmavān, tasya adharmakeṣu pravṛtti:, ekasaṃjñāyogitvasādṛśyāt|
na cātra nāmnaiva ati- deśa:, sarveṣyāpi mukhyatvena tadasaṃbhavāt|
ekatra mukhyasya hi nāmna: aparatra gauṇatve nāmātideśa:, na tu sarvatra pravṛttinimittasattvena mukhyatve'pi|
na caivaṃ prāyaṇīyasthe'pi ekasaṃjñāyogyāt atideśāpatti:, tasya prāyaṇīyasyatvena dvādaśāhikadvitīyārthadharmadarśanena cānatideśatvāt|
ata eva prayojanāntararahita: eva ekasaṃjñāyoga: ati- deśasādhaka:|
atra ca yatra dharmavān, tasya adharmakeṣu pravṛtti:|
sa pūrvo vā uttaro vā yuktisāmyāt|
prāyaśa: pūrva eva tādṛśa iti sūtrādau tathokti:|
ata eva pūrva- pūrvasya kiṃcicciddharmakadharmatve uttaretareṣu pravṛtti:|
