ata eva pūrvasmin sāhastre sahasraṃ (dakṣiṇāṃ) vidhāya uttarasmin ' yāvadasya sahastrasya uttarā gau: samāhitā bhavati, tāvadasyāhastralokādasau loka: ' iti sahastraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ darśayati|
sādṛśastre ca pūrvasmin saṇḍaṃ somakrayaṇaṃ vidhāya uttarasmin tatyātau ' strī gau: somakrayaṇī, vyākhyātā hyeṣā spardhatā ' ityanena striyo vidhānaṃ spardhatā- vyāvṛttyanuvādaṃ saṃgacchate|
nyāyabindu:- sāhastrā: sādṛśyā: ityevannāmnā yugapadutpakramya paścāt krameṇa vihitā yāgā nikāyina:|
teṣu ekasamhavartitvaṃ ekanāmatvaṃ ca avāntarasādṛśyamasti, iti pūrvasya uttareṣu vidhyanta:, na tu somasyeti|
anyatarato'tirātratvāt pañcadaśarātrasyāhīnatvaṃ kuṇḍapāyināmayanasya ca, tadbhūteṣvahīnatvasya darśanāt |
bhāṣyaṃ- pañcadaśarātraṃ kuṇḍapāyināmayanaṃ ca ubhāva- pyahīnau|
ubhā- vapi etau anyatarato'tirātrau, tena ahīnau iti|
pañcadaśarātrāvat ' tridaśamidupatridaśam ; trirātra:, daśa- rātra:, udayanīyo'tirātra: ' iti|
kuṇḍapāyināmayanapi ' māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' ityārabhya ' daśarātra:, mahāvrataṃ, udayanīyo'tirātra: ' iti|
kathaṃ jñāyate ? ' tadbhūteṣu ahīnatvasya darśanāt ' tadbhūteṣu anyatarato'tirātrabhūteṣu ahīnatvaṃ śrūyate ' yadanyatarato'tirātrastenāhīna: ' iti|
(yathā dvirātrādi: ) atra ca (pañcadaśarātre kuṇḍapāyināmayane ca) atirātro'nte (dṛśyate, nādau)|
bhāṣyaṃ- ahīna iti cāyaṃ pañcadaśarātra: pratyakṣamukta:|
ye eva bhūtikāryamicchantaste enaṃ pañcadaśarātra- mupeyu:|
codanāgataṃ yat, tat antaraṅgaṃ bhavati, bahiraṅgamitarat|
ayaṃ cāparo viśeṣa:-, ahīna- liṅgena ca nityena ahīnasya saṃstutirnopapadyate, upa- pattyā etadahīnatvamucyate ' yadanyatarato'tirātrastenā- hīna: ' iti|
sā yadi tāvadupapatti: sādhikā, tata: antareṇāpi vacanaṃ siddhamahīnatvam|
atha na sādhikā, ucyamānamapi na sidhyati|
stutiśca nityena ahīna- liṅgena anyatarato'tirātratvena ahīnasya nopapadyate|
yena tāvadayaṃ anyatarato'tirātra:, tenā- hīna:, ātmanā ca satram|
ata ubhayātmā viśiṣṭo'yaṃ anyebhya: satrebhya iti|
na ca īdṛk vacanamasti, ' yo'nyatarato'tirātra: so'hīna: ' iti|
bhāṣyaṃ- - satraliṅgaṃ ca kuṇḍapāyināmayane darśayati ' gṛhapatigṛhapati: ; subrahmaṇya: subrahmaṇya: ' iti|
gṛhapatirhi satre āmnāta: ' gṛhapatisadṛśā: samupeyu: ' iti|
satre ca tenārtha: ṛtvarthān yājamānān kartum|
soma- - ahīnatvāt kuṇḍapāyināmayane pañcadaśa- rātre ca pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyena ahīnadharmaprāpti:|
sūtrārthastu - pañcadaśarātrasya kuṇḍapāyināmaya- sya ca anyatarato'tirātratvāt ahīnatvam|

bhāṭṭa- - pañcadaśarātrasya kuṇḍapāyināmayanasya ca na satratvaṃ ' yadanyatarato'tirātrastenāhīna: ' iti śrutyā anyatarato'tirātratvasya ahīnalakṣaṇatvāt arthāta ubhayato'tirātratvasya satralakṣaṇatvena pañcadaśarātrādau ahīnalakṣaṇasattvena tadanupapatte:|
iti prāpte, ahīnatvābhāve'pi prāpnu- yena ahīne anyatarato'tirātratvāt asminnapi pañca- daśarātre anyatarato'tirātratvena ahīnatvopacārasya stutya- tvena upapatte:|
ata eva ' gṛhapatigṛhapati: ' iti gṛhapatiśabda: satraikāntavṛtti:|
nyāyabindu:--pañcadaśarātrasya kuṇḍapāyināmayanasya ca āsanāpāyicodanāt satrākāṇḍāmnātatvācca satrameva, na tu ante'tirātramātreṇāhīnatvam|
bhāṣyaṃ- iha paśugaṇā udāharaṇaṃ ' vasante lalāmā- kṣīn vṛṣamānālabhate ' tathā ' maitraṃ śvetamālabheta vāruṇaṃ kṛṣṇamapāṃ caupadhīnāṃ ca saṃdhavanakrama: ' (vannācakāma:) iti|
tatra vicāryate kiṃ agnīṣomīyasya vidhyantaḥ, uta ekādaśinānāmiti|
ndriyaṃ vīryaṃ dadhyāt , bhrātṛvyamasya janayet , ekayūpa |
ālabheta' iti yūpatritvaṃ pratiṣidhya ekaṃ yūpaṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ |
varuṇapraghāseṣu kevalāni havīṃṣi āmnāya yat vaiśvadevi- |
sādindriyaṃ vīryaṃ dadhyāt' iti yūpatrayaniṣedhatvena prati- |
etāni havīṃṣi sarvaparvasu saṃcaranti iti pañcasaṃcerāṇi |
kimata: ? ata etadbhavati, yat pūrvaiṣāṃ brāhmaṇa- |
bhāṭṭa- paśugaṇeṣu tu saulyepu vā paśugaṇā- |
pratipadya vaikalpike yūpānaikatve prāpte tat pratiṣidhya yūpai- |
cit vaiśvadevikā dharmā vidhīyante, yathā 'agniṃ manmanti' |
punarāmnānaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt, yadi vidhaya: atidiśye- |
sa yathā arthavādān gṛhṇāti, evaṃ vidhīnapi |
vājino yajanti āhutīnāṃ saṃpattyai triṃśatvāya' iti |
bhāṣya--vihitāmnānāt iti yaduktaṃ tasya ka: pari- |
tasmāt na etat jñāpakaṃ vidhīnāṃ anatideśasya |
cocyate yena vākyena, tat teṣāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ matam |
caruṃ, sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ, sārasvataṃ caruṃ, pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ, |
dbrāhmaṇānyeva pañca havīṃṣi, yadbrāhmaṇānītārāṇi' iti śrutam |
yadyapi ca anyatra upakārasya tatputrabhāvena padārthānā- |
tvena etad-brāhmaṇopapatteḥ śāstrasya mahāviṣayatva- siddhayarthaṃ ajñānāṃ śruterātideśaḥ |

na ca apekṣānrame- ṇaiva sarvāntrayāt arthabhāvanāyāḥ itikartavyatā'pekṣāyāṃ ajñātideśe avagate paścāt tadviśiṣṭārthabhāvanāyāḥ vidhisaṃnyadhāvagatārthaṃ tasya stulyapekṣayā stutyatideśaḥ iti viramya- vyāpārāpattiḥ, itthasāmānyavat itikartavyatāsāmānyākṣepā- deva tadviśiṣṭabhāvanāvidhisiddheḥ stutyapekṣāvelāyāmeva atideśapravṛtteḥ |
yā tu evaṃ sati viśvajiti ātideśikārthavādaphalakalpanāprasaktiḥ, sā kaustubhe eva nirastā |
vastutastu vācanātideśasya bhinnavākya- viṣayā pramāṇātvāt utpattivākye itikartavyatāsāmānyā- kṣepaḥ āvaśyaka eva |
na ca prāśastyādihetu tasya niruktāṅgalasattve pramāṇābhāvāt atideśalakṣaṇasya adhyāptiḥ, lakṣaṇe aṅgalpadena bhāvanetikartavyatātvena
padāntarakalpatayā saṃkāratvāt ekādaśe vakṣyamāṇa- marthakarmatvaṃ paraṃ tupāṃse ityuktaṃ prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇe kaustume (2|3|11 pṛ. 85 )|
ata eva 'nāyudau juhoti, na sāma gāyati, na gamanamantraṃ japati' ityādi- niṣedho'pi saṃgacchate |
atideśe'pi ca na tadīya- dravyasya ekapālasyātideśaḥ, aupadeśikena viśeṣa- vihitena, ca tuṣṇikaphāsadravyeṇa lākṣaṇikasya sāmānya- vihitasyātideśaprāptasya dravyasya bādhāt |
nyāyacinduḥ— varuṇapraghāseṣu 'vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tupaiścāvabhṛthaṃ yanti' ityavabhṛthaśabdena apāṃ nyutsekaṃ darśapūrṇamāsātideśaprāptamantra tuṣṇiphāsavidhiḥ |
iti prāpte, avabhṛthaśabdasya tatparatve mānābhāvāt 'yanti' itivihitakarmāntare avabhṛthaśabdo gauṇaḥ, iti mukhyāvabhṛthadharmātideśaḥ, iti siddhāntaḥ |
vājine somapūrvatvaṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ ca graheṣu tācchabdyāt |
bhāṣya— cāturmāsyeṣu vājinejyā śrutā 'vājibhyo vājinaṃ' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ ubhayoḥ saumiko vidhvantaḥ, uta dāśapaurṇamāsika iti taducyate |
vājine, sautrāmaṇyāṃ ca graheṣu somapūrvatvaṃ, saumiko vidhvantaḥ |
somaśabdastu atra śrūyate 'somo vai vājinaṃ, surā somaḥ' iti |
na tāvat vājinaṃ somaḥ, na surā |
sādṛśyaca paraśabdaḥ pātra somadharmakatvaṃ śakyaṃ vidhātuṃ, nānyat |
sa eṣa nāmnā dharmātideśaḥ, na vidhyantena |
bhāṣya— anuvaṣaṭkāraṃ ca somadharme darśayati 'vāji- nasya agre vīhi ityanuvaṣaṭ karoti', 'surāyāḥ vīhi ityanuvaṣaṭ karoti' iti |
bhāṣya— samupahūya bhakṣaṇaṃ ca somadharmaḥ tatra dṛśyate 'śeṣaṃ samaṃ vibhajya samupahūya bhakṣayanti' iti |

( krayaṇaṃ ca, śrayaṇaṃ ca, puro- ruk ca, upayāmagrahaṃ ca, āsādanaṃ ca, vāsopanahanaṃ vāsena vāsasā upanahanaṃ ca, teṣāṃ samāhāraḥ ) bhāṣya— krayaṇādīṃśca somadharmān surāyāṃ darśayati 'sīsena klīvāt krayyā', 'kuvalasaktubhirāśvinaṃ śrīṇāti' iti |
'upayāmagṛhīto'syacchidrayā tvā'cchidrayāśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāmi iti gṛhṇāti, gṛhītvā sādayati |
kṣaume vāsasi upanahanāni tokmāni ṣaḍpāṇi ( ca ) bhavanti' iti |
bhāṣya— haviḥsāmānyena vā atra dāśapaurṇamāsiko vidhvanto niyamyeta |
praśaṃsā'rtho'yaṃ somaśabdaḥ, na vidhvarthaḥ, vidhāyakasyā- bhāvāt |
'somo vai vājinaṃ, surā somaḥ' iti prakṛta- phalavattvāt somasya tadbhāvena surāvājinayoḥ praśaṃsā, yathā 'siṃho devadattaḥ' |
bhāṣya— itarāṇi tu sīsakādīni vācanikāni prāpterabhāvāt |
bhāṣya— 'śappaireva dīkṣaṇīyāmāpnoti, tokmabhiḥ prāyaṇīyā, siṃhalomebhirātithyā' iti |
bhāṣya— paśupuroḍāśāt ca grahāṇāṃ śrūyate 'naiteṣāṃ paśūnāṃ puroḍāśā viyante, grahapuroḍāśā hyete paśavaḥ' iti |
iha tu aspaṣṭaliṅgātideśa iti pādāntaralamāntaryaṃ ca |
vājinādau vakṣyamāṇaliṅgānāṃ yathākathaṃcit upapādanī- yatvāt jhaṭityapratītaśca aspaṣṭā |

arthavādagatasya soma- śabdasya vācanikatipayadharmaninvanaṃ vā pratyakṣādyava- gataṃ vā siddhameva sādṛśyamādāya sūtryatayā upapatteḥ vidhyuddeśagatāmihautriśabdavat sādhyasāhadayaparatve pramāṇā- bhāvāt nātideśatvaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |

atra somaśabda- (3|1|13) 'upadayo yūyo bhavati' ityatra pṛthagvyākhyāta- śravaṇāt vidhāyakatayaiva yūyaśabdāsyātideśatvamāsādya pṛthagvākyaśravaṇe'pi puruṣapāyapārāśrayaṇāt vidhvante- raikavākyatvāca vidhāyakatvābhāvāt anatideśatvaṃ itya- punaruktiḥ |
sūtrārthastu— vājine sautrāmaṇīgraheṣu ca somaprakṛtikatvaṃ somaśabdavattvāditi |
' bhāṣya— vājinayāgasya āmiṣā'nuniṣpannavājina- pratipattidharmo'pi aṅgāpekṣayā kiṃ saumikātideśaḥ, uta dāśarthika iti cintyate |
tatra 'somo vai vājinaṃ, surā somaḥ' iti asome somaśabdaḥ somadharmātideśārthaḥ |
na ca 'upaśayo yūyo bhavati' itivat arthavādatvāt anatideśakalatvaṃ, tadviha siddhasāhadayabhāvena nāmāti- deśāvaśyakatvāt |
ata eva anuvaṣaṭkāramantrau, samupahūya bhakṣaṇaṃ (ca) ubhayatra darśayati |
surāyāṃ sīsena krayaṇaṃ, kuvalasaktubhiḥ śrayaṇaṃ, ekā puroruk, upayāma iti mantraḥ, gṛhītvā āsādanaṃ, kṣaume vāsasi upanahanaṃ (ca) darśayati |
iti prāpte, ārthavādikasya somaśabdasya prakṛtaphalavarūpasiddha- sādṛśyena upapattau vākyabhedādakavidhiparatve pramāṇābhā- vāt grahaśabdasya prāyaṇīyavat grahaṇasya aupadeśikatvenaiva upapatteḥ |
liṅgānāṃ ca vācanikatayā'pi upapattau aprati- badhena codanāliṅgātideśena dāśarthikavidhyanta eva |
ata eva 'śappaireva dīkṣaṇīyāmāpnoti' iti dīkṣaṇīyāprāpti- vacanaṃ saṃgacchate |
itarathā hi tasyāḥ pratyakṣatvena prāptiva- nana stutiḥ asaṃgateva syāt |
tathā 'naiteṣāṃ paśūnāṃ puroḍāśā viyante grahapuroḍāśā hyete paśavaḥ' iti graheṣu puroḍāśaśabdavattvāt taddharmakatve saṃgacchate |

yadyapi ca eteṣāṃ grahāyāntarāṇāṃ vārtikakāramate paśupuroḍāśa- kāryāpannatvasya daśame (10|1|13 sū.) vakṣyamāṇatvāt sthānāpatyeva puroḍāśaśabdopapattiḥ, tathāpi sthānāpatyā- 'pi tāvat paśupuroḍāśadharmāprāpteḥ liṅgopapattiḥ |
vastutastu aṅgāpekṣāyāṃ aṅgaghaṭitasādṛśyasya puraḥsphūrtikatvena sthānāpatyevātideśāpekṣayā codanāliṅgātideśasya balavattvāt auṣadhadravyakatvena sarvaprakṛtibhūtadarśapūrṇamāsavikāratvameva |
ata eva 'eṣāmasaṃbhave kuryādiṣṭiṃ vaiśvānarīṃ budhaḥ' ityādi 'tathāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyā' ityādi ca na jyotiṣṭomādi- ( dīkṣaṇīyādi ) dharmāḥ |
yadā tu dāśamikasūtrabhāṣyakāra- rītayā ( 10|1|13 sū. ) prākṛtapaśupuroḍāśayāge eva surādravyantaramātravidhiḥ ityādiśyate, tadā somādi- śabdasya nāmātideśanirākaraṇamātrārthaṃ idamadhikaraṇaṃ, na tu
nyāyacindu:-- vājine sautrāmaṇīṣu ca sopāti- deśa: 'somo vai vājinaṃ, surā soma:' iti gauṇa- prayogāt |
iti prāpte, arthavādasyāvidhāyakatvāt vājine payovidhattaḥ, surāgraheṣu ca auṣadhavidhvantaḥ iti siddhānta: |
viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe tatpūrvaketvājjyotiṣṭomi- kāni pṛṣṭhānyasti ca pṛṣṭhaśabda: |
kuta: ? yo hi asarvapṛṣṭha:, tasya sarvapṛṣṭhatā vidheyā |
yastu sarvapṛṣṭha eva, tasya tathā kiṃ vihitayā |
kathaṃ ? tatpūrvaketvāt jyotiṣṭomapūrvaketvāt jyotiṣṭomikāni stotrāṇi atra prāpyante |
teṣu māhendrastotrādīni catvāri santi, tāni sarvāṇyeva |
asti ca pṛṣṭhaśabda:, teṣvasti pṛṣṭhaśabda: 'saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni' iti |
api ca ṣaḍahe tu pṛṣṭhavallamasti, yasyāyamanuvāda: syāt |
tatra hi codanā: pṛṣṭhānāṃ 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityevamādyā: |

ṭu-- jyotiṣṭome 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' (kimanu- vādamātraṃ sarvapṛṣṭhaśabda:, uta vikalpaprāptorvṛhadrathaṃtaro- sāmasyavidhānaṃ, āhosvit pāḍahikānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhānā- matideśa: iti cintyate |
tatra prathamaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayati-) ityekasya pṛṣṭhasya vihitatvāt (bahutvāpekṣiya: ) sarva- śabdasyāmidheyābhāvāt vākyārthaya (prasajyeta ) |
paḍahe tu gāyatraṃ prakṛtya sarvāṇi pṛṣṭhāni (kāryāṇi ) iti vihitaṃ, tatra sarvapṛṣṭhadravyatvatā |
'saptadaśāni' iti ca saptadaśatā vidhīyate, na pṛṣṭhatā |
dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayati ) na ca vikalpaprāptayo: samuccayaneyāvattvā, vyarthatvādeva sarva- śabdasya (brahmapakṣatvātsya ) |
(bhāṣyoktaṃ parihāramāha-) athavā pṛṣṭhagatā sarvatā sākṣāt vidhīyate |

bhāṣya--liṅgaṃ ca etanmadhye darśayati 'pavamāne rathaṃtaraṃ karoti, ābhaye vṛhat, madhye itarāṇi, vairūpaṃ hotu: sāma, vairājaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya, raivataṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsina:, śākaramacchāvākasya' iti viniveśapare vākye pāḍahikāni pṛṣṭhāni darśayati |
ṭu-- (liṅgadarśanācceti sūtrārthamāha-) evaṃ ca krama- vidhiparaṃ vākyaṃ ( 'pavamāne rathaṃtaraṃ, ābhaye vṛhat, ityādi ) upapadyate tasmin ( viśvajiti ) |
bhāṣya-- atha yaduktaṃ, asti ca pṛṣṭhaśabda iti, tatra brūma: |
utpannānāṃ stotrāṇāmasau adhikāra: yāni etāni pṛṣṭhānīti |
jñāte ca teṣāṃ pṛṣṭhatve tadupapadyate, na ca tatra jñātam |
iti saṃniveśamātravidhirūpatāparyagrāhakatvena sarvapṛṣṭha- śabdasya niruḍhalakṣaṇā pādikahyaṃtarādihāmaparatvāvagateḥ teṣāmeva vidhiḥ |
ata eva sarvapadena atideśaprāptayoḥ vaikalpikayoḥ vṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ samuccayavidhiḥ ityapāstam |
hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe vairūpasya aupadeśikatvena tayo- rbādhāt, sarvaśabdasya bahutvāpekṣatvena dvayorasaṃbhavācca |
yanmate tu ekameva prakṛtau pṛṣṭhastotraṃ pṛṣṭhadvayaṃ vā tanmate prāptatvāpi nātuvādaḥ |
ayaṃ ca yadyapi na nāmātideśaḥ sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdasya pādaha- vācitvābhāvāt, viśvajiti bahuvrīhiṇaiva pṛṣṭheḥ gauṇatvā- bhāvācca |
na vā ayaṃ vacanātideśaḥ; gṛhamedhīye 'ājya- bhāgau yajati' itideva padahīyatvasya vidheyatā'navacche- dakatvāt |
ata eva na ṣaḍahadharmāṃtarāṇāṃ iha karaṇaṃ anyakarmāṅgatvasya etadvākyapravṛtteḥ pūrvāvagamasāmyāt |
'pradhānaṃ nīyamānaṃ' iti nyāyādeva na rathaṃtarādidharmāṇāṃ āvaśyakatvobhādīnāṃ pavamānādikāryā- ntaropayogirathaṃtarādisādhanatvenaiva prāptiriva |
tena vikalpena prāptayoḥ sarvatvaṃ samuccayo vidhīyate |
iti bhrāme, baharthasarvaśabdasya dvayorasaṃbhavāt pādikahānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ vacanātideśaḥ |
tatra na gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ asyaiva, netarasyeti |
bhāṣya--ekaṃ vā vikuryāt, dadhi payo vā, nome |
bhāṣya-- yatu na gṛhyate viśeṣa iti, tatrocyate |
saṃhataṃ dadhi, āmiṣkā'pi saṃhitā, payo dravam |
bhāṣya-- payo vā āmiṣyā vikriyate, na dadhi |
dadhi ca tatra payo ghanībhāvāyituṃ upādīyate |
loke'pi paya eva ghanībhāvayituṃ dadhi upā- dīyate |
tasmāt paya eva amlasaṃyogena ghanībhūtaṃ āmiṣkā ityucyate |
bhāṣya--sadyaskālatā dharmaḥ payovikāratvena anu- gṛhyate, vaiśvadevasya sadyaskālatvāt |
vaiśvadevo'pi vyahakālaḥ kriyate, tathā tasya dharmo bādhyeta |
yadi dadho vikāraḥ syāt tathā vyahakālābhāve dātavyaṃ, na kathaṃ cana payaḥ syāt, tatra etaddarśanaṃ nopapadyate |
dadhyeva pratinirdiṣṭasya tena vadhnāti deva- tām |
(iti prāpte ucyate ) payasastu pradhānatvaṃ tatra karma- samāptiḥ |
dadhnā hi nīyamānena tadeva vyāpyate payaḥ |
soma-- payordadhivikāratvābhāve'pi āmiṣkāyāḥ dadhivikāratvaṃ syāt ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |

caturthyaṃ ( 4| 1|122-24 ) dadhaḥ prādhānye'pi āmiṣkāyaiva dadhyāna- yanaprayojikā, na vājinaṃ iti siddhe, payaḥprādhānyaṃ atratya- meva vastugatimanusṛtya vyavahṛtaṃ, ihaiva viśeṣātideśa- sidhyarthaṃ payaḥprādhānyaṃ sādhanīyaṃ ityupapannaruktiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- āmiṣkā tāvaccārthāntaraṃ, api tu dadhipayo'- nyatararūpaṃ iti sādhitaṃ caturthyaṃ ( 4|1|19 ) |
tatrāpi tu viśeṣa- cintāyāṃ 'tate payasi' ityatra dvitīyānirdiṣṭapayaḥ eva 'sā vaiśvadevī' iti tacchabdena parāmarśaḥ, na tu saptamyantapadanirdiṣṭasya payasaḥ, guṇabhūtatvāt |

na ca 'ānayati' iti dvikarmakatvāt payaso vyāpyamānatvena dadhyapekṣayā'pi prādhānyāvagatiḥ, dvikarmakadhātusthale adhikaraṇatvātkāntaraniścayāt saṃbandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ ca saṃbandhasāmānye paṣṭhīprāptau 'akathitaṃ ca' iti sūtreṇa ( pā0 1|4|51 ) karmasaṃjñākaraṇāt dvitīyāvidhānāvagatāpi prādhānye pramāṇābhāvāt, prakṛte saptamīśravaṇe adhikaraṇatvavivakṣā''vagateḥ dvitīyakarmapratyayabhāvācca |
ataśca dadhirūpatvā- dāmiṣkāyāḥ dadhiyāvikāratvameva iti laukikasya payasaḥ adhikaraṇatvam |

iti prāpte, madhurarasabhūyastvāt dadhya- bhāve'pi ca amlāntareṇa āmiṣkāsaṃpatteḥ anvayavyati- rekābhyāṃ, 'jubantāṃ yujvaṃ payaḥ' iti mantravarṇācca payasa eva avasthāviśeṣāpannasya āmiṣkāpadavācyatvāvagateḥ tadanuro- dhena tacchabdasyāpi saptamyantapadanirdiṣṭapayaḥ parāmarśitatvasya agrataḥ paya eva āmiṣkā |
evaṃ ca 'tate payasi' ityatra saptamyā prādhānyalakṣaṇā, dvitīyā ca sakṛnyāyena (2|1|4|12) karaṇalakṣaṇayā ityapi dhyeyam |
avasthāviśeṣarūpā āmiṣkā ca nāpaṃ vinā, iti na tasyāpi vivakṣā |
yadi tu tāpaṃ vinā'pi āmiṣkā loke saṃbhavāmye tadā na saptamyā prādhānya- lakṣaṇā'pi |
tamapayo'dhikaraṇatvaviśiṣṭadvayānanyasya avasthāviśeṣaviśiṣṭarūpatvāmiṣkādeśena vidheyatvāt uddeśyavācakapyatulyatayā ca vākyārthapūrtiḥ |
tasyaiva ca tacchabdena parāmarśitaṃ sutarāṃ lipnopapattiḥ |
adhikaraṇa- tvasyaiva ca dadhyānayanaṃ prati aṅgatve'pi payaso nāṅgatvaṃ, kalpyaprayojanatvāt iti dhyeyam |
iti prāpte, 'tate payasi' iti vākye payasa eva prādhānyāt tadevāmiṣkā |
bhāṣya-- iha saṃsthāgaṇā udāharaṇaṃ 'agniṣṭomaḥ, pañcokthyaḥ, śatāgniṣṭomaṃ bhavati, śatātirātraṃ bhavati' ityevamādayaḥ |
atra cintyate kiṃ jyotiṣṭomasyāyamabhyāsaḥ, uta evaṃsaṃkhyānāṃ saṃsthāviśiṣṭānāmanāṃ vāda iti |
tasya etat kṛtaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ agniṣṭoma:, ukthya:, ṣoḍaśī, atirātra: iti |
taṃ ca lakṣaṇayitvā saṃkhyāṃ kevalāṃ vidhāsyati |
nānā'hanāṃ tu vāde saṃkhyā saṃkhyā ca ubhayaṃ vidhīyate, 'ukthyasaṃsthā bhavanti, te ca pañca bhavanti' iti, tathā vākyaṃ bhidyate |
tattatsaṃsthaṃ kratuṃ vadituṃ śaknoti, na jyotiṣṭomameva |
gaṇodanayā praśāntā ahanāṃ pañcānāṃ saṃsthāmātraṃ vidhāsyate |
sa eka evārtha:; yathā 'lohitoṣṇīṣā ṛtvija: pracaranti' iti |
pṛthaktvaniveśinī ca evaṃ saṃkhyā anugṛhyate, tasmāt dvādaśāhikānāṃ nānā'hanāṃ vāda: |
soma- pūrvatra ṣaḍāhavṛti: na prasiddhapadārthā, iha tu prasiddhajyotiṣṭomārthā ityutthite: |
sūtrārthastu-śatokthyādiṣu saṃsthāsu jyotiṣṭomābhyāsa: pratīyate, ukthyādibhi: kṛtalakṣaṇasya kṛtataṃsasya jyotiṣṭomasya grahaṇadanād iti |
bhā- anārabhya 'śatāgniṣṭomaṃ bhavati, śatokthyaṃ, śatātirātraṃ' iti śrutam |
tatra agniṣṭomādidaśānāṃ jyotiṣṭome eva pracuraprayogatvāt tadanuvādena śatasaṃkhyā abhyāsāpādikā vidhīyate |
nahi agniṣṭomādidaśānāṃ saṃsthāviśeṣakṛtsāmānyāvācitvaṃ, tathātve 'athāto'gniṣṭomena mapriṣṭhomena' ityādau prākaraṇikottarabhedena cayanasya vikṛtau niveśāpatte: |
athavā agniṣṭomādidaśānāṃ nāyagṛhītaviśeṣaṇanyāyena saṃsthāmātravācitvāt, jyotiṣṭome nirūḍhalakṣaṇādīkare'pi prakṛte tadāśrayaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt, nityakāmyasaṃsthā'nuvādena śatrāvṛttividhi: |
astu vā idaṃ karmāntaraṃ, tathāpi anyapadārthasya ekavacanantvāt ekameva tat |
ata: śatasaṃkhyāka abhyastaṃ ekaṃ karma jyotiṣṭomavikāra:, iti na gaṇātideśa: |
na tāvat jyotiṣṭomodeśena saṃśodeśena vā saṃkhyāvidhi: |
tathātve ekasya karmaṇa: anekasaṃsthākasya asyā'mantareṇa anupapatte: |

ata: agniṣṭometyādidaśānāṃ 'trivṛdagniṣṭoma: ' 'ukthyo vairūpasāmā' ityādau vikṛtiyajñasāmānādhikaraṇyāpi kācitkaprayogeṇa sāṃpratikalakṣaṇayā tattatsaṃkhyājñāntaraparatvaṃ aṅgīkṛtya śatasaṃkhyābhinnatvādyajñavidhivairāyam |
evaṃ ca anyapadārtha: na karma, api tu śataṃ ukthyasaṃsthāyā: |
yajña: yasmin iti vyutpattyā phalameva iti dhyeyam |
api tu tātparyagatyā aśaṃtayaviśiṣṭatādvaganāvidheraiva iti yuktā gaṇatvadeśāt śatavāramāpatti: |
nyāyavindu- 'śatokthyaṃ bhavati' ityādau ukthyādidaśānāṃ jyotiṣṭomanāmatvāt tadanuvādena śatavṛttividhi: |
tāni ca prāyeṇa ukthyasaṃsthāni, dvau agniṣṭomau |
'śatokthyaṃ bhavati' ityukte agniṣṭomayo: ukthyastotropacaya: prāta:, 'śatātirātraṃ bhavati' iti sarveṣu rātriparyāyopacaya: |
tatra cintyate kiṃ dvādaśāhat upacaya: kartavya:, uta jyotiṣṭomāt iti |
dvādaśāhaprakṛtaya: ete ahargāṇā:; teṣu dvādaśāhiko vidhyantaḥ |
na ca bhikṣukā bhikṣukāntaraṃ yācate ' iti nyāyena jyotiṣṭomasthānyeva kāryāṇi |
anyaṃ ca nātideśa:, api tu karmāntaratve pramāṇābhāvāt yatra ukthyaprasiddhi:; tānyāpi vacanena vidhīyante |
daśarātre ca abhito dvau agniṣṭomau, madhye aṣṭau ukthyā: |
tathā ca śatokthyādau viṃśatirāgniṣṭomā:, te cokthyasaṃsthayā vardhayitavyā: |
pakṣāntare ca ṣoḍaśina: ukthyasaṃsthopacaye kartavye'pi dvādaśāhasya ṣoḍaśino'tideśa pravṛtti:, na tu jyotiṣṭomikasya |
tata: saṃnidhānādukthyastotropacayo'pi tata eva grāhya: iti |
tadiha śatokthyame tāvat atideśaprāptānāṃ ukthyādīnāṃ bādhāt agniṣṭomasaṃsthātve na kā'pi kṣati: |
ukthyātirātrayostu yeṣu atideśenaiva ukthyasaṃsthātvaṃ prāptaṃ, teṣvapi na kā cit śaṅkā |
yeṣu tu agniṣṭomasaṃsthākatvaprāpti:; teṣu vacanādeva ukthyeṣu kartavyeṣu dvādaśāhikānyeva ukthyātirātrastotrāṇi upasthitātvāt kartavyāni |
iti prāpte, na tāvat atideśena teṣāmupasthiti: |

prathamasya prathamaṃ ityevaṃ krameṇa pratyekameva tattadaha: tattadahanā atideśena yāni ahāni ukthyasaṃsthāprākṛtāharvikārāṇi, teṣu tadīyokthyaprāptāvāpi agniṣṭomasaṃsthāprākṛtāharvikāreṣu tadyāto pramāṇabhāvāt, prathamottamayoreva atirātrasaṃsthākatvena tayo: kāpi anatideśena rātriparyāyāṇāṃ sutarāmādeśa: |
ata: śatokthyādau teṣuteṣu aha:su vācikāni stotrāṇi, 'nahi bhikṣuko bhikṣukāntaraṃ yācate' iti nyāyena jyotiṣṭomasthānyeva kāryāṇi |
anyaṃ ca nātideśa:, api tu karmāntaratve pramāṇābhāvāt yatra ukthyaprasiddhi:; talyāni vacanena vidhīyante |
ata eva rātriparyāyādīnāṃ jyotiṣṭome phalārthasaṃsthā- itvena iha anatideśo'pi na kā cit kṣatiḥ, upa- deśenaiva tadvidhānāṅgīkārāt |
iha tu ukthyasaṃsthāyāḥ aupadeśikatvāt agniṣṭomastotrottaraṃ ukthyavicchidiḥ |
iti prāpte, jyotiṣṭome eva ukthyadharmopadeśāt tadvikārameva, na tu dvādaśā- hikavikāratvam |
'nahi bhikṣuko bhikṣukāntaraṃ yācate' iti nyāyāt siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣya--katrca karmaviśeṣe (ṣaṭtriṃśadrātre) śrūyate 'ṣaḍahā bhavanti, catvāro bhavanti' 'pañcāhā bhavanti' |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ dvādaśāhikānāṃ ahanāṃ pravṛttiḥ, uta ṣaḍahasyeti |
ṣaḍahakālābhyāse'pi etasmin śrūyamāṇe vāda- rirācāryaḥ dvādaśāhikānāmahanāṃ pravṛttiṃ manyate sma |
ṣaḍahaśabdena atra aharmitāni ṣaṭ saulyāni karmāṇi ucyante |
yadi ekasyaiva karmaprakṛtasya pārśvikasya ābhiprāvikasya vā abhyāsaḥ kalpyeta, tataḥ catuḥṣaḍahāḥ iti syāt |
atha punaḥ catvāraḥ ṣaḍahāḥ ityukte caturviṃśatyahani pratīyante, sā ahaḥsaṃkhyātvenā prakṛtiliṅgatvāt dvādaśāhikīṃ ahaḥpravṛttiṃ gṛhṇāti |
bhāṣya--tadāvṛtti pārśvikasya prajñātasya ṣaḍahasya āvṛtti jaiminirācāryau mene |
caturviṃśatiḥ ahā apratyakṣā saṃkhyā anumānāt gamyate |
tena pūrvaṃ tāvat ṣaḍahacatuṣṭayameva prayyeti, tat samāhṛtya caturviṃśatisaṃkhyām |
yathā dhūmapratyayenaiva kṛtārtho bhavati, nāsau agnipratyayamādriyate |
bhāṣya- dvādaśāha: 'prāyaṇīyo'tirātra:, pṛṣṭhya: ṣaḍaha:, trayaśchandomā:, avivākyamaha:, udaya- nīyo'tirātra: ' iti |
evaṃ hi upadiśanti satraṃ ahīnaśca dvādaśāha iti |
'eko dvau bahavo'pi vā ahīnaṃ yajeran, tān dīkṣitā yājayeyu:' 'gṛhapatistadasyā: svayamlijo brāhmaṇā: satra- mupeyu:' ' ityevamādaya: |
tat daśame'dhyāye vakṣyate 'dvādaśāhasya satramāsanopāyicodanena yajamānabahu- tvena ca satrasambandhisayogāt' (10|6|16|60) 'yajatitodanādīnatvaṃ svāmināṃ cāsthitaparamāṇatvāt' (61) iti |
sa dvirātrādiṣu ahargaṇe pravartate 'gaṇeṣu dvādaśāhasya' (8|1|9|17) iti |
tatra saṃdihyate kiṃ ubhayaprakāro'sau vikṛtau pravartate, uta vyavasthā ca kidahīnabhūta:, ka citsatrabhūta iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? tayorbhayathā pravṛtti: syāt aikakammāt |
na tasya pravṛttau viśeṣo gṛhyate, iha evaṃvidha: iha neti |
nanu ekā cet dvidhā pravṛttā, dvitīyā kārye nāsti |
aikakammāt vikalpo bhaviṣyati, yathā āgneyavikāreṣu abhimatardānasya |
bhāṣya- apivā naitadevaṃ sarvatra ubhayathā pravṛtti- riti |
yatra yajati: śrūyate, tatra ahīnabhūtasya pravṛtti: |
satrabhūta: āsanopāyicodana: 'dvādaśāhamṛddhikāmā upeyu: ' ' dvādaśāhamṛddhikāmā upāsīran' iti |
bhāṣya- atrāha, ke punaste ahargaṇā: yajati- codanā: yeṣu ahīnabhūta: pravartate, ke vā āsanopāyi- codanā: yeṣu satrabhūta iti |
dvirātrādīnāṃ ā ekādaśarātrāt ahīnatvaṃ, tatra ahīnabhūta: pravartate, teṣāṃ yajatiśabdena codanāt 'dvirāmena yajeta' iti |
bhāṣya- 'trayodaśarātramṛddhikāmā upeyu: ' ' catu- rdaśarātraṃ pratiṣṭhākāmā upāsīran' iti |
evaṃ vā (sūtrārtha: -) yasmāt yajatitodana: ahīna:, tasmāt dvirātrādīnā- mapi ahīnatvam |
yasmāt āsanopāyicodanaṃ satraṃ, tasmāt trayodaśarātrādīni satrāṇi, tānyapi tathodanāni iti |
bhāṣya- 'agniṣṭomo vai prajāpati: sa uttaranekāhā- nakhajata, tametaṃ dvirātrādaya: ahargaṇā ūcu:, tvama- smān mā hāsī: iti, tadeṣāṃ ahīnatvaṃ ' iti dvirā- trādīnāmahīnatvaṃ darśayati |
' soma- āmiṣāyā viśeṣagrahaṇāt ubhayavikāratvā- bhāve'pi ahargaṇeṣu avyavikāratvaṃ avyavasthayā ityu- sthita: saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu-satrāhīnobhayasthāpi dvādaśāhasya gaṇepu avyavasthayā pravṛtti: syāt dvādaśāha- rūpakarmaṇa: ekatvāditi |
dvāda- śāhe cārita satramahīnatvaṃ ceti dharmadvayam |
tatra āsī- ran, upeyu: ityādicodanācodite satratvaṃ aloṇḍopādhi:, aniyatasvāmike yajatitodanācodite ca ahīnatvaṃ atra- ṇḍopādhi:, vṛddhavyavahārāt |
taccharmakatve nimitte ca tatsa- dharmaviśeṣā vihitā: |
tathā anye'pi satrasaṃjñakā: ahī- nasajñakāśca ahargaṇā adharmakā: samāmnātā: |
tatra dvivi- dhe'pi dvādaśāhasya ekasya dharmapravṛtti: |
ata: avi- ruddhā: samuccīyante, viruddhāśca vikalpyante |
nahi atra dvādaśāhamedo'sti, yena avāntarasāmānyāt 'tattad-dvā- śāhavat ' ityādideśavākyaṃ kalpyeta |
bhede pramāṇā- bhāvāt 'dvādaśāhavat ' ityeva atideśavākyakalpane avyavasthaiva yuktā iti |

evaṃ prāpte, satyāpi dvādaśāha- tvenaiva atideśe, satrarūpanimittābhāvāt tannaimittika- dharmā: nāhīne, ahīnatvarūpanimittābhāvācca tannaimittikā dharmā na satre pravartante, iti phalato vyavasthitaṃ prakṛtitvaṃ satrātmakeṣu ahargaṇepu satrātmakasya dvādaśāhasya, ahīnātma- keṣu ahīnātmakesya iti |
dvirātrādārabhya ā ekādaśa- rātrāntaṃ ahīnā:, dvādaśāha: ubhayātmā, trayodaśarātrādā- rabhya sarvaṃ satrabhūtā eva, tathaivoktalakṣaṇatvāt, vṛddha- vyavahārācca |
nyāyabindu:--satrākhye'hargaṇepu satrarūpadvādaśāha- tideśa:, ahīneṣu ahīnasya iti siddhānta: |
ekakapālānāṃ vaiśvadevika: prakṛtiyāmayaṇe sarva- homāpārivṛttidarśanādavabhṛthe ca sakṛd- vyavadānasya vacanāt |
bhāṣya- sākamedhe (veṣu) śrūyate ' etad-brāhmaṇa ekakapāla: ' iti |
tatra cintyate vaiśvadevikasya eka- kapālasya idaṃ grahaṇaṃ, uta vāruṇaprāghāsikasyeti |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ? tasya vihitā dharmā: ' alaṃkṛtya abhipūyaṃ upāṃśu yaṣṭavya: , āvi:pṛṣṭha: kārya: ' ityevamādaya: |
yasya vihitā: dharmāstatraitadyajyate vaktuṃ tada- didaṃ kartavyamiti |
nanu aindrāgnasamuccāraṇān ekakapālo'pi vāruṇaprāghāsika eva syāt, nāvaravyaṃ ekaparvaṇoreva samuccāraṇaṃ bhavitavyaṃ, nānāparvaṇorapi samuccāraṇamaviruddham |

āgrayaṇe cāvāpyavidheyasya ekakapālasya sarvahomaṃ aparyāvṛttiṃ ca darśayati 'yat sarvahutaṃ karoti sā tvekā paricakṣā, huto'huta: paryāvartate sā dvitīyā, ājya- syaiva cāvāpyavidhyau yajeta' iti ājyayāgavidhipare vākye ekakapālasya sarvahomaṃ aparyāvṛttiṃ ca prātāṃ darśa- yati |
etasmāt darśanāt, avabhṛthe ca sakṛd-dravyadā- nasya vacanāt |
avabhṛthe ca avadhāraṇaṃ bhavati ' idameva ekakapālasya dviravadyati ' iti |
kimata: ? sākamedhīye'pi ekakapāle vaiśvadevikā dharmā: prāptā:, teṣāmatideśa: anarthaka: |
vāruṇaprāghāsikasya ye dharmā: vaiśeṣikā aprāptā: , teṣāmatideśa: arthavān |
ke punaste dharmā: ? ' hiraṇmaya: suco bhavanti, śāmimyo vā' ityevamādaya: |

soma--yathā ' etad-brāhmaṇānyeva pañca havīṃṣi ' ityatra tacanasya bahuviṣayatvalabhyāya sāṅjñavidhikasya sārtha- vādasya kṛtsnasya kāṇḍasya atideśa: , tathā atrāpi bahuviṣayatvalābhāya vaiśvadevikātideśa: ityuktvāt, pūrvaṃ sāmānyata: siddhasya kṛtsnakāṇḍātadeśasya viśeṣavicā- raddhā saṃgati: |
bhāṭṭa— ekakapālasya prakṛtibhūta ekakapāla: vāruṇa- praghāsika eva, na tu dharmabhūtasye'pi vaiśvadevikaḥ, vakṣya- māṇāt sarvaikapāleṣu codanāliṅgātideśādeva vaiśvadeva- katharmatāsiddhe: |
tatra hi na dārśikendrāprātideśavidhiḥ, codanāliṅgāti- deśādeva siddhe: |
ata eva cāturmāsyaprakaraṇatvena upasthita- tvāt, vaiśvadeve ca aindrāmābhāvāt vāruṇapraghāsikasyaiva |
(tataḥ kiṃ ? tatrāha-) na cāśravaṇe tṛtīyāyāḥ, (phala-) sādhanatāṃ (yāgaḥ ) pratipadyate |
na ca sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ, laukikaṃ karma guṇabhūtaṃ (dṛṣṭam ), anenāpi (karmatvāt ) guṇabhūtena bhavitavyam (iti, sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya evaṃ- jātīyakeṣu apramāṇatvāt ) |
tatra) kimiti (ākāṅkṣāyāṃ ) nityameva puruṣārtha ākṣi- pyate sākṣāt pāraṃparyeṇa vā bhāvayatvā |
ata āha (bhāṣya- kāraḥ ) svabhāvasiddhaḥ karmaṇāṃ guṇabhāvaḥ (iti |
puruṣārtha- bhāvyatvā bhāvanāyā saṃbadhyamānaṃ karma svayamapuruṣārtha- svabhāvatvāt karaṇatvenaiva saṃśrayate iti bhāṣyārthaḥ |
tayorekārthatvāt samuccayo na saṃbhavati, tasmāt vikalpaḥ |
yat prakṛtau vyavastheti, nāsau kālakṛtā, kiṃ tarhi ? samudāyakṛtā |
na ca saurye tau samudāyau staḥ |
yadi evaṃ, abhimarśanemeva tarhi na prāpnoti, tayoḥ samudāyorabhāvāditi |
tayostu anabhimarśyatvāt, samudāyānāṃ taducyate lakṣa- ṇayā |
āgneyāt upamitalakṣitaprāpaṇena itikartavyatāṃ gṛhṇāti (ityuttare adhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ) |
āgneyasya ca paurṇamāsyāṃ amāvāsyāyāṃ ca vidyamāna- tvāt aśakyamavadhārayituṃ kiṃ paurṇamāsikasya saṃbandhinau itikartavyatāṃ pravartate, uta amāvāsya
na ca taddhitādidattau svarasata ekatvaṃ pratīyate, dvitvabahu- |
tvādi tu pramāṇāntaragamyamiti viśeṣa iti vācyam |
dharmāḥ te sarvakarmasu vihitā bhavanti, tatastatraiva dharmaiḥ |
aindrāgnādī'pi dharmavanta uktāḥ, tathā kartavyatā ceti nārtha |
atha ye yasya prakaraṇe ucyante te tatrai- |
voktā bhavanti tataḥ adharmakāṇi aindrāgnādīni, iti |
saṃkhyāsādhāraṇasaṃkhyāntaraṃ vā pratīyate ityavoktaṃ, na tveka- |
teṣu cintā bhavati kimeṣāṃ dharmāḥ santi, uta neti |
yadā ca santi tadā ke kinto vā kathaṃ cānuṣṭhātavyā |
tatredaṃ vicāryate kiṃ yajiprayuktā ete dharmāḥ kathaṃ yajiḥ |
bhāṣya—karmacodanāyāḥ śeṣabhūto dharmasamāmnāyaḥ eka- deśabhūta ityarthaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta anyā anya- nyādhānādikā itikartavyatā iti |
tasyāṃ codanāyāṃ yajeguṃṇabhāvaḥ śrūyate darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ iti |
karaṇabhāvo'tra yajeḥ śrūyate darśapūrṇamāsākhyena yāgasamudāyena anyat kuryāt iti |
yat tato'nyat, tat kartavyatayā codyate, na yajiḥ |
nanu phalamātra vākye śrūyate, svargakāmo yajeta iti, tat kartavyaṃ syāt |
satyaṃ śrūyate, na tu tadya- jinā kriyate, vinadhe yajau tadbhavati |
yasya karta- vyatā, tat itikartavyatā saṃbadhyate |
ḍup--anena ( pūrvapakṣasūtreṇa ) saṃnipyopakārakāḥ ( prokṣaṇāvaghātādayaḥ ) tadarthāḥ ( yāgārthāḥ ) ucyante |
bhāṣyaṃ--evaṃ ca sati sarve dharmāḥ sarvārthā bhavanti |
tatra saurye karmaṇi prayājānāṃ darśanamupapadyate ' prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti ' iti |
utpattau vidhayabhāvādā codanāyāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt, tataśca karmabhedaḥ syāt |
yattu pratyakṣe yajirsendho dharmāṇāṃ iti, atra bhramaḥ |
uktau yajñau nāsti vidhiḥ yajyarthā dharmā iti |
yathā vāsasi rāgaḥ śrūyate ' vāso rañjayati ' iti, vāsasi ca kriyate na cāsau tadarthaḥ |
evamihāpi yajñau śrūyamāṇāḥ kriya- māṇāśca apūrvārthā bhaveyuḥ |
tataśca karmabhedaḥ syāt, yataḥ apūrvārthā iti |
yaśca yajeḥ pratyakṣaḥ phale guṇabhāva iti, sa nākṛtvā apūrve bhavati iti prāṇāliko vijñāyate |
praṇāḍyā'pi ca yena kriyate, tat kāraṇaṃ bhavati |
yathā ' gomayaiḥ pacati ' ' tṛpyakā bhavanti ' iti |
yattu, tailapānavat yajitaḥ phalaṃ bhavi- pyatīti |
yacca phalaṃ balapuṣṭyādi, tat samyagāhārapariṇāmāt bhavati |
bhāṣyaṃ--yadyapi apūrve prayojakaṃ dharmāṇāṃ, tathāpi sarvadhamaiḥ syāt sasa padārthaḥ |
yathā ' vāhīkaḥ atithirāgataḥ, yatrāsmasmai prakriyatāṃ ' ityukte yoyo vāhīkaḥ, tasyatasya yavānaṃ kriyate |
yathā vā ' akṣayāmeye mudraudano bhoktavyaḥ, udarāmeye pāyaḥ pāyavyaṃ' iti |
sarvatra ca hi akṣayāmeye mudraudano bhujyate, udarā- meye'pi payaḥ pīyate |
evamihāpi ekasyāpūrvasya ye dharmāḥ śrutāḥ, te sarvāpūrvāṇāṃ bhavitumarhanti |
api ca aruṇa- parādarā nāma śāstrinaḥ |
' ye darśapūrṇamāsayordharmāḥ, te sarveṣāṃ agnihomīyasya ca ' ityārabhya yāvat ' sarvāḥ prakṛtitrika- tayo'nukrāntāḥ ' iti |
tasmāt apūrvaprayuktatve'pi sarve dharmāḥ sarvārthā iti |
arthasya tvavibhaktatvāt syādamidhāneṣu, pūrva- vatvāt prayogasya, karmaṇaḥ śabdabhāvatvāt, vibhāgācchedātpravṛttiḥ syāt |
arthasya tu avibhaktatvāt tathā syāt abhidhāneṣu |
artho vāhīkavat tadeśasaṃvanaḥ, so'vibhaktaḥ sarvavāhīkeṣu anugata ityarthaḥ |
tatra anvayavyatirekāmyāṃ jñātametat, deśanimittaṃ yatrādyaprayatā, na puruṣanimittā |
atha iha karmaṇaḥ śabdabhāvatvāt nānyataḥ śakyametat jñātuṃ ke kasyāpūrvasya dharma iti |
ataḥ śeṣāṇāṃ anyatra vihitānāṃ anyatra apravṛttiḥ syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ--atha yaduktaṃ smṛtiriti, tasya kaḥ parihāraḥ ?|
bhāṣyaṃ--pūrvavatī hīyaṃ smṛtiḥ--codakaṃ dharmagrāhakaṃ vakṣyati ' vidhvanto vā prakṛtiyat ' iti (4|4|10) |
tena prāpitānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ ayamanuvādaḥ--etannyāyapūrvikā, na aprāptānāṃ vidhāyikā |
yat kāraṇaṃ, vyavasthā dharmāṇāṃ etena nyāyena bhavati |
arthasya śabdabhāvatvāt pratiprakaraṇaṃ ca nibandhanācchuddhādevānyatra bhāvaḥ syāt |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt arthasya anyabhāvādāneḥ śabdabhāva- tvāt, pratiprakaraṇaṃ ca nibandhanāt śabdādeva anyatra bhāvaḥ syāt |
yathā ' gandharvāpsaraso vā etamunmāda- yanti, ya unmādyati, etā vai gandharvāpsaraso yadādyabhūtam |
tasmai svāhā tābhyaḥ svāheti juhoti ' iti |
abhiprāka- raṇe upannānāṃ rāṣṭrabhṛtāṃ udāhre upadeśaḥ ' eteṣāṃ rāṣṭra- bhṛto juhoti abhyātānān juhoti ' iti |
asati eta- smin vacane yathā'dhikāraṃ vyavatiṣṭheran dharmā iti |
tatra saptamena tāvat aindrādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ dharmāḥ santītyucyate |
atideśo nāma, ye paratra vihitāḥ dharmāḥ, tamatya anyatra teṣāṃ deśaḥ |
yathā devadattasya bhojanavidhiṃ kṛtvā ' śālisūpamāṃsāpūpai- daivadatto bhojayitavyaḥ ' iti |
tameva vidhiṃ yajñadatte atidiśati, ' devadattavat yajñadatto bhojayitavyaḥ ' iti |
ślokamapyudāharanti ' prakṛtāt karmaṇo yasmāt tatsamā- neṣu karmasu |
dharmapradeśo yena syāt so'tideśa iti sthitiḥ ||
tatra nāma trividhaṃ atideśikaṃ karmanāma, saṃskāranāma, yaugikamiti |
śā--' dharmāṇāṃ karaṇāṅgatve vicāro (vivādo iti pāṭhaḥ ) naiva vidhate |
tasmāt sarvārthā dharmāḥ iti anārabhyaḥ ati- deśavicāraḥ |
' soma--pūrve paṭṭake upadeśavicāraṃ parisamāpya idānīmuttarapaṭṭake atideśavicāro hetuhetumadbhāvasaṃgatyā prastūyate |
' itthaṃ kuryāt ' ityupadeśapūrvapūrvakatvāt ' tadat kuryāt ' ityupadeśasya tadvicāro'pi hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ |
yathāprakaraṇaṃ darśapūrṇamāsādiṣu dharmavyavasthāyāṃ sādhitāyāṃ dharmākāṅkṣeṣu sauryādiṣu atideśena dharmaprāptyarthaṃ saptamaḥ |
' asmāt karman ime dharmā atra bhavanti ' iti tadviśe- pasiddhayarthamaṣṭamaḥ |
ayamatra cintā- kramaḥ, uttarapaṭṭakaḥ kimārambhaṇīyo neti, tadarthamimaṃ cintā kiṃ sauryādiṣu atideśena dharmāḥ bhavanti, uta neti |
tadarthamanyā cintā kiṃ prayājādayo dharmāḥ sarvayagā- rthatvenopadiśyante, uta yathāprakaraṇaṃ vyavatiṣṭhante iti |
tadarthamaparā cintā kiṃ yajyarthā dharmāḥ, utāpū- rvārthā iti, kiṃ yāgasaṃbandhapūrvakāḥ apūrvabhāvanāsaṃbandhaḥ,, uta tatpūrvo yāgasaṃbandha iti |
sūtrārthastu-mukhyānāṃ- pūrvāṇāṃ bhede yathā'dhikāraṃ yathāprakaraṇaṃ dharmāṇāṃ bhāṣye vyavasthā syāt |
bhāṭṭa - evaṃ sādhikāre upadeśe avagate adhunā lyupadeśenaiva iti na ka cit atideśasiddhiḥ |

pādako bhāṭṭagranthaḥ anyatra gṛhīta iti taduttaragranthoṃ'tra 'agnihotraṃ' ityādīnāmapi 'siṃho devadattaḥ' itivat saṃgṛhyate iti bodhyam ) atideśanirūpaṇopadeśātvena idaṃ siddhasāhacaryaṃ, tadyalyanyāyameva vā ādāya anuvādaḥ |
nirūpyate, kiṃ prayājādīnāmupadeśena prakṛtiprāptāvarthaṃ, uta iti prāpte, yadyapi yāgānuvādena dharmavidhiḥ, tathāpi prakṛtivikṛtisādhāraṇyaṃ iti |
sādhāraṇye hi atideśa- anuvādasya sati saṃbhave saṃnihitagāmitvaniyamāt 'brīhi- vaiyarthyaṃ, iti upodghātā |
tatra yadyapi prayājādiṣu bhiryajeta' itivat prakṛtamātragāmitvaṃ, viśeṣataśca naya- āgneyādimātraviṣayaprakaraṇāderviśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ
suvāntareṇa saṃnve sa ca nāsti kathaṃ cana |
ye tu necchanti dharmāṇāṃ saṃbandhaṃ caikataḥ saha ||
na yuktaṃ, tatra cintā hi paṭke'smin kāryabandhanā |
upa- deśo hi nāmātra granthasaṃdarbha ucyate ||
yo'rthaḥ pratīyate yasmāt sa paraṃ naupadeśikaḥ ||
vidhvarthaḥ svapratī- tyarthe yathā'pi sati so'pi ca |
na padārthaviśeṣaṃ tu vaikṛtaḥ prākṛto yathā |
tadā virodho jāyeta na caivamiva saṃmatam ||
atideśāśrayatve hi vādhe tantre ca bhūyasī |
sa aupadeśiko jñeyaḥ sa ca dvaidhamupasthitaḥ ||
yatho- pakāraḥ prakṛtau niyogyo vā śruto yathā ||
( iti śālikanāthapraṇītāyāṃ prakaraṇapañjikāyāṃ atideśapārāyaṇam ) pañjikā pṛ. 226-231.
bhāṣyaṃ - evaṃ tāvat samenādhyāyena sāmānyato'- tideśalakṣaṇamuktam |
avihitadharmakeṣu aindrādyādi karmasu vihitadharmakebhyo darśapūrṇamāsādibhyo dharmā atidiśyante iti |
tatra cintā bhavati, kiṃ ekasmin karmaṇi sarva- karmasu ( sarvakarmabhyaḥ ) dharmātideśaḥ uta ekasmāt iti |
ekena tu nirākāṅkṣī- kṛte karmaṇi dvitīyadharmaprāptau kiṃ cit kāraṇaṃ nāsti |
satyaṃ, tadeva tu na jñāyate kasmin kasyeti |
tadarthaṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ vaktavyaṃ asmin asya iti |
tadidaṃ adhyā- yādau pratijñāyate ' atha viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ ' iti |
dānīṃ vṛttāt sāmānyātideśalakṣaṇāt anantaraṃ viśeṣa- lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |

dup - ' kimekasmin karmaṇi sarvakarmasu dharmati- deśaḥ ' iti ( asya bhāṣyagranthasya yadi tāvadayamarthaḥ :-) ekasmin karmaṇi ( darśapūrṇamāsādī ) ye dharmāḥ samā- mnātāḥ te sarvakarmasu ( iṣṭiputrayajñasomādiṣu ) ati- diśyante, utāho naikasmāt sarvakarmasu atideśaḥ ( iti so'yamatiyuktaḥ |
kathaṃ ? ) etasmin granthārthe ( yadyapi ) nyāyo na virudhyate |
parantu grantho ( ekena nirākṛte ityādiḥ ) na saṃtrayate itareṇa ( saṃśayagranthena ) |
yadi ekasyāṃ vikṛtau sarvadharma atidiśyante ityayaṃ pakṣa āśritaḥ, tat idamuttaraṃ yujyate, ekena vidhvantena nirākāṅkṣīkṛte ( karmaṇi ) dvitīyasya prātirnāsti ( iti, nānyathā ) |
atha ( evaṃ varṇyate ) ekasmin karmaṇi sarvadharmātideśaḥ ( sarvakarmasu ye dharmāḥ tepāmati- deśaḥ ), utāho na ( evaṃ, kiṃtu ) ekasāt ( eva ekasmin karmaṇi atideśaḥ ) iti |
( tathāpi na yuktam ) sarvakarmadharmātideśaḥ ityayaṃ pakṣo nirākṛtaḥ ( vidhvantādhikaraṇe 7|1|1 |
tatra hi - ) atha kasmāt ume ( api ) itakartavyate ( laukikī vaidikī ca saha ) na pravartate ( ityādāṅkya ) ' miyo vipratiṣedhāt ' iti sūtreṇa ( 7|1|6 ) nirākṛto- 'yaṃ pakṣaḥ |
ekayā nirākāṅkṣīkṛte dvitīyā na pravartate, pramāṇābhāvāt |
tasmāt ) ihadhaḥ saṃśayo yuktaḥ : kiṃ aniyamena yasya kasya cit sākṣāt itakartavyatā pravartate, utāsti kaścit niyamaḥ iti |
utta- rastu niyataiva ( ekā itakartavyatā pravartate |
sūtrārtha- māha - ) ' atha viśeṣalakṣaṇam ' iti ekasmānniyatā pravartate ityarthaḥ |
( kathaṃmarthaḥ : iti cedāha - ) viśeṣaḥ itya- sādhāraṇamucyate |
yadi cāniyamena ( pravartate ) tataḥ asādhāraṇaṃ na ( syāt ) |
tatra ) katara- smāt ( viśeṣāt ) katarasya ityata āha ' yasya liṅga- marthasaṃyogāt ' iti |
śā - - vidhvantādhikaraṇe ( 7|1|1 ) sauryādiṣu ānu- mānikavacanena vaidikī itakartavyatā astītyuktam |
tasyedānīṃ viśeṣa ucyate kasya vidhvantaḥ ka pravartate iti |
soma - - sāmānyato'tideśanirūpaṇānantaraṃ viśeṣā- tideśo nirūpyate ityadhyāyayoḥ saṃgatiḥ |
' sāmānyāti- deśābhyantaraṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ' iti bhāṣye sūtraṃ vyākhyātam |
vārtike tu viśeṣaśabdasya asādhāra- pārthatāmaṅgīkṛtya ekaivetikartavyatā pravartate ityarthe vyākhyātam |
coda- nāliṅgātideśasya tu sāmānyato nirūpitasya prakṛtivi- śeṣanirūpaṇārthama atha : ārabhyate |
tatra ekasmin sauryādau ekavidhvantenaiva nirākāṅkṣatvāt sarvavidhvantasamuccayoge- 'pi niyāmakabhāvāt aniyamena aneka
bhāṣyaṃ-- ekādaśanī śrūyate ' upaśayo yūpo bhavati ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ etadupaśayādarthaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ, jopaṇādayaḥ saṃskārā atra kartavyāḥ, uta neti |
ayaṃ yūpaśabdaḥ saṃskāranimittaḥ, sa eṣaḥ asatsu saṃskāreṣu nopapadyate |
ete saṃskārāḥ asmin kāṣṭhe kriyante, etena dvāreṇa yajatinā saṃbhalasyate, itthaṃ saṃskṛte kāṣṭhe niyu- ktena paśunā yajiḥ kriyamāṇaḥ apūrvaṃ nirvartayati iti |
asmiṃścopaśaye na paśurnīyate, tatra kṛtāḥ saṃskārāḥ anarthakāḥ syuḥ |
bhaktyā bhaviṣyati, yathā ' yajamāno vai yūpaḥ ' iti |
āha, tatra sādṛśyāt, iha punaḥ kathamiti ? ucyate |
yūpasaṃskārā- strasya cit arthātācchedādayaḥ tūṣṇīṃkṛtāḥ santi |
yathā snātā kanyā analaṃkṛtā mālāguṇaināpi alaṃkṛtā iti |
evaṃ ekādeśenāpi saṃskārāṇāṃ saṃskṛtaḥ iti stutyā abhi- dhīyate |
śā-- ' upaśayo yūpo bhavati ' iti anuvādo'yaṃ upaśayastulyarthaḥ, na saṃskṛtimapekṣate |
tasmāt laukikāḥ yūpadharmāḥ ke cit chedanādayaḥ upaśaye vacanādanīyante, tena nimittena gauṇo'yaṃ vādaḥ |
somaḥ-- saṃskāranāmnaḥ atideśatvaṃ uktaṃ ka cidupapadyate iti saṃgatiḥ |
sarveṣāṃ upānāṃ dakṣiṇataḥ upa- śete iti upaśayaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ sa yūpaḥ |
na dharmātideśa- katvaṃ yūpaśabdasya iti siddhāntaḥ |
sūtrārthastu-upaśaya- dravyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ yūpaśabdābhidheyasaṃskārayuktaṃ syāt saṃskāra- vācakaśabdaśravaṇāditi |
vi-- ' saṃskāraḥ syādupaśaye na vā, yūpoktito'- grimaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- yūpaikādaśināṃ yūpasamīpe ekaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ sthāpa- nīyaṃ iti vidhāya ' upaśayo yūpo bhavati ' iti śrutam |
tatra upaśaye kāṣṭhe yūpaśabdasya yūpadharmān jopaṇādīn saṃskāranimittatvāt asatyapi sthānāpatyadeśe nāmāti- deśavidhayā atidiśet |

iti prāpte, asya gauṇyā śaktyaiva vā dharmavidhāyitve vākyabhedāpatteḥ, upaśaya- stutyarthatvena tadvidhaikavākyatāpacca asya pṛthak vidhi- tvānupapatteḥ, arthaprāptakatipayacchedādidharmayogena gauṇyā vṛtyā upaśayastutireva idaṃ, na tu nāmātideśakam |
nyāyabinduḥ-- ' upaśayo yūpo bhavati ' ityarthavādaḥ chedanādinimittaḥ, na tu atideśikaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ-- kiṃ epa evotsargaḥ sarve karmanāma anyana śrayamāṇaṃ dharmāṇāṃ grāhakarmiti ? evaṃ khalu prāptam |
gavāyane śrūyate ' vaiśvā- naro jyotiṣṭomaḥ prāyaṇīyamaherbhavati ' iti |
asti tu dvādaśāhne prathamamahaḥ prāyaṇīyaṃ nāma ' prāyaṇīyo'ti- rātraḥ ' iti |
tayornānātvaṃ tenaiva nyāyena siddhaṃ ' prakara- ṇānte prayojanamalpaṃ ' iti (2|3|124) tatra ayaṃ prāyaṇīyaśabdaḥ paratrāpi śrayamāṇo na dharmāṇāṃ grāhakaḥ |
kathaṃ ? lakṣaṇayā nāma- dheyaṃ dharmāṇāṃ grāhakamuktam |
' guṇena kriyāyogena tasmin karmaṇi śrutyaiva yujyate |
prayanti anena iti prāyaṇīyaṃ, pravarta-te anena sane iti |
bhāṣyaṃ-- vākyaśeṣāśca etamevārthamāha ' jyoti- reva purastādādhāti ' iti |
yena jyotiḥ prāyaṇīyaṃ bhavati, tena jyotiḥ purastāt kriyate ityartho ' jyotireva purastā- ddhāti ' iti |
siddhāntāt-- ) prayanti ( prārabhante ) anena iti prāyaṇīyaṃ ityanena yogena dvādaśāhne ( prathame- 'hani ) iyaṃ saṃjñā pravṛttā |
gavāyane ca ( prathame'hani ) ayaṃ yogo vidyate eva |
tasmāt ( kṛtatvayogena mukhya- tvopapattau gauṇyā vṛtyā ) dharmātideśo nāsti |
yatra tu pañcamaḥ pañco vā prāyaṇīyaḥ, tasya yogābhāvāt anudāharaṇa- tvam ( tatra pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyena bhavatyevātideśaḥ |
) tasmāt tādṛśo na pūrvādhikaraṇapādāt : śā-- atideśe prāpte'bhidhīyate ' prāyaṇīyapadaṃ yena nimittena pravartate |
prāthamyena tadasyeva gavāyanādike- 'pi naḥ !! tasmāt siddhanimittena śrutyā nāmatvasaṃbhavāt |
bāhulakāt karaṇe anīyara- pratyayaḥ, prāyaṇamārambhaḥ, tatra bhavaḥ iti prāyaṇīyaḥ |
tacca dvādaśāhnegāvā- yanikayostulyaṃ iti ubhayatrāpi nāmadheyaṃ, iti na gauṇa- tvena dharmātideśatvam |
evaṃ ca yatra natrudye pañcame vā ahani prāyaṇīyaśabdaḥ, tatra prāthamyarūpapravṛttinimittasaṃbha- vāt gauṇyā vṛtyā dharmātideśatvaṃ yuktam |

etena ' caturviṃśe : prāyaṇīyo bhavati ' iti caturviṃśatyahe dvitīyo'hani prayuktasya prāyaṇīyaśabdasya vidhyamānapada- hācchilakṣaṇamāsāpekṣayā prāthamyamādāya mukhyatvāt anati- deśatvaṃ iti vedabhāṣye mādhavoktaṃ cintyam |
sarvopalakṣyā prāthamye eva prāyaṇīyaśabdasya mukhyatvaṃ, māsādikiṃci- dapekṣayā tu prāthamye gauṇatvameva |
tathā ca avadyaṃbhāvini gauṇatve dharmavidhilipsayā atideśakaratvasyaiva yuktatvāt |
sūtrārthastu-- satrakarmaṇi gavāyane eṣā śrutiḥ : prāyaṇīyaśabdaḥ guṇārthaḥ : avayavayogārthaḥ syāditi : vi-- ' gavāyane āye'hani prāyaṇīyeti nāma yana |
' bhāṭṭa-- dvādaśāhe prathamamahaḥ prāyaṇīyaṃ sadharmakaṃ vidhāya gavāyane ' vaiśvānaro jyotiṣṭomaḥ prāyaṇīyamaha- rbhavati ' iti śrutam |
tadete dve karmaṇī vinigamanā- virahāt iti nirṇītaṃ prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇe ( 2|3|1 ) kaustubhe |
na ca codanā- liṅgātideśeva tasyātisiddheḥ : nāmātideśavaiyarthyaṃ, gatya- sāmye'pi dvādaśāhāntaragatadvādaśāhasyaiva codanāliṅgāti- deśena dharmāprāpterdharmāmāṇatvāt |

iti prāpte, yenaiva prathamaṃ yanti anena iti yūpapatyā prāyaṇīyaguṇayogena dvādaśāhike ahani pravṛttiḥ, tenaiva gavāyane'pi iti prāthamya- yogena ubhayatrāpi mukhyataiva pravṛttau gauṇatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
na cātra pūrvvavat dvādaśāhike pracuraprayogaḥ, yena tatraiva 'tra na nāmātideśaḥ prāyaṇīyapade |
vaiśvānarapadaṃ tu prakaraṇe vaiśvānaradharmānāt tatpratyayanyāyena nāmadheyamepi vaiśvā- narasaṃjñakasya karmāntarasya aprasiddheḥ naivātideśakama |
jyotiṣṭomapadaṃ tu jyotiṣṭomadharmapratipādakatve sat bhavatyeva atideśakama |
tena etattulyāyāṃ virodhe na gatya- sāmyāt dvādaśāhikadvitīyādyaharmāḥ, api tu jyoti- ṣṭomakāḥ |
idaṃ cādhikaraṇaṃ gavāyane'praye'hani prāyaṇīya- padasya bhāṣyakārādile manāt avagatamavyam |
yadā tu chando- gasūtrānusāraṇaṃ prāyaṇīyapadasya gavāyane'pi dvitīye caturviṃśe'hani prayogaḥ, tadā atideśo bhavatītyeti dhyeyam |

nyāyabinduḥ — dvādaśāhikaprathamahāryakaḥ prāyaṇīya- śabdo gāmayanaprathama'hani gauṇa iti atideśe prāpte, prāthamyena nimittena prāyaṇīyapadasya tatrāpi śaktatvena gauṇyabhāvāt nātideśa iti siddhāntaḥ |
tatra cinyate kiṃ phalanīyamakartṛsamudāyānāṃ sauryādiṣu pravṛttiḥ, neti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? 'iṣṭipa darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pravṛttiḥ' (8|1| 4|11) ityanena nayena pravṛttiḥ iti prāptam |
kutaḥ ? karmaṇaḥ apravṛttitvāt, tadvantvācca phalādī- nām |
na ca karma vidhyantāvihitaṃ, vidhāvihitaṃ tat |
tasya apravṛttitvāt phalanīyama- kartṛsamudāyasya ananvayaḥ, apravṛttirityarthaḥ |
phalaṃ tāvat 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti darśapūrṇamāsasaṃyuktaṃ śrutam |
evaṃ niyamo'pi karmamantranaḥ 'yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti |
sa darśapūrṇamāsābhāve kathaṃ syāt ? tathā kartā karmavandhanaḥ 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmaḥ' iti |
so'pi kathaṃ tayorastauḥ syāt ? samudāyo'pi āmeyādīnāṃ, tāni sauryādiṣu na santi, iti tatsamudāyaḥ kathaṃ tatra bhavet ? tasmāt teṣāmapravṛttiḥ |
dupa — saurye karaṇasya pratyakṣatvāt karaṇāntarasya apra- vṛttiḥ, ānumānikatvāt |
yāva- jjīvako niyamaḥ kartṛdharmaḥ, sa puruṣārthāccātidiśyate |
phalena vyāpyamāno yaḥ kartā, sa nātidiśyate |
yaḥ punaḥ 'yajeta' ityatra kartā, sa kratuṃ nirvartayati iti phalarthaḥ |
kiṃtu yatra vahavaḥ kartāraḥ śrūyante, tatra tāvat ānumāniko nātidiśyate |
samudāyaḥ karaṇaparicchedena upakṛtavān, sa iha paricchedābhāvāt nātideśyaḥ |
samudāyaṃ ca gṛhatā āgneyādayaḥ kāryāḥ, te tu kriyamāṇāḥ svarge sādhayeyuḥ, tathā sati yathāśrutaphalavyāghātaḥ |
ayodhcetat, samudāyaṃ gṛhan nāntarīyakatayā āgneyādīn kariṣyati, na phala- sādhanatvena |
samudāya eṣāṃ guṇabhūtaḥ, na ca guṇaḥ ākṛṣyamāṇo guṇināmārṣati, atadarthatvāt |
bhāṣya — api ca dharmāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ karmāyāṃ, karmaṇaḥ upakartum |
niyamo'pi na karmadharmaḥ, kartṛdharmo'sau ityuktaṃ 'kartṛtvā śrutisaṃyogāt' iti (2|4|12) |
tathā kartā svargakāmo na karmārthaḥ, karma svargakāmārtham |
nahi svargakāmaḥ karmaṇaḥ upadiśyate 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti, kiṃ tarhi ? karma svargakāmasya upadiśyate, svargakāmo yajeta, nānyat kuryāt iti |
tathā samudāyo na karmārthaḥ, phalayo'sau, 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
evameteṣāṃ karmaṇaḥ anupakāra- katvāt pravṛttirarthikā syāt |
bhāṣya — atrāha, yadi darśapūrṇamāsasaṃyogāt phalā- dīnāṃ apravṛttiḥ, prayājādīnāmapi tatsaṃbandhatvāt apravṛttiḥ prāptā, tatrāpi hi tatsaṃyuktānīti |
yadyapi tāni darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrutāni, vidhyantena tu sauryādi- ṣvāpi atidiśyante (8|1|2) |
teṣāṃ yadi pratyakṣa pravartakā śrutiḥ syāt, tataḥ pravartan |
' soma — aṅgavat phalādīnāmapi atideśaḥ iti utthitaḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu — karmaṇaḥ karaṇasya vikṛtau apravṛtteḥ phalādīnāṃ tanniyatasaṃbandhamavṛttiriti |
vi — phalaṃ ca niyamaḥ kartā saṃghaḥ saurye na vā, 'grimaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa — evaṃ prakṛtiviśeṣe nirūpite phalanīyamakartṛ- samudāyādo teṣāṃ na prakṛtitaḥ, yatasteṣāmatideśaḥ |
tathāhi, prakṛtiphalaṃ tāvat prakṛtyanatideśādeva nāti- diśyate |
nahi prakṛtirapi atideṣṭuṃ śakyā, vikṛtibhāva- nāyā vikṛtikaraṇena nirākāṅkṣatvāt |
na ca sauryā- divākye dravyadevatāmātraviśeṣābhāvanavidhau kṛte sāha- śyena prākṛtabhāvanopasthitau tatsaṃbandhādhikaraṇasya prayājā- divat atideśopapattiḥ |
anumitisāmanyā- calavattvena sūryādidevatayā yāgāmānalasyāpi āva- śyakatayā śābdatve vijñātīyayāgasyāpi bhāvanāvidhyaṇa- tayā vidherāvaśyakatvena karaṇākāṅkṣā'bhāvāt atideśā- nupapatteḥ |

na ca tathāpi tadaikānye āgneyavadbhedakalpane gauravāt tathāye āgneyāpattiḥ, vinigamanāvirāhasaha- kṛtavidhipunaḥśravaṇeṇa vaijātyānāṃ bhedasiddheḥ, anyathā āgneye'pi sauryādyapattau sauryādīnāṃ sāṃkaryāpatteśca |
ataḥ sauryādīnāṃ bhinnānāmeva karaṇānāṃ lābhāt na teṣā- matideśa iti siddham |
na ca tadabhāve'pi aṅgavat vikṛteḥ phalā- kāṅkṣā'sti brahmavarcādisādhanaphalasya nirākāṅkṣatvāt |
yatrāpi viśvajidādau na phalaśravaṇaṃ tatrāpi na tadatideśaḥ |
sa hi āgneyātideśena prakṛticchandena bhavet bhinna vā ? nāyaḥ, ekenaiva 'prakṛtivadvikṛtiḥ kāryā' iti vākyena vikṛtyuddeśena aṅgavidhānaṃ, phaloddeśena ca vikṛtividhānaṃ, iti vairūpyate |

yadyapi ca prakṛticchandamātrasya vikṛtividhivyākyaśeṣakalpanā aṅgatrayaviśeṣavikṛti- bhāvanāvidhānena avairūpya ityāśaṅkyeta, tathāpi eka- syaiva prakṛticchandasya aṅgāṃśe vidheyasamarpakatvaṃ, phalāṃśe ca uddeśyasamarpakatvaṃ iti vairūpyateḥ tadavasthaiva |
na hi nimittamaṅgaṃ, yena prayājādivat atideśo bhavet, pramāṇābhāvāt |
evaṃ satyapi yadi prakṛtiti syāt, tato bhedanavat vikṛtāveva nimittasaṃnipāte naimittikaṃ vikṛtyaṅgatvāt prakṛtyanujñānaṃ prasajyeta, yatasteṣāmanuṣṭhānavat, na tvetadasti |
sarvathā na nimittātideśo naimittikaṃ vā vikṛteḥ |
kartā adhikārī, tasyāpi prakṛtau aṅgatvāt tadvi- śeṣaṇānāṃ svargakāmatvāhitāgnyādīnāṃ anatideśaḥ |
rāja- tvādestu kartṛviśeṣaṇatvāt tasya ca prakṛtau aṅgatvāt vikṛtau atideśa iṣṭa eva |
nahi tat prakṛtau adhi- kāraviśeṣaṇa, adhikāriṇaḥ śābdavidhicchoyatvapakṣe uddeśya- viśeṣaṇasya rājatvādeḥ avivakṣā''patteḥ |

vastutastu prathamāpekṣitatvena svārājyakāmapadasya phalaparatvāt adhi- kāriparatvānupapatteḥ adhikārī ārthikavidhidho eva iti tatra na śābdasya rājatvādeḥ anyasaṃbhavaḥ iti rājatvādeḥ kartṛviśeṣaṇameva |
ata eva āhitāgni- tvādeḥ yauktikasya ārthika adhikārividhau viśeṣaṇatva- kalpanām |
yājñikāstu rājatvādeḥ adhikārividhopya- maṅgīkṛtya anatideśaṃ manyante |
tasya prakṛtau aṅgatve'pi paraprakṛtyāmīṣomīyādipratiyogikatvāt tadabhāve vikṛtau nātideśaḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ — svarga-yāvajjīva-svargakāma-āgneyā- disamudāyānāṃ pradhānatvena karmānaṅgatvāt na vikṛtāvāti- deśa iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ--iha guṇakāmā udāharaṇaṃ 'godohenena praṇa- yet paśukāmasya' 'upāsamai gāyatā naraḥ iti grāmakāmāya pratipadaṃ kuryāt' ityevamādayaḥ |
tatra vicāryate kiṃ guṇa- kāmānāṃ vaikṛteṣu pravṛttiḥ, uta neti |
yathā paṭe ākṛṣyamāṇe tadāśritaṃ citramapi ākṛṣyate |
yathā ca camasaḥ pravartate, yathā ca 'khādiraṃ vīryakāmāya yūpaṃ kuryāt' iti, evaṃ godohenamāpi pravartate |
godohane ca pravartamāne tadāśritaḥ kāmo'pi pravartitumarhati |
evaṃ sati upahomādibhirnirākāṅkṣatvāt (sāṃgraha- ṇyādiṣu) atideśo na prāpnoti |

tatra evaṃ (parihāre) varṇayanti, upahomāḥ prākṛtānāṃ prayājānuyājānāṃ madhye śrutāḥ ( 'āmaṃnamasāmanasya devā iti tāhutī- juhoti' iti ) tatsaṃbandhipadavyākhyāt (miśratvāt ) te'pi (prayājādyaḥ ) kathaṃbhāve upanipatantaḥ (eva) gṛhyante |
etaṃ parihāraṃ dūṣa- yati -) evaṃ varṇyamāne yatrāpūrvamahaṃ prākṛtenāsaṃbaddhaṃ (śrūyate ), tatra tenaiva nirākāṅkṣatvāt atideśo na prāpnoti, na caivamiṣyate |

uttaraṃ tu tantraratnaṃ mudritaṃ ca ḍupaṭīkāṃ tulayitvā gṛhṇīmaḥ :] (samādhatte - yasādevaṃ saṃni- dhyāmātapadārthamātreṇa apūrvatve somasya varṇyamāne ati- prasaṅgo bhavati -) tassādaṇyathā varṇyate |
kathaṃ ? (ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ ) yatra saṃnidhau āmnātaṃ nirākāṅkṣī- karaṇakṣamaṃ (bhavati ) tatra tenaiva nirākāṅkṣatvāt bhavati kṛtsnavidhānatā |
upahomādiṣu (tu ) saṃnidhyopakārakarūpābhāvāt kṛtsnavidhānatā nāsti, tassāttatra ākāṅkṣā na nivartate (tasmāt tatrātideśo na vihanyate |
some tu nairākāṅkṣyāt nātideśaḥ, iti naiṣṭhikaviṣyantaprāptiḥ |
) yuktyantaramāha -) athavā sāhaśyena vidhyanto niyasyate, na ca somasya darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ (vyaktacodanāmyāṃ sāhaśyaṃ asti |
nanu upacitvākye ( 'somena yajeta' ityatra ) devatā'bhāvāt avyaktacodanaḥ, prayogavākye (prakaraṇāmānātāmaindravāyavādīnāṃ ) deva- tānāṃ vidyamānatvāt vyaktacodanaḥ |
prasaṅgāt yāgaṃ nivartayanti, na tu tāsāṃ yāgaṃ prati tādarthyaṃ prāmāṇyamasti |
kalpyena grahaṇena devatāḥ saṃyuktāḥ, tā yāgamamilayanti, yāgo'pi devatā'milāpī, tāyoḥ saṃbandho'rthāt bhaviṣyati |
(kathaṃ ?) yāgo dravyaṃ gṛhṇan tadāśritāṃ devatāṃ gṛhṇāti |
yathā praṇayanaṃ kalpyate ātmānirvartakaṃ sādhanamapekṣamāṇaṃ (paśukāmaprayoge camasasya bādhitatvāt ) godohanaṃ puru- ṣārthe (api prasaṅgataḥ ) gṛhṇāti |
) evaṃ cet avyaktacodanaḥ (svārthadevatāvaidhuryameva avyakta- tvamiti bhāvaḥ |
) ata āha sūtrakāraḥ - 'avyaktāsu tu somas' iti (8|1|9|16 |
) nanu evamapi prayāja- syolatvivākye devatāśravaṇābhāvāt avyaktatā (prāpnoti, tataśca tatkratuḥ somaḥ syāt |
) kṛtsnavidhānatā iti (asyāyamarthaḥ -) yadānnāyate dharmajāta, tena nirākāṅkṣatvāt arthaprāptaṃ (aiṣṭika- vidhyantaṃ ) na gṛhṇāti |
bhāṣyaṃ - sugabhidhāraṇasya ca abhāvāt anuvādaḥ some bhavati |
'ghṛtaṃ vai devā vajraṃ kṛtvā somamaghnan, sucī vāhū, tasmāt suci somahavirnāsāyate, na somamājyenābhighārayati' iti |
atha darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtiḥ syāt ājyenābhighārya sugyāṃ hayeta |
bhāṣyaṃ - iti cet paśyasi sugabhidhāraṇābhāvāt- vādadarśanāt apūrvaḥ soma iti |
atha kasmāt darśapūrṇa- māsaprakṛtitvena prāptasya sugabhidhāraṇasya pratiṣedho'yaṃ vidhirna bhavatīti ? sthitāyāṃ pratijñāyāṃ sūtreṇa parichoda- yati |
'yadāha, aṃguṃraguṣṭhe deva somā- pyāyatāṃ' iti tasya vākyaśeṣo'yam |
'avadhiśuryā etat somaṃ yada- bhipuṇanti, yadasya sucī vāhū kurvanti, yacca ājyamabhi- kamakārpuḥ, yadāha, aṃguṃraguṣṭhe deva somāpyāyatāmiti,
yadevāsāghnataṃ dhuramakurvan tadāpyāyayanti' iti (yade- vāsyādāntaḥ dhuramakṣuraḥ tadāpyāyayanti iti pāṭhaḥ ka- cit ) |
yadi ayamapi vidhiḥ syāt, vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
bhāṣyaṃ - some śaṅkate 'yadanupoṣva prayāyād grīva- baddhamenamuṣmin loke nenīyaren' iti |
dāśapaurṇamā- sike vidyante sati niyatamupoṣaṇāṃ syāt |
apūrvatve prākū upoṣaṇavidhā- nāt upoṣva anupoṣya vā prayāyāt |
bhāṣyaṃ - yacca prayājānuyājānāṃ darśanaṃ liṅgetvenopa- diṣṭaṃ, 'tasyaikaśataṃ prayājānuyājāḥ' iti, tat dīkṣaṇīyā- dīnāṃ somāṅgabhūtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ye prayājānuyājāḥ, teṣāṃ samuccayavacanam |
soma - pūrvatra liṅgādatideśa ityuktaṃ, iha tu liṅgā- bhāve'pi pravṛttyā atideśamādāṅkya nirākriyate iti saṃgatiḥ |
atra prābhākaraiḥ : agnihotradarśapūrṇamāsomā- nudāhṛtya teṣūpadeśopakārasamātilakṣaṇaṃ mūlaprakṛtitvaṃ cintyate ityuktam |
tadyuktaṃ, saṃnitātivargapauṣkalyena nirākāṅkṣatayā atideśaprasaṅgena upadeśopakārasamāti- lakṣaṇamūlaprakṛtitvasyāsiddhatvāt adhikaraṇacai- varthāt |
na ca saṃnipātivargamātrādupakārākāṅkṣā- śāntiḥ, kiṃtu ārādupakārakatvādi, tasya ca iyattā- niśrāyakābhāvādatideśaprasaṅge tannirākaraṇe mūlaprakṛtitva- sādhanāyādhikaraṇamāvaśyaka miti vācyam |
tathā sati ārādupakārakahitasyāgnihotrasya siddhānte'pi nirā- kāṅkṣatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt |
sūtrārthastu - aiṣṭikavidhyantasya dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu pravṛttatvāt some'pi pravṛttiḥ syāditi |
vi - 'vidhyanta aiṣṭikaḥ some syācca vā, syāt pravṛttiḥ |
' bhā - yatra dravyadevatādisaṃnidhyopakārakāsāmagrī- sākalyasya āmnānarūpaṃ kṛtsnavidhānaṃ, tatra agnihotradarśa- pūrṇamāsajyotiṣṭomādau na parasparaṃ dharmātideśaḥ; svataṃtrau yāvadāmnātaiḥ |

jyoti- ṣṭome tu 'tasyaikaśataṃ prayājānuyājāḥ' iti prakṛtiprāpta- prayājānuvādena śatasaṃkhyāvidhānaliṅgāt dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu dākṣikadharmāṇāṃ pravṛttatvā tanmadhyavartini some'pi dākṣī- kavidhyantaprāptiṃ manyamānasyottaraṃ, dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu vica- mānānāmeva prayājādīnāṃ paraṃparayā somasaṃbandhāt 'vāja- peyasya yūpaḥ' itivat 'tasya' iti pañcyanuvādeāpapatteḥ; pravṛ- satvasya hetoḥ ākāṅkṣānivandhanatvena tadabhāve asādha- katvāt na some atideśaḥ |
ata eva 'ghṛtaṃ vai devā vajraṃ kṛtvā somamaghnan, sucī vāhū, tasmāt suci soma- havirnāsāyate, nājyenābhighārayati' iti dākṣīkāsādanā- grabhāvāt na upapadyate |
nahi ayaṃ paryudāsavidhiḥ, 'yadāha aṃguṃraguṣṭhe deva somāpyāyatām' ityetādvidhyaika- vākyatvena tadarthavādasya svatantravidhitvānupapatteḥ |
kiṃca 'yadanupoṣva prayāyāt śrīvaddhamenaṃ amuṣmiṃlloke nenī- yeran tasmādupoṣva (dagdhvā vediṃ ) prayāyāt' ityupo- ṣaṇavidhirpi anatideśe upapadyate |
nyāyabinduḥ - - some iṣṭipaśu darśitakartavyatayā upasthiteḥ some'pi tadanyathāṅgāyāṃ abhiprādisaṃni- patyopakārakāṅkṣairnirākāṅkṣatvāt na some tadanyayaḥ |
'tasyaikaśataṃ prayājānuyājāḥ' iti tu dīkṣayajñadvāra- saṃbandhanāt iti siddhāntaḥ |
pādeṣu akṣarāṇi 1|2|1|8| 8|1|2|8 udā0 'sa hi śardho na māstaṃ' (ṛsaṃ. 1|123|6 ) bāla. pṛ. 66, ke.
vāla. pṛ. 66, ke. atipātanasya anaārambhatve pramāṇābhāvāt yāgākaraṇasya asamāpanasya atipātanatvena tada- rjñānopapattiḥ |
anaārambhatve'pi vā dravyārjanasya prayogavahirbhūtājñatvāṅgīkāreṇa prayogāntaḥpāte'pi bhūti- vanaprathājādideva pratiprayogāttvayyaṅgīkāreṇa atipāta- darśane na kā cidanupapattiḥ |
bhāṣṭa. 4|1|2 pṛ. 85. atirātraḥ agnīṣṭomu āditaḥ antato vā bhavati |

sati asminnadhikaraṇe pavamānataditarasādhā- raṇyena āgame vyutpādite, vaiśeṣikasamāptasthale iva taditaraśle'pi pavamāneṣu sidhyatyāgamaḥ; tathāpyanyāyasya vyutpādanāt, pāṭhabalaprāptasyāpi pavamāneṣveva niya- mitatvāt, itarastoṣu abhyāsaśca sidhyati |
sūtrārthastu- stomavibhṛddhau prākṛtānāṃ sāmnāmabhyāsena saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ syāt avi(dhi)kārāt codakataḥ saṃnidhānāt tadguṇatvena saṃkhyāmātravidhānāt sāmāntarasyāśrutatvācceti |
bhāṣya--vivṛddhastomakeṣu ṛtuṣu 'ekaviṃśenātirātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yājayet' ityādiṣu sāmāvāpaḥ pavamānaviṣaya eva |
hastasyānupānantaryasya paryāse bādhe pramāṇābhāvāt, samā- khyāyāśca prakṛtau pāṭhaprāptāntimasthānakatvānudākatvena sthānavidhikalpakatvābhāvāt ante evāgantūnāṃ niveśaḥ|
dvādaśāha pādike dvitīya'hani tu vācanikaṃ vṛṣapanto- stṛcayoḥ prākaparyāsādante'nuṣṭhānam|
nyāyabinduḥ - vahiṣpavamāne stotrīyo'nurūpaḥ paryāsa- śceti trayastṛcā viṣṭutstomakeṣu ṛtuṣu atideśaprāptāḥ|
dvādaśāhe vṛṣapantīnāṃ paryāsāt pāk pāṭhadarśanāt, tatrāpi tathā'numānāt paryāsaśabdasya cāntavacanatvaprasiddheḥ|
iti prāpte, anumānasyāpramāṇatvāttadante niveśa eva nyāyāditi siddhāntaḥ|
' atirātre kāmyastomadviddhau saṃkhyāpūrṇārtha mādhyaṃdinabhavapavamānayorogamitātāṃ sāmnāṃ gāyatrīchandaske tu āvāpaḥ|
tatra āgamyamāneṣu sāmasu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ teṣāmante niveśaḥ, uta gāyatrībṛhatnuṣṭup iti|
'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti vacanaṃ ka cchi- khyate, tat 'atirātre brāhmaṇasya' ityetadeva brāhmaṇapada- parityāgena iti veditavyam |
bhinnatve'pi vā brāhmaṇa- vākyena upasaṃhāraḥ iti dhyeyam |
astu vā tenaiva sarveṣāṃ prasaktasya ṣoḍaśiyāgāsya 'nātirātre' ityanena vikalpaḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 10|2|12, 'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti', 'nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti yatra tasminnevārthe vidhiḥ tasminneva ca niṣedhaḥ, tatra vikalpasyāvaśyakatvāt nañarthaḥ pratiṣedha eva, na tu paryudāsaḥ, lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
10|8|13. atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ 'anuṣṭupcchandasa iti bhakṣamanyaṃ namati' iti darśanam |
bhā. 3|2|1|129. atirātre sārasvatī meṣī caturthaḥ kratupaśuḥ |
vi. 9|1|17. atirātrayoḥ prāyaṇīyodayanīyarūpayoḥ ekādaśināḥ paśavaḥ vibhavya kartavyāḥ |
8|3|1|10-11. atirātraprathamāhā- rottaramapi agniṣṭomasaṃsthāṃ kṛttvaiva udridādayaḥ kāryāḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 5|3|13. atirātrameke prathamaṃ yajñamīyate, agniṣṭomaṃ prathamaṃ vayam |
satyāṣāḍhaḥ 7|17. ati- rātraśabde'pi rātrimatīyaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate iti vyutpattyā saṃsthā nimittakaḥ eva |
rātrimatīya vartate iti vyutpattyā śrayaṇe tu agniṣṭomādiṣu taprayogāni |
ku. 3|6| 16|41. atirātrasaṃsthākajyotiṣṭomasya 'ati- rātrameke prathamamāharanti' iti vacanādeva prathamamanu- ṣṭhānam |

pādeṣu akṣarāṇi 16|16|12|8|8 udā0 'sārka jātaḥ kratunā' (ṛsaṃ. 2|2|3) bāla. pṛ. 66. ke. 'atihāyeḍo barhiḥ prati samānayati juhvā- maupabhṛt' pañcānāṃ prayājānāṃ madhye tṛtīyaḥ prayājaḥ iṣṭaśabdena bahutvanāntena abhidhīyate |
taṃ tṛtīyaṃ prayājamatikramya varhirnāma kaṃ caturthaṃ prayājaṃ hotuṃ upabhṛtsaṃ- kāyāṃ suci sthitaṃ ghṛtaṃ juhvāṃ ānetavyaṃ iti asyārthaḥ |

yathā kaścidyatiḥ gārhasthyadaśāyāṃ kasya cinmihyāṃ snehaṃ kṛtvā paścāt saṃnyāsānantaraṃ śravaṇe pravṛtto'pi tenaiva snehajanitaprati- bandhena tattvaṃ guruṇopadiṣṭamapi na jñātavāniti loke gāthā pratīyate, tathābhūto'pi pratibandho jñānavattvarupadi |
anyādikamajanaka- daśāto janakadaśāyāmapi tiśayavat, kāryakaratvāt kuṭhādā- vat |
na cāpyauṣṇyā- tiśayena siddhasādhanatā, auṣṇyāsya kadācitkatvena tajanane'pi tiśayāntarānumānaprasaṅgāt |
na ca pratibandha- kāmāvena siddhasādhanatā, abhāvasyāpi bhāvāntarasya sthitatvāt, bhāvatve svarūpādīnāṃ cājanakadaśāyāmapi saṃbhavāt teṣāṃ kāraṇatvam |
ajanakadaśāvilakṣaṇasyaiva bhāvasya pratibandhakābhāve nāmāntareṇa śaktirevāṅgī- kṛtā |
abhāvaprameyasya nāstijñānajanakatvāt saṃbhavatīti cenna, viṣayasyākāraṇatvāt itarathā atītānāgatayorapi viṣayatvena kāraṇatvaprasaṅgāt |
vihitakaraṇāt pratyavāyo- tpattiriti cet, nākaraṇāt pratyavāyotpattiḥ, kiṃtu anyakaraṇāt |
prātarupalambho'- nuvartate iti cenna, prātarbhāvādeva tasya gatatvāt |
pratibandhakābhāvasya kāraṇatvamiti cenna anyathā siddhatvāt vyatirekasya |
anyanathā- siddhānvayavyatirekau hi kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ kalpayataḥ, anyathā anavasthāprasaṅgāt |
kiṃca kāryavighātakaraḥ pratibandhakaḥ iti sarvavādibhirabhyupeyaṃ, pratibandhakābhāvasyāpi kāraṇa- tvamabhyupagacchatā avaśyaṃ pratibandhako'bhyupagantavyaḥ |
tathā ca sati pratibandhakabhaṅgādāveva kāryavighātopapattī, na tadabhāvasya kāraṇatvamucitaṃ, anyathāsiddhatvāt kalpa- nāyāḥ |
pratibandhakābhāvasya kāraṇatve'pi ka cit pradhvaṃsaḥ, ka cit prāgabhāvaḥ, ka cit ciduttejakasambhavaḥ, ityaneka- kāraṇakalpanaṃ syāt, tadapi śaktikalpanam |
nanu śakti- vādināmapi pratibandhakāvasthāyāṃ śaktervināśakatvaṃ kalpanīyaṃ, na |
śaktervināśo'pyadau nāmyupeyate, śakteḥ kāraṇakalpanā- prasaṅgāt, śakterapi śaktikalpanāmaprasaṅgāt |
evaṃ ca sati vidhya- mānāyā eva śakteḥ pratibandhakasadbhāvādeva kāryakaraṇaṃ, tadabhāve kāraṇamityāstheyam |
evaṃ ca sati svarūpasyaiva pratibandhakābhāve kāryakaraṇaṃ, tadabhāve cākāraṇamastu, kima- nayā śaktyā ? maivam |
anupalabhyamānasya hi ghaṭasya kuḍyādinā pratibandho dṛṣṭaḥ |
śaktestu kāryakalpyatvādeva kāryadarśane pratibandhakatvakalpanāyā na virodhaḥ |
yattuktaṃ 'ko'yaṃ śakteḥ pratibandhaḥ; kiṃ prāgabhāvaḥ, kiṃvā pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ, āhosvit sahakārivaikalyaṃ' iti |
kiṃ kārya- vighāta eva (vastutaḥ parihāraḥ) maṇimantrādisannidhāne kārye notpadyate, tadabhāve notpadyate iti sarvaṃ siddham |
nanu kāryabhāvaḥ kāraṇābhāvādeva, na ca bhavatāṃ kāra- ṇābhāvaḥ, asamante tu pratibandhakābhāvasvarūpakāraṇābhāvaḥ |
tathā ca sati prati- bandhake tadabhāvasya kāraṇatvamapi na syāt |
nahi kāraṇā- bhāvamātrasya pratibandhakatvaṃ, mudgarābhighāte ghaṭasya prati- bandhakaḥ, na mudgrābhāvaḥ iti vyavasthā'nupapatteḥ |
nanu ajanakadaśāyāmapi śakterabhyupagamāt janakadaśā- yāmatiśayatvaṃ śakyaṃ syāt |

naivaṃ, pratindhāvasthāyāṃ śaktyavagamo nānumānāyataḥ, kiṃtu janakadaśāto vilakṣaṇa- rūpeṇānumānasiddhasyaiva paścādevaṃ vimarśo jāyate 'prati- bandhāvasthāyāṃ kiṃ nāsti eva yuktaḥ; uta kāryakaratvameva' iti, tataśca kāryakaratvameveti nirṇayo jāyate |
prābi. pṛ. 39-42. naivaṃjātīyake'pi atīndriye'pyartheṣu puruṣavacanaṃ prāmāṇyamupaiti, jātyādyānāmiva vacanaṃ rūpa- viśeṣeṣu |
bhā. 3|2|1|2 pṛ. 16. 'atulyatvāt vākyayoḥ' (2|2|1|126) ityatra guṇaphalasambandhaparyavasāyitvaṃ uktam |
vā. 2|3|1|11 pṛ. 597. 'atūrno hotā tūrṇīhyatvād' iti āhva- nīyavādaḥ |
'atūrno hotā tūrṇīhyatvād' iti vākye hyatvahanaliṅgāt gārhapatyaḥ |
iti prāpte, 'devedo manvidaḥ' ityupakrame samidhayajñena sāmidhe- nībhiḥ sutasāhavanīyasyaiva vādaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 4|2|13. 'atke cenmadhu vindeta kimarthaṃ parvata vrajet |
arke itipāṭhe tu 'ruī' iti bhāṣāyā- mucyamāno vṛkṣaḥ |
ṛtusādhanībhūtāhavanīyayāgnirvartate'nyāyenyanta- gītapūrṇāhutyaiva sarvakratuphalavātā satyāṃ kimiti ṛtuṣu pravartate |
agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyāṃ agniṣṭoma- stotrottaraṃ yasyastutaśastrasahitaḥ ṣoḍaśī graho gṛhyate |

atyagniṣṭomaḥ 264 adhyāryasya hānaṃ 512. 'atra hyevāvapanti' avibhṛdastobhake kausādīnāṃ nyāyādeva pavamānadaye evaṃ prākṛtaṛgādhikāra- ṇakāvāpasiddhau pavamānavṛttistriguṇādhikaraṇāvṛtti- phalaka: gāyatryādyadhikaraṇaniyamo'yaṃ iti dhyeyam |
bhāṭṭa. 10|4|12, 'atra hyevāvapanti' iti vacanena kausādivat samasaṃkhyaprākṛtasāmasādhane pavamānastotrayoreva niveśa: iti pūrvapakṣau |
kausādinyāyenaiva samasaṃkhya- prākṛtasāmavādhakatvā yatkiñcitstotre tanniveśaprasaktau sāṭa- śyaviśeṣeṇa tanniyama: asya sāmānyanyāyatvāt iti siddhāntī |
śeṣaṃ ca tallakṣaṇaṃ ca, śeṣasya vā arthasya lakṣaṇamiti |
athāto'gnimagniṣṭomena ' ityatrāgnimagni- padena agniṣṭomasaṃjñakajyotiṣṭomatvoktvāpi nāgni- ṣṭomasaṃjñākatvasya uddeśyatā'vacchedakakoṭipraviṣṭatvaṃ gaura- vāt, prayojanābhāvācca |
bhāṭṭa. 10|8|122, 'athāto- 'gnimagniṣṭomena ' ityādau prakaraṇoktacaraveratvena caya- nasya vikṛtau niveśaḥ |
8|3|4. 'athāto'gnimagni- ṣṭomenayajati, tamukthena, tamatirātreṇa, taṃ dvirāvreṇa ' iti vākyena prakṛtau agniṣṭome kāmu cit ukthādiṣu vikṛtiṣu ca agnicayanalakṣaṇa āśrayaḥ upadiśyate |
vi. 10|8|122, 'athāto'gnimagniṣṭomenayajati, tamukthena, taṃ ṣoḍaśinā, tamatirātreṇa ' idaṃ ' ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute ' ityevaṃ vidhāya śrūyate |
na cātra agniṣṭomo yāgavācī, kiṃtu vahnidvayavācyeva |

2|3|10. 'athāto'gni- miṣṭomenayajanti ' iyanārambhādhītena cayanarūpasyāgneḥ jyotiṣṭomāṅgatvena vidhiḥ iti sthitaṃ dvitīye (2|3|10), atratyāgniṣṭomaśabdasya jyotiṣṭomaparatayā kausume vyava- sthāpitatvāt |
māṭṭa. 10|8|119, 'athāto'gnimagniṣṭome- nānujayanti, tamukthena, tamatirātreṇa, taṃ dvirāvreṇa ' iyā suttaravākyeṣu agniṣṭomādiṣānāṃ cayanayuktaṃ vihitam |

2|3|10. 'athāto'gnimagniṣṭomenayajati, tamukthena, taṃ ṣoḍaśinā, tamatirātreṇa, taṃ satrātreṇa, tamapārātreṇa, tainavarātreṇa, taṃ daśarātreṇa, tamekādaśarātreṇa ' iti vākyaṃ agniṣṭomasa yāganāmatve prāpakam |
bhāṣyaṃ- loke yervyeṣu prasiddhāni padāni, tāni sati saṃbhave tadarthānyeva sūtreṣu ityavagantavyam |
itarathā vedavākyāni vyākhyeyāni svapadārthaiḥ vyākhyeyāḥ iti prayatnagauravaṃ prasajyeta |
tatra loke ayamathaśabdaḥ vṛttādanantarasya prakriyārtho dṛṣṭaḥ |
bhavi- tavyaṃ tu tena, yasmin sati anantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā ava- kalpate |
tathā hi prasiddhapadārthaḥ saḥ (athaśabdaḥ :) kalpito bhavati |
anyasyāpi karmaṇo'nantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā yuktā, prāgapi ca vedādhyayanam |
tādṛśī tu dharmajijñāsā adhi- kṛtya athaśabdaṃ prayuktavānācāryaḥ, yā vedādhyayanamantareṇa na saṃbhrati |
katham ? vedavākyānāṃ anekavidho vicāra iha vartitavyate |
api ca naiva vayamiha vedādhyayanāt pūrvaṃ dharmajijñāsāḥ pratiṣedhaṃ śiṣmaḥ, parastācca ānantaryam |
nahi etadekaṃ vākyaṃ purastācca vedādhyayanāt dharmajijñāsāṃ pratiṣedhayati, parastācca ānantaryaṃ prakariṣyati |
anyā hi vacanavyakirasya purastāt vedādhyayanāt dharmajijñāsāṃ pratiṣedhati, anyā ca para- stāt ānantaryaṃ upadiśati |
' vedānadhītya ' iti ekasyāṃ vidhīyate anyatra ānantaryaṃ, viparītaṃ anyasyām |
kiṃtu adhīte vede dvayamāpatati gurukulaca samāvartitavyaṃ, vedavākyāni ca vicārayitavyāni |
tatra gurukulamā- samāvartitavyaṃ, kathaṃ nu vedavākyāni vicārayet ityegarbhoṃ- ''yamupadeśaḥ |
yathaivaṃ, na tarhi vedādhyayanaṃ pūrvaṃ gamyate, evaṃ hi samāmananti ' vedamadhītya snāyāt ' iti |
iha ca vedamadhītya snāyan dharmaṃ jijñāsamānaḥ imāmannāyamati- krāmet |
na ca tasya adhyayanamātrāt tatra- bhavanto yājñikāḥ phalaṃ samāmananti |
yadapi ca samāmana- ntīva ( ' yaṃ kratumadhīte tenenāsya iyaṃ bhavati ' ) tatrāpi ' dravyasaṃskāramasu parārthatvāt phalaśruti-
na ca adhītedasya snānānantaraṃ etat vidhīyate |
nahi atra ānantaryasya vaktā kaścit śabdo'sti |
na vā idaṃ snānaṃ adṛṣṭārthe vidhīyate |
kiṃtu lakṣaṇayā asanā- nādinimayasya paryavasānaṃ vedādhyayanasamakālamāhuḥ : ' veda- madhītya snāyāt ' |
tasmāt vedādhyayanameva pūrvama- bhinivartya anantaraṃ dharmaṃ jijñāsitavyaḥ iti athaśabdasya sāmarthyam |
na ca brūmaḥ, anyasya karmaṇaḥ anantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā na kartavyeti |
kiṃtu vedamadhītya tvaritaṃ na snātavyaṃ, anantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavyaḥ |
yathā ' kṣema- subhikṣo'yaṃ ato'smin deśe prati vasāmi ' iti |
evamadhīto vedo dharmajijñāsāyāṃ heturbhavati : ( ataḥ ) anantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavyaḥ : iti ataḥ śabdasya sāmarthyam |
dharmāya hi vedavākyāni vicārayituṃ anadhītavedo na śaknuyāt, ataḥ etasmāt kāraṇāt anantaraṃ dharmaṃ jijñā- situmiccheti iti ataḥ śabdasyārthaḥ |
dharmāya jijñāsā dharmajijñāsā, sā hi tasya jñātu- micchā |
sa kathaṃ jijñāsitavyaḥ ? ko dharmaḥ, kathaṃlakṣaṇaḥ, kāni asya sādhanāni, kāni sādhanābhāsāni, kiṃ- paraśceti |
tatra ko dharmaḥ, kathaṃlakṣaṇaḥ ityekena sūtreṇa vyākhyātaṃ ' codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ ' iti |
kāni asya sādhanāni kāni sādhanābhāsāni, kiṃphara ( kiṃ- phalaḥ ) iti dopalakṣaṇena vyākhyātam |
ka puruṣaprayatnaṃ, ka vā puruṣo guṇabhūtaḥ |
ityetāsāṃ pratiṣṭhānāṃ piṇḍastha etat sūtraṃ ' athāto dharmajijñāsā ' iti |
dharmaḥ prasiddho vā syādaprasiddho vā ? sa cet prasiddhaḥ, na jijñāsitavyaḥ |
dharme prati hi vipratipannā bahuvidaḥ, ke cidanyaṃ dharmamāhuḥ, ke cida- nyam |
so'yamavicāraṃ pravartamānaḥ kaṃ cideva upādadāno vihanyeta, anarthaṃ ca ṛcchet |
kuto vā gṛhate doṣaṃ sūryo madicchittu |
neṣyate yaḥ parasyo'pi sa svayaṃ gṛhyate katham |
nirdoṣacai- kavākyatvaṃ ca vā lokesya dṛśyate |
( ratnākara-bhartṛmitrādibhiḥ ' nitya- niṣiddhayoḥ : ihādiṣṭhaṃ phalaṃta ' ityādiṣvapa- siddhāntaparigraheṇa mīmāṃsā lokāyatīkṛtā nāstikapathe nītā |
sarvesyaiva hi śāstrasya karmaṇe cā'pi kasya cit |
yāvat prayo- janaṃ noktaṃ tāvat tat kena gṛhyate |
na śubhraśrayituṃ śakyā prāga- nuktvā prayojanam |
vidyāntareṣu nā ( cā ) pyetad yadyabhīṣṭa prayojanam |
anarthaprāptaṃ tāvat tebhyo nā''ihyate ka cit |
parasya ucyatau kāryaṃ vā yadanugrahāya praśāntaryādirūpaḥ ) noktaḥ prayojanāt |
uktaṃ hi paśvora- nāsya saṃvandho nābhidhīyate |
(ucyate) kiṃtu 'lakṣaṇayā eṣo'rthaḥ syāt' ? kimidamucyate lakṣaṇayā tu eṣo'rthaḥ syāditi ? idamucyate 'na cedamadṛṣṭārthaṃ vidhīyate |
kiṃtu lakṣaṇayā asthānādi- niyamasya paryavasānaṃ vedādhyayanasakālamāhvaḥ veda- madhīya snāyāt iti' |
'gurukulammā samāvartita iti' mūlā- ntaravaṃca spaṣṭeḥ adṛṣṭaṃ atra kalpayitavyaṃ ataḥ 'adṛṣṭārthatā- parihārāyaiva ' ācāryakaraṇavidhiraiva asyā mūlam |
' tasmāt vedādhyayanameva pūrvamabhinivartya anantaraṃ dharmaṃ jijñāsitavyaḥ iti sthitaṃ athaśabdaprayogasāmarthyāt |
' na yūyaḥ anyasyāpi karmaṇaḥ anantaraṃ dharma- jijñāsā na karttavyeti |
vedamadhīya na tvaritaṃ snāyāt, anantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya
adhyayanamātrādeva samāpte śāstrārthe gurugṛhāt samāvartita- vyam |
' tena arthajñānāvāsanaṃ adhyayanaṃ adhyayana- vidhinā vidhīyate iti, vicāramantareṇa tadupapatteḥ |
adhyayanavidhireva vicāramākṣipan tadidaṃ sārta jñānaṃ bādhate iti, siddhaṃ adhyayananantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā kartavyā iti |
akārapraśleṣeṇa vā sūtraṃ adharmajijñāsāyā- mapi vyākhyeyam |
'upanayīta' ityanena ācāryakaraṇe 'samānanotsajñanācāryakaraṇajñānaśrutivigaṇanayeṣu niyaḥ' (atra si0 kaumudī - atra utsañjana-jñāna-vigaṇana-vyahā- nametervācyāḥ |
tathāhi, 'śāstre nayate' śāstrasthaṃ siddhāntaṃ śiṣyebhyaḥ prāpayati ityarthaḥ |
(iti pāṇi- sūtreṇa (1|3|36) vihitena ātmanepadena niyojya- viśeṣaṇaṃ ācāryatvaṃ pratīyate |
upanayane yo niyojyaḥ sa evādhyāpane'pi, tayorekaprayojanatvāt |
evaṃ sati ācāryakartṛkaṃ adhyāpanaṃ māṇavakakartṛkeṇādhyayane vinā na sidhyati, iti adhyāpanavidhiprayuktyaiva adhyayanānuṣṭhāna- siddheḥ na pṛthak adhyayane vidhirbhavyapagantavyaḥ |
vicāraśāstraṃ viṣayaḥ avadhai vaidhaṃ veti saṃśayaḥ |
tatra vaidhatvādī pratyayeḥ, vidheyaṃ ācāryakartṛkamadhyāpanaṃ kiṃ māṇavakasya arthajñānamāpi prayujyata, kiṃvā pāṭhamātram |
pāṭhamātraṃ tu vicārasya viṣayo na bhavati |
āpātataḥ pratītataḥ saṃdigdho'rtho viṣayaḥ, tathā sati arthapratītareva nāsti, tatra saṃdehasya kā kathā |
nirṇayo vicārasya phalaṃ, so'pi viṣayatvat dūropetaḥ |
mā nāma adhyāpanena arthāva- bodhaḥ prayujyatām |
tathāpi śāstre'dhyāpayino nigama- niruktakārayaiḥ vyutpannasya pauruṣeyatve'pi vede'pi arthāvabodhaḥ svataḥ eva prāpnoti |
nanu yathā 'vipaṃ bhuṅkṣva' ityatra pratīyamāno'rtho na vivakṣitaḥ, tathā vedasyāpi vivakṣābhāvastadavastha iti cet na |

viprabhojanavākyasya ātapraṇītatvena bādho mā bhūt iti mukhyārthastatra pari- tyaktaḥ, vede tu kuto na vivakṣitārthatvam ? vivakṣite ca vedārthe yatratra puruṣa saṃdehaḥ, sa sarvo'pi vicāra- śāstrasya viṣayaḥ |
tataḥ adhyā- panavidhiprayuktyena adhyayanena buddhimānasyārthasya vicārya- tvāt vicāraśāstrasya vaidhatvaṃ siddham |
' iha khalu nikhilapumarthāthasādhanau dharmādharmā sāṅgopāṅgavedā- dhyayanasamadhigamyau |

iti tadarthadarśanāya paramakāruṇiko bhagavān jaiminirācāryaḥ sakalavidyopakāriṇīṃ dharmamīmāṃsāṃ 'athāto dharmajijñāsā' ityārabhya 'vicate vā'nyakālatvāt yathā yājyāsamaipyo yathā yājyāsamaipyaḥ' ityantaiḥ sūtraiḥ bahvadhikaraṇagarbhitāṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇīṃ abhyarhitāṃ vidyāṃ prakaṭīcakāra |
vedādhyayananantaraṃ vedārtha- vicāraḥ kartavyo vā na vā iti saṃdehaḥ |
tatra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ--- 'adhītya snāyāt' iti smṛtyā adhyayana- nantarameva gurukulāt parāvartanavidhānavirodho na kartavyaḥ |

na ca adhyayanavidhita eva arthajñānamāvyakatvāvāt tatsiddhiḥ, arthājanajanakatvena adhyayanasya lokasiddhatvena avidheyatvāt, tannimittasya ca arthajñāne anupayogāt, avyabhicaritakratusaṃbandhābhāvena kratuṃ yāvat upayoga- kalpanā'nupatteśca na vidheyatvam |
lekataḥ pūrvaṃ pratyayyīkaraṇe yathāśrutārthajñānārthe vā adhyayanameva vā bhāvanābhāvyamastu |
na caivaṃ iṣṭabhāvyakatvābhāvāt pravṛttyanupapattiḥ, 'ana- dhīyānā vrātyā bhavanti' iti vacanena akaraṇe pratyavāyabodhanenāpi pravṛttisiddheḥ |
tasmāt nārthavicā- rārthe gurukule avasthānaṃ iti |
siddhāntastu, na svādhyāyavidhiḥ svargādyarthe adhyayanaṃ vidhatte, hye saṃbhavati adṛṣṭasyāpyanyathātvāt |

tathātve vrātyāvodhakavākyena adhyayanasyā- vaśyakatvāt, gṛhītapadārthārthasaṃgatistasya 'syāgurayaṃ bhārahāraḥ kilāmudhīta vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham' ityādivacanāt jñānasyāpyavaśyakatvena yathāśrutārthajñānasya ānuṣaṅgikatayā'pi siddheḥ svādhyāyavidhirvaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt |

ato vaiyarthyaparihārārthe prayojanadarśanāyānudeśena svādhyāyā- dhyayanaṃ tatyayyena lakṣaṇayā vidhīyate, prayojanavadartha- mī. ko. 35 jñānādisādhanībhūtasvādhyāyeodeśena vā adhyayanamātraṃ, tavyayyena svādhyāyasya karmatvābhidhānāt |

ataśca guru- sadana-adhyayana - akṣarāvāpti - tadarthajñāna - sādhanībhūta- svādhyāya-dharmānuṣṭhāna-putrasvarga-vividipāsu uttarottarasya pūrvapūrvabhāvyatayāḥ śrutyādisiddhatvāt na yāvadarthajñānaṃ gurukulāt parāvṛttiḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ - adhyayanasya svargādyarthatvāt karta- vyānantarābhāvāt tadanantarameva gurugṛhāt samāvartitavyam |
iti prāpte, arthajñānarūpadṛṣṭaphale saṃbhavati adṛṣṭakalpanā'- yogāt arthajñānasya ca vicāraṃ vinā asaṃbhavāt taṃ kṛtvā samāvartanaṃ iti siddham |
anena sūtreṇa viṣayaprayo- janakathanadvārā śāstrārambhakartavyatā pratipādyate |
kartavya- padavyāhāreṇa jijñāsāpade vicāralakṣaṇayā ca vedādhyayana- ntaraṃ vedādhyayanahetukaḥ dharmajñānecchāprayojyaḥ dharmaprāptalako vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |
tena vicārahetusūtrasamba- dāya rūpaśāstrasya dharmajñānaprayojanakatā dharmaviṣayatā coktā |
vedādhyayanahetutā cādhītavedasya 'dharme pāpamapanudati' ityādivākyebhyaḥ, sāmānyo dharmajñānasya viśeṣadharmaprakārakajñānecchāhetutvāt |
tathāhi, 'dharme' itihāsyena sāmā-yato dharmajñāne taduttaraṃ tadanuvyavasāye dharmajñānavasāmāyapratyāsatyā sakaladharmajñānaṃ, ghaṭatvasāmānyāpratyāsatyā nīlatvādi- jñānavat |
tataḥ tadiyakecchā, iti krameṇa sāmānya- dharmakārakajñānasya viśeṣadharmaprakārakajñānecchāprayojakatvam |
idaṃ ca sūtraṃ smṛtīrūpaṃ svasūcita- nyāyānugrāhyapramāṇasāpekṣaṃ ca iti adhyayanavidhilūkam |

vidhīnāṃ pravṛttijanakapravartanājñānaṃ, arthavādānāṃ prāśastyajñānaṃ, mantrāṇāṃ viśiṣṭārthasmaraṇaṃ, nāmnāṃ karmabhedo guṇa- phalopabandhaḥ saṃkalpalāghavaṃ ca, sāmnāṃ akṣarābhivyaktiḥ, stobhānāṃ sāmakālapūrtiḥ, upaniṣadāṃ pāralaukikaphalaka- karmapravṛttijanakatvaśarīravyatiriktajīvātmajñānaṃ kramajñānādi ca yatheṣṭamūhanīyam |
adhikaraṇaṃ ca pañcāṅgaṃ 'viṣayaḥ saṃśayaścaiva pūrvapakṣa- svottaraḥ |
tasmāt anyena iti śabdena agniṣṭomabhijñānāṃ saṃsthānāṃ gavādīnāṃ ca nirdeśaḥ |
jyotiṣṭomājñānaṃ praka- raṇena jyotiṣṭome eva viśrāntatvena uttarakratu tadasaṃbha- vāt |
nahi vikritisaumānāṃ agniṣṭomāt nirgamanarūpaṃ viha- raṇamupalabhyate, nāpi triṣṭudādayaḥ agniṣṭomādyān yajña- kratūn prāpnuvanti upalabhyante |
‘āpattivihārabodhakavākyayoḥ kevalapraśaṃsāparatvaṃ, na tena anyaśabdārthaniścayo bhavati’ iti śaṅkāṃ vā- śabdena nirastan siddhāntī āha |

vidhipratyayāt āpatti- vihārayoḥ sākṣādvidhāve'pi ‘prakṛtitve'pi’ iti atideśaśāstrātmakavidhijanyāt pratyayāt āpatti- vihārayorjñānāt jyotiṣṭomaprakṛtikāḥ sarve yajñakratavaḥ ‘athāntyena’ iti anyaśabdena nirdiṣṭā iti gamyate |
nahi kilka akasmāt prākapraśaṃsāṃ vinā praśaṃsā''pi syāt |
tathā ca āpattivihārapradarśanāt sarveṣāṃ yajña- kratūnāṃ agniṣṭomādupapattiḥ, agniṣṭoma rūpatāprāptiśca jñāyate |
tena anyaśabdena agniṣṭomabhijñānāṃ ukthyā- dīnāṃ gaurayujyotiḥ ityādīnāṃ ca nirdeśaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. athāntyena ityanyaśabdaḥ satasaṃsthāmātraparaḥ satrāhīnā- disādhāraṇo vā iti saṃśaye, sata saṃsthā satrāhīnātha iti sarvasādhāraṇaḥ anyaśabdaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhā. 5|3|14|39-42 athāntyena ityanyaśabdena ekasto- makā anekastomakā vā somavikārāḥ sarve kratavo gṛhyante |
athāpi śāstratantratvaṃ tathāpi tadanekatvā ’ iti grahādhikaraṇa-( 3|1|7 ) -vārtikoktanyāyena sakṛduccaritasyāpi pratyayasya ekapadopāttānekārthavidhitvāt- svam |

‘athaiṣa ekatrikaḥ’ tasyaikasyāṃ ( ṛci ) bahi- ṣpavamānaṃ, tisṛṣu hoturājyaṃ, ekasyāṃ maitrāvaruṇasya, tisṛṣu brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ, ekasyāmacchāvākasya, tisṛṣu mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaḥ’ iti ekatrikanāmakaḥ kratuḥ śrutaḥ, ‘eka- saṃkhyāyāścisaṃkhyāyāśca vyatiṣaṅgāt |
‘athaiṣa jyotiḥ’ ityasmin vakṣyamāṇodāharaṇe ( 2|1|8 ) yāgāvanamāt prāgeva saṃjñātvāvagamāt saṃjñāyāḥ karmabhedahetutvam |
vi. 2|1|2 athaiṣa jyotiḥ’; ‘athaiṣa viśvajyotiḥ’; ‘athaiṣa sarvajyotiḥ’ ‘etena sahaladakṣiṇana yajeta’ ayaṃ parastādanubandhena vidhiḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 28. athaiṣa jyotiḥ0 ityatra ayaśabdena vicchedatāt saṃjñāyā bhedakatvam |
... atra dyotanādi- guṇayogena jyotiśadisaṃjñaṃ karmatrayaṃ somayāgaprakṛtike tattadākhyāyai rūpe sahaśabdakṣaṇāt ‘etena ṛddhikāmo yajeta’ iti vākyena phale vidhīyate |
bhāṭṭa. 2|1|8. ‘athaiṣa bhūḥ’ iti bhūnāmakaṃ ekāviśeṣamupakramya ‘dhenurdakṣiṇā’ iti śrūyate |
vi. 10|3|14. ‘athaiṣa bhūścaivaḥ’ ityanena vihite bhūsaṃjñake ekāhe ‘dhenu- dakṣiṇā’ ityāmnāyate |
bhāṭṭa. 10|3|14. ‘athaiṣa bhūścaivaḥ’ ityādau yatra na yāgaparicāyakapadaśravaṇaṃ, tatra vaikalyikasaṃjñāprakṛtikatvaṃ pūrvapakṣe |
yathā nahi vahnirdagdha dahati kintu adagdhamiti, tathā prakṛte'pi |
tattathā-agnirdagdhaṃ dahati, yadagdhaṃ tatra dahati’ iti |
sāhasī. 293. adantatvaṃ ( hetumātramadantatvaṃ 3|1|45 sū. ) dantarāhityaṃ pūṣṇo deyasya, tasmāt tadarthasya haviṣaḥ peṣaṇaṃ kartavyam |
ke. adarśane na asattvenaiva, kintu anabhivyaktāvapi ghaṭate eva |
adarśanāt darśanābhāvāt adṛṣṭaṃ ajñātaṃ nāsti iti gamyate tadat |

saṃpradāyasya pauruṣeyatvena mūlapramāṇāpekṣatvāt, adṛṣṭatvādidiśakṣā- viṣayabhūtasya ca pramāṇāntarasya adarśanādṛṣṭanyāyamūlala- saṃbhave ca adṛṣṭamūlatarakalpanā'yogyāt nyāyamūlatvāva- gateḥ; nyāyāvirodhe saṃpradāyāt vedārthavagame'pi virodhe nyāyāvagamyaviśiṣṭaśabdasattvenaiva yājñikairapi vyākhye- yatvāt tad-vyācikhyāsā cintayituṃ yuktā |
‘bhrātṛvyatā- ḍābhyo grāhyaḥ’ ‘eṣa vai haviṣā haviryajate yo'dābhyaṃ gṛhītvā somāya yajate’ iti vacanayorvaiyarthyāpatteḥ saṃyogapṛthaktvena ubhayārthatvāt |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|15. adābhyaḥ grahaḥ ‘devā vai yajñe'kurvata tadasurā akurvata, te devā adābhye chandāṃsi savanāni samavasyā- payan’ iti vacanāt aṅgāntram |
soma. 2|3|1. adābhyaḥ nāma grahaḥ kratuśeṣaḥ; na tu savana- śeṣaḥ |
tena tasya sakṛt grahaṇaṃ prātaḥsavane dhārāgrahebhyaḥ pūrvameva, na tu pratisavamam |
ke. adābhyaśca aṅgu- śreti grahī jyotiṣṭome eva vihito na tu tat yāgā- ntaram |
bhā. 2|3|120. ‘adābhyaṃ gṛhṇāti’ ayaṃ grahaḥ prākaraṇikamevaiḥ samuccīyate jyotiṣṭome |
vi. 3|6|11, adābhyagrahasya viniyojakaṃ vākyaṃ taittirīyāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhakāṇḍe ṣaṣṭhe prapāṭhake prākaraṇikaṃ draṣṭavyam |
‘aditiḥ pāśaṃ pramuñcatveta’ iti daikṣe eva paśu- pāśamocane anumantraṇamantraḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 1|3|4, ‘aditiḥ pāśānpramuñcatvetān’ iti daikṣe paśu- pāśamocane bahuvacanānto mantra āmnātaḥ |
viṣṭaddhaya- māne kalpyaḥ syājjāyate tena so'rthavān |
pṛ. 462. yo hi yasya phalasya phalavato vā śeṣatvena avadhārito bhavati, sa kathaṃ tasya upakariṣyati ityecchite sati hyamupakāramapyadṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt adṛṣṭaḥ parikalpyate |
vā. 3|1|12 pṛ. 657, āmnātānāṃthā'nupapattyā hi adṛṣṭaṃ kalpyate |
tacca āmnānaṃ ( yatra ) anyathaiva dṛṣṭatayā upapannaṃ ( tatra ) arthāpatterasambhavāt |
bhā. 10|1|12|23, adṛṣṭakalpanāyāḥ lakṣaṇā jyāyasī pramāṇādi sā bhavati |
3|1|15|37. sarvatraiva ca adṛṣṭakalpanāyāṃ tādṛśaṃ kalpayitavyaṃ, yat dṛṣṭaṃ na viru- pyaddhi, na vā adṛṣṭāntaramājñāyate |
2|1|121 pṛ. 526, adṛṣṭaphalabhojino yajamānasya adṛṣṭarūpaḥ śāstrīyaḥ saṃskāraḥ |
’ vā. 3|1|15 pṛ. 399. yaḥ khalu adṛṣṭārthaḥ, tataḥ apūrvam |
bhā. 4|1|7|19. adṛṣṭārthau sāmānyaviśeṣavidhī yathā udāhṛtau āhavanīyapadavidhī |
paryudāsavidhiṣu prāgukto dvividho'pi puruṣārthaḥ adṛṣṭārtha eva |
bāla. pṛ. 21, kevaladṛṣṭārthaḥ niyamavidhiryathā prakṛtau vaikalpikoḥ bṛhadrathaṃtarapṛṣṭhayoḥ adṛṣṭārthayoḥ anyatarasya cit vikṛtau niyamaḥ śrūyate iti |
pṛ. 24, parisaṃkhyāyāṃ itaranivṛttyarthaḥ sarvatrāpi adṛṣṭārtha eva |
adṛṣṭārthodāharaṇaṃ tu gṛhamedhīye pañcame pakṣe iti |
bhā. 10|2|16|47. adṛṣṭārthe saṃnipatyopakārakaṃ trividhaṃ bhūtopayoga- saṃskārārye bhāvyupayogasaṃskārārye upayogasamakālaṃ ceti|
sākṣādviniyukta- saṃskārārye sākṣādviniyuktasya yadupakārakaṃ, tatsaṃskārārye ceti|
bāla. pṛ. 82-83. adraṣṭārthe sāra- svate satre kāmeṣṭau dakṣiṇādānam|
mā. 10|2|15|45- 46. adṛṣṭārthāni aṅgāni phalopayatāmapi (kartuḥ) kurvanti, nāṅgatvāt prapadyante ca|
etadapiṣayako vistaraḥ 'vidhiḥ dvividhaḥ' iti vindī bālaprakāśe draṣṭavyaḥ|
ke. ada- ṣṭārthān śabdavṛttiḥ (lakṣaṇā) laghīyasī (sukarā, bala- vatī ityarthaḥ)|
mīnyā. adṛṣṭā- rthayoḥ ṛtuyājyāvaraṇahariṇayoḥ anuṣṭhānaṃ kārye dvādaśā- hādau satre|
satyapi cādṛṣṭārthatve nirape- kṣaṇāṃ gatyantare sati samuccayanānāśrayāt|
vā. 3|15| 12. adṛṣṭārtheṣu kāryabhedāt vaikṛtena prākṛtasya na bādhaḥ|
mā. 4|1|7|18-20. yāvāniha adṛṣṭārthāḥ sa vaikikavidhipratiṣedhadvaya upapannaḥ|
vā. 13|8|27 pṛ. 282. 'adopatvena sa guṇo viguṇe' iti nyāyaḥ|
ayaṃ subodhinyāṃ prathamaskandhatrayodaśādhyāyasya saviśe paye -dṛṣṭavya iti|
