adopanirvātāthaṃ aniyatanimittakaṃ vaidikaṃ karma yathā 'bhinne juhoti' ityādi|
adya ityukte śvaḥ paraśvo vā iti nokto bhavati|
maṇi. pṛ. 116. 'atītāyā rātreḥ paścārdhena āgāminyāḥ pūrvādhrena ca sahito divasaḥ adyatanaḥ' iti bhaṭṭojidīkṣātaḥ|
na kasya cidapi prakaraṇe śrūyate 'epa vai haviṣā haviryajate, yo'dābhyaṃ gṛhītvā somāya yajate|
' 'parā vā etasyāyuḥ prāṇa eti yo'dābhyaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti|
atra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ yāgāntarametadadravyakaṃ, uta jyotiṣṭome yāge guṇavidhiḥ iti|
pūrve 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pānītamutsṛjati' ityasya yajimadabhidhānaṃ nirākṛtya idānīṃ prasaṅgādaśdā- bhyavākyayorapi yajimadabhidhānaṃ nirākriyate|
aṃśadābhyavākye tāvat pradhānatvāt yāgaḥ eva kalpa- yitumucitaḥ, anārabhyādhītatvena tadanuvādena grāhyaviśeṣa- rahitagrahaṇalakṣaṇaguṇavidhānāsaṃbhavāt|
somāyeti caturthyā somo devatā, dravyamapi 'haviṣā haviryajate' ityanu- vādāt|
tadaiva haviṣā haviryajate, yadi somadravyeṇa somameva devatāṃ yajate|
adābhyamiti saṃjñā'pi, adṛṣṭā- rthasya pradhānayāgasya guṇaphlopavanatvanārthamucitā, na dṛṣṭārthasya grahaṇasya, saṃjñā vinā'pi tatra vyavahārasaṃbhavāt|
tena adābhyavākye tāvat somadravyakaṃ somadevatākaṃ ca karma vidhīyate, iti siddhaṃ karmanāmadheyatvam|
tatra ca grahaṇaṃ saṃskāratvena nāma- dheyasaṃvanayogyatvāt pratyayārtho'tra saṃjñā'vacchinno vidhī- yate aṃsuṃ kuryāditi|
yāgarūpaiva anu- saṃśikā kriyā vidhīyate iti yathākathaṃcidatra pūrvapakṣa- gamaniketi|
tathāhi na tāva- datra vidhiḥ śrūyate, kiṃtu kalpyanā'sau|
yadi viśiṣṭa- yāgavidhipayo'sau kalpyeta, tadānīmaṃśaviśeṣaṇavidhi- kalpanāṃ, atideśakalpanāṃ, phalakalpanāṃ ceti kalpanāgaurava- māpadyeta|
grahaṇasvarūpasaṃskāravidhikalpanāyāṃ tu na kalpanāgauravamiti tadvidhireva kalpyate, |
sa sa ca somadravyuteḥ somāyāgo nirṇīyate|
'vaidhātavīyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' ityādiṣu vaidhātavīyā- nāmāvacchinnasya saṃskārasya dīkṣaṇīyādikārya vidhānopa- yogadarśanāt|
tenātra somasya devatātvābhāvāt 'haviṣā haviryajate' ityarthavādādapi na somadravyadevatāsaṃbandha-
sa eva svecchayā vyomādiprapañcena pariṇamati bījamiva vṛkṣarūpeṇa |

nidekarasaṃ brahma kathaṃ jaḍarūpeṇa pariṇamatīti cet, na paramārthataḥ pariṇāmaṃ brūmaḥ, kiṃtu aparimitameva pariṇatavat, ekameva sat anekadhā mukhamiva ādārśādiṣu avidyāvaśāt vivarta- mānaṃ, cidrūpaṃ jaḍarūpamiva, advitīyaṃ sadvitīyamiva paśyati |
tathā ca 'sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma' 'ātmai- vedaṃ sarvaṃ', 'neha nānā'sti kiṃcana' ityādayaḥ bahavaḥ advaitavādāḥ |
tathā 'indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate' iti bhedāvagateḥ vyaktameva māyānibandhanaṃ darśitam |
tathā 'lokāstaṃ parāduryo'nyātmano lokān veda' ityādinā anātmadarśane nindā 'sarvamidaṃ advaitameva brahma pāramārthikaṃ bheda
tāni adhāryamāṇāni na śaknuvanti kriyāmabhinirvartayitu- guma |
bhā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 696. adhikaraṇasya ādheyasaṃsakārārthatvena 'agāre gāvo vāsyantāṃ' ityādi prādhānyadṛṣṭāntā lakṣaṇayā adhikaraṇatvācintā: saptamyā: prādhānyārthatā yuktā |
su. pṛ. 722. adhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śruti: yathā 'pañca- kṛtno trirvā aho bhuṅkte' |
bāla. pṛ. 45, adhikaraṇe saptamī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śruti: yathā 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' |
amukhye'pi naimittike'pi āgrayaṇagatayāvāpṛthivya- dravirhavirhi adhika: guṇa: |
'vāsiṣṭhānāṃ' ityatra tu vyavasthārtha- tvāt tathā'ṅgīkaraṇe iti viśeṣaḥ |
ataśca vaiśyakartṛka- sātamadasyānurodhena tathaiva tāsu adhikāraḥ |

iti prāpte, sāmidhenīsādhanībhūtasātamadasyodeśe viśiṣṭodeśāpatteḥ, sātamadasyāmodeśe ca vikalpapūrvasādhanībhūtasāmidhenī- nāmeva viśiṣṭa upasthāpākābhāvena anuvādāyogyāt yūpa- sātamadatvādāpatte vidhānāpatteḥ prakaraṇānugrahācca, vaiśyodeśe- naiva tadadhikāriderpūrṇamāsasaṃvandhisābhivenītvitva- saṃbhavena sātamadasya vidhīyate, arthācca vaiśyasya nimitta- tvam |
vikratau ca anaimittikatvārthe punaḥśravaṇaṃ iti sarvo'dhikāraḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ - 'samadaśa vaiśyasya' iti darśapraka- raṇagatavākyena sāmidhenīsātamadasyādhvena vaiśyaḥ kartā vidhīyate |
tena yatrādhvarakalpādau sātamadasya, tatra vaiśyasyai- vādhikāraḥ |
iti prāpte, prakaraṇe eva vaiśyānuvādena sātamadasyavidhaupapattau utkarṇīyagata prakṛtau vaiśyanimittaka sātamadasyam |
adhvarakalpādau tu svābhāvika, iti trayāṇā- mapyadhikāraḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
iti tat kiṃ syāditi na jñāyate |
bhāṣyam - ṛtviktvaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇarājanya- vaiśyānāṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam - brāhmaṇānāmeva ārcijyaṃ syāt, netarayo- ryeṇayoḥ |
kutaḥ ? smṛteḥ; evaṃ śiṣṭāḥ smaranti 'yāja- nādhyāpanapratigrahāḥ brāhmaṇasyaiva druvyapāyāḥ' iti |
smṛtiśca pramāṇamityuktaṃ 'athavā kāraṇāgrahaṇe prayu- ktāni pratīyeran' (1|3|17) [ iti ] |
bhāṣyam - itareṣāṃ rājanyavaiśyānāṃ phalacamaso vidhī- yate |
'sa yadi rājanyaṃ vaiśyaṃ vā yājayet, sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayiṣet, nyagrodhastiminīrāhṛtya tāḥ saṃpiṣya dadhani unmujya tamasai bhakṣa prayacchet somaṃ' iti |
yathā yadi kṣīre lipsati tatra dīyate, tatra yadi vā kṣīrābhāvo vijñāyate, yadi vā bhoktukṣīrabhojitvam |
ihāpi some vibhakṣayiṣite phalāni dīyante, tatrāpi somābhāvo vā, yadi vā bhokturasomatvaṃ vijñāyate |
na cāsomapābhyāṃ śakyate ārcijyaṃ kartuṃ, niyamāt somabhakṣasya |
bhāṣyam - api ca sāṃnāyye makṣaṃ rājanyavaiśyayoḥ pratiṣedhan asomapīthatvaṃ hetumāha |
'na rājanyo na vaiśyo vā sāṃnāyyaṃ pibet anomapītho hepaḥ' ityevaṃ bruvan somapī- thābhāvaṃ rājanyavaiśyānāṃ darśayati |
bhāṣyam - darśapūrṇamāsayośca puroḍāśasya caturthakaraṇe brāhmaṇā eva nirdiśyante |
yadi rājanyavaiśyorapi ārcijyamasti, na brāhmaṇānāmeva idaṃ haviḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam - darśapūrṇamāsikāyāṃ ca anvāhāryadarśanāyāṃ brāhmaṇā eva druvyante |
'ta ete vai devā ahṛtādo yad brāhmaṇāḥ, yadanvāhāryamāharanti tāneva tena prīṇāti' iti |
tāṃ ca etāni darśa- nāni upodvalayanti |
darśa- pūrṇamāsajyotiṣṭomādiṣu ki tribhirapi dvijātibhiḥ ārcijyaṃ kārayitavyaṃ, uta brāhmaṇādeva iti saṃśayaḥ |
iti prāpte- 'bhidhīyate 'dvijottamānāmārcijyaṃ na tu kṣatriya- vaiśyayoḥ |
soma - yājananiyamākṣasya niyamārthe pravṛttasya ṛtuvidhiṣvapi upakaraṇena tacchāstrasya prasaṅgavicāraparyava- sānāt asyādhikārasya sākṣādapi saṃgatiḥ saṃbhavati |
bhāṣṭa - prasaṅgāt brāhmaṇasyaivārcijyaṃ, uta trayāṇāmapi varṇānāṃ iti cintāyāṃ vidvatvādiṣopāt trayāṇāmapi |
yattu 'parṇāṃ tu karmaṇamasya trīṇi karmāṇya jīviṃkā' ityanena brāhmaṇasyaiva yājanamuktaṃ tat puruṣārtham |
ataśca kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ pratyavāya soḍhvā'pi ārcijyakaraṇe na ṛtuvaiguṇyam |
iti prāpte, 'yajñaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ' ityupakramya 'brāhmaṇā ṛtvijaḥ' iti kalpasūtrakāraiḥ |
kātyāyanādibhiḥ ārcijyedeśena brāhmaṇavidhānāt mantrārthavādetihāsādī tattatkramakatvācca brāhmaṇasyaiva ārcijyaṃ iti siddham |
prītimetu nṛhareḥ padapadme yena janmanihavo na punaḥ syāt ||
iti prāpte, 'yajñaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ' ityupakramya 'brāhmaṇānāmārcijya' iti yajñasūtrakārasmaraṇaṃ ṛtvartha- tvenaiva niyamabodhakam |
ata eva rāmāyaṇe 'kṣatriyo yājako yasya caṇḍālasya viśeṣataḥ |
surāḥ devatābhūtāḥ, ṛṣa- yaśca ṛtvigbhūtāḥ ityarthaḥ |
tathā 'rājyājājyāsya vinaśyati yathā haviḥ' ityapi vacanaṃ ṛtvaiguṇyabodhaka- meva |
bhāṣyam - agnihotrādiṣveva saṃdehaḥ kiṃ adravyasyā- dhikārī neti |
kutaḥ ? na hi śaknoti adhvaraḥ druvyasaṃyuktaṃ karmānuṣṭhātum |
bhāṣyam - nevaṃ syāt, yaduktaṃ adruvyasyānadhikāra iti |
yaḥ śaknoti yaṣṭuṃ, tasya 'yajeta' iti vācakaṃ bhavati |
yo na kathaṃ cidapi śaknoti yāgamabhinirvartayituṃ taṃ nādhikaroti 'yajeta' iti śabdaḥ |
yastu kena cit prakāreṇa śaknoti, na taṃ varjayitvā pravartate |
jīviṣyati vinā dhanena, ityetat viprati- pattidam |
ṭup - na ca jātyā kaścit adravyo nāma, yena itare adhikriyeran |
tasmān druvyatvasya anava- sthitatvāt, sarve adhikriyeran |
śā— puruṣādyopāttadravyatāṃ lābhāt nādravyasya tadarjanaṃ kratubhirākṣipyate |
vidyā hi pratyakṣaviśiṣṭā trayāṇāṃ, iti tadaiva upapannāḥ ṛtavaḥ, na śuddhasya (vidyāṃ) ākṣipanti iti yuktam |
(nanu vidhyantarā- bhāve'pi bhojanādyarthamupāttaṃ yasya dravyamasti, tat eva kratuyajñasidhdeḥ adravyasya na kratumindrayākṣepaḥ |
ityata āha—) dravyārjanaṃ tu sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ dravyakāryaiva ākṣetavyam |
tatrāviśeṣatvāt bhojanādivat ṛtanāmapi tadākṣepatvaṃ na vāryate |
(bhavedevaṃ yadi 'bhojanādimareva dravyākṣepaṃ, na kratumiḥ' iti niyame kiṃ cit pramāṇaṃ syāt |
tathā sati kratorapi dravyakāryatvāviśeṣeṇa bhojanāditulyatayā dravyākṣepatvaṃ avarjanīyam |
śrutyādyābhāvāt arjanasya kratuvyabhicārācca) ataḥ adravyo'pi dravyamarjayitvā kuryāt |
' 'dhanī dravyavān eva kartā uta anyo'pi iti saṃśayaḥ |
bhāṭṭa— agnidhrayorva dravyasyāpi pratigrahādi- puruṣādyopāyavidhivalādeva labdhatayā kratuvidhibhirākṣe- pāt paramayutpattisiddhadravyata eva adhikāraḥ, na tu asiddha- dravyasya tadarjavitvā |

iti prāpte, pratigrahādya upāyavidherapi anujñāvidhitvāt dravyasya sthāpitatvāt (4|1|2 varṇakaṃ 3) dravya svatantravidhiprayuktatvābhāvena jīvanādiprakāreṇaiva kratunā'pi tadākṣepaupapatteḥ pratigrahādepi saṃbhogaprayaktva- nyāyena (4|1|3|1) kratvarthatvasya sthāpitatvāt prayā- jādivat kratunā'pi tadākṣepaupapatteśca adravyo'pi dravya- marjayitvā adhikriyate eva |
iti prāpte, dravyasya prayojanavadojanātnāt bhojanādivat kratunāmapi tadākṣepa- kalyamaviruddham |
vidyā tu na rāgaprāptā, kintu pratyakṣavidhi- siddhaiva gṛhyate iti bheda iti siddhāntaḥ |
' 'ādau adravyavato'- pi adravyasya pratīkāre kṛte sati yāgānanuṣṭhānādhikāraḥ saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ |
bhāṣya— idaṃ samāmananti 'etena rājapurohitau sāyujyakāmau yajeyātāṃ' iti |
tatra sandehaḥ kiṃ rājño dvau purohitau yajeyātāṃ, uta rājā ca purohitaśceti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? rājño dvau purohitau iti |
kutaḥ ? purohita- śabdāt paraṃ dvivacanaṃ śrūyate, tat śabdavācyasya dvitvaṃ śaknoti vadituṃ |
nanu ekasya dvau purohitau na sta: |
'purohitaṃ vṛṇīte' iti hi upādīya- mānasya vibhaktimekatvamiti |
yathā vacanena 'añjalinā juhoti' iti ekasyaiva dvau pāṇī bhavataḥ; yadyapi sadyaḥ aprāpta- sthāpayati |
iha rājapurohitau iti bhinnakalpayoradhikāraḥ iti prati- pādayituṃ adhikaraṇam |
(rājapurohitau iti) kimayaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaikaśeṣaḥ, uta kṛtaikaśeṣeṇa uttarapadena tatpuruṣaḥ, uta samānādhikaraṇaikaśeṣaḥ, uta dvaṃdvaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ |
na ca kṛtaikaśeṣeṇa uttarapadena iti (pakṣe) bhāṣya evoktam (uttaram) |
bhāṣya— tuśabdāt pakṣo viparyavartate naivaṃ syāt dvau purohitau iti |
ucyate ; na tu vacanādetat śakyaṃ, saṃskāranimittatvāt purohitaśabdasya |
bhāṣya— arthānāṃ ca vibhaktyaṃ śrūyate 'tejaḥ- saṃstaro brāhmaṇasya' 'vīryasaṃstabo rājanyasya' tābhyāṃ varṇābhyāṃ tenena phalena saṃbandho'nūyate |
tasmādapi na dvau purohitau ekasya rājña iti |
bhāṣya— atha yadukta etasādeva kāraṇāt ekasyaiva puruṣasya dvau pāṇī bhavata iti |
añjalau pratyajñabhūtaḥ dakṣiṇasya pāṇe: savyaḥ pāṇiḥ |
tasmāt rājā ca puro- hitaśca syāt |
nanu tatra rājapurohitaśca rājapurohitaśca rājapurohitau yajeyātāṃ iti |
sa rājā purohitena saha ekakāryo bhavati, na tu purohitaḥ purohitena |
ubhāvāpi to hi rājānamapi carantī purohitau ityucyate, nahi tami- cchantī, saṃskāradravyo hi purohita iti |
śrutyabhāve lakṣaṇayā'pi vyavahāro bhavati, yathā 'agni tiṣṭhati' 'avaṭaṃ tiṣṭhati' iti |
tasmāt rājā ca purohitaśca rājapurohitau iti |
śā— rājaḥ purohitasya cātra (kulāyayajñe) bhinna- kalpayoreva satorvacanāt adhikāraḥ |

yadyapi prajādādiṣu tulyaḥ kalpo rājapurohitayorapi saṃbhavati, tathāpi 'havi- ṣkṛdāgahī rājanyasya' 'tamasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet' ityevaṃ bahuśo rājanyasya kalpānnāmāne rājanyapuro- hitayoḥ ekarūpaprayogasya atyantasaṃbhavitvāt bhinna- kalpamavarjanīyam |
' bhāṭṭa— 'etena rājapurohitau sāyujyakāmau yaje- yātāṃ' ityatrāpi na bhinnakalpayoradhikāraḥ |
dvaṃdvasya yugapaddhikaraṇavacanatvena padadvaye'pi lakṣaṇātvāt, tada- naṅgīkāre'pi vā sāhityavārthe padadvaye lakṣaṇāyā āva- śyakatvāt |
ataḥ tatpuruṣa evāyaṃ, tattattvaṃ ca ekaśeṣaḥ |
tasmāt rājadvayasaṃbandhinau dvau purohitau samānakalpatvena yajeyātāṃ, ityādyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
dvivacanasya viśeṣaṇyavivakṣyupatteḥ saṃbhyādhikaraṇe (6|1|12) vyutpāditāt ekasya anekasya vā rājño dvau purohitau, ityaparaḥ |
athavā ekaśeṣaṃ kṛttvaiva tatpuruṣaḥ kāryaḥ, itarathā padadvayāvṛtti- prasaṅgāt rājapadadvayasyadharmasaṅgāt |
ata eva ekasyaiva rājño dvau purohitau ityanyaḥ |
pūrvapade lakṣaṇāyā pramāṇabhāvāt 'purohitaṃ vṛṇīte' ityupādeyatādātmyāt ekasyaiva vivakṣitatvena ekasya rājñaḥ purohitadvayābhāvācca karmadhāraya evāyaṃ (iti caturthaḥ pakṣaḥ) |
iti prāpte, brāhmaṇā- nāmeva paurohityaśravaṇāt karmadhārayānupapatteḥ dvaṃdva evā- yam |
na ca tatra padadvaye lakṣaṇā, yugapaddhikaraṇavacana- tvasya nirākṛtatvāt (6|1|12) |
na ca sāhityapratītyarthe lakṣaṇā, tattadītarāmānikatvenāpi upapattau lakṣaṇāyā pramāṇabhāvāt |
samāhāre paraṃ ekatvānvayārthe padadvaye'pi samudāyalakṣaṇā iti viśeṣaḥ |

vastutastu itaretaradvaṃdva'pi vyāpyabhāvena sāhityapratīteḥ ānumānikatvāyogān avaśyaṃ pratīyamānasya tasya yadyapi lakṣaṇikatvamāyadyaka- meva, tathāpi tallakṣaṇayā ekaśeṣe'pi samānatvena sarva- pakṣeṣu āvaśyakatvāt pūrvoktayuktyā dvaṃdvopapattiḥ |
ataśca rājaḥ purohitaśca ca bhinnakalpayorapi adhikāraḥ |
purohito'pi tasyaiva rājñaḥ, purohitatvasya sasaṃvanyakatvena rājapratiyogitvasyaiva saṃbhavāt aihikasya ekarājyapatitvarūpa- sāyujyaphalakatvasya anyānupapatteḥ |

bhinnakalpatvaṃ ca yadyapi na narāśaṃsamantre, rājo'nuparodhena purohitasyāpi narāśaṃsamānakasyaiva saṃbhavena tādṛśayo- reva tayoḥ adhikāropatteḥ, tathāpi somaphalacamasarūpa- bhinnakalpayorapi adhikāraḥ |
rājaḥ prāthamikatvāt nimittatvāt tannimittakena somasya bādhāt |
nyāyabinduḥ— 'etena rājapurohitau sāyujya- kāmau yajeyātāṃ' ityahīnaviśeṣe (kulāyākhye) śrutam |
tatra tatpuruṣe lakṣaṇādoṣāt ekasya ca rājaḥ purohitadvayābhāvāt karmadhārayasya cāsaṃbhavāt dvaṃdva evā- yam |
ato rājaḥ purohitasya ca bhinnakalpayorvacanādhi- kāraḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ svargakāmaṃ pumāsamadhikṛtya yajeta ityeṣa śabda uccaritaḥ, athavā aniyamaḥ striyaṃ pumāsaṃ veti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? puṃliṅgami- kṛtaṃ mene etiśāyanaḥ |
puṃliṅgena viśeṣeṇa nirdeśo bhavati 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
tasmāt pumān ukto yajeteti, na strī |
tu— ahādhikaraṇe (3|1|7) vibhaktivācyasya (ekatvasya) avivakṣā uktā, na prātipadikārthasya (liṅgasya) |
tasmādayaṃ (pūrvapakṣavādinaḥ) abhiprāyaḥ, arthasya uddiśyamānasyāpi yathā vivakṣā, evaṃ (tadvā- cyasya) liṅgasyāpīti |
bhāṣyam— avijñāte garbhe hate bhrūṇahatyānuvādo bhavati 'tasmādavijñāte garbhe hatena bhrūṇā hatyā bhavati' iti |
'bhrūṇā pāpakṛtamḥ' yasya ubhayalokyorupakaroti tasya hantā bhrūṇā, yajñahantā bhrūṇā, sa yajñasādhanadhanakārī |
sa hi vibharti vā sarvai, bhūtiṃ vā nayati, ato bhrūṇā yajñavakārī |
avijñāte garbhe hanyamāne kadā cit pumān hanyeta |
tatra yajñadhikṛtasya hatatvāt yajñavatho bhrūṇahatyā syāt |
itarathā yadi ubhayo- radhikāraḥ, tato vijñāte cāvijñāte ca yajñavadhaḥ syāt |
jāti tu bādarāyaṇo'viśeṣāt, tasmāt stryapi pratīyeta, jātyarthasyāviśiṣṭatvāt |
jāti tu bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ adhikṛtāṃ manyate sma |
āha, kimayaṃ svargakāmaḥ iti jātiśabdaḥ samādhigataḥ ? netyāha |
kena tarhi śabdena jātiruktā yā adhikṛteti gamyate ? naiva vayaṃ brūmaḥ jātivacana iha śabdaḥ adhikāra iti |
kiṃ barhi ? svargakāmaśabdena ubhāvapi strīpuṃsau adhi- kriyete iti |
nahi śaknoti eṣā vibhaktiḥ svargakāmaṃ liṅgena viśeṣetum |
svargaṃ kāmo yasya tameva lakṣayati śabdaḥ |
tasmāt śabdena ubhāvapi strīpuṃsau adhikṛtau iti gamyate |
puṃso vibhaktyā punarvacanaṃ anarthakaṃ iti cet |
tasmāt strī api pratīyeta, jātyarthasya aviśiṣṭatvāt |
bhāṣyam— atha yaduktaṃ 'paśumālabheta' iti puṃśurālabhyate puṃliṅgavacanasāmarthyāt, evamihāpi puṃliṅgavacanasāmarthyāt pumānadhikriyate yāgavacaneneti, tat parihartavyam |
yadi hi lakṣaṇatvena śrūyeta, tataḥ striyā api yāga ukto na puṃvacanena niyaryeta |
idaṃ tu paśutvaṃ yāgasya viśeṣaṇatvena śrūyate |
tatra paśutvasya yāgasya ca saṃbandhaḥ, na dravyayāgayoḥ |
yathā paśutvaṃ yāgasaṃbaddhaṃ, evaṃ puṃstvaṃ ekatvaṃ ca |
yacca doṣaśruti- ravijñāte garbhe hate ātreyī ca puṃyuktatvemeti, tatra parihartavyam |
na ca āpannasattvā ātreyī, gotraṃ hyetat |
dravyattvāttu puṃmāṃ syāt dravyasaṃyuktaṃ, krayavi- krayābhyāmdravyatvaṃ strīṇāṃ, dravyaiḥ samānayogitvāt |
bhāṣyam— puṃsāṃ tu syāt adhikāraḥ dravyatvāt |
vikrayo hi śrūyate 'dātamatiyaṃ duhitumate dadyāt, ārṣe gomithunaṃ' iti |
na caitat dṛṣṭārthe sati ānamane, ahardhārthe bhavitumarhati |
bhāṣyam— 'yā patyā krītā satī athānyaiścarati', iti krītatāṃ darśayati |
bhāṣyam— āha, yadanayā bhaktotsarpaṇena vā kartanena vā dhanamupārjitaṃ, tena yakṣyate iti |
yadā hi sā anyasya svabhūtā, tadā yat tadīyaṃ, tadapi tasyaiva |
api ca svāminaḥ tayā karma kartavyam |
na tat parityajya svakarma arhati kartum |
yat tayā anyena prakāreṇa upārjyate, tat patyureva svaṃ bhavitumarhati iti |
evaṃ smarati 'bhāryā dāsaśca putraśca nirdhanāḥ sarva eva te |
yat te samadhigacchanti yasya te tasya tad dhanam |
yadi smṛtimanurudhyamānā paravaśā nirdhanā ca syāt yajeta ityukte sati na yajeta, tatra smṛtyā śrutirbādhyeta |
tasmāt phalārthinī satī smṛti apramāṇīkṛtya dravyaṃ parigṛhyāt yajeta ceti |
bhāṣyam— arthena ca asyāḥ samavetatvaṃ bhavati |
evaṃ dānakāle saṃvādaḥ kriyate 'dharme cārthe ca kāme ca nāticaritavyā' iti |
yattyucyate bhāryādyo nirdhanā iti, sārthamapi nirdhanatvaṃ anyāyyameva śrutivirodhāt |
tasmāt asyāsvataṃtryaṃ anena prakāreṇa ucyate saṃvyavahāraprasiddhadravyam |
bhāṣyam— yattu krayaḥ śrūyate, dharmamātraṃ tu tat, nāsau kraya iti |
krayo hi uccanīcapaṇyayo bhavati, niyataṃ tu idaṃ dānaṃ śatapratiśataṃ śobhanāṃ aśobhanāṃ ca
bhāṣyaṃ - 'patnī vai pāriṇavyasyeṣṭe patyaiva gatama- tumarta kriyate' |
tathā 'jāgatyā patnī: saṃtrājayanti, bhasatrīrhi panya: bhasadā vā etā: paragṛhāṇā- maiśrayamevava ruṇadhate' |
bhāṣyaṃ - saṃ patnī palyā sukṛtena gacchatāṃ yajñasya dhuryā yuktāvabhūtām|
' na ca adravyalambhā: kartanādibhirarjanasaṃbhavāt, pitrādittasaṃbhavāt, dāyādi- saṃbhavāt |
'putrābhave duhitā' ityādisaraṇāt, palyā arjitasya cobhayasādhāraṇatvāt 'dharme cārthe ca kāme ca nāticaritavyā' |
pāṇigrahaṇāt sahatvaṃ karmasu tathā puṇyaphaleṣu dravyaparigraheṣu ca' ityādivacanāt |
'ye yajñapatnī vardhān' ityādimantravarṇaiśca spaṣṭa: striyā adhikāra:, patnīśabdasya nyāyamitracanatvāt|
soma-- yathā annādikaṃ prati kratoravidhānāt tasya anadhikāra:; evaṃ striyā api, iti pratyavasānāt saṃgati:|
sūtrārthantu-- svavato'rthavato: ājyāvekṣa- ṇānnā rambhādivacanādai kakampyaṃ sadya:prayoga: syāditi|
bi-- 'striyā na so'styasti vā, no puṃlliṅgena tadīraṇāt|
' bhāṭṭa-- ṛtuṣu puṃsa evādhikāra:, uta striyā api iti cintāyāṃ 'svargakāma:' iti puṃlliṅgaśravaṇāt puṃsa eva|
nedaṃ adhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ kartṛmanādhikāraṇatvena tadvi- śeṣaṇasya asya aśnutādhikāriviśeṣaṇatvānupapatte:|
ataśca ājyātopāttaikatvavadeva puṃsasyāpi asya vivakṣā nānupapannā|
kiṃca adravyatvādi striyā nādhikāra: 'bhāryā putraśca dāsaśca traya evādhanā: smṛtā:|
ityādinā pitrā bhartre mūlyena dāsatvat vikrītatvācca|
ata eva 'garbhaiṇāvijñātena hatena bhrūṇahā' iti yatsādhanapuṃgarbhahanaśaṅkayā bhūṣaṇapadavācyayajñentyatvāliṅgaṃ avakalpate|
anyā strītvena vijñāte'pi yajñahantutvāviśeṣāt avijñātapadaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt|
iti prāpte, yadyapi kartṛviśeṣaṇaṃ puṃstvaṃ, tathāpi pramāṇāntareṇa striyā: adhikāragata: vidhilaghyānu- rodhena sādhutvāthai avatuyyānuvāda eva puṃstvaṃ, yathā 'vasante brāhmaṇa:' ityādī|
prakṛte tu anapekṣitatvāt nāsya kartṛviśeṣaṇatvaṃ, api tu yogyatvāt adhikāri- viśeṣaṇameva|
tataśca tasya phalaṃ pratyapi prādhānyāt uddeśyatvena tadviśeṣaṇāvicchā|
vastutastu prathamapekṣita- tvāt svargakāmādipadasya phalaparatvameva iti kṛ puṃstvasya vitrāśaprasakti:|
na cādravyatvaṃ kartanādibhirarjanasaṃbhavāt, pitrādittasya dāyasya vā smṛtipustatvācca, 'dharme cārthe ca kāme ca nāticaritavyā' iti smṛtyā patyā arjita-

syāpi ubhayasādhāraṇatvācca, 'bhasadā vā etā: para- gṛhāṇāmaiśrayamevava ruṇadhate' iti saraṇācca, 'saṃ patnī palyā sukṛtena gacchatām' ityādimantravarṇāt, 'pāṇigrahaṇādi sahatvaṃ karmasu tathā puṇyaphaleṣu' iti saraṇācca, palyā apyadhikāra:|
yat 'bhāryā putraśca' iti vacanaṃ krītatvādicanaṃ ca, tat 'na strī svātantryamarhati' iti vacanāntarānasārāt akhāta- nyaparam|
maulyādānaṃ tu adṛṣṭārthe kanyāyāṃ kanyālāti- riktatvābhāvasya vakṣyamāṇatvena tādasyāpi aupacāri- katvācca|
ātreyī ca atrigotrotpannā, na tu āpanna- garbhā|
satyapi na striyā: ka cin karmādhikāre, asati gamakāntare, japādisakalavaidikakarmānadhikārāt avijñāta- liṅgadarthaṃ puṃstve prāyaścittaviśeṣavidhānārtham|
nyāyabindu: - 'svargakāma:' ityatra puṃstvasya prakṛtyartha- tvāt vivakṣitatvaṃ iti striyā nādhikāra:|
iti prāpte, prakṛtyarthatve'pi uddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvāt avivakṣita- meva puṃstvam|
na cādhanatvaṃ, pitrādittasaṃbhavāt, 'dharme cārthe ca ityādivacanācca|
bhāṣyaṃ - iha caturhotrṛṣu āmnāyate 'prajākāmaṃ caturhotrā yājayet, caturgrahītamājyaṃ gṛhītvā caturhotāraṃ vyācakṣīta, pūrvaiṇa agnerdhṛtaṃ juhuyāt, taduttareṇādhai' iti|
tatra saṃdeha: kiṃ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu evamādaya:; uta asaṃskṛteṣu iti|
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ? saṃskṛteṣu agniṣu evaṃjātīyaka: akratuśeṣo'pi homa: syāt|
yadyapi apūrvā darvihomā: na kutaścit dharmānākāṅkṣanti, tathāpi āhavanīyādayo homādīn ākāṅkṣanti, 'yadā- havanīye juhoti tena so'syābhīṣṭa: prīto bhavati' ityevamādibhi: śrutibhi:|
evaṃ iṣṭipūrvatvāt sarva- homānāṃ saṃskṛtāgniṣvittvaṃ evaṃjātīyakānamiti|
anāhitāgne: iṣṭyo na vidhyante, ye tete caturhotāra: tasya evaiṣa iṣṭi:; iti anāhitāgne: evaṃjātīyakān homān darśayati|
evaṃ tarhi atraśeṣāṇāṃ vidhiraiva bhaviṣyati eṣā vā anāhitāgne: kriyā iti|
evaṃ arthavat vacanaṃ bhaviṣyati, bādamātramarthakaṃ bhavati|
yattu akratuśeṣāṇāmiti, tatra sarveṣāṃ ṛtuśeṣāṇāṃ akratuśeṣāṇāṃ ca caturhotrṛhomānāṃ (vidhi:) |
caturhotrṛṇāmayaṃ dharma ucyate, na viśeṣa: ṛtuśeṣāṇāma- kratuśeṣāṇāṃ ceti|
na ca ṛtvaṅgaṃ kevalaṃ prayujyamānaṃ kasmai cit prayojanāya syāt|
na cāsya anyat phalaṃ prakalpyeta pramāṇābhāvāt|
na asaṃ- skṛteṣu aśiṣu evaṃjātīyakā homāḥ syuḥ |
nanu vacanamidaṃ 'eṣā vā anāhitāgneḥ teṣāmarthavādaḥ; na sarveṣāṃ catu- rhotraṇām |
iṣṭitvena tu mantune homaḥ syādanāgnipra- yogāditareṣāmavacanāt |
bhāṣyaṃ-- yaduktaṃ eṣā vā anāhitāgneḥ kriyā iṣṭi- tulyā iti, japānāmeṣa vāda iti, tanna |
kathaṃ ? naiṣā vacanavyaktiḥ 'yā eṣā anāhitāgneḥ kriyā sā iṣṭi- tulyā' iti |
yeyamiṣṭiḥ, eṣā anāhitāgneḥ iti tadviśiṣṭatvāt homānāmeva vādaḥ |
kathaṃ ? iṣṭirnāma; sa eṣa āsecanākhyo homaḥ |
yaduktaṃ sarvehomāthya āhavanīya iti, tanna caturhotraiva adhikṛtya ucyate, kiṃtvaviśeṣeṇa homānām |
sa caturhotraṣu asaṃbha- vāt anyeṣu bhaviṣyati |
caturhotraṣu ca anāhitāgneḥ ucyamāneṣu āhavanīyo nāgnimiti |
yathā pitṛyajñaḥ āhitāgneḥ anāhitāgneśca, evaṃ caturhotāro'pi |
kathaṃ gamyate ? varṇitametat yadā anuvādapakṣaḥ tadā āhitāgneḥ, yadā vidhivakṣaḥ tadā anāhitāgneḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ-- na caitadasti pitṛyajñavat ubhayoḥ caturho- tāro bhaveyuriti |
'eṣā vā iṣṭiḥ anāhitāgneḥ' iti vacanena adhi- kṛtaḥ, na āhitāgniḥ, nirdeśasāmarthyāt |
arthavāde copa- kṣīrṇaṃ tatraiva na virudhyate iti |
'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti vacanaṃ na caturhoteneva adhikṛtya ucyate ityuktam |
bhāṣyaṃ-- atha yaduktaṃ pitṛyajñavat iti, yuktaṃ pitṛ- yajñe, tatra āhitāgnisaṃyuktasya punaretadvacanaṃ bhavati 'apyanāhitāgninā kāryyaḥ' iti |
etadacchanaṃ anāhi- tāgnerapi iti anāhitāgninā anvācayaṃ karoti |
soma-- caturhotrādemādiṣu āhitāgnestyādhikāra ityevamadhikārapādādau'tra prādhānyena vyutpādyate iti pādā- nantaraṃmānantaryyaṃ ca |
sūtrārthastu-- darśahaumavat apū- rvo'pi akratuśeṣacaturhotrahomaḥ saṃskṛteṣvagniṣu syāt |
na cāpūrvyate kutaścit prakṛterāhavanīyāprāpteḥ kathaṃ saṃskṛteṣu iti vācyam |
ādhānasya sarvahomopakārakatvāt sarveṣā- mapi homānāṃ pacamāneṣuviṣyatvāt 'āhavanīyo juhoti' ityanārabhya vidhānāt sarvahomasādhāraṇyāhavanīyaprāpteḥ iti |
agni ke vidhivyāpti, ssyo homatvāt kratuhomavat ||
tatra ye tāvat kratudharmāḥ, puruṣārthā api vacanāt kratu- prayogamadhyavarttinaḥ, teṣu vivāda eva nāsti |
ye'pi pṛthagbhūtāḥ kāmyā japāste'pi avivāda eva āhitā- gnyāhitāgnisādhāraṇatvāt |
ye tu tādṛśā homāḥ, teṣāṃ 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' ityanena āhavanīyādhikāraka-
'yat eṣā vai anāhitāgneritiḥ' iti catu- rhotrasaṃnidhau vacanaṃ, tat yeyaṃ anāhitāgneḥ kriyā japādi- rūpā sā iṣṭitulyā ityevaṃ iṣṭisādṛśyamātrānuvādena japā- bhiprāyakatayā nānupapannā |

yadi tu vidhitvenatadveṣā- bhāvena arthavādatvamanupapatteḥ jape iṣṭisādṛśyasya kathamapi anupapatteśca 'yeyaṃ tyāgaghaṭitatvāt caturhotrahoma- rūpā iṣṭiḥ sā anāhitāgneḥ' ityarthāṅgīkāreṇa vidhiḥ ityāśrīyeta, tathāpi asya āhitāgniparisaṃkhyārthatve pramāṇābhāvāt piṇḍapitṛyajñavat ubhayādhikārakatvam |
iti prāpte, pratyakṣavacanena anāhitāgneḥ kartṛtvāvidhau tat eva svātaṃgyadhikaraṇāt kalpaprāpteḥ āhavanīyādhikaraṇaka- tvasya asaṃbhavādeva bādhāt parisaṃkhyātvāpatteḥ anāhi- tāgnereva adhikāraḥ |
piṇḍapitṛyajñe tu 'evamanāhitāgneḥ' iti vacane anāhitāgnerapi abhyanujñānāt ubhayādhi- kāraḥ iti viśeṣaḥ |
nyāyavinduḥ-- 'caturhotāraṃ prayuñjīta' 'canu hotrā prajākāmo juhuyāt' iti caturhotrasaṃjñakamantraiḥ japahomāḥ śrutāḥ |
'eṣā ha vā anāhitāgneritiḥ' iti tu japaviṣayam |
iti prāpte, vacanasāphalyaya anāhitāgnerādhikāro vacanāt iti siddhāntaḥ |
(prayoge'puruṣaśruteḥ iti vā vārttike pāṭhaḥ) bhāṣyaṃ-- 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti śrūyate |
atra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ aniyamena eko dvau bahavo vā yajeran, athavā eka eva yajeta iti |
yadā prayoktari tadā vittisametatvaṃ yathā vakṣyāmaḥ |
iha tu tadeva āśriṣyate, punaśca nirṇīyate iti |
puruṣe yāgaṃ śrāvayitvā śabdaḥ ekasya dvayoḥ bahūnāṃ vā yāgaṃ na vārayati |
nāsau puruṣo yāge śrūyate, yāgamabhinirvartayet yāgena phalaṃ phalamabhinirvartayet iti |
kathaṃ tarhi ? yāgena phalaṃ prāpnuyāt iti |
yadi hi aṅgabhaviṣyat yāge phalanirvṛttau vā, tadā saṃkhyā guṇabhūtā tadrūpaṃ puruṣaṃ paricchidyāt |
atha punaraṅgabhūtaṃ prakāśayan lakṣaṇātvena puruṣaśabdaḥ saṃśrūyate, na guṇavacanatayā, tatra cāvivakṣitaṃ saṃkhyāvacanam |
yāvānarthī samarthaśca, tāvantaṃ sarve adhikṛtya etadu- cyamānaṃ na śakyate ekena vacanena viśeṣayitum |
kathaṃ ca gurupradhānāyaṃ ? na phalotpatyā kiṃ cit prayojanamasti, na yāgotpatyā |
tasmāt yāthākāmyaṃ syāt eko dvau bahavo vā yajeriti |
tathā ca darśayati 'yuvaṃ hi svaḥ svargati iti dvayoryaja- mānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryyāt' iti |
tathā 'ete asupramindvaḥ iti bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti dvayorgrahaṇaṃ ca yāgaṃ pradarśayati |
ḍupa--nanu yāganirvartakatvena upādīyamānatvāt viva- kṣitā saṃkhyā, kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? ucyate |
bhavati vyāpyamānaśca (svargaḥ, tasādhana ca prati) pradhāna- bhūtaḥ |
(eka (tu ākhyāte) vivakṣitā saṃkhyā, na (tu) itaratra (svargakāmapade) iti (abhyupagamyamāne) nāsti sāmānādhikaraṇyam|
(kathaṃ tarhi anuṣṭhāna- siddhi:? ata āha-) tatretarā (yadi nānutiṣṭhati, tataḥ) 'phalamahaṃ nāpnuyāṃ' ityarthāt yāgamanutiṣṭhati|
evaṃ cet anūditatvāt prayoge (puruṣasya) kathaṃ tasya saṃkhyā vivakṣeta? |
athavā prayoge puruṣa- śrute: prayoge puruṣaṃ śrāvayitvā kṛtārtha: śabda:|
'tena yāga: kārya:' iti yadi īdṛśa upadeśo bhavet tato nirvartakatvena (guṇabhāvāt) vivakṣitā saṃkhyā syāt|
bhāṣya - iti cet, evaṃ cet bhavāna

bhāṣya— iti cedbhagavān padyati evaṃ sati yadi svargakāmaḥ anyasyāpi svarge kāmyamāno bhavati, anyasya svarge kāmyamāno'pi anyo yajeta ( iti ), tatra pūrvokto nyāyaḥ pratyudadhṛto bhavati ' śāstraphalaṃ prayogar iti ( 3|1|8|18 ) |
ḍupa-- yadi svargakāmaśabdaḥ parasya ātmano vā yaḥ svarge kāmyate tatra aviśeṣeṇa vartate, evaṃ cet ( anuvādapakṣe'pi ) parasyāpi svargamicchan yajeta iti |
likhite tu ' yaḥ svarge ' ityādi sarve vartate, tataḥ prāktanaṃ tu nāsti ) anyārthe nābhisaṃbandhaḥ |
bhāṣya-- na parasya svargakāmo na, ityevaṃ na yajeta, nāpi anyasya svargakāmaśabdo na vācaka iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? phalamasau na prāpnoti iti |
kathaṃ punaḥ phalasyāptiḥ ? upagrahaviśeṣapravaṇāt yajeta iti |
yāgamātravidhānena tasya anuvādyātvāt tadviśeṣaṇasya takartṛviśeṣaṇasya ekatvasya avivakṣā iti eko dvau bahavo (bā) kartāraḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ kṛtaḥ |

tat phalededyakasya vijātīyasya puruṣaprayatnasya aprāptatvena vidheyatvena tatratatra sthāpitatvāt tadviśeṣaṇasya kartṛtvasya vivakṣopapatteḥ; svargakāmapade tadvivakṣāyāmapi tatsāmānādhikaraṇyāt vātha- kābhāvāt upekṣitam |
taddhi kartṛtve anveti na tu tadāśraye, anyathā daṃpatyoḥ vyāsajyavṛttitvānupa- patteḥ |
ataśca tadāśrayāṇāṃ anekatvasya patnīrādāya āvaśyakatve puruṣapānādāya tatkaraṇe bādhakābhāvāt aneke- ṣāmapi kartṛtvam |
iti prāpte, asati viśeṣagrāhaka- pramāṇetadāśrayasyāpi prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvāt ekasyaiva pratītiḥ ānubhavikī |
tatra 'dharmaṃ ca' ityādivākyasya pramāṇāntarasiddhatve'dhikārakarmamātraviṣayatve palayā api agrahaṇe pramāṇābhāve puruṣāntarasya agrasakteḥ |

yatra tu patnīgrāhakapramāṇasadbhāvaḥ, tatra satyapi tāsāṃ kartṛtvādhiṣṭhā- natve puruṣasya ekatve tat, prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvāt, 'svargakāmo yajeta, yajamānaḥ kedaśamaśca yajeta, mekhalayā yajamāna' ityādi vinā kāraṇaṃ suvupāttaikatvasya pākṣikā- nuvādatvānupapatteśca |
nyāyabinduḥ - 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti svarga- kāmasya uddeśyatvena tadvaitaikatvasyāvivakṣitatvāt eko dvau bahavo vā yajeran |
na ca ākhyātopāttasaṃkhyā kriyā- ''kṣitakartṛviśeṣaṇaṃ, phalyadeva phalabhāvanāyāḥ prāgapāta- tvāt |
iti prāpte, phalecchāyāḥ prāptatve'pi bhāvanāyā aprāptatvāt tadākṣite kartari vivakṣitamevaikatvam |
nahi pravṛttasyaiva phalaṃ iti loketo nirṇīyate |
śatānyāyuṣva iti vigrahīṣyāmaḥ; iti ( cothe ) ukte ' naivaṃ saṃkhyāśabdānāṃ samāsa iṣyate ' iti ( uttaramuktaṃ bhāṣye ) |
tasyārthaḥ--) yau dvivacanabahuvacanāntau saṃkhyā- śabdau, tābhyāṃ na samāsa iṣyate |
rājapuruṣa ityukte na rājaśabdāt paraṃ dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vā śrūyate |
nanu ekatve'pi pramāṇaṃ nāsti, tena vā kathaṃ vigrahaḥ ? ucyate |
citraguḥ iti citrā gāvo yasya iti ( bahuvacanāntena ) vigrahe prayogasmṛtiḥ pramāṇam |
matyarthaṃ hi bahuvrīhiḥ, bhūmiṃ ca matup sabhyate, iti bahuvrīhireva bhūmānaṃ gamayati, iti yukto bahuvacanena vigrahaḥ |
bhāṣya-- nahi etāyadayuṣā rasāyanānāṃ saṃbandho dṛṣṭapūrvaḥ |
dṛśyante tāvat alpasya sthira- bhāvasya kāraṇāni |
śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ iti satyapi vacane adhikaṃ jīyana dṛśyate eveti |
kadā cit yāṃ ca yāvatīṃ ca śarīrasthiratāṃ utpādayeyuḥ, na drāghikālam |
yathā prakāmanto'bhyāsāt prakramāṇāṃ buddheḥ yāṃ ca yāvatīṃ ca mātrāṃ prāpnuvanti, na tu abhyasyantaḥ puruṣapāṇupeṇi, yojanamātraṃ prakrameyuḥ |
evami- hāpi saṃbandhābhāvāt sahasrāyuṣṭvaṃ prāpnuyanti veti saṃdi- gdham |
bhāṣya-- kathaṃ tarhīti ? sa manuṣyādhikārapakṣe kulakalpo bhaviṣyati ityevaṃ kārṣṇājinirācāryo manyate sma |
yathā śakyate tathā pārayitavyaṃ iti gamyamāne bahavaḥ śakuvantaḥ pravartaren |
anye'pi tatkulīnāḥ anyena ārabdhaṃ samāpayeyuḥ iti |
bhāṣya-- śāstraphalaṃ hi prayoktra iti samadhi- gatam |
yaśca kātsnyena vidhimupasaṃhartuṃ samarthaḥ, sa evādhikriyate iti |
evaṃ tarhi etadadhya- seyaṃ, vacanaprāmāṇyāt etat karma kurvatāṃ āyurvardhate iti |
tathāhi sāmānyena adṛṣṭaṃ kalpayituṃ laghīyaḥ, na tu karmaṇā āyurvardhate iti viśeṣādṛṣṭakalpanā |
athavā ānartha- kyameva abhyupagamyeta kāmaṃ, na ayukti phalakalpanām |
athocyeta, arthatṛtīyāni jñānāni (250) dīkṣiyante, caturbhirvaiḥ samāpyate iti |
evamapi niyataparimāṇaṃ hīyate 'caturviṃśatiparamāḥ : saptadaśārāḥ : satramāsīran' iti |
vacanasya tu ānarthakyaparihārāya parimāṇaṃ hāpaviṣyate iti cet, tadyuktam |
bhāṣya-- kathaṃ tarhi ? evaṃ, anyatara'tra gauṇaḥ śabdaḥ syāt |
yadi vā asaṃvatsare saṃvatsaraśabdaḥ, yadi vā pañcapañcāśataḥ iti śabdo gauṇa iti |
kuta etat ? vipratiṣedhāt, vipratiṣedho hi bhavati ubhayasmin vihite |
yadi pañcapañcāśataḥ trivṛtaḥ, na saṃvatsarāḥ; atha saṃvatsarāḥ trivṛtaḥ, na pañcapañcāśataḥ |
tasmāt virodhāt anyatarat vacanaṃ gauṇaṃ iti lādhukāyana ācāryo manyate sma |
bhāṣyaṃ-- etaduktaṃ anyatarat vacanaṃ gauṇamiti, tadvacāritayat |
pañcapañcāśataḥ ityayaṃ tu vyakparimāṇasya arthasya vācakaḥ, ekenāpi une na bhavati |
māseṣu na saṃvatsaraśabdaḥ uktaḥ 'yo māma: sa saṃvatsaraḥ' iti |
tasmāt pañcapañcāśato māsā iti (83 saṃva0 4 māsādha) nanu etasmin pakṣe sahasrasaṃvatsaraśabdo nāvakalpate |
avidhīyamānaṃ ca yena kena cit guṇena avakalpyate |
na tāvat jīvanamasti, yāvatā etadakalpyeta dārāprikālasomapūrvavyāpekṣayeti |
tena etasmin kriyamāṇe aparisamāpte eva asyāyu: paryupayukta syāt, tathā ca adhyāyanādeva aṭaṣṭaṃ kalpyeta |
evaṃ tarhi dvādaśāha: prakṛtiḥ, iti pañcapañcāśato dvādaśāha bhaviṣyanti iti |
tathā ca dṛśyate 'dvādaśa vai rāyaḥ saṃvatsarasya pratimā: (mā ?) iti |
triścacchabdaśca dvādaśāha divase dṛṣṭaḥ, na dvādaśāhane |
na pañcapañcā- śato māsāḥ, kiṃ tarhi divasā: |
'ādityo vā sarva kadanaḥ, sa yadaitadeti atha vasanto, yadā saṃgro'tha
grīṣmo, yadā mayaṃdino'tha varṣāḥ, yadā'parāhno'tha śarad, yadā'stameti atha hemantaśiśirau' iti sarvā- ṭnun ahani saṃpādayati |
api ca pañcapañcāśatastrivṛtaḥ iti trivṛtāṃ pañca- pañcāśatam |
na tatra trivatsaṃkhyāyā dvādaśarātreṇa mukhyayā vṛttyā sāmānyādhikaraṇyam |
(athaiva sūtrama anyathāvyākhyānarūpo bhāṣyagranthaḥ likhitapustakapratyakṣaḥ: iti bhā-ṭippaṇī |
sa ca evam-) vāśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati |
ahani pañcapañcā- śatastrivṛtaḥ iti trivṛcchabdena ākhyāyante |
soma-- pūrvatra vṛṇitotrāṇameva iti niyamā- bhāve'pi iha gandharvādhikāraniyamo'sti iti pratya- vasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- sahasrasaṃvatsaraṃ satraṃ manuṣyeṣviva sahasrāyuṣāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ syāditi |
ṣaṣṭho'stu yo māsa etra saṃvatsara īritavān |
bhāṣya -- 'pañcapañcāśatastrivṛtaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ, pañca- pañcāśataḥ pañcadaśāḥ, pañcapañcāśataḥ saptadaśāḥ, pañcapañcāśata ekaviṃśāḥ, viśvasṛjāmayaṃ sahasrasaṃvatsaraṃ' iti śrutam |
trivṛt- saṃvatsaraśabdau tu lakṣaṇayā trivṛtstomasaṃvatsarasādhyakatva- vṛttirī |
tadidaṃ trivṛdādistomakamaṃ yadyapi sākṣātsaṃbandhena ahantyeva tathāpi tādṛśārdhatitvāt saṃvatsare'pi tat saṃbhavati iti na ko'pi doṣaḥ |
tatra saṃvatsaraśabdo mukhyayā vṛttyā saṃvatsa- ramevābhidhatte |
tena manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasrāyuṣābhāvāt tiryagādhikaraṇe (6|1|2) nirākṛto'pi śrutivat gandharvādīnāmāmevādhikāraḥ |
teṣāṃ tu agnyāyupasaṃhārasā- sānyāt manuṣyāṇāmeva vā ryāyanalavasahasrāyuṣāṃ saḥ |
rasāyanādeḥ etādāyuḥsaṃpādanasāmarthye pramāṇābhāvāt 'śatāyurvai puruṣaḥ' iti śruteśca ekena ārabhyasya putrādipāraṃparyeṇa samāpanaṃ iti kulakalpo vā |

'śāstra- phalaṃ proktar' (3|1|8) iti nyāyasya vinā vacanaṃ apavāde pramāṇābhāvāt, samastakartṛmānubhāve vikalā- nuṣṭhānaṃ phalānupapattiprasaṅgāt, sattarārambhādeva sahasrāyuṣyaṃ jāyate iti vā kalpyam |
etādṛśakalpe'pi pramāṇā- bhāvāt pañcapañcāśataḥ iti yajamānābhiprāyaḥ saṃkhyā |
tena eko'pi trivṛtstomakāyutaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ pañcapañcā- śālokyakaiḥ yajamānaiḥ : saṃvatsaratvaṃ : tāvatsaṃsthaḥ ityupa- caryate |
ataḥ anuḥsaṃvatsaramidaṃ satraṃ sārdhaśatadvayaiḥ yajamānaiḥ kārya iti vā pakṣāntaram |
asyāpi buddhī atyantamanorathāhat, 'samadaṣṭāvaḥ caturviṃśatipuruṣāḥ' iti ātideśikaparimāṇavādhāpatteśca anupapattiḥ |
tasmān saṃkhyāśabdaṃ saṃvatsaraśabdaṃ vā gauṇamāśrityaiva manuṣyādhikāraḥ samarthanīyaḥ |
saṃvatsarapadaṃ tu jaghanyatvāt sauracāndrādibhedena anekatvācca arthaniścayasāmarthya bhavati iti gauṇam |
tatra 'yo māsa: sa saṃvatsaraḥ' iti darśanāt māseṣveva saṃvatsaraśabdaḥ ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
nahi ādhānādūrdhvaṃ sahasramāsāparyantaṃ (83 varṣāṇi 4 māsāśca) jīvanaṃ saṃbhavati |
ataḥ 'saṃva- tsarapratimā vai dvādaśa rātrayaḥ' iti prayogān dvādaśa- rātriṣu iti aparaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pratimāśabdaviśeṣaṇaṃ tu atra saṃvatsaraśabdaḥ, na tasya dvādaśarātreṣu prayogaḥ |
trivṛ- dādipadairhi stomamātrānvayakerepi tadviśiṣṭaṃ ahureva lakṣa- ṇayā prakāśyate |
ataḥ tadvidyā saṃvatsarapadaṃ divasaparameva iti siddhāntaḥ |
idaṃ ca kṛtādīyāntareṣvapi manuṣyāṇāṃ śatameva para- māyuḥ iti kṛtvācintayā |

yadā tu smṛtipurāṇetihā- sādau śrutasya prakṛtapuruṣayogādiphalasya anekasahasra- vatsaraparimitasya āyuo'pi prakṛtayugayugasya prāmā- ṇikatvaṃ, etajjñāpakatvenaiva ca 'śatāyurvai puruṣaḥ' iti śrutī śatāni āyuṣi yasya iti vigrahaḥ |
kaliyugābhi- prāyatvaṃ vā āśraṇīyaṃ, tadā trivṛdādiśśabdena ahaḥsaṃbhave trivṛtstomakādyetyatatsaṃbandhena saṃvatsaraśabdo yathāśruta eva |
satraṃ ca gauṇādivat yugāntarasthatāva- dāyuṣyamanuṣyapara iti dhyeyam |
nahi mīmāṃsakamate yugādi- vyavasthā alīkā, tattadyugadharmavyavasthāpyasārtavidhīnāṃ nirvighnavyāpateḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ-- 'pañcapañcāśatastrivṛtaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ, pañcapañcāśataḥ pañcadaśāḥ, pañcapañcāśataḥ saptadaśāḥ, pañcapañcāśata ekaviṃśāḥ, viśvasṛjāmayaṃ sahasrasaṃvatsaraṃ' iti |

atra sahasrāyuṣāṃ gandharvādīnāmevādhikāra asyā- śrabhāvenasaṃbhavāt, manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasrāyuṣya rasāyane- bhāvena phalyayogār, etattvārambhādeva etāvadāyuḥ- kalpane mānābhāvāt, pañcapañcāśata iti yajamānasaṃkhyā
tena catuḥsaṃvatsaramidaṃ satraṃ sārthastadathaiḥ kriyamāṇaṃ sahasrasaṃvatsara iti|
māsaparatve'pi ādhānādūrdhvaṃ tāvajjī- vanāsaṃbhavāt iti siddhāntaḥ |
'ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ satramāsate' 'ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ satramupayanti' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ satrāṇi trayāṇāmapi varṇānāṃ, uta brāhmaṇā- nāmeveti |
nāhi kaścit viśeṣaḥ āśrīyete, amīṣāṃ varṇānāṃ satrāṇi bhavanti, amīṣāṃ neti |
'ye yajamānāste ṛtvijaḥ' ityayaṃ yat ānūpūrvya, tatra yajamānatvak- śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattyā ekena lakṣaṇārthena bhavi- tavyam |
tatra mukhyatvāt yajamānaśabdaḥ śrutivṛttaḥ, jaghanya- tvāt ṛtvikśabdo lakṣaṇārthaḥ |
'yacchabdastacchabdau (yathā- kramaṃ ) uddeśyapratinirdeśakau iti (sthite ) ko vākyārtha iti cintyate |
tatra ( sarvavarṇānāṃ ) yajamānānāṃ nirdiṣṭa- pratinirdiṣṭānāṃ ārtvijyaṃ vidhīyate ( saṃskāratvena ) iti pūrvataḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhāntastu, ( satyaṃ ) sarve varṇā uddiṣṭa- pratinirdiṣṭāḥ |
kiṃtu iha ) yajamānāḥ ārtvijyasya kartṛtvena vidhīyante |
tasya ( ca ) dvau dharmau ( prakṛtitaḥ prāptau ) anyakartṛkatā brāhmaṇakartṛkatā ca |
brāhmaṇakartṛkatā ( tu ) svadharmaṃ kartṝṇāṃ yajamānānāṃ ( guṇabhūtānāṃ satramāsīran iti brāhmaṇamātracaritārthatvāmānyavacanaprāptena ) dharmeṇa traivarṇikatvena na jahāti |
kiṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati ? evamāha, 'bārhaspaiirdrā brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārthuraśmaṃ rājanyasya, rāyovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti dvādaśāho bhavati vacanaṃ brahma- sāmavidhānaparam |
na caita- dasti, trayāṇāmapi varṇānāṃ adhikāra iti |
bhāṣya-- iti cet paśyasi rājanyavaiśyayorvaiguṇya- māpadyate iti |
vacanāt yajamānāḥ santaḥ ṛtvijo bhaviṣyanti 'ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ' iti |
ke punaryajamānāḥ ? ye satraphalaṃ kāmayamānāḥ satrakarmaṇi pravṛttāḥ, te rājanyā api, vaiśyā api |
tatra etat syāt, yeṣāmātvijyaṃ śakyaṃ kartuṃ teṣāmidaṃ ārtvijyavidhānamiti |
yathaiva brāhmaṇānāṃ yajamānānāmprāptaṃ vacanaprāmāṇyāt bhavati, evamabrāhmaṇānāmapi yajamānānāṃ vacanaprāmāṇyādeva bhaviṣyatīti |
tasmāt ārtvijyasaṃskṛtā rājanyavaiśyā api satramāsīran iti |
svāmittvanena vacanena vidhīyate, etankāmāḥ satramāsīran iti vidhīyate, nārtvijyam |
atha 'ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ' ityanena vacanena vihitamārtvijya iti |
kathaṃ ? nātraiṣā vacanavyaktiḥ, ye yajamānā iti uddeśyapadaṃ ṛtvijaḥ iti vidheyapadam |
tathāhi sati ārtvijyamatraṃ yajamānasaṃskārakaṃ vidhīyeta, na yajamānāḥ ārtvijyasya aṅgam |
eṣā ca vacanavyaktiḥ, ṛtvija itti uddeśyapadaṃ, te iti vidhīyate, ye yajamānāḥ ta eva ṛtvijo bhavanti nānye, iti ārvijeṣu padārtheṣu yajamānāḥ kartāro vidhīyante |
evaṃ sati prākṛtaprayojanā eva ārvijāḥ padārthāḥ, na yajamānasaṃskāraḥ adṛṣṭo vidhīyate iti |
yajamānakartṛkalpanāyāmāpi eṣāmadṛṣṭaṃ iti kalpyeta, tatra brūmaḥ |
itarasmin pakṣe yajamānaviṣayaḥ so'dṛṣṭaḥ saṃskāraḥ ityavaśyaṃ kalpanīyam |
bhāṣya-- na caitadasti gārhapate vā padārthe rājanyavaiśyau iti |
yajamāna- camasaḥ somamayaḥ ekeṣāṃ, phalacamasam ekeṣām |
tathā brahmasāma gārhapate brāhmaṇānāṃ, pārthuraśmaṃ rājanyanāṃ, rāyovājīyaṃ vaiśyānām |
bhāṣya-- atha yaduktaṃ liṅgadarśanāditi, tat pari- hartavyam |
ataḥ ṛtvijāṃ svāmitvāt rājanyavaiśyānāṃ satraṃ nāvakalpate iti |
yajamānaṛtvikśabdayoḥ bhinnārthayoḥ śrutyā sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt ekasya lakṣyatve, jaghanyasya ṛtvikśabdasya tarkyapadārthalakṣaṇāmārśritya teṣu yajamānāḥ kartṛtvena vidhīyante |
na ca ṛtvikśabda ṛtayajananimittaḥ iti mukhyameva sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ saṃbhavatīti vācyam |
vastutaḥ ṛtvik-śabdasya ṛtayajananimittatve'pi asmin vākye tatparatve yajamānānāṃ tatsattvena vidhyarhatā vākyānarthakyāpatteḥ |
ye parārtha ṛtau yajanti tatparatayā mukhyasāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt |
evaṃ ca ṛtayajananimi- ttena ṛtvijāmeva satāṃ yajamānānāṃ ṛtvigviśeṣakāryeṣu parāyaiṣu vidhiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- satre'pi 'ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ' iti śrutam |
tatra na tāvat yajamānānāṃ ṛtayajanakartṛ- tvarūpamṛtviktvaṃ ādāya dvayoḥ prathamāntayoḥ sāmānā- dhikaraṇyena |
tenāpi ca na yajamānapadasya yāgakartṛbhinnāḥ ityevaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇya- nānanvayaḥ, svāmani parikrayāsaṃbhavena bādhāt |

na ca ṛtvikpadena prakṛtau vastuto ye parikrayaṇītāḥ tarkya- kartṛn abhidhāya tena saha yajamānapadasya abhedānvayaḥ, suvantayoḥ parasparānvayasya aṣṭaprasaṅgāt, viśiṣṭa- lakṣaṇayā tarkyalakṣaṇayā eva ṛtvikpade nyāyya- tvācca |
ṛtvikapade eva tatkāryaṃ lakṣayitvā yajamānasaṃskārārthatvena tat vidhīyate, yacchabdaprāthamyābhyāṃ yajamānasyaiva ude- śyatvapratīteḥ |
ata eva phalamuttvāt aprākṛtakārya- kalpanā'pi na doṣaḥ |
eva ṛddhikāmatvāviśeṣāt trayāṇāmapi varṇānāṃ ātithyasaṃsarkārārthatvāgateḥ trayāṇāmapi satre adhikāraḥ |
ata eva dvādaśāhe 'bārhaspatīra brāha- ṇasya' ityādidikkamapi upapadyate |
evaṃ ca yajamānasaṃskā- raikaiva ṛtvikapadeḥ prākṛtakanūpakārasyāpi siddheḥ na tadarthaṃ parikriyādibhiḥ ṛtvigantarasaṃpādanaṃ ityapi draṣṭa- vyam |

iti prāpte, jñāpakasattve vyavahitanyāyakalpatayā śābdabodhasya loke dṛṣṭatvāt iha apūrvavidhitvād dṛṣṭā- prākṛtakāryakalpanādidoṣabhiyā yacchabdasya vyavahitatvena svarūpaprāptimātrasūcanena vā ṛtvikārthasyaiva uddeśyatva- maṅgīkṛtya yajamānāḥ kartāro vidhīyante |
na ca etāvatā aṛtvikatvaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ, yajamānānāmapi ṛtvikatvasya sādhitatvāt |
varaṇadidikkyuktaṃ yajamānabhinnatvaṃ paraṃ atideśaprāptaṃ upadeśena bādhyate |
na tu etāvatā abrāhmaṇakartṛkatvamapi, iti tadanugrahāya brāhmaṇānāmevā- dhikāraḥ |
'ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ' iti yajamāne saṃskāratvena ātithyavidhiḥ, guṇabhūtakartṛparicchedakatā brāhmaṇyaṃ ātithyāṅgam |
iti prāpte, saṃskāratvena ātithyavidhau aprākṛtakāryatvāpatteḥ taduddeśyenaiva yajamānavihitaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ -- etat samadhigataṃ brāhmaṇāmeva satraṃ, na rājanyavaiśvānāmiti |
athedānīmidaṃ saṃdigghaṃ kiṃ sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ, uta vāsiṣṭhānāṃ saḥ, uta bhṛguśunakasidhdānta- varjayitvā anyeṣāmiti |
nahi kaścit viśeṣa āśrīyate amīṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ satraṃ, amīṣāṃ neti |
vāsiṣṭhānāṃ brahmatva niyamāt vāsiṣṭhānāṃ satraṃ syāt, nānyeṣāṃ |
kutaḥ ? brahmatvasya niyamo bhavati 'vāsiṣṭho brahmā bhavati' iti |
ato vāsiṣṭhānāṃ tatsamāna- kalpanānāṃ ca satraṃ syāditi |
bhāṣyaṃ-- sarveṣāṃ vā satraṃ syāt aviśeṣāt |
punaḥ pratiprasayate 'ya eva kaścana stomabhāgamadhīyīta sa eva brahmā bhavet' iti |
vāsiṣṭhopadeśa idānīṃ kimayamiti cet, stomabhāgaśra- sārthaḥ |
stomabhāgān adhīyānaḥ avāsiṣṭho'pi vāsiṣṭha- kāryaṃ samarthaḥ kartumiti |
kutaḥ ? vaiśvāmitrasya hautraṃ niyamyate 'viśvāmitro hotā bhavati' iti |
tasmāt vaiśvāmitrāṇāṃ, taiśca samānakalpanāṃ adhikāra iti |
vi-- 'viprasya satraṃ sarvasya vāsiṣṭhasyaiva vā bhavet |
' 'radimarasi kṣayāya tvā' ityā- dayo mantrāḥ stomabhāgā nāma |
bhāṭṭa-- prakṛtau 'vāsiṣṭho brahmā, vaiśvāmitro hotā' iti brahmatvādyudeśena vāsiṣṭhādividhānāt tadyośa viruddha- kalpatvāt satre vikalpaḥ |
iti prāpte 'ya eva kaścit stomabhāgamadhīte sa eva vāsiṣṭhaḥ' ityetāvedena dveyanapadasya vidhisattvād lakṣaṇayā stomabhāgādyetumātraparatvāt śaktyārthavidhabhāvena vaiśvāmitrasamāna
evaṃ ke cit nārāśaṃsa- kalyāḥ, ke cit tanūnapātalyāḥ |
tatra kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? saṃnipāte bahūnāṃ yajamānānāṃ ye eva tulyāḥ, te eva saha satramāsīran |
itarathā yasya kalpo nopasaṃhiyeta tasya vaiguṇyaṃ syāt |
yathā prakṛtāveva vinā sādṛśyena phalābhāvaḥ evamihāpi iti |
(iyaṃ ṣaḍ- ktiḥ mudrite likhite cāsti, paraṃtu tantra-ne nāsti) |
tatra (vasiṣṭhānāmetareṣāṃ ca kartṛtva-) saṃnipāte (sati) atatkartṛtvāt (ayasikkṛtvāt, kṛtau) nimittavidhātāt anaṅgaṃ nārāśaṃsaḥ |
(paśāntara- māha-) tatkartṛtvādā (nārāśaṃsakartṛtvāt) vasiṣṭhānāṃ, tairapi kriyamāṇe nārāśasena itareṣāṃ kalpasiddhiḥ (kāryasiddhiḥ) iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
(vasiṣṭhā hi kartāro nārāśaṃsaṃ sāṅgaṃ, itare tu tanūnapātam |
ubhayakartṛsaṃnipāte tu dvayorapi kātsyena kartṛtvān nārāśaṃso'pi tāvat vasiṣṭhena kriyate eva iti nāsti vaiguṇyam |
evaṃ tanūpā- dapi aviguṇaṃ eva iti yena kenāpi saguṇaḥ kratuḥ sarveṣāṃ phalāsādhanamiti) |
siddhāntastu - vasiṣṭhānāmiti (ṣaṣṭhī) svāmillakṣaṇārthā, (ataḥ) yeṣāṃ svaṃ nārāśaṃsaḥ, teṣāmeva karmasiddhiṃ karoti, netareṣām |
yathā 'puruṣārthamupapadyatā' iti vacanasāmarthyāt śavaśirasāṃ sparśanaṃ smṛtivipratiṣiddhamapi kriyate evamihāpi |
yathā ṛtapeye 'ghṛtavrato bhavati' iti vacanāt ṛtuduhi nivṛttāyāṃ anyāmāśire gāṃ kalpayanti |
bhāṣyaṃ - naitadasti, yaduktaṃ bhinnakalpanāmāpi adhi- kāra iti |
atha yaduktaṃ vacanāt vaiguṇyametasya- tīti, tatra, anārambhyatvādvāt |
tadi vacanāt praka- lpyate, yasmin akalpyamāne vacanamanarthakaṃ bhavati |
yadi hi ārabhya bhinnakalpān etaducyeta, tato vacanamanarthakaṃ bhavati, iti bhinnakalpanāmāpi satramabhyupeta, na tu ārabhya bhinnakalpān etaducyate |
yathā 'yajamānena saṃmitāmaudumbarī parivāsayanti' iti yasya kasya cit parimāṇena siddho yaśaḥ anyeṣāṃmapi siddho bhavati |
sa ca prakaraṇaprāptāṃ yāgārthatāṃ bādhiṣyate iti |
nanu itarathā'pi adṛṣṭaṃ avaśyaṃ kalpa- nīyam |
dvitīyate tu pakṣe kalpayitvā śabdaṃ tena ekavākyatā syāt |
ka cit samā- nātena saha ekavākyatā bhaviṣyati, tathāpi aprakṛtena vyagrahitena ca kalpyamānā prakṛtakalpanāyāḥ gurutarā syāt |
yacca yasya yajñārthaṃ, tena saha phaladaṃ karma tasya bhavati |
tena evamabhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate, vāsiṣṭhādīnāṃ nārāśasena sahitaṃ karma phaladaṃ bhavatīti |
bhāṣyaṃ - atha yadupavarṇitaṃ yathā audumbarī tathā iheti |
ekenāpi yajamānena saṃmitā ceyaṃ sarveṣāṃ yajamāna- saṃmitā bhavati |
na tu iha ekasya kalpe saṃgṛhīte sarveṣāṃ saṃgṛhīto bhavati |
'yathā puroḍāśakapālena tugānuṣapatti' iti parārthyakapālena tupā upasannayā iti upādīyate, evameta- dapīti |
bhāṣyaṃ - evaṃ cedvāñ paśyati, yajamānena samānaṃ taprayojanaṃ, na svena anyena vā yajamāneneti, tathā prayo- gāntare yo yajamānaḥ, tenāpi saṃmānaṃ prāpnoti |
na tu yajamānaśabde kaścit viśeṣaḥ, yato yajamānaśabdāt vyavasthā syāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? ekatvasya vivakṣitatvāt, na dvābhyāṃ yajamānāni kartavyāni iti nānya ānīyate |
āha, anya eva tathaiva sarvejāmaneṣu bhavatu |
kāminaṃ hi adhikṛtya sāṅgatya yāgasya vacanam |
saṃnipātāttu nimittavidhātaḥ syād, bṛhadrathaṃtara- vad vibhaktaśiṣṭatvād vipratiṣedhaiḥ |
bahuṣu yaja- māneṣu saṃnipātāt nimittavidhātaḥ syāt |
vasiṣṭhairvarṇyaṃ prayoge nārāśaṃso naimi- ttikaḥ, anyasmin tanūpāt naimittikaḥ |
yatra idānīṃ ubhaye kartāraḥ sasahayena, tatra nairvṛttirna kevalena |
na cet vāsiṣṭhaḥ kevalaḥ karttā, tarhi tannimittaṃ tatra na karttavyaṃ, na cetaranimittam |
tadyathā 'bṛhadrathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' iti bṛhadrathajanakaṃ, na rathaṃ- tarasādhanakaṃ iti naiva tatra bṛhat nimittaṃ bhavati, na rathaṃtaraṃ vā |
kṛtsnaṃ prati kevalasya kartṛtvena saṃyogo bhavati |
kathaṃ punaḥ: kātsyena kartṛtvaṃ ? svāmitvena abhisaṃbandhāt |
karma prati svāmitvena kevalanāṃ vasi- ṣṭhādīnāṃ abhisaṃbandho bhavati |
tasmādekaikaḥ kṛtsnasya karttā iti tatraimittikaṃ sarve prāpnoti |
yadyapi sā tuṇḍapiṇḍayormātā, tathāpi tasyai dīyate |
kātsyena hi tasya sā mātā bhavati, nahi vyāsyate mātṛtvam |
sāmnaḥ: karmavṛddhayaikadeśena saṃyogo guṇatvenā- bhibhaṃvandhestasmān tatra vighātaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ - atha yaduktaṃ 'bṛhadrathaṃtarayo'diti, tat pari- haraṇīyam |
bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ sāmnoḥ naimittikakarmavṛddhayā ekadeśena saṃyogo bhavati |
stotraikadeśena tu tatra sāmnoḥ saṃbandhaḥ, na kṛtslena stotreṇa |
guṇatvena hi tatra sāma śrūyate, stotraṃ prādhānyena |
soma- na ca ' rājanyatrivṛthvaidyaśunakānāṃ kaṇvakāśyapasaṃstutānāṃ nārāśaṃso dvitīyaḥ prayājaḥ, tanūnapādebhya' iti vākye dhātorevābhāvāt kathaṃ dhātvartha- vidhānamucyate iti vācyam |
atra avaśyaṃ vidhipratya- sya kalpanīyatvāt, tasya ca prakṛti vinā anupapatyā prakṛterapi kalpanāyāṃ 'eteṣāṃ nārāśaṃsaṃ dvitīyaṃ prayajet' ityevarūpaṃ saṃpadya vākyaṃ, iti dhātvarthavidhānopapatteḥ |
'dvitīyaḥ prayājaḥ kāryaḥ' iti kalpanāyāmapi kṛtisāmānya- vācakasya prayāje eva paryyavasānāt dhātvarthavidhirupapadyate |
bhāṭṭa - darśapūrṇamāsādī kalpabhedaḥ śruta: 'rājya- vāsigrānāṃ nārāśaṃso dvitīyaḥ prayājaḥ, tanūnapādanyeṣāṃ ' ityādinā |

atra hi 'tanūnapātaṃ yajati ' ityanena eka- deśapravṛttinimittanāmadheyaṃ aṅgīkṛtya vihitasya dvitīya- prayājasya krame āābhāvena sāmānyatoḥ nārāśaṃsatanūna- pānmanyoḥ avayavasthayā vikalpena dvitīyaprayājasaṃbandhi- tvena prāptoḥ vāsiusaṃbandhamācaṃ nārāśaṃsasya kriyate |
ata eva nārāśaṃsa iti taddhitaḥ dvitīyapadaṃ cānu- vādaḥ |
tataśca pariśeṣādeva tanūnapānmanye anyasaṃbandha- siṃheḥ 'tanūnapādanyeṣāṃ ' ityapi 'goducyattare ' itivat anuvāda eva |

na ca nārāśaṃsama-traya prakaraṇāṇe pāṭhe'pi darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe pāṭhābhāvaḥ iti keṣāṃ nidukaṃ yukta, padyaprakaraṇe'pi sukte yaktanārāśaṃsamantrapāṭhe'pi 'nārā- śaṃso'maya ājyasya vetu ' ityasya darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe pāṭhān |
ata eva āśralāyanādibhiḥ tathaiva sa paṭhitaḥ |

yattu nārāśaṃsavākye dvitīyatvādiṣvitiprāyājatvavidhiḥ, tasya na vāsiusaṃbandhitvena vidhānāt anyeṣāmabhāva iti, tanna, tathātve samiyāgottaratvarūpadvitīyatvasya nārāśaṃsamaye vidhāne'pi vāsigrānāṃ tanūnapā- cāgatvādhe pramāṇābhāvāt nārāśaṃsottaraṃ tatkaraṇāpatteḥ |
nahi dvitīyapade tatkāryakāritvena nārāśaṃsavidhiḥ, yena teṣāṃ tanūnapādābhaḥ śaṅkyeta |
tathātve siddhānte vāsi- jñānāmapi uddeśatvena vākyabhedāpatteḥ |

na ca 'tanūnapā- danyeṣāṃ ' ityanena anyeṣāṃ tanūnapāddiātānāṃ vāsi- jñānāṃ tathāpyapattiḥ, tasya ekatrākyatvenopattau vākya- bhedāṅgīkāre pramāṇābhāvāt, viśiṣṭavidhipūrvavidhividhiramāntara- kalpanāgauravaprasaṅgācca |
ataḥ pūrvoktaprakaraṇa mantrasyaiva vāsiusaṃbandhavidhāne kalpabheda upapādanīyaḥ |
sa ca dīkṣaṇīyādidvārā anekakartṛkeṣu satrādiṣu prāptaḥ |
tatra satrādau bhinnakalpanāmapyadhikāraḥ, tata samānaka- lpanāmeva iti cintāyāṃ, aviśeṣāt bhinnakalpanāmāpi |
na ca ekakalpakaraṇe anyeṣāṃ vaiguṇyaprasaṅgaḥ, vāsijñānā ityana mantrasya śuddhavāsiugratvavidhāne prakaraṇābādhāyā- patteḥ |

ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmatve ca parisaṃkhyā''patteḥ : vāsiṣṭha- tvasya, nārāśaṃsamantre haitre vaiśāmitravidhānāt sākṣātkartṛ- paricchedakatvena vidhyayoge'pi prayojakakartṛbhūtayajamāna- paricchedakatvena vāsiusaṃbandhavidhyupapatteḥ, satrādau audumbarīsaṃ- mānatvat ekavāsiusaṃbandhakṛtve'pi anyeṣāṃ vaiguṇyāpatteḥ |

iti prāpte, vika- lpena prāptayormantrayoḥ niyamārthatvena vākyatārthakyeopapattau niyataprātāyāḥ satrākhyāvṛttirūpaparisaṃkhyāphalakayogāt, vāsiurodeśenaiva pramāṇāntaratvāt vāsiuābhilaṣitaphala- sādhanībhūtadarśapūrṇamāsāṅgabhūtadvitīyaprayājadvārā nārāśaṃsa- mantraviniyogavidhiḥ |
ataśca nārāśaṃsamantrasya vāsiueṣu viniyogābhāvādeva nivṛttiḥ, iti na tatparisaṃkhyā |
ataśca bhinnakalpanāmāpi adhi- kāre ekāṅgamantrapāṭhe itareṣāṃ phalānāpatteḥ : samāna- kalpanāmeva adhikāraḥ |
nyāyabindu: - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : 'rājyavāsigrānāṃ nārāśaṃso dvitīyaḥ prayājaḥ, tanūnapādanyeṣāṃ ' iti śrutam |
tatra vāsiuāsidaiḥ kuto nārāśaṃso vāsiukartṛkaḥ saṃpanna iti, evaṃ tanūnapādapi anyaiḥ, iti kaṃ cit kalpanāmāśritya bhinnakalpā api satrāṃ kuryuḥ |
iti prāpte, vāsiuādyartha- tvena nārāśaṃsādividhiḥ, rūpakāradvāreṇa tādarthya iti na phalāntarakalpanā, dhātvarthasya vidheyatvaṃ ca yuktaṃ sannikṛṣṭa- tvāt |
evaṃ ca ekakalpaāśraye anyeṣāṃ ṛtuvaiguṇyāt samānakalpanāmeva satraṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
' ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ satramāsate ' ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ satramupayanti ' iti |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ : kiṃ sāmīnāmanīnāṃ ca tāni bhavanti, uta sāmīnāmeva iti |
bhāṣyaṃ - sārasvate ca satre bhavati darśanam |
' para- rairyāṃ ete svargaṃ lokaṃ yanti, ye'nāhitāgnayaḥ satramāsate ' iti anāhitāmīnāṃ satraṃ darśayati |
bha ṣyaṃ - prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ' agraye viviccaye'- ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet, yamyāhitāmeryeragnibhara- mayaḥ saṃtyujyeran ' iti saṃsarge agnīnāṃ prāyaścittaṃ darśa- yati |
' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvā somena yajeta ' iti jyotiṣṭomasya iṣṭiparvam |
upagrahaviśeṣo hi bhavati ' amī- nādavīta ' iti |
tasmān anyasyāmiḥ : anyasya na siddhiḥ, yadyapi ṛtvarthā agrayaḥ iti |
tenāpi sāmayaḥ satrāṇi upāsate iti gamyate |
... athedānīṃ pūrvoktasya (29 sūtre) liṅgasya parihāra ucyate |
kathaṃ ? araṇye kāntāraṃ gacchatāṃ sthitānāṃ vā dasyubhayāt śrāpabhayādvā trāse jāte, dātrāgninā vā saṅkhyern mitho vā, sa viṣayaḥ prāyaścittasya bhaviṣyati iti |
jñā - ' tatrāgnīnāṃ parārthatvād yasya kasya cidagniṣu |
sādhitaṃ karma sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ sādhayati dhruvam |
iṣṭe cānāhi- tāmīnāṃ na kathaṃ cidadhikriyā |
sūtrārthestu - vihārasyāgnīnāṃ anyadīyānā- mapi anyo'kāraṃ prabhutvādanahitāmīnāmapi satraṃ syāditi |
tri - anāhitāgnu tatra kiṃssā''dhuverā, grimo yataḥ |

bhāṭṭa - sārasvatasatre ' pararairyāṃ ete svargaṃ lokaṃ yanti, ye'nāhitāgnayaḥ satramāsate ' iti vidhau satragraha- ṇasya saṃkoce pramāṇābhāvāt sarvakṣetreṣu anāhi- tāmīnāmapi āhitāgnisāhatānāṃ adhikāraḥ iti manyate |
ata eva sārasvatasatradeva itarasarvasatravyatiriktaviṣaya- meva ādhānagatārthānepadam |
iṣṭisomatvakāla tā ṛtvajjñātvā ekaṃ kaṃ cit tādṛśaṃ iṣṭisomakartāraṃ apekṣopa- paṃceva |

iti prāpte, ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmi- ṣṭvā somena yajeta, ya etenāgniṣṭutā yajeta gartta- patyameva tad bhavati ' iti vākyebhyaḥ atideśāt eka- ktvāpadānādena vākyabhedābhāvāt iṣṭisomamānakartṛ- katvāvagateḥ |

tatra ca ādhānagatāḥmanepadānurodhena āhi- tāgnimātrakartṛkatvāvagateḥ ; sārasvatasatraprakaraṇathavidhividhākye ca brīhmāditvaṃ tathaiva anāhitāgneḥ abhyanujñānāt ātmanepadānurodhena itarasatrepu āhitāgnīnāmeva adhi- kāraḥ |
nyāyabindu: - anāhitāgnerapi, kasya cidagnibhiḥ kāryasiddheḥ tena saha satre'dhikriyate |
iti prāpte, soma- vikārāṇāṃ iṣṭiparvatvāt anāhitāgneśca iṣṭyabhāvāt nādhikāraḥ |
' ādhadhīta ' iyāramanepadāt ādhānuāterā- mayaḥ karmatāthanaṃ, ato'pi nānamīnāmadhikāraḥ |
ṛju. bhāṣya-- iha smārtāḥ padārthā udāharaṇa pratyupasthita- |
adhikāra: sākāṅkṣabuddhiviparyavṛttiḥ (ayaṃ kiṃ jātamātrāṇāmime padārthāḥ, upanītānāmiti |
mīmā. pṛ. 236-239. varṇatrayasyāpi śrutasāmidhenīsāta- daśyāsu akṣaratvādiṣu|
( kalpaśabdo'tra prayogaviṣayakaḥ, na tu kalpasūtra- viṣayakaḥ) |
6|1|16-16. nanu evaṃ striyā adhikāro na syāt tathā adhya- yanapratiṣedhe tadvidhisiddhajñānābhāvāt |

'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityādi svargakāmapadasya uddeśa- yasamarpakena puṃstvasya uddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvāt grahaikatvavat aviśiṣṭatvena striyā adhikārasya sādhitatvāt iti cena, satyaṃ adhikāraḥ sādhitaḥ, na tu svātantryeṇa 'na strī svātantryamarhati' ityādinā tasya niṣiddhatvāt, svātantryeṇa kartṛtve prayogadasyāpi vaiguṇyāpatteśca |
yaja- mānaprayoge patnīkartṛkājyāvekṣaṇādiyopasaṅgāt, patnīpra- yoge ca yajamānakartṛkājyāvekṣaṇādiyopasaṅgāt |
sahādhikāratvena yajamānavittaiva patnyā pāṇigrahaṇāttu sahatvaṃ sarvakarmasu tathā puṇyaphaleṣu ' iti vacanena striyā adhikāranirṇayāt |
mīmā. pṛ. 233- 239. (yasya na yatra) adhikāraḥ na anyadaṅga- badhiramakānāṃ tirasthāṃ vā vaidike karmaṇi |
bhā. 6|1|10|42. adhikāraḥ na dvādaśaśatatyūna- dhanasya viśiñjiti |
adhyayanasya upanātādhikāratvāt, upanayanasya ca 'aṣṭavarṣe brāhmaṇa- mupanayīta' ityādinā taivarṇikādhikāratvāt, ādhāna- syāpi 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta' ityādinā taivarṇi- kādhikāratvāt |
mīmā. pṛ. 236. adhikāraḥ na śūdrasya vaidike karmaṇi |
bhā. 6|1|27-38. prekṣāpūrva- kāriṇāṃ phalededhaṃ vinā adhikārāyogaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1381. adhikāranyāyaḥ (6|1|1-3) atra svargaḥ pradhānataḥ, karma guṇataḥ iti, svargakāmamadhikṛtya 'yajeta' iti vacanaṃ, ityadhikāralakṣaṇamidaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati, ityu- ktam |
svargadāmakasyaiva kāmye karmaṇi adhikāraḥ iti nyāyārthaḥ |
ke. adhikāra- lakṣaṇasya prakaraṇasya viniyojakatvaṃ nāmyapagamyate |
anena hi svargamuddiśya yāgaṃ vidadhatā svargakāmasya yāgajanyaphalabhoktṛtvaṃ pratipādyate |
yasyāhitāgnervirdhamān dahet, so'gneye sāmavate'ṣṭā- kapālaṃ nirvapet ' ityādibhistu agnidāhadau nimitte karma vidhiriddhaḥ nimittataḥ karmajanyapāpakṣayaphala- sāmyaṃ pratipādyate |
mīmā. pṛ. 235-36. adhi- kāravidhiviṣayakaṃ 'vidhiḥ dvividhaḥ : iti vindī bālyaprakāśā draṣṭavyam |
ke. adhikāravidheḥ eva ' kāryaṃ jñāte'dhikāraḥ syāt ' ityanena nyāyena prayoga- vidhiprayojyasamastāṅgāvadhāraṇapūrvakatvena prayogavidhirodha- vṛttitvaṃ nyāyyam |
yattu upādānahetutāṃ (anuṣṭhānahetutāṃ) pratipadyate tat adhikṛto kāraṇam |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 30. adhi- kārātamakasya prakaraṇasya prakṛtatvalyatvāt bahu- nāmatyāgāṃ na prakṛtatvāviśeṣaṇāt tulyakālaṃ grahaṇāyateḥ na avāntaramahādhikārayoḥ balāvalaviśeṣo'sti |
su. pṛ. 911. adhikārī āvirbhūtasarvāṅkaraṇasāmarthyaḥ, nāṅgasā- marthyābhibhave adhikāravān |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 340. adhi- kārī iti karmaṇāṃ uparibhāvenāvasthitaḥ, sāmyī ityarthaḥ |
bhā. 6|1|13 pṛ. 1354. adhikārī karmasu kiyatā punarviditena vidvān adhikriyate ? yāvatā viditena
yathoktaṃ, ṛtumabhinirvartayituṃ tāvat yo veda sa tena ṛtunā adhikriyate |
anyasmin kratau kartavye anyakratujñānaṃ na dṛṣṭā bhavati |
bhā. 3|8|1|46. adhikārī karmasu ' nahi avidvān vihito'sti ' |
bhāṭa. 8|14. adhikāriṇaḥ pramitijanako vedaḥ iti nyāyāt samyakpadārthavijñānavata eva vākyārthabodho adhikāraḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 86. adhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ ca tadeva, yat puruṣaviśeṣaṇatvena śrutam |
ata eva ' rājā rājasūyena svārājyākāmo yajeta' ityanena svārājyamuddiśya rājasūyaṃ vidadhatā'pi na svārājyakāmasya taphalabhoktṛtvaṃ pratipādyate, kiṃtu rājñaḥ sataḥ tatkāmasya |
yathā adhyayana- vidhisiddhā vidyā, agnisādhyeṣu ca karmasu ādhānasiddhā agnimatā, sāmarthyaṃ ca |

eteṣāṃ puruṣaviśeṣaṇatvena atha- vaṇe'pi adhikāraviśeṣaṇamastyeva, uttarakratuvidhīnāṃ jñānākṣepātkabhevena adhyayanavidhisiddhajñānavantaṃ pratyeva pravṛtteḥ, agnisādhyakarmaṇāṃ ca agnyākṣepakatvena tadvi- dhīnāṃ ādhānasiddhāgnimantaṃ pratyeva pravṛtteḥ |
evaṃ sāma- rthyamapi adhikāraviśeṣaṇaṃ, asamarthe prati viniyujyate |
' ātmānatāmarthe bruvatāṃ śaktiḥ sahakāriṇī ' iti nyāyāt |
na tu aṅgasamarthaḥ : pradhānamātrasamarthasya kāmye karmaṇi adhikārī, pradhānavidheḥ aṅgavidhikyavākyāt''pradhānasya sāṅgakarmasamarthe pratyeva pravṛtteḥ yathāviniyogamadhikārāt |
yadi hi samarthe pratyeva pravṛttau syāt citta śrutyā virodhaḥ syāt, tadā asamarthasyāpi adhikāraḥ syāt, na ca viro- dho'sti svargakāmaśruteḥ samarthe pratyeva pravṛttau virodhā- bhāvāt |
pratyuta asamarthe prati pravṛttau pradhānavidheḥ aṅga- mī. ko. 40
vākyaikavākyatayā pratipannasya aṅgasāhityasya bādhāpatteḥ, nityavacchrutānāmaṅgānāṃ pākṣikatvaprasaṅgācca |
ataḥ sāṅge karmaṇi samarthasyaiva kāmye karmaṇi adhikāraḥ |
tāni hi yāvajjīvaśrutyā yāvajjīvaṃ kartavyatvena coditāni |
na ca yāvajjīvaṃ kenāpi sājñaiḥ prayogaḥ kartuṃ śakyate |
aṅgāni tu yāvanti kartuṃ śakyante, tāvanti kāryāṇi ityāstāṃ bahuktyā, sūribhiḥ parākrāntatvāt |
mīmā. pṛ. 236-241. adhi- kārisaṃkocaḥ : jñānākṣepāśaktikalpanāgauravaparihārā- rtham |
bhāṭa. 4|1|14. adhikāre ca mantravidhiratadākhyeyu, śiṣṭa- tvāt |
āgneyyā āgnīdhramupatiṣṭhate, aindrā sadaḥ, vaiṣṇavyā havirdhānaṃ ' iti jyotiṣṭome śrūyate |

kiṃ prakṛtābhireva āgneyyādibhirmantraibhiḥ upasthātavyaṃ kiṃvā dāśatayībhyaḥ ' āgneyyā upatiṣṭhate ' iti mantrasya vidhiḥ adhikāre jyotiṣṭomakaraṇasya mantre atadākhyeyu tadākhyabhiniṣu aprakṛteṣu ca mantreṣu vā syāt |
tasmāt prakṛtau vā grāhyaḥ dāśatayīstho vā āgamayitavyaḥ |
tadākhyaḥ : tena adhikāreṇa ākhyāyate sa prakaraṇasya eva grāhyaḥ |
tatra āgneyyamantre prakaraṇaṃ, anyatra ca upapattiḥ : 'agnidevatā asya ' iti vṛttisa- rvanāmanā prakṛta eva mantraḥ parāmṛśyate |
brahmaudanagrāhā- nādividhau ca prakṛtānāmeva caturṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ grahaṇe lāghavāttyā upapattiḥ |
tasmāt prakṛtā eva mantrā grāhyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
' āgneyyā āgnīdhramupatiṣṭhate ' iti upadeśaḥ āgnī- dhropasthānajanyāpūrvalakṣaṇāyā abhāve anarthakaḥ : niṣphalaḥ
adhikāro nāsti karmaṇi 314 adhikāro nāsti viśva syāt|
hi yasmāt upa- sthānaṃ apūrvātiriktena phalavat phalayuktaṃ na bhavati |
tasmāt prakṛtaiva āgneyī ṛk grāhyā iti siddhāntaḥ |

atra sudhā - ṛtvaikāntikatve'pi āgneyīādīnāṃ upasthānasya tatsvarūpāniyamatvena taddārakatvanyā- yogāt āgneyīādiśbdānāṃ ca saṃskāranimittatvā- bhāvena āgneyīāditvat svarūpaniścayaiva saṃkalānape- kṣaṇāt naiṣphalyapatteḥ upasthānasvarūpamatropadeṣṭāḥ sanmā- trasya phalavadsaṃbandhapatteḥ anarthakaḥ syāt iti phalavatā ityantasyārthaḥ spaṣṭaḥ iti |
'āgneyyā''gneyīmupatiṣṭhate' iti vihitā āgneyī ṛk prakaraṇasthaiva grāhyā iti siddhānta uktaḥ |
nanu prakaraṇapaṭhitānāṃ āgneyīnāṃ stotrādiprayojanāntarasaṃba- ndhena nirākāṅkṣatvāt praya
ityatra śākyānāmane hyadi peṣaṇāya māṃsamāvapan ‘māṃsamasi dhinuhi devān’ iti ūheta |
vi. 1|1|3 varṇakaṃ 2. adhiśrayaṇādi-amivāsanāntena kāṇḍena vāruṇacatuṣkapālapuroḍāśeṣu anusamayaḥ kartavyaḥ |
ukthyā- diṣu vikṛtiṣu saṃtardanaṃ nāma dṛḍhaḥ saṃkṣepaḥ kāryaḥ |
vi. 3|1|11. adhipavaṇaphalakayoḥ saṃtardanaṃ ukthyādirhasyādyu ahanādiṣu na niviśate, jyotiṣṭomāt tu notkarṣaḥ, na ca agniṣṭome nivedhaḥ |
āha ca ‘ācāryā mātulaśceti dravye- katve'pi dṛśyate |
’ vā. 2|3|1|27 pṛ. 424. atra sudhā- ācārya- śabdārthasya śiṣyameva sadbhāvena śiṣyapakṣatvāt ape- kṣaṇīyābhāve cāpekṣā''nupapatteḥ śiṣyaḥ prati- saṃtranyācāryasya śiṣyapekṣāyāṃ hetuḥ |
tadbhedena dravyaikye'pi pṛthaktvena vyavahāro dṛśyate iti vṛddhaślokārthaḥ |
pṛ. 653-54. adhīte'pi vede dharmavicāraṇāya gurukule evādhi- vāsaḥ kartavyaḥ |
vi. 1|1|1. adhītavedo hi viditavedārthaḥ vedārtheṣu adhikriyate |
maṇi. pṛ 140. ‘adhīya manāyāt’ iti smṛtyā adhyayana- nantarameva gurukulāt parāvartanavirodhāt vedādhyayananantaraṃ vedārthavicāraḥ na kartavyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
smṛtau ktvāpratyayaḥ uttarakālamātraparaḥ na tu adhyayanaparaḥ |
ratnamālā. pṛ. 28. adhyayanaṃ dṛṣṭe sati nāhyathāya |
śā. tarka. pṛ. 6. adhyayanaṃ na kratvarthaṃ na puruṣārthe ityuktaṃ tantraratne dravyārjanavarṇake (4|1|2 varṇakaṃ 2) |
vāla. pṛ. 81. adhyayanaṃ nityaṃ kratvanujñānasya nityatvāt |
vi 6| 2|11. adhyayanaṃ nityaṃ tatphalasya karmādhikārasya āvaśyakatvāt |
ratnamālā. pṛ. 28. adhyayanaṃ niyamāpūrvadvairaiva ṛtujñānasādhanaṃ sat aśeṣakratujanyāpūrvajanakaṃ bhavati |
6|1|6. yattāvat upādhyāyaḥ śiṣyasannidhau adhīte, tat (adhyayanaṃ) grahaṇārtham |
grahaṇadhāraṇe prayogārthe bhā. 1|2|1|13. yaniyamadibhiḥ adhyayanaṃ puruṣārthatvena avagatam |
vā. 6|1|3|7. adhyayanasya, karmaṇāṃ niyatayā phalato nityatvam |
maṇi. pṛ. 4. adhyayanasya jyotiṣṭomādyarthatvābhāve'pi tādṛśajñānārthatvāt kratvartha- tvam |
bhā. 4|1|2 pṛ. 82. adhyayanasya tu svargaḥ phalam, dṛṣṭaprayojanasya anuṣṭheyavijñānasya saṃbhavāt |
bhā. 1|1|1 pṛ. 6. adhyayanasya nityatvasiddhiḥ ‘ata ūrdhvaṃ patantyete’ iti vākyena ‘anadhīyānā vrātyā bhavanti’ iti niṣedhena ca |
vi. 1|2|17. adhyayanadharmāḥ parvaṇi nādhyeyaṃ, vāte nādhyeyaṃ, stanayitnau nādhyeya ityādiḥ |

1|1|1. adhyayanaprakaraṇapaṭhitasyāpi adhyāyānadhyāyādidharma- jātasya svarūpe kārye ca anupayogāt adhyayana- naineva phalakarmavirodhaṃ bhāvayet iti adhyayananiyamasya anāravyavihitasyāpi adhyayanajanitajñānopasthāpiteya- karmājñatayā sāmarthyapravihitena saṃnidhinā avadhāraṇāt tad-dvārā karmājñatvāt amāvāsyādau karmājñabhūta- yājyānvākyādimantroccāraṇaṃ na kārye iti ‘mantrāṇāṃ karma saṃyoge svadharmeṇa prayogaḥ syāt dharmasya tannimittatvāt ’ (1|2|13|18) iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣayitvā prakaraṇena adhyayanājñatayā avadhāritasya anarthatve pramāṇābhāvāt avipraparisamāptyarthatvena tadupayogasaṃbhavāt karmājñatvā- bhāvena karmakāle adhyāyānadhyāyādidharmānādareṇa amā- vāsyādāvapi karmājñamantroccāraṇaṃ kārye iti ‘vidyāṃ prati vidhānādvā sarvakālaṃ prayogaḥ syāt karmārthatvāt prayogasya’ (19) iti sūtreṇa siddhāntayiṣyate |
su. pṛ. 52. na ca tasya (vedasya) adhyayanamātraṇa tatrabhavanto yājñikāḥ phalaṃ samānamanti |
bāla. pṛ. 22. adhyayanavidhiḥ evaṃ sarvasya puruṣārthaparyavasāyitve pramāṇaṃ iti svamatena vārtikakāraḥ pratipādayati |
“ sakalasya tāvat vedasya ‘svādhyāyo'dhye- tavyaḥ’ iti adhyayanabhāvanā vidhīyate |
tatra kiṃ bhāvayet ityapekṣāyāṃ adhyayanaṃ ityagatamapi puruṣapravartanādiyuktena vidhāyakena apūrvārthasādhyāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ pravartanāśakti- prasakteḥ tadaṃśatā nirākriyate |
tataśca adhyayana i itivi- rodhāt saṃnidheśca karmāraṇe niviśate |
‘tena kiṃ’ ityape- kṣite ‘yat śakyate’ ityupagranthāt akṣaragrahaṇaṃ ityapaṭhati |
tasyāpi apūrvārthatvāt ‘tena kiṃ’ iti paṭhāvadhāraṇaṃ ityupatiṣṭhate |
tenāpi padārthajñānaṃ, tena vākyārthajñānaṃ tena ca anuṣṭhānaṃ, anuṣṭhānena svargādiprāptiḥ ityetāyati prāpte nirākāṅkṣībhavati |
” iti vā. 1|2|1|7 pṛ. 23. adhyayanavidhiḥ kartṛsāpekṣaḥ kāryāpekṣān upanītāneva kartun gṛhṇāti iti adhyayanavidhiprayuktādhyayanajanyārthajñānaṃ traivarṇikānāmeva sidhyati |
maṇi. pṛ. 4. adhyayanavidhiḥ traivarṇikānāmeva na śūdrasya |
tasya niṣedheṣu adhyayanameva niṣedhārthamajānan pratyaveyāt iti kalpanāt sāphalyam |
maṇi. pṛ. 3. adhyayanavidhiḥ svargārthaḥ viśvajitanyāyena iti jijñāsādhikaraṇe pūrvapakṣaḥ |
dṛṣṭe saṃbhavati adṛṣṭakalpa- nā''navakaśāt phalavadarthāvabodhe'pyadṛṣṭatve etadupapatteḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 2. adhyayanavidhiḥ ‘svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ’ iti akṣaragrahaṇamātraparyavasāyī iti kecinmanyante |
tato vidhiḥ vicāra- śāstrasya prayojakaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
su. pṛ. 690. adhyayanavidheḥ prayojanavarthā- vabodhanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanam |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 271. adhyayanavidheḥ phalaṃ arthajñānaparyantaṃ gurukulavāsaḥ vicārakaraṇaṃ ca |
maṇi. pṛ. 4. yo'yaṃ agnihotrādiṣu adhītevedānāṃ traivarṇikānāmeva adhikāraḥ na anadhītavedānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ iti adhikāraniyamaḥ, sa prayojanaṃ adhyayanavidheḥ |
jñā. pṛ. 6. adhyayanavidhiḥ svādhyāyaṃ iti dvitīyā guṇavattvena lakṣyate anyathā svādhyāye vājapeyavākye iva yāge guṇavidhau vairūpyāpatteḥ iti bhavadevaḥ |
ācāryakaraṇavidhiprayuktasya hi svādhyāyādhya- yanasya prayojanāpekṣāyāṃ puruṣāntarāmilena bahiraṅgampi prathamāgatatvena tassiddhirevāsya prayojanaṃ yuktaṃ, na tvarthajñānaṃ paścādbhāvitvāt |
akartavye ca nirṇaye na vicāraḥ kartavya iti tadarthakaṃ mīmāṃsāśāstramanarthakatvādvārambhaṇīyamiti |
kathaṃ ācāryakaraṇavidhiprayuktamadhyayanaṃ, na svavidhiprayuktaṃ ? ucyate - na svādhyāyavidhāvāsti niyojyastatra cāsati |
na hyanadhikārasya vidhiviṣayānuṣṭhāpakatvaṃ saṃbhavati prayā- jādiniyogavat |
na ca kalpayituṃ śakyo niyojyaḥ pitṛyajñavat |
siddhe tasmiṃśca kalpayituṃ śakyate anupapatya- bhāvāt |
anuṣṭhānādhīnasiddherhi niyogaḥ tasiddhayarthama- nuṣṭhātāmākṣipya anadhikāriṇaḥ anuṣṭhātṛtvātsambhavāt, aniyojyasya cā
prāgapi saṃbhavati, tathāpi adhyayanakālāniyatibhayāt paścādeva kariṣyate |
prayuktādhyāpane eva niyojyo na saṃbhavati, ācāryasya sāmānyato'pi prāgasādhanādanavagamāditi anantarameva vakṣyāmaḥ |
yadeva hi niyogaphalaṃ tadeva kāmyamānatayā niyojya- mavacchettumalaṃ tuvavimokādivat |
jñānaṃ tu viṣayabhūtā- dhyayanaphalaṃ, na niyogajanyamiti na tatkāmasya niyojyatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti cet, tarhinaiva hetunā ācāryakamapi na niyojyaviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, tasyāpi viṣayaphalatvāt |
ācāryakaṃ tu na jñātaṃ mānenānyena citt |
āhavanīyādidavalaukikamācāryakaṃ pramāṇāntareṇānava- gataṃ adhyāpanavidhāyakenaiva vacanenāgamyate, iti bhavatāṃ darśanam |
na cānavagate kāmanāma saṃbhavatīti na tatkāmasya niyojyatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
anenaiva tu vacanena jñātvā kāmyate ityāśrīyamāṇe parasparārthadoṣāpattiḥ |
vidhāvasmin pravṛtte ca tatkāmasya nirūpa- ṇam |
syādetat— adhikārādanuṣṭhānaṃ vidhyate sa tvihāpi ca |
asyapi niyojyatve taddhi sākṣāt sādha- nam |
niyogaṃ prati hi niyojyatā, nāsau sākṣādviṣayānu- ṣṭhānasādhanaṃ, kiṃtu niyojyatvena saṃbaddhyasya puruṣasya niyogaḥ kartavyo bhavati |
sa eva hi niyojyaḥ, yo niyogaṃ mamedaṃ kāryamiti budhyate |
yasya ca niyogaḥ kartavyastasya ca tatsādhane karmaṇyadhikāro bhavati, svakāryasādhanatvāt, adhikārāt‌anuṣṭhānam |
yatra cāntareṇāpi niyojyatvama- dhikāro bhavatyavagataḥ, tatra tata evānuṣṭhānasiddheḥ kiṃ niyojyatvena |
ācāryakasādhanatvenāpyanena vacanena prati- pādite tadarthenastvamarthena svadhāne anuṣṭhānasiddheḥ |
tadākṣitānuṣṭhānenaivādhyayanena labdhātmakaḥ adhyayananiyogo na niyojyaṃ parikalpayatīti |
vināpi viniyojyatvaṃ arthajñānasādhane adhyayane svā- dhikāradeva tadarthenaḥ anuṣṭhānasiddherādhyāpanaprayukta- tyānupapattiḥ |
na tāvatā paraprayuktatvamanu- ṣṭhāne saṃbhavati, svakīyādevādhikārādanuṣṭhānalābhāt |
satyāpi ca niyojye phalasādhane karmaṇi tata evānuṣṭhānaṃ, na niyogāt kāmādhikāravat |
phalaṃ cāsatapi niyojye sādhanānuṣṭhānaṃ prayoktuṃ kṣamamiti kiṃ niyojyasadbhāva- vicāreṇa |

yatra tu niyojyādhīnameva phalāvataḥ viśvajidādau, tatra bhavatu niyojyāpekṣā, atra tu anta- reṇāpi niyojyamarthajñānasādhanatvenaadhyayanamavagamyate iti tata evānuṣṭhānasiddhernadhyayanasyādhyāpanaprayuktatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
yadi niyojyābhāvātprayojakamadhyayanaviṣaye, tato'- dhyāpanavidhirapi tadabhāvātprayojakaṃ bhavati |
athā- dhikārasadvāvāt tasya prayojakatvaṃ, adhyayanavidherapi tarhi tatsadvāvāt prayojakatvaṃ yuktamityubhayorapi tulyatvāt nādhyāpanavidhiradhyayanasya saṃbhavati |
tadadevādhyayanasyāpi tenaiva prayuktiḥ saṃbha- vatīti na prayojakāntaraṃ mṛgyam |
yena hi phalainārtha- jñānenetikartavyatābhūto vicāraḥ prayujyate, prayujyate- tarāmanena karaṇabhūtamadhyayanam |

vidhiraiva vicārasyāpi prayojakaḥ, sa hi viśiṣṭaprayo- janāyadhyayanottaramadhyāpanaṃ vidadhat tasiddhayarthaṃ tādṛśa- madhyayanaṃ prayuṅkte, tādṛśālaṃ cādhyayanasya vicāramantareṇā- nupapannamiti tenaivāsau ākṣipyate iti |

yadyapi upanayanadvāreṇādhyayanaṃ prayuñjāno'dhyāpanavidhiḥ upanayanaprakramātītatvādhyāpyate'dhyayanasyetyetadavākyavihitaṃ yarthajñānārthamadhyayanaṃ, tasyaivānuṣṭhānaṃ prayuṅkte, tathāpi tatsvarūpamātramevopakārakatvāt prayuṅkte, na tvarthajñānā- nuṣṭha
labdhe tu tasmin na tadapekṣāyāṃ niyandhanamasti |
adhyayana- vidhiradhikārāvidheyaḥ tadabhāve'pi tattvātmatvāt, yasya vidheryadabhāve'pi ātmalābho bhavati sa tadvidhiraḥ, naimi- ttikavidhiriva phalavidhira; iti pratihetusadbhāvāt |
yadi cānupapattyabhāve'pi anyatra dṛṣṭamiti kṛtvā'dhikāraḥ kalpyate, tataḥ phalaparyantaṃ kāmyeṣu dṛṣṭamiti naimitti- kaniṣedhavidhivorapi tatparyantaṃ syāt, na caitadiha manyate |

atha viṣaye'tatparatve'- pi dṛṣṭādarthajñānaṃ prayojanamaṅgīkriyate, hanta atatparatve'- dhyayanasyādhyāpanatvena pratīyamānasyārthāvivakṣitatvāt, avivakṣitasya ca vicārānarhatvāt, anārbhameva śāstraṃ syāt |
athāpi kathaṃ cidvicaryate, tathāpi vidheratatpara- tvācca vaidhatvaṃ vicārasya sidhyati |
yadi dhyāyanavidhividhāyanamartha- jñānāvasānaṃ viddhyāt tatastena vicāramantareṇārthasya jñānamupakravyatvādidvāro'pyadhyāśitaḥ svavicchadaṃ snānamuka- paॅntu |
yadā tvadhyayanamātreṇaiva vidhau'nuṣṭhitaḥ, tadā na vidhistatvāddicārādanuṣṭhānamākṣipatti |
yadi paramuttarakarmā- nuṣṭhānārthe puruṣaḥ svecchayā laukikena rūpeṇārthajñānopāyepu upadeṣṭṛvacanādiṣu pravartamānaḥ kadā cidvicāramapi kuryāt, tathā sati karmānuṣṭhāne samupasthite, sati |
nanvadhyayanāṅgabhūto vicāraḥ; na cānaṅgena karaṇena vidhiḥ sidhyatīti vidhivaiva svasiddhayarthe vicāramanuṣṭhā- payatīti kathamaidhatvaṃ vicārasya |
satyamadhyāyanaṃ vicāraḥ, tathāpi na vidhisiddhāvuyujyate, arthajñānādyakāryayogā- tyān |
na ca kāryāntaropayogyāṅgaṃ kāryāntareṇa tadekakaraṇake- nāpi dṛṣṭikāmāputryeṇa saubharakaraṇakenādhyāpanāpūrvopa- yogilaubhirāṅgaṃ ūrdhvaninaṃ prayujyate |
atha vidhividhārtha- jñānādhyāyanasyāttvāt tādṛgbhigrayasaṃsparśasya vicāramākṣi- pattītyucyate, tadadhyāpanavidhividhiyuktaṃ vicāraṃ nirākurva- dvirassāmirnirākṛtam |
yadyapyarthajñānārthamayaṃ, tathāpi na tena rūpeṇa vidhisādhanatvaṃ, svarūpeṇaiva tatsādhanatvāt |
yadyapi vicāramantareṇa vidhirna sidhyati, tathāpi nāsau vicārānuṣṭhānamākṣipatti, niyojyābhāvāt |
na hyasau kena cit puruṣeṇa mameedaṃ kāryamiti pratīyate, tena na sa svātmanyapi tāvattvaṃ prerayet, kuta eva svasiddhayupāye |
yasya hi karaṇe'pi niyojyābhāvādanuṣṭhāpakatvaṃ na saṃbhavati, tasya kathamanyeṣu saṃbhavet |
syādetat adhyayanavidhivaiva adhyayanasyārthāt jñāta- marthajñānaṃ prayojanatvena svīkṛtya tasiddhayarthe vicāramākṣipa- tīti |
na tāvattra vini- yuṅkte, pramāṇāntareta eva tatsādhanatā'vagamāt, atra- ghātādividhivamvidhavanavagamya |
atha tādarthyamanumanyate ityucyate, tatra ananumatasyāpi tādarthyasya lābhāt |
yada- numatyabhāve'pi yallabhyate tattadanumanyate, iti hāsyame- tat |
labhyate cāntareṇāpi vidhiyunmati adhyayanasyārtha- jñānārthateti ko'rtho'numatya |
tasmānna kathaṃcidvicārasya vaidhatvaṃ sidhyatīti na tadvalena snānonotkarṣaḥ śakyate kartum |

adhyayanamātreṇaiva samāte vidhryai sati anantaraṃ 'vedama- dhīya snāyāt' itismṛtibalena snātvā pañcājjyatiṣṭho- mādikarmānuṣṭhāne samupasthite tannirṇayārthamupāyāntarālabhe ca vicāro'pi kadā cidagṛhīte vā na vā, iti nāthāto dharmajijñāseti sūtramānantaryapratipādanaparamupapannaṃ syāt |
' iti smṛtyupanitena upanādhyāpanenācāryaṃ bhāvayediti evaṃrūpaṃ vacanamiti, tadayuktam--

yathaiva 'etayā''nnāyakāmaṃ yājayet' iti yājyateḥ paraḥ śrayamāṇo'pi vidhiḥ yāgavidhira eva prayojaka- vyāpāraparaḥ śabdo dravyārjanārthaprāptakalpityāpārānuvāda iti sthāsyati, tathā 'adhyāpayet' ityadhyayanavidhiraḥ eva, nādhyāpanavidhiraḥ; dravyārjanopāyatvaiva prāptatvāt |
anyathā 'svaritatritaḥ' ityanenaivācāryaka- sādhane'pyarttamānātmanepadasya sidhyatīti samā- nanetisūtramanarthakaṃ syāt |
tasmādadhyetṛsaṃskāradvāreṇadhya- yanāṅgenopanayanaṃ anuṣṭhānaṃ vājinamitrābhimārthe dadhyāpanaṃ ācāryakaṃ sādhayati, na tu tadartham |
kiṃca, na nālaukikamātrārthakaṃ, upanīya vedādhyāpayiturācārya- śabdo vācakaḥ : pāṭhakāditvat |
upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣya- mityapi śabdārthapratipādanaparameva |

athāpi 'vicādānena sumartirjhalake medhīte' ityādibhirvidhyādānādhyāpanā- dadhyāpanamapi anyantaraśeṣatayā vihitaṃ bhavet, tathāpi tatra sarvatra niyojyāśravaṇādadhikāramātrasya cādhyayane'pi sadbhāvāt, vicārasyāvaidhatvamadhyāpanavidhividhiyukta- madhyayanam |
kaścina punarāha, yadyadhyayanasya svādhikāroṇa prayuktiḥ saṃbhavati, tathāpi nāsāvāśritaṃ yujyate |
tathāhi, jñānaṃ nādhyayanasya sthānaṃ svamahimnā prayojakam |
jñānasādhyāni tu agnihotrādīni tad- dvāreṇa prayojakāni bhavanti, na tu teṣāṃ jñānamapi kiṃtū- pakāramātram |
ācāryakasya tu adhyāpanamyameva ata- stvāt svāṅgadvāreṇāpi prayojakaṃ labhate, agnihotrādīni tūpakāradvāreṇa |
na ca nāmikāvadaṅgadvāreṇāpi prayojakatva- lābhe sati upakārakadvāreṇa vājinavat prayojakatvaṃ yukta- maṅgīkartuṃ, tasmādadhyāpanavidhividhiyuktamadhyayanamiti |

yadyapi na karmāṅgaṃ jñānaṃ, adhyayanaṃ tu jñānāṅgameva, tena prayujyamānamadhyayanaṃ śeṣavidhiyuktameva bhavati, na vadhya- yanamaṅgaṃ, atastena prayukkamadhyayanaṃ upakāryāmātraprayuktaṃ syāt, na śeṣavidhiyuktam |
tena śeṣavidhiyuktatve saṃbhavati upakārya- mātrāprayuktatvamukkamiti sūtrādhikāramyukamadhyayanaṃ nādhyāpanaprayuktam |
yadyapi jñānaṃ svarūpeṇāpuruṣārthaḥ, tathāpi karmānuṣṭhānopayikatvāt puruṣārthatve eveti puruṣārtha- tvādhyayanasya prayojakatvaṃ saṃbhavatyācāryakavat |
tadapi hi svarūpeṇānabhilaṣitaṃ dakṣiṇālābhasiddhayarthameva puruṣeṇā- rthyate |
ato yathā tasya prayojakatvaṃ, evaṃ jñānasyāpi |
sulabhasvarūpeṇārthāthaṃ prayojakamimi niyamaḥ : samaṣṭi, sulabhajñānapaśutvādivāt phalāntarasādhanatayā arthitasya prayojakatvāvirodhāt |
yadyapi cāmihotrādyapūrvameva jñāna- dvāreṇa prayojakaṃ, tathāpi tadeva yuktaṃ nādhyāpanaṃ, puruṣā- ntaragāmitvāt |
adhyetṛgamye tu jñānaṃ vā tatsādhanaṃ vā agnihotrādi prayojakaṃmadhyayanasya yuktam |
yo'pi aṅga- dvāreṇādhyāpanavidheḥ prayojakatvamupakārakadvāreṇāgnihotrā- dīnāmiti viśeṣo'bhihitaḥ ṣoḍaśapi nāsti |
yadyucyate ācārya eva svakāryasiddhayarthamadhyayane māgavatkaṃ svādhikārapradarśanaina pravartayatīti |
satyamevaṃ, kiṃtu tathā sati svādhikāraḥ eva tatra prayojakaḥ svādhyā- yādhyanavidhiḥ sthatito'taiva svādhikāraḥ |
sā hyanabhija- nāpādādhikārāpi dravyārjanapravṛtteḥ ṛtvigbhiradhikāra- pradarśanaina nipādenānuṣṭhāpyamānā svādhikāraprayukta, na dravyārjanaprayaktā tathā adhyayanamapi |
bhavatu vā adhyāpayitrā savi svādhikāradarśanenā'pi māṇavakānuṣṭhāpyamānasya adhyāpanaprayuktatvam |
nahi tatra māṇavakasya kaścidadhi- kāro'sti, yadyadhyayanenāsau adhyāpyeta, ācāryakasiddha- māprayojanatvādanyasya pūrvapakṣe |
nanu niyogasiddhayā pūrvapakṣe'pyadhikāraḥ saṃbhavati, na, akāryatvāt |

athāsyapi svādhi- kāre sāmādinogāyāntareṇa kathaṃ cidadhyāpyeta, tathā sati viśvajidādīnāmapi kathaṃ cidadhyāpye pravṛttaireva ṛtvigbhiḥ pravartamānena yajamānenānuṣṭhānasaṃbhavāt nānuṣṭhasiddhaye adhikārasiddhayarthe niyogyaparikalpanaṃ śakyate |
athānarthakyārthalijo yajamānamāhayanti nakṣa- sāvanadhikārī tebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadātīti, tadatrāpi samā- nam |
nahyadhyayane'dhikriyamāṇo māṇavako dakṣiṇādānādi ācāryasyāntarati (iti na) tannisyā ācāryasyārtha- kamiṣṭam |
na ca pūrvapakṣe adhyayanaṃ māṇavakasyeti nādhyayanena prayu- ktiḥ saṃbhavati |
na cādhyayanasya pūrvapakṣe puruṣārthatā'stīti, na brahmalokaprāptiphalavidyādānavidhivādādapi tasya prayuktiḥ saṃbhavati |
yā''pi kimadhyayanasyācārya- kamarthajñānaṃ vā prayojanamiti cintā, sā'pyuktā |
kimimaṃ vidhigamyasya prayojanasya cintā, kiṃ vā pramā- ṇāntaragamyasya ? na tāvat pramāṇāntaragamyamātraṃ śāstre cintanīyam |
tenāprakaraṇadhītvātprāgupārjitajñānārthatayā'dhyayanavidhānaṃ yena kṛtyartha syāt, kiṃ tvadhyayanāpādita jñānaṃ kṛtvartha iti |
kathamidānīmarthakānāṃ huṃphaḍādīnāmadhyayanamarthatāyai, kathaṃ ca kṣatriyādhikāraśramedhādipratipādakasya vedabhāgasya brāhmaṇādibhiradhyayanārthamadhyayanam |
yadyapi kathaṃ cid brāhmaṇasya yājanayogijñānārthamadhyayanaṃ saṃbhāvyeta, tathāpi kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ vaiśyastaumāśvamedhādhyayanamarthakamevādyartha vā |
kathaṃ ca niṣedhavākyeṣu 'nānugreha nanathyā' ityādiṣu niyamārthanam |
śakyate kartuṃ tasmai epa samākhyāyate, śakyate cānena padārtho'bhidhātuṃ, śakyate ca kriyākāle pratipattum |
tasmā- dedaḥ padārthāḥ śātumupādeyāḥ kriyākāle ca pratipattum |
na ca gamyate viśeṣo vidhātumaya samākhyāyate na prati- pattumasti |
tatra pratipattuṃ cānena krameṇa śakyate nānyena, iti |
(bahuḥ pāṭhabhedo'tra ) yatra tu mantro vidhyate, tatra tasyānyārthatvāt |
vidhāyakasya tu vidhānenāpi kṛtārtha- tvāmantrasyaiva sārakatvam |
ata eva tatra mantrakrameṇaiva padārthānuṣṭhānaṃ na vidhikameṇa, tatra brāhmaṇakramo japayasā- dāvupayujyate, tathā phalavatpratipādākanāmapi phalavatprati- vistārena |
na cāyaṃ niyamo yata kṛtyatve'va niyamavidhiriti, puruṣārthavepi jñānādīnādipu niyamavidhyabhyupagamāt |
phalata eva tu pūrvoktanītyā nyāyavido vadanti |
tathā cānadhītavedasyevādhikāraḥ kṣudravadāva smaranti 'yo'nadhītya dvijo vedānanya kurute śramam |
tasmādarthajñānā- rthatvādadhyayanasya, tasya ca vicāramantareṇāsaṃbhavāttadanantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā kartavyeti siddham |
tata- stasya vicāramantareṇāsaṃbhavāt adhyayanavidhinaiva arthā- dvicāro vihitaḥ, iti gurugṛhe evāvasthāya vicārayitavyo dharmaḥ |
tadanupapatteradhyayanavidhiva vicāramākṣipan tadviruddhaṃ smātaṃ jñānaṃ bādhate iti siddhamadhyayanānantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā kartavyeti |
utpādyatvaṃ āpyatvaṃ saṃskāryaṃ vā vā karmatvaṃ yathā 'ghaṭaṃ karoti', 'grāmaṃ gacchati' 'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti |
adhyayanaṃ ca bhāvārthādhikaraṇa- nyāyena ( 2|1|1 varṇakaṃ 2 ) bhāvanāyāṃ karaṇatvena anveti |
svādhyāyasya ca tena utpādyatvasaṃbhavāt āpyatvaṃ saṃskāryaṃ vā karmatvaṃ bhavati |
tataśca 'adhyayanena svādhyāyaṃ prāpnuyāt' iti vacanavyaktiḥ, 'adhyayanena svādhyāyaṃ saṃskuryāt' iti vā |

tatra adhyayanena avāsya saṃskṛtasya vā svādhyāyasya svataḥ apuśārtha- tvāt phalakāṅkṣāyāṃ abhītavedajanyadharmāvabodhasya svargādisādhanatayā phalatvāt, sati ca saṃbhave adṛṣṭa- kalpanā'yogāt tameva prayojanavadarthāvabodhaparatāmaneyaṃ adhītasvādhyāyasyaḥ phalatvena gṛhṇāti, anārthādhyatasyāpi adhyayanasya sāmarthyādeva ṛtuvidyākṣitārthasāne upayoga- saṃbhavāt |
tataśca, 'adhītena svādhyāyena arthāvabodhaṃ bhāvayet' iti paryavasyo'rthaḥ |

tatra arthavādānāṃ vācya- vidhayā dharmapramitijananasaktyabhāve'pi kṛtsnasya vedasya prayojanavadarthāvabodhaparyavasānaṃ adhyayanavidhinaiva vidhyapekṣitaprāśastyāpayauryanamukhena utthāpitalakṣya- vidhayā tvatyatipādanadvārā vidhyupayogāt dharmaprāmāṇyamupa- padyate iti vārtikādigrantheṣu sthitam |
arthāva- bodhastu gṛhītapadārthasaṃgatikasya svata eva bhavati, na tu tatra adhyayanavidhervyāpāraḥ, dharmāvabodhastvanye- nākātsyeprasaṅgāt |
kiṃca agnihotrādilakṣaṇa- vedārthasya adhyayanāt prāk saṃdhyopāsanavat pitrādyupadeśato jñāne sati jñātatvādeva tadavabodhasya kāmyatvābhāvāt phalatvānupapattiḥ |
tataḥ prāk tajjñāne tu na sa kāmayituṃ śakyaḥ |
pitrādyupadeśato viśi- ṣyāvagate'pi aupadeśikajñānasya prāmāṇyasya punartho- dhakāmanayā ca yuktā iti cenna |
agnihotrādiviśeṣajñānānāṃ hi na tāvat ekabuddhyā viśeṣākāreṇa uddeśaḥ, anantatvāt |
sāmānyākāreṇa uddeśe ca sāmānyajñānameva vidhiphalaṃ syāt, na tu viśeṣajñānam |
ataḥ arthāvabodhasya uddeśatvā- yogāt na phalatvam |
na ca adhyayanavidheḥ arthāvabodhānta- tvābhāve vedasya kathaṃ svārthe tātparyayogamḥ iti vācyam |
evaṃ ca vyāka- raṇamahābhāṣye paspaśāhnike 'brāhmaṇena niṣkāraṇo vedaḥ paḍaṅgo'dhyetavyo jñeyaśca' ityādāvapi śrutau 'jñeyaśca' iti pṛthak jñānavidhiḥ arthavān bhavati |
niṣkāraṇaḥ- kāryate anena iti kāraṇaṃ phalam |
dṛṣṭaprayojananirapekṣaḥ śikṣā- vyākaraṇādipadagrahasahito vedaḥ adhyayanena grāhyaḥ tadarthaśca pratipattavyaḥ |
so'yaṃ dharmo na dṛṣṭaphalaḥ, nitya iti yāvat |
tadabhāve hi pratyavāyaḥ smaryate 'sthāṇurya bhāra- hāraḥ kilābhūdadhītya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham' ityādiḥ |
na ca gṛhītapadārthasaṃgatikasya svata eva jñānasaṃbhavāt tadvidhivyartha iti vācyam |
nahi adhyayanaṃ gṛhītapadārthasaṃgatikena bhāvyaṃ iti lokto labhyaṃ, acyutapraṇāmapi bahulamupalabhyāt, padapadārtha- saṃgatigrahaṇāmātasave'pi atigahanavedārthasya nyāya- vicāramantarā anupapatteḥ |
ataḥ padapadārthasaṃgati- madhigamya nyāyavicārato yathāvat vedārthajñānaṃ nitya- tathā vidhīyate |
tadapi svasvapidhādikramāgataveda- bhāgalāmātrasya, netarasya vedabhāgasya, svādhyāyavidhau svapadārthakyāpātāt |
tathā ca svādhyāyā adhyayanaṃ artha- jñānaṃ ca nityam |
itarājñānāṃ tu adhyayanaṃ arthajñānaṃ ca ṛtuvidhiprayuktaṃ ārthikameva, na ca tatra svādhyāyavidhe- rvyāpāraḥ |
puruṣa- paraṃ pratyavekṣyati iti tṛtīye 'jñāte ca vācanaṃ nahya- vidvān vihito'sti ' (3|8|18 sū.) ityatra bhāṣya- vārttikayoḥ spaṣṭam |
