na ca svādhyāyavidhitastacchabdā- nusāreṇa 'vedo'dhyeyaḥ ' itivedaśabdasya svādhyāyāmātra- tve'pi 'jñeyaḥ ' ityaṃśe vedaśabdasya tathā saṃkoce mānā- bhāva iti vācyam |
adhyeyaḥ iyam anvitasyaiva veda- śabdasya svādhyāyāmātraparatayā niścitasya 'jñeyaḥ ' itya- trāpi anvayavaśādeva tathā saṃkocalābhāt |

uktaṃ ca bhavatsvābhiprāye 'brāhmaṇānāṃ bahutvāt, ekaikasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ aparisamāptatvāt, arthasya ca durgrahītatvāt asarvajanīnatvāt, saṃdṛṣṭavivaraṇārthaṃ sūtraṃ yuddhyā karmaṇyupajñāya phalāni sarve prāpnuyuḥ iti kalpa ārabhya ācāryeṇa ' iti |

kiṃcaivaṃ 'yo ha vā aviditārṣeyacchandodaivatabrāhmaṇena mantreṇa yājayati vā'dhyāpayati vā, sthāṇuṃ varcchati gate vā patye pāpīyān bhavati, pra vā mīyate, yātāyāmyanyasya cchandāṃsi bhavanti, tasmādetāni mantremantre vidyāt ' iti tāṇḍakatalavakārādirāṣṭrāsu mantrapratipādya- devatānāṃ viniyojakabrāhmaṇānāṃ ca smaraṇavidhānaṃ kastva- vedārthajñānasya āvaśyakatve anarthakaṃ syāt |
mantreṣu deva- tāvagamastu kātyāyanādipraṇītamardhānukramaṇikādi- granthato vedārthajñānābhāve'pi sulabha eva |
viniyojaka- brāhmaṇavākyajñānaṃ ca kalpasūtrataḥ sulabhameva, nānādhāvāgata- viniyojakabrāhmaṇavākyasaṃgrahātmakatvāt kalpasūtrāṇām |

'evaṃvidemevādhvaryuṃ kurvīta nānevaṃvidaṃ ', 'evaṃvidemeva hotārṃ kurvīta nānevaṃvidaṃ ', 'evaṃvidemevadgātārṃ kurvīta nānevaṃvidaṃ ', 'evaṃvidemevabrahmāṇaṃ kurvīta nānevaṃvidaṃ ' ityādi vājamaneyakādiśākhāgatāni lugādānādi- brāhmaṇatadarthavidābheva adhyayaurviparaṇāni ca kastva- vedārthajñānasya anāvaśyakatāṃ gamayanti |
ata eva ca kalpasūtreṣu svādhyāyopasaṃhārasya pravṛtteṣu kastvavedārthajñāna- karmādhikāriṇopagatayā nopanibaddham |

kiṃca brahma- mīmāṃsāyāṃ tṛtīyacaturthādhikaraṇe ' śeṣatvāt puruṣārthe- vādo yathā'yeṣyite jaiminiḥ ' iti sūtreṇa (3|4| 1|2) ātmajñānaṃ karmaśeṣabhūtakartṛdvārā parvatāditavat karmāṅgaṃ, 'tarati śokamātmavit ' iti phalaśrutistu apāpaślokaśravaṇādivat arthavādaḥ iti jaiminimate pūrva- pakṣatayā udbhāvya ' taddhato vidhānāt ' (3|4|16 brasū.) iti sūtrāntareṇa 'ācāryakuladamedamadhītya ' iti śrutvā sakalavedārthajñānavataḥ karmavidhānādapi liṅgāt karmāṅgaṃ ātmavidyā iti svayaṃ yuktyantaramudrāya ' adhi- kopadeśāttat bādarāyaṇasyaiva taddarśanāt ' (3|4|18 brasū.) iti siddhāntamupasthāya ' adhyayanamātravataḥ ' iti sūtreṇa (3|4|19 brasū.) 'ācāryakuladamedamadhītya ' iti vākye vedārthajñānamātrataḥ karma vidhīyate na tada- rthajñānataḥ, yena kastvavedārthajñānavataḥ karmavidhānāt aupaniṣadamātmajñānasya karmaśeṣatā syāt |
ṛtuvidhiprayu- kāryajñānaṃ tu ārthikatvāt na karmāṅgaṃ brīhādividhau karma- ṇādivat |
evaṃ ca ṛtuvidhibhiḥ yāvadupaśrutavedabhāgamā- tārthajñānasya apekṣānāt tadviruddhaniyamajñānasya karma- śeṣatā yujyate ityāsīt bhagavatā bādarāyaṇena |
tadetat bhāṣye bhagavatpādaiḥ tadvyākhyātṛbhiśvācaspatiprabhṛtibhiḥ bahudhā prapañcitaṃ iti neha tanyate |

kiṃca ' na prathama- yaśe pravṛtyāt, pravṛttyā''dyā ' ityupakramya 'yo'nūcānaḥ śrotriyaḥ tasya pravṛtyāt ' iti āpastamba-satyāṣāḍha- bhāradvājādyudāhṛtabahvṛcabrāhmaṇe ' ekāṃ śāgvāmadhītya śrotriyo bhavati ' itilakṣitaśrotriyasya, ' sāṅgā- dhyāyī anūcānaḥ ' itilakṣitasyānasya ca prathamayaśe pravargyaniyamavidhānāt atathāvidhasya prathamayaśe pravargyā- niyamavidhau paryavasānāvāgamastvavedārthajñānasya karma- śeṣatā dūrāpāstā |
ṛtuvidhivastu yāvadupaśrutavedatadarthāva- gamamātreṇāpi kṛtārthāḥ kastvavedatadarthādhīme tāvat naiva vyāpriyante |
evaṃ ca arthavādaviṣaye svādhyāyavidhitaḥ phaladarthaparyavasānālābhāt teṣāṃ vidhyuddeśākāṅkṣānuthā-
nāt vidhyarthavādānāṃ parasparākāṅkṣatvāt ekavākyatvaṃ iti siddhānto vārttikakārāyuktaḥ anupapannaḥ |
arthavādānāṃ stutiparatayā vidhyaikavākyatā tu anya- tarākāṅkṣayaiva upapādyā |

yathā ' raktaḥ paṭo bhavati ' iti vākye ' paṭo bhavati ' ityetāvati nirā- kāṅkṣe'pi 'raktaḥ ' ityasya bhaktikriyā'nvayaṃ vinā anartha- kyāpatyā saṃnidhipāṭavaiyarthyāpattyā ca paṭavākyasya raktapade ākāṅkṣotthitau paṭaviśeṣaṇasamarpakatayā raktapadaṃ paṭa- vākyāntarbhāvamāpadyate, tathā arthavādānāṃ svārthato nirā- kāṅkṣatve'pi vidhipratyayagamyāyāḥ śabdabhāvanāyāḥ aṃśa- prathamapekṣamāṇāyāḥ vidhivyatyaya eva bhāvyāṃśaṃ puruṣa- pravṛttiṃ, karaṇāṃśaṃ śaktigrahādikaṃ ca vyākaraṇādito labdha- valyāḥ, tṛtīyāṃśaṃ stutiṃ apekṣamāṇāyāḥ stutilābhamantarā anupapattyā vidhyuddeśasaṃnidhyāmanāt vaiyarthyāpattyā ca artha- vādānāṃ vidhyadeśākāṅkṣā uttiṣṭhati |
tadvācya lakṣaṇayā teṣāṃ stutiparatvaṃ iti bhāṣyānuyāyī sugamaḥ panthāḥ |

kiṃca ' aupadhe yiva śimā te vardhiṣyate ' ityādi- laukikavākyeṣviva ' sa āmanto vayāmudakivadat ' ' gāvo vā etat satramāsata ' ityādyarthavādavākyeṣvapi asadavattvāvalambanena kevalavidheṣustutiparatvaṃ, na tu svārthaparatvamapi, tathā sati aprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt |
tathā ca 'tatsā- mānyāditareṣu tathātvaṃ ' iti nyāyena (1|2|123) tadita- reṣāmapi 'vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā ' ityādyarthavādānāṃ na svārthapara- tvam |
kiṃtu jahatsvārthalakṣaṇayā kevalavidheyastutiparatvaṃ iti pracchannabauddhāḥ ke cit mīmāṃsakamanyāḥ |
vaidikadhiromaṇayo vārttikakṛtastu sarveṣvapi arthavādavākyeṣu avayavārthāntikameṇaiva ajahatsvārtha- lakṣaṇāyā prāptasyaparam (pratipādayanti) |
'sa ātmano vapāṃ ' ityādi sargādau parameśvara eva svamahimnā paśuṃrūpa anyadekaṃ svīkṛtya tadapoktatvena karma prāpnuyukta ityevaṃ prakāreṇa sarvatra svārthe satyatā utpreyā |
' ātmā vā idameka evāgra āsīt ' ' parāsya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca ' ityādyarthavāda- vākyaiḥ acintyaśaktiparameśvarakartṛkasṛṣṭimalyaṅgī- kārāt |
' ādityo yūpaḥ ' ityādāvapi ūrdhvatvādiguṇayo- gāt svārthaparatā'pi |
tathā ca ' virodhe guṇavādaḥ syādanu- vādo'vadhārite |

yuktaṃ caitat ' guṇavādastu ' ' rūpāt prāyāt ' 'dūrabhūmyatvāt ' ' rūpaprāyāt ' kartṛśca putradarśanāt ' 'ākālikepsā ' ityādibhiḥ arthavādādhikaraṇaguṇasūtraiḥ 'stainaṃ manaḥ ' ityādiṣu gauṇyā vṛttyā avayavārthaparatvasyāpi pradarśanāt |
tatra ' agre gṛhapate sugṛhapateḥ ' ityādimantreṣu ' śataṃ himāḥ ' ityādyaṃśānāṃ ' śataṃ te hemantānihapiyati iti vāvaitadāha ' ityādivākyaśeṣāḥ mantrāṇāṃ vivakṣitārthatve liṅgaṃ iti vyavasthāpanāt |

tatra yavavarāhatetaśabdānāṃ krameṇa priyaṅguyavajambupu dīrghaśūkasūkaravajuleṣu ca loke prayujyamānānāmapi vede 'yavamayaścarurabhavati ', 'vārāhī upānahau ' upamuñjate ' ' vaitase kaṭe prājāpatyān saṃcinoti ' ityatra ' yatrānyā opa- dhayo mlāyante'thaite modamānā iyocchinti ' ' varāhaṃ gāvo'nudhāvanti ', ' apsujo vetarāḥ ' iti vākyaśeṣaiḥ dīrghaśūkasūkaravajulaparatvavyavasthāpanāt |
tatra aśvavālaśabdasya ' yaśo vai devebhyo'śvo bhūvā'pā- kāmat, so'paḥ prāviśat, sa vāladhī gṛhītaḥ, sa bālān muktvā viveśa, te bālāḥ kāśā abhavan ' iti vākyaśeṣeṇa kāśaparatvāvyavasthāpanāt |

tatra ' yadājimayaḥ tadājyānāmājyatvaṃ ' ityādyaśabdanirbacanena ' āpo vā ṛtviyamāīn tāsāṃ vāyuḥ pṛṣṭhe dhyavartata ' ityatra- yuktanāmāpa vāyusahāt rathaṃtarādīnāmutpattipādanena spardhajanyaṃ putraṃ iti nirvacanena ca ājyapṛṣṭhadadhyo- rnāmadheyatvavyavasthāpanāt |
tatra ' yathā ha vai dyenau nipatyādave evamayaṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ nipatyādave ' iti vākyaśeṣasiddhāṃ gauṇīṃ vṛttimāśritya nāmadheyatva-
kiṃca nāmadheyapāde 'vaiśvadeve vikalpa iti cet' ( 1|4|10|13-16 ) ityadhikaraṇavirodhaḥ |
tatra 'yadviśvedevāḥ samayajanta tadvaiśvadevaṃ' iti nirvacanamātreṇa vaiśvadevaśabdasya nāmadheyatva- vyavasthāpanāt |
tatra 'yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ' iti yajamānaśabdasya krunirvartakatvaguṇayogāt gauṇyā vṛttyā prastare vṛttervyavasthāpanāt |

tatra 'agnirvai brāhmaṇaḥ' ityagni- śabdasya 'sa muvatastrivṛtaṃ niramimīta, tamagnirdaivata- nsvasṛjata, gāyatrī chando, rathaṃtaraṃ sāma, brāhmaṇo manuṣyāṇāṃ, ajaḥ paśūnām' iti muvajātatvaguṇayogāt gauṇyā vṛttyā brāhmaṇa vṛttervyavasthāpanāt |
tatra 'yajamāno yūpaḥ' iti yajamānaśabdasya ūrdhvatvaguṇayogāt gauṇyā vṛttyā yūpe vṛttervyavasthāpanāt |
tatra 'apaśavo vā anye goaśvebhyaḥ paśavo goaśvāḥ' iti apaśu- śabdasya aprāśastyaguṇayogāt gauṇyā vṛttyā ajādipaśuṣu vṛttervyavasthāpanāt |
'svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' ityatra adhyayanakaraṇabhāvanāyāṃ arthajñānaṃ bhāvyaṃ karmānānuṣṭhāpyatvena puruṣārthatvāt |
vyākaraṇādīnāṃ vedārthajñāno- payogitvāt, svargārthatve vā tadanupayogāt |
vedādhyayanaṃ ijjanakatayārthaṃ arthavadapi yakavihitādhyayanatvāt aṅgā- dhyayanavat ityanumānāt |
na ca arthajñānasya bhāvyatve anadhyāyādinānāṃ svarūpakāryayoḥ anupayogāt adhyayanajñānānupapattiḥ, kāryopa- yogābhāve'pi vinnanirākaraṇārthatvena svarūpopayogitvāt, niyamāpūrve upayogaḥ |
'īpsitakarmatve'pi svādhyāyakramabhāvanāviśiṣṭakaraṇabhāvanāvidhitvena eta- sya viṣaye arthajñānabhāvyatvaṃ' iti kaścit |
svatvaṃ ca paraṃparā adhyayanaviṣayatvaṃ, anuṣṭhānaviṣayatvaṃ ca |
tatra itikartavyatāpekṣāyāṃ yogyatāyā vicāraḥ itikartavyatātvena saṃbadhyate iti vicārakartavyatāsiddhiḥ |
evaṃ ca 'syāṇurayaṃ bhārahāraḥ kilābhūdadhītya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham |
yo'rthajña it sakalaṃ bhadramaśnute nākameti jñānavidyutāpā ||
' ( nirukte 1|18 ) ityarthābhijña- tadanabhinnanindāstutī upapadyate iti vārtikodayaḥ |
pitṛcaraṇāstu prokṣaṇādivadhau apūrvasādhanatvena vrīhīṇāmapi prayojanavadarthajñānajanakatvena svādhyā- yasyaiva bhāvyātvam |
vedārthajñānasya dravyaprāptipraupayika- tvavat karmānuṣṭhānāpayikatvaṃ iti lokasiddhaṃ puruṣārthatvaṃ dravyarjanavat |

nanu adhyayananiyamasya niṣedhepu nopayogaḥ : adhyayanenaiva vidhyarthaṃ jānan vidheyānuṣṭhānena phalamāpnuyāt itivat, adhyayanenaiva niṣedhārthaṃ jānan niṣedhānuṣṭhānena pratyavāyāt iti kalpanāyāṃ niṣedhādhyayane pravṛttayogāt iti cet, na |
tatra asatyā adhyayanenaiva niṣedhārthaṃ ajānan pratyavāyāt iti kalpanāt |
'yadeva vidyayā karoti' iti vākyaṃ tu arthajñānasya nājñātā- bodhakaṃ, kiṃtu śraddhopanivajjanyajñānārthavādaḥ, astu vā
san ajñatādyotakaḥ śrīvidhividhivat, tathāpi na kalpyavārthajñānajanakatvenaiva uddeśyatā, yena adhyayanasya ajñatā syāt, syācca prakaraṇāpekṣā |
svādhyāyasyoddeśyatve'dava tadattaikatvāvivakṣayā 'vedānadhītya' ityādismṛteḥ etanmūlakatve na tanmūlaśrutyantarakalpanāgauravam |
tena arjanavidhivat arthajñānajanakatvenaiva uddeśyatā iti arthajñānaphalakavidhiḥ vicārakartavyatā''kṣepaka ityāhuḥ |
tena arthajñānaparyantaṃ gurukulavāso vicārakaraṇaṃ ca adhyayanavidheḥ phalaṃ, atvadhikāraniyamārtham |
tathāhi 'vasante brāhmaṇamupanīyata, grīṣme rājanyaṃ, śaradi vaiśyaṃ' ityādivākyaiḥ brāhmaṇādyadhyayanaṃ vidhīyate |
'aṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayīta' ityādivākyeṣu brāhmaṇoddeśena adhyayanapalādividhiḥ tatsaṃnidhipatitaśca adhyayanavidhiḥ kartṛsāpekṣaḥ |

kāryamapekṣān upanītāneva kartṛn gṛhṇāti, iti adhyayanavidhiprayuktādhyayananyarthajñāne traivarṇikānāmeva siddhe ṛtuvidhayo'pi arthajñā- nogāyākṣepakatvābhāvalakṣaṇavatsahakṛtāḥ brāhmaṇādiparāḥ eva bhavanti, iti śabdādeḥ upanītakartṛkādhyayanajanyajñāna- rūpāṅgasaṃpādanāsambhave'sya adhikāraḥ |
'tamadhyāpayīta' iti saṃnidhisiddhopanītakartṛkatvānuvādaḥ, yadvā upanayanādhyā- panavākyayoḥ prayojakavyāpāraviṣayatvā upagamanādhyayana- vidhiḥ, 'aṣṭavarṣo brāhmaṇa upagacchet so'dhīyīta' iti |
ata ūrdhvaṃ patantyete' itivākyena 'anadhīyānā brātyā bhavanti' iti niṣedhena ca nityatvasiddhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 394. adhyayanadinaniyame śraute ujnītasyādhikāro nānupanitasya |
vi. 6|1|6. adhyayananādyanayoḥ niśrātatraivārṇikakartṛtvāt tadadhīna- siddhīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ arthamātrasaṃśravatvagame'pi sati apa- śūdraviṣayatvamevāvatiṣṭhate ( tathā ca śūdrādhikāro nāsti ) |
1|3 pṛ. 579. adhyayananānantaraṃ mīmāṃsā kartavyā na vā iti saṃśaye dharmajñānāya kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhā. 12|4|143. adhyā- pane ṛṇārthe 'parvaṇi nādhyeyaṃ' iti niṣedhaḥ |
vi. 12|17, adhyāpanavidhiprayuktena adhyayanena prayuktaṃ dharmavicāra- śāstraṃ iti prābhākarāḥ |
ūho, bādhaśca, tantraṃ ca prasaṅgoditāḥ kramāt ||
' vi. prastāvanāyāṃ ślo. 11-12. adhyāyādisaṃbandho hi arthadvāraḥ,, na granthasvarūpaḥ |
vivekināṃ buddhi ātmani avatārayituṃ viśeṣaṇaviśedhyādiprapañcakalpanā yathāpratīti sattāmādāya kriyate adhyāropāpavādāyena |
upadeśasāhasrī pañca. rāmatīrthe : 18|199. adhyā- ropāpādābhyāṃ niṣpannaṃ prapañcitam |
nanu brahmaṇo nirvi- śeṣatvāt ānandapradāyakalatvaṃ anupapannaṃ, adhyāropā |
prapa- ñcita iti pūrvārdhoktanyāyenamanusṛtya prapañcasya vyavahāra- mātratvavyāptiākārat iti cet |
yathā-asarpabhūtāyāṃ rajj sarparopaḥ, ajatvabhūtāyāṃ śuktau rajataropavedāntinaḥ |
apavādo nāma rajjuvivartasya sarpasya rajjumātratvavastviva- taiyāvastuno'jñānādeḥ prapañcasya vastumātratvamiti |
tābhyā- madhyāropāpādābhyāṃ niṣpannaṃ saccidānandānantādvaita brahma prapañcyate, vistāryate iti bhāvaḥ |
manastu- jānīye nīlakaṇṭha: 2136. śivatvapratipannaṃ bhedaḥ, tato nadīsamudravat jīvabrahmaṇorbhede na virodhaḥ |
adhyāropā- papadyate iti nyāyātikrameṇa jñānotpattibhāvena mukhya- bhāvaprasaṅgāt |

'viśvajitā yajeta' ityatra svargakāma: iti vā svargārthamiti vā, 'saurye caruṃ nirva- pet brahmavarcasakāmaḥ' ityādau prākṛtāgnyādhānādīti- kartavyatāvācakasya āgneyatva iti padasya, 'pratitiṣṭhanti ha vā etā rātrīrupayanti' 'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' ityādau vidhipadasya, sauryādivikṛtau ātideśikamantre arthalopena nivṛttāgnipadasya ca adhyāhārāt iti vyākhyātam |
maṇa. pṛ. 71. adhyāhāra: 'saṃ te prāṇe vātena' ityādau ekavākya- tvārthe, na tu anupaṅgaḥ, vyavetattvāt |
' tatra adhyāhārodāharaṇaṃ yathā 'viśva- jitā yajeta' iti |
vā. 2|1|15 47 pṛ. 450. bhavati ca adhyāhāre'pi kalpanā |
yathā dvāraṃdāraṃ ityukte saṃtriyatāṃ apāvriyatāṃ iti vā |
adhyāhāre hi aśrutaḥ śabdaḥ kalpyate, itaratra śrutena saṃbandhaḥ |
bhā. 7|4|210. parityāgāt varaṃ adhyā- hārya pūraṇam |
adhyāhārādapi svapadavṛttireva vyavahita- kalpanā laghīyasī, dharmamātratvāt |

bāla. pṛ. 3. adhyāhāranyāyaḥ 'anuṣaṅgādhikaraṇa' iti cindau draṣṭavyaḥ |
maṇa. pṛ. 110. adhyāhārodāharaṇaṃ sūtre 'śeṣabhājāṃ bhavetlopa ityadhyāhārakalpanā' |

ślokā. 1|2|154. atra nyāyyaratnākaraḥ- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pradhānārthasya avadānasya nādyadoṣāpahārastu satsu śeṣapadavadānpūrvapakṣikṛtya havirantarālodāne siddhānte śeṣakāryārthe gṛhītatvādā- nasya nāśādau sati kiṃ kartavyamityapekṣāyāṃ sūtraṃ 'apivā śeṣabhājāṃ syāt' ( 6|4|3 sū. ) iti |
atra kiṃ saṃśrayatve, tattadyuktaṃ, nahi pratipattirdvayaṃ prayukte |
atha tad-vyāvṛttisamarthāt apivāśabdāt tatratyapūrvapakṣokteḥ śeṣāvadānaṃ saṃśrayet, tadapyuktam |
eṣa asyā daśāyāṃ yujyate iti lopapadādhyāhāraḥ kalpayiṣyate |
na śakyaṃ paripūrṇe vākye adhyā- hartum |
agnī- pomīye paśau śeṣabhakṣe adhyūnī śiścarūpaḥ eva hotṛ- adhyūnī tu 335 adhyūnīnyāyaḥ syāt na saṃśayaḥ |
adhyūnī iḍābhakṣavikāraḥ syāt itarasya iḍābhakṣasya vikāraḥ bādhaḥ syāt |
yathā anijyā- śeṣaiḥ cimiraiḥ : ijyāśeṣāṇi aṅgāni bādhyante tadat |
adhyūnī nāma śiścarūpo bhāga iti ke cit |
yadyapi puṃsapaśoḥ ūdhasaḥ stanasyāpi cābhāvaḥ tathāpi tatsthānīye māṃsa- piṇḍe tātparyam |
sā śeṣe samavaiti 'anasthibhirāḍāṃ vardha- yanti' iti tasyā iḍāṃ haraṇaṃ prāptam |
tasmāt hotṛ- bhoge tasyā niyamaḥ syāt hotre eva haranti nānyasmai, hotre anyaṃ bhakṣaṃ tu kurvantyeva iti |
yathā, 'yadyuyuṃktaṃ rathamadhyeva dadāti' iti rathasya adhvaryubhāge niyamaḥ tadvat |
evaṃ na syāt adhyūnyāḥ hotṛbhāge niyamo na syāt |
adhyūnī iḍāyāmprāptā 'atha yattu pariśiṣyate tatsamavacanāntāmānayati, yad hṛdaya prāsyati, jihvāṃ, vakṣaḥ, stanaṃ, vaniṃ' ityatra adhyūnyāḥ kīrtanābhāvāt |
tasmāt sā hotṛharaṇamudiśya vidhīyate adhyūnīmeva hotre haranti nānyat iti |
adhyūnī na iḍābhakṣavikāraḥ kiṃtu tasyāḥ hotre dānamātraṃ syāt |
bhakṣaśabdena bhakṣaṇaṃ tasyāḥ abhi- saṃyogasya saṃśravasya abhāvāt |
sā hi apūrvā vidhīyate na bhakṣārthā |
tasmānna bhakṣavikāraḥ; nāpi niyamaḥ iti tataścaśaṅkā |
yajamānena ādāveva agnīpo- mābhyāṃ paśau saṃkalpitaḥ |
tattatha śeṣaṃ prati yajamānasya hotrā aviśiṣṭatvam |
yathā hotā na prabhuḥ tathā yajamā- no'pi |
śeṣaṃ prati avi- śipratvāt dātuḥ avidyamānatvaṃ, tasmāt adhyūnī hotṛ- iḍābhakṣavikāraḥ syāt |
hotre adhyūnī eva, nānyat iḍāgataṃ kiṃ cit |
agnīpomīye paśau adhyūnyā hotṛḥ kṛtsneḍābhakṣasya nivṛttiḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ-- asti jyotiṣṭome paśugnīpomīyaḥ 'yo dīkṣito yadagnīpomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatrāyamarthaḥ sāṃśayikaḥ kimadhyūnī hotṛbhakṣasya vikāra utavikāraḥ, hotṛrniyamyate iti |
kathaṃ vikāraḥ syāt, kathaṃ niyamyate iti ? yadi adhyūnī vidhīyate 'hotre haranti' itye- tadadbhu, tato vikāraḥ |
atha adhyūnīmudiśya hotre haranti iti vidhīyate, tato niyamaḥ |
kiṃ prāptaṃ 1 hotṛḥ bhakṣasya vikāraḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? apūrvā adhyūnī adaivata- śeṣatvāt iḍābhakṣe na prāptā, sā na śakyā'nuvaditum |
adhyūnī bhavantī hotṛ- haraṇe pratyakṣā ānumānikamiḍābhakṣaṃ nivartayatīti |
yathā anijyāśeṣaistaiḥ : ijyāśeṣāṇi niva- rtante tadvat |
bhāṣyaṃ-- vāśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati, iḍābhakṣa- vikāra iti |
kathaṃ ? 'ana- sthibhiriḍāṃ vardhayanti' iti tasyā haraṇaṃ prāptaṃ, hotṛsaṃbandho na prāptaḥ, sa vidhīyate, 'yāmimāṃ adhyūnīṃ haranti,
hotre tu anyaṃ bhakṣaṃ kurva- ntīti |
apica 'hotre haranti' iti ānnaryādika- vākyatā pratyakṣā |
itarasmin pakṣe 'adhvaryūṃ haranti' iti ca hotṛśabdavyavadhānāt kalpayitavyā bhavet |
yathā 'yajuryajñaṃ ratha- madhyava~ dadāti' iti rathasya vākyāntareṇa prāptatvāt avyavadhānācca adhvaryubhāge niyamaḥ |
kutaḥ ? nāsti śāstraṃ yena iḍābhakṣe adhvaryūṃ syāt |

anuvādasvarūpatvāt, prāptatvācca anasthikānāṃ vacanāntareṇa 'atha yadyat pariśiṣyate tat samavattadhānyāmānayati, yad hṛdayaṃ prāsyati, jihvāṃ, vakṣaḥ, stanama, tasmā vaniṣṭuṃ' iti anuvāda iti gamyate |
yat vyavadhānāt aprāptaiva ekavākyatā kalpayitavyā iti, apūrvatvādadhvaryūṇāḥ anuvādābhāve anarthakalpaparihārāya kalpayiṣyāmaḥ |
evaṃ ca svapadagataṃ haraṇaṃ vihitaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |
itarathā tu hotṛadhvaryūsaṃjñayo vidhīyeta, na svapadagataṃ haraṇam |
yadyevaṃ, na vacanā- ntareṇa iḍābhakṣe adhvaryūṃ prāptā, sā apūrvā hartavyā vidhīyate, na tarhi bhakṣavikāraḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ--tuśabdaḥ pakṣe vyāvartayati dānamātrametat na bhakṣavikāra iti |
paśurhi evaṃ saṃkalpitaḥ yāgaṃ varjayitvā nānyat svakāya anena kāryamiti |
ubhāvapi na prabhavato dravyasya, iti nāsti dānam |
atha kathaṃ bhakṣaśabdanbhisaṃ- yoge bhakṣaḥ ? caturthīśravaṇāt |
caturthī tadarthe bhavati, hotṛarthā adhvaryū, tathā hotā abhipreyate, sā hoturupa- karoti |
sā bhakṣayamāṇā sāmarthyajananasya dṛṣṭasya lābhāya yayā ca yāvatyā ca mātrayā upakāriṇī bhavati |
śā --yat hotre haranti tadadhvaryūṃ iti prākṛtaṃ hotṛ- saṃpradānakaṃ haraṇaṃ adhvaryūpratipādāne viniyujyate |
soma--yadvairaninyāropeḥ hṛdayādīnāminyāropāṇāṃ bādhe'pi anijyāśeṣabhūtādhvaryūṇā na teṣāṃ bādhaḥ ityu- sthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- adhvaryū hotṛbhakṣavikāraḥ syāt, yathā vyañjanāmiāśeṣa- vikāravat tadaditi |

bhāṭṭa--paśau iḍāṃ atideśaprāptāṃ prakalpya 'adhvaryūṃ hotre haranti' iti śrutvā adhvaryū prākṛtasya kṛtsnasya hotṛḍābhāgasya nivartikā na vā iti cintāyāṃ, adhvaryū tāvat atra dvitīyāntāthṛdedhyā pratipādyā ca ārkāṇakaratvāt |
taduddeśena ca hotṛsaṃpradānakaṃ bhakṣārthe haraṇaṃ prākṛtakāryapannaṃ saṃskāratvena vidhīyate |
haraṇaṃ ca yadyapi na dānaṃ adhvaryoḥ svābhāvena tattvānupapatteḥ, tathāpi bhakṣārthe samarpaṇaṃ, tatraiva na kathaṃ cit saṃpradāna- tvopapattiḥ |
athavā hotṛkartṛkabhakṣaṇopayogitvena hotṛ- tvāt tadarthatvaṃ iyam |
sarvathā hotṛviśiṣṭasya prākṛ- tasya haraṇasya adhvaryūīsaṃskāratvena vidhiḥ |
prāptaṃ haraṇamanucca tadāśritaṃ hotṛsaṃpradānakatvāccaiva vā taduddeśena vidhīyate |

paraṃtu 'anasthibhiriḍāṃ vardhayanti' iti vacanāt ana- sthirūpāyāḥ śikṣāyāḥ adhvaryūḥ iḍāyāṃ prāptatvāt tatra hotṛsaṃpradānakaharaṇasyāpi pakṣe prāptatvena tanniyamavidhi- pratīteḥ hotṛreva adhvaryū ityarthāvagame'pi na tasya bhāgā- ntaranivṛttiḥ |
iti prāpte, 'atha yadyat pariśiṣṭaṃ tattat samavattadhānyāmānayati |

yad hṛdayaṃ prāsyati, jihvāṃ, vakṣaḥ, stanama, tasyai vaniṣṭuṃ' iti vacanena hṛdayādīnāmeva iḍāyāṃ prāsanavidhānāt, tadabhiprāyeṇaiva ca ana- sthibhiḥ ityasya vartamānapradeśasya anuvādalopataḥ adhvaryūḥ iḍāyāmāptatvena tasyāṃ hotṛniyamayogāt, prākṛtahotṛrūpameva upasthitatvāt aprākṛtasaṃskāryāntara- saṃbandhitvena vidhīyate, prākṛtaharaṇāśrito hotaiva vā tathā vidhīyate |
tataśca tadaraṇasya prakṛtau bhakṣārthatvāt adhva- ryūā api bhakṣasiddhiḥ |
prākṛteḍābhakṣaṇasya ca pūrvavat kartṛtvena siddheḥ, na tasya punaḥ hotṛā anuṣṭhānam |
ata eva nātra hotṛsaṃpradānakaharaṇameva adhvaryūī- saṃskārārthatvena vidhīyate, prākṛteḍābhakṣaṇārthatvenopa- sthitatvena karmāntaratve pramāṇābhāvāt |
ataḥ siddhaṃ kṛtsnasya hoturiḍābhāgasya adhvaryūī nivṛttiḥ iti |

yadā tu āpastambādyuktarītyā hṛdayādīnāmājñānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pradeyānāmeva iḍātvaṃ tatsaṃskārārthaṃ ca 'anasthi- bhiriḍāṃ vardhayanti' ityanena anasthikaraṇaṃ vardhanaṃ vidhī- yate, tathāpi ca dṛṣṭavidhyā bhakṣaupayikatvāt bhakṣārthatva- meva, tathāpi 'klomānaṃ śrīmānaṃ purotāta' ityamiprāyavā- kyena avayavatrayasya anasthipadena grahaṇāt adhvaryūāḥ prāpyabhāvena pūrvavat apūrvatvā eva haraṇasaṃbhavāt prākṛte- ḍābhakṣavikāratvasiddhiḥ |

dhūrtasvāmyādīnāṃ tā vākyaśe- pasya upalakṣaṇatvamaṅgīkṛtya adhvaryūāḥ anasthitvena iḍā- vardhanakatvāt prāptāyāṃ tasyāṃ hotṛniyamamātrāṅgīkaraṇe iḍā- bhakṣārthatvakalpābhidhānaṃ, upalakṣaṇatve pramāṇābhāvāpe- kṣitam |
nyāyabinduḥ-- paśau 'adhvaryūṃ hotre haranti' iti śrutam |
tatra 'anasthibhiriḍāṃ vardhayanti' iti vacanāt iḍāṃtargata adhvaryūī nāma ucchra upari ratnabhāgarūpā hotṛbhāge niyamyate iti neḍābhakṣavādhikā |

iti prāpte, 'anasthibhiḥ' ityasya 'hṛdayaṃ prāsyati jihvāṃ vakṣaḥ' ityādi vacanānumānādvāt, tatra ca adhva- ṅkīrtanābhāvāt, 'yat hotre harati, tad adhvaryūī' iti apūrvavidhānāt, iḍābhakṣavādhikaiva iti siddhāntaḥ |
'na cāsya (vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā ityasya mantratvaṃ ) tādṛgyepyateḥ, adhveṭusmaraṇa- bhāvācca |

prāssā agniṃ bharata, śṛṇota bahiḥ, anenaṃ mātā manyatāmu pitā'nu bhrātā saga- bhyo'nu sakhā sayūthyaḥ |

1|4|2014, agnigṛ- praiṣasya āvṛttirbhājapeye prājāpatyapaśuṣu ṛtupaśuṣu ca kāla- bhedāt |
etāni norha gacchanti agnigau viṣamaṃ hi tat |
su. pṛ. 284. agnigṛpraiṣagatānāṃ vicārapadānāṃ pāṭhakrameṇa uttare laghusiddhāntā niveśitā iti jñātavyam |
ke. ) 'āśāsānā medhapatibhyāṃ medhaṃ' ityatra medhapatiśabdo devatāparaḥ |
tathā ca eka-dvi-bahudevatānusāreṇa medha- pataye medhapatibhyāṃ medhapatibhyaḥ ityevaṃ yathāyathaṃ ūha- nīyaḥ |
aitareyabrāhmaṇe tādṛśosya medhapatiśabdaṃ devatā- paraṃ svīkṛtyaiva spaṣṭameva vidhānāt |
ke. 1|3|12|32- 40. ekādaśineṣu paśuṣu medhapatiśabdaḥ ekavacanagrādaḥ nivartate, dvivacanadastu 'medhapatibhyo medhaṃ' iti ūhitavya eva devatāpṛthaktvāt gaṇatvābhāvāt |

bhā. 1|3|14|43. bahudevatāke paśau devānāṃ gaṇatve sati 'medhapatibhyo medhaṃ' ityanena saha 'medhapataye medhaṃ' ityeka- vacanānto'pi mantro vikalpyate ekavacanena gaṇasya bodha. nāt yathā 'arcaṃ vaśāmādilebhyaḥ kāmāyālabheta ' ityatra |
vi. 1|3|13. agnipraiṣe medhapatiśabdaḥ bahudevatve paśau dvivacanadaḥ ūhena, ekavacanadaśca avikṛtaḥ ityabhyorvikalpaḥ |
bhā. 1|3|14|41-42. yatra tu devatānāṃ gaṇatvaṃ nāsti kintu pṛthakpṛthageva devatvaṃ yathā ekādaśineṣu, tatra 'medhapatibhyo medhaṃ' iti bahuvacanāntatvameva ūhanīyaṃ, na tu vikalpaḥ |
vi. 1|3|14. 'prāsmai' ityasya na vikāraḥ yadā agnī- pomīyaḥ savanīyaśca samānavidhānāḥ |
bhā. 1|3|8|22. atirātragatasavanīyapaśucatuṣṭayaviṣaye 'prāsmai' ityasya bahuvacanatvenoho na kartavyaḥ |
yadi sādhāraṇāḥ paśudharmāḥ, tataḥ sāra- svatī agnigṛvacanaṃ aprāptā |
atha agnīṣomīyadharmāḥ, tataḥ asyāṃ agnigṛvacanaṃ ūhena prāpyate 'prāsyai agne' iti |
bhā. 1|2|17|49. ukthyagatasavanīyapaśudvaya- viṣaye 'prāsmai' ityatra dvivacanāntatvena ūho na kartavyaḥ |
tri. 1|3|8, ṣoḍaśiśatasavanīyapaśutrayaviṣaye 'prāsmai' ityasya bahuvacanatvenoho na kartavyaḥ |
1|3|8. 'sūrya cakṣurmayatāt' ityādī dvinupaśukyāge saṃsa- rgidravyavācakacakṣurādiśabdānāṃ golakavācitvābhāvāt dvivahuvacanāntatvena ūho na kartavyaḥ |
tatra dvipaśu- kalpe ekadhaikadhā'nayostyaccāvācyatathā iti, bahulye tu ekadhaikadhaikadhaiṣāṃ tvacca ācchayatāt ityūhaḥ |
ke. 1|3| 11|29-31. 'ekadhā asya tvaccācchayatāt ' ityatra 'asya' iti padaṃ paśugaṇe yathāyathaṃ dvivahuvaca- nāntena ūhitavyaṃ ityavivādam |
bhāṭṭa. 1|3|11, 'ekadhā'sya tvacca ācchayatāt' ityatra tvacaṃ iti padaṃ paśugaṇe yathāyathaṃ dvivahuvacanāntena ūhitavyaṃ ityavivā- dam |
1|3|11. 'iyenamasya kṛṇutāt' ityasya yathā yenasadṛśaṃ vakṣaḥ na naśyati tathā sākalyenoddhara- ṇīya ityarthaḥ, na tu vakṣasaḥ śyenākāropādanam |
evaṃ śalā- kaśyapa- kavaṇa- sekaparṇeṣu kātsnyameva pratipādyate na tu ākāraviśeṣasaṃpādanam |
vi. 1|4|6. 'praśāsā bāhū' iti praśāsāśabdasya asiḥ iti nārthaḥ kintu praśastī ityarthaḥ |
tathā dvivahupaśuke praśāsāśabdasya dvivahuvacanāntatvena ūhaḥ kartavyaḥ praśasau bāhū iti vā praśaso bāhū iti vā |
tathā ca yājñikasaṃmatatva (svadhiti) buddhau eva ūhaḥ |
ke. 1|4|4. 'śallā dopaṇī' atra paśvanekatve'pi śalā- śabde nohaḥ, ekenāpi upamānena sādṛśyapratipādanasya śakyatvāt |
1|4|6, kavapohū ityatra paśubahutve'pi kavapāśabde nohaḥ tasya kātsnyaparatvāt |

1|4|25-27. aśvamedhe 'bahviśitasirasya vakrakrayaḥ' ityasya sthāne asvārthe 'caturviṃśadājino devavandhoḥ' (krasaṃ. 1|6|1|8) iti ṛcaṃ paṭhitvā tuparagomṛgayorthe 'dvipañcāśadanayorvakrakrayaḥ' iti paṭhi- tavyam |
kiṃvā 'ṣaḍaśītireṣāṃ vakrakrayaḥ' iti samasta vacanaṃ kartavyam |

bhā. 1|4|17-21, 'pañca- viṃśatirasya vakrakrayaḥ' tā anuṣṭhayoccāyayatāt ' ityatra 'dvipañcāśadanayorvakrakrayaḥ; aṣṭasaptatireṣāṃ vakrakrayaḥ' ityevaṃ paśusaṃkhyānusāreṇa mukhyānāṃ vakrakrīṇāṃ saṃkhyākathanārthe dvi- bahupaśugaṇe yathāyathaṃ samasta vacanaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca anekapaśu vikṛtiṣu ekavacanānto'rukaśabdaḥ dvivahuvacanāntena yathāyathaṃ ūhanīyaḥ |
tatra dvitve 'uruṇī ke manyamānāḥ' iti padabhedapakṣe 'uruke manyamānāḥ' iti padaikalpe vaktavyam |
bahutve ca 'uruṇi kāni manyamānāḥ' iti vā 'urukāṇi manyamānāḥ' iti vā vaktavyam |
1|4|22. agnigṛpraiṣagatasya prāsmai iti padasya agnī- pomīyasavanīyayoḥ samānavidhānatve na vikāraḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ-- asti some paśugnīpomīyaḥ 'yo dīkṣito yadagnīpomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatra agnigau idaṃ sāmnāyate 'prāsmā agne bhara, stṛṇīta barhiḥ: anvenaṃ mātā manyatāmanu pitā'nu bhrātā' ityeva- mādi |
yadā tu agnīpomīyaḥ savanīyaśca samāna- vidhānāḥ, tatredaṃ vicāryate kimagnigau 'prāsmai' ityeva- mādi padaṃ ūhitavyaṃ, uta neti |
tatra yaḥ patyadhikaraṇe (9|1|7) pūrvapakṣaḥ sa iha pūrvapakṣaḥ |
śā - tṛtīye'dhyāye saṃsthāpaśavaḥ samānavidhānāḥ iti pūrvapakṣe ( 3|6|16|41-43 ) samāna- vidhānatvaṃ yaduktaṃ, tasyedaṃ prayojanaṃ pūrvadhikaraṇena siddhaṃ anena sūtreṇa kathyate |
yadā samānavidhānāḥ, tadā ukthyaṣoḍaśyādidivihapaśuke'pi savanīyagaṇe pravartamānaḥ prāsmai ityādigrupaiṣatattadvacanāntaḥ śabdaḥ patnīśrāddhadeva nohitavyaḥ; vikārapakṣe tu ūhitavyaḥ |
prāsmā iti tadā mantro patnīnayena nohanam |
' paramā- rthatastu savanīyapaśūnāṃ agnīpomīyavikṛtitvāt asyaiva liṅgavacanayoḥ pāśyāyena ūhaḥ |
bhāṭṭa - evaṃ ṛtupaśūnāṃ samānavidhānatvapūrvapakṣe 'prāsmai' ityagnigṛpraiṣe ekavacanānta eva teṣu prayoktavyaḥ patnīśrāddhavat |
na tu ekavacanānurodhena ekapaśuke eva deśādau |
ata eva yasya puṃliṅgasya śrutyā strī- puṃsagaṇe asaṃbhavaḥ, tatra atyantanipaḍalakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇā- bhāvāt mepyavindaṃ puṃsudhveva saṃkoca iti vaiṣamyam |
asamānavidhānasiddhānte tu prāsmai ityasya vacane liṅge ca 'praibhyo asyā agne bhara' ityevamūhitavya eva |
tade- tat tādarthyasya samānavidhānatvavicārasya prayojanamātra- kathanam |

nyāyabinduḥ -- saṃsthāpaśūnāṃ sāmānavidhyapūrvapakṣe dvivahupaśuke savanīyagaṇe 'prāsmai' ityagnigṛpraiṣatamaka- vacanaṃ patnīśrāddhavadeva nohitavyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ, siddhānte tu ūhaḥ iti prasaṅgāduktam |
prāsmai iti puṃliṅgaṃ tu atyantānupapatteḥ na sārasvatyāṃ pravartate iti vaiṣamyam |
bhāṣya-- asyaikādaśinī 'praiṣā''gneyena vāpayati, mithunaṃ sārasvatā karoti, reta: saumyena dadhāti, prajananayati pauṣṇe' ityevamādi |
asti ca prakṛtāvadhigupraiṣe ekavacanānto dvivacanāntaśca medhapratiśabdaḥ |
pṛthagata devatā anyasya paroranyā devatā, anyāntyetyevam |
prakṛtau caitat dvayaṃ kāraṇaṃ ekavacanāntasya niveśe |
yathoktaṃ, 'ekatve'pi guṇanāpāyat' iti (9|3|13|40), parapakṣamanurāha tadvacanaṃ, na svapakṣaḥ |
śā-- gaṇābhiprāyeṇa pūrvavadūhaṃ manvānasyottaraṃ 'devatātmana ekatvādvikāraḥ puroditaḥ |
tadapyasya tu bhinnatve ko nāmohaṃ nivārayet |
' soma-- bahanāṃ devatātvāt devatākārakasyaikāt pūrvavadūhaḥ ityukteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-arthāntare ekādaśinādau devatākārabhedādvikāraḥ syāt pratyekameva taddhitādisamatrāt pratyekameva devatā syāditi |
vi-- kṛṣṇagrīvādike noha ūho vā, 'sya na pūrvavat |
' bhāṭṭa-- yatra tu devatātvāni anekāni adhiṣṭhānaṃ tu ekamanekaṃ vā tatra (adhigupraiṣagatamedhapratiśabdasya) ekavacanāntasyāpi ūhaḥ |
atra tvaṣṭṛ-patnīvatoḥ adhigupraiṣaśca adhigupraiṣatve'pi taddhita-caturthībhedāt devatābhedaḥ |
na ca anyormantrayoḥ arthadvayaparatvena ūhaṅgīkāre prakṛtau vikṛtau vā devatātvadadhiṣṭhānarūpārthabhedāt samuccayāpattiriti vācyam |
ekavacanānto hi devatātve paraṃparāsaṃbandhena medhapatiṃ vadan paraṃparāsaṃbandhakatvayā adhiṣṭhānamapi upasthāpayati |
dvivacanānto'pi adhiṣṭhāne medhapatiṃ vadan svīkārāsaṃbandhasya devatātvadhīnatvāt devatāmapi upasthāpayati iti satyapi viṣayatābhede ubhayorapi ubhayopasthāpakatvāt vikalpopapattiḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ-- paśugaṇe tu gaṇābhiprāyeṇaikavacanānūhaṃ manvānasyottaṃ devatā rūpabhede ūha eva, tadekaye paraṃ nānūha iti siddhāntaḥ |
maṇḍana-- 'ekādaśinyāḥ vikṛtistu tatra' tatra medhapratiśabde vikṛtiḥ : ūhaḥ |
15. oṃ adhigupraiṣagatasya medhapratiśabdasyaikavacanāntasya bahudevatve paśau dvivacanāntena vikalpaḥ |
asti tu prakṛtāvagnīṣomīye dvivrvacanaṃ ekavacanācca medhapratiśabdaḥ |
atra codakaprāptaḥ saṃdihyate kiṃ dvivrvacanaṃ uhitavyaḥ : ekavacigado nivartate, utaubhāvāpi parasparaṃ vikalpyamānau niveśe-yātāmiti |
nanu prakṛtau dvitvāvivakṣitatvāt vikārye prayogaḥ prāpnotīti |
na ca gamyamānaṃ niṣprayojanaṃ, anyasaṃkhyāparicchedena punaḥ saṃkhyepamupasthāpayati, tadasya dṛṣṭameva prayojanam |
ḍupa-- siddhe'pi pūrvādhikaraṇe pūrvapakṣo'sya yat kriyate, tatra (paradāhakayā, śaṅkāntarātsadrāvāta |
prāyeṇa ityukterabhiprāyamāhe-) 'ekatve'pi guṇanāpāyāt' (9|3|13|44) iti (pūrvādhikaraṇe), kiṃtu tatra ekatvasyāvikṣā uktā |
(kiṃtu iti bhinnakramaḥ; kiṃtu āsmin sūtre avikṣā uktā iti |
kathaṃ tarhi gatārthatvamiti, ata āha-) sa eva hetuḥ vivakṣāyāmapi iti |
uktaṃ hi gaṇābhiprāyaṃ tatprakṛtau, saṃsargitvād devatātvāni |
tadadihāpi gaṇābhiprāyat, saṃsargitvād devatātvāni niveśete iti |
siddhe hyatrāvikāre uttarādhikaraṇe anenaiva nyāyena pūrvapakṣamāśaṅkya pratyudāharaṇarūpeṇa siddhāntaḥ pradarśayituṃ śakyate, iti uttarasya upodghāto'yam |
' bhāṭṭa-- yatra devatātvamekaṃ, adhiṣṭhānaṃ tu ekaṃ bahu vā, tatra dvivacanāntasya adhiṣṭhānaparatvāt tadanurodhena ūhaḥ |
ekavacanāntasya tu adhikāra eva devatātvasya ekatvāt yathā 'vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta' 'vaiśvadevaṃ dhūmālabheta' 'sa etān paśūnādityebhya ālabheta' ityādi |
atra vāyuvekama-dhiṣṭhānaṃ, viśvedevāḥ samastāttvāt bahavo adhi-ṣṭhānam |
yadyapi ca śabdasya devatātvāt nātra śabdānāṃ

bahulaṃ, tathāpi devatvādidevavyavahārasiddhayarthe kalpasya svīkāra-syāpi arthiniatyeva kalpanāt svīkāraghaṭitamedhaprati-tvasyāpi arthe eṣopapatteḥ; arthaḥ evātrādhikaraṇe paraṃparā devatātvādhiṣṭhānapadena ucyate iti tadūhatvopapattiḥ |
na ca śabdasya devatātvapade caturdhrthāpatterdeva-tātve prātipadikasya ādityapadasyaiva anvayāt, tasya ca ekena bahuvacanenāpi ekatvasyaiva lakṣaṇāt, kathamadhiṣṭhānānekatvaṃ iti vācyam |
satyāmapi lakṣa-ṇāyāṃ svaśaktyāśrayavācakatvapaddhatistvasaṃbandhenaiva lakṣaṇāt tasya ca ekena bahuvacanenāpi bahvalopapatteḥ |
ataśca tatra adhi-ṣṭhānasaṃkhyā''nusāreṇa dvivacanāntasya ūhaḥ, devatātvaṃ tu ekaṃ, anekatve pramāṇābhāvāt |
ādityebhyaḥ ityatrāpi na bahulaṃ vibhaktyapatterdevatātvānvayi, api tu bahuvvya ārthikaṃ arthasaṃvanaṃ gṛhyatvā tallakṣitatvameva, iti tatrāpi devatātvaikatvam |
astu vā bahuvacanatvāt tatra devatābhedaḥ : iti tadiha udāharaṇaṃ, kiṃtu adhigupraiṣe eva |
nyāyabinduḥ--vaiśvadevādiṣvadvaite ekavacanāsāma-rthyadūhaḥ iti śaṅkāyā devatātvikatvāt prakṛtitvadūhaḥ iti pūrvādhikaraṇaprayojanamuktam |
bhāṣya-- asminvākye idamamanāyate 'śyenamasya vakṣaḥ kurutāt, śalā dopaṇī, kasyevāsau, kavayo rūpaṃ, sekrapaṇā''drīyante' iti |
eṣa saṃśayaḥ kiṃ ākṛtivacanaṃ eṣu bhavati, uta kātsyrnenārpaṇaṃ iti |
iha prasiddhasya saṃnidhau yadadhīyate kiṃcididaṃ kartavyamiti, tatra ākṛ-
ṛg- kriyantāṃ' iti, 'arjunavadarāḥ mekhalāḥ kriyantāṃ' iti |
śyeparṇā karavīrapatra- siṃhakṛtivacanaṃ mekhalā''kṛtivacanaṃ ca gamyate |
sūtrārthastu- śyenākṛti vakṣaḥ kartavyaṃ, śalākṛtī dopaṇī, kavyapākṛtī |
śyenādiṣyākṛtivacanaṃ cañcucaraṇādyavayavasaṃsthānābhidhānaṃ aṃsau, kapākṛtī ūrū, karavīraparṇākṛtī aśrīvantau |
syāt prasiddhasya śyenādeḥ saṃnidhāne tadākṛtereva jhaṭiti iti |
vi— 'sāhaśyamyuta sākalyaṃ śyenāyuktā vivakṣi- bhāṣyaṃ-- pāśadaḥ pakṣaṃ nyāyavatyati, na caitadasti |
tatra śyenapadaṃ ivaśabdamanupraiṣe vakṣasa kuruta, kṛtsnāni uddarata ityayamartho'gamyate |
bahutarasaṃbhave saṃbhave katipayadhamaiḥ anyāyatatvāt ākāra- atadākṛtīnāṃ avayavāt |
ataśca vakṣa uddṛtya kartanādinā śyenā- iti |
iti prāpte, avadānavākye'pi 'atha vakṣasaḥ' bhāṣyaṃ-- adhigu aṅganāmasudaraṇārthaḥ, aṅgānāṃ |
iti śravaṇāt tasyaiva haviṣyapratīteḥ na kartanādinā kātsyaṃ noddharaṇaṃ kathaṃ syādityevamarthaḥ |
tena sādṛśyasaṃpattiḥ avi- bhavati vacanaṃ, 'gātrāṃgātramasānuṃ kṛṇutāt' iti |
kaledarādanavā jāye iti akhilakaledaraṃ prakāśayitumeva tasmādapi śyenādibhiḥ kṛtsnoddharaṇaṃ gamyate iti |
māntravarṇikyāḥ vidhāne gaurava aṣṭārthatā vā āpadyeta |
evaṃ 'śalā dopaṇī, kavyapākṛtī, kapākṛtī, śyeparṇā- saṃpādanena śyenasaṃsthānaṃ kartavyaṃ (iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ) |
naitayuktaṃ adṛṣṭārthatāprasaṅgāt, kartane ca vakṣaso vaikalyāt |
ayaṃ pūrvapakṣe siddhānte ca śyenādīnāṃ upamāna- soma--prasāsādādasya praśaṃsāmātraparatve ānarthakyāt |
tvasya āvaśyakatvāt tatrāpi ca ivaśabdaśravaṇe 'siṃhe tanmukhena sākalyaparatve'pi śyenādiṣyānāṃ sādṛśya- |
devadattaḥ' itivat gauṇatvābhāvāt 'siṃha ivaite vīrāḥ' mātraparatvopapatteḥ na tanmukhena sākalyaparatvaṃ ityutthitaḥ |
yadyapi idamadhikaraṇaṃ nohavicāropayogi, tathāpi śalaṃ śalaṃ' ityamarakośāt śalākādī iti bhaṭṭa- |
aṃsau kaśyape kacchapau iva iti mādhavaḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ-- 'śyenamasya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt' iti ūrū kapā kavāṭasadṛśau iti bhaṭṭabhāskaraḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ-- liṅgaṃ khalvapi bhavati yathā saṃsargiṇo dopaṇī śalākā''kārau hastau |
'na mātā vardhate, na pitā, na nābhiḥ, kūrmakārau ityarthaḥ |
prāṇo hi saḥ' iti, prāpasya siddhamūhaṃ hetutvena upa- vā ūrū |
soma-- nīvāragatatāvayaveṣu vrīhiśabdasya ekavaca- maṇḍana-- 'kṛtsnoddhṛtau śyenavacaḥ |
nāntavahuḥśabdasya anekapeṣu sāmarthyābhāvāt ūhaḥ śaṃkara-- 'śyenādau cāpi sākalyam |
divat saṃyuktā api pṛthagvatiṣṭhante, te saṃsargiṇaḥ yathā adhigupraiṣagatānāṃ saṃsargidravyavācakacakṣu- |
sūtrārthastu- saṃsargiṣu rādipadānāṃ paśuguṇe ūho na ||
tathā ca saṃsargāniyamaḥ saṃsargiṣu nāsti iti 10|28 ||
bhāṭṭa-- daikṣa adhigupraiṣe 'udīcīnān asya pado kiṃ uhitavyaḥ, uta neti |
nighattāt, sūrye cakṣurgamyatāt, vātaṃ prāṇamanvavaja- nigadatvādeva ayaṃ nohitavyaḥ; dvayoścakṣuṣoḥ ekavacanānto |
tāt, antarikṣamasuṃ, diśaḥ śrotraṃ, pṛthivīṃ śarīram' iti yataḥ śrūyate |
tatra paśugaṇe 'asya' ityekavacane dvivacana- sūryagamanamāha, nahi adhiṣṭhāne sūrya gacchataḥ; tejo- |
cakṣurādipadviṣaye tu ūhānūhacintāyāṃ satyāṃ adhi- anyāyanigadaḥ |
ṣṭhānabhede indriyaṃ lāghavāt vyāsajyavṛtti ekameva kalpyate |
labheta, vāruṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ, apāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca saṃdhau anna- |
ataśca tasya kāmaḥ' ityevādiṣu paśubhedāt tejaso bhede gamyamāne |
ekatvāt ekavacanaṃ sametāyameva paśumede tadedādū- ūhaḥ syāt iti prāpnoti |
prāṇapadavācyaprāṇaṃ tu adhiṣṭhānasyāpi ekatvā- adhiṣṭhānabhedena bhinne eva tejasī |
śarīrasya tu pratyakṣaṃ eka- 'sūryasya cakṣurgamyatāt' iti yat paroktejaḥ tad |
na ca cakṣuṣo vyāsajyavṛttitve ekagolaka- vivakṣitaṃ, nādhiṣṭhānabhedaḥ |
vināśa'pi ca cākṣupānāpattiḥ, ekagolakamātrāvṛttitve- ūhaḥ iti |
tāśrayabhede tadādheyabhedasya rūpādī ausargikasya tyāgena raśmīnāṃ saṃsarga eva, ekībhūtāḥ teṣāṃ raśmayaḥ |
anyathā sarvaprāṇi- pānīyeya tailaya ghṛtasya vā stokāḥ nānādeśeṣu |
sādhāraṇyena ekacakṣuḥ kalpanā''pattau asiddhiprasaṅgā- bhinnāḥ samānadeśe ekībhūtā bhavanti, tadvad raśmayaḥ |
tacca pramāṇāntaratvāt tasmādekavacanāntaḥ teṣāṃ vācaka iti anūhaḥ syāt |
vastustu golakādhiṣṭhitasya sūryamanāsaṃbhavāt tato nirga- tasyaiva atra cakṣuḥpadenābhidhānam |
na ca paryagnikaraṇo- ttarameva adhigupraiṣāt tadānīṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ golakasthatvāt na nirgamana iti vācyam |
ataśca nirgata- syaiva cakṣuṣaḥ pradīpaprabhāvat anekasyāpi saṃsargeṇa ekī- bhāvāt prakṛtau ekavacanaṃ nirvādham |

nahi nirgatacakṣuṣāṃ pradīpapānāmiva bhinnadeśāvasthānasya kalpanātraikībhāvaḥ ; ekagolakamīlane tatpuraḥpradeyāvasthitaghaṭādeḥ golakāntarasthitacakṣuṣā darśanena nirgatacakṣuṣaḥ visphārakalpanāt ekībhāvo- papatteḥ |
atra ca tejasvādivat cakṣuṣādikamapi ava- yavāvayavavicchittijātiḥ ; tena tattadgolakasthitatattaccharīraiḥ ārabdhaḥ avayavī api cakṣureva iti nohamasaktaḥ |

śarīre tu yadyapi naikabhāvasaṃbhavaḥ ; tathāpi ucyamānasya kāraṇī- bhūtasūkṣmapṛthivyāṃ lyāparpāyyāgamanasya pratyakṣabādhitatvāt prakṛtāveva stutyarthamucyamānatayā asamametathyakatvāt anūho draṣṭavyaḥ |

nyāyabinduḥ - adhigupraiṣe 'sūrye cakṣurgamyatāt' ityādau dviguppuṣu dvivahuvacanohaḥ ; ekavacanasya prakṛtau cakṣupastejasatvena jalavat saṃsargetayā svarūpataḥ saṃkhyā'narhatvena paśupādhikatvāt adhiṣṭhānopādhikatve dvitvāpatteḥ |
iti prāpte, adhiṣṭhānānnirgataṃ tejaḥ ekībhavati ityabhiprāyeṇaikavacanaṃ, na tu adhiṣṭhānābhiprāyaṃ, tayoḥ sūryamanāyogāt, dvidhācca |
ataḥ paśubhede'pi uktaikyasaṃbhavāt anūhaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣya - jyotiṣṭome agnīṣomīye paṣṭhau adhigu vacanaṃ 'vaṇiṣṭhamasya mā rāvīṣṭorūkaṃ manyamānāḥ' |
tatra urūkaśabdaṃ prati vicāraḥ kiṃ vaṇiṣṭhaṃ asya mā rāviṣṭa urūkasadṛśaṃ manyamānāḥ, uta urūkaṃ vapāṃ manya- mānāḥ vaṇiṣṭhaṃ mā rāviṣṭa iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? vaṇiṣṭhaṃ urūkaṃ manyamānā iti |
paryaṅkaḥ palvaṅkaḥ, romāṇi lomāni, aṅguṣṭhaḥ aṅguṣṭhiḥ |
evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ ; urūka- śabdena vapā'bhidhānaṃ syāt |
vapā manyamānāḥ vaṇiṣṭhaṃ mā rāviṣṭa ityeṣā buddhiḥ kriyamāṇā vyarthā |
bhavati hi vaṇiṣṭha- saṃnidhānāt vyāmohena vaṇiṣṭhohanaprasaṅgaḥ |
taṃ ca niva- rtayan eṣa śabdo dṛṣṭaprayojano bhavati |
itarasmin pakṣe vaṇiṣṭhaṃ mā rāviṣṭa iti lavitavye vaṇiṣṭhau anarthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
kathaṃ punarvāpāyāṃ aprayuktau vapā pratyā- yayiṣyati urūkaśabdaḥ iti ? ucyate |
tathā, 'uraṃ hi rājā varuṇaścakāra sūryāya panthāmanvetā u' iti |
na vistīrṇa medo manyamānena tatsaṃnikṛṣṭo vaṇiṣṭhaḥ ; lavitavyaḥ iti vapā- vacanatā siddhā bhavati |
kiṃ bhavati prayojanaṃ ? vaṇiṣṭha- vacanapakṣe upamānasya urūkaśabdasya anūhaḥ |
kaśāśabda iti uruṇī ke, uruṇī kāni |
soma - ṣaḍviṃśatiśabde samasyavacanātmako'pi urūkaśabde nohaḥ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
bhāṭṭa - adhigupraiṣe eva 'vaṇiṣṭhamasya mā rāviṣṭa urūkaṃ manyamānāḥ' iti śrutam |

tatra urūkapadena kiṃ urūkasthamidhānaṃ, kiṃvā vapāyā iti cintāyāṃ, vapāyāṃ urūkaśabdaprayogabhāvāt, anyatra vede lakārasthāne rephadaśa- nāt loke'pi ca romāṇi lomāni ityādi ralaghaṭita- padayoḥ samānavṛttitvāt, urūkapadena urūkamābhidhānaṃ, tataśca urūkabuddhyā vaṇiṣṭhaṃ mā chindata iti mantrārthaḥ |
iti prāpte, na tāvat vaṇiṣṭhoḥ sarvathaiva lavanaṃ niṣidhyate, hṛdayādivat tasya haviṣtvena lavanasyāvaśyakatvāt |
nārpā urūkasādṛśyabuddhiḥ lavanakāle niṣidhyate, adṛṣṭārthatvā- patteḥ |
vapodarakaṇāle vapā manyamānāḥ bhrāntyā vaṇiṣṭhaṃ mā chindata ityarthaḥ |
ataḥ tasya pūrvaṃ lavanapratiṣedhavacanaṃ dṛṣṭārthaṃ bhavati |
avayavayogaśca urūkaśabdo vistīrṇavācī, dīrgha- cchāndasaḥ ; kadādyado medovācī, nāmaṃkedeśa nāmagraha- ṇāt ka-śabdo'pi tadacana eva, tataśca padadvayamidaṃ samāso vā |
na ca rūḍhyā yogamādhaḥ ; rephaghaṭitasya padasya urūka'pi rūḍhya- bhāvāt |
ataśca vapā'nekalye ūrṇi kāni itipadadvaya- pakṣe, urūkaṇi iti samāsapakṣe ūhaḥ kāryaḥ |
nyāyabinduḥ - 'vaṇiṣṭhamasya mā rāviṣṭorūkaṃ manya- mānāḥ' ityatra urūkaśabdena ralayoraikyāt urūkabhi- dhānāt tasmādadṛṣṭabuddhyā vaṇiṣṭhoḥ avayavaviśeṣasya lavana- pratiṣedhaḥ |
iti prāpte, uru vistīrṇe, kaṃ māṃsaṃ iti vapā'bhidhānam |
vapodarakaṇāle saṃnidhānāt bhrāntyā vaṇiṣṭhorlavanaṃ prāptaṃ niṣidhyate |
tatra saṃdehaḥ ; kiṃ praśaṃsā bāhū kṛṇutāt, praśaṃsā iti tṛtīyāntaḥ praśaṃsā bāhū grahītavyau iti, uta praśaṃsā iti dvivacanaṃ ākāre vibhakteḥ kṛte praśastau bāhū kartavyau iti |
sāpadena praśastatvābhidhānāt, tasya ca avikalatvasūca- vi-- 'praśasetyasyaḥ syāt stutirvā, chedanā- |
prākṛtapadasya bāhutve chāndasatvāt bāhubahutve, dvipāśi- sādhanam|
kāyāṃ vikṛtau bahutvacantāntapādyamanyasyeva apabhraṃśe: bhāṭṭa-- tatraiva praiṣe (agnigupraiṣe) 'praśasā |
'svādhīne śabdaprayoge' iti nyāyena 'praśastān bāhūna' bāhū' iti śrutam|
pūrvapakṣe ca 'praśāsaiḥ' (iti ūhaḥ) iti praśasā ityanena kiṃ karaṇībhūtaḥ śāsaḥ ucyate, |
idaṃ ca mahābhāṣyasārasyāt kāntadhāto- uta praśastatvaṃ iti cintāyāṃ, praśasāyāṃ adṛṣṭā- |
riva sāndhatāto'pi tulyanyāyatvāt kivvicau na staḥ|
rthatvāpatteḥ praśā iti tṛtīyāntaṃ akāralopena hrasvena |
ityastrīkṛ ṣāsapadasyaiva gama iti chāndasaṃ ityāgāya ca śāsavācī|
yadvā tu mahāvārtikasārasyāt bahu- ityādi liṅgāt asivacanaḥ|
taraprayogān māntadhātoḥ kivvicau iṣyate tadā paśyamāna- khaḍgena bāhū china iti praiṣārthaḥ|
svarānuguṇyān 'śasu hiṃsāyāṃ' ityanuśiṣṭasya hiṃsārtha- reva padyaprakaraṇe sāmānyataḥ chedane vihitaḥ, tathāpi |
kasya śasadhātoḥ lunakivvantasya tṛtīyāntarūpasyāpi bāhūcchede māntravarṇiko viśeṣavidhiḥ anena na viru- |
vamaneḥ yājñikasaṃmanaṃḥ śāmamadrī eva ūhaḥ anusaṃdheyaḥ|
amayaḥ bhavanti' iti asihastatvasya vidhānāt tadanu- |
agnigupraiṣe 'tā anuguyoccāyayatāt' ityatra likhitatvāt, śāsasyāpi paśau vihitatvena upekṣaṇam|
anuguyā iti anuṣṭhiteḥ prayatnakarmaṇaḥ striyāṃ 'āta- vastutastu bodhāyanādisakalakalpaparyālocanayā śāsapadasya |
śrosage' (pā0 3|1|106 aṅ syāt chino'pa- svadhitavāpi śakyatvānmātra bāhucchedane'pi svadhitireva |
vai śāsamācakṣate' iti liṅgaṃ, tat svadhitireva asitulyatvena |
uccāyayatāt : udarakarmaṇaḥ praiṣe loṭ madhyamapuruṣa- stulyam|
pāṭhādvā śāsaśabdasya bāhucchedane karaṇatvamate'pi praśā iti |
agnigupraiṣe paśuguṇe samastaṛkkīyataprakā- saṃbhavati, akāralopasya hrasvasya ca bāhulakatvāṅgīkāre |
ṣaḍviṃśatirathyāsena, paśuguṇe tatprakṛtitvāt, sāmānyādhikaraṇye saṃbhavati vaiyadhikaraṇyasya anyāyatvācca|
nāmisambandho vikārāt samāmaḥ syādasaṃyogo dvivacanasya ākāradeśastu svatantrasūtravihitaḥ (supāṃ |
) tasya (ca saṃbandhasya) śabdo praiṣe idāmāyate 'ṣaḍviṃśatirasra vaḍkrayaḥ' iti|
yaḥ (ca) pradhānaṃ, dakena dvipakṣādīn paśugaṇān saṃprānaṃ, 'maitraṃ śvetamāla- |
tatra arthāt saṃbandhau abhyasyate bhate, vāruṇaṃ kṛṣṇamapāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca saṃdhāvanmantraḥ|
asyopapattimāha -) evaṃ (saṃbandhaprādhānye abhyāsa- śabdo'bhyasitavyaḥ, kimavikāreṇa prayoktavyaḥ; kiṃ vacana- |
(tarhi vaḍkri- mātramityetat, athavā asyapadābhyāsaḥ, uta samasya |
śabdasya kathanamanvayaḥ ? ata āha -) vaḍkriśabdaśca vacanamiti|
akaraṇo'yaṃ mantraḥ pramā- padyoḥ ṣaḍviṃśatirvaḍkrayaḥ uktāḥ|
reṇa) prakāśitasya prakāśane prayojanamasti (ityeṣṭā- vikāreṇa prayujyeta, na kṛtvā vaḍkrairabhivadet|
) evaṃ ca yat prakṛtau kṛtaṃ, tat vikṛtau bhavati, samasa vacanaṃ kriyeta, tathā ṣaḍviṃśatiśabdo nivarteta, |
nanu paśoḥ kāryaṃ yaḥ padyoḥ sthāne, sa |
(evaṃ ca tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ sidhyatīlāha -) vaḍkribhiḥ saṃbandhavatyaḥ, tathā hi prakṛtau vacanaṃ |
avikṛtena ṣaḍviṃśatiśabdena atrākhye pratipādayituṃ, ekaikasya ṣaḍviṃśatyā saṃbandhaḥ pratyāyitaḥ|
sūtre 'nanu ṣaḍviṃśatī ityabhidhāne' ityādibhāṣyaṃ artha- parokṣayā avayavasaṃkhyayā saṃbandha ānumānikaḥ syāt|
to'nubhāṣya vyācaṣṭe -) nanu ṣaḍviṃśatiśabdaprādhānye ca niyogataḥ: ṣaḍviṃśatyā ekaikasya saṃbandhaḥ pratyāyitaḥ |
hi saṃkhyāvādāḥ: (prāk viśateḥ: saṃkhyeprādhānyāḥ dvau nayau gamyate|
yadā saṃkhyā ātmānamupasarjanīkṛtya saṃkhyye vartate, tadā ṭup - asminnadhikaraṇe pañca pakṣāḥ|
vinā ṣaṣṭhyā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati yathā 'viṃśatirgāvaḥ' śatiḥ asya iti padadvayāsaḥ: iti prathamaḥ|
na stuti) tadā ṣaṣṭhīmantareṇa saṃkhyyeyaśabdena sāmānādhi- asya-padasya ūhaḥ: iti caturthaḥ|
atra (uttaramāha bhāṣyakāraḥ: 12 sūtre) lakṣa- saṃbandhaḥ: ityucyate -) 'ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ asya' anyoḥ |
nanu dravya- vācināṃ guṇaparatvaṃ ca cihna dṛṣṭaṃ, ata āha-) dṛśyate ca prayogaḥ yathā indra prī devatā iti |
yadā devatātvena gaṇaḥ (samudāyaḥ) vivakṣito bhavati na ca pradhānabhūtaḥ, tadā'pi vinaiva ṣaṣṭhyā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛśyate yathā devadattaviṣṇumitrayorataḥ : paśyaditi |
atra paryaccha- bdaśca pradhānabhūtaḥ, itare devadādayaḥ śabdāḥ tadviśeṣa- tvena, tathā vede'pi pañcapañcāśataśatavibhaktaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ iti |
atra (pañcāśan-) saṃkhyā pradhānabhūtā, tathāpi vinaiva ṣaṣṭhyā (mitrusaṃvatsaraśabdābhyāṃ saṃkhyāvācyābhyāṃ) sāmānādhikaraṇyam |
(netyāha-) tathā sati pañcaśabdaḥ akiṃcit- karo bhavati, pañcāśacchabdaṃ tu (saṃkhyāpradhānaṃ) viśeṣa- ṇyam arthavān (bhavati |
tadiha 'ṣaḍviṃśatirasrya vakṣyata:' iti vakṣyīṇāṃ pratinirdeśa: kāryārtha:|
kiṃ tarhi? avikṛta: ṣaḍvi- śatiśabda: prayoktavya:|
yadi hi karaṇatvena nirdiśyeta, tato'nena prakāśitaṃ kartavyaṃ na dhyānādineti mantrāntena dharmasaṃnipāta: syāt|
tatrāśakya- mavikṛtatvena yaugapadyaṃ kartumiti vikriyeta, abhyasyeta vā|
atha punaretakaraṇaṃ kriyamāṇatvādinayanakālamagniṣṭu- vacanamanena kasmina paśau codakenātra nipatitam|
kiṃ tarhi? ṣaḍ- viṃśatisaṃkhyāyā: saṃbandha: kartavya:|
yathā, dvipatnīke bahupatnīke vā prayoge patnīśabda: ekavacananānto na saṃkhyāyā patnī: paricchinatti|
dup- (sūtrāthamāha -) akaraṇena agniṣṭumā prakaraṇe samāmnānāt prakaraṇina: upakartavyam|

tat kathaṃ (ityapekṣāyāṃ) yathā śaknuyāt (iti upavadhyate) kiṃ ca śaknotyaṃ (kartuṃ?) iti (apekṣāyāṃ) kriyā- pradhānane (anena mantreṇa) yathāsamāmnātai: padai: abhi- dhānaṃ (kriyāmātraṃ kartuṃ) kartum|
tata: kimityata āha -) tatra vakṣyīṣvityādibhyāmnātāt aṣṭaṣṭaṃ yathā prakṛtau, tathā vikṛtāvāpi iti|
yat yatsaṃkhyāye āhṛtya tatsaṃkhyāyocyate, tatra vacanaprāmāṇyāt vipratipannasaṃkhyāśabdasya prayu- jyamānasyādyo'rtho'pyupagamyate|
na liha āhṛtya ṣaḍviṃśatiśabda: anekasmin paśau prayujyate|
tatra yat nyāyyaṃ tadyodaka: prāpayiṣyati, na āhṛtya ṣaḍ- viṃśatiśabdam|
kiṃ tanyāyyam? yat prakṛtau viva- kṣitam|
yadā ca na karaṇaṃ, tadā kathamayaṃ vakṣyī- yattāvacana:; śrutvā ṣaḍviṃśatisaṃkhyāvacana: eva bhavitu- marhatīti|
yadyapi nāsya tṛtīyā nirdeśa:, tathāpi prayogavacanenopagṛhīta: sādhako bhavan kamyaṃ dṛṣṭa- mupakāraṃ kariṣyati anyata: avadānaprakāśanāt|
prakaraṇān yāgamātreṇābhisaṃbaṃdhe sati ṛtvijāṃ praiṣa: iti gamyate|
tathārūpāṇi chātra vākyāni, 'daivyā: śamitāra uta manuṣyā ārabhadhvaṃ' iti|
yathā, yajamānaśabde 'ekayaja- mānavācini svasaṃkhyāvāci ekavacanamiti kṛtvā dviyaja- mānake ca prayoge svasaṃkhyāvacanapradeśād dviyaja- kriyate, eva- mihāpi|
yadi vakṣyīpaṭviṃśyalo: (śabdayo: prakṛtau) samavetārthatā nāmaviṣyat, tata: aṣṭaṣṭārthatāmavakalpayema|
asti tu samaveta: avadāna- saṃbadha: vakṣyīkārya: (tena vakṣyīśabdastāvat samave- tā:)|
sa ca (vakṣyīkārya:) svabhāvāt (prakṛtau) ṣaḍviṃśatayeva paricchinna: (tena saṃkhyāśabdo'pi samave- tāthe:)|
tasya (ca vakṣyīkāryasya) avadāt: (śamita:) saṃskāro dṛṣṭārthameva prasaraṇam|
tasmāt vakṣyīṇāṃ) prakāśanātha prakṛtau (agniṣṭuvacanam), tadvat (vikṛtau) apīti (samasya vacane kartavyam)|
yuktaṃ patnyāṃ, na tatrai- kapatnīke yajamāne patnīśabda: samāmnāta:, dvipatnīke,
yathā, ekasyā: patnyā: svasaṃkhyāvacana:, evaṃ dvayorbahūnāṃ ca svasaṃkhyāvacana: iti|
bhāṣya- tuśabdo'nyaṃ pakṣamavatārayati, na samasta vacanaṃ, saṃbyoha: syāditi|
nanu ṣaḍviṃśatī itya- midhāne vakṣyīṇāṃ prathamā na prāpnoti|
yadā ṣaḍviṃśatiguṇa: prādhānyena vivakṣito bhavati, tadviśeṣa ṇātheṃ saṃkhyayemyucyate, tadā prathamāntenāpi lakṣaṇayā saṃkhyā viśeṣyate|
yadā dvivedairvya- karmaṇo'rtho guṇo vivakṣito bhavati, tadaikavacanāntaṃ dvivaca- nānta: evendrāgnī iti śabdo lakṣaṇyā viśinaṣṭi|
tathā ca prayogo dṛśyate, 'pañcapañcāśatastriṃśat: saṃvatsarā:, pañca- pañcāśata: pañcapañcāśata: samadaśā:, pañcapañcā- śata ekaviṃśā:' iti saṃkhyāvacana: śabdastrivṛta iyanena lakṣaṇayā viśeṣyate|
evamavikā- raśca bhaviṣyati, sarvavakṣyīgāmī ca ṣaḍviṃśatidābdo bhaviṣyati|
tatra bhāṣyakāreṇa saṃkhyāsva- guṇapradhāno'yaṃ tasmāt vacanoha: ityuktā noditaṃ-) nanu ṣaḍviṃśatī ityamidhāne vakṣyīṇāṃ prathamā na prāpnoti (iti|
tasya) ko'rtha:? (kathaṃ saṃkhyāyā: prādhānyaṃ, yatredaṃ codya iti praśnātha:|
uttaraṃ -) guṇavacano hi kaścit dravyasaṃsṛṣṭaguṇavacano bhavati yathā śukla: paṭa: iti|
kaścit (tu) niṣkṛṣṭaguṇavacana: (bhavati) yathā śauklyaṃ paṭasya iti|
tatra (saṃkhyāśabdeṣu ye) prāk viśate: (te) saṃsṛṣṭaguṇavacanā: (eva yathā) 'pañca gāvo, daśa gāva:' iti|

(tatra) yadi iha dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ (tata:) 'vakṣya: ' iti prathamābahuvacananirdeśāt ṣaḍviṃśati- śabdanāpi (samānādhikaraṇena) bahuvacanāntena bhavitavyaṃ 'guṇavacanānāmādhayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti' iti (sara- ṇāt)|
nanu evaṃ vakṣya: iti prathamā na prāpnoti, ṣaḍvyā bhavitavyam|
tat (ca) parihṛtaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa (lakṣa- ṇyā sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti, vivṛtaṃ cāsmābhi: prāgeva prathamasūtre)|
saṃkhyā tvevaṃ pradhānaṃ syād, vakṣya: puna: pradhānam|
bhāṣya- satyamupapadyate eva vacanaṃ, ṣaḍviṃśatī vakṣya: iti|
vakṣya: puna: prakṛtau pradhānaṃ, na saṃkhyā|
tadevaṃ na prakṛtitvavidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet, tatra codaka eva prāpyeta|
dup- - 'saṃkhyā tvevaṃ pradhānaṃ syād vakṣya: puna: pradhānam' iti uktam (iti sūtraṃ nigadavyākhyātam|
pūrvoktaṃ codyamanubhāṣyate -) nanu evaṃ sati ṣaḍviṃśatī bahuvacanaṃ prāpnoti (anyathā vakṣyībhi: sāmānādhikara- ṇyāyogāt) |
ubhayatra (vakṣyīpade ṣaḍvi- śatipade ca yathākramaṃ) pratyayena prātipadikena (ca) upāttaṃ bahutvaṃ (sāmānyaṃ) tadiśeṣaṇa (ṣaḍviṃśatyā- tmaka:) |
tatra vakṣya: iti yat tadvat (pratyayagataṃ sāmānya- rūpaṃ) bahutvaṃ, yacca ṣaḍviṃśatiprātipadikagataṃ viśeṣarūpaṃ, tayo: (sahitayo:) |
yat ṣaḍviṃśatī ekavacanaṃ, tan viśeṣa- ṇyasya ekatvāt|
svabhāve'sau viṃśatyādīnāṃ yadete svābhi- dheyavartinīṃ saṃkhyāṃ bhajante, na tu dravyasaṃkhyām|

atha bahuvacanānvitābhirvāṅkrībhiḥ paścāt ṣaḍviṃśatisaṃkhyā lakṣyate 'vaṅkrīṇāṃ vā paḍviṃśatiḥ saṃkhyā' iti, tato- 'smatpakṣe'pi ekavacanānvitā paḍviṃśatisaṃkhyā paścāt vaṅkrīviṃśatihe paḍviṃśateḥ saṃvandhinyo yāḥ vaṅkrīyaḥ; tāḥ iti |
na tu lakṣitāsu vaṅkrīṣu paścāt vacana- yogaḥ, yena bahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ syāt |
) athavā paḍviṃśatiprātipadikena uktvāt bahuvasya, bahuvacane nivṛtte nirdeśamātrevacanamiti |
nanu dvau bahavaḥ ityatrāpi prātipadikena (dvitvavahutvayoḥ) uktvāt dvivahuvacane na prāpnutaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ - na khalvapyasmin pakṣe sarvamevā''mnātamu- cyate, anāmnātavacanamapi pratīyate iti, paḍviṃśati paḍviṃśataya iti |
atha dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vā anāpa- tayā na kriyate, naiva tāsāṃ vaṅkrīṇāṃ kātsyenābhidhānaṃ syāt |
na samāsavacanaṃ, abhyāsaḥ syāt, evamavikāro bhaviṣyati, tatrā''pa- codakau anugṛhyante, satvaṃ samāmnātaṃ kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati |
paśusvevaṃ pradhānaṃ syādabhyāsasya tannimittatvāt, yasmāt samāsaśabdaḥ syāt |
katham ? evaṃ sati paśuḥ prādhānyenātra nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt |
paśoḥ paśoḥ paḍviṃśatiḥ paḍviṃśatirvaṅkrīyo na kaścidapaḍviṃśativaṅkrīyaḥ paśuriti |
paśoḥ saṃkhyāsaṃbandhe abhidhisite evaṃ vacanaṃ bhavati |
na ca paśusaṃkhyā- saṃbandhaḥ prakṛtau vivakṣitaḥ ityuktam |
tā iti pratinirdeśādapi tāsāṃ pradhā- natā |
tasmāt dvipañcāśadanayorvaṅkrīyaḥ, aṣṭasaptatireṣāṃ vaṅkrīyaḥ ityevaṃ samastābhidhānameva nyāyyam |
soma--- nanu iyamadhikaraṇapravṛttirevānupapannā, yatra mantro vinibhuktaḥ, tatraitya prādhānyena pratipādyatayā bahu- pradhānanivandhanapakṣabhedānāmanena-nepāt iti cet |
syādevaṃ yadi śrutyādiniyogyaḥ syāt, na tvevaṃ, kiṃtu liṅgakaraṇaviniyogyaḥ, tayośca sādhāraṇyāt aneka- paśnopamesaṃbhavāt |
prakṛtau ekasya paśoḥ paḍviṃśati- saṃkhyāvaṅkrīvyabhidhānāt, iha ca paḍviṃśatisaṃkhyārūpaṇasya pratipaśu vibhaktatvāt |
tatra yadi yathāprakṛtyaiva avikāreṇa prayogaḥ, tadā gaṇe vaṅkrīṇāṃ kātsyenābhidhānaṃ na syāt |
na ca samasta vacanaṃ saṃbhavati, prākṛtasya sarvathā prādhenā- tyantikatvāt |
samāse'pi ekasya paśoḥ sarvābhi- vaṅkrībhiḥ saṃyogābhāvācceti |
bhāṭṭa-- tatraiva (atrigu-) preṣe 'paḍviṃśatirasa vaṅkrīyaḥ, tā anuprayocyāvayatat' iti śrutam |
tatra asya mantrasya karaṇamantrābhāve'pi samavetaprakāśakatva- saṃbhave asamavetāthatvasya anyāyatatvāt avikāra eva paśu- gaṇe iti tāvat anāśaṅkyam |
vikāro'pi kīdṛk iti cintāyāṃ, prakṛtitvapradhā natyāt pramāṇābhāvāt aśrutapadantarakalpanā''nupapatteḥ yāvatpaśugatasamasta-

ata eva prākṛtapadagrāhye pramāṇābhāvāt na ka cidapi ekavacanamohaḥ, 'aditiḥ pāśaṃ' 'medhapataye medhaṃ' ityādidapi abhyāsena sarvapāśādiprakāśanopapatteḥ ; aśrutadvivacanādyuhāhārāpekṣayā śrutatvenābhyāsakalpane lāghavācca, anyathā dvidhā tridhā ityevaṃ ūhenaiva prakāśanopapattau ekapādasyāpi abhyāsāpatteḥ |
na ca ekatvādinā prakṛtau ekatvatvādinā anudeśyatvāt apūrva- sādhanabhūtasaṃkhyātvena prakāśane ca vikṛtāvāpi paśubahu- tvādeḥ apūrvasādhanabhūtasya prakāśanāthaṃ bahuvacanādipra- pāvasaṃbhavaḥ |

'āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvaṃ, saumyaṃ babhruṃ' ityādi padekatvasyaiva tattadapūrvasādhanatvena bahula- syāvihitatvāt, 'prājāpatyān' ityādi yāgagrahaṇā- rthameva bahuvacanopādānena atideśāptasya paśve- katvasya tattadapūrvasādhanatvāt |
ataśca tatkathanārthe āvṛttireva śrutadasya yuktā, na tu sūryādipadavat padāntara- prakṣepaḥ |

yattu mūle etatpakṣasādhanārthe paḍviṃśatisaṃsyayā paśubhayasaṃbandhapradhānamidaṃ vākyaṃ pratipaśu bhedena tatsaṃbandhaṃ prakāśayituṃ abhyasanīyaṃ iti yuktirupamyasā, sā saṃbandhasya ṣaṣṭhyarthasya guṇatvena prādhānyā''ḍanupapatteḥ ; vākyārtharūpasya na aśābdatvena sutarāṃ tadanupapatteḥ ; prādhānye'pi ca tasya pratipaśu ūhenāpi prakāśanopapatteḥ abhyāse pramāṇābhāvāt upekṣitā |
ataḥ uktayuktyaiva padadvayābhyāsaḥ prasādhyate iti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ |
dvitīya- yastu, paśugaṇe ekaprayogavidhirihatānīnāṃ anekeṣāṃ sāṅgānāṃ yāgānāṃ yaugapadyāvagateḥ |
arthaprakāśanakāryāpi yaugapadyāvagamāt tadanurodhena yugapadekavākyakapadapakṣe- pasya āvaśyakatvāt na ka cit śrūyamāṇatvenāpyāsaḥ |
'aditiḥ pāśaṃ' ityādī tu guṇānurodhena pradhānaprāti- padikasya abhyāse pramāṇābhāvādi nāśo, api tu bahu- vacanādyūha eva |
yadyapi ca bahutvaṃ na kasya siddhaṃ, tathāpi pāśaprātipadikena anekapāśādāne sādhutvārthe tatkṣepa- syaiva āvaśyakatvāt |
na ca ekavacanāntapalīśabdavat pratyekavyastyabhiprāyeṇa ekavacanaprayogaḥ, tasya pāśaika- tvānekatvadehajanakatayā nirṇāyakatvābhāvāt prakṛtitva- dvāvādhaprasaṅgena aprayojakatvāt |
ata eva 'dvidhā anayosvau ācchayatāt' ityādyuhāhāre'pi ekatvatvaci prayatnasādhya-chedakatvasyakañjanakatayā nirṇāyakatvābhāvādeva agalā ekadhāpade abhyāsāṅgīkara- ṇam |
prakṛte tu vivakṣitārthaviṣaye saṃśayajanakatvābhāvāt yaugapadyasaṃpattaye ūhāṅgīkaraṇameva yuktam |
tatrāpi paḍvi- śatiprātipadike anyathātve pramāṇābhāvāt paḍviṃśatī paḍviṃśatayaḥ ityevaṃ vacane eva ūhaḥ |
tathāhi sarvatra dvau trayaḥ ityādayaḥ saṃkhyāśabdāḥ saṃkhyepyapradhānā eva |
ihārthatā ca tadyādhānye 'anyonyayoḥ pārśvayoravadyati' iti vacanāt sākalya- vagāmena tatprakāśanasya vyaṅgyatvāt |

na caivaṃ 'viṃśa- tirgāvā' itivat vaṅkrīṇāṃ guṇatve vaṅkrī- śabdasya padyantatvāpattiḥ, saṃkhyāprādhānye'pi 'deva- dattādayaḥ paśū' 'pañcapañcāśatstriṣataḥ' saṃvatsarāḥ ' ityādau lakṣaṇayā saṃkhyepyadāsya saṃvyāsāmānādhikaraṇya- darśanena vaṅkrīlakṣaṇayā vaṅkrīśabdasyāpi sāmānādhi- karaṇyopapatteḥ |
na ca lakṣaṇābhibhava vaṅkrīvaṅkrīprādhānyaṃ 'viṃśatirgāvaḥ' itivat iti vācyam |
'nāmārthayoḥ pākṣikānvaya- velāyāmapi abhedenānvayaḥ, iti niyamānaṅgīkāre tu mamāpi vaṅkrīṇāṃ samavetasaṃbandhena saṃkhyāyāmanvayopapatteḥ na lakṣaṇā |

na ca vaṅkrīśabdasya vaṅkrīlakṣaṇayā saṃkhyāviśeṣaṇatve tasyā ekatvena ekavacanapātiḥ, bahu- vacanasya svaśaktyāśrayasamavetavṛttitvasaṃbandhena ekatvala- ṇārthatvāt, tava mate'pi saṃkhyepyaprādhānye paḍviṃśatiḥ itye- kavacanena svaśaktyāśrayasamavetavṛttitvasaṃbandhena bahula- lakṣaṇāyā āvaśyakatvāt |
na caivaṃ vinigamanāvirāhaḥ, vaṅkrīpade jaghanyatvasya niyāmakatvāt |
iti prāpte, 'tā anuṣṭhayā ūccāvayatāt' iti vaṅkrīṇāmeva parāmarśat
saṃkhyā tu tadviśeṣaṇatvena upāttā- 'pi sākalyasūcikā iti nādṛśyārthatā''pattiḥ |
evaṃ ca ṣaḍviṃśatipadatayaikavacanasya bahulalakṣaṇārthatvena asama- vetārthatvāt naiva ūhasambhavā |
api tu pañcaviṃśatiprā- padike eva samavetārthatvāt ūhaḥ |
ataśca dvipañcāśadanayo- rvaidhukyaḥ iti samasta vacanameva yuktam |
kiṃca prakṛtatvāpi ekaikasmin pārśve trayodaśatrayodaśa vaṅkyaḥ samastyaiva ṣaḍviṃśatipadena uktāḥ |
iti ihāpi samastyaiva sarvāḥ prakā- śayitavyāḥ iti gamyate |
yadyapi ca nyāyasiddhamapi idaṃ samāsavacanaṃ 'ekathā pañcaviṃśatiriti dvivahanāṃ (dvirdviva- hanāṃ iti so. |

dvivahanāṃ paśūnāṃ saṃtrandhinī etau śabdau dviḥ brūyāta iti gārgyavṛttiḥ) ityākhyāyanasūtramūlabhūtaśrutyā sutrakṣaṇyā- ''havat ābhāsīkartumucitaṃ, tathāpi 'pañcaviṃśatiriti samāsaiva' iti sāṅkhyāyanasūtramūlabhūtaśrutyā sutrakṣaṇyāpaye samāsasthāpi abhyanujñānāt na virodhaḥ |
(vastutastu 'eke- kathā pañcaviṃśatiḥ pañcaviṃśatiriti, samāsena vā' ityeva sāṅkhyāyanaśrautasūtre 6|1|10 pāṭhaḥ |
'eṣa dyobhanataraḥ pakṣo'bhipreta ācāryāsya' iti tadbhāṣyaṃ samāsapakṣa- bhiprāyeṇa-ke |
) ata eva pakṣe abhyāso'pi dvivāra- meva, na tu yāvatpaśu |
agnīṣomīye paśau agnipraiṣe 'prāsā agniṃ bharata ' ityevamādi samāmnāye |
yadā ca agnīṣomīyaḥ paśuḥ savanīyasya pañcātra : samānavidhānāḥ iti pakṣaḥ svīkriyate tadā prāstai ityādipadaṃ uhitavyaṃ na veti vicāre siddhā- ntamāha atideśena |
tadā savanīya paśuṣu adhigau agnipraiṣe tadat pūrvādhikaraṇoktapavanīyata jñātavyam |
patnīśabde yathā nohaḥ, tathā prāstai ityādāvapi nohaḥ iti |
'āgnāvaiṣṇavaṃ prātaraprākpālaṃ nirvapet, sārasvataṃ caruṃ, bārhaspatyaṃ carum |
āgnāvaiṣṇavekādaśapālaṃ mādhyaṃdine, sārasvataṃ caruṃ, bārhaspatyaṃ carum |
āgnāvaiṣṇavaṃ dvādaśapālamaparāhne, sārasvataṃ caruṃ, bārhaspatyaṃ carum' iti |
(saumye adhvare yathā savanatrayaṃ tathā asyāmpi savanatraye yāga- trikatrayaṃ iti adhvarasāmyāt adhvarakalpā |
ke.) bhā. 11|2|4|19, 'yajñamevaitathā prāpnoti ' adhvarakalpāyā iṣṭeḥ idaṃ phalam |
12|4|4|19, 'yasya bhrātṛvyaḥ so'nena yajeta' mā. 11|2|4|19 anena adhvarakalpāyāḥ śyanādāḥ phalaṃ iti jñāyate |
paśu-mitra- vindā'dhvarakalpādyau sāmadaśasya prakaraṇavihitaṃ, tasyaiva atideśaprāptapāñcadaśyena niviśate |
'sata- daśa sāmidhenyo bhavanti' iti adhvarakalpādiṣu vākya- śeṣaḥ |
bhā. 10|1|9|32, trayāṇāṃ trikāṇāṃ 'kālabhedāt aṅgānāṃ gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ |
ke. 11|2|4|22, yadyapi atra trayastrikāḥ, tathāpi 'phalaikatvāt' 'so'nena yajeta' iti iṣṭivodhaḥ 'ekavacanānta: śabdaḥ yukta eva |
adhvarakalpāyāṃ āgnāvaiṣṇavadvādaśapālasya aindrāg- vikāratvāt āmāvāsyatantreṇa sarasvatayāṃ ājyabhāgāyāṃ
adhvara- kalpāyāṃ satyapi yāgatrayavidhāne 'etayaiva yajetā- bhirdhryamāṇaḥ' iti vākyāntareṇa abhicāranirāsātya- phaloddeśena sahitānāṃ vidhānāt trayāṇāmapi ekaprayoga- vidhiparigrahaḥ |
atra pūrvaṃ bārhaspatyasya dharmāḥ, tataḥ ājyasya, codako hi prayogavacanatāt bala- vattaraḥ |
'āgnāvaiṣṇava- mekādaśapālaṃ nirvapet, sarasvatamājyasya yajeta' ityatra ājyabhāgayoḥ pure'nuvākye dhrvanatyeva, na tu vārtraghnī avirodhe prathamasya pravalatvāt |
ke. āgnāvaiṣṇavyasya prathamaṃ nirvāpādyanuṣṭhānaṃ, tato bārhaspatyasya caroḥ: vaikṛta- mukhyakramānurodhāt, tataḥ sārasvatasyājyasya |
bhāṣya-- asyadhvarakalpā nāmeṣṭiḥ; 'āgnāvaiṣṇava- mekādaśapālaṃ nirvapet, sarasvatayājyābhāgā syāt, bārha- spatyaścaḥ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ: kimāgneyavikārasya bārha- spatyasya pūrvaṃ dharmāḥ? codako balavattaraḥ: prayogavaca- nāt, utopāṃśuyājavikārasya prayogavacano balavattaraśrau- dakāditi |
kiṃ prāptam? vikṛtau asyāṃ yathāpradhānaṃ syāt, tadvacanāt |
tena saṃni- hitānāmaṅgānāmupasaṃhāraḥ: prayogavacano hi pratyakṣaḥ; taddha- rmāṇāṃ cā''numānikaḥ |
ṭup-- tṛtīyaḥ (bārhaspatyaḥ ekadevatyatvāt aupadha- dravyakatvācca) āmeyavikāraḥ |
prathamaḥ (tu āgnāvaiṣṇavaḥ dvidevatyatvāt aupadhadravyatvācca) agnīṣo- mīyaṃ vikaroti |
itarayostu cintā) kiṃ prathamaṃ āmeya- vikārasya (bārhaspatyasya) dharmāḥ kāryāḥ: codakasāma- rthyāt, uta upāṃśuyājavikārasya (sārasvatasya dharmāḥ)
kiṃ prāptaṃ? pradhānānāmatra pratyakṣapāṭhāt mukhyakramo balīyavān |
tasmāt (ānumānika- tvāt) pratyakṣaṃ prayogavacanaṃ parigṛhītaḥ kramo balīya- vān |
bhāṣya-- mukhyākramavipratipattau vā, yathā prakṛtau tathaiva vikṛtau bhavitumarhatīti |
yādṛśāḥ prakṛtau dharmāstādṛśā eva vikṛtau bhavitumarhantīti mukhyakrameṇa kriyamāṇā na prakṛtivikṛtāḥ |
sa prāpte- pūtpannaḥ prātinimittaka uttarakālaḥ: pūrvaprāptaṃ na bādhituma- rhati codakaṃ pratyakṣo'pi san, vahirlakṣaṇatvāt |
tasmāt pūrvaṃ bārhaspatyasya dharmāḥ, tata ājyasyeti |
ṭup-- mukhyaprāptikau (kramau) prayogavacanā- śritatvāt durbalau, śrutyarthapāṭhakāṇḍānāṃ (tu) codakāśrayatvāt balīyastvam |

kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? kathamilā- kāṅkṣāyāṃ (vikṛtibhāvanāyāṃ) utpannāyāṃ (satyāṃ) yā (prākṛta-) padārthalocanā artha (agnyādhānādi- padārthaḥ) iti, sā utpattiriva utpattiḥ (prathamā'va- gatiḥ ityupacaryate), tādṛśān avaghṛtāna (padārthān) prāpayati (vikṛtau viniyuṅkte) |
tata uttarakālaṃ prayogavacanaḥ (utpannān viniyuṅkte) samīkṣya (prākṛtān) kṛtsnān upasaṃ gṛhṇāti (anujñāpayati) |
prakṛte kimāyātaṃ tadāha-) upasaṃharan (ca) yādṛśāścodakena prāpitāḥ, tādṛśānupasaṃ gṛhṇāti (nānyathā- daśān) |
tena (codakena ca yathāprakṛti) viśiṣṭa- kramakā eva prāpyante |
ataḥ pratyakṣasyāpi (prayogavaca- nasya ānumānikādi) codakādeva uttarakālaṃ ātma- lābhāt durbalatvam |
(kathaṃ durbalatvaṃ tadāha-) yaśca (tadadhīnātmalābhatvamāha-) yāvadutpattirnāsti, na tāvat prāptiḥ |
aṅgatve cāva- dhṛte ( paścāt prayogavacanena ) samīpasthasya ( aṅgasya ) saṃgrahaḥ ( prayogaḥ ) |
tasāt prayogavacanasya paścātkālī- natvāt tadāśrayo yaḥ kramaḥ, sa āśrayasya ( prayoga- vacanasya ) daurbalyāt ( pravalacodakāt ) durbalaḥ |
ata āha ( bhāṣyakāraḥ ) uttarakālaḥ ( prayoga- vacanaḥ ) pūrvakālaprāptaṃ ( codakaṃ ) na bādhitumarhati pratyakṣo'pi san bahiraṅgatvān ( pāścātyāt ) |
kiṃ prayogacoditāṅgapradhānaprayāsasya- nugrahāt mukhyakrameṇājyadharmāṇāṃ prathamanuṣṭhānaṃ, uta coda- kavadājyadharmāḥ pūrvaṃ bārhaspatyasyaupadharmāḥ kartavyā iti |
te ca sakramakā eva prāpyante codādiha |
soma - aupadeśikakramayorbalavalavicārānantaraṃ aupa- deśikātideśikayoḥ tadvicārāt saṃgatiḥ |
nanu prayoga- vacanaśrodakāpekṣayā durbala iti dvādaśe 'jaimineḥ paratantratvāpatteḥ svatantrapratiṣedhaḥ syāt |
tat kathamaਿਹ prayogavacanaprābalyena pūrvapakṣa iti cet, satyaṃ, anyatra prayogavidhi- durbalaḥ, kramaviṣaye tu sa eva prabalaḥ, sarvatra kramaklpteḥ prayogavidhivyadhīnatvāt iti pūrvapakṣyāśayaḥ |
padārthaprāpya- dhīnatvāt prayogavidheḥ, tatyāścodakādhīnatvāt codako- pajīvitayā prayogavidhividurbala iti siddhāntapakṣyābhiprāyaḥ |
evaṃ ca svayaṃ kalpanā'śaktasyāpi prayogavidheḥ kalpanā- mulocchedāt na kramāntarakalpakatvaṃ iti kramaviṣaye'pi prayogavidhividurbalaḥ |
sūtrārthastu-vikṛtau yathāpradhānaṃ kramaḥ syāt, padārthānāṃ yathāpradhānakramavacanaprayogavidhivalāt iti |
bhāṭṭa - idānīmatideśikapāṭhakramāpekṣayā vikṛtau mukhyakramasya valavatvaṃ cintyate |
adhvarakalpyāyāṃ 'āgnā- vaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet, saraslajyābhāgā syāt, bārhaspatyaśca' : iti śrutam |
atra satyapi vākya- trayeṇa yāgatrayavidhāne 'etayaiva yajetābhiścaryamāṇaḥ' iti vākyāntareṇa abhicāranirāsāsyaphalodde- śena sahitānāṃ vidhānāt trayāṇāmapi ekaprayoga- vidhiparigrahaḥ |
iti kecit samānākṣaradvitāntapaṭhakatvāt āgnī- pomīyasyeti vadanti |
tatra ājyadravyakāgadharmāpekṣayā āgnāvaiṣṇavasya dharmāḥ ātideśikapāṭhamukhyakramayorivirodhāyadeva prathamataḥ kāryāḥ |

bārhaspatyasya tu mukhyakramāt paścāt kāryāḥ, uta ātideśikapāṭhakramāt pūrva iti cintāyāṃ, mukhya- kramasya aupadeśikaprayogavidhivṛttitvena aupadeśikatvāt satyapi atideśottarakālatve śarādivat vādhopapatte- rmukhyakramasya valavattvam |

iti prāpte, prayogavidheḥ aupade- śikatve'pi svarūpeṇa mukhyakramasya kalpyatvāt śaranyāyānu- papatteḥ, kalpanāyāṃ cāpekṣāmūlatvena prayogavidhivyupajīvya- prāthamikātideśaprāpitapāṭhakrameṇaiva ākāṅkṣayā ucchedāt dvenādau atideśikanānāprakṛtitvādeva atideśi- kapāṭhakramaprāpitakramasyaiva valavattvam |
tadetat siddhamapi codakasya prayogavidhivyapekṣayā valavattvaspaṣṭīkaraṇārthaṃ krama- lakṣaṇe punarucyate iti mantavyam |
na caivaṃ āgnāvaiṣṇava- bārhaspatyadharmāṇāṃ prākṛtakramakrameṇaiva anuṣṭhānapatteḥ yājñikānāṃ vaikṛtamukhyakramānurodhena āgnāvaiṣṇavasya prathamaṃ nirvāpyānuṣṭhānaṃ virudhyeteti vācyam |

hi yatra pāṭhādipramāṇakaḥ kramaḥ; tatra 'tatpadārthānantaraṃ tadarthādeḥ kāryaḥ' iti viśeṣaiva vākyakalpanāṃ, mukhya- kramastu lāghavāt dharmigrāhakapramāṇabalāt 'ādyapradhāna- dharmāṃnantaraṃ uttarapradhānadharmā anuṣṭheyāḥ' ityeva kalpyaṃ, na tu viśiṣṭaṃ, na vā āgneyādipraveśaḥ |
ata eva vikṛtau apūrvāgneyaveśo'pi na vākyāntarakalpyaṃ ityapi lāghavam |
evaṃ pravṛttikrame'pi 'klṛptakramakāṅgamavṛttikrameṇa itare padārthāḥ kartavyāḥ' ityekāvākyakalpanām |
ataśca vikṛ- tāvapi 'ādyapradhānadharmāṃnuṣṭhānottarameva dvitīyapradhāna- dharmāṃnuṣṭhānaṃ' iti āgnāvaiṣṇavasya prathamaṃ nirvāpaḥ; paścāt bārhaspatyasya |
evaṃ sādyatke sthānakramakramopākaraṇasya vācanikātideśavattvayāṃ kasya cidvikṛtī vācanikopā- karaṇapatye vyalastopakaraṇapravṛttayeva niyojanādikam |
evaṃ ca keṣāṃ cit etādṛśaviṣayadvaye'pi yājñikācāre mūlaṃ cintyaṃ iti prakṛtitatkramakramaiva siddhāntakaraṇaṃ mūlyoktatvātpapekṣyam |
ata ātideśikapāṭhavirodhe eva mukhyakramāderdāvalyaṃ iti sthitam |
viśeṣataśca adhvarakalpā- nyāyena tasyopasthitatvāt tasyaiva dīkṣākāle apakarṣaḥ |
bhāṣya - idaṃ śrūyate ( adhvarakalpe ) 'āgnā- vaiṣṇavaṃ prātarākapāle nirvapet, sārasvataṃ caruṃ, bārha- spatyaṃ carum |
āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ mādhyādine, sārasvataṃ caruṃ, bārhaspatyaṃ carum |
kiṃca yasyāparāhṇe (dvādaśa- kapāladinarvāpasya ) karaṇaṃ prātaṃ (pradhānakālatvāt,) tasya na prātaḥsāmānyaṃ (prātaṃ,) nāpi prātarviśeṣaḥ |
yasya tu pūrvohṇe karaṇaṃ (prātaṃ ) tasya prātarviśeṣamātraṃ vidhīyate, sāmānyaṃ prātameva |
bhāṣyaṃ— yattu viśeṣasya ekakālatvāt iti, tatra brūmaḥ |
prathamasya karmaṇo yo nirvāpaḥ, tasyaitat kālavacanaṃ 'purā vācaḥ pravaditornirvāpeta' iti |
trayāṇāṃ ca nirvāpāṇāṃ kramaprāptasya pūrvasyaiva vijñāyate |
bhāṣyaṃ— yattu itiriti, bhinnānāmapi karmaṇāmeka- phalānāṃ phalasyaikatvameva ekavacanaṃ bhavati, phalāntatvā- dīhāyāḥ |
yathā sarvapṛṣṭheṣṭiḥ, mṛgareṣṭiḥ, sumanā nāmeṣṭiḥ iti |
śa— tatra (adhvarakalpyāyāṃ) kimjñānaṃ tantraṃ, uta trayāṇāmapi trikāṇāmatha trirajyānīti |
tadarthamidaṃ cintyate 'purā vācaḥ pravaditornirvāpeta' iti kiṃ sarvervāpasyāpakaḥ, uta prātaḥkālīnasyaiveti |
yathoktakramaṃ ca samāpanaṃ, iti uttareṣāmāpi ajñānāṃ tantram |
( iti prāpte ucyate ) syādevaṃ yadi nirvāpaḥ sarvaimāpakṛtyate |
tasmāt prātarmadhyaṃdināparāhnavartināṃ pradhānānāṃ aṅgānyāpi tatra- tatrāvartanīyāni iti tantramevaḥ |
soma— 'indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ dhṛṣṭake bhrātṛvyo yajamānaḥ, yajamānasya adhvarakalpaṃ prati nirvapet bhrātṛvye yajamāne, nāsyendriyaṃ vīryaṃ dhṛkte ' iti śatrūṇāṃ kriyamāṇayāgaprati-
iha satyapi trikatrayasya kāla- mede nāṅgānāṅgāvṛttiḥ ityuttiḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- adhvarakalpyāyāṃ paśuvat aṅgānāṅgatantratā syāt viśe- pasya nirvāpāntakalpasya ekakālatvavacanāt iti |
upasya- śeṣanirvāpāt tad-dvārā'ṅgāpakarṣaṇāt, prātarnirvāpaśeṣe- dhyānmugvakālaya micchatā ||'
bhāṭṭa— adhvarakalpyāyāṃ 'āgneyyāvaṃ prātaraṣṭākapālaṃ0 so'nena yajeta' iti śrutam |
atra ca 'yasya bhrātṛvyaḥ so'nena ' iti vākyena navānāpi yāgānāṃ phale vini- yogatāt ākhyāyatemādacca tat tāvat pṛthagvākyam |

pūrvaṃ ca yadi ekameva vākyaṃ syāt, tadā navabhiḥ dravyadevatāsaṃśrayaiḥ navasu vāgeṣu kalpiteṣu tattad-dravyadevatāviśiṣṭāvayāga- vidhāne kṛte pārthikānāṃnyavelāyāṃ dravyāntare devatānantara- saṃbandhasyāpi āpatteḥ mijñānyeva etāni utpattivākyāni naya |
tattkālīnaprayogavicitraśca na āgneyyāvamanāsya, tathātve sārasvatabārhaspatyayoḥ triḥpāṭhaivyapyate |

na ca prātarādipadāni triṣvapi anupapannāt ekaikasmin kāle ekaikavikaprayogāśrayakā, utpatti- vidhereva prayogāvācitatparyasya anupapannasya ca kalpanā- pekṣayā nirvapeditidātupeṣaṇa ' prātarnirvepeta ' ityasya vākyāntarakalpanāyā evocitatvāt |
ata eva tena ānantyāt trihavika eva prayogo vidhīyate |
tadevaṃ sthite 'purā vācaḥ pravaditornirvāpeta' itideśaprāpte nirvāpe kālaviśeṣaḥ śrutaḥ |
sa kiṃ prātarkālīna- havipameva, uta sarveṣāṃ iti cintāyāṃ, aviśeṣāt sarve- ṣāmeva |

na ca prātaḥkālīnahaviṣāṃ pakṣe tatkālīna- nirvāpaprāpteḥ niyamamātrakaraṇe lāghavāt mādhyāhnikapa- rāhikahavirnirvāpasya ca pakṣe'pi etatkālasyasadbhāvena tatra tadvidhāne apūrvavidhiteḥ lāghavānurodhena prātaḥ- kālīnahavirnirvāpasyaiva ayaṃ kālaviśeṣavidhiḥ iti vācyam |
prātaḥkālasya udayottarakālīnatvena tatkālīna- havirnirvāpasyāpi vākyavadanāt pūrvaṃ aprasaktatvāt,
atastyāgānāṃ caturakṣaradevatātvena paurṇamāsīvikāratayā udayottarameva sarvanirvāpasya atideśaprāptatvāt |
ataśca sarvanirvāpakarpe tadantākapanyāyena (5|1|12|14) ' nirvāpāntapadārthānāṃ sarvaprayogīṇāṃ tantreṇa karaṇaṃ, yatho- pakramaṃ ca samāpana' iti niyamāṅgīkāre ca uttarāṅgānāmapi |
iti prāpte, devatāgataikatvasaṃkhyeyāpekṣā tadakṣaragata- catuṣṭvasaṃkhyāyā antaraṅgatatvāt sārasvatabārhaspatyayo- stāvat āgneyavikāratvameva |
āgneyyāve'pi aṣṭā- kapālasya tyāgagatadravyatatkapālasaṃbandhāt rūpasya tyāgā- ṅgatvoddeśatadevatādāśrayākṣarasaṃkhyeyārūpacatuṣṭvatvā- pekṣayā antaraṅgatatvāt āgneyavikāratvameva |

ataśca prāta:- kālīnayāgātrayasya āgneyavikāratvāt tasya ca paurṇa- māsyāmāvāsyāsādhāraṇatvena 'udita āditye paurṇamāsyā- srtantraṃ prakramyati, prāgudayādāmāvāsyāyāḥ ' itivacana- vihitasya udayaprākālīnātvasyāpi nirvāpe pakṣaprāptatvāt tatraiva vākyapradanapūrvakālīnalanīyopapatteḥ apūrvavidhi- niyamavidhiyuktatvairuppyaparihārya prātaḥkālīnasya nirvā- pasyāpakarṣaḥ |
na ca atideśikasya udayaprākālīnalasya aupadeśikena prātaḥkālena bādhāt tatrāpi pakṣaprāpyabhāvaḥ |
'evaṃ prātaropadeyaṃ vyupite udite vā' iti āśvalāyana- sūtravyavahāreṇa (āśvaśrau. 2|4|23-24) udayāt pūrvamapi prātaḥkālasattvāt |
ataśca mādhyāhnikaprāhi- kayoḥ nirvāpakarṣābhāvāt na tantreṇāṅgāni |

yadā'pi 'sarasvatyājyābhāgā' iti āgnāntaravacanāt madhyamasyo- pāṃśuyājavikāratvaṃ, tadā'pi upāṃśuyājasya brahmacabrāhmaṇe (kaupītaki.) amāvāsyāyāmapi vidhānena sādhā- raṇyamupapādya siddhāntaḥ samarthanīyaḥ |
adhvaryuḥ uttaravedyāṃ sthitvā preyati, maitrāvaruṇastu sadasi sthitvā preṣyati |
adhvaryuḥ etena prakāśitamanuṣṭhāsyāmīti (ādhvaryavahādimantrān paṭhet ), yajamānastu na pramadiṣyāmīti |
grahahomayā- putratvena kadā vidaśaktau camasādhvaryavo juhuyuḥ |
vi. 3|1|22, 'adhvaryurhetapati dīkṣayitvā ' ityādidīkṣā- vākye nirdiṣṭā adhvaryuprabhṛtayaḥ ṛtvijaḥ ṣoḍaśa, na tu camasādhvaryavaḥ iti niyamo draṣṭavyaḥ |
'adhvaryu- rhetapati dīkṣayitvā ' ityādinā sarve tatsaṃskārakadīkṣo- ttarakālavidhānāt kāṇḍānusamaya eva satre |
'adhvaryurhetapati dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati ' iti na dīkṣā vidhīyate |
nāsau yajamānasya, na vā'dhvaryuḥ kartā, sarvasya codakena prāptatvāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? dīkṣākramaḥ aniya- mena prāptaḥ san niyamyate |
'adhvaryurhetapati dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati tata udgātāraṃ ' ityādinā brahmodgātrādisamākhyāsaṃyogadīkṣāsaṃyo- gayoḥ : ārciṣyayajamānayotayoḥ pratimānāt satre yaja- mānā eva ṛtvijaḥ |
adhvaryuḥ darbhapūrṇa- māsādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ sāṅgānāṃ kartā |
nahi yathā tatra manvādibhiḥ kṣatriyasya pūrvapakṣaṃ racayati sa |

iti na rakṣaṇaṃ vihitaṃ tat rājakarmatvena jñāyamānaṃ pratyayārthatvaṃ prati- jñāyate kiṃ kṛtyapuruṣārthamabhiprāyaṃ uta kṛtyasarvārthamabhiprāyaṃ, padyate, tayeha kena cit sāmīdhenyavacanāderhotṛkarmatvaṃ tatrāpi kiṃ vākyasaṃyuktasarvārthāḥ , utāsaṃyuktasarvārthāḥ |
na caivaṃ sati yadi tāvat puruṣārthī abhiprāyaḥ , sa varaṇabharaṇayoḥ |
uktaṃ hi 'prakaraṇaviśe- mavayavavyutpattau viniyogaḥ ? uktametacchabdasāmyānmātrā- pādvā tadyuktasya saṃskāro dravyatvat' (3|4|156) ityā- diti |
tathā dadaśe vakṣyati 'nirdeśādvā vaidikānāṃ syāt' (1|2|1312 ) iti |
tasmādevaṃ tāvanna sarvārtha- na vyutpadyate, tataḥ antareṇaiva kartṛkarmasaṃbandhaṃ rūḍhyā tvam |
nāpi saṃyukteṣu 'tān puroḍāśaṃyurvibhajati' ityādi- sārūpyamāsthayopapannatvāt nārthapattiḥ śrutiṃ kalpayet |
yāni tvaṃsyuktāni nahi varṇasāmyānmātraṃ śālāmālyoḥ kaścit saṃtravaḥ |
kāryāṇi , tāni yatra tatra vede paṭhitāni yena kena tathā ca vakṣyati (10|4|1246) nahi kalpyayaṃtare cit kartrā yathāsāmarthyaṃ kartavyānīti sarvāsāṃḥ |
yadapi ca kṛte rājñaḥ karma- diti - sarvāṇi hi kāryāṇi śaknuvanti tān prayoktum |

tasmādyathaiva tatra nityāyereva śabdā- puruṣakāryamiti yattat karmaṇi puruṣaiḥ prāgavacanaviśeṣāt thayornitye eva saṃtrave sādhyatve pratīyamāne sādhutvaprati- svasāmarthyena śakyate tattat ityevaṃ yujyate, na puruṣārthābhi- pattivelāyāṃ rājaśabdamanvākhyāya rājyaśabdo'nyākhyāya- prāyeṇa |

māno yaugikaḥ : tannimittaśrayamāṇo'pi nityanimitta- tvāt na ādimattvaṃ pratipadyate, tathaiva hātṛmiti buddhi- tatsayogāt karmaṇo vyavasthā syāt, saṃyoga- darśanāddotṛśabdāt 'tasyedaṃ karma' ityevamanvākhyānamiti sthyāttvat |
kena tu tattasya karmāvagatamiti ? samākhyā- darśanāt tadeva tādṛśaṃ vacanamanumāsyāmahe |
tarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti samākhyātastadvanaṃ, tena klṛpte saṃyoge ye yena puruṣeṇa samākhyāyante, te tena kartavyāḥ |
sā tu kena nimittena pravṛtteti maddharyuṇā, hotṛ hotā, audgātramudgātreti |
tasmā- nnumīdaśī śrutiriti, yathā hotā kartṛvyametaditi |
nahi hotṛ- sarveṣu eva liṅgādiṣu evametadavatiṣṭhatīti vyākhyātam (balā- makurvato hotṛsamākhyā arthavatī bhavati |
tasmādanyathā''nupapattyā 'ākhyā caivaṃ tadarthatvāt' (3|1|6|13) ityanenai- kalpitayā śrutyā viniyogaḥ |
satyaṃ siddhaṃ na tu tatra virodhāvi- nirapekṣayoreva rūḍhirūpeṇa kartṛkarmasamākhyayoḥ prasiddhayoḥ |
kutaḥ ? tvaprasaktyā virodhamāśaṅkya pariharati, uttaravivakṣayā vā 'saṃyogaḥ pūrvasiddho hi nimittatvaṃ prapadyate |
' hotṛ- śabdāstvaṃ hotṛnimitta iti rājaśabdavadeva pratyaya- śā—nānākartṛ siddheyu sāṃprataṃ saṃdhāyate |
na ca vyavasthitaṃ teṣāṃ kārye vinā vyavasthitam ||
soma—'śālaphalaṃ prayoktari' (3|7|8|188) ityādinā pravṛttyopadeśāttasyasaktānupravaktasya ca samāpyā prāptāvasaro'yaṃ vicāraḥ |
) sūtre prayuktatvāt ṛtvijāṃ sarvapadārthakaraṇa- śakyā padārthaiḥ sarvaiḥ prayuktatvāt ityarthaḥ |
vi—'na kāryaṃ niyataṃ teṣāṃ niyataṃ vā, ''śrito yataḥ |
śaktāḥ, kena kimityatra niyatiḥ syāt samā- khyayā |
bhāṭṭa—tattatkratuṣu pramitātāṃ teṣāṃteṣāṃ kartṛṇāṃ avyavasthayaiva asati viśeṣavidhau liṅgakaraṇamayāṃ tat- syādarthakatvaṃ, na tu tathā durbalayā ādhvaryavādisamā- khyayā saṃkocaḥ |
sthitā- duttaraṃ ) nātra samākhyayā liṅgakaraṇamayovirodhaḥ, kiṃtu tābhyāmanvayasyā prāptānāṃ kartṛṇāṃ vyavasthāmātramapekṣata kriyate |
ataśca hautrasamākhyātāḥ padārthāḥ hotā kartavyāḥ, ādhvaryavasamākhyātāśca adhvaryuṇā, audgātra- samākhyātā udātrā |
sarveṣu hi ṛgyajurvedasāmavedeṣu ye padārthā vihitāḥ, teṣāmetāḥ krameṇa samākhyāḥ |
yaugikāśca ete śabdāḥ na padārthānāṃmādhvaryavādidisaṃbandhavyatirekeṇa saṃbhavanti iti teṣu teṣāṃ yogyatāt kartṛtvasiddhiḥ |
adhvardīivat karmatvena parikrītasya patnīpuṃsānaṃ, yajamānasya śriyaṃ adhvardīivat svasa- yāge parikrīyeti cet |
ratna. 6|1|4. adhvardīivat—palyā na prābhākaramata iya anumātimātre kartṛtvaṃ, anumateryajijñāsārthatvābhāvena anumatyā tadanu- kulācaraṇe'pi adhvardīivat yāgakartṛtvānupapatteḥ |
ato na kevalaṃ yajamānenaiva devatoddeśena dravyatyāgaḥ kartavyaḥ, kiṃtu patnyā api, iti vyāsaktameva tayoḥ kartṛtvam |
soma. 6|1|4. adhvardīivatsamākhyā- nurodhena jyotiṣṭome dvādaśaśatadakṣiṇāyā vibhāgaḥ |

prakṛtivikāratvāt (vastutaḥ ) anyonyānapekṣau nityaṃ ca arthānvitau, tathāpi śabdasya artha prayogavyākhyāḥ prakṛteḥ kūṭasthanityatvābhāvāt, nityasya ca naimittika- katve'pi avirodhāt ādhvaryavaśabdapravṛttau vācyatvena adhvaryaśabdārthānvayasya nimittatvāt adhvaryaśabdasya ādhvaryavaśabdo prati nimittatvābhupacarya prakṛtivikāra- tvākhyānam |
'anadavāhāṃ yunakti' atra dvitvasya kāraka- dvārā kriyā'nvayaḥ |
tathā ca dvayoreva yojanaṃ, naikasya bahūnāṃ vā |
vi. 4|1|5. 'anadavāhāṃ yunakti' ityatra paśuṃ itivat dvitvasya vivakṣitatvaṃ draṣṭavyam |
'anatidiśyaṃ stṛṇāti' ( yathā kevalā vediḥ na draṣṭuṃ śakyeta tathā dairācchādanaṃ anatidiśyaṃ staraṇam |
anadhikṛtatvā anācāraḥ ( yasmin karmaṇi svādhikārā'sti tat sāpekṣā adhikṛtaṃ karma |
na adhikṛtaṃ anadhikṛtaṃ svādhikārāviṣayabhūtaṃ karma anadhikṛtaṃ, tasya kriyā karaṇam |
yathā kaścit śrā rātrau svāmigṛhasaṇaṃ kurvan cauramāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā'pi na vamape |
kuta etaditi gardamena pṛṣṭaḥ kukku- kuro vabhāṣe ahamanādhikṛtaḥ tvayā nātra kiṃ cidaktavya- miti |

laukikaśabdajanyajñānaṃ tu na pramā anadhitāārthagantṛtvā- bhāvāt |

( syāt ityatra sā iti pāṭhaḥ ubhayatra, padamañjarī nāma kāśi- kāyāḥ ṭīkā |

tadanenā'- nanyalabhyaḥ śāstrārtha iti nyāyena medasa prāptatvena tatra na tātparyaṃ, kiṃcidaite eva vedavākyānāṃ tātparyamiti pūrṇa- praśīye uktamiti |

nyāyāmṛtādvaitasiddhī bhūmikā pṛ. 4. anapāyaśca kālasya lakṣaṇaṃ hi puroḍāśau iti nyāyaḥ (10|8|169) |

anapāyaśca iti guṇasūtre 'upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati' ityantarālopa- lakṣaṇapuroḍāśadvayakāryānvābhāvāt 'nāsomayājino brāhmaṇasyāmīmīyaḥ puroḍāśo vidyate' iti asoma- yājino brāhmaṇasya ekapuroḍāśayāmi paurṇamāsyāṃ upāṃ- śuyājo'sti iti vyavasthāpayiṣyate |

soma. 5|1|18. anapāyaśca kālasya iti nyāyena ekapuroḍāśāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmiva amāvāsyāyāmapi upāṃśuyājopapattiḥ |
