yathā somavamaneḥ vaidikasomasya vamane, na tu lauki- kasya iti |
tacca abhi- hitatvaṃ na tiṅādivācyatvaṃ tatpratipādyatvamātraṃ vā |
tathātve 'pācakena gamyate', 'caitreṇa bhuktvā gamyate' ityādau tṛtīyāntātpatteḥ kṛtpratyayena kartṛtvātkatvāt kvāpratya- yena samānakartṛkaloktyā kartṛpadābhāvāt |

nāpi abhi- hitasaṃkh‍yākatvaṃ, 'caitreṇa pakkaḥ' iti vat 'caitreṇa pācakaḥ' iti prayogāpatteḥ, sūtre lakṣaṇasaptamyante, 'viṣayakṣo- 'pi saṃvarca svayaṃ chettumasādhu' iti nipātena 'yujyate' iti kriyābhidhāyakena saṃsyānabhidhānāt vṛkṣamiti dvitīyā- ''patteśca |
api tu yad yadvibhaktisaṃbandhaṃ svānvayakriyā- pratipādakena padena śrutyā pratipādyate tattvam |
asti cedaṃ 'caitraḥ pacati, odanaḥ pacyate' ityādau caitrādivṛtti- kartṛkarmatvādeḥ niruktapadena pratipādanāt |
'pācakena gamyate' ityādau ca kṛdupāttasya puruṣasya gamanakriyaiva anvayinī, na tu pākakriyā, tasyā eva tasminnanvayāt |
tadvṛtti ca kārakatvaṃ na karmādyatena abhihitaṃ, iti yujyaiva tatra tṛtīyā |
evaṃ caitreṇa ityasya bhujikriyāyā- manvayāt gamanakriyāyāmevānvayāṅgīkārāt tṛtīyopa- pattiḥ |

'mayaiva paktvā mayaiva bhujyate' ityatra tu paktvā ityanena kartṛpāttvāt na kartṛ 'mayā' ityādiyutīyā, api tu 'ātmānamātmanā vetsi' 'anenaiva jīvenā- tmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi' ityādivat karaṇe, iti na kā cidanupapattiḥ |
'paktvā odano bhujyate' ityādī tu paścātoḥ karmākāṅkṣāyāṃ dvitīyā- nodanapadādyāhāreṇa vākyapūraṇam |
suptasya kārakasya guṇabhūtakriyāyāmapi uktiḥ iti niyame pramāṇamasti, yena adhyāhāraṃ vinā'pi vākyaṃ sama- rthyeta |
tathātve 'odanaṃ bhuktvā śāstraṃ pacyate' 'śrutvā'pyatha nānumatastena so'rthaḥ kubuddhinā' ityādi- dvitīyāprayogānupapatteḥ |

yadi tu uktaprayogeṣu anā- śvāsaḥ, 'mayaiva paktvā mayaiva bhujyate' ityatra ca kartari eva ādyā tṛtīyā, 'paktvā odano bhujyate' ityatra nādhyāhārāṅgīkaraṇaṃ, tathā uktaniyamamaṅgīkṛtya katvāpra- yasyāpi ca bhāve eva śaktimaṅgīkṛtya tadarthasya bhāvasya pūrvakālatvasamānakartṛkatvasaṃsargeṇa uttarakriyāyāṃ anya- yo''ṅgīkriyate, tadā astu yad-vṛttikārakaraṇaṃ svānvayi- pradhānakriyāpratipādakena padena vṛttyā pratipādyate tattvaṃ abhihitatvaṃ, tadabhāvaḥ anabhihitatvaṃ, tatra tṛtīyā iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
evaṃ sati 'laḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ tiṅādyanvitaṃ vācyaṃ, prathamāntasya ananvayāt |
ataśca lasya itisūtratrayavyāpyatiḥ, lādeśabhūtaśānajādeḥ kartrā- divācitvānupapattiḥ |
na ca 'kartari kṛt' ityanena tadvācitvaṃ, tathātve'pi karmaṇi bhāve cākamekebhyaḥ tavāteḥ sūtrāntaraprāptau evā'nveti |
lāghavena vṛttyā taddravyatvasyaiva śāstratātparya- viṣayatvena śakyatve tadvāpārākalpanāt |
sā tu prādhānyaṃ vinaiva sidhyati iti siddhamākhyāte kartarderavācyatvaṃ, śānajādau ca vācyatvaṃ iti |
'lasya' iti sūtrasya ca tiṅādīnāṃ lādeśalavidhāyakasya na vaiyarthyam |
bhāṭṭa. 3|4|8 pṛ. 322-24. anabhihita- śabdaḥ eva (anabhihite iti pāṇinīsūtre 2|3|1 ) lakṣaṇayā viśeṣamātmanā avagatatve vartate |
pacatipacyateśabdayoḥ ca saṃkhyāsaṃbandhatvāt viśeṣarūpeṇa kartṛkarmaṇī gamyete |
kārakantrāṇi na kadā cidevaṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa pratīyante iti vibhaktītpadyantī |
kārakaviśeṣā'pi ca yathā kartṛkarmaṇoreva viśeṣapratītiḥ saṃkhyāsaṃbandhasya bhava- tīti tathoktam |
yattu bhāvotpannakārakatvena vyabhicāraḥ 'neha pacyate, neha bhujyate' ityādiṣu pacimātravivakṣāyāṃ kartṛkarmaṇoranāśrayaṇāt dhātvarthabhāvanayorāśrayatve tatkṣā- gamalamiti |
' yathaiva kriyāyā anaikāntikatvāt a-yatrāgamakamalpamāpadyate tathaiva śabdasyāpi karmanābhidhā- nāt, 'odanaḥ pacyate' ityatrāpi anabhidhātṛtvapra- saṅgaḥ |
jariṣyatīti, tadā tad vrataṃ kriyamāṇamanarthakaṃ syāt |
tasmāt tadā ana- rthakaṃ vrataṃ anityaṃ syāt |
pūrvādhikaraṇe bhakṣādernityatvamuktaṃ, atra anityatvamucyate iti pūrvavailakṣaṇyārthaḥ |
ke. oṃ anarthakyopadeśaḥ syādarthavattvāt phalavatā, nahyupasthānaṃ phalavat |
āgnīdhrasyeti dohavirdhā- nānāṃ ṛtvaikāntikatvāt tatsvarūpānanyatvāvidhāne'pi anuniṣṭhāditatvena kalpyatvāt siddheḥ vākyabhedaparihāra- śajñānirāsārthaṃ sūtram |

āmī- dhādīnāṃ upasthānasya tatsvarūpānanyatvāvidhānena taddāraka- ṛtvanvayāyogāt āgnīdhrādidāśanāt ca saṃskāranimi- ttatvābhāvena āhavanīyādivat svarūpanimittyaiva saṃskārā- napekṣatvāt naiṣphalyapāteḥ |
upasthānasvarūpamantropadeśaḥ sanmātrasya phalavadasaṃgrahāpatteḥ anarthakaḥ syāt iti phala- vatā ityantasya sūtrāvayavasyārthaḥ |
nahi ityādi sūtrāvayavaḥ āmīdhrādidāśopasthānasya ṛtvanvayāyoge'pi prakaraṇān phalavattvaṃ bhaviṣyati ityāśaṅkānirāsārthaḥ |
prakaraṇān ṛtvanvayaḥ pratīyamāno'pi avidhīyamānaḥ anuṣṭhānānna niṣpadyate iti sāmānyanyāyasyāpi vidheyatvāt, gaurave sati aparihāryatvāpatteḥ |
ṛtvanvayaśca upasthānaṃ na phalavat iti sūtrāvayavena śaṅkānirāsaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1131. oṃ anavagatamapekṣitaṃ ca viśuddeśāt gṛhyate |
parākrama. pṛ. 312. oṃ anavayave śāstrārthasaṃpratyayaḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
siddhe tu dharmopadeśe'navayavavidhijñānāt, yathā laukikavaidi- keṣviti |
loke tāvat, brāhmaṇī na hantavyaḥ, surā na peyeti, brāhmaṇāmātraṃ na hanyate, surāmātraṃ na pīyate |
yadi cāyavayena śāstrārthasaṃpratyayaḥ syāt, ekaṃ ca brāhmaṇamahatvā ekāṃ surāmapītvā anyatra kāmacāraḥ syāt |
tathā 'pūrvavayāḥ pratyuttheyaḥ' iti pūrvavayomātraṃ pratyutthīyate yadi cāyavayena śāstrārthasaṃpratyayaḥ syāt, ekaṃ pūrvavayasaṃ pratyutthāyā'nyatra kāmacāraḥ syāt |
tathā vede khalvapi 'vasanta brāhmaṇī'gnidhomādibhiḥ kratubhiryajeta' iti agnyādhānanimittaṃ vasantevasanta iṣyate |
yadi cāyavayena śāstrārthasaṃpratyayaḥ syāt, sakṛdiṣṭvā punarijjyāṃ na pravarteta, evaṃ prakṛte'pi |
'dhātoḥ' (3|1|9) iti sūtramahābhāṣye tu 'ā kuto'yaṃ dhātvadhikāraḥ ! kiṃ prāg lādeśādāho svidāttīyavyāpyaparisāmāpteḥ ! iti bahudhā saṃgīmāṃsya |
jusbhāvo lopeneti cakraka- manavasthā ca prasajyeta' ityāyuktamityanya vistaraḥ |
kiṃca pañcadaśīgranthasya tattvavivekasyaprathamaviveka- ' vikalpo nirvikalpasya savikalpasya vā bhavet |
sāhasī. 612. anavasthā yathā ārambhaṇīyāyāṃ ārambhaṇīyā kartavyā iti pakṣe |
nanu tasyā apyathaṃ anyā ārambha- ṇīyā, tasyā apyathaṃ anyā ārambhaṇīyā, tasyā apyathaṃ anyā ityevaṃ ārambhaṇīyā na vyatiṣṭheta |
yāvatyo hi agni kāla paurṇamāsyāmādyādikaṃ nātikrāmanti tāvatyaḥ kariṣyante |
vā. 3|6|16. oṃ 'anavānaṃ yajati' iti yājyāvapaṭkārayo- rmadhye śrāmaniṣedhena tayoraikakartavyamagamyate |
' sarve ṛtvija upavasanti' ityādicanāt ca cit ṛtvijā- mapi |
yathā anāgataṃ na āgataṃ bhaviṣyat kārye ādāveva avekṣyate vicāryate tadvat |

ke. tena śabdotkarṣasahitena taccheṣāṇāmapi niṣkṛṣya prayogaḥ iti bhāṣyāvayavānupadreṇa parihārārthe ‘tena’ ityādi bhāṣyaṃ (pṛ. 853 paṃ. 28) ‘klapta- śeṣaiḥ’ (klaptayogaśeṣaiḥ vā. pṛ. 854 paṃ. 10) iti vārtikena anāgatāvekṣaṇanyāyena arthato vyākhyātam |
su. pṛ. 1263. oṃ niyamavidhikārakaśca sarvo'pi anāgatā- vekṣaṇanyāyena atra (4|2|9) kautthame ca mantrādhikaraṇe (1|2|4) eva pradarśitaḥ |

bhāṣya. 4|2|9. prasiddha- sambandho hi śaknoti lakṣayituṃ iti ataevābhyāsoktā upapattiḥ anāgatāvekṣaṇanyāyena ‘viśeṣaṇaṃ hi prasiddhaṃ bhavati, na ca vidhīyamānāsvasthaḥ krayaḥ prasiddhaḥ’ iti aruṇādhikaraṇavārtikena uktā |

su. pṛ. 1027. oṃ prāmāṇyasya svatastvaṃ ayathārthatā'bhāvaśceti ubhayaṃ ‘anapekṣatvāt’ (1|1|5) iti sūtrāvayavokta- vat tad- vyākhyānāt sare vācyamapi anāgatāvekṣaṇena vakṣyamāṇatayaiva codanāsūtre eva vārtikakṛtā uktam |
bāla. pṛ. 6. yakṣyamāṇaḥ iti acayanī vibhaktiḥ ityayamarthaḥ vakṣyamāṇena anāgatāvekṣaṇena atrāpi vākye tulyaḥ iti malā bhāṣyakāreṇa darśitaḥ |

ratna. 5|4|31-9. oṃ yadyapi ānumānikavacanaprāmāṇyaṃ viśeṣātideśanirūpaṇaṃ vinā na paryavasyati iti tadanantarameva valāyalacintā yuktā, tathāpi anāgatāvekṣaṇanyāyena bhāvividhivaśanā- dityeva (7|4|2) kriyate |
soma. 7|4|2. oṃ yāgavidhikārakaśca asmābhiḥ anāgatāvekṣaṇanyāyena āgneyādhikaraṇe (2|3|14) eva pradarśitaḥ |

kau. 2|3| 4|14. yāvato'śvān ityādipūrvapadānukūlatvasya prati- grahītuvipayatve'pi dātṛviṣayeyetiviśeṣāsāmarthyayoga- śajñānirāsārthe ‘idaṃ śrūyate’ ityādi (bhā. pṛ. 165 paṃ. 3) ‘nirvapet’ ityantaṃ bhāṣyaṃ (pṛ. 166 paṃ. 1) ‘ata iha yadyapi’ ityādinā (vā. pṛ. 163 paṃ. 22) ‘dāturihaviśāyate’ (dāturiti viśāyate) ityantena vārtikena (pṛ. 164 paṃ. 10) anāgatāvekṣaṇena saṃde- hopādānavelāyāṃ avayavaśo vyākhyātam |
śā. 3|1|4. saptamaditīyāde vakṣyamāṇasyaiva gīti- mātravācyatvasya (sāmaśabdena) iha lakṣaṇasamarthanāya anāgatāvekṣaṇanyāyena bhāṣyakṛtā uktatvāt apaunaru- ktyam |
mitrasvajanocchiṣṭabhojanaṃ sarvavarṇa- parasparaspṛṣṭāmbūladattadattavastrānāṃ camananirlejakadhautagarda- bhārudvavaparidhānabrahmahatyātirikta mahāpātakakāryaparihara- ṇādīni ubhayeṣām |
atisvalpāni pratipuruṣājāti- kulādisyatassarvadharmavyatikramamanāni tu anantamedāni sarvatra vigānahetudarśanāni ca prāyeṇaiva saṃbhavanti iti naivajātīyakamiśrasadācāradharmavyākhyāvaśyasaṃbhavaḥ |
vā. 1|3|13 pṛ. 204, yattu acatanānāṃ ahicchatra- māthurabrāhmaṇānāṃ surāpānādi, dākṣiṇātyānāṃ mātṛduhitṛ- vivāhādi smṛtiviruddhamupyastam |
smṛtyācārayoḥ itaretaranirapekṣaveda mūlatvena tulyabalatvāt vihitapratiṣiddhavikalpānuṣṭhānāśrayāt adoṣa iti |
anye tu evamāhuḥ - ‘sarvaiṣā mevamādīnāṃ pratideśaṃ vyava- sthayā |
’ iti tathā manunā- pyuktaṃ ‘yenāsya pitaro yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ |
tena yāyāta satāṃ mārgaṃ tena gacchan duṣyati ||
’ yeṣāṃ tu yaḥ pitrādibhireva artho nācaritaḥ smṛtyantapratiṣi- ddhaḥ, te taṃ pariharantyeva |
smārtedharmādhikāre hi śaṅkhalikhitairāmnāya uktam 'āmnāyaḥ smṛtidhārakaḥ' iti |
āpastambavacanaṃ tu (ādha. 2|13|7-9) baudhāyanena smṛtiviruddhaduṣṭacārādaharaṇāt nyavacchatā nirākṛ- tam |
svaprāmāṇyādihetvantaradarśanāt na viruddhacārāṇāmāpa- stambavacanasya vā śrutimūlatvopapattiḥ |
āha, kena vā brāhmaṇīnāṃ surāpānaṃ pratiṣiddham |
'pañcadhā vipratipattirdakṣiṇataḥ--vā- anupanītena bhāryayā ca saha bhojanaṃ, paryuṣitabhojanaṃ, ucchiṣṭabhojanaṃ, pitṛvyamātuladuhitṛpariṇayanamiti |
tayottarataḥ pañcadhā-ūrṇāvikrayaḥ, sīdhupānaṃ, ubhayatodadvi- vyavahāraḥ, āyudhīyakaṃ, samudrayānamiti |

(caudha. 1|2|1- 5) iti baudhāyanena smṛtiviruddhaduṣṭācārādaharaṇāt datvā 'itara itarasmin kurvan duṣyati netarasmin' iti deśa- prāmāṇyavyavasthāyā prāmāṇyaṃ uktvā 'mithyaitaditi gautamaḥ, ubhayaṃ tvetannidrayate, śiṣṭasmṛtivirodhāt' iti gautama- matasya nirākṛtatvāt āpastambasyāpi manvādidharmaśāstrapra- vaktṛtayā yājñavalkyena saraṇāt tadvacanasya mithyātvāyoge- 'pi garhādhikāramātraparatayā tat vyākhyeyaṃ ityāśayaḥ |
manuvacanaṃ tu 'tena yāyāt satāṃ mārga' iti viśeṣaṇāt aviruddhakuladharmairviṣayatvena aviruddham |
kesariṇaḥ, aśvasya, aśvatarasya, kharasya, uṣṭrasya, ubhayatodataśca dānaṃ pratigraho vikrayaśca |
' (hariḥ 1|1. vyavasthitaṃ ityatra yadakṣaraṃ iti mūle pāṭhaḥ |
satyapi ca svyaparādhe yadi mātudeva kṣetriṇo vā punaḥ tatastayoḥ prasiddhajāti- tvāt naiva durśinatā bhavet, tayorapyavaṃ, evaṃ tatpūrvajayorapi iti anādinyāyena jātiravardhāyaitaiva |
anādeśe prakṛtiḥ pratyetevyā iti nyāyāt citreṣṭau anuktāni havīṃṣi saumya-sarasvatī-sinīvālī- varje sarve puroḍāśāḥ |
mantrādvāmnātmaka vede nirūpite ūhapravaranāmadheyānyapi mantrāntargatatvāt prasa- ṅgena mantrā neti vicāryate |
vikṛtau atidiṣṭe tu prakṛtisamavetārthamidhāpido- dvāreṇa vikṛtau samavetārthamidhā padamucyate |
evaṃ 'pravare yajamānādīn kīrtayet' iti vacanena yajamānasya pravarakīrtanaṃ nāmadheyakīrtanaṃ ca mantramavipattanāt |
tatro- hitapadasya pravarapadasya nāmadheyapadasya ca mantramadhyapatanāt tatsahitasyaiva ca mantrasya vihitārthasmārakatvāt teṣāmapi mantratvameveti |
bhavedevaṃ yadi mantramadhyapāto vihitārthasmārakatvaṃ vā mantralakṣaṇaṃ brūmaḥ, kintu adhyayanakāle abhiyuktamantrapadaviṣayatvam |
kimuhapravaranāmadheyānāṃ nikṣepe sarva- syāvamantratvaṃ, uta niścitasyeveti |
yathā adhītasvaravarṇakramaprabhiśāne mantratva- pratyabhijñānaṃ bhavati, tadanye tu mantratvapratyabhijñānābhāvāda- mantrameveti |
bhavedevaṃ yadya- vayavinaḥ samūhasya vā ekadeśāpāye'pi pratyabhijñāyamānaṃ tādrūpyaṃ vidyeta |
nahi gorgaḍuna jāte viprāṇe vā bhadre gotvapratyabhijñā'siddhiḥ |
tada- dihāpi ekāvayavābhāve'pi padāntaraprakṣepe'pi pratyakṣeṇa cādhyayanakālavagatamantrarūpapratyabhijñānāt prakṣiptamātra- syāvamantratvaṃ, na tu sarvasyeveti |
na ca 'na girāgireti brūyāderaṃ kṛtodreyam' ityatrāpi girāpadodāreṇa irāpadasyāmantratva- prasaṅga iti vācyam |
adhyayanakāle evālocyadevamavagataṃ, yat 'prakṛtī girāpadavānayaṃ mantraḥ, vikṛtāvapirāpadavān' iti |
nyāyena kalpyamāne tu na śakyaṃ tannirūpaṇam ||
nanu sarvaśabdāvagamyā codanā iti nyāyā- dvādhikamapi nyāyagamyaśrutāthaipsitatve'pi vedagamyatvādi- rāpadatulyameveti |
tena yat kiṃ cit śrutāthaipsayā vede kalpyate, tat sarve vedāmṛta- tvādeda ityucyate |
nanvevamapi 'pravaranāmadheyāni kīrtayet' iti pratyakṣavedopadeśāt pravaranāmadheyeṣvamantratvaprasaṅgaḥ, na caitat |
atra hi pravaraśabdena asitadeva- śāṇḍilyādipravaramādhāyipādakīrtanaṃ, nāmadheyaśabdena ca yajamānābhidhāyiviṣṇuśarmādināmakīrtanamabhimamatam |
evaṃ tarhi yatra mantre 'asāveṣa te piṇḍeḥ, ye cātra tvāmya yāśca tvāmya tasmai te svadhā' iti paṭhyate, tatrāpi sarvanāmasthāne pitṛnāma nidhiyate, tasya svarūpājñānābhāvādamantratvaprasaṅgaḥ |
tadyadi sarvanāmnāṃ tasyā- naśabdāntarasamarpakaṃ tadā teṣāṃ mantratvam |
athāgnātasya sarvanāmnasteṣāṃ prayoge aprāmāṇyaṃ, tato na mantratvam |
tatra tāvat sarvanāmapadaṃ 'pravaranāmadheyāni kīrtayet' itivat pramāṇam |
na cāsya svatastatpitrādināmasāmarthyamasti svayaṃ prayogānarha- sat viśeṣaśabdena prayogārhānupalakṣayati |
ataḥ sarva- nāmāgrānamavivakṣitarūpaṃ pitrādyarthaviśeṣaviṣayān pravara- śabdān mantravākyaniveśino darśayati tadarthameva sarva- nāmapadamanyavidhinā adhyāpitamiti niścityate |
āmnāteṣu ‘ mantro'yamidaṃ rabhya vihitaḥ ‘ prajākāmaṃ caturhotrā yājayet ’ iti brāhmaṇam ’ ityeṣa vibhāga iti |
tautā. vihitaḥ caturhotrahomaḥ ‘ eṣā vā anāhitāgneriti yacca- 2|1|9|134 ||
yatra yaja- anārabhya vihitaṃ ‘ yadāhvake cakṣure bhātavyasya mānasya ārṣeyaṃ triyate sa pravaraḥ |
yacca yajamānataputrā- vṛddhe ’ iti cakṣurañjanaṃ kartavyaṃ na puruṣārtham |
kutaḥ ? adiruktatvāt, evaṃ adiruktaṃ bhavi- ṣyatīti |
dviruktatāyāṃ ko doṣaḥ ? asaṃbhava iti brūmaḥ |
yadi prakṛtau vikṛtau ca bhavati asi tat prakṛtau |
tasmāt anākāṅkṣitatvāt anāramyavidhiḥ na tatra vidyate |
vā - sarvavidhīnāṃ aprāptakaviṣayatvāt yatra pramā- ṇāntareṇa prāsirnāsti, tatra khādiratvādyupadeśaḥ |
vikṛtiṣu aṅkāntarārthe avaśyakalpanīyena atideśena khādiratvādi prāpnoti, iti nopadeśamapekṣate |
tava dviruktatvāt, adiruktatvādvā mama iti sūtram |
yattu codakena prāptīti, anāramyavidhinā prāpte na codakamākāṅkṣati |
anāramyavidhivākyena pratyakṣeṇa khuve khādiratā, codakavākyena ānumānikena vikṛtau |
vā - (tadjaṃ tu vacanaprāpte) prāpteḥ iti vā pāṭhaḥ |

satyaṃ dviruktamanvayārthaṃ, tatra kuta etat, atideśaprāp- tvāt upadeśo vihanyate, na punaḥ upadeśāsiddhaṃ atideśa eva prāpayediti ? yuktaṃ ca padārtheviprakarṣāt atideśo na syāt, saṃnikarṣāt pūrvatarapravṛttopadeśāśrayaṇam |
athocyeta sāmānyaviṣayatvāt upadeśo durbala iti, tat atideśe'pi sarvāṅgaviṣayatvāt aviśeṣam |
bhāṣyaṃ - yadi anāramyavidhiḥ codakāt balīyān, anāramyavidhinā prāpte na codakamākāṅkṣati |
nirā- kāṅkṣe vaikṛte karmaṇi codako naiva prāpnoti |
dṛśyante ca prayājādayaḥ ka cit 'prayājeprayāje kṛṣpalaṃ juhoti' iti |
yadi atideśā- dupadeśo balavān, evaṃ sati tenaiva upadeśena avaruddha- tvāt atideśo naiva syāt |
kutaḥ ? śaknoti hi prakṛtivikṛtisādhāraṇaṃ khādiratvaṃ prākṛtopakārasādhane dṛṣṭa- śaktitvāt vikṛtiṃ nirākāṅkṣīkartum |
tasmāt atideśavinirmuktāyāṃ prakṛ- tāveva niveśo yuktaḥ iti |
bhāṣyaṃ - na prakṛtyarthaḥ, sarvārtha iti brūmaḥ, apra- karaṇe samānamānāt |
yaduktaṃ anāramyavidhinā nirākā- ṅkṣasva na codaka iti, tatropapadyate |
prāpte hi coda- kena khuve, khādiratā anāramyavidhinā śakyā vidhā- tum |
na ca anāramyavidhiḥ khuvaṃ prāpayati, tasya ca khādiratām |
ekārthā hi codanā 'yasya khādiraḥ khuvo bhavati' iti |
na cātra khuvaḥ khādiratā ca ubhayaṃ vidhīyate |
khuvasya sataḥ khādiratāṃ eṣa śabda āha, sa ca codakena prāptaḥ |
sa hi anāramyavidhivākyasya taṃ varjayitvā taṃ varjayitvā anyaṃ prāpayati |
nahi ekasmiṃśca atideśo bādhitaḥ : sarvatraiva bādhito bhavati |
tathathā dvāreḥ kuśoṣu nivartitaiṣapi na prayājā- dayo nivartyante |
na ca khādiratvaṃ akriyātmakatvāt śaknoti vikṛtiṃ nirākāṅkṣīkartum |
yugapacca prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ pravartamānaṃ aśakyaṃ kalpopakāratvena nirūpayitum |
pradhānakriyā'nupādāne sati viśiṣṭavidhāne anupa- padyamāne vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
tasmāt anāramyavidhi- prāpite khuvasya khādiratve tadjaṃ atideśaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ - iti cet paśyasi utpattireṣā prakṛtividhi- bhisyulvā |
'pañca prayājān yajati' iti saṃkṣepeṇa 'samidho yajati' ityevamādinā vistareṇa |
ihāpi 'yasya khādiraḥ khuvo bhavati' ityevamādirvistaraḥ, 'yasyaivaṃlpāḥ khucaḥ' iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
evaṃrūpaḥ prakṛtau vidhirhaṣṭaḥ, ayamapi evaṃ- rūpaḥ |
vā - atra tārkikaḥ kaścidāha, prakṛtyarthaḥ anāramya- vidhiḥ saṃkṣepavistārābhyāṃ vidhīyamānatvāt prayājādivat iti |
kevalamatra prākṛtavidhisāhaśyaṃ, na tu prakṛtau etad bhavati iti pramāṇamasti |
api ca, vikṛtaupi saṃkṣepavistārābhyāṃ aṅgāni vidhīyante 'tisra āhutī- rjuhoti' iti saṃkṣepaḥ, 'āmanamasyāmanasya devāḥ' iti vistaraḥ |
vā - na tāvat īdṛśasya anumānasya gatiḥ |
api ca anu- mānamapi etanna bhavati, anaikāntikatvāt |
tatra etat syāt, ekena vihitatvāt saṃkṣepavistārayoranyataraḥ naiva vidhā- yaka iti |
iti cet, tatsarvārthatvaṃ paśyasi, tada- yuktam |
yatra hi pātrāṇāṃ viniyogotpattiḥ, tatra tadjaṃ jātividhānaṃ śakyate |
yadi hi prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ tulyavat pātrāṇi prāpnuyuḥ, tataḥ sarvāsvapyadeśena jātividhānamavakalpeta |
tatra yā codadeśena prāptiḥ, yā cātideśena prāptiḥ, sā sarvā'pi prāsitena tulyā |
yadyapi upadeśātideśayoḥ saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣau vicete, tathāpi tau svaviṣaye eva balābalaṃ kurutaḥ, na anāramyavādena saha |
pātrāṇāṃ hi tat vākyena, na yāgānām |
yāgāḥ codanāliṅgasaṃyogāt prakṛtimepekṣante, tayā saha ekavākyatāṃ yānti |
prākṛtāśca tān śaknuvanti nirākāṅkṣīkartuṃ, na anāramyavidhiḥ |
na cāsau prakaraṇādāmabhāvāt pravartamāno'pi vaikṛtena yāgena saṃbadhyate |
'prakṛtau vā' iti vipratiṣedhe, codakasāmarthyāt prākṛte vākyaśeṣe prāpte anāramyavidhirna bhaviṣyati |
vā - prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt ityetadeva nyāyyam |
' padārthadeśāpatte śāstratideśapatte vā tadjadāt kadā cit bhedo bhavet |
yāgastattva vyāpāraḥ, atidiśyate iti daśame vakṣyāmaḥ (10|1|12) |
tena prakṛtitvata ityevaṃrūpasya atideśasya ekatvāt sarveṣu aviśeṣasya sarvatra pravṛttiḥ apravṛttirvā, naikadeśeṣu |
cairapi kuśāḥ prāptā eva bādhyante ityuktaṃ valāvalādhikaraṇe ( 3|3|1- 14 ) |
tat yadi tāvat anārabhyavādānurodhena khādirā- dividhaye atideśaḥ parityajyate, tata eva ajñānā- revapi, iti sarvatrividhaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha keṣāṃ cit prākṛtānāmanurodhena tadvi- dhayaḥ atideśaḥ pramāṇaṃ kriyate, tataḥ khādirādiprāpti- rapi aviśiṣṭā iti sphuṭaṃ dviruktatvaṃ prāpnoti |
yāgata- vyāpārāpekṣātvāt svaprakaraṇāmanāmapi atikramya, vikṛtayaḥ prākṛtaṃ tāvat gṛhṇanti iti sarvatra sthāpayi- ṣyāmaḥ |
yāvatā ca yatra na suvādayaḥ prāpnuvanti, tāvatā khādira- tvādo'pi, iti nopadeśaviṣayatvaṃ ghaṭate |
tena ca paritre anarthakaye, vikṛti- saṃbandho niṣpamāṇakaḥ |
yeṣāṃ tu ṛtusaṃbandha eva pratyakṣaḥ, te anārabhya- vādā api sarvārthā eva yathā 'eṣa vai saptadaśaḥ prajā- patiryajñamanāyat' |
śā— anārabhyavādavicāraprastāvāgataśeṣaviṣayaṃ vicāraṃ samāpya idānīṃ tameva anārabhyavādaṃ anusandhatte |
naivaṃ dviruktadoṣaḥ : syāt prāptasya hi punarviveḥ |
samuccitāśca te sarve prakṛtau tadviśeṣa- ṇam |
tathā sahaiva parṇatve prāptaṃ, na tu vidhīyate |
soma— yasmānnārabhyavādasya atideśikapadārthānape- kṣatvaṃ, tatra pratyakṣasya śīghrapravṛtteḥ prakṛtivikṛtisādhāraṇya- meva |

yathā 'āśrāvayeti caturakṣaraṃ, astu śrauṣaḍiti catu- rakṣaraṃ, yajeti dvyakṣaraṃ, yeyajāmaha iti pañcākṣaraṃ, dvyakṣaro vaṣaṭkāraḥ, eṣa vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiryajñamanāyat' : ityādau, tatra vikṛtirūpayajñasya atideśikatvābhāvāt iti dhyeyam |
prayojanaṃ yatrānārabhyavihitapadārthāśritā guṇāḥ : santi, tatra guṇānāṃ vikṛtiṣu pravṛttiḥ pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte tu ādhamikanyāyena ( 8|1|120 ) apravṛttiriti |
sūtrārthastu — parṇatādikaṃ sarvārthe kasya cit prakaraṇe anāmnātatvena sarvārthatvasya nyāyyatvāt iti |
vi— 'prakṛtau vikṛtau vā syād yasya parṇayasī vidhiḥ |

bhāṭṭa— anārabhya śrutena 'yasya parṇamayī juhū- bhavati' ityādinā ayamabhiraktakratusambandhijuhūdeśena vidhīyamānā parṇatā tad-dvāreṇa juhūsādhyakratvaṅgatāṃ, iti sthite sā kiṃ prakṛtivikṛtisādhāraṇī, uta prakṛtereva iti cintāyāṃ, atideśāt sarvaiṣāpi |
na ca vikṛtau atideśenāpi prāpteḥ dviruktatvāpattiḥ, upa- deśenaiva prāptiratve atideśasya kutaścidvyatvātkalpanā- parṇatāviṣayatvātkalpanāt |
na ca vikṛtau juhūmātre atideśasyātvāt tasya ca prakṛteḥ sarvāṅgasambandhottara- kālikatvena parṇatāvidheḥ prathamaṃ prakṛtiviṣayatvādbodha- janakatvāvadavabhāve punarvikṛtiviṣaye tajjanakatvāyogena
vaimṛdhādivat parṇatāvyatiriktasyāṅgasambandhe prakṛteḥ pūrṇatvama- ṅgīkṛtya vikṛtau atideśopapattau parṇatāyāḥ paścā- deva vidhānena sādhāraṇeopapatteḥ |

iti prāpte, yatkiṃciditikartavyatātveopetasakalaṅgasambandhena prakṛteḥ pūrṇatvamaṅgīkṛtya vaimṛdhe atideśakalpanāyāpi yeṣāmaṅgānāṃ svāṅgasambandhena nirākāṅkṣatā, teṣāme- vātideśaḥ, na vaimṛdhasya, aṅgaviśeṣānavagamane tadbhāva- nāyā aparipūrṇatvāt |
ataśca parṇatāpāṅgasambandhaṃ vinā prakṛteḥ pūrṇatvābhāvāt atideśeto juhūgrāpyanantaraṃ punaḥ parṇatāvidhau prātikālavaiṣamyāpatteḥ prakṛtyartha eva parṇatā |
yathā ca evaṃ sati 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti' ityatra abhīṣomīyasambandhyanyasambandhopadeśātideśacche- danasādhāraṇyena dīkṣākālavidhau na prātikālavaiṣamyaṃ, tathā tatraiva ( 11|3|4 ) vakṣyāmaḥ |
vastutastu naiva tatra sādhāraṇena vidhiḥ, prakṛtyarthatvena vihitasya atideśa- to'pi prāptisaṃbhavāt |
tathāpi yūpatvaṃ bhinnakālikatvena aguḍhabhāvāviśeṣatvāt pātrāntaradeva nānupapannam |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe parṇatālope vedāntarīyavikṛtau yājurvedikātvāt taddveṣaprāyāścittam |

' anārabhyādhikaraṇe anārabhyavidhinā, vikṛtiṣvapi khādirādiprāpteḥ taddve prakṛtivikṛtyarthatve dviruktatva- prasaṅgasya asiddhatvaśaṅkātha uktyā, codakasya anārabhya- vidhito daurbalyaṃ tenaiva vikṛtinairākāṅkṣyāt codakā- bhāvāpattyā tadāpyaprajādi 'darśanāditi cet' ( 4 ) iti sūtreṇāśaṅkya 'na codaikyārthāt' ( 5 ) itya- nena anārabhyacodanāyāḥ khādirādivākyatvena suvā- dyamidhānāt vikṛtinairākāṅkṣyakaraṇādyeḥ codakasya daurbalye'pi anārabhyavidhivrāptaprajājādiprāpakatvopapatti- muktvā, siddhāntaikadeśimena dviruktatvaprasaṅgasya asiddha- mī. ko. 48

tvamapyetaya saṃkṣiptavistārarūpatvena hetunā prajājādividhi- dṛṣṭāntena lādirādividheḥ prakṛtimātrāthatvalānumānaṃ 'upa- jiriti cet' ( 6 ) ityanenāśaṅkya, 'na tulyatvāt' ( 7 ) ityanena āhanomādāvivikṛtirvyasyāpi saṃkṣepavistārarūpatvadarśanena anaikāntikatvāt anumānā- yogamuktvā, 'codanāthakālyāttu mukhyavidhipratiṣedhāt prakṛ- tyartham' ( 8 ) ityanena anārabhyavidheḥ saviśeṣya- khādiratvādipayabhūtasuvādiprāpya codakāpekṣatvena codaka- syaiva balīyastvāt anārabhyavidhiviṣayavarjanānupapatteḥ kṛtasyaiva prākṛtāṅgājātasya codakacodanāthatvagamanena anārabhyavidhervikṛtirthatve mukhyasya vikṛtividheḥ codakaḥ śeṣaḥ anārabhyavidhirvā iti vipratiṣedhāpatteḥ, tatparihārāya anārabhyavidhānaṃ prakṛtimātrārtha iti dvirukta- tvaprasaṅgasya asiddhatvaśaṅkānirāsena siddhāntaṃ upasaṃhara- yati |
su. pṛ. 1277, anārabhyādhikaraṇesiddhāntasūtreṇa 'prakṛtau vā' ( 2 ) ityanena khādirādeḥ prakṛtivikṛtitva- thatve dviruktatvāpattilakṣaṇaḥ nyāyaḥ uktaḥ |

3|7 pṛ. 41, anārabhyādhītaṃ: pravarthaḥ 'purastādupasadāṃ pravarthaṃ pravṛ- ṇakti' iti somābhyabhiritopasadādisambandhāt somaṃ gacchati, tatrāpi anārabhyanyāyena prakṛtibhūtaṃ jyoti- ṣṭomaṃ, tatrāpi prathamaṣaḍasyayogāt tadīyādyaprayogam |
vi. 3|6|4, anārabhyādhītaṃ 'uttare'han dvi- rātresu dvirātresu prātaḥ san agjhirāsaṃ dvirātre eva, nānyeṣu dvirātresu iti parisaṃkhyāyate iti vṛttikāramatam |
\ aṇāra- bhyādhītaṃ ‘yasya parṇamayī juhurbhavati’ itīdaṃ parṇamayatvaṃ kratvartha, tasya vākyena kratusaṃbaṃdha:; phalaśravaṇaṃ tu arthavāda: |
\ aṇārabhyādhītaṃ ‘sata- daśa sābhimenīranuyāt’ iti sābhimenīsātadasyaṃ vaimṛ- dhādhvarakalpādī upasaṃhriyate |
\ aṇārabhyādhītāni yajñātrāṇi ādhānamārabhyaiva ābharaṇaṃ dhāryāṇi, na kevalaṃ paurṇamāsīmārabhya |
\ aṇārabhyādhītayo: asaṃvādamayo: na sarvagranthane anuṣṭhānaṃ, kiṃtu prāta:satrena eva dhārāgrahebhya: pūrvameva, yeṣāṃ prākaraṇiko viniyoga: teṣāṃ vidhivallādeva anuṣṭhāna
sakṛdā pratyayavayaṃ veti ubhayathā parikraye prāpte 'vāmano dakṣiṇā' 'ayutaṃ dadāti' ityādiḥ tattadavayave punaḥ śrutiḥ |
tasmāt rājasūyopakrame dhrutāmeva ṛtvijāṃ rājasūyasamāptiparyantaṃ niyamaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
oṃ aniyamena upasaṃhāryasa upasaṃhāraviṣaye prāptau upasaṃhārarūpaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ yathā- 'yajyuktaṃ rathampardhvaye dadāti' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 17, oṃ aniyamena tatra cānyatra ca prāptau parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ |
( 3|3|18|31 bra. sū. ) aniyamanyāyasya pratīkavyatirikteṣvapi upāsaneṣu upa- patteḥ |
śāṃbhā. 4|1|6|15. 'aniyamaḥ sarvāṃsāmavi- rodhaḥ śabdānāmānām' iti sūtram |
devayānagatiḥ yāsu upāsanāsu śrūyate tatraiva jñātavyā, uta yāsu śāṇḍi- lyādiṣvapi na śrūyate tatrāpi jñātavyā iti vicāre sarvāsāma upāsanānāṃ eṣā gatirbhavati iti jñeyam |
yāsyeva śrūyate upakosalavidyādiṣu tasyeveti na niyamaḥ |
kuta etat ? 'tathe itthaṃ viduḥ ye ceme arakhye śraddhā tapa ityupāsate' iti śabdena śrutvā, anumānena 'śuklakṛṣṇe gatī' iti smṛtyā ca tayā aniyamaḥ sidhyati iti nyāyasūtrārthaḥ |
anena nyāyena pratīkopāsanāmicchāsu sarvāsu ahaṃmahopāsanāsu devayānagatiḥ aniyamena sādhyatvetyuktam |
ke. oṃ yattu aniyamanyāyāt aviśeṣeṇa sarveṣāṃ vikārālamvanānāṃ eṣā gatiriti, tat dūṣayati (bhāṣyakāraḥ) |
nyāyani. 4|3|6|19 bra. sū., oṃ sarveṣu upāsaneṣu aniyamanyāyāt vikārālamvaneṣu viśeṣā- siddhiḥ |
4|3|6|15 bra. sū., oṃ pratīkālambanān na nayati, vikārālamvanāt nayati iti ubhayathopagame sati 'aniyamaḥ sarveṣāṃ' iti nyāyasya na kaściddoṣaḥ |
4|3| 6|15 bra. sū., oṃ aniyamādhikaraṇanyāyaṃ guṇopasaṃhā- rasthaṃ hetutvena smārayati (bhāṣyakāraḥ) |
anyatra tu kaḥ cit kramasya aniyamaḥ na niyamaḥ |
yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ yāja- mānānāṃ prajājānumantrādīnāṃ nānāśākhāsamāmnātānāṃ mantrāṇām |
ādhāne dakṣiṇā ekā gauḥ, ṣaṭ, dvādaśa, śataṃ, sahasraṃ aparimitaṃ vā gāvaḥ ityuktam |
tatra aparimita- padena kā cit saṃkhyaiva grāhyā iti pūrvādhikaraṇe sādhi- tam |
sā tu saṃkhyā sahasrāt nyūnā adhikā vā kā cit grāhyā iti aniyamaḥ syāt aviśeṣāt viśeṣasya anukūlatvāt |
adhikaṃ vā syāt, bahurthatvāditeḥ saṃnidhā- nāt |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasyan siddhānta- māha |
'sahasraṃ deyaṃ, aparimitaṃ deyaṃ' ityatra apari- mitaśabdena sahasrāt nyūnaṃ samaṃ vā na grāhyaṃ, kiṃtu adhikameva grāhyaṃ, bahurthatvāt aparimitaśabdasya |
tatra itare : ekatvādibhiḥ sahasrāntaiḥ saṃkhyeti viśeṣaiḥ saṃnidhānāt sahasrāpekṣaṃ bahulaṃ grāhyam |
tasmāt 'aparimitaṃ deyaṃ' ityanena sahasrādhikaṃ deyaṃ ityartho grāhya iti siddhāntaḥ |
ādhāne dakṣiṇā 'sahasraṃ deyaṃ aparimitaṃ deyaṃ' iti aparimitaśabdaḥ sahasrādhikavācī iti siddhānte arthavādāphalyarūpahetvantarapratipādanāyartha sūtram |
aparimitaśabdasya atra sahasrādhikasaṃkhyāvācakatve sati iti tacchabdārthaḥ |

‘utkṛṣṭaṃ vai aparimitaṃ' iti aparimitasya sahasrāt utkṛṣṭatāṃ bruvan arthavādaḥ; 'kṣayiṣṇu vai parimitaṃ' iti ca sahasrāntasya kṣayiṣṇutvaṃ bruvannarthavādaḥ arthavat sāmānye napuṃsakaṃ, arthavān saphalaḥ |
aparimitaśabdaḥ kiṃ aniyatabahutvārthakaḥ, uta sahasrādhikabahutvārthakaḥ iti saṃśaye dakṣiṇākalpāntaraparasahasrasaṃnidhānena viśeṣasaṃni- vāt aniyatabahutvārthaḥ |
iti prāpte, aparimitaśabdasya pratiyogisāpekṣatvāt bahulārthakatvāt tadākāṅkṣayā anyārthasaṃnidhānamapi viśeṣakam |
ataḥ saṃnihitasahasrā- dhikanyūnārthaḥ iti 'adhikaṃ vā syāt bahurthatvāditeḥ saṃnidhānāt' iti sūtreṇa siddhāntitam |
ahīne yajamānagaṇe sati śukkāgnyārambhaṇaṃ audumbarī- saṃmānaṃ ityādīni parāthoni kamo'pi aniyamena yaḥ kaścit yajamānaḥ kuryāt |
evaṃ yajamānasya aniyamaḥ syāt, aviśeṣāt, nātra śabdakṛto vā arthakṛto vā viśeṣo gṛhyate |
bhā. 6|5|12|12-15, oṃ anirukte'pi abhyu- daye vaikṛtyameva devatāmyo nirvāpaḥ kartavyaḥ |
darśakalpanā caturdaśayāme yāge pravṛtte candradarśane ca sati darśeṭiriva abhyuditeṣṭitvena kartavyā |
tatra prākṛta- devatānāmapanayaḥ devatāntarāṇāṃ ca saṃyogaḥ kartavyo bhavati |
tatra anirukte nirvāpe akṛte, nirvāpāt prāk abhyudite candre dṛṣṭe prākṛtabhya eva devatābhyaḥ nirvāpet prākṛtadevatā evodiya nirvāpaḥ kartavyaḥ |
kutaḥ ? taṇḍulabhūteṣu trīhiṣu devatātāṃ apanayāt apanayasya kartavyatvāt |
nirvāpottaraṃ ava- ghāte kṛte taṇḍulā niṣpadyante |
evaṃ vrīhiṣu taṇḍula- bhūteṣu satsu devatātāṃ apanaya uktaḥ |
tasmāt nirvāpāt prāk devatā'panayābhāvāt prākṛtabhya eva devatābhyo nirvāpaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ tuśabdena nirasyan siddhāntamata- māha |
yattu akāle kṛtaṃ karma, tat vi-ṛddhaṃ vyuddham |
vyuddhaṃ karma yā devatā bhajante tā vyuddhyamāḥ |
tābhyaḥ vyuddhyamāgbhyaḥ vaikṛtyamyo devatābhyaḥ : 'agnidātā, indraḥ pradātā, viṣṇuḥ śipiviṣṭaḥ' ityetābhyo nirvāpeta iti ālekhanaḥ ācāryo manyate sma |
kutaḥ ? devatāpanayasya tatkaritvāt vyuddhakāri- tvāt akalpapravṛttakarmakāritvāt |
iti nirvāpāt prāgapi candrodaye jāte vaikṛtyamya eva nirvāpaḥ, na prākṛtamya iti siddhāntaḥ |
'vyuddhya- māgbhyaḥ havirśanabhāgamyo vaikṛtyamyaḥ' iti subo- dhinī |
tatra vyuddhyaśabdena havirśanaṃ vyuddhyabhākśabdena vaikṛtatvaṃ ca kathamucyate iti na jānīmaḥ |
'pravṛddha- kālabhāgamyaḥ' iti kutūhalasūtre likhitaṃ, 'pravṛddhakāla- pravṛttaṃ haviḥ tadbhāgamyaḥ' iti kutūhalamūle ca likhitam |
tatra candrodayottaratvāt kālasya pravṛddhatvaṃ śakyate vaktum |
tatkaritvāt tena vyuddhyaśabdasya akālatantrapravṛttatvaṃ ityartho jñātuṃ śakyate tathāpi vyuddhyamāgbhyaḥ iti ya-pāṭhameva sādhiyāṃsaṃ matvā svīkṛtavanto yamiti |
oṃ anirdiśārthāḥ pratyayāḥ triṣvapi kāleṣu bhavanti iti nyāyaḥ |
ataḥ ‘anirdiśārthāḥ' iti nyāyāt āsamāptevartamānakāla- tvāt atītavartamānabhaviṣyapurāṇānāṃ kartṛtvaṃ aviruddham |
su. 317 pṛ. 34. aniṣṭaprāpti: pratiṣiddhakarmānuṣṭhāne sati bhavati |
'tasmādvāṇiyā''yaṇena navasyāśitavyam' iti niṣedha: phālakṛṣṭāttyāśaneṣva, na vrīhiyavāśanesya ' yā: phālakṛṣṭāstāsmitareṇa ' iti vākyaśeṣe phālakṛṣṭātītarene viśeṣe vyavasthāpanāt |

iti prāpte, ayānasya dravyasāmānyena kāraṇasaṃbhavena pravṛtterviśeṣaviṣayatvena sāmānyasya viśeṣe paryavasānāya vākyaśeṣāvaśyakatve'pi nivṛtternava- dhānyasāmānyānāṃviṣayatvakalpanānupapatterabhāvena yavānākā- kṣitasya vākyaśeṣeṇasamāptatvāt phālakṛṣṭādyartha: |
chatrinva lakṣaṇayā stāvakamātrāmiti sarvagrāmyāṇāmeva bhakṣaṇaprati- vedha: |
muddhādiśamīdhānyānāmapi phakaupadhilāviśeṣeṇa niṣedhe prāpte, teṣāmayāgayogyavādaiva na niṣedha: |

'sasyaṃ nāśrīyād' iti vacanāntareṇa śākādī- nāmapi bhakṣaṇaniṣedhe prāpte, teṣāṃ yāgayogyatā- bhāvena 'devā oghadhīṣu pakkāsmijyustānindrādī prathama- mudajayatām' ityupakramya navāśananiṣedhena devebhyo dātuṃ yogyānāṃ dhānyānāṃ pakānāmeva taistebhyo'niṣṭvā bhakṣaṇasya nindyā pakkānānāṃ haritavādīnāṃ bhakṣaṇe yāthā- kāmyam |
saṃkarṣa. 312|122. anīkavatī iṣṭi: cāturmāsyagatasaktameghāvayava- bhūtā prāta:kartavyā sadyaskālā |
su. pṛ. 1087. 'anukaraṇaṃ hi śiṣṭasya sādhu bhavati' iti nyāya: |
'yathā loke ya evamau dadāti, ya evamau yajate, ya evamavadhīte iti tasyā'nukurvan dadyācca yajeta cādhīyata ca so'bhyudayena yujyate' iti 'ṛlak' sūtramahābhāṣye suvistara: iti |
ke. anuktampyūha iti paṇḍito jana:, iti nyāya: |
vicakṣaṇo jana: akathitamapi viṣayamanubhavatīti viṣaye''sa pracāra: |
uktaṃ ca 'udīrito'rtha: paśunā'pi gṛhyate hayāśca nāgāśca vahanti coditā: |
anuktampyūhati paṇḍito jana: pareṅgitajñānaphalā hi buddhaya: ||
sāhyī. 649. anukrameṇāpacchede uttarapacchedanimittaṃ prāya- ścittaṃ kartavyam |
abhi- vādayitavyaśca' 'vṛddhavatyā: pratyuttheya: saṃmantavyaśca' iti vihitānāṃ nimittāvṛttau āvṛtti: |
mā. 3|5|16|42, anujñā ca somabhakṣaṇe nūnādhikyadoṣaparihārāyaika- pātrāṇāmeva |
3|5|17|43, anujñā ca somabhakṣaṇe vaidikamantreṇa na tu laukikottyā |
agniṣṭome camasaṃ somaṃ hutvā sadyati bhakṣyanti |
na ca tena ucchiṣṭā bhavanti, tathā vidhā- nāt |
bhakṣaṇakāle ca sa camaso yasya hotādevaibhavati tasyā- nujñā gṛhyate 'hotaupahavyasya' ityādimantreṇa, so'pi ca 'upahūta:' iti mantreṇa anujñāṃ dadāti |
ekapātre some sādhāraṇe saṃskṛtatve 'samaṃ syādaśrutatvāt' ( 10|3|13|153 ) ityanyāyena samo vibhāga: prāpnoti |
tatra avibhajya pīyamāne kadā cit anyena pātavyaṃ anya: piveta |
tatra anujñāpanaṃ saṃbhavati ' lyyārthaṃ pātavyaṃ mayārthaṃ, kadā cidahaṃ abhyadhikaṃ nyūnaṃ vā pivetaṃ tat anujñātumarhasi' iti |
'ekapātreṇa tvayā saha ācaraṇaṃ ahaṃ tava cittaprasādanaṃ nyāyanyā' iti saṃbhavatyanujñā |
bhā. 3|5|17|43, anujñāpanasya ca etadrūpaṃ, yatra anyena kartavyaṃ anyaści- kīyaita sa: 'anumanyasva' iti brūte |
sahabhojanādi vā ācaritukāma: cittaṃ anyasya anukūlayati |
bhā. 3|5|14|40. anuptattau tu kāla: syāt, prayojanena saṃbandhāt |
jyotiṣṭome 'prahṛtya parichinan juhoti hāriyojanam ' iti paṭhitam |
atra paridhipraharaṇaṃ hāriyojanahomāṅga- tvena vidhīyate, kiṃcā paridhipraharaṇottaraṃ hāriyojanahoma: iti homakālo cīyite iti cintāyāṃ siddhāntamāha |
tathā ca anuptattau utpattiyākyabhinne asmina vākye kāla: syāt, kālasyaiva vidhānametat |
praharaṇahomayo: prayojanena jyoti- ṣṭomāpūrveṇa phalena saha saṃbandhāt parasparaṃ saṃbandho nāsti |
tasmāt kāla eva tena vākyena ucyate |
ke. 'anutpādya sutaṃ mohānmokṣamicchan patatyadha:' ityitaraktasya pratyavāyaśravaṇāt prajotpādanaṃ nityam |
'anutpādya sutān na lokaṃ gacchati' iti prajotpādanaṃ kāmyamiti cet, maivam |
'anutpādya sutaṃ mohānmokṣamicchan patatyadha:' iti smṛte: prajotpādana- mapi somavat vidyāvacca nityam |
vi. 6|2|11. anuddiṣyāpi kriyamāṇāni prakṛtitvat kṛtāni bhavanti |
anunirvāpyā: kasya cit yāgasya samāpyuttaraṃ anye ke cit yāgā vihitā bhavanti |
yathā 'amīṣomīyasya paśupuroḍāśa-manu devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati' iti |
yathā vā anuba- ndhyāyāṃ paśau devikāhavīṃṣi anunirvāpyāṇi |
yatra 'anu nirvapeta' 'anu nirvapati' iti vidhānaṃ syāt tāni anunirvāpyāṇi |
agnicayane deva- suvāṃ havīṃṣi paśu puroḍāśatantrasya prasaṅga: ||
bhāṣyaṃ- 'amīṣomīyasya puroḍāśamanu devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati' iti |
tatra bhūyastvena tantraṃ niyamyate, anunir- vāpyāṇāṃ bahutvāt |
kiṃca yat sviṣṭakṛcchabdakaṃ sviṣṭakṛte vacanaṃ dṛśyate paśu- puroḍāśasya devikāhavīṃṣāṃ ca 'amaye sviṣṭakṛte samava- dyati' iti, tat anunirvāpyāṇāṃ tantre upapadyate |
yadā tu paśupuroḍāśatantraṃ, tadā asaviṣṭakṛcchabdakaṃ syāt |
āgantukatvādvā svadharma: syācchrutiviśeṣādita- rasya ca mukhyatvāt |
evaṃ śrute pūrvaṃ paśupuroḍāśa:, paścādanunirvāpyā bhavantīti sa mukhya:, itare tu jaghanyā: |
atastepāmāgantukatvāt ita- rasya ca mukhyatvāt paśupuroḍāśa: svadharmā syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ- api ca paśupuroḍāśasthānaṃ yat vapāpracā- rāt para:, atraipi tasya tasyānaiva bhavitavyaṃ pradhāna- deśatvāt teṣām |
tasmin sthāne taddāni kriyeran paśupuroḍāśāni anyasthānāni bhaveyuḥ |
evaṃ ca paśupuroḍāśasya tantreṇa anirukte sviṣṭakṛti prāpte vikāro nacatvā bhavi- ṣyati |
yathā 'agraye pavamānāya nirvapati' iti vacanāt pavamānaśabdako nirvāpaḥ kriyate evami- hāpi |
bhāṣyam—avikāraḥ astisriṣṭakṛcchabdakaṃ vacanaṃ kartavyaṃ prakṛtivat atideśāt |
kiṃ tarhi samavadānaṃ devikāhaviṣāṃ 'agraye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' iti |
tatra vikāre anyasmin vidhīyamāne vākyaṃ bhidyate ( bhidyeta ) |
kathaṃ tarhi sviṣṭakṛdvacanaṃ ? codanāṃ prati bhāvācca |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ yā asti sviṣṭakṛccodanā, sā sviṣṭakṛcchabdikā, tat prati etadvacanaṃ tadupalakṣa- ṇāya |
tasmādaye yo'sau śeṣabhāk iti yāvat‌ke syāt, tāvat agraye sviṣṭakṛte iti |
yathā 'śaramayaṃ barhirbhavati' iti 'navanītāmajyaṃ' iti prākṛtaṃ kāryaṃ lakṣyate prakṛtiliṅgena dravyaśabdena, evamihāpi sviṣṭakṛ- bdena prākṛtī lakṣaṇāyā devatā anyate |
śa—aninirvāpyāṇāṃ svādhrmeṇa puroḍāśasya prasaṅgatvaṃ viparītaṃ vā iti saṃśaye bhūyastvena aninirvāpyāṇām |
nahi teṣāṃ saha codanā, nāpi sahoṣakramaḥ |
kiṃtu paśupuroḍāśatva-prakānte anini- rvāpyāṇāṃ tantramadhye vidhānāt vispaṣṭaṃ prasaṅgatvaṃ itarasya ca tantritvaṃ, tantradharmaśca prasaṅginā upajīvanīyaḥ |
soma—pūrvatatra virodhābhāvāt bhūyastvasya akiṃci- tkaratve'pi iha bhūyastvena vyavasthā ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
atra aninirvāpyāṇāṃ tantritvaṃ, uta puroḍāśasya ityevaṃ na vicāryate |

kiṃtu puroḍāśasya tantritvaṃ anu- nirvāpyāṇāṃ prasaṅgatvaṃ iti siddhaṃ kutraiva dharmavipratiṣedhe kiṃ bhūyasāṃ prasaṅgīnāṃ dharmo grāhyaḥ, uta ekasyāpi tantriṇo dharmaḥ ityevaṃ vicāryate iti dhyeyam |
prasaṅgādidhaiḥ tantravidhupajīvanena pravṛttyā tantrinaḥ prābalyāt taddharma eva grāhya iti |
paśoḥ puroḍāśasya aninirvāpyāṇāṃ ca dharmavipratiṣedhe paśoḥ svādharmyam |
puroḍāśasya anini- rvāpyāṇāṃ ca dharmavipratiṣedhe puroḍāśasya svādharmya iti bodhyam |
asti, maivaṃ tantramadhye vihitatvāt prasa- ṅgitā ||
' mādṛ—cayanādau agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśānantaraṃ 'agnīṣomīyasya puroḍāśamanu devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati' tathaiva anupranthadau 'devikā havīṃṣi nirvapati' iti ca śrutam |
tadeṣāṃ aninirvāpyāṇāṃ haviṣāṃ bahutvān tantritvaṃ puroḍāśasya tu pakṣeyatā klṛptaprasaṅgatvasya prasaṅgatvam |

yadi tu anuśabdayogāt 'vaimṛdhamanunirvapati' itivat uttarakālapratīteḥ tasya ca prayogānvayitvāt paśupuro- ḍāśaprayogavidhihitākṣepeṇatasyapaśupuroḍāśānantaraṃ aninirvā- pyāṇāṃ svākṣepetānāṃ prayogavidhiḥ iti vibhāvyate, tadā astu vaimṛdhatva prayogabheda eva iti nānyormīthaḥ tantra- prasaṅgabhāvaḥ |

atraiva yathaiva vāyāgottaraṃ paśupuroḍāśa- prayogavidhānāt anyataḥ alpopakārāṇāṃ nirvāpasiddha- kṛdādīnāṃ paśupuroḍāśaprayogavidhirvidheyatā vāyāgottara- meva karaṇaṃ, tathaiva devikāhaviṣāpi svaprayogavidhi- vidheyanirvāpasviṣṭakṛdādyapekṣitānāṃ sāṅkayapaśupuroḍāśottara- kālameva karaṇaṃ iti na mithaḥ pravandhaḥ |
ubhayorapi tu paśu- tantramadhye pāṭhāt pāṭhāt tadīyaprayājādiprasaṅgaḥ |
tathātve tad- deva sviṣṭakṛdedāpattyā śatapathe paśupuroḍāśayāgamabhi-
dhāya 'tasya so'gniṣṭaḥ sviṣṭakṛt' ityanena aniṣṭasviṣṭakṛ- tvalakṣaṇaṃ guṇaṃ vidhāya aninirvāpapradhānakaraṇabodhakavākya- saṃdarbhānupapattiḥ |
tenātra anuśabdena aninirvāpyapaśupuro- ḍāśayoḥ tattaddharmapradhānānāṃ tattaddharmapradhānottaratvasya vidhā- nāt samānatantratvasya pratīteḥ na tāvat dvayorāpi prayoga- bhedaḥ |
vapāyāgottarakālaṃ puroḍāśayāgaprayogavidhau tu na kiṃ cid bādhakam |
pratyuta tadīyasviṣṭakṛte agnernirguṇa- tvavidhiḥ prayogabhedatātparyagrāhaka eva |
tataśca aninirvā- peṣu paśupuroḍāśanirvāpāpekṣapadārthai kṛtvā tadīyanirvāpā- dyekekapadārthakaraṇaṃ, sviṣṭakṛti tu krameṇa sarvottārādhanava- dāya sakṛtkaraṇaṃ iti vastusthitiḥ |
viruddheṣu tu satyāpi devikāhaviṣāṃ bahutve anuśabdena paśupuroḍāśaguṇapravṛtteḥ tattantratāyāva- gamāt tanmukhyatvātprajīvinātragamāt prasaṅgatvameva |
ata eva aninirvāpyapradhānakaraṇottaraṃ 'agraye sviṣṭakṛte sama- vadyati' iti uktvā 'agraye sviṣṭakṛte preṣya' iti maitrāvaruṇaṃ prati praiṣāmānamapi śatapathabrāhmaṇe saṃgacchate |
aninirvāpyatantritve tu tatāre pratyeka aiṣṭikātideśena 'agni sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yaja' iti praiṣā- pattiḥ |
ata eva paśupuroḍāśatantritvena sviṣṭakṛte 'agraye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' ityasya sārthakyam |
yattu sūtrakāreṇa evaṃvidhaṃ sārthakyamuktvā dhātye evātra vidhī- yate, sviṣṭakṛcchabdastu avivākṣatārthaḥ iti prakārānta- ramuktaṃ tat prauḍhimātram |
tasmāt puroḍāśa'pi sviṣṭa- kṛdādividhaye tantrī, aninirvāpyāḥ prasaṅginaḥ iti siddham |
vastutastu kāṇvaśākhāyāṃ 'agni sviṣṭa- kṛtaṃ yaja' iti praiṣāmānnāt teṣāmapi tantritvagataḥ vikalpa eva yuktaḥ |

agnicayanaṃ 'agni- yomīyasya paśupuroḍāśaṃ aṣṭau devasūnāṃ havīṃṣi anu- nirvapati' ityatra kiṃ agnīṣomīyapaśudharmaḥ ekādaśa- prayājavādayaḥ grāhā uta aninirvāpyadharmāḥ ? prayājayā- dayaḥ iti saṃśaye bhūyo'nugrahanyāyena ( 12|1|22 ) aninirvāpyadharmamedhe prāpte, yatra sarveṣāṃ tantritayā na gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ, tatra mukhyyānugrahanyāyāpavādaḥ ( 6|1|16 | 37 ) |
yatra tu ekaḥ tantrī, itare prasa- ṅginaḥ iti gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ, tatra ekasyāpi tantrina eva dharmā grāhāḥ, bahunāmapi prasaṅgināṃ tattantropajī- vittvena svadharmāprayojakatvāt iti nirṇītam |

agnicayanaṃ 'agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśamanu aṣṭau deva- suvāṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati' ityanena ukteṣu aninirvāpyeṣu paśupuroḍāśatantramavyapātile'pi teṣāṃ bhūyastvena anu- nirvāpyatantrasya anuṣṭhānena paśupuroḍāśānāṃ prasaṅgataḥ iti aninirvāpyatantrasya niyamaḥ syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
āgantukatvatvādvā svadharmā syācchutiviśeṣādi- tasya ca mukhyatvāt |
'aninirvāpya' iti anuśabdarupa śrutiviśeṣāt aninirvāpyāṇāṃ devasuvāṃ devikāhaviṣāṃ ca āgantukatvāt, itarasya paśupuroḍāśasya ca mukhyatvāt, paśupuroḍāśaḥ svadharmā syāt |
sve svīyāḥ dharmāḥ yasya sa svadharmā, aninca samāsāntaḥ |
tasmāt puroḍāśasya tantraṃ aninirvāpyaiḥ na niyamyate, na prasaṅgaḥ |
agnicayane 'agnīṣomīya puroḍāśamanu devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati' anubandhyāyāṃ ca devikā- havīṃṣi |
agnicayane agnīṣomīyapaśupuroḍāśamanu devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi anubandhyāyāṃ ca devikāhavīṃṣi bhavanti |
tatra kasya ka prasaṅga iti vicāraḥ |
agnīṣomīya tasya tatraiva bhavita- vyaṃ, pradhānadeśatvātteṣām |
yadi aninirvāpyāṇāṃ tantraṃ syāt, tataḥ tasmin sthāne taddāni kriyeran,
tasmāt teṣāṃ svasthānalabhāya paśu- puroḍāśasya tantraṃ kartavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
svitkṛcchravacanaṃ svitkṛte vacanaṃ paśupuroḍāśasya devikāhaviṣāṃ ca śrūyate 'agnaye sviṣṭa- kṛte samavayati' iti |
yadā tu paśupuroḍāśatantraṃ, tadā asvitkṛcchra- bdakaṃ syāt |
paśupuroḍāśasya tantreṇa anirukte svitkṛte prāpte 'agnaye sviṣṭakṛte samavayati' iti vacanāt vikāraḥ syāt asvitkṛcchrabdakaṃ syāt |
caivaṃ paśutvādijātiḥ pavekatvādyapi ca anupādeyaṃ syāt |
yajamānavyaktestu svakṛtyavyāpyatvāt tad- dvārā'pi na tadīyaikalyajāti kṛtitvānya iti anupādeyameva |
ata eva 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' ityasya 'anupādeya- saṃtrandhasattviḥ asaṃnidhiḥ prakaraṇāntaraṃ' ityanyanyāviṣa- yatā iṣyate |
nanu yajamānasya ātmīyamekaṃ brāhmaṇyādi- jātiśca anupādeyā cet tattvaṃtrandhasattvie asaṃni- dhinā prakaraṇāntaratvāt medaḥ syāt, tatra ādyodāharaṇaṃ 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' ityeva |
śrutilakṣaṇaviṣaye ca śruti- nyāyyā, na lakṣaṇā |
tathā, pṛṣadājye devatāyāṃ yo vidhiśabda uktaḥ, tena vacanaṃ kartavyam |
ḍupa— siddhāntastu samāna iti kṛtvā vanaspatirudā- hṛtaḥ |
soma— yadi codakānugrahāya mantraviśeṣalābhāśrayaṇaṃ tadihāpi tadanugrahāya yena kena cidabhidhānaṃ ityucitam |
āpastambācāryaistu ' mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ gorvai- pāyā medasa'nubrūhi ', ' mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ gorvaipāyā medasaḥ preṣya iti saṃpreṣye ' iti gośabdanīyama evoktaḥ |
sa ca śāstrāntare tathāpāṭhaparikalpanayā kathaṃ cidupa- pādanīyaḥ |
atra vidhinigamaśabdamedasārthyāt na codakātireka ityeva siddhāntaḥ |
mantrajyānasmṛti: mantrapāṭhottarakālā iti tatra mantramu- ccārayan smaret ityupapannam |
ṛjavastu 'karaṇabhāve sati' iti ( lakṣaṇaśloke ) vivakṣitatvāt na karaṇeṣu atiprasaṅga: |
uccārayan iti ca 'vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadā' iti sattā |

bhā. 318|120. anumantraṇamantrā: ekādaśa anujyājeṣu barhi- rārāśaṃsayo: catvāraścatvāro vikārā: |
avaśiṣṭā: trayastu sviṣṭakṛto vikārā: iti tattadanumantraṇamantrāṇāṃ tatratatra atideśa: |
su. pṛ. 102. darśapūrṇamāsayo- ryajamānānāṃ prayājāsumantraṇādīnāṃ nānāśvāntara- samāptānāṃ 'vasantaṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi' ityevamādīnāṃ kramasya niyamo nāsti |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 304. anumānaṃ kāryakāraṇayoreva iti cit, tattu ayuktaṃ, akāryakāraṇabhūtānumānāpi kṛṣikādīnāṃ avi- roddhatarohiṇyādipratipattihetutvadarśanāt |
anyasminneva saṃbandhe sati paścāt prasiddhasyamena anumānavyavahāropalakṣaṇatvena upanyasyati |
yadvā śaktyabhiprāyaṃ, yayoreva hi vyāptigraha- ṇakāle gamyagamakābhyāṃ ātmanā kāryakāraṇabhāvāttvena sā avadhṛtā, tatraiva hetutā |
vā. 121|26 pṛ. 139. anumānaṃ ca pratyakṣavirodhāt (viśeṣe sati) na pramā- ṇam |
bhā. 6|1|12 pṛ. 1359. anumānaṃ jñāta- saṃbandhasya ekadeśadarśanāt ekadeśāntare asaṃnikṛṣṭe arthe buddhi: |
jñātasaṃbandhasya puruṣasya ekadeśadarśa- nāt ekasya saṃbandhino darśanāt, ekadeśāntare saṃbandhvantare asaṃnikṛṣṭe arthe buddhi: anumānam |
yathā śātavahidhūma- niyatasāmānādhikaraṇyasya puruṣasya dhūmarūpaikadeśadarśanāt asaṃnikṛṣṭe ekadeśāntare vahnau buddhi: |
evaṃ ca dharmasaṃbandhino liṅgasya agrahāt nānumānasaṃbhava: iti bhāva: |
anumānaṃ śatasaṃbandhasya ekadeśadarśanāt eka- deśāntare asaṃnikṛṣṭe arthe buddhi: |
tat dvividhaṃ pratya- kṣatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ sāmānyatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ ca |
pratyakṣato- dṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ yathā, dhūmākṛttidarśanāt agnyākṛtivijñā- nam |
sāmānyatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ yathā devadattasya gati- pūrvikāṃ deśāntaraprāptimupalabhya ādityagatisaraṇam |
bhāṣyaṃ. pṛ. 36-37. atra bhāṣye anumānaśabda: anumitipara: |
jñāta: saṃbandha: liṅgaliṅginorvyāptyākhya: saṃbandho yena pramātrā puruṣeṇa tasya |
anena ca vyāptistatpakṣadharmatājñānajanyaṃ jñānaṃ anumiti: iti lakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati |
yatra viśeṣayo- reva pratyakṣena saṃbandho gṛhyate tadviśeṣaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣato- dṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ ityucyate |

-dharmāviśeṣatajanyadhūmaviśeṣayo: saṃbandhagrahaṇe pratyakṣena jātaṃ, tasminneva dharmiṇi kālāntare tasyaiva dhūmaviśeṣasya darśanena tasyaiva saṃdihyamānasadbhāvasya aviśeṣasya yada- numānaṃ tat pratyakṣatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhātmakamanumānam |
ākṛtigrahaṇaṃ ākṛtyora itaravyavacchedakatvena hetusādhya- saṃbandho gṛhyate tat sāmānyatodṛṣṭasaṃbandham |
'ādityo gatimān, deśāntaraprāptimatatvāt, yoyo deśāntaraprāpti- mān sa sa gatimān yathā devadatta: ' |
iti gati- prāpyo: sāmānyayoreva pratyakṣena saṃbandho gṛhyate: āditye gatyanumānopayogī itīdaṃ sāmānyatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhajanyanu- mānam |
vidyānātha: pṛ. 36-37. ( bhāṣyārtha: ) ' pramātā jñātasaṃbandha, ekade- śyatha vocyate |
' (ślokā. anumānaṃ 2.) yena pramātrā jñāta: saṃbandha:-, tasya buddhi: iti tṛtīyārthe bahuvrīhi: ityāha pramāteti |
yekadeśina: agnisaṃbandho niyamāravyo jñāta: tasya yo dhūmākhya: ekadeśa:, tasya parvatādau darśanāt tatraiva eka- deśāntare abhivṛddhi: iti vā ṣaṣṭhyarthe bahuvrīhi: ityāha- ekadeśitī |
saṃbandhino- vyāptyasya vartamāna: ekadeśī, ekadeśī ca saṃbandhinau |
jñātasau saṃbandhasya, tasya ya: ekadeśa: saṃbandhī dhūma:, tasya darśanāt saṃvandhvantare buddhi: ityāha- karmadhāra- yeti |
tatra ekasya samudāyina: darśanāt anyasya samudāyino buddhi: iti bahuvrīhī eva arthāntaramāha- dvayamiti |
yo yasya deśakā- lābhyāṃ samo nyūno'pi vā bhavet |
sa vyāpyo, vyāpakastasya samo vā'pyadhiko'pi vā |
vyāpya- tvād gamikā gāvo, vyāpikā na viṣāṇitā |
tatrāpi vyāpyataiva syādaṅgaṃ, na vyāptitā, mite: (anu- mite:) |
deśe yāvat kāle vā vyāpyatā prāgu nirūpitā |
tasya tāvat tādṛk sa dṛṣṭo dharmya- ntare puna: |
' nanu hiṃsatvaṃ agnīpamīyādihiṃsāyāṃ adharmatvamanumāpayet, asita tasya adharmatvena vyāpti: brahmahatyādau ata āha- vyātireti |
satyaṃ asita hiṃsātvasya vyāpti:; tathāpi na adharmatvavyāptestat prayojakam |
yadeva niṣiddhatvaṃ asmin adharmatve sati amuṣya niṣiddhatvasya bhavituṃ śakti: iti nirūpyate, tadeva prayojakam |
anye tu hiṃsātvādya: pareṇa niṣiddhatvena prayuktāṃ vyāptiṃ upajīvanti |
ata: satyāmapi vyāptau tairhetorapi vyāpakadharmatvaṃ nāvadhārayituṃ śakyam |
ka: puna: prayojaka: ? yasya dharmāntaraviraheṇāpi sādhyānvayo dṛṣṭa:, sa prayojaka: |
yasya tu anyasahitasyaiva sādhyānvaya:, sa tadabhāve niśrite tadrahito na prayojaka: |
niṣiddhatvasya na hiṃsātvaviraheṇāpi surāpānādau adharmānvayo dṛṣṭa:, iti tadeva adharmatvavyāpte: prayojakam
’ dhūmatajjñānādīnāṃ pramāṇatvaṃ, prameyajñānaṃ phalaṃ, tatrāmāpye tu hānādibuddhiḥ phalaṃ, vyāpāraḥ : samānaviṣa- yatvaṃ pratyakṣavat ihāpi veditavyaṃ sarveṣāṃ dhūmādīnāṃ prameya- jñāne vyāpārāt |
svayamamumitāyai parasyāpi anumānabuddhiḥ yena vākyena ucyate, tadākyaṃ sādhanaṃ ityucyate |
tacca vākyaṃ pratijñāhetudṛṣṭāntaḥ sāvayavamaṅgīkṛtya pratijñāṃ śodhayati |
sa svayaṃ anumitasyārthasya anumā- nenaiva pratipādanaṃ parasmai vācyaṃ prathamaṃ vaktavyaḥ ityāha— ‘anumānagṛhītasya tenaiva pratipāda- nam |
parebhyo vācchatā vācyaḥ pūrvapakṣo (pūrvapakṣaḥ pakṣaḥ pratijñā) yathoditaḥ |
bhāṣyollakṣaṇa- gatasya asaṃnikṛṣṭapadasya vyācaṣṭyāha— ‘asaṃnikṛṣṭa- vācā ca dvayamātra jihāsitam |
’ yena rūpeṇa anu- mātumiṣyate, tenaiva rūpeṇa tadviparītena vā rūpāntareṇa śīghrapramāṇena paricchinno yo dharmī, sa saṃnikṛṣṭaḥ |
mūle tasya hyanutpanne pūrvaṇa viṣayo hṛtaḥ |
’ liṅgadarśanasyāti- saraṇādikaṃ anumānasya mūlaṃ, tatrāvat naiva niṣpadyate,
anumānāvāgamyarūpa- viparīta rūpeṇa paricchinne tadviparīta rūpe na pramāṇāpekṣā |

na kevalamanumānaviṣayamevedaṃ mantrasya bādhyatvaṃ, kintu dhūmādīnāṃ pratyakṣādīnāṃ madhye yenaiva śīghrapravṛttiā prathamaṃ arthaḥ : avadhārito bhavati, tenaiva uttarakālasya mantrasya utpattitirodhalakṣaṇo bādho bhavati ityāha— ‘pratyakṣā- deśca ṣaṭkasya yanaivārtho'vadhāritaḥ |
’ pratyakṣa- virodhodāharaṇamāha— ‘agrāhyatā tu śabdādeḥ pratya- kṣeṇa virudhyate |
’ tataśca ‘śabdaḥ aśrāvaṇaḥ guṇatvāt rūpavat’ ityanumānasya anumānenaiva bādhaḥ |
’ dharmoktyā pratijñāvirodhamāha— ‘sarva vākyaṃ mṛṣā vākyatvāt’ ityanumānasyāpi vākya- rūpatvāt |
‘dharmyuktyā''ha yato jātaḥ sā vandhyā jananī mama |
’ upamānaviro- dhamāha— ‘jñātago gavayākāraṃ prati yaḥ sādhyate- didam |
’ hṛdyādarśanādavagatagābhāvakalpi- tasya vahnibhāvasya abhāvapratijñā abhāvapūrvikā arthā- pattyā bādhyate |

2- pratyakṣavadadāhakatvasiddhirucyateḥ- adāhakatvaṃ atacchaktitvaṃ pratyakṣapūrvikā, 3-ceṣṭānumita- jñānakalpitābhidhānaśaktyanumānaṃ anumānapūrvikā, 4- śabdajñānakāraṇatvenānumitasya karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnasya digākāśādīnāmanyatamasya sāmarthye kalpite tadabhāvā- numānasya anumānapūrvikā arthāpatyā bādhaḥ, 5- arthā- pattisiddhāmidhānaśaktyanyathā'nupapatti kalpitaśabda nityatva- viparītānitāpyakṣatā arthāpattipūrvikā |
tasya ca pratyakṣagatatvena tailena bādhyate tad- vyātaḥ : agnireva vādhito bhavati |
dharmasvarūpopadeśa- vyāmudāharati— ‘adharmo vihito duḥkhaṃ karo- tyalpamitīha tu |
ubhaya- svarūpadviśeṣabādhamudāharati— ‘athathāthī dharmaḥ sarvā ityukte dvayavādhanam |
’ jñānasvarūpasya tadviśeṣasya ca kṣaṇikatvasya, ayathārthatvasya tadviśeṣasya ca ātyantikatvasya bādhaḥ, tadgrāhiṇāmapi dhiyāṃ mithyā- tvāpātāt |
tatra ekadeśadarśanāt ityanena darśanaśabdena niścayavācinā nirastaṃ asiddhaṃ darśayati-- ‘darśanādekadeśasyetyanenat vyudasyate |
’ vādi- prativādinoḥ ekasya dvayorvā saṃśayaḥ, aghīḥ ajñānaṃ ca, viparyayaśca yasmin saḥ aniścitatvāt asiddhaḥ |
dvayorvi- paryayāsiddhimāha— ‘śailyaśca dāhako vahniḥ, śvāṅku- balatvādinatyayā |
’ śabdānityatve yadeva mīmāṃsakaṃ prati vaiśeṣikādibhiḥ kṛta- katvaguṇādihetṛtvenopanyamānaṃ prativādinaḥ asiddhaṃ, tadeva mīmāṃsakenocyamānaṃ vasiddhiprati |
pṛthagjanānāṃ dehāti- rikte puṃsi saṃśayāt saṃdigdhaāśrayāsiddhiḥ |
anaikāntika- viruddha bhāṣyasyā''śratantrapadavyāvarttitau saṃśayaviparyaya- hetu darśayati— ‘saṃdehaviparītatvahetu cātra nirā- kṛtau |
sarasādhye tadabhāve vā dvābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ ca |
tābhyāṃ sapakṣavipakṣabhyāṃ vyāvṛttaḥ : kevalapade evaṃ vartamānaḥ asādhāraṇaḥ |
dharmānta- reṣu viruddhavyābhicāri hetutrayaṃ ekatra ekadeśini dṛśyamānaṃ viruddhavyabhicāri |
vyāpyaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ vyāpakaṃ sādhyarthavattvāt dhūmaḥ agninā niyamyamānaḥ abhivyati- |
jñātasaṃbandhasyeti ca na vyāpye eṣā ṣaṣṭhī |
‘ yathāgnināsti tatra dhūmo nāsti ’ ityevaṃ anyabhāvāt |
hi vastuni vyāpyavivakṣāyāmeva yathā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, tathā phalaṃ, yasmāt pakṣe'pyevaṃ nirūpitam |
tathā ca laukikāḥ bhāvamātraṃ hi vyāpyānnivartate |
‘ mamāyaṃ, ayaṃ punaranyasyāpi ’ iti vyapadiśanti, tasmādyaiva śuklatve paṭasyokte, virodhinām |
raṇena hi vyapadeśo bhavet iti ṣaṣṭhyā saṃbandhavyāpyatā 137|
ayaṃ punaḥ anyasyāpīti pratisaṃbandhinyāpyatai- sāmānyatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ ca ’ ityādibhāṣyam |
) adṛṣṭalakṣaṇaviṣayamanumā- namati kriyādipu ( kriyāyāṃ śaktau ca ) |
kathaṃ punaḥ adṛṣṭalakṣaṇe ( ṇayoḥ ) saṃvandhi ( ndha ) darśanam ? |
utpattitaḥ ( sva- ) phalasya darśanāt ityupapāditama- dhastāt asāmiḥ śruttvāde |
( lakṣaṇābhidhānaprayojanaṃ pṛcchati ) kaḥ punaranumāne vyabhicāraḥ ? yathā pratyakṣe śuktikādiṣu |

‘ yāvān kaścit pratiṣedhaḥ sa sarvo'nupalabdhitaḥ’ iti |
amau sati dhūmaḥ iti tāvat pratyakṣeṇāvagamyatāṃ, asati tvagnau dhūmo nāstīti kiṃ pramāṇam ? nanvanupalabdhiliṅkakamumānameveti |
vahnerdravyenopādhiko dhūmasaṃyogaḥ, tada- bhāve bhavatyeva vahnerdhūmasaṃyogabhāvaḥ |
dhūmasya tu vahni- saṃyogo naupādhikaḥ; kathamasau na bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkate ? kathamanaupādhikāvagamaḥ ? prayatnenāpyanyadhūmane aupā- dhikatvānavagamāt |
taccaitat bhūyodarśanāccamiti manvānā ācāryā bhūyodarśanaṃ dṛhavantaḥ |
nanvevaṃ saṃbandhaniyamavāsāya- samaye eva yāvadvadhūmādimāvativā vahnyādisaṃbandha- svāgatatvāt dhūmādisattāniśśayādadhikaṃ niśvetavyaṃ nāviśiṣyate, ityanumānapramāṇaṃ syāt |
iha tu saṃbandhaniyamasamekadeśadarśanaṃ nānubhava- kāraṇamastīti vyāptītyanubhūtirūpatve āśrayādiśucitā, iti yuktamevānumānasya prāmāṇyam |
aśeṣadeśakāla- vartinastu liṅgasya laiṅgikasaṃbandhaḥ saṃbandhaniyamavādharaṇasamaye evāvadhṛtaḥ |
dhūmavatā hyulakṣitānāṃ deśakālaviśeṣāṇāṃ saṃbandhaniyamavadhāraṇāt 'yoyo dhūmavān saso 'bhimān' iti |
laiṅgikaikadeśaviṣayaṃ saṃbandhaniyamaṃ smarataḥ puruṣasya niyatasaṃbandhaikadeśadarśanāt yā buddhistadanumānam |
na cāśritasyāśrayamanya- reṇa saṃbhave'stīti āśrayākṣepe naikadeśābhyāṃ bhinnasyā- śrayākṣepaḥ, ekākṣepeṇaivopāpatteḥ |
api cāttaraśabdo- 'pi samānāśraye eva samarthito bhavati |
udāharaṇaṃ tu mahānasādau jñātātrisaṃbandhaniyamasya dhūmasya parvataparivartino darśanāt parvatatitabhyagatadhūmau jñānam |
na tādevaṃ sarvatra lokasya pratītiḥ; kiṃtu parvatāditamapyagniṃ lokonu- minoti |
na cāśrayabhedaḥ, ekatvāt parvatasyāvayavinaḥ tadāśritatvādima dhūmayoḥ |
nitambhoparibhāgau tu tattathai- vāvayavāviti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
asyeva hi gandhā- khyasyaikadeśasya rasākhyenaikadeśena ekārthasamavāyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandho niyataḥ |
sa tu saṃbandhaniyamo na pratīta- pūrvaḥ |
yo hi yena saṃbandho dṛṣṭaḥ; sa tamupa kalpayitumalama |
yasya tu kena cidapi saha saṃbandho nāvadhāritaḥ, sa kaścidapi smṛtiṃ janayitumakṣamaḥ; iti kathaṃ saṃśayaṃ prasūyeta |
kṛtakatvasya hi nityatvena saha saṃbandha eva nāsti, kiṃtvanityatvenaiva saha |
ayaṃ pratītasaṃbandhaniyamaḥ : svāsāma- dhyainānityatvamupasthāpayan nityaṃ bādhate iti siṣādhayi- pitadharmatvāt bādhako hetvābhāsaḥ |
prameyatvasya nityatvena saṃbandho'sti jñātaśca, kiṃtvanityaḥ, nitye'pi prameyatvadarśanāt |
saṃśayahetutvāt, nityatvānityatvobhayasaṃbandhatvāt, ekasya ca dharmiṇo nityā- nityavirodhatvāt |
unmīlite hi cakṣuṣi gṛhopahārādiṣu yadrūpamupalabhyate tattaijasamīdakaṃ vailukaṃ tattvālloke |
tathā yasya pakṣī ekadeśatvamanekadeśatvaṃ ca tasyāpyata eva nirāsaḥ yathā 'vedaḥ kutakaḥ : upā- dhyānātmatvāt' iti |
nanu dhūmo'pi na hetuḥ syāt, kṛtsna- parvatavyāpakatvābhāvāt |
tatrāvayavī parvata ekaḥ: tasyaikadeśa eva dhūmaḥ |
iha tu na vedavayavī ekaḥ; iti yuktaṃ bhāsāsiddhatvam |
darśanagrahaṇena svarūpāsiddhaṃ hetvā- bhāsaṃ darśayati yathā 'buddho dharmādharmī pratyakṣamīkṣate sarva- jñātvāt' iti |
nahi buddhasya sarvajñatvaṃ kena cidi pramā- ṇenāvagantuṃ śakyate ityuktam |
tathā vidyamānasyāpyeka- deśasya yāvaddarśanaṃ nāsti tāvadetulyaṃ yathā andhakāre dhūmasya |
nanu candrodayāt samudravṛddhayanu- māne kṛttikodayācca rohiṇīsaṃnidhānakalpane kathaṃ samānāśra- yatvam |
ekakālavartinaṃ candrodayasamudra- vṛddhayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ : tatra kālaḥ eva āśrayaḥ iti |
tathā, kṛttikodayarohiṇyastayorapi ekahorātravartitvena saṃbandhaḥ; tena kṛttikodayādahorātra eva āsamarohiṇyayo'numī- yate |
pitrostu brāhmaṇatayā yatputrasya brāhmaṇyānumānaṃ ke cidi- cchanti, tat prābhākarā nānumanyante |
tena brāhmaṇa- śābdavācyastrīpuṃsaprasūtatvādanyatva brāhmaṇa nāstīti nātyanu- mānānumeyabhāvaḥ |
'abādhite' ityanena pramāṇāntaravā- dhite vipaye nānumānamupyate iti darśayati yathā 'vahnira- nuṣṇo dravyatvāt' iti |
nanu dravyatvasyānuṣṇatvena saha saṃbandhaḥ eva nāsti, vahniva asyanuṣṇatve dravyatvasya darśanāt |
yadi bādhitaviṣaye'pyanu- mānamupyate, tadā dravyatvasya saṃbandhaniyamabhāva eva na bhaveta, vahnerapyanumānenaiva anuṣṇatvasya siddhatvāt |
dravyatvasya ca vahnireva sarvatratā'nuṣṇatvena saha saṃbandhaniyamavadhāraṇaṃ jātamiti tadvalenānumānodaye pāścā- tto'pi saṃbandhaniyamabhaṅgo nātmānaṃ labhate |
tasmāt bādhitaviṣayatvādevānumānamanudayāta saṃbandhaniyamo'pi bhajyate ityavādhitaviṣayatvamanumānasya kāraṇam |
'śabdaḥ śrotrāgraho na bhavati guṇatvāt' ityanumānasya viṣayo'numānena bādhitaḥ |
yadviṣayā hi yamapīti : yatkaraṇikā, tadindriyaṃ tasya grāhakamucyate |
anupahate hi śrotre śabdapratītirutpāyate, upahate ca nopajāyate, iti śrotrānvayavyatirekakāriṇī śabdapratītiḥ : śrotrakaraṇikā |
ataḥ : śabdapratītiḥ : śrotrakaraṇikā śrotrānvaya- vyatirekānuvidhāyitvāt ' ityanumānena śrotragrāhyatvama- dhṛtaṃ sat, yo vādī nāstītyāha tasyānumānamanumānena bādhate |

nanu saṃbandhaniyamagrahaṇatatparamekadeśadarśanasāpe- kṣasya arthāntarāvagāmanirapekṣo'pi pratyakṣaṃ śīghrajana- tvā, avaśyaṃbhāvitvā ca viṣayanādupalavdhiṃ prati- badhnāti, anumānena tanmānasya kathamyutpattirityanvayaḥ : iti vaktavyam |
yena nāma śrotrāgrāhyaṃ śabdasya nirākartavyaṃ, tenācaśyaṃ grāhyakatvasaṃbandhaḥ : prathamamava- gantavyaḥ, anyathā niṣedhānavakalpanāt |
avagatameva vastu vipayāntare pratiṣṭhite, na tu sarvathā anavagatameva |

tenānyatra grāhyagrāhaka saṃbandhamabhyupagacchatā aṅgīkṛtā tāvat anvayavyatirekānuvidhāyiliṅgakasya anumānasya pravṛttiriti śīghramābhyanumānaṃ anumānāntarasya viṣayamapa- harat bādhakatāṃ pratipadyate |
yathā anumānapūrvakānumānāt pratyakṣapūrvakamanumānaṃ prathamabhāvi, tathā prasiddhāṅkananu- mānaṃ prasādhyāṅkadanumānādāyuttarabhāvīti veditavyam |
arthāpattyā cānumānaviṣayapahā ro yathā 'jīvan devadatto veśmaviṣayamāno bahirapi nāsti' iti |
pramāṇāntarasiddhe'pi viṣaye, nānumānaṃ vartate yathā pratyakṣavagate vahnerauṣṇye |
tadyathā saṃbandhaniyāmadhāraṇasiddhaviṣayaṃ kimiti nopapadyate ? pramātārastu nivṛttapramitāḥ tatra saṃbandhaniyāmānusaṃdhānaṃ prati nādiyante iti nānumānamu- deti |
yadi ca anusaṃhitasaṃbandhaviniyamaikadeśadarśane'pi viṣayasiddhau nānumānamupapadyate, tato bhavedeva asādhita- viṣayatvamapi anumānakāraṇam |
tasmāt pūrṇa- midaṃ anumānakāraṇaparagaṇanaṃ niyatasaṃbandhaikadeśadarśanaṃ, saṃbandhaniyā
dṛṣṭaḥ, iti kathaṃ vegātmā saṃskāraḥ śaravaryākāśena |
śabdaśravaṇādi tejo'vayavaiḥ sthititaiśca vāyubhiḥ saha saṃyogavibhāgau |
kāryācchabdocāritavadanumīyate, śabdānuccāraṇaṃ ca ārabhate, iti na śakyamāśritum |
svavacanaṃ tu maunitā- vibhāgasaṃyogau utpadyete iti yuktameva karmānumānam |
māha, na punarmonitāmiti na tena vyāghātaḥ |
yāvaddhi kasmiṃściddharmiṇi syāt, tadā kāryameva nopadyeta |
tasmāt samyaksādharmya- dṛṣṭāntaprayogeṇaiva saṃbandhanīyamāvateḥ anarthakaṃ vaidharmya- dṛṣṭāntopādānamiti |
mā bhūt dṛṣṭāntadopā- dānaṃ kiṃtu vikalpo'stu |

vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntenāpi hi sādhya- dharmavirahinamuddiśya sādhanadharmavirahivau kurute sarvasādhya- virahiṇāṃ sādhanadharmavirahivyapagamādanyatra sādhanadharmā- 'vakāśalamamānaḥ sādhyadharmavatyeva vartate iti sādhyadharma- saṃbandhaniyamamāvateḥ vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntenāpi hetutvaṃ samarthita- meva bhavatīti tulyakāryatayā sādharmyavaidharmyadṛṣṭāntayo- rvikalpo nyāyya iti |
vaidharmyadṛṣṭānto vakraḥ iti na vikalpo yuktaḥ |
vipakṣamāmanantatvāt sādhyadharmasaṃbandhāvyabhi- cārarūpastha saṃbandhaniyamo yathā'vagantuṃ surūpoditameva |
tasmāt sarvatra sādharmyadṛṣṭānta eva kevalaḥ prayoktavya iti sthitam |
yata evaṃvidhaṃ samānaṃ, ato dūṣaṇamapi pakṣasya pratyakṣādibādhitatvaṃ aprasiddhaviśeṣatvā ca hetoḥ svarūpā- siddhatvamekadeśāsiddhatvaṃ asādhāraṇatvaṃ sādhāraṇatvaṃ vādha- katvaṃ ceti |
dṛṣṭāntasya ca sādhyavikalatā, sādhanavikalatā, saṃbandhaniyamavikalatā, niyamaśūnyatā, viparītaniyamatā |
ata eva ca pratijñāntaramapi pṛthag doṣo na bhavati, dūṣita- pūrvepratijñasyaiva pratijñāntarālambanatvāt |
aprasiddhatve hetorasiddhatvaiva doṣaḥ, siddhatve vā tadgrāhakapramāṇatvāt pakṣasya doṣaḥ |
pratyakṣa satsaṃpa- yogajanyalakṣaṇena lokasiddhena avyabhicāramuktvā idānīṃ anumānāderapi avyabhicārārthe lokasiddhameva lakṣaṇamāha - (bhāṣyakāraḥ) |
' anumānaṃ jñātasaṃbandhasya ekadeśadarśanāt ekadeśāntare asannikṛṣṭe arthe buddhiḥ |

yasya yādṛśaḥ, yena yādṛśena saha, sākṣādvā praṇāḍyā vā yādṛśaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, saṃyogaḥ, samavāyaḥ, ekā- rthasamavāyaḥ, kāryakāraṇatvaṃ, anyo vā dṛṣṭāntadharmeṣu niyatato jñātaḥ, taṃ tādṛśaṃ sādharmyadharmaṃ dṛṣṭavataḥ tasmin tādṛśo jñātasaṃbandhasaṃbandhini pravalena pramāṇena tādṛṣya- tadviparyayābhyāṃ aparicchinne yā buddhiḥ, sā anumānam |
yathā dhūmasya anuparatordhagamanasya agnisāhityaṃ mahānasā- diṣu niyatatvamupalabhyataḥ parvate taddarśanāt agnijñānam |
nanu niyamavyāpārādhīnatve kathaṃ tādṛpyeṇa aparicchinne pravṛttiḥ ? |
evaṃ cet yāvadvyaṃ agnisvabhāvaḥ avagata eva iti nāparicchinnatvaparyeva anumānasya saṃbhavati iti |
ata eva cocyatāṃ vivakṣataḥ ke cit asannikṛṣṭagrahaṇaṃ smara- ṇābhimānanirāsāya vyācakṣate gṛhītagrāhitvameva anumā- nasya svīkurvāṇāḥ |
tathāpi nāprāmāṇyaṃ, nahi agṛhīta- grahaṇaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ, anubhūtirhi tallakṣaṇam |
anumānaṃ ca gṛhītagrāhitve'pi pratyupabaliṅkakāraṇajanyatvena saṃskāra- mātrajanyatvābhāvāt anubhūtireva iti yuktamasya prāmā- ṇyam |
saṃskārātiriktakāraṇasadbhāve hi ' idaṃ rajataṃ ' ityanubhavaprasthāpi rajatajñānasya valavat smṛtipramābhitra pramopaḥ aṅgīkṛtaḥ |
atra tu liṅgasya anubhavakāraṇasya sadbhāvāt ayuktaṃ pratīti- siddhasya anubhavatvasya apahavena smṛtipramoṣāṅgīkaraṇa- miti |
tathāhi, yadi hi yāvadvyāpyavyāpakasadbhāvaḥ avagataḥ syāt, tato gṛhītagrāhitvaṃ āśaṅkyate'pi, na tu evamasti |
nasādiṣveva hi dṛṣṭāntadharmiṣu prāganumānāt dhūmasya agni- sāhityamavagataṃ, na sarvatra, pramāṇasaṃbhavāt |
yathā cāsaṃ- bhavaḥ, tathā nyāya ratnamālāyāmeva prapañcitam |
dṛṣṭānta- dharmiṣveva bahuśaḥ aprisāhityamupalabhyataḥ ; ananyau ca cidapi prayatnenānicchyamāne dhūmaṃ adṛṣṭavataḥ : sādhyadharmiṣu agnisājñānaṃ utpadyate |
āha ca 'sāhitye mitadeśa- tvāt prasiddhe vahnidhūmayoḥ |
tataśca anumitasā na sarvatrāṃ dhūmavatāṃ agnimatā ava- gantavyā, nāpi sarvatra anagni dhūmasyābhāvaḥ |
bhūyo'- misāhityaṃ vyabhicārādarśanaṃ ityetādeva anumānārthibhiḥ abhyarthanīyaṃ, nādhikaṃ kiṃ cit |
iti jñānaṃ, tat anumānameva iti tatraivoktam ( nyāya ratnamālāyām ) |
nanu evamapi anenaiva sāmānyānumānena sarvadhūmavatāṃ agnimatā ava- gatā iti punaḥ parvatādiviśeṣeṣu dhūmadarśanāt anyanumānaṃ, tasya gṛhītagrāhitvaṃ tadavasthameva syāt |
sāmānyena hi dhūmavatāṃ agnimatā avagatā, parvatādeṣu deśaviśeṣasya svarūpa- mapi prāganavagataṃ, natarāṃ agnistvam |
yastu avagata- meveti manyate, tena parvatasvarūpameva tāvadaprāptaṃ parvatā- samīpasthaiḥ kena pramāṇenāvagataṃ iti vaktavyam |
na ca anavagataparvataḥ tasyā- gnimatāṃ avadhārayitumalama |
yadi ca idānīṃtanaṃ parvata- syāgnimatvaṃ prāgevāvagataṃ syāt, tataḥ agmyarthinaṃ vinaiva dhūmadarśanena agmye parvatārohet |
kiṃ ca dhūmo- palakṣitasya parvatādeśaviśeṣasya agnisaṃbandho'vagataḥ iti vadatā dhūmasaṃbandho'pi avagata iti vaktavyam |

atha deśamātrasya dhūmopalakṣaṇaṃ, na deśaviśeṣasya, tataḥ agni- mattvamapi tanmātrasyāvagataṃ, na deśaviśeṣasya, ato liṅga- liṅginoḥ aviśeṣāt ' liṅgasya deśakālātirekaḥ, na liṅginaḥ' iti pralāpamātram |
api ca ' yatra amī- ndhanasaṃyogaḥ, tatra dhūmaḥ ' ityanena dhūmo'pi avagata eva, iti na kiṃ cidapi avagantavyamavaśiṣyate dhūma- jñānena, ityalaṃ vālajalpitena |
yadi ca avagatameva anu- mānenāvagamyate, tataḥ smarameva pramupitatadava anu- mānajñānaṃ syāt |
saṃbandhadarśanaṃ hi sahyādarśanavat saṃskāra- mudrodhayet, klṛptaṃ hi tatra tasya kāraṇatvam |
saṃskā- raśca udbodhitaḥ smṛtiṃ janayati ityavivādam |
tadevaṃ klṛptenaiva mārgeṇa dhūmādagnijñānopatteḥ ko nāma klṛptaṃ liṅgasya liṅgajñānahetutvaṃ kalpayet |
kalpanāyāṃ vā śukāvapi rajatavedanasya anubhavatvāt tadupapatteḥ doṣasya anubhavahetutvaṃ kalpanīyam |
akalpane tu atrāpi smṛtipramopāt aprāmāṇyameva syāt |
nanu apriviśeṣasya agṛhītasaṃbandhasya anumeyatvāt sāmānyameva anumeyaṃ, tacca prāgavagatameveti kathaṃ agṛhītagrāhitvam |
avagatasyāpi sāmānyasya deśā- ntarakālāntarasaṃbandhasya agṛhītasya grahaṇāt upapannaṃ prame- yatvam |
idaṃ cāparaṃ ekadeśinā vaktavyaṃ, kena pramāṇena dhūmadarśanasya agnijñānahetutvamavagamyate iti |
nahi agnijñānasya anu- bhavatve pratyakṣamanyadā pramāṇamasti, asti tu smṛti- pramoṣatve |
atha smṛtipramoṣatve bādhakaṃ syāt, na ca agnijñānasya tadasti, ityato na smṛtipramoṣaḥ iti cenna |
maṇiprabhā- darśanaḥ maṇibuddhisattvāt smṛtipramoṣa eva, anyathā viparītakhyātiprasaṅgāt, atha ca pravṛttasya maṇibhāvāt na bādhakamasti |
tasmāt smṛtireva anumānaṃ iti aprā- māṇyapattiḥ |
paridṛṣṭe deśe kāle ca abhirunmīyate, sa kena pramā- ṇena prāgavagataḥ ? na pratyakṣeṇa, tasya vidyamānopalambhana- tvāt |
kiñca agnidhūmayoḥ mithaḥ saṃbandho deśakālānavacchinnaḥ pratyakṣavagataḥ |
itye- tāvadeva bhavān bravīti, na caitāvatā deśāntarakālāntara- saṃbandhaḥ agneragato bhavati |
kimatra agṛhītam ? agnisāmānyaṃ tāvat gṛhītameva, parvato'pi pratyakṣavagataḥ; aviśiṣṭeṣu parvato na kenāpyavagataḥ; iti so'numeyo bhaviṣyati |

yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' iti viśiṣṭavidhopa'pi vidhiḥ viśeṣaṇapare bhavati, tathā ihāpi viśiṣṭaprameyamānaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ prāptatvāt 'yajñubhuṃ rathamadhye dadāti' iti saṃbandhaviṣayaṃ bhavati iti |
yastu pratipadyamarthaṃ paraṃ (prati) anumānena pratipipād- yiṣati, tena sādhanaṃ prayoktavyam |
yena vākyena yasmānnu- mānyuddipyate tat sādhanamityucyate |
'tacca pañcatayaṃ ke cit, dvayamanthe vayaṃ trayam |
' akṣapādīyāstāvat pratijñā- hetūdāharaṇopanayanigamanaiḥ pañcāvayavaṃ sādhanaṃ manyante |
anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñā, kṛtakatvāt iti hetuḥ; yat kṛtakaṃ tat anityaṃ yathā ghaṭādi ityādiharaṇaṃ, kṛta- kaśca śabdaḥ iti upanayaḥ; tasmādanityaḥ iti nigamanam |
ayaṃ tu ativistaro gatāyaiḥ iti manvānāḥ saugatāḥ dvayavayaṃ udāharaṇopanātmakaṃ manyante |

svarthamānamiyaṃ hi liṅgaṃ sādhyadharmiṇi anusaṃdadhānasya svayameva liṅgi- buddhirutpadyate, tena 'yat kṛtakaṃ, tat anitya' iti kṛtakatvasya anityatvena vyāptiniyamaṃ smāra- yitvā 'kṛtakaśca śabdaḥ' iti upanayamātre kṛte śabdasya anityatvaṃ avagamyate eva iti kṛtamavayavāntaraiḥ |
evaṃ tu atyantasākalyameva kleśadagmādhārtha bhavati iti vyayavameva yuktam |
'anilaḥ śabdaḥ; kṛtakatvāt, yat kṛtakaṃ tat anityaṃ yathā ghaṭādi' ityevamudāharaṇāntaṃ sādhanaṃ sarvatra vārtikakāraḥ prayuṅkte |
'athavā yat kṛtakaṃ tat anityaṃ yathā ghaṭādi, kṛtakaśca śabdaḥ; tasmādanityaḥ'
tathā ca 'yat karma tat phalavat, homo'pi karma, tenāpi phalavatā bhavitavyaṃ' ityeva sarvatra bhāṣyakāraḥ prayuṅkte |
pratijñādoṣāḥ pratyakṣavirodhādayaḥ aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇatvā- dayaśca vārtike prapañcitāḥ |
asiddhiḥ, anaikāntikatvaṃ, bādhakatvaṃ ca iti trayo hetudoṣāḥ |
tatra asiddhiḥ pañcadhā 'buddho dharmādharmavedī, sarvajñatvāt' iti svarūpā- siddhiḥ |
'vahanaḥ adāhakaḥ, śītatvāt' iti saṃbandhasiddhiḥ; dautyasya vahanisaṃbandhabhāvāt |
nanu evaṃ samudradvayau candrodayasya hetutvaṃ na syāt, udayasya samudrasaṃbandhabhāvāt |
deva prāk asvarūpārthaṃ tenaiva hetunā prasajyeta |
svarūpa- pratipādane ca bādhite arthapratipādanamapi taddharmasvarūpaṃ bādhitameva |
nahi prāk saṃgrahagrahāt arthāntarapratipattiḥ śakyate vaktuṃ, pratītivirodhādeva |

sarvatra yo hetuḥ yāgavi- śeṣaviśiṣṭena dṛṣṭāntadharmeṇa niyataḥ, sa tādṛvi- śeṣaviśiṣṭasya sādhyasya dharmiṇā pramāṇāntaravirodhāt sādhanāsaṃbhavena viparītaṃ viśeṣaṃ niyamatvāt svayameva bādhyamāno nirviśeṣasya ca sādhyasya asaṃbhavāt sādhyameva na sādhayati |

yathā śarīracetanakartṛkatvena ghaṭādipu vyāsa- mutpattimeva dehāṅkurādīnāṃ cetanakartṛkatvasādhanāyocyamānaṃ śarīraviśeṣatasya anupalabdhivirodhena sādhyamityubhaya- tvāt aśarīrasya tenaiva hetunā ghaṭādivat nivāraṇāt viṣādayaśūnyasya cetanasya asaṃbhavāt cetanakartṛkatvameva aṅkurādīnāṃ na sādhyati, tena dharmaviśeṣavirodho hetoḥ sādhyasiddhimaiva niruṇaddhi iti bhavati dūṣaṇam |
dharmivi- śeṣavirodhastu sādhyāvirodhāt na dūṣaṇaṃ, pratyuta siddhā- ntantaradūpaṇatvāt prativādina eva nigrahasthānatvāt dūṣaṇaṃ tat bhavati, na vādinaḥ |

yastu dṛṣṭāntaparicchedasādhyaviśeṣa- virodhasaṃbhe'pi tadrahitaṃ sādhyamātraṃ hetuḥ sādhayatyeva, tacca viśeṣāntaramākṣipya sidhyati iti vadati, tasya uṣṇāgniniyata: tṛṇādivākara: hime hṛdayamāna: śailapratyakṣa- virodhāt auṣṇyasaṃbhe'pi aṇutvāmevāpi sādhayet |
sādhyaṃ liṅgamudiśya liṅgina: upādānaṃ 'yoyo dhūma- vān mahānasādiḥ, sa sarvo'gnimān dṛṣṭaḥ' iti |
samya- śukte ca sādharmyaṃ na vaidharmyaṃ vaktavyaṃ, gatārthatvāt |
yadā vaktavyamāpatati, tadā liṅgayabhāvamudiśya liṅgābhāva- pādānaṃ 'yatrāgnirnasti, tatra dhūmo'pi nāsti yathā toyādiṣu' iti |
yatra bhāvena bhāvyaḥ sādhyate, tatraiva vidhi rūpaṃ sādharmyaṃ, tatrativaidhūpaṃ ca vaidharmyaṃ |
yatra tu meghābhāvādinā vṛṣṭyādyabhāvaḥ sādhyate, tatra sādharmyameva pratiṣedharūpaṃ yathā 'yadā yatra meghopattirnāsti, tadā tatra vṛṣṭirnāsti' iti |
vaidharmyaṃ tu vidhirūpaṃ 'yatra vṛṣṭi- rasti, tatra meghopattirasti' iti |
sādharmyābhāsāśca sādhyavikalatvādayaḥ, vaidharmyā- bhāsāśca sādhyābhāvāvaikalatvādayaḥ : vārtike eva draṣṭavyāḥ iti |
' dṛṣṭalakṣaṇaviṣayamevamānumānaṃ ' iti manvānān nirā- kartuṃ adṛṣṭalakṣaṇaviṣayamevamapi anumānaṃ kriyādiviṣaya- masti, iti darśayituṃ dvaividhyābhidhānam |
nahi kriyā- svalakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kadā cit gṛhyate, pūrvottaradeśasaṃyoga- vibhāgamātrasya pratyakṣa grahaṇam |
tābhyāmeva āgantu- kāmyāṃ āgantukaṃ kāraṇamanumīyate, tacca kriyelyucyate |
nanu dravyameva kāraṇaṃ syāt, na, tasya prāgapi sadbhāvāt |
nanu kṣaṇāntare anyat dravyaṃ sarvasaṃskārāṇāṃ kṣaṇa- katvāt, sādhyatvāt pratyabhijñānam |
tat yadā samāna- deśe pūrvapūrvara uttarottaramārabhate, tadā tiṣṭhatīti lakṣyate |
yadā tu anantaradeśe pūrvapūrve uttarottaramārabhate, tadā gacchatīti lakṣyate |
dīpagamanavat chāyāgamanavat sadṛśā- pārāparakṣaṇānāṃ uttarottaradeśāpārādhanāṃ gamanābhāsa- nimittatvāt kṛtaṃ kriyā |
kiṃca anupannasya kṣaṇasya kriyāśrayatvāyogyāt, utpannasya ca vināśagrastatvāt kathaṃ kriyā''rambhakaṃ ? yathā āhuḥ 'kṣaṇikāḥ sarvasaṃskārā asthirāṇāṃ kutaḥ kriyā' iti |
tataḥ sthiratve sati tanmātreṇa anupapatteḥ kriyā'numānaṃ yuktamiti |
prayatna- viśeṣāntaraṃ hi śarīre deśasaṃyogavibhāgāravyaṃ phalaṃ utpadya- mānaṃ upalabhyate, tataḥ sa eva nimittam |
tad- dātmaśarīrasaṃyogaśca asamavāyi, śarīraṃ ca samavāyi, iti kimatra adṛṣṭakāraṇānumānena |
nanu asamavāyi- kāraṇabhūtasya saṃyogasya svāśraye svāśrayasamavete vā kāryaṃ, nānyatra tantusaṃyogānāmiva svāśrayeṣu tantuṣu paṭaḥ, tantu- turīsaṃyogasya vā paṭurīsaṃyogaḥ |
prayatnavadātmasaṃyogastu anenarvidhena vyomni kathaṃ saṃyogamārabhate ? ataḥ kāraṇā- ntaraṃ kalpanīyaṃ iti cet, na |
tantusaṃyogaḥ svāśraye eva paṭamārabhate, paṭasya bahutanuvyāpitvāt, saṃyogānāṃ ca dvayordayoreva vṛtteḥ |

nodanātsyāt yugapadeva śarādyavayaveṣu ca sarveṣu anta- rbahivartiṣu bahūnāṃ karmāṇi utpadyante, tatra yeṣāmavayavānāṃ jyāsaṃyogo nāsti teṣu aśvāśrayeṣu svāśrayasamaveteṣu ca jyāsaṃyogaḥ karma ārabhate iti vyabhicāraḥ |
nahi te saṃyogā'bhiprete śare samavetāḥ, śarasyaiva teṣu samavāyāt |

kiṃca prayatnavadātmasaṃyogāntaraṃ yugapadeva haste prayatna- vadātmasaṃyukte tatsaṃyukte nāṅgade aṅgulīyeke ca tallagne maṇī ca karma utpadyate, atha evamādiṣu na codanāt na prayatnavadātmasaṃyogādvā karmotpattiḥ, kiṃtu saṃyuktasaṃyo- gāt iṣyate, jyāsaṃyuktayavayavasaṃyogān tadanantarāyave tasaṃyogācca tadanantare |
tathā ātmasaṃyogāt haste, tasaṃ- yogādde, tatsaṃyogāt maṇāvapi iti |

evaṃ tarhi atrāpi śakyate vaktuṃ, prayatnavadātmasaṃyogaśarīrākāśa- saṃyogāt śarīrākāśadeśavibhāgaḥ, tatsaṃyogācca tadanantara- deśasaṃyogaḥ, iti dṛṣṭenaiva saṃyogena saṃyogavibhāgasiddheḥ na karmakalpanā akalpyate |
sarvāṇyeva asamavāyikāraṇāni svāśraye svāśrayasamavete vā kāryamārabhante, nānyatra |
tataśca karmāpi asamavāyi- kāraṇatvena anumīyamānaṃ viyati vihaṃgame ca ubhayatrā- numīyeta |
dṛśyate hi sarpāti sarpe bhūmeḥ sarpasya ca dvayoḥ mithaḥ saṃyogavibhāgāviśeṣe'pi sarvameva calatīti buddhiḥ ālambate, na bhūmim |
ataḥ asyā buddheḥ āla- mbanamasti sarpe calanaṃ nāma tattvam |
tasmāt naiva- mabhiprāyaṃ idaṃ bhāṣyaṃ ( tattu dvividhaṃ ityādi ), kiṃtu viśeṣaviṣayaṃ sāmānyaviṣayaṃ cānumānaṃ ityanumānasya viṣayaprayathārtham |
ye'pi manyante 'viśeṣe'ṇusāmānyabhāvaḥ, sāmānye siddhasādhratā' iti, te anena nirā- kriyante, ubhayorapi viśeṣopapatteḥ |
tatra viśeṣaviṣaya- maḥ, sāmānyanugame tu sāmānya-
na ca siddhasādhyatvaṃ, deśāntarakālāntara- saṃgrahaṇasya adṛṣṭasya grahaṇasya iti prāgeva varṇitam |
yenaiva hetunā te pramāṇaṃ, tenaiva vyavasthitā eva prāmā- ṇyamarhanti |
tasmān holakādāyaḥ prācyadhaireva kartavyāḥ, āhnīnebukādadho dākṣiṇātyaireva, udīcyaprabhṛtaya udīcyai- reveti |
prācyādipadānāṃ cārthaviśeṣa- pānavadhāraṇaṃ anyavyavasthitārthatvāt prācyādipadavatī codanā na vyavasthitā, na pramāṇamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhā- ntastu--bhavedevaṃ, yadi prācyādipadavatī codanā anumī- yate, kiṃtu sāmānyena holakādikarmamātraviṣayaṇī |

tat kimayamityardhārthaprācyādipadavatī codanā buddhayupasaṃhā- rāsaṃbhavāt mūlatvena kalpayitumeva na śakyate ityapramāṇam ? kalpitā vā pramāṇam ? yadyakalpitaiva na pramāṇaṃ, tadā ko virodhaḥ ? atha kalpitā satī na pramāṇamityu- cyate, tadasaṃbaddham |
nahi buddhayupasaṃhāramantareṇa ācāra- mūlatayā codanā kalpayitumeva śakyate |
pūrvatra smṛtigataṃ viśeṣaṃ nirūpya idānīmācāragato viśeṣaścintyate |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo''- bhisaṃdhiḥ; holakādyācārasya prācyādisaṃbandhenaivopalambhāt taddeśena atiranumīyamānā holakādayaḥ prācyādibhireva kartavyā iti viśeṣaśrutirevānumīyate |
nanu prācyādiśabdapravṛttinimitta- syaiva avyavasthitatvāt vyavasthitaviśeṣaśrutinumānaṃ saṃbha- vati |
tathāhi, na tāvat brāhmaṇatvādijātivat prācyā- tyādijātirasti |
ṭādau jambhālalīlānuṣṭhānaṃ, vakṣyāmāṇayānāṃ tu caitraśukla- cāradarśananāt |
prayojanaṃ, pūrva- kāraṇaṃ, anyadeśīyanānāṃ taddeśanivāsināmapi taddarśanatvāt |
pakṣe prācyādibhireva holakādyanuṣṭheyaṃ, siddhānte tu sarvai- ata eva kṛṣṇamṛttikādeśīyatvaṃ lohitākṣatvādikaṃ vā na |
sūtraṃ tu—‘holakādikarma sarvairdhamaiḥ’ vyavasthākāraṇa, sarvaireva vyabhicāradarśanāt |
holakādikarmavidhānasya sarvadharmatāpratipādaka- ekaikaraśaḥ sarveṣāṃ vyabhicāre'pi, prācyādisāmānyā tāvat |
anumānavyavasthānāt tatsaṃyuktaṃ pramāṇaṃ tvāt samākhyāyuktapuruṣaviśeṣaviṣayameva pramāṇaṃ syāditi |
teṣāṃteṣāmeva dharmāḥ uta sarveṣāṃ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
anumānasya śrutyanumitikāraṇībhūtatvena liṅgabhūtasya smṛtyutsāraṇe caturdhā pravartate |
ācārasya vyavasthānāt deśabhedena vyavasthitatvāt, ‘so'sya nivāsaḥ’ (4|3|9) ‘tatra bhavaḥ’ (53) ‘tatra |
pramāṇaṃ ācāraṇepanitā śrutiḥ tatsaṃyuktaṃ tattaddeśavācaka- jātaḥ’ (25) ‘tata āgataḥ’ (74) |
naivukaṃ dākṣiṇātyāḥ kuryuḥ’ ityādipaiva śrutiranumeyā prāci jātaḥ, prāca āgataḥ prācya ityucyate |
dharmaḥ sarvadiksthānāṃ janānāṃ dharmaḥ syāt vidhānasya nimittābhāve'pi āhīnaivukasyānuṣṭhānadarśanāt |
tasya sarvadharmasya utpādakaḥ nyāyaḥ : ‘vidheḥ sarvaviṣa- ucchṛṅkhalaiva laukikī samākhyā nimittamityucyate, tathā |
yatvaṃ’ yasmin kalpe vidhāne vidhāyakavākye'sti sati dākṣiṇātyasyāpi sāṃketikaprācyādināmno holā- |
tanyāyatvāt vidhāyakavākyasya sarvaviṣayatvāt holā- padayuktaśrutikalpane gauravaprasaṅgaśca holakādi- |
nanu yathā dhilākyo vyapasthitaḥ ke cit triśikhāḥ, śrutismṛtivihite'pi karmaṇi keṣāṃ cidanuṣṭhānaṃ anuṣṭhānaṃ |
ke cit pañcaśikhāḥ; tathā holakādyo'pyācārāḥ tatta- cānyeṣāṃ |
dikasthānāmeva kuto na syuḥ iti cenna |
gotrapravara- śilā nidadhāti’ iti smṛteśca darśanāt viniyogaḥ |
vā bhavaḥ, mathurāyāṃ vā jātaḥ, mathurāyāḥ sakāśādāgato tripravarāḥ : śikhātrayaṃ, pañcapravarāśca śikhāpañcakaṃ nidadhāti |
holakādau tu nāsti tādṛk kiṃ cit |
holakādyācāravyavasthāyāṃ karmadharmaḥ kartṛliṅgaṃ ācārāṇāṃ niyatadeśatvaṃ vyavasthāpayiṣyati |
vaiśvadevena yajeta’ iti prācīnapravaṇo deśaḥ vaiśvadeva- nityasya liṅgasya cābhāvāt holakādayo na vyavasthitāḥ; |
vṛhattvaśyāmatvādinā pūrvoktena kartṛ- holakādīn ācārān deśabhedena vyavasthāpayiṣyati |
dharmeṇa kartṛdharmeṇa tulyametat deśasya karmadharmatvaṃ, na vyava- iti cenna |
tasmāt holakādyācāraḥ sarvadharmaḥ deśādgacchataḥ prāk vā udaṅ vā gatvā sthire bhavati |
2|3|4, anumitavākye viśiṣṭadeśasya adoṣatvāt, syāt deśāntare'pi tasmin kartari gate sā ākhyā na |
'bdena kāryāpattiryathā- ‘na girāgiriti brūyāt .airaṃ syāpi māthura iti ākhyā |
’ atra pratipanne girāpade tatkārya sādhaṃnā- iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
tatra ca lakṣitarāpadasya sādhyābhilāṣiṇe syād yogākhyā hi māthuravat |
kāryāpattiryathā- ‘juhvā vā etarhi vāgabhavati yarhi pṛṣṭayaḥ yogākhyā yogamātrāpekṣā syāt, na bhūtavartamānabhaviṣyat- |
pṛ. 130. ityevādiparityāgena na kadā cit prācyādisamākhyā |
maṇi. pṛ. 30-31, anumitiḥ saṃśayā- kārā na iti akṣapādīyāḥ |
pṛ. 42, yadi pakṣaviśeṣaścaḥ parāmarśaḥ tadā taditidheikaiva anumitiḥ |
hetu- viśeṣake tu sādhyaviśeṣikā iti maṇikṛt |
pṛ. 37, dhūmaliṅgaka parvatatvakatvavidhepakā'numiti iti dhūma- parāmarśa hetutvam |
pṛ. 33. anuminerapi vahiviśiṣṭaḥ parvato viṣayaḥ iti anadhigatārthagantṛtca- rūpaṃ prāmāṇyam |
vahnayādyanumitau vahnayādyālokān parvata: ityādisthirarāmarśasya hetutvaṃ, na tu āloko vahnayāpyaḥ ālekavān parvata: iti jñānadvayasya, gauravāt |

sa kiṃ śeṣapratipattayasya āvāpika- sviṣṭakṛdyāgasya devatāsaṃskārārthaḥ, uta anuyājāntara- vat ārādupakāraka iti cintāṃyāṃ, ubhayoḥ prakaraṇena darśaṅgatvamāvagamāt na parasparaṅgatve pramāṇamasti iti ārādupakāraka eva |
iti prāpte, dṛṣṭe saṃbhavati adṛṣṭa- syānyāyyatvāt tadīyadevatāsaṃskāratvameva |
na ca vinigamanāvirahaḥ, prakṣepesya vākyādeva śeṣapratipattaya- tvena kṛtārthatvāt, tyāgāṃśasyāpi pradhānaprayuktadravyopa- jīvitvena pradhānāṅgatvasya prakaraṇaṃ vinaiva avagamāt |

yattu śabdadīpikāyāṃ tasya iṣṭadevatāprāptikena kṛtārtha- tvamuktaṃ, tat mantrasya iṣṭadevatāprāptakatve'pi yāge apū- rvāyāṃ eva agnisviṣṭakṛddevatāyā vidhānāt, uddeśāṃśasya iṣṭadevatāsaraṇyālatvābhāvāt upekṣitam |
na ca evamapi uttamaṇuyāje mantravarṇikasya devasyāpi devatātvapratīteḥ |
tasya ca āvāpikasviṣṭakṛt devatātvābhāvāt kathaṃ tadīyadevatāsaṃskārārthatvamiti vācyam |
bhāṣyakāralikhi- tena ‘agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati’ iti vacanena ‘viṣṇuṃ yajati’ itivat devatāvidhānena mantravarṇikasya devasya devatātvātprapannā |
uktaṃ hyetat devatāpramāṇaṃ na dvitīyāyāḥ mantra- varṇāpekṣayā daurbalyaṃ kaustubhe |
tasmāt uttamaṇuyājasya āvāpikasviṣṭakṛddevatāsaṃskārārthatvāt yatraikapalamātra- haviṣke'sau āvāpikasviṣṭakṛllopaḥ |
yatra vā piṇyādī agniḥ kathyavāhanaḥ sviṣṭakṛ- ddevatā āvāpikasviṣṭakṛt, tatra uttamaṇuyāje'pi ‘devo agniḥ kathyavāhanaḥ sviṣṭakṛt sudraviṇo mantraḥ kaviḥ |
’ ityādiḥ mantra ūhaḥ, tyāge ca tadevollekhaḥ |
yājñi- kāstu evaṃ na kurvanti, tatra mūlaṃ cintyam |
anuṣattu tu kālaḥ syāt, prayojanena saṃbandhāt |
bhāṣyaṃ— jyotiṣṭome śrūyate ‘āgnimārutādūrdhvamanu- yājaiścaranti, prahṛtya paridhīna juhoti hāriyojanam’ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimagniṃ vidhīyate, uta kāla iti |
anuyājā āgnimārutaṃ ca prāptaṃ, ānantaryameva tayoḥ prāptaṃ, tadīyate, tathā hāriyojanasya paridhipraharaṇasya ca |
evaṃ ca sati na hāri- yojanasya paridhipraharaṇena kaścidupakāraḥ kriyate, hāri- yojanameva vā paridhipraharaṇasya |
soma— pūrvavat ihāpi aṅgāṅkitvaparatā iti pratya- vasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
prayojanaṃ prathamapūrvapakṣe (karmāntara- vidhirūpaṃ) āgnimārutāttamaṇuyājānāṃ anyatvāt sava- nīyapaśvarthatayāḥ svakāle kartavyaḥ |
dvitīyapūrvapakṣe (aṅgaprayojanasaṃbandhavidhirūpe) savanīyapaśvarthatayā coda- kaprāptānāmanuyājānāṃ tata āgnimārutāt jhatvā vidhānāt savanīyapaśvarthā anuyājābhāvāt vikṛ- tiṣu anuyājābhāvaḥ |
siddhānte tu (kālārthasaṃyogavidhi- rūpe) savanīyapaśvarthasyāgnimārutātkālavidhā- nāt na svakāle pṛthaganuyājānāṃ, na vā savanīya- vikṛtiṣu anuyājābhāvaḥ; kiṃtu kālārthaḥ saṃyoga iti |
eva syāt, anuyājānāṃ prayojanānantarasannināmāgnimāra- tārthatayā viniyogāditi |
ke— jyotiṣṭome savanīyapaśvarthānāmanuyājānāṃ āgnimārutādūrdhvatvaṃ vihitaṃ, tatrāyaṃ vicāraḥ |
bhāṭṭa— some ‘prahṛtya paridhīna hāriyojanaṃ juhoti’ ‘āgnimārutādūrdhvamanuyājaiścaranti’ iti śrutam |
tatra praharaṇaṃ tāvat dvitīyayā paridhisaṃskārakaṃ, paridhaśca yadyapi na somayāgaṃ, tathāpi tadaṅgasavanīyayājñatvena prāptā eveti teṣāṃ phalavattvam |
ataśca hāriyojanasyāpi yadyapi nedamutpattivākyaṃ, tathāpi tadutpattivākye phalā- śravaṇāt tasya paridhipraharaṇatvam |
yadyapi cāyaṃ soma- yāgāmya eva, tathāpi etadabhyasya paridhipraharaṇāṅgatvaṃ abhyāsāntarāṇāṃ svargādyarthatve'pi udgātrapacchedanimittapunaḥ- prayogasyaiva na virudhyate |
evaṃ dvitīyavākye anuyājā yadyapi na somayāge prakṛtāḥ, tathāpi tadaṅgasavanīyayājña- tvena sannyeva phalavat |
āgnimārutaścasya yāvat prakaraṇāt kalpyaṃ kalpyate, tāvat vākyenaivanānuyājā- ṅgatvam |
na cātra vaimṛdhat padantarakalpanā'pi, aṅga- bhūtakālaviśeṣaṇatvenāṅgāṅkitvopapatteḥ |

na ca vaimṛdhadasvānu- pattivākyatvāt, utpattivākye ca phalapekṣāyāṃ prakara- ṇāt kalpyakalpaneti mūlektaṃ yuktaṃ, utpattivākye tadapekṣāyāmapi iṣṭasāmānyādbhavyātmaṅgīkṛtya vākyā- ntareṇa viniyogopapattau durbalapramāṇena aṅgakalpanā'nu- papatteḥ |
iti prāpte, hāriyojanasya tāvat jyotiṣṭomenaiva svargādirūpasya phalasya kalpyatvāt na vaimṛdhatvena padā- ntarakalpanāyā praharaṇāṅgatve pramāṇamasti |
āgnimārutasya tu yadyapi na viśiṣṭa vākyena kṛtvaṃ, tathāpi ‘dvādaśa śalo'gniṣṭomaḥ’ ityādyanyathāsiddhaliṅgeprapañcakaraṇa- vaśenaiva kṛtvasambhave vākyena kṛtvakalpanā'yogaḥ |
vastu- tastu prātanuyājādeśana ūrdhvasya āgnimārutasya ca vidhī vākyabhedāpatteḥ, parasparānvitatvavādināṃ prācāmapi viśe-
ṣaṇavidhikalpanāgauravāpatteḥ nānena vākyena āgnimāruta- syānuyājāṅgatvena vidhānam |
ata eva ‘āgnimārutādūrdhvaṃ’ ityatra padadvayena lakṣaṇayā tadyatiyogikordhvakālaḥ |
‘darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvā’ ityādī tu tṛtīyāntasya iṣṭvā ityatrānvayāt lakṣaṇeti dhyeyam |
vastutastu na prakṛte'pi lakṣaṇā, ‘tāṃ caturbhiḥ’ itivat viśiṣṭabhāvanābodhe'pi ūrdhvamātravidhiphalakatayā vidheyānekatvābhāvāt |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe savanīyavikāre somayāgānaṅge hāriyojane'gnimārutāyoḥ karaṇam |
anuyājānāṃ ātideśikānāṃ sāṃgameṣṭau upadiṣṭaiḥ āmanahīmaiḥ samuccayaḥ |
10|4|12 23-24. anuyājānāṃ savanīyapaśvarthānāmeva āgni- mārutādūrdhvatvakālavidhānāt na svakāle pṛthaganuṣṭhānaṃ, na vā savanīyavikṛtiṣu anuyājābhāvaḥ |
soma. 4|3|15. anuyājeṣu anavānalavidhānaṃ uttamaṇḍe'nuyāje nopa- saṃhartavyaṃ tritayasādhāraṇatvāt |
