anuyājeṣu ekādaśasu catvāro barhiṣo vikārāḥ, catvāro narāśaṃsasya, navama ekādaśaśca sviṣṭakṛtaḥ |
teṣvekādaśa pratyekaṃ prākṛtatritaya- dharmāṇāṃ vikalpena prāptiḥ; āgneyavikāre tathā darśanāt |
iti prāpte, ‘sama syād’ itinyāyena (10|3|13 53) vibhajya prakṛtikavikārabhāḥ |

gaṇitaśāstre hi samavibhāgābhāve saikīkṛtya niraikīkṛtya vā yathoppatti vibhāga uktaḥ, tadadatra nirapekṣe'pi samaṃ vedhā vibhāgā- saṃbhavāt saikīkaraṇaṃ catuścaturvibhāge catvāraścatvāro barhirnarāśaṃsayorvikārāḥ, avaśiṣṭāḥ sviṣṭakṛtaḥ |
■ anuyājeṣu 'devān yaja' iti praiṣaḥ tritva- sādhāraṇa eva ||
anuyājeṣu 'devān yaja' iti praiṣa āmnātaḥ, sa ca barhiryāgaviṣayaka eva |
sarvārthatve saṃni- pātinoḥ praiṣayoḥ samuccayāyogena vikalpāpatteḥ |
uparavamantrāṇāṃ karaṇatvena pratyavaramyamāhateḥ ekaikasminnupareve bahutvasaṃbhavena avi- vakṣitārthatve'pi prakṛte saṃbhavato bahutvasya tadyogyādi- dhaikramakramāt |
'āvaha devān yajamānāya' iti sāmānyenābhidhāya 'agnima āvaha' ityādiviśeṣa- bhidhānamityasya ṣoḍaśe vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
ata eva śrutyantaraṃ 'devān yajetyuktvā''ha, chandāṃsi vai devāḥ, chandāṃsyeva tadyajati, yadyarhiyati gāyatrī tadyajati, yannarāśaṃsaṃ triṣṭubhaṃ tat, yadagniṃ sviṣkṛtaṃ jagatī tat' ityupapadyate |
tena 'aparyāptayānuyājau yajati' ityu- khyeṣau barhiryājatvābhāvena 'devīṃ yajayaja' ityuhasamuccayābhyāṃ narāśaṃsaṃ praiṣaḥ phalati |
'nānuyājeṣu yejyāmahaṃ karoti' 'yajatiṣu yejyāmahaṃ karoti' ityubhayoraikyatatrā 'anuyājavyatirekiṣu yajatiṣu yejyāmahaḥ kartavyaḥ' iti paryudāsenānuṣṭhāna- miti |
tatra anuyājakramamāmnāyena praiṣasya anavānasya uttame upa- saṃhāraḥ |
iti prāpte, uttamainetivākyasya anuyājakatvena viśeṣavidhitvābhāvāt nopasaṃhāralam |
sūtre'pi anu- vādapadaṃ anutarthitavyaṃ iti bhāṣyakāraḥ |
barhirnarāśasa- yājayoḥ alākṣaratvena tāvat madhye anavānasya kadā- citkatvena prāptau anavānocāraṇaṃ niyamyate |
tena anyobhinna- viṣayatvāt vidhipratiṣedharūpatvācca naikaina anyopasaṃhāraḥ |

evaṃ satyapi prāṇābhyāsaśālinaḥ dīrghayājyāyāmapi kadā- cit avanavānasya aprāptirasti ityetanmātreṇa pākṣikaprāptimādāya 'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' iti vidhiriva niyamavidhivaṃ tṛtīyānuyājādoṣapi saṃbhavat na nirasituṃ śakyam |

ata eva 'sakṛdavānyāt evamapya- navānaṃ' iti nyāyasiddhasyaiva gauṇānavānasya kaṇṭhataḥ anuvādena 'anavānaṃ yajati' iti vidhitagānavānapadaṃ gauṇamukhyasādhāraṇatvena vyākhyāṇā śrutiḥ : anuyājatraya- viṣayatvaṃ vidhiranumanyate |
ataḥ tenaiva siddhau, prati- ṣedhaḥ anuvādāt nopasaṃhārakṣamaḥ : ityāśayaḥ |
■ anuyājadevatāprakāśanāthaṃ cāturmāsyeṣu prākṛtāvā- hanamantrasya avikāreṇaiva prayogaḥ |
■ anuyājannyāyena (saṃkarṣa. 2|3|4) daśamānu- yājasya sviṣkṛdadhikāratve prāpte, devatāsāmānyasya utpatti- samasamāvagatasya prayogakālavāgatakramāt balavatvena prathama- vikāratvameva |
saṃkarṣa. 2|3|1. anuyājahetvarūpaprapa- dājyārthatve, prayājahetvīpajyārthatve ca pātrabhedaḥ kartavyaḥ : agnīṣomīye paśau |
bhā. 5|2|18|16. darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ uttamayā vācā anuyājādi |
bhā. 5|1|12|13- 24. anuyājotkarṣeṇa utkṛpṭe sūktavāke sanīyadevatānāṃ utkarṣa eva nyāyyaḥ |
1|1|3|16-54, cāturmāsyeṣu 'pṛpadājyenānuyājān yajati' iti pṛpadājyo vidhīyamānaḥ pratyanuyājaṃ bhidyate |
10|16|17|64, paśau 'pṛpadājye- nānuyājaṃ yajati' iti vidhīyamānaḥ pṛpadājyaguṇaḥ pratyanuyājaṃ bhidyate |
■ anurjhakabhedaḥ anurjhabhedamākṣipatti, bhātra- nāyā dhātvarthacchedaṃ vinā bhāvanā'ntarāt vyāvṛttyapratīteḥ ekabhāvanā'vacchedakavirodhaprasaṅgena ekasyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ anekānurajhakasamāveśāyogāt |
su. pṛ. 704. ■ anurūpo nāma tu jyotitome vahiṣpavamāne 'davituyatyā ṛcā0' ityādirdītyastacaḥ |
prathamastu pratipadaṃ nāma tṛtīyastu tucaḥ paryāpto nāma |
tatra vyastāni anuvacanāni hautrāṇi, samastaṃ praiṣānu- vacanaṃ tu maitrāvaruṇasya |
vā. 3|1|21|43. anu- vacaneṣu praiṣānteṣveva maitrāvaruṇasya kartṛtā |
somasya homaṃ yadā adhvaryuḥ karoti tadā hotyā paṭhati yājyānte vaṣaṭkāra ucyate |
tataḥ eva hotā 'somasyāme vīhi' iti mantraṃ paṭhati adhvaryustadā punarapi avaśiṣṭaṃ somaṃ yajati |
paṭhyatāṃ ' iti, sa āditaḥ ārabhya parisamāpya punarā- |
idaṃ vāmāsye haviḥ-priyamindrābṛha- spatī ityekaṃ ' ayaṃ vāṃ pariśiṣyate-soma indrābṛha- spatī ityaparam ' |
3|1|123. vāraṇādhikaraṇapodi- tasya ajñāvatārasya anuvākyādhikaraṇena ujjīvanāt vākyavirodhaḥ kramasya paridṛṣṭaḥ |
) su. pṛ. 1072. anu- vāgottaraṃ yājyāparyantaṃ hotṛvāṃgamanam |
bhā. 1|1| 6|23 pṛ. 80. anuvādaḥ apravṛttiviśeṣakaraḥ anarthakaḥ syāt |
yastu vākyabhedaprasaktyarthameva anu- ṣaṅgamicchet kuryādapi saḥ |
tatra tu punaḥ 'caritvā' ityetasya vidhānāt yāvadanuṣaṅgaṃ upasadāṃ anuṣṭhānaṃ prāpnoti |
atha agnihotra- syaiva purastāt kṛtvāmiḥ sarvānupaśarthasaṃpādanaṃ ityucyeta, tathā sati śabdoccāraṇamapi evamevāvasthitaṃ agnihotrā- dīnāṃ pāṭhakramānurodhena upakariṣyati iti nārtho'- nuṣaṅgena |
'amyakū sā ta indra ' ityuci uparitanyāmṛci 'laṃ tū na indra ' taṃ ryaṃ dāḥ ' iti śrūyate tadevānuṣaṅgena draṣṭavyaṃ iti purastādanuṣaṅgo'yam |
bāla. pṛ. 60. anuṣaṅgaḥ dvividhaḥ anuṣaṅgaḥ anukarṣaśceti |
'saṃ te prāṇo vātena gacchatāṃ, sama- jñāni yantraiḥ; saṃ yaśapatirāśiṣā' atra madhyamamantre nahu- vacanāntena 'ajñāni ' ityanena anvetumayogyatāt tadvyavāyena buddhisannidhābhāvāt nāstyanuṣaṅgaḥ |
vi. 2|3|188. anuṣaṅgaḥ śeṣyākāṅkṣayā śeṣākāṅkṣayā ceti prakārāntareṇa dvividhaḥ |
ke. anuṣaṅgaḥ sakṛ- taditisthāpi vyākhyānavelāyāṃ uccāraṇakṛtiḥ |
su. pṛ. 170, anekeṣu sākāṅkṣeṣu ekasmin śeṣānvaye nirākāṅkṣīkṛte'pi itaretarākāṅkṣayā anuṣaṅge'yuktaḥ |
tatra ādyo yathā 'yadi brāhmaṇo jayeta vāī- spatyaṃ madhye nidhāya āhutimāhuti hutvā tamimaṃhā- yeta, yadi rājanya aindraṃ, yadi vaiśyo vaiśvadevam ' iti |
atra aindraṃ vaiśvadevaṃ ityataḥ paraṃ 'madhye nidhāya ' ityādi anuṣajyate |
dvitīyo yathā, 'athaiva jyotiḥ ' 'athaiva viśvajyotiḥ ' 'athaiva sarvajyotiḥ ' 'etena sahasra- dakṣiṇena yajeta ' iti |
bhāṣyaṃ - 'yā te agne'yāśayā tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā gahva- reṣṭhaṃ vaco apāvadhīṃ tveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhīṃ svāhā, yā te agne rajāśayā, yā te agne harāśayā ' iti |
atra saṃdehaḥ tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā iti sarveṣu anuṣaktavyaṃ, āhosvit laukiko vākyaśeṣaḥ kartavya iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? 'yā te agne rajāśayā ' ityetasya tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā iti na vākyaśeṣaḥ |
yathaiva hi ayaṃ 'yā te agne'yāśayā ' ityetasā- nantaraṃ, evaṃ 'yā te agne rajāśayā, yā te agne harāśayā ' ityetorapi |
harāśayā ityetasya vyavahita iti cet, tantra, samudāyasya avyavadhānāt |
samudāyena ca vākyaśeṣasya saṃbandhā- bhāvāt samudāyārthasya saṃbandhaḥ |
api ca sākāṅkṣasya saṃnidhau parastāt purastāt paripūrṇasamarthaḥ śrūyamāṇo vākyaśeṣo bhavati |
kiṃyāstu kālaḥ saṃnidhiḥ iti ucyate ? yāvati śaknoti ubhau api apekṣitum |
kaśśasau ? ānantarye saṃbandhapadavyavāyo vā ! tāvati hi śaknoti ubhavāpi apekṣitum |
yatrāpi apareṇa sākā- ṅkṣatvena vyavāyaḥ, tatrāpi asti saṃbandhaḥ |
dvayorapi hi kāryaṃ vaktavyaṃ iti paraḥ pūrvamapekṣate |
dvayorapi asaṃbaddhaiḥ padaiḥ avyavahitatvāt, dvayorapi ākāṅkṣāvattvāt |

athaivaṃ bhavitavyaṃ, yatra nirākāṅkṣāṇāṃ saṃnidhau paripūrṇasamarthaḥ śrūyate, yathā 'citpatistvā punātu, vākpa- tistvā punātu, devastvā savitā punātu acchidraṇa pavi- treṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ' iti |
atra hi punāla- ntāni paripūrṇāni, na kiṃcidākāṅkṣanti |
satyamākāṅkṣati, ākāṅkṣadapi etat ekamākāṅkṣat, ekenaiva tat nirākāṅkṣa saṃpadyate iti |
anarthakatvādākāṅkṣati, ekena ca saṃvaddho nārthako bhavati |
nanu etasya vākyaśeṣasya eka- mapi ākāṅkṣataṃ na gamyate viśeṣaḥ; kena nirākāṅkṣī- kriyate kena vā neti, tena anavagamyamāne viśeṣe sarvaiḥ saha saṃbhansyate |
yena asya pratyakṣamāntaravyupalabhyabhāhe, tena saha saṃbhansyate iti gamyate viśeṣaḥ; tasmāt tena antareṇa saha saṃbhansyate iti nāsti sarvatrānuṣaṅga iti |
punātu- śabdena asya pratyakṣamāntaryaṃ upalabhyabhāhe, punātu- śabdasyāpi citpatistvā ityevamādibhiḥ |
tenāvacchinnāmo yatra punātu-śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, tatra tena ekavākyatvāt acchi- dreṇa ityevamādi vinā punātu-śabdena sākāṅkṣāḥ |
te ca punātu-śabda ākāṅkṣanti, sa ca punātu- śabdaḥ acchidreṇa ityanena viśiṣṭaḥ |
tena punātu- śabdena sānuṣaṅgeṇa niyogataḥ sarve nirākāṅkṣīkartavyāḥ |
tasmāt sarveṣu tulyayogaḥ iti vākyaparisamāpti- ranuṣajyate |
vā--jyotiṣṭome tisṛṇāmapi upasadāṃ ādau āgneyī vihitā 'amimīnakaṃ ' iti |
tatra prathamāyāḥ krame 'yā te agne'yāśayā ' iti nirākāṅkṣo mantra āmnāyate |
uttarayostu sākāṅkṣau 'yā te agne rajāśayā ' 'yā te agne harāśayā ' iti |
tatra strīliṅgavyucchidanardeśasya śrīpadāyaina kena ciddinā paripūrṇatā nāsti |
tatra tadanyathā'nupapattyā avaśyaṃ paripūrṇasamartho vākya- śeṣaḥ kalpanīyaḥ |
kaścit kāpi sthitaḥ śeṣaḥ so'nveṣṭavyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
tadiha pratyakṣopalabhye vākyaśeṣe na tāvatyeva uparatanvyam |
yadi anumānādīnyapi nivarti- ṣyante, tata etāvānevāyaṃ mantraḥ iti kalpayiṣyāmaḥ |
atha tu taiḥ kaścidavagamyate, tataḥ tatsahito'yaṃ mantraḥ sakalaḥ, prāk tasādūnaḥ, ityadhyavasyāmaḥ |
tadiha arthā- patyā tāvat sāmānyataḥ kaścit asti śeṣaḥ ityadhya- vaseyam |
tataśca amāvasyānya anavasarāt, ūnamidaṃ vākyaṃ na prayogāhe, tatra viśeṣākāṅkṣāyāṃ laukikaḥ kalpanīyaḥ; uta vaidika eva pūrvamantrataḥ tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā ityādiranuṣaṅgyaḥ; iti saṃśaye laukika ityāha |
' yathaiva āhavanīyādayo vaidikāḥ tannirdiṣṭakāryātirekeṇa na pravartante, tathaiva vaidikaḥ śeṣaḥ, yatra vākye samāmnā- yena viniyuktaḥ, sa tannibandhanatvāt nānyatra prayogaṃ kṣamate |
laukikaḥ punaḥ anivaddhatvāt sarvārthaḥ; sarvā- kāṅkṣāpūraṇāyāpi niyajyamāno na virudhyate |
tatra yadi vaidikamapi racitatvāt laghutara- prayogaṃ racayiṣyatvāt avaidikāt laukikāt manvānaḥ prayuṅkte, na kena cit vāryate, vaidikatvabuddhistu tatra na kartavyā |
' yadi tu ānantyāviśeṣe- pāt rajāśayā ityanenāpi saṃbandho'bhyupagamyeta tato yathānideśaṃ prayogāt purastādevāsta prayogaḥ prāpnoti |
' vaidikasya vākyasya vaidika eva śeṣaḥ pūraṇakṣamo na laukikaḥ, codanālakṣaṇadharmaniyamāt |
yadā tu vedaḥ sarvātmanā anviṣyamāṇo'pi tyaktavyāpāro dṛśyate, tadā laukikamapi anujānāti |
khasmin vākye'pi na syāccenmṛgyo vākyāntare tataḥ |
' ekasminnarthe sākāṅkṣatve abhihite prakṛtyā pratyayena vā, tatsaṃbandhasamarthe arthāntaraṃ yadi vā tatraiva dṛśyate tato ramaṇīyam |
atha na dṛśyate, tataḥ pramādālasye parityajya prakṛtau pratyaye cānveṣyam |
tayo- rapi cenna dṛśyate, tataḥ parastāt purastāt vā anantaro- carite padāntare |
yadi tu svākye na labhyeta, tatastenaiva krameṇa prakṛte vākyāntare |
vākyāntare'pi tu alabhya- māno yathopāsyamānānusāreṇa prakaraṇāntare |
yadā tu tatrāpi na labhyate, tadā loke |
loke'pi cennopalabhyeta tato nāstītyevamavadhārya ākāṅkṣābuddhiṃ antikatvena parikalpya nirākāṅkṣīkartavyam |
sarvatra ca 'saṃnikṛṣṭo na labhya- śced viprakṛṣṭo'pi vaidikaḥ |
sa evāvaidikastu syāt prāptaḥ saṃnihito yadā |
' tadiha rajāyā- harāśayāvākyayoḥ śeṣaḥ svapadasvavākyayoḥ alabhyamāna- tvāt vākyāntare nūnaṃ ityupasaṃhiyate |
sa ca yādṛśā- kāṅkṣitaḥ tādṛśaiva ekāntaraṃ purastādupalabhyate, anyasya vyavahitaḥ |

yadyapi cāsau prathamamantre kṛtātmatvāt na tau ākāṅkṣataḥ, tau tu tena vinā anupapadyamānau ātma- samīpe anyasya annāmnāt evaṃ purūprayukte, 'sarva- samīpe sakṛt paṭhitumāśakyaḥ pramāṇāntaralabhyatvāt punaḥ- punarāvṛtto''ya avayorapi arthena ānnātaḥ śeṣaḥ, naikasyaiva saṃnidhiviśeṣanimittaānnātaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ |
yadyapi ca purastādānnātaye, tathāpi yadyadeśavative tābhyāṃ kāṅkṣitaḥ, tatraiva viniyujyate |

' sa hi sakṛdānnāya- mānaḥ sarveṣāmīpsite pradeśe na śakya ānnātaṃ ityekasya yathākramamāmnātaḥ, itarayośca yāvatā buddhiviṣayatā- māpadyate, tataśca gṛhītaḥ san svayamapi pradeśāntare sthātuma- samarthaḥ, tābhyāmapi ca anvayavṛttitvena ākāṅkṣitaḥ; pūrvatra ca parastādāvasthityā dṛṣṭasāmarthyaḥ; parastādeva niveśyate |

bhāṣyakāreṇa tu prathamadvitīyayormadhye pāṭhāt agraha- māṇaviśeṣaḥ śeṣaḥ ubhayorapi ānnātatvena saṃbandhau ityuktvā tṛtīyasya vyavadhānāt asaṃbandhamāśaṅkya arthe- tvāviśeṣāt ubhayoḥ samudāyāpādanena avayavadhāne sādhite, samudāyaśeṣatvameva tarhi prāpnoti ityāśaṅkya tasya aprayogārhatvāt prayogārhasamudāyisaṃbandhaḥ, tatrāpi tayoḥ prādhānyāt, anyathā ca nairākāṅkṣyānupapatteḥ, pratyekaṃ sakalaśeṣasaṃbandhasiddhiḥ ityabhidhāya punaryā- ntaramārambham |

api ca sākāṅkṣasya saṃnidhau iti ( sarveṣu tulyayogitvāt iti sūtrāvayavasya sarveṣu śeṣeṣu tulyaśeṣatvānantaryayogitvāt iti pūrvavyākhyāna, tulyākā- ṅkṣasaṃnidhiyogyatāyogitvāt ityevaṃ vyākhyāntaram |
( svamatamāha - ) apare tu vadanti, pūrvatra aparitoṣataḥ uttaraṃ kṛtam |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ 'na tāvat samudāyatvaṃ kena citrirmitaṃ tayoḥ |
punaḥ pratyekanirmāṇe na ca hetuḥ pratīyate |
' samudāyatvaṃ hi ekakāryatvena ekaśabdopādānena vā bhavet, na cātra ekampyasti |
aho nu khalu mantrāṇāṃ kāryaṃ ( kalpaprakāśanaṃ ) vijñātam |
patrādapi sā samudāyatvāmeva tasya saṃgatiriṣṭā iti ādyata eva samudāyatvaṃ na labhyate |

yadi ca samudāyatvamāpadyata tataḥ punaḥ pratyekaṃ saṃbandhaḥ, iti rājaikaputrakrīḍā āpadyate ( ekaputrasya atyantaṃ priya- tvena pitṛbhyāmanivāraṇāt, rājakyatvena ca anyairani- vāraṇāt atyantā anyāyā yathā krīḍā tathā iyaṃ iti sudhā. pṛ. 693 ) purastādeva ca
prathamastha hi asau yathā''kāṅkṣite deśe sthito nocca- rayoḥ |
( kiṃ tat iti, āha - ) 'ākāṅkṣā saṃnidhānaṃ ca yogyatā ceti ca trayam |
'yo hi bahūnāṃ saṃndhitvena sakṛdānnāyate tasya avaśyaṃbhāvi ekenānantarya iti na tadeva tadā saṃbandhakāraṇatvena āśrīyate, tatrāpi asādeva kāraṇa- trayāt saṃvadhasideḥ |
evaṃ hi tatra jñāyate, sarvātho'yaṃ āmnāyamānaḥ sarvasādhāraṇānvayārthasaṃbhavāt vākyaikatvācca kasya cit ekasya samīpe paṭhyate |

) viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyeṣu buddhayanuvṛttiṃ vinā sarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaikabuddhayupapatterasaṃbhavāt viśiṣṭabuddhayutpattiṃ yāvat viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabuddhīnāṃ anu- vṛttiriṣyate viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāntyeṣu apekṣā'dhīnatvāt iti sudhā. pṛ. 694 ) |
sā ca ānantaryaṃ saṃbandhapada- vyavyāye ca bhavati |
' 'yā te agre rājāyā' ityanena apekṣitaḥ śeṣaḥ parastādalabdhamānaḥ purastāt āālocya- mānaḥ labhyate tanvīryaiṣṭā iti |
yadā ca tatrā'ruḍhaḥ, tadā harādāyā ityasya anantarībhūtaḥ punarevameva tṛtīyayenāpi saha saṃdhyate |
tataḥ paraṃ tu anyasya annāmnāt tāva- tyeva upakṣīyate |
sarvatraivameva parastāt parastāt prasutā ekatra āccha ityeteṣāṃ anantarībhavantī tāvadapekṣyamāṇā nigṛhṇāti, yāvat kiṃcit na yogyamasti ayogyaṃ copalabdham |
yadyapi ca krameṇoccāraṇāt saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣau pratīyate, tathāpi nityavādasya anantare dūrasthe ca yugapada- mī. ko. 55 pekṣā saṃbandhaśca iti pañcādvagamāt na prāmāṇye kaścidviśeṣaḥ |
evaṃ vākye padānāṃ, prakaraṇe ca vākyānāṃ saṃbandho yāvat sākāṅkṣatvena tatsaṃbandhārheṇa parasyāpi anantarīkṛtaṃ samarthena vyavadhānam |
'avyava- dhāne vicchede'pi ( iti bhāṣyaṃ ) virodhinā padena avyavadhāne viprakṛṣṭatve bhavati saṃbandha ityarthaḥ |
sa eva samāpyate tena iti samātiḥ |
yatra nairākā- ṅkṣyaṃ, sarveṣu śeṣiyu ekaḥ śeṣaḥ sākāṅkṣaḥ paṭhyate, yathā 'cipattisvā punātu' ityeteṣāmante 'acchidraṃ' ityādiḥ, tatra kathamite |
' ( tataḥ evaṃ bhavet, eṣa tu ) ānantaryaviśeṣeṇa hi ayaṃ 'punātu' ityetena saṃbadhyate |
sa na eka eva triṣvapi vākyeṣu |
na ca kārakabhedāt tasya bhedo bhavati, yena cippatyādi saṃbadhyāta asya ananyatvaṃ viśāyate |
na ca acchidraṃ ityevamaryā kriyā, yena sakṛtsaṃbandhena saṃtudhyet |
' athocyate ekatve'pi asyāḥ yatkartṛ- viśiṣṭābhyāsāt yaḥ karaṇasaṃbandhaḥ śrūyate, tadviśiṣṭaiva tena yojayitavyā |
yathā ekasyāpi jyotiṣṭomasya maitrā- varuṇaprahābhyāsaviśiṣṭasya payasā śrayaṇaṃ coditaṃ nāti- prasajyate, yathā ca atraiva cipatyādayo na sarve sarvatra bhavanti |
nahi tathā kiṃcit kāraṇa- masti, karaṇasya kriyā prati upayuktatvāt |
karaṇaprakā- śanadvāreṇa saiva kriyā punaḥ prakāśyate |
iti prāpte, 'yathāpekṣita- vartate, naivaṃ achidrapavitrapratiyogikaraṇāntaraśravaṇamasti, rūpe hi vākyaśeṣe samarpitaṃ |
na ca kartṛprayuktaṃ karaṇaṃ, yataḥ śeṣo na mṛgyo niṣpramāṇakaḥ |
kārakāṇāṃ kriyākṣitatvena para- soma- prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe mantraśeṣaprāyāścittā- svarasaṃnadhabhāvāt |
yadyā adhyā- punātu-śabdena asya saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
darśa- hṛtasya laukikasya śeṣasya amanatratvāt pūrvapakṣe prayoga- pūrṇamāsavarhirdharmavat vyavasthāsiddhiḥ |
( yathā barhi- kāle uccāraṇaṃ nānuṣṭheyaṃ, buddhau pratisaṃdhānamevāpi artha- dharmoṇāṃ prakaraṇāt darśapūrṇamāsabarhirvāgavateḥ |
ata eva iṣe tvā ityādī china- pitṛyajñavarhiṣi prasaktiḥ, tathā asyāpi śeṣasya prakaraṇa- dami ityādi padaṃ prayogakāle yājñikairnānuṣṭhīyate |
na mantrā- anuṣaṅge tu mantratvāt prayogakāle uccāraṇamapi kartavyaṃ ntaragatapunātu-śabdānvayaprasaktiḥ |
ke cittu adhyāhṛtasyāpi uccāraṇamasyeva, yājñi- prakramya punātu-śabdasya yat kāryaṃ tataśca achidrādi- kānāṃ tu tadanuṣṭhānaṃ anāsthayā ityāhuḥ |
sūtrārthastu- viśeṣaṇaṃ mantradvaye'pi tadekaṃ, iti pratyakṣamavagacchāmaḥ |
anuṣajyate ityanuṣaṅgaḥ, saḥ vākyaparisamāptiḥ vākyapari- na mantrāntare, karmāntarataddvayantarasaṃskārārthatvāt |
samāpakaḥ sarveṣu śeṣeṣu vākyaśeṣasya yogapadyenānavayāta nanu evaṃ sati ekakāryatvāt mantravikalpaḥ prasajyeta, iti |
( vibhāgamantravat yukta eva atrāpi vikalpaḥ iti pari- ci- 'yā te agne rajetyādyahāro yadā'nuṣajya- harati-) kuto vā evamādīnāṃ saṃkhyāyuktāvidhānāt nam |
anyaśeṣo'pi prasaktiḥ ilāha-) sarveṣu viparītucibhañjasanidhiḥ buddhiśrau laukikastu na tādṛśaḥ |
achidrāpa- cittistvetyanākāṅkṣatvāto (kāṅkṣato) nātrānu- hṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ punastadvānapekṣate |
hitena achidreṇādinā ananyagatikatvāt yadā punātu- mantradvaye'tastaddvārā sarvaśeṣo'nuṣajyate |

2|1|17|48. śabdaḥ svīkṛtaḥ, tadā 'punātvacchidreṇa' ityevaṃ kalpite bhāṭṭa- yatra bahūnāṃ śeṣepekṣāṇāṃ ādyasya anantaraṃ saṃbandhe ya eva anantaraḥ : punātuśabdaḥ, sa eva pūrvo- śeṣaḥ samāmnātaḥ yathā 'yā te agne ayaśayā' pi iti karaṇasaṃbandhadaśanevelāyāṃ anveti |
uttarau padārthāḥ santaḥ tāmapekṣamāṇāḥ sakaraṇāmeva āsāda- mantrau 'yā te agne rajāśayā, yā te agne harāśayā' yanti iti sarvathā'nupaṅgaḥ |
tatra uttarayoḥ śeṣekṣiṇoḥ ayameva śeṣaḥ : anu- ye tantreṇa prayujyate, teṣāṃ tadālakṣamātram |
purastāt para- ṣyate, na tu laukikaḥ : adhyāhṛte'dattvāt |
na stādvā vākyaśeṣasya anuṣaṅgāviśeṣe sati yat purastā- na causau ekatra nibaddhaḥ anyatra netuṃ śakyaḥ; sarvā- danuṣaṅge anvīyate iti kaiściducyate tat viśeṣaprasiddhi- thatvena āmnānāt |
na ca ādyasya anantaraṃ apekṣita- mātraṃ iti draṣṭavyam |
ākā- śā- atrāpi yajuḥparimāṇameva cintyate (iti ḍkṣāyogyatvāt : aviśiṣṭatvāt |
śeṣo'nyatra na netavyo ānantaryameva saṃbandhakāraṇaṃ, tadabhāve'pi śābdabodhasya

.... evaṃ dhānasya sakṛtpāṭhe aśakyatayā ākāṅkṣādvidheyatvaṃ ca tāvat anekeṣāṃ utthitākāṅkṣāṇāṃ saṃnidhau āāmnāyamānaḥ : sarvārthatvajñānopapatteḥ, āvṛttyādipāṭhasya sarvāntapāṭhasya ca śeṣaḥ sarvatrānujyate ityuktaṃ (prathamavarṇake) |
apekṣitadeśapāṭhaśca pyākāṅkṣāṇāṃ anekeṣāṃ saṃnidhau āāmnāyamānaḥ śeṣaḥ liṅgena jñātaṃ śakyatvāt āāmnāyasya sarvārthatvāvagateḥ : sarvatrānujyate |
na caivaṃ avyavadhānasya akāraṇatve pada- vandhipadādhyavadhāne'pi anuṣaṅgaḥ sādhitaḥ |
asya pratyu- śrutyā yāgasya karaṇatvāt āpattiḥ, tasya akāraṇatve'pi dāharaṇaṃ tu vyavāyādhikaraṇam |
prakṛte tu ākā- pradhānakathaṃvāstu amitaḥ : anyasaṃnadhamātraṃ uktvā ṅkṣādviśeṣeṇa sarvārthatvasya pratīteḥ niyāmakatvākāṅkṣā- yāvadantaṃ gacchati iti anuṣaṅgādhikaraṇe vyākhyātam |
ataśca tad-śreṣe'pi vā. 3|1|14|44 pṛ. 411. buddhirnivṛtteḥ : (buddhi- yajurbhe-prāyaścittameva |

yatra nirākāṅkṣāṇāmeva śeṣīṇāṃ bahūnāṃ ante sāpekṣaḥ su. pṛ. 1112, mantraśeṣāyaḥ : ekamantrāyavatvānvita- śeṣaḥ samāmnātaḥ yathā 'cittitsunātu punātu, vākya- śeṣaprakāśitatvena nirākāṅkṣīkṛto'pi mantrāntarāyavayānāṃ tistvanā, devasavitā savitā' ityetepāmante sākāṅkṣatvāt punarupasthākāṅkṣaḥ : san punaruccāritapūrva- 'achidraṇa pavitreṇa' iti, tatrāpi saṃnidhiyogya- mantraśeṣaprakāśakatvaṃ pratipadyate iti anuṣaṅgādhikaraṇe tvayoḥ aviśeṣāt sarvānuṣaṅgaḥ |

pṛ. 1224. yāvanti padāni saṃnikarṣa- kāṅkṣayā ekasaṃcanavenaiva caritārthatvāt ānantaryasya viprakarṣavanti, tāni sarvāṇi anuṣaṅgādhikaraṇoktena niyāmakatvopapattiḥ : śeṣākāṅkṣayā ākāṅkṣothāpane'pi mārgeṇa anādyasya saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣau yugapat saṃnipatanti |
pradhānatvān śeṣīṇāṃ vinigamanāvireheṇa sarveṣāmeva śeṣa- tataḥ sarvaśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāṃ anuṣṭhānayogyāṃ bhāvanāmāsāya grāhakatvāvagateḥ : ānantaryasya aniyāmakatvāt |
sa ca ekenaiva prayatnena tāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ eva anekahiviṣvakivisaṃnidhipaṭhitaśeṣeṣāmānāṃ sarvārtha- vidadhāti iti anekaśaktikalpanā doṣaḥ |
ataśca suvanāmāmigulphadeśapāvanādheṣu eteṣu 316 pṛ. 485. anuṣaṅgādhikaraṇapratyudāharaṇaṃ mantreṣu śeṣo'pi anujyate, pratipradhānādyanvintyāt |
' anuṣaṅgādhikaraṇasvarūpaṃ tu 'anantareṇa anuṣaṅgo vākyasamāptiḥ, sarveṣu tulya- saṃbaddhaḥ syāt parasthāpyanantaraḥ |
'yā te agne rayāśayā tanūrvipripā gahreyreyaṃ vaco 2|1|16|48 sūtrārthike tu 'tataḥ punastadārūḍhaḥ : apāvadhītveyaṃ vaco apāvadhītsvāhā |
yā te agne iti tṛtīyapādaḥ paṭhyate |
rajāśayā, yā te agne harāśayā' iti |

tatra saṃdehaḥ : ( anuṣaṅgādhikaraṇe) anuṣaṅgapakṣe āāmnāyasya kiṃ 'tanūrvipripā' iti sarvatrānuṣajyaḥ; āhosvit sarvārthatvenaiva sādharmyamātvāt anuṣaṅgasya āāmnāta- laukiko vākyaśeṣaḥ kartavya iti |
atraiva viṣayaśuddhiḥ : tvena mantratvavat yajurdvasyāpi upapatteḥ : pūrvavat yajuḥ- jyotiṣṭome 'tisra eva sāhutyopasadaḥ : ' ityupama- parimāṇacintā''kramam |
prayojanaṃ anu- iṣyo'pridaivatyāḥ : 'agninīkam' ityevamādivākya- vihitāḥ santi |
tatra prathamāyā ihe: 'yā te agne'yāśayā' ityayaṃ mantraḥ saṃpūrṇatvātnirākāṅkṣaḥ |
dvitīyāyāstṛtīyāyāśceṣṭe: 'yā te agne rajāśayā, yā te agne harāśayā' ityetā- vadasaṃpūrṇatvāt sākāṅkṣau |

tatrādyaṃ saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ prathamamantra- samāptyanantaraṃ 'tanvarthavidhiḥ' ityādivyākhyasya dvitīya- tṛtīyamantrayoranupapannaḥ; athavā laukikasyāhāraṇa pūrṇaṃ, pūrvamanuprasaṅgena yajuḥparimāṇe nirūpite sati idānīmanu- prasaṅgeneva asaṃpūrṇasya yajuṣaḥ kimadhyāhāreṇa pūrṇaṃ, utānupapanneneti |

atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo'bhisaṃdhiḥ- na tāvat 'yā te agne'yāśayā' ityetaccheṣabhūtasya 'tanvarthavidhiḥ' ityādiḥ 'yā te agne'yāśayā yā te agne harāśayā' ityetaccheṣabhāvaḥ saṃbhavati, pūrvavākyaśeṣa- tvenaivādhyāyanavidhinā adhyāpitatvāt |

'na tāvat anuṣṭhāna- velāyāṃ asyaṣṭaḥ śakyaḥ kartuṃ ityavaśyaṃ- bhāvinyā smṛtyā yogyasādhanāpekṣāpekṣaṇāt yatkiṃcit brāhmaṇapadārthānuṣṭhānaṃ vā pūrvapadārthapratyavekṣaṇaṃ vā sūtragrantho vā ātmīyagrahaṇavākyāni vā upadraṣṭādi vā sādhanaṃ grahītu- mārabhyate |

tatra ananyaprayojanān mantrān prakaraṇe paṭhya- mānān sāmānyena 'kimapi ebhiḥ kartavyaṃ' ityevaṃ prayogavacanena gṛhyamāṇānupalabhya yāṭaśena vākyena smṛtiḥ kartumākāṅkṣyate tadrūpā ete iti viditvā liṅgaprakaraṇā- mitayā śrutyā viniyoge sati abhidhānārthatā vijñāyate |
kṛtyarthe samidho yajati, uta puruṣārthe iti |
tathā kiṃ kyarthe ( anutavadanaṃ ) vadet, uta puruṣārtha- miti |
yadyevaṃ ca vadanaṃ tadarthasyaiva anutapadaṃ viśeṣaṇam |
pratiṣedhavelāyāṃ ca tatparo vidhiḥ; iti śeṣaṃ avadhāritadamanarthya anutadityam |
tataśca ekatra ( liṅge niṣedhaparatve ) evaṃ vacanaṃ vyajyate ' yat puruṣārthamanutavadanaṃ, tacca kuryāt ' ( iti ) |
apa- ratra ( najo niṣedhaparatve ) tu evaṃ ' yat ṛtvartha- manṛtaṃ vadet, tanna ' iti |
tataśca etasya sarvasya ākhyātanirūpaṇāyattatvāt tadto'yaṃ vicāro bhaviṣyati kimākhyātena kartā abhīdhīyate, neti |
( ita ārabhya ‘ abhidhānanāmavidhānavicāraḥ ’ ityanto vārtikagranthaḥ ( pṛ. 908 paṃ. 7 ) pracchidya kartṛdhikaraṇe niveśitaḥ ) |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? prāyeṇa vācaḥ anutavāditvāt yat puruṣa- ghasya ātmārye vadane anutaṃ prasaktaṃ, tasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ puruṣaṇāṃ
'satyaṃ brūyāt' ityasyāṃ hi bhāvanāyāṃ prayojanākāṅkṣā sarvavicīnāṃ puruṣārthatvatvāt svargādinā nivartyate |
tena eṣo'rthaḥ 'sati vacanadvayena vyavahāre satyavacane vyavahran abhyudayena saṃbadhyate ' iti |
tathā 'nānṛtaṃ vadet' ityenāpi pratiṣedhena anutavadanāt narakaprāptirbhavati, satyavadanāt na doṣaḥ, na guṇaḥ |
tasmāt abhyudayet ubhayopi apuna- ruktatayā vidhilam |
āha, bhavedetat saṃyogāṃtaraṃ, yadi smṛtau 'satyaṃ brūyāt' ityetānmātrameva ucyeta |
tasyāṃ tu satyavacanavidhivat anutapratiṣedho'pi bhedena sarpyate |
', 'anṛtaṃ hi vadet' ityevaṃ hi tatrāpi niyamyate |
nahi darśapūrṇamāsake kaścit puruṣadāsahateura vrataśabdaprayogaḥ, vikalpaprasaktirvā |
śāstraprāptapratiṣedheṣu hi vikalpo nārthaprāptipūrvakeṣu iti vakṣyati ( 10|8| 116) |

( kevalapuruṣārthatvapakṣe bhāṣyakārīyasaṃyogāṃtaravyākhyāṃ dūṣaṇapūrvakaṃ svayaṃ ṛtayukta- puruṣārthatvapakṣe saṃyogāṃtaravyākhyāṃ pratijānīte-) yathā tu evaṃ pratyasthīyate ' yathā prajāpativratatya- rekeṇāpi evamādayaḥ pratiṣedhāḥ santi ' tadā tadvā evaṃ saṃyogāṃtaraṃ vyākhyātavyaṃ ' smārtaḥ puruṣa- mātrasya saṃyogaḥ svārthasiddhaye |
' nanu etenaiva hetunā sāmānya- prāptyapekṣayā viśeṣasyānuvādaṃ yuktam |
yo hi smārtaḥ anutapratiṣedhaḥ, tena etāvadagataṃ ' āmadoṣaparihārāya puruṣeṇa nānutaṃ vaditavyaṃ ' iti |
tatra yadā darśapūrṇamāsayo'pi tadati- kramaṃ karoti, tadā bāhyātikramavat asya svayaṃ pratyavāya- mātraṃ syāt, na karmaphalaprativandhaḥ |
ye puruṣagatā vidhipratiṣedhāḥ, te ṛtvantaragata iva asya sadasadbhāvayoḥ |
nahi teṣu guṇabuddhirṛtvantrā, yena atikrame vaiguṇyabuddhiḥ syāt |
tena darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ anutaṃ vadan narakaṃ ca prāpnu- yāt, darśapūrṇamāsaphalaṃ cāvikalpameva āpnuyāt iti |
śrautaḥ punaḥ prakaraṇayuktapuruṣadharmaḥ iti (kṛtvā) atra (śraute niṣedhe) eṣo'rtho vijñāyate 'varjitānutavacana- kena puruṣeṇa kṛtau darśapūrṇamāsau phalaṃ sādhyataḥ ' iti |
prakaraṇasāmarthyāddhi puruṣagataṃ apūrvasādhanatvaṃ lakṣayitvā anṛtaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ, ataḥ tadatikrame darśapūrṇamāsāpūrvameva vaiguṇyāt na syāt, na tu puruṣasyaiva kaścit pratyavāyaḥ |
nahi tadānīṃ pratyavāyaḥ kalpyamānaḥ svatantrapuruṣasaṃbandhine kalpayituṃ śakyate |
evaṃ śuddhaṛtudharma- pakṣe'pi kratupuruṣapratyayāyaviśeṣāt saṃyogāṃtaraṃ vyākhye- yam |
( kratvarthapakṣe'pi kratvarthaniṣedhātikrame ṛto- vaiguṇyāsyapratyavāyaparihāraḥ phalaṃ saṃbhavatīti ) |
umādidānīṃ pūrvapakṣau āsāte yaśca puruṣamātradharma eva satyavidheḥ saṃyogāṃtareṇa, yaśca ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharme iti |
( itaḥ paraṃ 'sarvākhyāteṣu kartṛṇāṃ' ityādivārtikaṃ pṛ. 913 ārabhya 'tasmātprabhidheyaḥ kartā ' pṛ. 940 ityantaṃ kartṛdhikaraṇe draṣṭavyam ) |
na cet śrautaḥ, na prakaraṇaṃ bādhiṣyate |
yattu puruṣaprayatnaḥ anarthako bhavati, karmadharmapakṣe prayoga- vacanena kartavyatāvatanāditi, taducyate |
tasmāt ajñaṃ yadadat, tat na vācyamiti |
tena yat saṃkalpitaṃ, tadajñaṃ, tadeva karta- vyam |
brīhimayaṃ saṃkalpya, na yavamayaḥ ( puroḍāśaḥ ) pradeyaḥ |
āha- yadā ubhayopi pakṣayoḥ nātrataṃ vadi- tavyaṃ, tadā vicāraṇārtha iti |
pūrvasmin pakṣe puruṣadharmaḥ, tatra aṃśe sati prāyaścittam |
siddhānte darśapūrṇamāsadharmaḥ; tatra aṃśe yājurvedikaṃ prāyaścittam |
kartuḥ ākhyātābhidheyatvā- bhāvāt, kārakavyāpāraḥ - ) śrautatvābhāvāt na prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |
yattu karmadharmapakṣe darśapūrṇamāsavidhinaiva vihita- tvāt prātyāmiko vidhiranarthakaḥ syāt, tasmāt puruṣārtha- teti, tatra brūmaḥ ' yāvacca vidhisaṃsparśastāvanmātra prayojanam |
vinā ca tena dhātavartho na ṛtvaṅgaṃ pratīyate ||
' vidhirahito hi dhātvarthaḥ svayameva sādhyatāṃ pratipadyamānaḥ anapekṣitaprayojanatvāt na śakyate darśapūrṇa- māsakathabhāvena grahītum |
na ca tenāpyetat : prayogavaca- nena vidhātuṃ śakyate |

tasmādavadayaṃ prātyāmikena vidhinā sākṣāt pāraṃparyeṇa vā puruṣopakāritvaṃ bodhayitvā dhālarthaṃ karaṇīkṛtya tadatiriktaprayojanasāpekṣāyāṃ satyāṃ saṃnihitadarśapūrṇamāsopakārasaṃbandhe tayā aṅgatvaṃ kalpa- yitavyaṃ, anyathā ca itaretarāśrayaṃ syāt, aṅgatvān vidhiḥ viśeṣāṅkatvamiti |
ataśca ' vadet ' ityanena etāvadavagataṃ ' darśapūrṇamāsopakāraṃ vadanena sādhayet ' iti |
tataḥ anutapadasāmarthyāt evaṃ bhavati ' yat vadanena kuryāt, tat anutena ' iti |
punaśca nanusaṃndhāt ' yat anutavadanenopakuryāt, tanna ' iti vacanaṃ vyajyate |
tasmāt darśapūrṇamāsopakārāya vadato yat anutaṃ prasajyate, tatpratiṣedho vidhīyate |
tataśca yāvat ( yāvān ) karmārthaḥ saṃvādaḥ, tatra sarvatra anṛtaṃ varjanīyam |
tena ' yavamayaḥ puroḍāśaḥ kartavyaḥ ' ityevaṃ ādī adhvaryumuktvā ' sakatvarthaṃ me yatrā bhavi-
ṣyanti, tasmāt brīhimayaḥ kriyatāṃ ' ityevaṃ na visaṃ- vaditavyam |
' saṃkalpa ' iti ca tatpūrvatvāt vadaneva pratilapyati |
athavā svena vacanena adhvaryumeva saṃkalpaṃ kārayitvā iti dvijihvasya rūpaṃ draṣṭavyam |
āha- yadā smṛtiprāptanānuvāde, saṃyogāṃtarācca vidhī ' nātrataṃ vaditavyaṃ ' ityayamaṃśastulyaḥ, kiṃ tadā cintāyāḥ prayo- janamiti |
taducyate ' smṛtiprāptānuvāde hi smārte naimittikaṃ bhavet |
' smṛtau ca yat anutavadananimittaṃ prāya- ścittaṃ tadeva ( gāyatrībhṛte japet iti ) kartavyaṃ, yadi anuvādaḥ |
vidhau punaḥ asya yājurvedikatvāt śreṣṭhya, yajurvedato yajño vinhaḥ iti anvāhārthapacane 'bhuvaḥ svāhā' iti hotavyam |
smṛtau ca anyataramūlatvānavadhāraṇāt na vedapreṣaṇanimittaprāyaścittāvādhāraṇaṃ syāt |
evaṃ mūlamūli- bhāvābhyupagame'pi smṛtyaiva (nānṛtaṃ brūyāt ityanayā) tadartheḥ (niṣedhārtheḥ) tadatikramaśca anutataḥ iti tadīyemeva prāya- ścittam |
nanu tavāpi yājurvedikavacanāt tadeda- prāyaścittameva bhavet |
etaddhi āha- vanīyādiviṣayatvāt āhvitāgnyādhikāramavalambate, anuta- pratiṣedhaśca puruṣamātradharmatvān anāhitāgnerapi anavasthitaḥ |
tena asya tāvat avaśyaṃ sāte prāyaścittamapekṣaṇīyam |
taccedapekṣeta, etaccāgnimittasya āhitāgnerapi tadeva yuktaṃ, iti vaidikaprāyaścittābhāvaḥ |
kiṃca ' yajñe'- nyatamavedāṅge bhraṣṭe naimittikaṃ śrutam |
ayajñāṅga- vināśe tu na tasyāvasarau bhavet ||
' ' yadi ṛkto yajña ārtimāyāt ' iti hi sarvaḥ preṣaḥ yajñasaṃbandhino nimittatvena śrūyate |
tatra ' vedasaṃyogānna prakaraṇena bādhyate ' ( 3|3| 18 ) ityanena nyāyena vākyavatvalīyastvān prakaraṇaṃ tāva- datikramyeta, na tu yajñasaṃbandhaparyāye heturbhavati |
tasmāt avagatavedaviśepamūlye'pi puruṣadharme'pi na tannimittaṃ prāya- ścittaṃ kartavyam |

yadā tu phalakalpanābhāvāt prakaraṇācca ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmā bhavanti evaṃjātīyakā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ; śuddhaṛtudharmatvaṃ ca siddhāntaḥ, tadā ubhayatrāpi yāju- rvedikayajñaśreṣṭhanimittameva prāyaścittaṃ iti prayojanāntaraṃ
' sarve hi samidādayaḥ ṛtvantara- gatāḥ stotraśastrapādasya pūrvapakṣavādinaḥ puruṣasaṃskārāḥ |
te ca 'yājamānāstathyānatvāt karmavat' (3|8|14) ityenādhikaraṇena yājamānāḥ syuḥ |
tatra samidādīnāṃ yāgātmakatvāt dravyatyāgavyāpāreṇa dīkṣaṇīyādivat ubha- yathā'pi yājamānatvāt tadeva ca yajamānaviśuddhāvapi tantreṇa prayoga iti na kaścit viśeṣo dṛśyate |
ye tu stotraśastrapādasyaḥ, te guṇabhūtakartṛkametanmamarthaṃ pradhānaniyamanadhikṛtāṃ pradhānottarādismārayāṃ bādhitvā dantavyāvanādivat yajamānakartṛkā bhaveyuḥ |
yajamāna- viśuddhau ca sādhāraṇadravyatyāganyāyena tantratvaṃ na saṃbhavati iti pratiyajamānaṃ bhiyeran |

itiṣedhe'pi ca yadā vidhyaṃśa evamavadhāritaḥ 'ṛtuyuktapuruṣopakāri anuta- vadanaṃ' iti, tadā asyaiva anutaviśiṣṭapratiṣedhāt ayamanartho bhavati 'yajamānena ātmasaṃskārārthe āsīḥ- prayogadiṣu yadyucyate, tatra vaikalpikāvadhāraṇe svarūpa- dvāreṇa vā mupātvaṃ na kartavyaṃ, anyatra tu anyeṣāṃ ca yatheṣṭavāditvaṃ' iti |
śuddhakratudharmapratiṣedhe tu 'yāva- kratau kiṃ vidadyataṃ (tatra) yajamānasya ṛtvijāṃ vā anutataṃ prajñayate tat sarvaṃ na kartavyaṃ' (ityarthaḥ :) ṛtu- saṃgrahatvāviśeṣāt |
ataśca yathaiva yajamānena vrīhimayaṃ saṃkalpya na yavamayo dātavyaḥ, tathaiva adhvaryādibhirapi 'anyatare pakṣe kariṣyāmaḥ' ityuktvā na lāghavādithena punarvidhedavatithyam |
adapi ca punaḥ saṃskārārthe kiṃ cit, tadapi kratvartho'nena varjayitavyam |
nanu ca pratiṣedhārthe guṇabhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ, tata ādhyarthavasamāsayā niyāmakaḥ, iti praṇītāpraṇayanādadhvaryuḥ anutapratiṣedhamatha- lambheta, satyamatvamatveta, yadi pratiṣedhārthaḥ anujñeyo bhavet |
ayaṃ tu anujñānābhāvātmakatvāt na kartṛviśeṣa- mapekṣate |
sa (niṣedhaḥ) yatra prātaḥ, tatra svātmanyeva gacchan na śakyate samākhyāyā vārayitum |
nanu 'vadet' itye- tāvat vidhyaṃśamātramalevyamānaṃ samākhyā niyaṃvasati, tataśca pratiṣedho'pi tadanusāritvāt niyato bhaviṣyati, naitadevam |
paryavasite hi śāstrārthe tarkatarpekṣāyāṃ satyāṃ samākhyā avatarati |
pratiṣedhasaṃvanatvāt hi tat anu- vādatvena sthitam |
na ca anuvamānasya śratamapi viśeṣe- paṇaṃ bhavati iti grahādhikaraṇe (3|1|7) sādhitam |
' tasmādasti sarvatra prayojanaṃ, ataḥ samyak vicāritaṃ iti siddham |
śā— kratau puruṣe ca arthataḥ prasaktaṃ padārthe pratiṣe- dhantaḥ kratuprakaraṇatāḥ pratiṣedhāḥ |

tatra saṃśayaḥ kimayaṃ puruṣadharmaḥ: vidhiḥ, uta ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmaḥ: anuvādaḥ, kiṃvā ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmaḥ: vidhi, uta śuddha- kratudharmaḥ: anuvādaḥ, athavā śuddhakratudharmaḥ: vidhiḥ iti (soma—kimayaṃ vidhiḥ, uta anuvādaḥ |
vidhi- pakṣe kiṃ śuddhapuruṣadharmaḥ: kiṃvā ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmaḥ: uta śuddhakratudharmaḥ |

tathā anuvādapakṣe'pi kiṃ ṛtuyukta- puruṣadharmaḥ: uta śuddhakratudharmaḥ: iti saṃśayaniṣkarṣaḥ ) tadarthe ca pratiṣidhyamānā kriyā vicāritavyā kimarthā satī pratiṣidhyate, kiṃ kratvarthā kiṃvā purupārthā iti |
tato'pi punarvicāritavyaṃ kimākhyātaṃ kartārama- bhidhatte, na veti |
pacati devadattaḥ ityādikartṛviśeṣavattvaṃ: devadattādipadaiḥ apṛthak śruteḥ sahaprayogāt sāmānādhi- karaṇyāt |
tadarthamayaḥ, yat puruṣopakāritā pratyakṣata vadan tatra tathā, kiṃtu apakāramevāsa sādhyati |
tena śrutvā prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā puruṣārthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
yastu smārtaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, tasyāpyetadeva mūlaṃ ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
prakaraṇayoravirodhāt ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmo'yaṃ, 'karma kurvā- ṇasya anutaṃ varjayitavyaṃ' iti |
so'yaṃ smṛtiprāptānu- vādaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
kratvartha eva ārādupakārakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, so'pi tu anuvāda eva iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tatra saṃyoga- bhedena vidhivadeva hi gamyate ||
' idānīṃ kratuyuktasya puruṣasya vā dharmaḥ, uta śuddhakratudharmaḥ: ityetādavaśi- ṣyate |
tata eva pratīyasa na kartṛrbhidhe- yatā ||
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca lakṣaṇāto gavādiva- ttathā ca śrutivirodhābhāvāt kratvarthaḥ: evāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ |
sa ca saṃyogāntaratvāt nātuvādaḥ : (kratvarthaḥ: saṃyogaḥ ekaḥ, puruṣārthasya saṃyogaḥ bhinnaḥ ) iti |
sūtrā- rthastu-- kratuprakaraṇārthaṃ akarma anutavadanācaraṇaṃ nityānuvādaḥ syāt, tasya smṛtyā upanayanaprabhṛti puruṣa- saṃyogāt iti |
vi-- 'anṛtaṃ na vadet vaidhaḥ: puṃdharmo vā'nuvāda- gīḥ |
saktau puṃsi śuddhe vā kratau yadā vidhiḥ kratau ||
' vaidhaḥ: vihitaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ puṃdharmaḥ: puruṣārthaḥ: ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
saktau puṃsi ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmaḥ: pratiṣedhaḥ vākyaṃ tu anuvādagīḥ: iti dvitīyaḥ |
śuddhe kratau śuddha- kratudharmaḥ: vākyaṃ tu anuvādaḥ: iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- tattatkratuprakaraṇasthāḥ vidhinatiṣedhaviśeṣāḥ 'samidho yajati', 'nānutaṃ vadet' ityādayaḥ kiṃ śuddhapuruṣadharmāḥ, uta ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmāḥ, uta śuddha- kratudharmāḥ: iti vicāraḥ |
yadyapi ca pratiṣedhasya parodeśapravṛttakartṛkārakatvena vidheyatvarūpaṃ aṅgatvameva durlabham |
pratiṣedhapadārthasya nivartanāyāḥ vadanānu- kūlakṛtyabhāvasya vā saṃbandhantareṇa kṛtyanvayitve'pi nimi- ttāditavat kṛtikārakalatvābhāvāt, upakārakatvavyāpyasya aṅgatvasya vyāpakābhāve asaṃbhāvyam |
pratiṣedhavadanādestu ṛtuyuktapuruṣaprabhāve avihitatvādeva kuppādivat dūrā- pāste |
ataḥ aṅgatvasaṃbhavādeva taddeśeṣuvicārāsaṃbhavaḥ, tathāpi pratiṣedhasya puruṣārthatvaṃ nāma puruṣaniṣṭhaprayatnāya- janakakriyāviṣayatvam |
idaṃ ca yatra na pratiṣedhakriyā viśiṣya śāstreṇa vihitā yathā prakṛtodāharaṇe |

yatra tu viśiṣya vihitā yathā ṣoḍaśi- grahaṇādau, tatra pratiṣedhyayo'piśiprahaṇābhāve'pi kratoḥ phalajanakatvaṃ ityeva niṣedhena ākṣipyate ukavidhārthātu- māpakatvenaiva pratiṣedhasya kratvarthatā iti dhyeyam |
ata eva gauṇamukhyasādhāraṇyena aṅgatvameva adhyāyārthaḥ: iti na lakṣaṇāsaṃgatiḥ |
tatra satyapi bhāvāthadhikaraṇanyāyena bhāvanā- vācitve ākhyātasya kartā'pi vācyaḥ: ekatvādivat tat- stasyāpi pratīteḥ |
'kartari kṛt' (pā0 3|1|67) ityetatsūtrārthakartīvetattuṅkaṇārthecārthādyuktena 'laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (pā0 3|1|69) ityanena kartṛkarmabhāvānāmāpi ākhyātācāryatvametaśca |
sa ca 'bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ' iti smṛtyā eka- tvādideva yadyapi bhāvanāyāṃ bhāvyatvena anvayaḥ: na tu karmaṇaḥ, vilambitapratītikatvāt |
iṣyate ca guṇatvena pratīta- syāpi prayojanākāṅkṣāyāṃ prādhānyaṃ yathā paśupuroḍāśādau devatādeḥ (10|1|19) |
ataśca vidhivattve sarvaṃ, niṣedhatve ca pratyayāya eva kriyāphalaṃ samānābhidhānavidhiśrutibhyāṃ, na tu 'ṛtupakāraḥ: prakaraṇa- pāt |
evaṃ ca yadyapi ākhyātena kartā nābhiyate,
tathāpi bhāvanāyā ākṣitasya ākhyātena lakṣitasya ca vacanasya ca tadvatavaiguṇyasaṃpapādakatvam |
ataḥ śuddhaṛtu- tasyopasthitatvāt tadarthakalpanāṃ na doṣaḥ |
vastutastu vaimukhyavat ( 4|3|11 ) prakaraṇāyena śuddhapuruṣadharmatvā- na tasya vācyatvaṃ, pratīteranyathā'pi upapatteḥ |
tadā ca anṛtavadanapratiṣedhasya upanayana- tathāhi, ākhyātāt tāvat karttā kṛtiḥ ekatvādikaṃ ca prayukti pravṛtteḥ svārtānṛtavadanapratiṣedhāpi imeva mūlaṃ pratīyate ityavivādam |
tatra anekārthabodhakapade sarvatraiva iti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ |
dvitīyastu, satyapi puruṣaprādhā- ekatra śaktiḥ, aparatra ākṣepādi iti tathaiva |
ita- nyāyavagame svargapralayādāvikalpanāpekṣayā ṛtagataphalā- rathā anekaśaktikalpanā''patteḥ |
tatra ca niyama- dhānayogyatāvagyatvaparisaṃskārasya prakaraṇāvagatasya kāpekṣayāṃ pradhānena guṇabhūtasya loke ākṣepadarśanāt śrutya
nirbhantyaśabdastu yaugika iti yuktaṃ tasya madhanakriyāvidhāyakatvam |
yūpaśabde tu kriyānyottaraṃ prayoge'pi tajjanyādṛṣṭaviśeṣādṛṣṭatvāt na śuddha- jātivācitvaṃ, iti yukta eva tatra saṃskārādeśaḥ |
vastu- tastu yūpakāryaṃ khalevālīvidhānāt yūpaśabdasya na saṃskā- rādiśaktatvam |
saṃskārātideśastu sthānāpatyā, iti sūtroktupapadaṣṭānta'pi asaṃgata eva |
anovāso'dhikaraṇātnyāyena paśupuroḍāśe loka- siddhaikādaśakapālasya grahaṇāt na prayogamadhye tatkaraṇā- vaśyakatā iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 12|1|2, ano- vāsonnyāyena prakṛtau puroḍāśamātraviṣayatvālocane citredhau laukikasya puroḍāśasya grahaṇaprāptau |

10|2| 30, yatra tu piṣṭataṇḍulau pradeyatvena śrapaṇaprāptiḥ, puroḍāśādipacyapakapiṇḍādighaṭakapākaprayojanakasya tadabhāve peṣaṇavat lepaucityāt, tatra anovāso- nyāyena siddhasyaiva piṣṭasya upādānam |

kau. 3|1|4-10 pṛ. 161. 'yathākathaṃcit' -śabdena viśvajanādyupacita- prakāraniyāmābhāvaṃ 'yenakenacit' ityanena ca kyā- nupādānaprakāraniyāmābhāvamuktaṃ anovāsonnyāyena upapāda- yituṃ 'rūpaṃ vā' iti saptamādhikaraṇasiddhāntasūtraṃ paṭhitam |
su. pṛ. 1309. antarajñatvācca vārhaspatyasyacaniryāpādayaḥ pūrva- bhāvinaḥ, paścāt sārasvatājyadharmāḥ, adhvarakalpayām |
prathamabhāvinaḥ āgneyasya vikṛtirvāhaspatyasya; paścā- dvāviṃśa upaാംśuyājājyasya vikṛtiḥ sārasvatājyaṃ iti |
vi. 5|1|10. antaraṅgabahiraṅgayośca antaraṅgaṃ balīyaḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
tat kasya hetoḥ ? atra hi pūrvaḥ pratyayo bhavet |
ye dharmā apūrvārthāḥ, te sākṣāt apūrveṇa asaṃ- badhyamānāḥ taddeyaṣu viśāyante |
atastatra vṛddhiḥ apūrvā- saṃbhavena nivartamānā adṛṣṭe pravartamānā antaraṅgate tāvadāpatati |
yatra ca pūrva- māpatati tatraiva tiṣṭhati, tadatikrame kāraṇābhāvāt |
bhā. 12|1|123. antarajñānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lug bādhate iti nyāyaḥ |
(pṛ. 200, 52 pari.) atra na 'pratyayottarapadayośca' iti sūtraṃ jñāpakam |
tyaktaṃ ityādau lupāpekṣayā antaraṅgatvāt vibhaktanimittakena 'tyamāvekavacane' ityanena siddhe idaṃ vyarthe sat tajjñā- pakam |
iyaṃ 'supo dhātu0' iti lugvācyaiva iti ke cit |
'eṅ hrasvāt saṃbuddheḥ' 'na yāsyoḥ' iti sūtra- syāprāmāṇyena luṅmātraviṣayā |
anena nyāyena anta- raṅganimittavināśakaluk: tatmayojakasamādīnāṃ ca prāpyaṃ bodhyate |
śekhara. antaraṅgasyaḥ nityebhyaḥ parebhyaśca kāryebhyaḥ luk balīyān iti nyāyaḥ |
'nanu saṃjñāviṣaye yathodeśa- syaiva (pakṣasya) svīkāre 'rājan+as, puruṣa+s' ityavasthāyāṃ pūrvaṃ bhaṣāyāṃ alopaprāptiḥ |
na ca anta- raṅganapi iti nyāyena alopo neti vācyam |

yathodeśa- pakṣe 'akṣopoḍanaḥ' ityatra 'yaci bhaṃ' ityasya anupa- sthityā (supo dhātupratipadikayoḥ iti) luguttara- mapi bhasaṃjñāyāḥ sattvena lopaprāpteḥ luk: antaraṅganimitta- vināśakatvābhāvāt' ityuktaṃ bhūto |
śabdantare ca 'antaraṅgapi iti nyāyena bhasaṃjñāyāḥ pūrvamapravṛttyā antaraṅgapinityāyāprāptaḥ |
ata eva 'ḍitsattve pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhaḥ' iti vārtikaṃ saṃgacchate |
anyathā gargāḥ ityādī itsaṃjñāyāḥ prāgeva uktanyāyena luki svaprāptyā vārtikasaṃgatiḥ iti vācyam |
itsaṃjñāyāṃ uktanyāyāpravṛttisāre'pi saṃjñāmadhe apravṛttisāre pramāṇābhāvāt' ityuktam |
bhūtiḥ. vyutpanīputraḥ ityatra antaraṅgapi iti nyāyena vibhaktiluki pratyaya- paratvābhāvena nādeśāpatteḥ |
'deśaṃ saṃbaṃddha' (1|1|6|10) iti sūtramārabhya 'tadeśānāṃ' (1|9| 6|25) iti sūtraparyantaṃ ekamadhikaraṇam |

tādi tatheti cet' (23), 'na yajñāśrutvāt' (24) iti sūtradātmakaṃ adhikaraṇāntaraṃ uktādhi- karaṇasya antarā vartate, tatrāha śābdīdapikā- 'athavā anena sūtradvayena adhikaraṇāntaraṃ prastutādhi- karaṇasiddhāntasya dṛṣṭāntasiddhayarthaṃ tadīyapūrvapakṣanyāyena ca pūrvapakṣaṃ vaktuṃ antarāgarbhiṇīnyāyena vicāryate' iti |
garbhiṇīśarīramadhye yathā garbhaśarīraṃ tathā ekādhikaraṇamadhye aparamadhikaraṇam |
ke. tatra evaṃ antarāgarbhiṇīnyāyo bhavati iti anyathā sūtraṃ varṇyate |
'antarā'nuccyaṃ sadaivalāya' iti śrutau antare- tyanena daśahotṛnyāhṛtamyabhāge sāmidhenīpāṭhavidhānena pāṭhakramādāviha |
na ca antarāśabdaḥ madhyasvaravāca- tvena kośādiṣu prasiddhaḥ, 'uccairnnatrā kriyate' ityā- dinā svarasya prāptatvena tadapekṣaṇāt |

iti prāpte, 'yat krauñcamanāha āsuraṃ tat, yanmantraṃ mānuṣaṃ tat, yadantarā tat sadaiva' iti śrutyantaragatamantarāpadaṃ tāra- mandrobhayamadhyamabhūmikātvena svaraviśeṣaṃ nirdiśya antarā- 'nuccyamiti vidhāne tasyaivopasthitestaṃ kramavidhāyaka- tvam |
saṃkarṣa. 4|1|2. 'antarā'nuccya' ityādīnāṃ vastutastu na sāmidhenī- mātroddeśena vidhānaṃ, pramāṇābhāvāt |
bhāṭṭa. 3|1|19, 'antarā'nuccyaṃ sade- valāya' ityatra sāmidhenīguṇā uktāḥ |
' vā. 1|3|14 pṛ. 188. antareṇāpi nimittaśabdaṃ nimittārthau gamyate iti nyāyaḥ |
ayaṃ nyāyaḥ 'dvivacane'ci' (pā0 1|1|56) iti sūtre mahābhāṣye abhihitaḥ |
sāhasī. 190. 'tathayā dadhipayasaṃ pratyakṣa jvaraḥ, jvaranimittaṃ iti gamyate |
naḍvalodakaṃ pādarogaḥ, pāda- roganimittaṃ iti gamyate |
āyurghṛtaṃ, āyuṣo nimitta- miti gamyate' iti bhāṣyam |
dadhipayasaṃ iti samā- hāradvaṃdvaḥ karmadhārayo vā |
dadhyeva viśiṣṭavākyāyuktaṃ trapusaṃ ityucyate iti kaiyaṭaḥ |

' iti pūrvoyaucāsamātau acaucāntaranimittasaṃnipāte pūrvāśaucakālaśeṣeṇa manunā śuddhimuktvā 'nimittāttau naimittikāvīvānāhavṛttiḥ anyāyānyā' ityāśaṅkanirā- karaṇārthe pūrvāśaucaparicchedārthapravṛttena daśāhādinā prasaṅgena antaḥpatitasya acaucāntarasyāpi paricchedaṃ śakyatvāt aśīcānāhavṛtteḥ nyāyatvaṃ 'na vardhayedahā- hāni' ityanenoktam |
tathāhi ' satyena labhyastapasā hyeṣa ātmā samyagjñānena brahmacaryeṇa nityam' iti |
nityaṃ sadā, nityaṃ satyena, nityaṃ tapasā, nityaṃ samyagjñāneneti sarvatra nityaśabdo'ntardīipikānyāyenānupakkavya iti |
soma. 2|16. 'antarvedaṃ tiṣṭhan sāvitrāṇi juhoti' iti vedadeśaṃ na nāriṣṭhahomavikāratvasādhakaṃ, kiṃtu deśopa- lakṣaṇatayā'pi upapannam |
bhāṭṭa. 8|4|2. 'anta- rvedaṃ praṇītā vinayati' dvitīyāyā saṃskāratvāvagamāt ninayanaṃ pratipattirūpaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti na praṇayanasya prayo- jakam |
vi 4|2|5. antarvedividhivedapadalakṣitadeśa- viśeṣasya upamānāṅgatyā 'arthamantarvedaṃ minotyarthaṃ barhirvedaṃ' iti |
śabdābhyāṃ ubhābhyāṃ madhyadeśo lakṣyate, na aṅgāṅgibhāvo vidhīyate |
vā. 3|76|14. oṃ antarvaidhamyaḥ iti lakṣaṇayā deśavidhiḥ ||
sāmidhenīreva prakṛtya 'antarvaidhamyaḥ pādo bhavatīti vahi- vaidhamyaḥ' iti śrutaṃ, tatra 'ardhamantarvedi' ityādivāva na sthānaviśeṣalakṣaṇa vākyadvayena saṃbhavati |
tādṛśa- sthānasyaikatvena tatraikaḥ pādo'nyatrānyaḥ pāda iti kathana- svārasyavirodhāpatteḥ |

tasmādedetarūpaviṣaya 'pra vo vājā abhidhvaraḥ' iti pādo vaktavyaḥ, tadvirūpaviṣaya 'haviṣmanto vṛtāvyā' iti, punastadanantarūpaviṣaya 'devān jigāti sumnayaḥ' ityāditā sāmidhenīranūdyāntye- naikavākyatayā sidhyati |
iti prāpte, 'tiṣṭhannadhvara' iti vidheḥ sthānaviśeṣasākāṅkṣatvena tatsamarpakatvaika- vākyatve saṃbhavati vākyabhedāyogaḥ, tādṛśasthāne sthita-
ekatri ke kratau mādhyaṃ- dinapavamānastotre, ādya eva tṛce gānam |
ekatri ke tṛcādiṣu mādhyaṃdine chandasāṃ śruti- bhūtatvāt |

bhāṣyaṃ - asye katri kaḥ kratuḥ, ' athaipa ekatri kaḥ, ' tasyaikasyāṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ, tisṛṣu hotrājyaṃ, ekasyāṃ maitrāvaruṇasya, tisṛṣu brāhmaṇacchaṃsinaḥ, ekasyāmacchāvā- kasya, tisṛṣu mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaḥ ' iti |
tadatra mādhyaṃdine saṃśayaḥ kiṃ tṛcāyāṃ gānaṃ kartavyaṃ, utā''tha tṛce iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ekatri ke kratau mādhyaṃdine pavamāne tṛcāyāsu stotriyāsu gānaṃ syāt |
śrutibhūtāni hi trīṇi chandāṃsi prakṛtau, ' tricchandā āvāpo mādhyaṃ- dinaḥ pavamānaḥ ' iti |
bhāṣyaṃ--agnau tu ādhunārthā mantrāḥ 'veśīnāṃ tvā pañcādhūnomi' ityevamādayaḥ |
tathā amau (bīja-) vapa- nārthā mantrāḥ 'yā oṣadhīḥ' ityevamādayaḥ |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ ādyopādānaṃ, uta aniyama iti |
apūrvāsu tu saṃkhyāsu aprakṛtipūrvikāsu śrūyamāṇāsu brūmaḥ |
ādyo- pādāne hi keṣāṃ cinmantrāṇāṃ utpattiranirvākyaiva syāt |
yā hi prakṛtipūrvikā bhavanti, tāsāṃ prākṛtaprayogeṇa arthavattva |
'imāmagampyān' iti mantrasya aṣṭyātve tu andhanyāyena yathaiva nīyata tatraiva vartiyate |

yathā kaścit cakṣuṣmān pumān paṅguḥ anyamanyaṃ naramāśritya pravartayati kiṃ cit phalamuddiśya, tathā cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ svayamapravarta- mānaḥ pravṛttiśaktimadacetanaṃ pradhānaṃ pravartayati iti sāṅkhyāḥ |
ukte ca 'puruṣasya darśanāyai kaivalyārthe tathā pradhānasya |

kalpataruḥ. 2|2|7|37 bra. sū. yathā kena cidacetana 'sa paṭo raktaḥ' ityukte ' kṛtaḥ idaṃ śrutaṃ ' iti parasyākāṅkṣāyāṃ sa yadi anyamanyaṃ tadupadeṣṭāraṃ brūyāt, so'pi anuyuktaḥ anya- manyaṃ, so'pi aparamanyaṃ, na kaṃ cidapi svopadeṣṭāraṃ cakṣuṣmantaṃ brūyāt |
anayā andhaparaṃparayā prāta: pata- raktimā yathaivāprāmāṇikaḥ, evaṃ iyamapi karmeśvarayoḥ pravartapravartakabhāvaparaṃparā |
parimalaḥ. 2|2|7|27 bra. sū. pūrvaṃ karma kathaṃ īśvarāpravartitaṃ īśvara- pravartanavartitena ityevaṃ andhaparaṃparādoṣaḥ |
yathā andhena nīyamānā andhāḥ patanti tathā prakṛte'pi |
sāhasī. 24. na cātra bhaktānuvākaśabde andhaparaṃparāyāḥ, abhi- dhānābhidheyayoḥ sarvapratyakṣatvāt |
vā. 3|2|10|25, nanu ( vyākaraṇasya ) puṃvākyamūlatve andhaparaṃpararāyāḥ syāt ityāśaṅkayāha |
1|3|8|27 pṛ. 286, yatastu iha ( aṇkāṇḍa ) svargādisādhya- sādhanasambandhaḥ sarvatra nāsau puruṣāntareṣu utpadyamānaḥ kaiścit dṛśyate iti andhaparaṃparayānyāyena apramāṇatā |
' 1|3|11 pṛ. 162, yadi hi akṣarānupāto'pi arthaḥ asmadā- dibhireva kalpyate, tathā sati ātmaceṣṭitatvena prāmā- ṇyamabhyupagataṃ syāt |
atha puruṣāntaradhāraṇamucyeta, evamapi tadadhona tairapyanyatvena andhatvena iti anādite sati andhaparaṃ- parānayena sarveṣāṃ parapratyayāt na kaṃ cit prāmāṇyavyākṣā- nam |
1|2|17 pṛ. 113, 'yathaiva hi granthaḥ saṃpradāyād- vicchinnaḥ astitvaṃ bhajate, tatu ayuktaṃ ' andhaparaṃparā- nyāyādeva |
yā hi codanā na kadā cidapyate tasyāḥ sarvapuruṣapratyakṣādiprasarābhāvāt durlabhataramastitvam |
1|3|11 pṛ. 164, samānadeśamānaṃ prakaraṇapāṭhāt padānāṃ parasparasaṃnidhi saṃbandhaṃ vā na vedo vadati |
kiṃ tarhi ? puruṣeṣu āmantrantu tathā dṛśyate |
tairapyanyebhyo dṛṣṭaṃ ityanāditve'pi sarveṣāṃ darśanasaṃbhavāt andhaparaṃparā- nyāye nivṛtte bhavati prāmāṇyam |
1|3|14 pṛ. 858. nanu vyākaraṇāntagatāsādhutvāntaraṃ pratyakṣeṇa asaṃkīrṇāsā- dhutvadarśane mā bhūt andhaparaṃparanyāyāpattiḥ |
saṃkīrṇasya tu sādhutvasya pūrvadṛṣṭasya vyākaraṇamātrāt vivekajñāne tadā- pattiḥ : aparihāryā ityāśaṅkya āha-yāvāniti |
aya- mādhyāyaḥ, na tāvat adṛṣṭasādhanatvalakṣaṇasādhutvaviveka rūpasādhutvavivekasyāpi na tadāpattiḥ, vedādividyāsthāna- prayogamūlatvāt |

su. pṛ. 317, nanu vidhiniṣedha- rūpaśrutilamānapekṣaparaṃparāmātreṇa sādhyasādhutvavivekasiddheḥ vidhiniṣedhanirākaraṇaṃ anarthakaṃ, mūlaśrutyekṣayāmāpi vā sādhutvaśāsanātmakatvena vyākaraṇasya sādhuvidhimātrāpekṣa- tvāt asādhuniṣedhanirākaraṇaṃ anarthakaṃ iti cenna, nirmūlatve andhaparaṃparānāyāpatteḥ na sādhusādhuviveka- siddhiḥ |
vā. 1|3|8|27 pṛ. 282. tadyathā kaścit jātyandho vadet ' svarāsyaṃ ahasya rūpaviśeṣasya' iti |
kutaste pūrvavijñānaṃ iti ca paryanuyukte jātyandhameva aparaṃ nirdiśet |
evaṃ jātyandhaparaṃparāyāmapi satyāṃ naiva jātu cit saṃpratīya- vidvāṃsaḥ samyagdarśanametaditi |
' iha tu samūla- tvāt ( vyākaraṇe ) ekāntaritaprāmāṇyasiddhiḥ |
vā. 1| 3|8|27 pṛ. 286. andhavadhiramukaṇḍvādīnāṃ ājyāvekṣaṇā- dyaṅgānuṣṭhānāśaktatvāt na yāgāyādhikāraḥ |
prajñāhīnasya pradhānasya andhasandhyānyāyavat kāla- jñānāyogāt na kadā cidapi jagatkāraṇatvaṃ upapadyate |
yathā 'ahaṃ brahmāsmi ' iti vākyotthayā dhiyā ātmānaṃ yogī paśyati, tadānyo''- pyanyo bhavati |
tathā ca śrutiḥ 'taṃ vā etaṃ setuṃ tīrtvā'nyaḥ sannanyo bhavati' iti |
setuṃ maryādā- vicārakaṃ parameśvaraṃ tīrtvā prāpyeti śrutipadayorartha iti bhīṣmaparvaṇi nīlakaṇṭhaḥ |
bhā. 10|5|8|27. annameva tadkṣiṇato dadāti, tasmāddakṣiṇena haste puruṣo'nnamati |
vā. 1|3|4|9 pṛ. 221, annamevobhayato dadāti, tasmādubhayato hastābhyāṃ pari- gṛha puruṣo'nnamati' |
1|3|17 pṛ. 209. annakāmaḥ : jyotiṣṭome ukthyānāṃ brahma- sāmni saubhare ūrk iti nidhanaṃ kuryāt |
bhā. 2|2|1|28, 'maitraṃ śvetamāla- meta vāruṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ajāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca saṃdhau annādya- kāmaḥ ' |
( kāvīya ) bāla. pṛ. 34. ādyat āhvayāvadadhyāt ubhya- manni cayane |
yatra sādhanīyo'rthaḥ saṃdehaviṣayībhūto bhavati, sa pakṣaḥ |
tatra cedretane vartate, kintu anyatraivāsau syāt, tena ca yadi sādhyo'rthaḥ sādhyavidyumipyate tadā 'anyagehasthitadadhumān gehāntaramamamit ' ityeṣa nyāyaḥ proktaḥ |
yathā vidvatto devadatto bhūyiṣṭhaṃ adhyayanaṃ viṣṇudattasyeti |
atra vidvatta- mattvādhanamadhyayanaṃ viṣṇudattasya devadattapakṣabhinne viṣṇudatte eva vartate iti |
sāhasī. 880. anyataḥ prāmāṇyajñāni samīkṣya prayoga- vidhirvidhatte' iti nyāyena prayogavidheḥ yathāprāpyeva ajñānāṃ pradhānapratyāsattividhāyakatvāt |
ku. 5|1|8|16. anyataḥ prāpte kartṛkarmaṇoravācyatā' iti laukikanyāyānusārī ' dvetyayoḥ ' ityādi sūtrārtho bhavati |
su. pṛ. 1426. anyatarakoṭivyavasthayā koṭyantarasya ārthikā vyavasthā bhavati |

tatra ādyā yathā 'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatayā, sa someṣṭyā agnīṣomīyo bhavati, yadevādaḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ, tattarhi anurnipate, tarhi sa ubhayadevato bhavati' iti agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśe kṛtasomayāgapuṃviṣayatvena vyavasthāpite arthāt tadbhāvaḥ akṛtasomayāgapuṃviṣayatvena vyavasthite bhavati |
iti amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrveṣuvaidikaraṇe vyavasthāpite arthāt havirabhivāsanottaraṃ vaidikaraṇaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vyavasthitaṃ bhavati |
oṃ anyatarato'tirātratvāt pañcadaśarātrasyā- hīnatvaṃ kuṇḍapāyināmayanasya ca tadbhūteṣvahīna- tvasya darśanāt |
pañcadaśarātraḥ kuṇḍapāyināmayanaṃ ca etau adhīnabhūtau satrabhūtau veti vipratipattervicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
pañcadaśa- rātrasya pañcadaśabhirahorātraiḥ sādhyasya yāgaviśeṣasya, kuṇḍa- pāyināmayanasya etannāmakasya ca yāgaviśeṣasya adhīnatvaṃ syāt, na satratvam |
anyatarataḥ: ādau vā ante vā yasya atirātrayāgo bhavati tādṛśa- tvāt |
' yadanyatarato'ti- rātrastenāhīnaḥ' iti śrutau tadbhūteṣu anyatarato'tirātra- bhūteṣu ahīnatvasya darśanāt |
pañcadaśarātraḥ ahīnaḥ ahaḥsamūhasyākratuviśeṣaḥ, na tu satraṃ iti pūrvapakṣe hetvantaramāha |
' yadanyatarato'tirātrastenāhīnaḥ' iti vacanena pratyakṣameva pañcadaśarātrasya ahīnatvamuktam |
evaṃ ahīna- vacanāt pañcadaśarātraḥ ahīnaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pañca- daśarātraḥ kuṇḍapāyināmayanaṃ ca ime dve api satre syātāṃ, na ahīnau |
' ya eva bhūtikārya- micchantasta evaṃ pañcadaśarātramupeyuḥ' iti, kuṇḍapāyināma- yane ca 'bhṛtikāmā upeyuḥ' iti, upeyaṣṭena iṇu gatau iti dhātunā codite ete |
'yada- nyatarato'tirātrastenāhīnaḥ' iti naitadvacanaṃ vidhāyakaṃ, kiṃtu anuvādo'yaṃ syutyarthaḥ |
stutiśca nityena ahīna- liṅgena anyatarato'tirātratvena ahīnasya nopapadyate |
tu satraṃ, iti ubhayātmakatvāt śreṣṭho'yaṃ iti |
kuṇḍapāyināmayane ' gṛhapatigṛhīteḥ; subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyaḥ' iti satrasya liṅgaṃ darśayati |
gṛhapatirhi satre āmnātaḥ ṛtvijaḥ yājamānān kartum |
anyataraprāptau vyavasthāvidhirayā- ' vāsiṣṭhānāṃ nārāśaṃso dvitīyaḥ prayājaḥ, tadanupāt anyeṣāṃ ' iti |
atra hi vidhipāṭhakramāt tadanupādeva dvitīyo grāhyo na nārāśaṃsaḥ |
yathā vā - ' yadi rathantarasāmā somaḥ syāt aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyāt, yadi bṛhatsāmā śukrā- grān ' iti |
atrāpi pāṭhataḥ aindravāyavāgraiva prāptā, na śukrāgrā iti |
oṃ anyatra kṛtārthaṃ anyatra pratipādyate ityeva hi nyāyaḥ |
( somalitānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ avabhṛthe nayanaṃ pratipattiḥ ityādiviṣaye ) |
' ( ślokā. codanāsūtre 192 ) ityanena nyāyena yāgādirūpasyaiva dharmatvaṃ ityapagraham |
' yajeta ' iti sāmānyaṃ, ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ ' iti viśeṣaḥ |

anyathākaraṇaṃ sūtre yathā- ' paśusāmānya- vidhyādau satramevānyākṛtam ' ( ślokā. 1|1|156 ) jyotiṣṭome paśudharmavidhiḥ kiṃ trayāṇāmapi paśūnāṃ sādhā- raṇaḥ, athavā savanīyasyaiva, athavā agnīṣomīyasavanī- yayoḥ; uta amīṣomīyasyaiva iti saṃśaye |
tadidaṃ sarveṣāṃ samāno vidhiḥ iti āya-

pakṣasya pratipādakaṃ sat ' sthānācca pūrvasya' ( 3|6|199 ) ityādisāṅgatitatprasaṅgāt tatsaṅgatitadarthe ādyapakṣaṃ utsūtraṃ kṛtvā savanīyasya ityetasmin pakṣe anyathā kṛtvā yojitaṃ, tulyaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśuvidhiḥ syāt yadi prakaraṇa- viśeṣo na bhavet, asti tu prakaraṇaviśeṣa iti |
oṃ anyathākaraṇe cāsya bahubhyaḥ syānnirvārāṇaṃ iti nyāyaḥ |
āyurvedai vaidikaśāntikapauṣṭikaprāyaścitta- tapopajadānāhomādyupadeśo bhāgaḥ apramāṇaṃ iti cet ( bauddhaśaṅkeyam ) na, tulyayogakṣematvāt |
( cikitsā- bhāgo'pi apramāṇaṃ syādityarthaḥ :) etadevāsiddhaṃ prakṣepa- syāpi saṃbhavāt iti cenna |
khame divasānubhūtadeśakālāntara- gatāḥ śiraśchedādyo viṣayāḥ adṛṣṭobodhitasaṃskāravaśāt smaryamāṇā nidrārūpadoṣavaśena ātmaniṣṭhatayā bhāsante |
evaṃ ca anyasaṃvittvena avagatānāṃ anyasaṃvittvena bhānaṃ śuktirajatajñānavat |
na ca bāhyaviṣayeṣu manasaḥ tadānīmasaṃbandhāt kathaṃ bhāna- miti vācyam |
oṃ anyathātvakalpane viparīṇāmadoṣaḥ, vyavahita- kalpanādoṣaḥ, vyavahārakalpanādoṣaḥ |
dvitīye, pratiṣṭhita iti ityatra pratiṣṭhā- santi, rātrīpeyuḥ ityanyathātve kalpite ye ityatra rātriprasama- bhibyāhṛtasya ye pratiṣṭhāsanti iti vyavahitakalpanā |
tṛtīye tu ' yāvataḥ 'dhān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvato vāruṇān -catuṣkapālān nirvapet ' iti |
sā ca yāvatyeva hetutva- mupapannaṃ, tataḥ adhikakalpanāyai na prabhavati |
taccet kalpitaṃ, arthavattvāt vākyasya kṣīṇā anyathā'nupapattiḥ nāpūrvāntarasya pramāṇaṃ bhavati |
atra aklṛptānyavyatirekānu vidhāvinaḥ iti vivakṣaṇīyaṃ, tena na kāraṇāntarasyānyathāsiddhiḥ, īśvara- jñānādisaṃgrahaśca |
yathā viṇṇavidhātāya kṛtaṃ maṅgalaṃ śiṣyaśikṣāyai nibandhātītyatra viṇṇadhvaṃsaṃ prati maṅgalasya kāraṇatā abhihitā siddhā- ntitanā |
tatra vādinā tu, nanu maṅgala na vidhvaṃsaṃ prati na vā samāptiṃ prati kāraṇaṃ, vinā'pi maṅgala nāstikā- dīnāṃ granthe nirvighnaparisamāptidarśanādityuktam |
prakṛtanyāyataḥ āyāti, na vā samāptiṃ pratītyukteriti |
oṃ anyapūrvakaṃ abhīpsitaṃ karma yathā viṣamamu kupyati, abhimannu yajati iti |
oṃ anyalabhyatvaṃ ' ekakapālānāṃ vaiśvadevikaḥ prakṛtiḥ ' ( 7|1|5|23 ) ityadhikaranyāyaḥ |
oṃ anyavidhānādāraṇyabhojanaṃ na syādubhayaṃ hi vṛttyartham |
some anyasya bhojanasya ' payo vrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmikṣā vaiśyasya ' itivacanena vidhānāt, dāryapaurṇamāsikaṃ codakaprāptaṃ āraṇyasya śyāmākādeḥ bhojanaṃ na syāt |
tasmāt prākṛtasya āraṇyādhanasya nivṛttiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
na ca ekaṃ tṛcaṃ paṭhitvā anyā'nyāṃ punarupādāya agrimaṛcaṃpaṭhyataḥ ityevaṃ ṛkaprathanameva kiṃ na syāditi vācyam |
kutaḥ ? āha- yasyāṃ abhidhānakriyāyāṃ śabdaḥ karaṇaṃ tasyāṃ sākṣādimān karma, yasyāṃ cāsau karma tasyāṃ śabdaḥ karaṇam |
evaṃ niyame avagate yadi pramāṇāntareṇa ekasyaiva śabdasya arthāntaramabhidheyaṃ, arthasya vā śabdāntaraṃ abhidhāyakaṃ gamyate, tatra avagato''pi niyamo bādhyate |
ratnākaraḥ - saṃbandhā- kṣepavāde ślo. 13 pṛ. 501. 'anyā'nyāneka- śabdatvam' (13|8|26) na caiṣa nyāyaḥ yataḥ sahaśāḥ śabdāḥ ekamarthamabhiniviśamānāḥ sarve avicchinnaparaṃparyā eveti |
hastaḥ karaḥ pāṇiḥ ityemādiṣu tu abhiyuktopadeśāt anādiḥ amīṣāṃ arthena saṃbandhaḥ iti |
bhā. 13|8|26. yathā anekatvaṃ ekasya śabdasya anyāyaḥ, evaṃ ekasya arthasya anyāyaḥ anekaśabdatvaṃ ityapi nyāyaḥ |
kalpataruḥ 3|1|1 brasū. anyāya'nyāneka- śabdatvaṃ iti nyāyaḥ prakaṭe udāharaṇatvaṃ |
bhā. pṛ. 301, 410, 748, 1340, 1266, 1550. anyā'nyānekaśabdatvaṃ iti sūtraṃ bhāṣyakṛtā anyāya- sthānakatvaṃ iti uhitvā paṭhitam |
su. pṛ. 356. anyā'nyānekatvaṃ ityasya bījaṃ anavasthitasaṃbandha- prasaṅgaḥ, anekāṭacavācakatvakalpanāprasaṅgaḥ, vikalpadoṣa- prasaṅgaśceti tritayam |
taduktaṃ vārtike 'na yena sthitaṃ ekasya śabdasyārthaikyaṃ anavasthitasaṃbandhānekāṭacavāca- katvakalpavikalpadoṣaprasaṅgāt' iti |
30 pṛ. 301. anyā'nyānekatvaṃ iti ekatraiva mukhyatvaṃ, nobhayatra |
soma. 7|2|2. ekaḥ śabdaḥ ane- kāryaḥ syāt, tatra ko doṣaḥ ? śabde uccarite saṃśayaḥ syāt, nārthaniścayaḥ |
bhā. 7|3|14|36 pṛ. 1533-37, karmāntarasya etat (paurṇamāsaṃ iti padaṃ) vācakaṃ iti pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
3|2|1|9 pṛ. 748. yatrārthabhedena pṛthak śaktikalpanaṃ tatraiva anyā'nyānekatvaṃ iti nyāyaḥ; naikaśaktiviṣayārtha- bhedamātreṇa |
soma. 7|3|2. satyāṃ gatī sādhāraṇa- śabdatā'pi ayuktā |

amīpomīye paśau pāśamantraḥ taittirīyake ekavacanā- ntāśapadaghaṭitaḥ paṭhitaḥ : 'aditiḥ pāśaṃ pramumo- ktveta' iti, maitrāyaṇīye kāṭhake ca bahuvacanāntāśa- padaghaṭitaḥ : 'aditiḥ pāśān pramumoktvetan' iti |
dvipaśuke tu yāge bahuvacanāntāśapadaghaṭitasya mantrasya avikāreṇa dvivacanānto rūpavikāraṃ vinā prayogaḥ
nāsya ekasmin pāśe pravartamānasya mantrasya dṛṣṭaḥ pratighātaḥ virodhaḥ |
adṛṣṭapratighātatvāt iti vā pāṭhaḥ svīkāryaḥ; tadā ca bahuvrīhiḥ |
atha kāṭhake maitrāyaṇīye ca ekapaśuke eva ekapāśake abhīṣomīye paśau bahuvacanāntapāśapadaghaṭito mantro vihitaḥ |
sa ca yadyapi anyāyasaṃbandhaḥ : ekasmin pāśe bahuvacanasya nyāyaśūnyatvāt, tathāpi vidhivalāt pāśasya avayavaviḥ ekatve'pi tadavayavānāṃ bahutvaṃ abhipretya, bahuvacanasyopa- pattirvaktavyā |
tathā ca tatrāpi adṛṣṭapratighātaṃ jñātuṃ śakyate |
evaṃ prakṛtau ekapaśukāyāḥ ekapāśakāyāḥ sthite, dvipaśuke yāge vicāraḥ : kasya pravṛttiḥ ? kasya nivṛttiḥ, kasminūhaḥ ? kasminnohaḥ iti |
tatra pādaikatvābhidhāyī mantraḥ dvipaśuke dvipaśake prayoge dṛṣṭapratighātatvāt na pravartate |
anyastu mantraḥ yathā ekapāśake avikāreṇa prayujyate, tathā dvipāyake'pi prayoktuṃ śakyatvāt sa pravartate anūhena iti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ |
vikāro neti yaduktaṃ tatra, vikāraḥ kartavyaḥ, mantrasya tadarthatvāt pāśamocanaprayogārthatvāt |
sa tu vikāraḥ pāśaikatvā- bhidhāyimantre eva 'aditiḥ pāśau pramumoktvetau' iti kartavyaḥ |
anyastu mantraḥ sakalābhidhānasaṃbhave vikalābhi- dhānamantrāyaṃ iti avivakṣitasaṃkhyākapāśamātraprakāśana asamagrābhidhānatvāt na pravartate iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
anyāya- saṃbandhāt anyāsya pāśabahutvābhidhāyino mantrasya saṃvandhāt saḥ avikāreṇa pravartate prakṛtivat |
prakṛtau yathā avayava- bahutvaṃ avayavini upacarya pravartate, tathā pareṣvāpi prakṛti- bhinne'pi vikṛtipaśugeṣvapi yathārthe pratipādikādyamana-
pāśaikatvābhidhāyī tu ūhena pravartate iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yathārthe arthamanatikramya pāśaikatvapāśabahutvābhidhāyino- mantrayordvayorapi dvivacanohaḥ kartavyaḥ |
anyāyasya prakṛti- vadūhaditapāṭhasya acoditatvāt tasmādūhyatena prayogaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
nanu yathā prakṛtau ekasmin pāśe pāśabahutvābhi- dhāyī mantraḥ pravartate anyāsaṃyandha-śco'pi, tathā dvipaśu- kāyāṃ vikṛtauapi pravartatāṃ iti |
bahuvacanāntapāśapadaghaṭito mantraḥ prakṛtau pāśaikatve'pi vacanenaiva vihitaḥ |
naikatvena bahu- tvena vā tatra prayojanam |

sāhasī. 423. anyārthenāpi bhinnopakāro bhavati yathā pakṣyathaiḥ prayājādibhiḥ paśupuroḍāśasya |

kiṃ cit vākyaṃ prakṛtāt arthāt anyameva arthe pratipādayati, paraṃtu tenaiva anyārthena vākyena dṛṣṭena prakṛte vākyārthe'pi kaścidupayogo bhavati |

'caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāṃ āhutayo hūyante, trayodaśa amāvāsyāyāṃ' iti vākyaṃ darśa paurṇamāse ca kati āhutayaḥ iti pratipādayati |
tena ca jñāyate darśādau āgneyādīni pradhānāni prayājādyaśca
ke. anyārthadarśanāni yāni ananyagatīni, teṣāmapi liṅgatvamabhidhāsyate |
vā. 3|1|7|4 pṛ. 841. anyārthadarśanarūpaṃ liṅgaṃ sāhacaryeṇa saṃnadhena kasya cidarthasya jñāpakam |

ābharaṇaṃ. 3|1|2|15 bas. anyārthadarśanarūpasya liṅgasya svatato niścāyakatvaṃ tāntrikāṇāṃ asaṃpratipannam |
anyārthasaṃnidhānasya ākāṅkṣāvaśāt viśeṣakatvaṃ iti nyāyaḥ aparimitādhikaraṇapratipāditaḥ ( 6|1|10 ) |
anyūnayoḥ pārśvayoravadyati ' iti vacanāt paśoḥ sākalyāvagamaḥ |
tadyathā devadattasamāyāṃ śarāveṇaudanaṃ ca yajñadattaḥ prati- vidhatte, tathā saṃgrāmaṃ hastyaśvarathapadātibhiḥ iti |
satre sasadabhyo yajamānebhyaḥ anye ṛtvijaḥ syuḥ |
yathā prakṛtau jyotiṣṭome yajamānādanye ṛtvijo bhavanti tadvat iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
apīvā yajamānāḥ syurṛtvijāmabhidhānasaṃ- yogāt teṣāṃ syādyajamānatvam |
na yajamānebhyo'nye satre ṛtvijaḥ iti apivā- śabdasyārthaḥ |
ṛtvijāṃ abhidhānasaṃyogāt 'adhvaryurgrahapati dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati' ityādau dīkṣāvākye ṛtvijāṃ yāni abhi- dhānāni teṣāṃ yajamāneṣu saṃyogāt saṃbandhadarśa- nāt |
tasāt teṣāṃ ṛtvijameva yajamānatvaṃ syāt yaja- mānāmeva ca ārtvijyaṃ syāt |
'adhvaryurgrahapati dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati' iti vacanāt kartṛsaṃskāraḥ kartṛṇāṃ ṛtvijāmeva dīkṣā rūpaḥ saṃskāraḥ syāt |
kartṛ- āmīyyābhiḥ saṃjñābhiḥ upalakṣya vacanasāmarthyāt teṣāṃ dīkṣāsaṃskāro vidhīyate |

yathā ādhāne ' yastaṃ śro'bhimādhāsyan syāt sa etāṃ rātriṃ vrataṃ caret' na māṃsamaśnīyāt, na striyamupeyāt ' iti vacanāt ādhātuḥ adhvaryoḥ niyamo vidhīyate, yathā vā jyotiṣṭome 'sarvairnija upavasanti' iti ṛtvijāmupa- vāso vidhīyate, tadvat iti pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
āghātṛtvat iti pūrvapakṣiṇā uktaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ vaiṣamyena pariharati |
syāt ādhātuḥ vrataṃ, vacanena apūrvavidhā- nāt |
paraṃtu viṣaye satre yajamānā eva ṛtvijo na vā iti saṃśaye tanyāyatvāt ' apivā yajamānāḥ syurṛtvi- jāmabhidhānasaṃyogāt ' ( 10|6|15|52 ) iti nyāyāt yajamānā eva ṛtvijaḥ iti yuktam |
sa nyāyo yeṣāṃ te tanyāyā yajamānāḥ, teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ tanyāyatvaṃ, tādṛśatvāt iti vigrahaḥ |
prakṛtitvat yathā prakṛtau jyotiṣṭome dīkṣākāryaṃ yajamānasaṃskāraḥ, tadvat satre'pi ' gṛhapatiṃ dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati ' iti yajamānā- nāmeva dīkṣāsaṃskāra uktaḥ syāt |
yanu ṛtvijāmupavāsa- vidhānaṃ ādhātuvratavidhānaṃ ca, tat vacanāt bhaviṣyati iti viṣamo dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
tasāt satre yajamānā eva ṛtvijaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'adhvaryurgrahapati dīkṣayitvā ' iti dīkṣāvākye adhvaryuḥ brahmā ityādyā ākhyāḥ svāmyākhyāḥ |
svāmina eva te sarve, ṛtvijastu anye eva syuḥ |
gṛhapatitvat yathā gṛhapatiḥ iti ākhyā svāmina eva na ṛtvijaḥ tadvat |
pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktaṃ tanna, prasiddhagrahaṇatvāt ādhvaryavādi karma kurvāṇānāṃ ṛtvijāṃ karmanimittena prasiddhānāṃ ākhyānāṃ grahaṇatvāt grahaṇāt |
gṛhapatiḥ iti ākhyā tu taddharmeṇa ṛtvidharmeṃṇa asaṃyuktasya svāmina eva iti yajamānābhidhayatā upapadyate |
prakṛtāvāpi ayaṃ gṛhapati- śabdaḥ ' gṛhapatiryajeta ' iti svāmini prayuktaḥ |
tasāt satre yajamānā eva ṛtvijaḥ, ṛtvija eva ca yajamānā iti siddhāntaḥ |
satre ṛtvikṣu ṛtviktvena kevalena yajamāna- tvena tulyeṣu satsu ' yo vai bahūnāṃ yajamānānāṃ gṛhapatiḥ satrasya praṇetā, sa hi bhūyiṣṭhādbhirmādvirti ' iti bahūnāṃ iti viśeṣavacanaṃ nopapadyate |
ekasmin gṛha- patiriti viśeṣavacanaṃ sadṛśānāṃ gṛhapatīnāṃ atulyatve sati upapadyate, na tulyatve |
yadi sarve ṛtviktvenyaḥ gṛhapatirbhavanti kuryuḥ na karmāntaraṃ, tato viśeṣābhāvāt gṛha- patau viśeṣavacanānupapattiḥ |
asāt viśeṣavacanāt satre ṛtvija eva yajamānā iti gamyate |
' dīkṣitāḥ satrairyajante, adīkṣitā ahīnairyajanti ' iti dīkṣitāśca adīkṣitāśca iti vyapadeśaḥ nirdeśaḥ |
arthayoḥ svārtha- yajanaparyantayajanayoḥ yajamāne ṛtviji ca nitya- bhāvitvāt |
yajamāne svārthayajanasya, ṛtviji pārārtha- yajanasya ca nityaṃ vartamānatvāt |
tasāt dīkṣitā- dīkṣitavyapadeśāt satre svayaṃkartṛkatvaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
' adakṣiṇāni satrānītyāhuḥ, nadyatra gaurdīyate na vāso na hiraṇyaṃ ' iti satrasya adakṣiṇatvāt aviccha- mānadakṣiṇatvāt dakṣiṇatvāt satrāṇi svayaṃkartṛ- kāṇi |
ṛtvijāṃ bhinnatve tu adakṣiṇatvaṃ na saṃbhavati |
tasāt satre yajamānāste ṛtvijaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

maṇi. pṛ. 76. 'anvahaṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dadāti' iti ahīnā- tmake dvādaśāhahe tattadaṅgatvena dvādaśaśatavidhānāt nātra dakṣiṇāyāḥ kṛtsnaprayogārthatvam |
ayaṃ vidhiḥ na pradhānārthatvabodhakaḥ, kiṃtu dvādaśaśatatiriktāśadādipari- saṃkhyārtha eva |
anvahaṃ iti tu atideśāptapradhānārtha- lānuvādaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
prātāyā dakṣiṇāyāḥ punaḥsada- ñcatvena vidhī yathaivāpatteḥ sakṛtkriyāmānatvena prasaktāyāḥ anvahaṃ ityanena āvṛttisiddhiḥ |

6|7|8, 'anvahaṃ' ityanena pratyahaṃ vibhajya dānaṃ'pi na tatra dakṣiṇāmedaḥ ityuktam |
11|4|1, 'anvahaṃ vidutāni sahasrāṇi dadāti catuṣṭome aśvasahasraṃ' iti mānavasūtre aśvasaha- srasya daśame'hani vidhānam |
na tu pārthasārathīratyā 'pratyahaṃ gavāṃ sahasraṃ, aśvasahasraṃ tu ekādaśe'hani' itye- vaṃrūpo vibhāgaḥ |
ataḥ pauṇḍarīke daśame'hani aśvasahasraṃ dattvā avaśiṣṭeṣu gavāṃ sahasrāṇi iti vibhāgaḥ |
'anvahamekaikamālameta dvādaśe ādyaṃ' iti vacanena dvādaśāhe vihārapakṣo vihitaḥ |
adhvaryuḥ yaja- māno vā gārhapatyasya paścāt padmāsanenopaviśya tribhiḥ svāhākārā-ttairddhamantraistriḥ sthūlaḥ samidhaḥ abhyā- dadhāti |
tato dakṣiṇāgnau ūrdhvajānurupaviśya tathaivā- bhyādhāya gārhapatyasya paścānmāgatena ā āhavanīyāt vāyavyadeśe prahoṣo'vasthāya tathaiva tisraḥ samidho'bhyā- dadhāti |
tato tatraiva tiṣṭhan daśamena ṛmantreṇa upasthānaṃ karoti |

brāhmādivāhotpannaḥ pitrā mātāmahena pitā- mahā vā vikalpena kuryāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ karmānuṣṭhānamanu yaḥ āhāyate dīyate dakṣiṇāgmyaḥ dakṣiṇātvena, sa caruḥ anvāhāryaḥ |
vi. 12|1|1. anvāhāryasya mahāpaṭhitapari- mitatvāpi sakṛduccārvikṛtacaturthyāpyāsitatvāt ānala- śaktiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1472. anvāhāryaṃ odane abhidhāraṇaṃ svādimne kriyate |
bhā. 10|1|10|38. anvā- hāryacarurūpā dakṣiṇā yajurvede samāmnātā |
vi. 3|8|1. anvāhāryadakṣiṇāyāḥ dādikāyāḥ somā- ṅgadakṣiṇīyādiṣu saumikadakṣiṇāyā prasaṅgasiddhiḥ |
10|1|6|34, anvāhāryadakṣiṇāyāṃ darśapūrṇamāsikyāṃ brāhmaṇā eva dṛśyante, 'ta ete vai devā ahutādo yad brāhmaṇā yadanvāhāryamāharanti tāneva prīṇāti' iti |
12|1|16|32. anvāhāryaṃ dvādaśaśatādidānaṃ karmasaṃyuktebhyaḥ abhidhā- ya iti daśame vakṣyati |
ye brāhmaṇā uttarastān yajamāna āha 'dakṣiṇata eta' iti |
uttarataḥ parīta' iti saṃpre- ṣyati' (kalpasūtramidam) pratigrahamantraṃ paṭhitvā ṛtvi- jastaṃ svīkurvanti |
mā. 10|1|3|7, anvāhārya- sthānāpanne'pi vatse pākānuṣṭhānaṃ na karttavyam |
101219137, anvāhārthasthānā- pannayoḥ vāsostasyoḥ abhighāraṇasya bādhaḥ āgrayaṇe |
anvāheti ca śaśvat karma syāt, codanā- ntvāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'puronuvākyāmnvāha' 'yājyā- manvāha' iti 'anvāha'śabdena uktaṃ anuvacanaṃ karma pradhānakarma syāt |
yājyānuvākyayoḥ samākhyayaiva prāptorapi anvāha iti codanāttarāt punarvidhānam |
some yathā śabdānuvacanaṃ pradhānaṃ karma tadvat |
anvā- heti śabdena anuvacanaṃ saṃskāraḥ syāt, na pradhānam |
coditasya samākhyāprāptasyārthasya vācako yaḥ śabdaḥ 'anvāha' iti, tasya vacanārthatvāt anupradhānārtha- tvāt |
tathā ca samākhyayā yaduktaṃ, tasyaivāyaṃ anvāha iti śabdena anuvādaḥ |
athavā coditasya samākhyā- prāptasya śabdavacanārthatvāt mantraśabdasya yat vacanaṃ tadartha- katvāt anvāhaśabdasyāpi ca sa evārthaḥ ityanuvādaḥ |
samākhyayā prāptatvāt punaḥ anvāha ityasya avācyatvāt |
samākhyayā prāptasyāpi yājyānuvākyā'nuvacanasya 'puro- 'nuvākyāmnvāha' 'yājyāmnvāha' iti punarvacanaṃ syāt saphalam |
guṇārthatvāt 'tiṣṭhan yājyāmnvāha' 'āsīnaḥ puro'nuvākyāmnvāha' iti sthānāsanarūpaguṇavidhānāt upapadyatvāt |
tasmāt yājyāpuro'nuvākyāvacanaṃ devatā- saṃskāraḥ, na pradhānakarma iti siddhāntaḥ |
ākāṅkṣāyogyatāsaṃni- dhānāni grāhakagrahaṇākhye anvitābhidhāne prayojakāni, na tu śabdopāttatvamapi |
tathātve śabdānabhihitasya prākpa- topakārasya vaikṛtavidhinā anvitābhidhānābhāvaprasaṅgāt |
uktaṃ ca śālikanāthena 'prākṛtenopakāreṇa padārthaścaiva vaikṛtaḥ ! prayogavidhinā'nveti vidhirinvita ucyate ||
vākyādibhiḥ prākṛtaśca sa yogyaḥ saṃnidhā- pyate ||
yadi ca kramasya anuṣṭhīyamānapadārthā- vasthārūpatvena prayatnasādhyatvāt na vidheyatvaṃ, tadā tadaṅgīkṛtaṃ tātparyakramasya vidheyatvaṃ vihanyeta |
pāñcamikasya tu vitatilakṣaṇamasya nāsti śabdābhidhānaṃ iti vairūpyaṃ ca uktlīyā anvitābhidhāne śabdāmidhisya apra- yojakatvāt akiñcitkaram |
soma. pṛ. 406. anvitābhi- dhānamapi apavādatvena tantraratne padavektvādhikaraṇe, nyāyaratnamālāyāṃ aṅkanirṇaye coktam |
bāla. pṛ. 42. anvitābhidhānasya śabde prakṛtipratyayorapi nirasta- tvāt kṛtānubandhameva svārthe pratyayo vadati |
tatra ke cittvāda- vibhāgameva vākyaṃ vyañjakatvamidat tenatena varṇapada- viparyasātmanā avagamyamānaṃ tasyatasya vākyārthasya prati- pādakamiti manyante |
anye tvevaṃvidhameva jñānaṃ vākyaṃ, tadanantaraṃ cānekajātiguṇadravyakriyābhāsaṃ vijñānameva vākyārthaḥ, kāryakāraṇabhāva eva ca vākyavākyārthayoḥ saṃbandha iti pratijānate |
apare tu pada- vat vākyamapi pūrvapūrvavarṇasaṃskārasacivaḥ antyo varṇo
vācaka ityādinā mārgeṇa sāvayavameva pratilavdhasaṃbandhatva- yavabhūtapadajanitapadārthasaṃvidupāyaṃ vākyārthasya vācakaṃ saṃgirante |
tatra jñānātmakavākyavākyārtha- vādastāvat svātmani kriyāvirodhādvibhavāsāca śūnya- vāde eva nirastaḥ |
vākyaṃ hi nāma ekavi- śiṣṭārthapratipādanaparaṇi padānyeva |
vākyārtho'pi padārtha evaikārthāntarasthitatvāt iti yadyapi nātyantabhedo bhedo vā śakyate'bhidhātuṃ, tathāpi avāntarasthityupa- patyenaṃ vahirbhūto'sau śakyate apahrotum |
nirbhāgavākya- vādo'pi bhāgāvāgamādevāpāstaḥ padavaditi cenna, asi- ddhatvāt |
tatraitatsyāt, yathaiva varṇavibhāgabhāgameva satye'pi ekapadabhāvasādharthyapateṣa varṇairvarṇyaḥ anupapatterbhāgāva- gamasya mithyātvācciravayavameva padaṃ padārthasya vācakamā- śritam |
tathā vākyamapi, tatrāpi hi ekamidaṃ vākya- miti parāmarśo'stīti sa eva nānātvaṃ pratiṣipati, nānātvaikatvayorvirodhāt |
vākyārthapratipattisannipāyā vākyameva nirbhāgaṃ kalpayatīti, tatraivaṃ dṛṣṭāntāsiddheḥ |
yasyaika- padamiti parāmarśaḥ, sa bahūnāmapyekāryapratipattini- mittaḥ |
bhavati hi bahūnāmapi ekakāryaninvanamekatvaṃ, yathā seneti, yathā vā rājasūya iti |

pratyakṣeṇa tu padasvarūpa- mekaṃ anaupādhikaṃ saṃhitapāṭhamātreṇa vyutpannānāmivateṣāṃ ca anupadetandriyāṇāmaviśeṣeṇa prakāśeta, tatra tāvadeka- padāvabhāsāt varṇātirekapadasiddhiḥ, pratyutāsaccameva tasya yogyānupalabdhyā niścīyate |
yadā varṇā evākṣadhīgocarā nānyaditi sthitaṃ, tadā varṇāntarajāyamānā arthapratipattiḥ tannimittaiva vijñāyate |
taccāntarasya tu pratyakṣānupalambha- nirassādvāvasya dūrāpāstameva vācakatvaṃ, nānyathā'nupa- pattyā'pi kalpayituṃ śakyate |
tena varṇānāmeva ekavaktṛ- cchāraṇāpāditanairataryāṇāṃ svaraviśeṣabhājāṃ saṃhatānāmānu- pūrvīviśeṣaśālināṃ anantaramarthāvagamyamadaśanāt tādṛśānā- mevārthabhidhāyakatvaṃ niścīyate |
kathaṃ punaḥḥ kramavartināṃ sāhityam ? avāntaravyāpāravaśāditi brūmaḥ |
pūrvapūrvau hi varṇa upalabhyamānaḥ saṃskārāparanāmadheyaṃ avāntaravyāpāre janayati |
evaṃ tarhi prativarṇaṃ saṃskārā bahavaḥ kalpanīyāḥ syuḥ, tadasmekameva śabdatvaṃ kalpitam |

na khalu pratyakṣānupalambhanirastasattvasya tasya sadbhāva- stavyā''bhyupayeyaḥ, saṃskārastu iṣṭopapatye kalpyamāno nātiva lajjāmāvahati, anekaṃmapi dṛṣṭopakārakaṃ kalpanīyaṃ, dṛṣṭaviruddhaṃ tu na kiṃcidapi |
yadā nātrāklṛptasaṃskārā- ntaraparikalpanā, klṛptā eva smṛtihetavaḥ saṃskārāḥ, ta eva caite'pi |

yadanubhavabhāvitāḥ tatraiva smṛtiṃ jana- yanti, na tvarthāntarapratipattimiti cet, naiva teṣāṃ smṛti- bhyo'nyatra vyāpāro'bhyupayete, tāmeva tu smṛtiṃ janayantaḥ arthapratipattī api upādhībhavanti smṛtāmeva varṇānāṃ vācakatvāt |
nanyubhayavat smṛto'pi varṇeṣu krameṇa jāyamānā na saṃbhavanti arthapratipattī |
atha krameṇānu- bhūtānāmapi yugadeva smaraṇaṃ, tato vyutkrameṇāpi uccā- ritā vācakāḥ syuḥ, tatrāpi smṛtihetusaṃskārajananāt |
atha tuccāraṇakramo''pi aṅkamiṣyate, tathā sati saivādṛṣṭakalpanā |
saṃskāro''pi hi smṛtihetuḥ kramāntare''pi jāyate eva, tannimittaṃ ca smaraṇam |
na cādṛṣṭamapi kalpayituṃ śakyate, anta- reṇāpyuccāraṇaṃ tatkarma ca smṛtyārūḍhābhyāṃ jarājarāśabdābhyāṃ nāmākhyātarūpāmyāṃ arthaviśeṣapāvagamāt |

yadi varṇā eva padaṃ, tato rājajarāśabdayorvarṇabhedābhāvāt anuccāritā- vakhyāṃ coccāraṇatajjanyānubhavakramayoḥ avidyamānatvāt, smaraṇasya caikasya yugapadanekavarṇagocaratvopyamānasya akramatvāt kutaḥ padabhedāvasāyaḥ, kutastarāṃ cārthabhedāva- gamaḥ |
na ca varṇāḥ svarūpeṇa nityā vibhravo deśakāle- pādhikaṃ kramaṃ bhajante, yadedātyadamevaḥ syāt |
padatattvaṃ yat vilakṣaṇapadabhāsaṃ bodhayatīti śabdatattvavidaḥ pratipannāḥ |
teṣu yattāvatkrameṇa smaraṇeṣu yugapada‌nubhavavat saṃbhūyakāritvā'saṃbhava iti mataṃ, tadastu, yugapadeva tu sarveṣu smaraṇamarthāntareṣviva ghaṭapaṭādiṣu kramādanubhūteṣvapi bhavati |
yattvevaṃ nuktame'pi arthāvagatiḥ syāditi, tadayuktaṃ krama- syāpyatvāt |

yadipi smaraṇasyāpi yugapanmanaḥ kramo nāsti, varṇeṣu vibhuṣu nityeṣu vastugatyā kramo nāsti, tathāpi vyañjakānāṃ dhvanīnāṃ kramavartitvāt tairvarṇaiṣbha- vyajyamāneṣu tadīyakarmo vyañjakeṣu varṇeṣu dīrghatvādivat ādarśalpatvamahattva iva mukhe samāropitaḥ pratīyate, tataśca smaraṇamapi paścājjāyamānaṃ viśiṣṭānupūrvisamālikti- śarīrāneva varṇān
nanu tasyāpi pratyakṣavagatabhiḥ śilādibhireva kriyāmirā- kāṅkṣā viramet, tena pramāṇāntareṇa sthitau aśve ca saṃni- hite, gaurānīyatāmityukte 'gaustiṣṭhati, ānīyatāmatraḥ' |
yāvanti hi padāni saṃhatya prayujyante, tāvatāṃ sati saṃbhave saṃhatyekaviśiṣṭārthapratipattiparatvaṃ loke dṛṣṭam |
tacca śrutayo- revānvaye nirvahati, anyathā vādhyate |
dṛṣṭānuguṇyaṃ yatra syāt kalpanā ca laghīyasī |
nanvekaṃ na pṛthaganyaye śaktiḥ kalpyate, ekaiva hi anvitaparyante kalpyate iti |
yadyapi hi viśiṣṭo'rtha eva, tathāpi viśiṣṭādvi- śeṣaṇamanyadeva, tasmin agṛhīte na tadviṣṭaṃ viśeṣaṃ grahītuṃ śakyate |
na ca tasya pramāṇāntaraṃ grāhakamastīti śabdenaiva tadabhidhānapuraḥsaraṃ viśiṣṭamabhidhātamiti śaktidvayakalpanāgauravaṃ syāt |
na caivaṃ vākyārthapratyayasyānupapattiḥ, yataḥ syāt svarūpāmidhāne'pi dhīrviśiṣṭārthagocarā |
sarvāvasthāsāmānyātmani padārtharūpe padenābhihite tata eva anvitarūpāvasthāviśeṣapratītisiddherna tāvadabhidhā- śaktirūpakalpituṃ śakyate |
yaccaivaṃ sati gaurānīyatāmitya kārakeṇa kriyā ca kriyākārakamātrākṣepācca niyamena gauḥ ānayanena, ānayanaṃ
syādetat, na vayaṃ sādhāraṇī padaśaktirekavākyatayā niyamyate iti kalpa- yāmaḥ |
kathaṃ tarhi arthāntareṇānvitābhidhānaṃ na bhavati, apekṣā'bhāvāt |
na ca pramāṇāntarapratītyoḥ kriyākārakayorapekṣā vidyate, śrutayo- stvapekṣā, sā ca parasparasaṃbandhādapi nivartate, iti nārthā- ntarānvayaprasaṅga iti |
bhavati hi kadā cidiyamavasthā, yadai kasmin deśe heṣādiśabdenāśramanāya tasya kriyāviśeṣaṃ jijñāsā- svate, kimaśvo gacchati tiṣṭhati veti |

pradeśāntare ca padavikṣepaśabdena gatimanumāya kārakaviśeṣaṃ jijñāsate, kimaśvo vā gacchatīti, tasyāmavasthāyāṃ gaustiṣṭhatīti padadarthaṃ kaściduccārayati, tatra yadyekavākyatvaṃ niyāmakaṃ neṣyate, tato heṣādiśabdānumitasyāśvasya kriyāviśeṣā- pekṣatvāt tiṣṭhatīti padāvagatāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kāraka- viśeṣāmekṣatvāt parasparānvayaḥ syāt tiṣṭhatya iti |
tathā padavikṣepaśabdānumitasya gamanāsya kārakapekṣatvāt gau- pādavagatāyāśca gauḥ kriyāpekṣatvānyonyānvayaḥ syāt gau- gacchatīti |

ata eka- vākyataiva śaraṇamarthaniyamya naitikānvayabodhanāya padairapyanva- tābhidhāyibhiḥ, sā ca padārthairapi svabhāvasiddhānvayabodhana- sāmarthyastatriyāmāpekṣeti kṣamyate iti kṛtamanvitābhidhāna- parikalpanavyasanena |

kiṃca dhvakhadirau ityādi 'yugapadadhi- karaṇe dvaṃdvaḥ' ityamyupagamāt vācakatvānvayayugapamācca avadayaṃ khadiro dvivacanānvāya sadditīyamātmānaṃ lakṣayati nābhidhatte, yena kenāpi sadditīyasya tadanyayopapattau kimiti dhvasadvitīyamevātmānaṃ lakṣayati ? tadevavākya- tvāditi cet, tarhi tadeva sarvatra padārthonāmanvitā- tmalakṣaṇayā kāraṇaṃ bhavatīti na kadā cidaklaptakalpa- nam |
tulyaiva śaktikalpanā syāt tathāpi padārtha eva vākyārthe pramāṇaṃ yuktamaṅgīkartuṃ, na padāni ānantaryyavya- vākyānām |
anvitābhidhānavāde'pi hi padaiḥ padārthai- jvagateṣu paścādvākyārthajñānaṃ jāyate, anyathā saṃnidherdu- bhatvāt |
te tu tairabhihitāḥ smāritā vetyatra vivādaḥ |
sarvathā tāvat padagrahaṇānantaraṃ padārtheṣu pratīteṣu vākyā- rthāvagatirityavivādam |
tataśca anantarānubhūtapadārthāti- krameṇa vyavahitāni padāni na yuktaṃ yadvākyārthāvagateḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavantīti kalpayitum |
na ca punaḥ padānusaṃ- dhānamastīti kiṃ cana pramāṇamasti |
asatyāpa ca tasmin padārthānusandhānamātreṇa vākyārthaḥ pratīyate iti sarva- janīnametat |
tena dṛṣṭānuguṇyādapi padārthanimittaka eva vākyārthaḥ, na padanimitto dṛṣṭāvadhaprasaṅgāt |
etena yatpadā- nāmevānvite sāmarthyamityabhidhānaṃ kārakayuktaṃ prāyādati, tadviparyayasādhanamiti veditavyam |
yastu tātparyāt padānā- meva sākṣādanvitapratipādakatvaṃ yuktamityuktaṃ, tat kāṣṭhānā- manapekṣitajyālānāṃ pākāsādhanatvaṃ āmeyādīnāṃ cātatra- tāvāntaravyāpārāṇāṃ paramakāryasādhanatvamāpādyeta |
atha tatrābheyādirūpeṇa tirohiteṣu jāyamānaṃ paramāpūrva na taiḥ sākṣājjanayituṃ śakyate, tādarthye cāntaravyāpārādreṇāpi sādhayatāmaviddhamityucyate, tadatrāpi samānam |
atrāpi hi tirohiteṣveva padeṣu padārthānusandhānanantaramagamya- mānasya vākyārthasya padārthā eva sākṣātsādhanaṃ, padāni tu tadvāreṇaiva sādhanaṃ na sākṣāditi |
nanvevamabhidhāyakatvaṃ padānāṃ na syāt, padārthasvarūpāpagateḥ : svarūpādivābhidhāyitvāt sārakalamevāstu nābhiyāyakatvam |
te'pi naivāsmṛtā yathā syādvākyārthaṃ gamayanti naḥ |
pratyāsattinimittaṃ smārakala, na ca padapadārthayoḥ saṃyogasamavāyādinā pratyāsatti- rasti, yataḥ smārakalyaṃ syāt |
syādetat, yathā saṃbandhantarābhāve- 'pi vācakatvaṃ, evaṃ smārakatvamapi bhaviṣyati |
pratyayatvaṃ hi vācakatvaṃ, tacca svabhāvaśaktyā 'pyupapannaṃ caturādīnāṃ rūpādiṣu |
nanu tatrāpi saṃyogasaṃyuktsamavāyatvamayalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandho vidyate eva |
tadva- cchabdasyāpi svābhāvikyaiva śaktyā pratipādakatvaṃ bhavi- ṣyati, smārakatvaṃ tu saṃskārodbodhena |
na ca saṃbandha- ntarādarśanena asau udbodhayituṃ śakyate, ka cidapya- darśanāt |
nanu pratyayatvakalpamapi asaṃbandhino naiva dṛṣṭaṃ svābhāvikaśaktiśālināmapi caturādīnāṃ saṃba- ndhaiva pratipādakatvāt, anyathā dadhidānāpi grahaṇapra- ṅgāt |
tatka- thamasya pratyayatvam ? ayantyādaṣṭamapi tadihaiva kalpyate, tarhi smārakatvameva kimiti na kalpyate ? vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ |
sarvathā tāvadanyatrā- saṃbandhinaḥ adṛṣṭamapi smārakatvaṃ pratyayatvaṃ vā śabdasya kalpyam |
śabdāna- ntaramarthapratyayadarśane tataśca tatra kāraṇatvaṃ kalpayituṃ yuktaṃ, na tu śabdāt saṃskārodbodhaḥ |
gṛhītagrāhitvāt smaraṇameva padajanitaṃ vijñānamiti cet, tadasat, atallakṣaṇatvāt |
na gṛhīta- grāhittvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ saraṇasya, kiṃtu saṃskāramātrajanyatvam |
pratyu- taprakārajanitaṃ tad yat gṛhītagrāhi jñānaṃ, tadanuvāda ityu- cyate, na smṛniriti |
kathaṃ tarhi vārtikavacanā, satyaṃ ghaṭate eva, anuvādasyāpi gṛhītagrāhitayā smaraṇadaviśiṣṭatvāt |
'bhāvanā vacanasāvattvāṃ sāryati lokavat' (ślovā. vākyā- dhikaraṇe 248) ityādiaupacārikavyavahāraḥ |
tathā ca 'padamapyadhikābhāvātsmārakatvānna viśiṣyate' ityāha (ślovā. śabdaparicchede 107), na tu smāraka miti darśayati |
kiṃca yadyabhidhānata evānvitatvamitiḥ kathaṃ tarhi [gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādiṣu lākṣaṇikasya tīrāderghoṣānvitasya pratipattiḥ |

athocyeta ] (ayaṃ granthaḥ kaścidāsti, ādayakasya ) gaṅgāśabdena nimittabhūte'rthasvarūpe smārite sati tena yatsaṃbandhāt smāritaṃ tīrasvarūpaṃ, tenānvitaṃ svārthe ghoṣaśabdo'bhidhatte, gaṅgāśabdastu tīrasmaraṇātropayogīti |
yatra tarhi sarvapadānāmiva lākṣaṇikārthatvaṃ na kasya cidapi mukhyo'rtho vidyate, tatra kathamanvitapratipattiḥ |
asti vā tādṛśaṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ yatra na vidyate |
kāryaṃ tad- nvitaṃ vā'pi yathā gacchati bhūmiḥ |
sarva- pāmeva padānāṃ kāryaṃ tadanvitaṃ vā abhidheyam |
yasya loke kunūhalapra- tivacanarūpaḥ siddhārthaviṣayaḥ : śabdaprayogaḥ kāryaśūnyo dṛśyate yathā 'ko'yaṃ gacchati, bhūmiṃ gacchati' ityādiḥ |
kavīnāṃ vā'rthaviśeṣavarṇanāt yathā- nīlotpalavane- cchvacca carantatsārasāḥ |
ityādiḥ, sa lākṣaṇika iti hi bhavatāṃ samayaḥ |
nahi bhūmipaśabdasya kāryānvitasvārthānabhidhāyitvāt ākāṅkṣādiyaśālinā'pi gacchatyarthānvitaḥ svārtho'- bhidheyaḥ, tathā gacchaterapi tadanvitaḥ anabhidheya eveti na padanimittānvayapratītirbhavate |
tenāvaśyaṃ padasāritanimitta- bhūtārtharūpāpyamaya ākāṅkṣāyogyatvaikavākyalasanābhyāṃ iyamanvitasaṃvittidamāsādyate ityākamenāpyanujñātavyam |
yathā siddhārtheṣu na padanimittā vākyārthasaṃvit, tathā padārthanimittā'pi na bhavati, kintvanumānanimittā |
sā ca svakāraṇabhūtaṃ viśeṣavijñānaṃ, tena ca viṣayabhūtāyāṃ- numānasiddhau na sarvapadārthānāmanvitapratipādanasāmarthya-
gāmānayetyādiṣvapi tadu- ktyaiva nītyā anumānaparaṃparayā viśiṣṭakāryāvagatisiddherna padānāpi anvitābhidhāyitvaṃ sukalpyam |
viśiṣṭārthaviṣayavyavahāradarśanena hi vyavaharamāṇasya tad- payameva vijñānamupacamityavaśyamaṅgīkartavyam |
na ca tadvā- kyamātrāt sidhyati, kiṃtu viśiṣṭavākyāvagamāt |
viśiṣṭavākyārthapratipāda- kena hi vākyena tadviṣayavivakṣāṃ vakturanumāya tato viśi- ṣṭārthaviṣayavijñānānumānadvārā'rthaviśeṣamavagamya prayojyavṛddho viśiṣṭārthavyavahārya ghaṭate nānyathā |
siddhārthebhyo'pi hi vākyebhyaḥ pārthivo gaccha- tītyādibhyo rājagamanādirūpaviśiṣṭārthaviṣayameva vijñāna- mupajāyate, tacca vakturviśiṣṭajñānānumānāt |
vākyasya ca viśeṣasta- darthapratipādakatayā syāt nānyathā |
tatra ca padānāṃ kāryā- nvitasvārthābhidhāyitāmādṛśaṃ sāmarthyābhāvāt padārtha- dvāreṇa viśiṣṭārthapratipādakatvamabhyupetavyam |
yadyucyeta nāvaśyamanvitapratipādakanaiva vākyena tadviṣayavijñānānu- mānaṃ, arthaviśeṣasmārakapadasaṃgrahātaviśeṣavādye viśiṣṭā- numānalambhāt |
tathā hi īdṛśī vyāptirsaṃvit 'yo yeṣāṃ padārthānāmitaretarānvayayogyānāṃ pratipādakāni padānātaḥ samuccārayati, tasya teṣāmanyonye jñānamasti' iti |
evaṃ ca antareṇāpi padārthānāmanvitapratipādakatvaṃ padaviśeṣaracana- yaiva jñānānumānadvāreṇa siddhārtheṣu viśiṣṭakāryārthānumāna- saṃbhavāt na padārthanimittatvaṃ vākyasya sidhyatīti |
gāmānayetyādivākyebhyapi padānāṃ padārthasvarūpamādhāya- katvenāpi viśiṣṭajñānānumānaparaḥsaraṃ viśiṣṭavākyā- rthānumānasaṃbhavāccānvitābhidhāyitvaṃ sidhyet |

vinā'pya- nvitābhidhāyitvaṃ svarūpamādhāyakatvamātrāpi yeṣāṃ padārtha- svarūpāṇāmanyonyayogyānāmanabhidhāyakāni padāni yenāteno- cāritāni, sa tadanyavita' itīdṛśasyaiva vyāpyā viśiṣṭa- jñānānumānasaṃbhavāt |
kiṃca svarūpamātramapi nāmidheyaṃ, padaviśeṣasyaiva vācakatvavat viśiṣṭārthaviṣayeṇa viśānena vyāptigrahaṇasaṃbhavāt |
