yathā hi vācakatvaṃ pratipadamartha- viśeṣaṃ prati gṛhyate goparda sāsnādimato vācakaṃ aśvapadaṃ vājivācaka miti, tathā tadanvitārthaviṣayavijñānavyāptiḥ tasyatasya padasya grahītuṃ śakyate 'āsasya goparda- racanā ākāṅkṣitasahitayogyārthāntarānvitasāsnādi- madvijñānapūrvikā' iti |
tataśca padānāṃ arthasvarūpa- vācitvamapi naiva prasidhyati |
syādetat, śabdaśravaṇasamanantarabhāvinīṃ prayojya- vṛddhasya ceṣṭāmupalabhya viśiṣṭārthaviṣayā pratītistasya kalpyate |

sā ca śabdāntaryāt tatkāraṇātkathaiveti śabdasya tadvācakatāśaktiḥ kalpyate, paścāttu kasya cit aya- tārthadaracanamupalabhya kathaṃ vyabhicāriṇo vākyāt prayojyavṛddhasyārthaniścayaḥ saṃjāta iti vicintyasya eva- mavadhārayati, 'nūmanenaivāyaṃ vattaivamavadhāritaḥ, nāyama- nvitāni padāni gṛhyante, tena nūnametenaivāpāmanyo śātaḥ iti jñānānumānaparaḥsamarthyaṃ niścitavān' iti kalpayati |
pūrvagataṃ tu vācakatvaṃ na mithyā manyate, tatsādita vācakatvamiti |
syāttu tajja- nyātā'nterbhrāntiḥ sā ca nivartyeti |
nahi prayojyavṛddhasya śabdāntarabhāvinī pratipattiḥ śabdajanyā yattasya śaktiṃ kalpyayet, śabdānumitavaktṛjñānaliṅga- janyatvāt |

yadyapi ca tasyāmavasthāyā- manvayajñānavadāraṇācchabdāntaryācchabdajanyatvaṃ bhrāntyā avagamya śabdasya śaktirdhrāntyā avagamyate, tathāpi paścā- datajjanyatvamavagamya tajjanyatvabhrānto nivṛttāyāṃ tanni- mittā śaktirbhrāntirvā nivartyate eveti dhūmāyamāna- dhūmamahipajanitadhūmadhvajavijñānavat |
tathā śabdasyāpi vāca- katvakalpanā kāryasyātajjanyatvāvadhāraṇāt nivartitumarhati |
śaktatvādanuvāda- katvamiti cet, taditaretarāśrayaṃ śakteranuvādakatvata śaktiriti |
bhidhāyi padaṃ, na vyatiṣaṅgabhidhāyi, vyatiṣaktaḥ ava- |
vyaktei anvayamantareṇa padārthasvarūpamani rūpyaṃ, yena tada- |
dasau nāntareṇa vyaktiṃ pratītimāroḍhuṃ kṣamate, rūpaṃ hi sā |
na ca rūpiṇūnyā rūpe buddhirasti, yadi syāt |
cidapi vyaktivikala avagatā, tathā padārthā api na |
tatkasya hetoḥ ? 1 śabdo hi svaśaktyā jāti- |
na tu śabdena prathamamavagatā ākṛtiḥ paścāccākṛ- |
vabodhayamānaḥ padārthanimittaka ityucyate, bhāṣye ca padārtha- |
nāpi anvitābhidhāyitvaṃ pratyayasya nocyate, kiṃ tarhi ? |
pratyayasya ca svecchayai, anurāgāṃśe ca prakṛtipratyaya- |
na vidanti ye samamaṃ kṛpayā tadanugrahaḥ kriyate |
tatra kāryārthavādinaḥ eva bhāvaṃ bhāvanāma- pūrve ca vākyārthān pratijānīte |
tasya mūlaṃ padanāmapi tathāvidhāvityeti tāmeva tāvadadau pariśodhayati |

atra ye pratyakṣamitapada- vibhāgaṃ vākyameva vākyārthasya vākyamityācakṣate, ye ca vākyānvayavarṇāḥ eteti, ye ca padairabhihitāḥ padārthāḥ parasparānvayaṃ ātmano'vagamayanti iti, tannirāsāya pratijānīte- 'padebhya eva vākyārthapratyayo jāyate yathā |
' padebhya eva vākyāt, nāpyanvayavarṇāt, nāpi padārthebhyaḥ ityarthaḥ |
svārthārthe bodhitā buddhau vākyārtho'pi tathā sati |
' vākyārthapratīti hi padānāmanupāyatve tadanyathā'nupapattyā vākyamekaṃ tadupāyabhūtaṃ kalpyate |

yadyapi vyutpannapekṣāt śabdāthoṃ nāvagamyate, yadyapi cānvayāta vākyānāṃ tadīnāṃ ca vaidikasya kāryasya nityopāyatvāt vyutpattiratrākhyā, tathāpi kāpya- nikapadapadārthavyutpattisaṃskṛtāt vākyāt vākyamavagaccha- tītyāśrīyate |
yadi vā kālpanikatve padapadārthānāṃ pramāṇa- bhāvādekaikavarṇāccāraṇe arthānavabodhāt kramoccāritānāṃ ca yugapacchravaṇāsaṃbhavāt pūrvavarṇajanitasaṃskārasahito'nyo varṇaḥ pratyakṣaḥ |
tasya ca pāramārthikapadapadārthavyutpattiḥ sahakāriṇīti pakṣaḥ svīkriyate, yadi vā padaiḥ sukara- vyutpattayaḥ ananvitāḥ eva svārthā abhihitā vākyārthamava- bodhayantītyaṅgīkriyate |
yadi tu padānyeva anvitān svārthānabhidadhatīti śakyate sādhayituṃ, tadā vākyārthasyā- vabuddhatvāt naitāḥ kalpanā ātmānaṃ labhante |
kathaṃ punaḥ padānāmanitasvārthamātropadhatve vākyārthāvagatiḥ sidhyati- tyāha- 'pradhānaguṇābhāvena lacchānvayo'nvayaḥ |
' nanu teṣāṃ bhūyastvāt bhūyāṃso vākyārthā vākyāni ca syuḥri- tyāha- 'bhūyāṃso yadyapi svārthāḥ padānāṃ te pṛthak- pṛthak |
' yadi pradhānabhūtaṃ tadeva kathaṃ nāma viśiṣṭaṃ pratīyate ityevamarthe guṇānāṃ pratipādanam |
tātparyaviṣaye eva śabdasya prāmāṇyabhyupagamāt, tasya tathābhūtasya prati- pattirnaikapadanibandheneti vākyameva tatra pramāṇam |
ata eva ca ṣaṣṭhyā 'naṃ padaṃ nāma kiṃ cana vākye, na padārthā nāma ke cana vākyārthe' ityu- ktam |
pṛthagbhūtaṃ padaṃ nāma na kiṃ cana pramāṇamasti, pṛthagbhūtāḥ padārthāḥ na prameyāḥ santītyarthaḥ |
saṃprati vākyameva vācakaṃ vākyārtha- syeti ye bruvate, ye ca vākyānvayavarṇa evaiti, tannirā- karaṇāyāha-'vyavahāreṣu vṛddhānāṃ vākyaśravaṇabhāviṣu |
' yadyapi vṛddhavyavahārapūrvakaiva sarvā vyutpattiḥ; vākyaireva ca vyava- hāraḥ, tathāpi yadāvāpe yasyārthabhāgasyāpaḥ yaduddhāre coddhāraḥ, tannireṇaivārthe tasyaiva vācakatvakriyate |
na ca tathā vākyārthapratipattirnopapadyate, vakṣyamāṇatvāt nyāyasya |
yena kāryatvena vākyamekaṃ pratyakṣaparidamānavarṇamedāpa- havena kalpyeta |

kiṃca 'śiśo gāmānaya' 'śiśo gāṃ vadhāna' 'bālaka gāmānaya' 'bālaka gāṃ vadhāna' 'arbhaka gāmānaya' 'arbhaka gāṃ vadhāna' 'ḍimbha gāmānaya' 'ḍimbha gāṃ vadhāna' ityeṣāṃ vākyānāmaṣṭau vācakatvasya kalpyāḥ |
padavā- dinastu satānāṃ vākyānāṃ sapta śaktayaḥ iti |
anayaiva diśā śuklāmitipadapakṣe vākyavādinaḥ aṣṭāvaparāḥ kalpyāḥ |
apāramārthike ca padavibhāge kimāśritā vyutpattirabhyupāyamupaitīti cintanīyam |
ye puna- vākyānvayavarṇasya vācakatāmāhuḥ, tanmate'pi yāvatpada- padārthavibhāgasya pāramārthikatvāt ghaṭataiva vyutpattiḥ |
na ca vākyānyavarṇavācakatvavādināṃ padaṃ padārthasya vācakam |
vākyāddhi yadaprayoge anvite sati yadapārthānvito vākyārtheḥ
pratīyate, tat padaṃ tasyārthasyāvācakameva bhavati nimittam |
ye'pyāhuḥ vākyameva smṛtyārūḍhaṃ vākyārthaṃ pratipādayatīti, teṣāmapi prācya- kalpanāgauravadṛṣṭamaśakyaparamparam |
bhāṣyakāravacanaṃ ca 'pūrvavarṇajanitasaṃskārasahito'nyo varṇaḥ pratyayākaḥ' ( 1|1|5 pṛ. 46 ) iti nirviṣayam |
atra ke ciccodayanti-nanu vṛddhavyavahāraprayukte vākye padānāṃ vācakatvavadhāraṇameva nopapadyate, puruṣavākyā- nāmarthe prati liṅgābhāvena pramāṇatvamapyupamāta |
vākyāddhi kāryabhūtāt prayatnistasya vaktustadarthaviṣayaṃ pūrvavijñānaṃ kāraṇabhūtamanumīyate |
tasya ca śaṃsya jñeyāvyabhicāri- tvāt śeṣabhūtārthaniḥśrayaḥ, iti na vācakatvakalpanām |
na nūnaṃ bhavān nītipathoktamarthaṃ (nītipathākhya- prakaraṇaṃ) samyagāphalyati |
bālo hi vyutpadyamānaḥ prayojyavṛddhasya śabdaśravaṇasamantarabhāvinīṃ viśiṣṭaceṣṭāmitāmarthapratītiṃ śabdakāraṇātmakavagacchati |
sa tathā vyutpannaḥ kadā cit kasya cidanvitārthapadavacanaṃ vākyamalpabhate |
tathopalabhamānasya caiṣa vimarśo jāyate, 'saṃbhāvyamānānvitārthapadavacanamidaṃ vākyaṃ kathaṃ vṛddhasvā- 'rthaniścayaṃ kṛtavat |
vṛddhasyāpi puruṣāyate vākye an- vitāthapadavacanaśaṅkā mameva saṃbhavati' iti |

tatyaivaṃ vicikitsodaye punareṣa niścayo jāyate 'nūmamanenāyaṃ prayoktā itthamavadhāritaḥ anvitārthānvaye padānyayaṃ prayuṅkte iti tathāvidhapadaprayoganiyamasyāsyānupalabdhe'nye nopapadyate' ityevamanyavopalabhyaṃ anumānatenānanyo niśrīyate, niścite cānye vākyametada- nuvādabhūtametyeti |

evaṃ cedanuvādakatā tasyārthasya tadvākyaṃ vākyameveti pūrvavācakaśaktijñānaṃ, nāyathārtha- miti manyate, yadi paraṃ mayā prāganumānapuraḥsaro'tha- niścayo'steti nāvagataṃ, yā'pi ceyamasyāniḥśrite anvaye viśiṣṭavaktṛjñānānumā, sā'pi padānāṃ svarūpa- mātrāvagamādeva nopapadyate, kiṃtu viśeṣāvagamāt |
tato mayeva ane- nāpi amīṣāṃ padānāṃ vācakatvāttvaritā, tena viśi- ṣṭānvayavācakapadaprayogatvāt tadviṣayaṃ vaktuḥ pūrvajñānamanumita- vān |
atra ke cidācakṣate- bhavatu padānāṃ padārtheṣu śaktijñānaṃ, tathāpyanvitābhidhānaṃ na sidhyatīti |
tathāhi, pratiyogināmanantatayā anvayānanyāt, tadānanye cānvi- tānāmapyānanyāt saṃbandhagrahaṇaṃ duṣkaram |
agṛhīta- saṃbandhasya ca padasya na vācakatva, ekasācchabdāt sarvā- rthapratītiprasaṅgāt |
sāmānyānyābhivānaṃ ca nāśakya- nīyameva, vākyebhyo viśeṣānvayāvagamanāt |
svarūpamātrā- bhidhānepi ca vākyārthapratītiḥ anvitābhidhānaśrayaṇe śaktikalpanāgauravāt |
tathā padena anvitasvārtho'bhi- dhīyamānaḥ kimabhihitena padārthāntareṇa anvito'bhi- dhīyate ? uttānabhihiteneti vikalpanīyam |
anabhihitena cet padārthāntaraprayogavaiyarthyaṃ, ekasmāt padārthāt sarvārthapratītiprasaṅgaḥ |
abhihitena cet, tadapi tarhi padaṃ anvitābhidhāyitayā padārthāntaramathyābhidhāna- pekṣate, itītaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti |
te ca tathābhūtāḥ padairarthā abhihitā ākāṅkṣāsaṃnidhi- yogyatāvato vākyārthamavagamayanti |

tadāha bhāṣyakāraḥ- 'padāni hi svasvamarthamabhidhāya nivṛttavyāpārāṇi, athedānīṃ padārthāḥ abhihitāḥ santo vākyārthamavagamayanti' ( 1|1|25 pṛ. 96 ) iti, tadetannirākartumupakramate- 'opyante codyamite ca svārthā ananyaśālinaḥ |
tathāhi, paderanvito'bhihito- 'rthaḥ : anvitapratipatternimittaṃ bhavatīti padānāṃ pāraṃparyeṇa- nviteṣvapi hetutvam |
tadāhurvārtikakārapādāḥ- 'na vimudyati sāmarthyaṃ vākyārtho'pi padāni naḥ |
dhikaraṇe ślovā. 229 ) padārthapratipādanaṃ ca vākyā- rthapratipattaye yuktānāṃ padānamāntaravyāpāraḥ, iti ca teṣāmeva vyavahāraḥ 'vākyārthamitye teṣāṃ prayuktaṃ nāntarīya kam |
etāmā śaṅkāmape kṣaiva tāvat doṣāntaraṃ pariharati- 'ā- kāṅkṣāsannidhiprāptiyogyārthāntarasaṃgatān |
svārtha- nāhuḥ padānitī vyutpattiḥ saṃśritā mayā ||
āna- nyavyabhicārābhyāṃ tathā doṣo na kaścana ||
' yattā- vaduktaṃ, ānanyācchabdasyatvadhāraṇānupapattiḥ, ayahīta- śakteśca vācakatve vyabhicāraprasaṅga iti |
ākāṅ- kṣitena yogthena saṃnihitena cānvitaṃ svārthaṃ padaṃ vakti iti vyutpattirādhīyate |
tau yathauktau ākāṅkṣāsaṃnidhī prātamākāṅkṣitaṃ saṃnihitaṃ yogyaṃ ca yat padārthāntaraṃ, tena saṃgatamityarthaḥ |
kiṃ punaridaṃ yogyaṃ nāma ? yat saṃbandhārhatvam |
lakṣaṇyavona hi ka cit svārthasya tyāgaḥ saṃgrahaḥ vā |
'sṛṣṭīpadhati' iti lakṣaṇasyāpi svīkāraḥ guṇināṃ lakṣmyamāṇatvāt tadanta- rgatatvācca suṣṭyarthasya |
tathā 'paurṇamāsī yajate' ityeka- vacanānupattyā paurṇamāsīśabdo yāgavacano yāgasamu- dāyalakṣaṇārthaḥ |
na ca samudāyaparigrahe samudāyātyāgaḥ, tadāśrayatvāt tasya |
tathā niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇapūrvapakṣe ṣaṣṭhyarthalakṣaṇā syādityucyate, na tatra prakṛtyarthasya tyāgo- 'pyāpadyate |
tathā medhamityekavacanāntasya gaṇalakṣaṇayā mantrasya prakṛtau niveśaḥ |
na ca gaṇīno'pīmayoyoratra hānamiti sarvā- rthopaparityāge'pi yuktaiva lakṣaṇā |
'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādi śrautasya gaṅgā''desya vākyārthe'nvayāsaṃbhavāt taṃ pari- tyajya tatsaṃbandhāt labdhabuddhisaṃnidheḥ kūlasya vākyārthā- nvayitā adhyavasīyate |
ata evāhaḥ- 'anupapatyā saṃbandhena ca lakṣaṇā bhavati' iti |
iha ca gāmānaye- tyādau na śrautasyārthasyānyayogatvaṃ, nāpi anvitā- vasthayānanyasaṃbandhādvā, anvitārthasyānyāntarāsaṃbha- vāt |
atha mā bhūdeṣā lakṣaṇā, kiṃtu kriyā avagata kārakakathanīyātmano daśāmavagamayati avinābhāvā- diti |
śabdatvaṃ tāvadityamabhūtamanyayāva- gamasya, kiṃtu sāmānyatodṛṣṭamānumanagocaratvā abhyupagatā bhavati |
atha viśeṣānvayaṃ vinā vyavahārānavakalpa- nādanarthakaṃ śabdoccāraṇamiti tadāśrayaṇaṃ, evamapi prekṣā- pūrvakāriṇāṃ svārthavākyamātraprayogiṇāṃ vacanāt viśeṣā- nvāvagamaḥ |
vede tvānvayatvena na bhavitavyamiti pramāṇā- bhāvāt śakyate viśeṣo'vagantum |
na ca loke'pyā- narthakyamāpadyate ityetāvatā kāraṇena upāyādināpi viśe- ṣānvayādhyavasānaṃ yuktam |
nahi dagdhukāmatya udakopādāna- manarthakamiti jalasya dāhaśaktitrāvirbhavati |
kāmamāna- rthakyaṃ, na punaḥ sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya viśeṣānvayāti |
atha ākāṅkṣitasaṃbandhahitayogyānvayaparatā vṛddhavyavahāre padā- nāmavagateti vyutpatyanusāreṇa viśeṣānvayāvagamaḥ |
tatra vṛddhavyavahāre eva tatparatā padānāṃ vā padārthānāṃ vā upāyabhāvena kathaṃ nāma nirvahati |
cintā sā hi padānāṃ vā padārthānāṃ vā śaktikalpanāṃ vinā anupapanneti manyāmaha |
tena teṣāmabhidhānaśaktiḥ saṃpratipannaiveti tasyā evānvaya- paryantatā kalpayituṃ sukarā |
tena dharmakalpanāto varaṃ dharmakalpanā ityanvitā- bhidhānaśaktiḥ padānāmeva kalpayitumucitā |

kiṃca padāni abhidhāyakānītyante, tatra yadi svarūpāmātraviṣayā- meva padārthabuddhimādadhyuḥ, tadā'pyabhidhāyakatā hīyeta, tasyā buddheḥ saṃvandhagrahaṇasamayātpadārthabodhakasaṃskāronnepa- prabhavatvāt |
tasāt saṃvandhagrahaṇasamayānadhigatānvitārthapratipādanābhyupagame eva śabdānāmabhidhāyakateti tāmaṅgīkurvatā padānāmanvitābhi- dhāyakatā āśraṇīyā |
yastu 'padamamyadhikābhāvāt smārakānna viśiṣyate iti, tadā bhāvanāvanastatāvat tāṃ sārayati |
lokavaditi ca ācāryavacanadarśanāt smārakatvāmeva padānāmabhidhāyakatvamāha' taṃ pratyāha |
yenāpi vādinā padānāṃ smārakatvameva padārtheṣvaṅgīkaraṇīya, so'pi vākyārthapratipattiparatāṃ padā- nāmabhyupetavye, anyathā vākyārthasyāśābdatvaprasaṅgāt |
evaṃ cet padānāmeva sākṣādvākyārthabodhanaśaktirastu, kiṃ para- sparāśrayaprasaṅgāt |
tena padārtheṣu padānāṃ smārakatvātiriktaṃ ye'bhidhāyakatvamāhuḥ, teṣāṃ śaktinyakalpanā |
padānāmidhāyakaśaktiḥ, aparā ca padārthagatā anvayo- ghanaśaktyādhānaśaktiḥ, padārthānāṃ cānvayajñāpanaśaktiriti |
smārakatvavādinastvabhidhānaśaktiṃ hitvā śaktikalpanāyā- vāduktanaiva nyāyena padānāmeva śaktikalpanā nyāyyā |
saṃprati pūrvoktamitaretarāśrayadoṣaṃ parihartuṃ yathā padebhyo vākyārthapratipattistathā darśayati- 'padajātaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ smāritānvitārthatvakam ||
' yastāvadagṛhītasaṃbandhaḥ, yasya ca saṃvandhagrahaṇasaṃskāro notpannaḥ dhvasto vā, sa vākyārthaprati- pattau nādhikriyate |
yastvanyavagrahasaṃvaraṇasaṃskāraḥ, sa padaṃ śrutvā tāvadidaṃ sarati, idamitamasyākāṅkṣita- saṃnihitayogyapratiyogyanvitasya vācakamiti |
evaṃ ca smaratā smṛtameva ananvitamapi svarūpamavyabhāñjam |
abhi- hitānvayavādino'pi hi yāvat padāntaramathāntaraṃ nopasthā- payati, tāvadanvayavagama nāsti, padārthasyānyatrāvabodhinaḥ padārthāntarāpekṣātvāt, pratiyogisāpekṣatvādanvayasya |
paścāt tasyaiḥ sarvaiḥ smṛtārūḍhaibhyo vākyārthapratipatti- raṅgīkaraṇīyā |
tadāhurhṛtikārapādāḥ- 'te'pi naivāsmṛtā yasmād vākyārthaṃ gamayanti naḥ |
ata eva tatrabhavata ācāryasya vākyalakṣaṇaṃ 'saṃhatya arthamabhidadhati padāni vākyaṃ' iti |
śrayamāṇena hi padena yo'rtho nāva- bodhitaḥ, sa kathamantarhitaṃ tasminbhavati |

abhihitānvayavādino'pi nāyaṃ niyamaḥ, śrūya- māṇa eva pūrvavarṇajanitasaṃskārasahito'nyo varṇaḥ padārtha- pratipādaka iti, bālyadaśā''dhītatvāt prāganavadhṛtāt akṣaraparijñānasaṃskārāt paścāt smṛtādapi vedārthamadarśa- nāt |
śraya- māṇena hi padena pratiyogisādṛśyalanvitābhidhānasya prāk sahakārivirahādarthaṃ nābhitaḥ |
meva padamanvitābhidhāyakamsta, itarāṇi ca padāni prati- yogisaṃnidhāpanamātre vyāpriyantāṃ, na vā gṛhyamāṇa- viśeṣatā, prāthamyena pradhānapadatvena vā viśeṣagrahaṇāt |
ata evāhuḥ, 'pradhānaṃ padaṃ vākyaṃ' 'ādyaṃ padaṃ vākyaṃ' iti, tān pratyāha |
prathamasyaiva syāt vākyā, yadi sarvapadārthānāṃ prathamapadārthānvitā syāt |
na cāyaṃ niyamaḥ, 'aruṇyaikahāyanyā piṅgākṣyā somaṃ krīṇāti' iti krayamātrānvayitvādādavasya |
kiṃca vākye padānāmānupūrvyaniyamābhāvāt kadā cit tadeva prathamaṃ sannanvitābhidhāyakaṃ, anyathā neti na yuktam |
yadyapyaruṇādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ somaṃ prati aidamarthyamasti, tathāpyasmin vākye kraye evāruṇādīnā- maidamarthyaṃ kriyākārakabhāvena cānvayaḥ, krayadvāreṇa tu somaṃ prati aidamarthyamātram |
atha yadyatipradhānapadaṃ vākyaṃ, tat pradhānamityucyate, iha tu krayaḥ eva sarvakarmakaraṇāna- cchihnaḥ pratipādyate |
tena krīṇātītyeva pradhānaṃ padaṃ, tada- nvayitā ca sarvapadamaṇādīnāmiti |
vākyasya yat tāvat tātparyaṃ, tatra vyavasthitam |
ka cidākhyātaparatvameva 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' iti, ka cit guṇaviparla 'dadhnā juhoti' iti |
tena pradhāna- padasyāpi sarveṣāṃ padānāṃ saṃbhavāt sarvemeva padānāma- nvitābhidhānaśaktiśravaṇīya |
dvau etāvarthau, yadānayanānvitaṃ golaṃ, gavānvitaṃ cāyanamiti |
nyāyasaṃpāditavyakti iti kimadaṃ, yāvannyāyena vacanavyaktiḥ saṃpādyate, tāvat padajātaṃ vākyārthasyāvabodhakaṃ na bhavati |
vyavahārānupapattirbhāṣye'rthavat 'idaṃ vidheyamidamanvayaṃ, idaṃ pradhānamidaṃ guṇabhūtaṃ, idaṃ vivakṣitamidamavivakṣitaṃ' ityādi na saṃpradhāryate, tāvanna ka ciddevavākyārthamava- budhyate|
taduktaṃ vārtikakārapādeḥ 'tāvadeva hi saṃdehaṃ vedavākye śrute bhavet|
ata eva mīmāṃsāyāṃ vedavākyapratipatti itikartavyatā- tvam|
taduktaṃ tairaiva 'dharmaṃ pramīyamāṇe hi vedena karaṇā- tmanā|
adṛṣṭapūrveṣu smṛtyādivākyeṣu loke'pi nānāvidhavivādyothānāt kuto drāgevārthaniścayaḥ|
api ca kāraṇābhāvenāpi lokasyāya viveko nāsti|
yadyedaṃ sarvapadānāmananvitābhidhāyitvamucyate, tat sarveṣu śrautārtheṣu padeṣu|
lakṣaṇikārthānyathāpadopamege tu yadeva śrautārthe padaṃ tadevā''nvitābhidhāyakam|
atra vācakatvānavadhāraṇāt svārtha- syāpi tat tadānīmavācakaṃ, anvayā''yogatvāt|
kiṃtu tadarthena smṛtena yat svasaṃbandhi sadṛśaṃ vā svayamanvaya- yogyamupasthāpyate, tenānvitaṃ śrautārthameva padaṃ svārthamabhi- dhatte iti darśanarahasyamidam|
na ca sarvapadānyeva lakṣa- ṇikāni gauṇāni vā vākye saṃbhavantīti niravadyam|
iti ca yaduktaṃ tacchabdopasthāpitāṃ darśayituṃ gauṇamabhihitalakṣaṇam|
kathaṃ punaranvitābhidhāyinā padena svarūpamātreṇa smārayituṃ śakyamityāha - 'anvitasyābhidhāne'pi svarūpaṃ vidyate|
' na hi yat pramāṇaṃ tat smaraṇakāraṇameva, pramāṇaṃ tat|
yasya tu yena saha kadā cit pratyāsattiḥ pratītapūrvā, sā tatra saṃskārādoṣa- dvāreṇa śabdotye smṛtiṃ janayitum|
asti ca svarūpa- syāpi tadabhidheyāntargāthā śabdena pratyāsattiḥ śaknoti tatrāpi śabdasmṛtiṃ janayitumarthavat|
yathā nirvikalpaka- daśāpratītārthasvarūpamātraṃ anabhidheyamapi śabdaṃ smārayati, tathā śabdo''pyardhamiti kimanupapannaṃ, etena padocārā- nantarā padārthasvarūpapratītiḥ pradarśitā|
abhihitānanvaya- vādine'pi sā na pramāṇaṃ, abhyādhikārthaparicchedā- bhāvāt, anadhigatārthatvaṃ pramāṇamiti siddhāntābhyupa- gamāt|
taduktam - 'sarvasyā''nupalavdhe'rthe prāmāṇyaṃ smṛtiranvayā' ( ślo. vā. pratyakṣasūtre 11) iti|
yadi punaḥ smṛtireṣā nābhyupayeta, tadā pramāṇasmṛtisaṃśaya- viparyayebhyaḥ pratipatyantarānabhyupagamāt padāt svapadārtha- pratītiḥ kāntarbhāṣyatāmiti vācyam|
' svārthasvarūpamātrasmaraṇe hi na padaṃ padānta- ramepekṣate|

atra kaścidāha - yadi smṛtisaṃnihitamāśritya anvitābhidhānaṃ padaiḥ kriyate, tadā saraṇasya pratyāsatti- nibandhanavādanekeṣāṃ cārthānāṃ pratyāsattisaṃbhavāt teṣu smṛtisaṃnihiteṣu agryamānāviśeṣatvāt 'avāyāṃ pacati' iti novā pacyamānārthānvitaiva kevalā''bhidhīyeta|
sā ca hi nirvāpādyanvitā'pi pratipadyeveti smaraṇāt tadanvitā''pyuktā''bhidhīyeta|
padāt tāvat padārthasyapratītiḥ: smaraṇāt bhinnā vadituṃ na śakyate, tena smṛgatāmevā- nvayabodhakatvamityāśrayaṇam|
aya śabdaḥ: smāritānāmanvayabodhakatvāt vṛddhavyavahāre tathā darśanādadoṣaḥ, matānantare'pi tulyametat|
na cāyamekāntaḥ, vṛddhavyavahāre adhyāhatenāpyardhena anvitā- bhidhānadarśanādityukam|
atha śabdārthe'vo'rthaḥ: svārthante, kiṃtu teṣāṃ katamenānanvayabodhakatvamiti, abhihitānanvayavāde tu abhihitānanvayabodhakatvaṃ yuktameveti|
smārakatvātirekiṇī kā anyā abhidhāyakatā, yā vyavasthāpanavacanam|
pratyāyakatā hi vācyavācakatā, sā ca yadyapi abhidhayādīnāṃ saṃbandhantarāpūrikā dṛṣṭā, tathāpi śabde tathā nāśrīyete|
evaṃ smārakalavā- gamādeva smārakalamiti, kiṃ pratyāsattantarāśrayaṇena|
api ca anvitārthavādina evedaṃ pratiniyatatvānnatyupapadyate, yat padārthāntarānvitābhidhāyakatayā smāryate|
yatrāpyavyavahāraḥ, tatrāpi saṃnidhāpakvaśena viśeṣānvitābhidhānalābha iti lokata eva jñātamiti na kaścid doṣaḥ|
jñātaṃ tāvadetad, yattena padenānvito vākyārthaḥ: iti|
yadyanenāpi anvitābhidhānaṃ syāt, tadā vākyabhedo bhavet|
ata eva yathākathaṃcidekavākyatvopapattau vākyabhedasyānvāyatvāt loke lakṣaṇā gauṇī ca vṛttirvākyamedādeva|
anyathā vākyaṃ bhitvā kimivyākhyātva yogyamarthāntaraṃ sarvapadānyeva mukhyā- rthāni nāśrīyante|
vede'pi ekavākyatvalādevā''rthavādeṣu guṇavādāśrayaṇaṃ vimaktivyatyayavarṇanaṃ, audumbarādhikaraṇe vā kathaṃ cit paśuvācakatvaṃ, citrā''dhikaraṇe rūḍhiparityāgena
'paśvadaśānyāyāni bhavanti' itivat kathaṃ citrā''medhayatvā- śrayaṇaṃ, vājapeyādhikaraṇe ca vākyabhedameva nāmadheyatvā- śrayaṇaṃ, paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe cānekaguṇavidhāne vākyabhedā- patteḥ|

samudāyānuvādakalasiddhiḥ, prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇe ca vākyabhedadopādevābhidheyapadasya gauṇatvavarṇanaṃ, grahādhi- karaṇe caikavākyatvāvivakṣitatvaṃ, 'ardhamantarvedi minotyardhaṃ bahirvedi' ityatra deśalakṣaṇaṇāvat, kṣaumādhikaraṇe ca puṃḍryavidhānaṃ, ārthādhikaraṇe ca cobhayapadasyāvivakṣā, vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣaiścaitraya nirapekṣalakṣaṇāyaiḥ; paryudāsādhi- karaṇe ca nañarthasya lākṣaṇikatvaṃ ityādi bahutaraṃ dṛśyate|
tatra yadi adhyāhiyamāṇasya padasyābhidheya parityajyā- nyena sahāyanvo lakṣyate, tadāpyekavākyataiva hīyeta|
vṛddhavyavahārotpattinyantāyāṃ śabdā''rthāvagatau ye nyāyā vṛddhavyavahāre vākyārthāvagatihetavayā viditāḥ, tānaparijahatā vākyārthā coddhavyāḥ iti sarvaśāstramevā- paryesītāmanavakāśaḥ|
bhavatu tarhi padārthāntareṇa tāva- danvitābhidhānaṃ ekavākyatvabalāt|
tatsmāritena svayaṃ smāritane ca tadekavākyatvānuguṇenārthāntareṇāpi kimi- tyanvitābhidhānaṃ na bhavati|
atha nopaśāntā ākā- ṅkṣā, tarhi ko nāma tatrānvitābhidhānaṃ vārayet|
ata evaikapadoccāraṇe tadarthasaṃbandhamulena bahuṣyāpi smṛtisaṃnihi- teṣu yasyārthasya kena cit prakāreṇa viśeṣo gṛhyate, tenai- vānvitābhidhānam|
ata eva vikṛtiṣu tattādṛśena yaduparye smṛtiśarmāṃ syopākāraṃ smārayati, tadīyenaivopakāreṇa paripūraṇam|
ato yatra bahutadarthamasādhāraṇyaniyantraṇena sāhaśyamanyasyodyeta, tatraiva śīghraṃ smṛtimupapatteḥ: tadīyopakārakapariśrahaḥ eva|
yathā''vṛddhavyavahārāvagamaṃ vākyārthāvabodhaḥ, tatra yadeva padena anavagrahasaṃbandhagrahaṇasaṃbandhasya puruṣasya niyamena smārthyate, tenaivānvitābhidhānaṃ padāntarasya dṛśyate, nānyena|
svāthe hi sarve padaṃ niyamena saṃbandhasmartṛṇāṃ sārayati, nārthāntaram |
tataśca tenaiva padāntarasanvitasvārthabodhaka- teti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
kiṃca yadi abhihite'nvita- svārtho'nubhavāpyupagame pratiniyatasanvayayo'pyaghaṭe nānayathā, tarhi kalpyatāṃ padāntāmanvitābhidhānaśaktirapi |
dirami- dhānamevāpadyate iti cedāpadyatāṃ, na kaściddoṣaḥ |
pūrvai kevalaṃ padamanvitasvārthamabhidhatte, pratiyogipadāntāmi- hitavastvantaradvayāprāpyā tu tacchadanvitamarthamāha, iti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
itthamapi cāsannamate śakti kalpanālagha- masti padārthagatānvayabodhanaśaktyā sahaśakti kalpanāyāḥ |
tulyāyāmāpi śakti kalpanāyāṃ padānamevānvitabodhanaśakti- rāśrayitumucitaṃ, na padārthānāṃ prathamāvagatatvāt vākyārthe ca tātparyasyāvagatatvāditi |

“matvarthīyā api viśeṣamevābhidadhati, nahi teṣāṃ vācyāntaraṃ nirūpyate ‘hiraṇyamālina ṛtvijaḥ’ ityatra viśeṣaṇībhūtā hiraṇyamālā tāvat prakṛtyaivotktā, ṛtvijo'pi viśeṣyāḥ svaśabdena, matvap tu kimabhi- dadhyāt anyat viśiṣṭāt” iti|
tatraiva pade'pi anvi- tābhidhānaṃ na iti matadvayamuktam|

tatra hi kathaṃ tarhi bhāṣyakāreṇa (1|1|725 pṛ. 99) prātipa- dikāduccarantī dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ, ‘prātipadikānāṃ viśeṣaka ityāha’ iti pratyayasya anvitābhidhāyitva- cyate iti gurumatena śaṅkitvā dvedhā samāhitam|

‘bhavatpakṣe vā kathaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ anvitābhidhāyitve sati viśeṣeṇa pratyayasya tatra kathyate, tena granthānupaguṇāt śabdāntarāṇāṃ svarūpamātrābhidhāyitvaṃ, pratyayasya tu anvitābhidhāyitvaṃ iti vyavasthāpyam|

yadvā anenāpi anvitābhidhāyitvaṃ pratyayasya nocyate, kiṃ tarhi pratyayena svārtho'bhidhīyamānaḥ prathamagataprakṛtyarthastatra evāvagamyate iti tatrānyavyatirekābhyāṃ prakṛteḥ pratyayasya ca svasvārthe anurāgāṃśaṃ ca prakṛtipratyayasa- bhidhyāhārasyaiva padāntarasamabhidhyāhārasyaiva padārthānurāge nimittatvaṃ viviyate|
ataḥ anurāgāṃśasya samabhidhyā- rādeva pratītisiddheḥ na pratyayasya tatra śaktiḥ|
taduktaṃ śabde ‘prakṛtipratyayau brūtaḥ pratyayārthaṃ saheti yat|
na nityaṃ viśiṣṭa evārthe pratyayo yat pravartate|
ityevaṃ paratayā śabdāntarādhikaraṇa- (2|1|1|9)- siddhāntavārtikaṃ bhaṭṭasomeśvareṇa vyākhyātam|
yattu prakṛtipratyayoḥ svārthābhidhāne smetārācārāt nityaṃ vibha- kṣitakramatvena pūrvamyuktaprakṛtyarthyateṣu pratipattṛṣu pratyayāḥ saṃnipatantaḥ tatkṛtānubandhameva svārthaṃ vadanti, tasmāt na
yathoktaṃ ‘prātipadikā- duccarantī dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ prātipadikārtho viśeṣaka ityāha’ iti|
iti so'yaṃ subantatiṅantapadayoḥ uktaḥ prakāraḥ pācakādikadante'pyuktaḥ|
pākayuk: punaḥ kartā vācyo naikasya kasya cit|
ayameva prakāro devatātaddhite matvarthīyādāvapi ca saṃbhavati|
' ityādiḥ (śā.) svargakāmādhikaraṇadau miśrādīnāṃ pade śrutitvavyavahāro nānvitābhidhānanibandhanaḥ|
na ca viśeṣaṇābhidhānaṃ vinā kathaṃ viśiṣṭābhidhānaṃ iti vācyam|

nanu ‘yajeta paśunā’ ityādipadaṃ viśiṣṭābhidhānamātrāt ketu śrutiḥ, tataḥ samākhyāyā api tattulyāt śrutivāpattiḥ, tena tadadhi- karaṇe tasyāḥ śrutitvāśaṅkaya ‘pākaṃ tu pacirevāha’ iti harikārikopanyāsena anvayānabhidhānāt śrutibhāvābho- kitarayuktā|

yā tu itaḥ paraṃ tatra yuktitvaktā, ‘ayāpi samākhyāyā saṃbandhamabhidadhyāt tathāpi na sā tatra pramāṇaṃ’ iti, saiva ‘na śrutyādayaḥ pārārthyamabhidadhati iti brūmaḥ, kiṃ tarhi vidhisahitāḥ pārārthyaṃ bodhayanti’ (śā. 3|1|2) ityādi|
tena vidhyābhāvādapi na samākhyāyāḥ śrutitvaṃ iti samajhasaṃ sarvam|
‘anvenaṃ mātā manyatāṃ’ ityaśrigupaipe mātrā- diśabdaipratiṣedho'pi ‘na mātā vardhate na pitā’ ityādirūpa|
ko nāmāsi yasya te nāmāmanyahi yaṃ tvā somenātī- tṛpāma’ iti|
anveṣaṇarūpaḥ arthavādaḥ—‘iha vā sa iha saḥ’ iti|
‘apaḥ praṇayati’ iti prakṛtya śrūyate ‘munma- yena pratiṣṭhākāmasya’ iti|
idaṃ mṛnmayatvaṃ kāmyaṃ nitya- prayoge nānneti, kiṃtu ‘apaḥ praṇayati’ iti vidhānāt anyat kiṃ cit pātraṃ grāhyam|
‘camase- nāpaḥ praṇayet’ ityanena nityatvena vihitaścamasa eva nityaprayoge grāhyaḥ|
vi. 4|3|2, ‘apaḥ praṇayati’ ‘praṇītābhirhaviṣi saṃyauti’ ‘antarvedi praṇītā ninayāt’ atra praṇītānāmapāṃ haviḥsaṃyanameva prayojanaṃ, antarvedi ninayanaṃ tu pratipattiḥ|
praṇītānāṃ saṃyayanameva prayojakaṃ, ninayanaṃ na yojakam|
4|1|5, ‘apāṃ praṇayanaṃ ‘camasenāpaḥ praṇayet’ iti vihitamāśritya godohanaṃ vidhīyate|
na tu tadeva kāmyaṃ sat nityārthe'pi|
apāṃ yāgaḥ paśukāmeṣṭau satyāgataḥ: upāṃśu- yājasya vikṛtiḥ|
apāṃ vyustekasya darśapūrṇamāsasaṃvanaḥ prakaraṇā- nniśrito nāvabhṛthatvam|
apakarṣaḥ agnīṣomīye paśau prajātānāṃ jīvatveva paśau śrutaḥ|
vi. 5|1| 12, apakarṣaḥ agnīṣomīyapaśucchedyasya ‘dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti’ itivacanatvāt dinadvayāt pūrvasmin dīkṣā- kāle|
apakarṣaḥ abhiṣekena saha videdhanā- dīnāṃ rājasūye|
ṭup. 5|1|10|21, apakarṣaḥ abhi- pekasya rājasūye abhiṣecanīyāṅkabhūtamāhendrastotrakāle|
‘apa- kṛpyeta dvādaśepastatā asaṃyogān jyotiṣṭomena, ahī- nainākyavākyatvasya pratyakṣatvāt’|
bhā. 3|3|8|16, apakarṣaḥ bhakṣamantrasthānāṃ keṣāṃ cidvākyānāṃ bhakṣaṇavākyāt prāk ‘rūpopadeśābhyāmakaparbo bhavet keṣāṃ cidatra’|
apakarṣeḥ na abhīṣomapraṇayanādeḥ saumi- kasya, dīkṣāsu yūpakarmārpakaṣeḍapi|
apakarṣaḥ na amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvaidhurvederapakaṣeḍapi havi- rabhivānasantasya samūhasya pramāṇābhāvāt|
vediviṣaye tu sāmānyāvabodhasya ‘pūrvedhuramāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti’ iti viśeṣavacanana bādhaḥ|
apakarṣaḥ na pradānasya, āśvinādigrahagrahaṇasya amāvāsyāparvya apakarṣeḍapi|
apakarṣavidhiḥ upadeśena agnīṣomīye, atideśena ca savanīyānubandhavyoḥ aṅgabhūtasya yūpasya anuṣṭhānasādhāraṇārthya: ‘dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti’ iti|
bhā. 6|3|1|18-19, apacāre pratinidheḥ, śrudravya- sadbhemeva anyat grāhyaṃ, na tu pratinidheḥ pratinidhiḥ|
6|3|1|35, apacāre nhīdādeḥ śruta- dravyasya, vaikalpika yavādidravyaṃ pratinidhetvena nopādeyam|
6|3|1|27, apacāre śruta- dravyasya, nityakarmaḥ prārabdhakāmyakarmaṇaḥ pratinidhinā samāpanam|
6|3|1|13-17, apacāre śrutapratinidheḥ, mukhyadravyasadṛśasyaiva pratinidhirna, na tu pratinidhisadṛśasya|
tatra bahiścavamāne pratipat na upavatī, na abhi- prayogāṅgakartānisiddhayarthā iyaṃ dakṣiṇā tayogāṅgabhūtaiva yavatī, kiṃtu anyaiva |
anyaprayogasya hi ṛtvijaḥ 59-61, apacitau ekāhe bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ hotṛḥ pṛṣṭhe eva (dvitīyaṃ) saṃskṛto (dakṣiṇā, kartā) anyaprayo- samucciya niveśaḥ |
tataśca taddakṣiṇālope citau ekāhe rathaṃtarādidharmāṇāṃ prakṛtitvat vyavasthā |
upakrama vadona upasaṃhāraśabdakalpanā lakṣaṇayāparigraheṇa śabdārtha vijñānasya dharmabādhaḥ|
śrutyā ca lakṣaṇāprāptaṃ bādhyate, tatra vācyasambandhavijñānabādhaḥ|
apūrve hi dharmāṇāṃ prayojakaṃ nimittaṃ ca iti paurvāparyābhāvāt itaretarabādhanam|
smin prayoge ekaḥ kalpaḥ, anyasminparo bhaviṣyati |
yadi anyatareṇa vinā vaiguṇyaṃ ityadhyāyeta, sarvese kriyamāṇe adākṣiṇyābhāvāt viguṇaḥ syāt |
na anyasmin prayoge kriyamāṇe anyaḥ prayogaḥ anujñāyate |
na ca adākṣiṇyasya sarvasvadānasya ca prādhānyam |
śā - ekasminneva prayoge dvayamāpatati tadaśakyaṃ samuccayaṃ iti vikalpaḥ |
, prayoge paścime nāsti nimittaṃ tena tad dvayam |
bhāṣya - yaugapadye prāyaścittadvayaṃ avirodhāt samucca- yainaiva |
pratihartṛpacchedanimittaṃ sarvasvadānaṃ udgāmapaccheda- nimitte punaḥprayoge'pi śakyate eva kartum |
athavā dakṣiṇotkarṣaviśiṣṭapunaḥprayogamātrāṃ tannaimittikaṃ punaḥ adākṣiṇyamapi, tasya arthāpattena anuvādyatvāt |
ataḥ pūrvaprayoge'pi sarvasvadāne na kaścit virodhaḥ |
iti prāpte, na tāvat pūrvaprayoge evaṃ sarvasvadānaṃ, asa- tyapi adākṣiṇyasya naimittikatve dakṣiṇotkarṣasya pūrva- prayoge sarvasvadāne anupapatteḥ |
nāpi punaḥprayoge sarvasvadānaṃ, pratihartṛpacchedasya prayoge eva tadvidhānāt |
anyathā ekasmin prayoge pratihartṛpacchedo kratoḥ tadatvā- viśeṣān taduttarasarvaprayogeṣu sarvasvadānāpattiḥ |
nimitta- vati prayoge naimittikasya devākaraṇe prayogāntare'pi tadāpattiḥ |
'apasuma- ntāyājabhāgāṃ yajati' iti parisaṃkhyānāt yāvadduk- mevānujñeyaṃ, na sarvam |

vi. 10|7|15. apabhraṃśa- śrutaraḥ prayājān yajati' , 'apabhraṃśaipī dāvandyājau' ityanena saumike avabhṛthe prayājacatuṣṭayasya anuyāja- dvayasya ca vastuto nahiḥprayājānuyājatiriktā vidhānaṃ, viśiṣṭavidhinyāyena vā paryudāsaviśiṣeprayājānuyāja- vidhiḥ, na tu vahiḥprayājānuyājamātram |
apabhraṃśaḥ -- avinadhaiḥ śabdairbhāpamāṇasya svarga- yaśopakauro bhavati |
yāye ca karmaṇi apaśabdairbhāpa- māṇasya anutamiva vadataḥ pratipiddhācaraṇanimittakratu- vaiguṇyaprasaṅgaḥ |
'mama hi hi bhikkhave karma vacchasī save' |
tathā 'ukkhitte loḍambhima uvve asthi kāraṇaṃ, paḍuṇe natthi kāraṇam' |
'aṇubhave kāraṇaṃ ime sakkaḍā dhammā saṃbhavanti sakāraṇā, akāraṇā viṇassanti |
('mama api hi bhikkhave karma vartate sarvam' |
patane nāsti kāraṇam' ' anubhave kāraṇaṃ ime saṃskṛtā dharmāḥ saṃbhavanti sakāraṇāḥ, akāraṇā vinaśyanti' |

eka evāyaṃ śabdaḥ (gauḥ ityādiḥ) purāṇāśaktipramāda- kāraṇādimedāt tāsāṃ varṇavyunātirekakramānyatvādyaśaṃ anupatastantena apabhraṃśarūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇaḥ tamevārthaṃ prati- pādayati, iti na paryāyakalpatayā vācakaśabdāntaralaukā- ntasiddhiḥ |
' tattādiśabdāpi hi bālaprayuktāt tadanukāritorukhadviprayuktatvādā devadattādyarthapratyayamupalabha- mānaḥ kathamiva prayogapratyayadarśakābhyāmeva vācakatvamabhya- vasyet |
' katiṣu cideva gāvyādiṣu virāpabhraṣṭatvāt rūḍhayāśaṅkāyā sādhutvabhrāntirbhavet |

ye tu saṃpratyeva jaḍa- prāyaśakaraṇaiḥ abhinavagāvyādirūpeṇa vinādyaśabdāḥ prayujyamānāḥ prakṛtyanusaraṇadvāreṇa vā arthe pratyāpayantaḥ upalabhyante, teṣvapi prayogapratyayadarśanamasti iti anaikā- ntiktā |
' 11|8|25 pṛ. 276-77. apabhraṃśaḥ gāvyādayaḥ sāsnādimati arthe na pramāṇam |
ekaḥ śabdaḥ avicchinnaparaṃparārthaḥ arthābhidhāyī itare apabhraṃśāḥ |
11|8|26, gośabdamuccārayitukāmena kena cit aśakyā gāvī iti uccāritam |
apareṇa jñātaṃ sāsnādimān asya vivakṣitaḥ, tadarthe gauḥ iti uccārayitukām : gāvī ityu- ccārayati |
tataḥ śithilā apare'pi sāsnādimati viva- kṣite gāvī iti uccārayanti |
11|8|28. gośabdasya gāvyādayaḥ apabhraṃśāḥ iti evaṃ- vidaḥ tattvavidaḥ |
teṣāṃ naiva gāvyādiṣo'pi arthajñānamutpa- dyate gośabdādeva arthe pratipadyante ityuktaṃ vyāgātyabhiḥ |
tatra kena cit buddhena gośabdamuccārayitukāmena pramādāt gāvī ityuccāritam |
tatrāparo vṛddhaḥ arthakaraṇādiśośena tadīyāṃ vivakṣāmavagamya ' gośabdamuccārayitukām : gāvī ityuccāritavān' iti uccārayipitāt gośabdādeva gavādyarthe pratipadyate, na punaḥ gāvīśabdāt |
ṛju. pṛ. 238. deśabhāṣāpabhraṃśapadāni hi vicchutibhraṣṭāni na śakyante vivektum |
vā. 11|5|10 pṛ. 226, śabdāpabhraṃśaḥ, arthāpabhraṃśaḥ, pramādajaḥ, aśaktijaḥ |
11|4|19 pṛ. 219-20, apabhraṃśena kaścit viśeṣaḥ pratideśaṃ abhīyate |
' bhā. 11|8|29, śākyādigrantheṣu punaḥ yadapi kiṃcitāsādhuśabdābhiprāyeṇa avinadhairuddhyā prayuktaṃ, tatrāpi prasṛtivisitapadayātiṣṭha- tādiprāyaprayogāt kiṃ cideva avituptaṃ labhyate |
kimuta yāni prasiddhāpabhraṣṭadeśabhāṣāmāyo'pi apabhraṣṭarāṇi ' bhikkhave ' ityevamādīni |
dvitīyābahuvacanasthāne hi ekārāntaṃ prākṛtaṃ padaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, na prathamābahuvacane saṃjñopadhe- 'pi |
saṃskṛta-śabdasthāne ca (saṃskṛta = sakata = saṃkaḍa = sakaḍa ) kakāradvayasyogaḥ anusvāralopaḥ ṛvarṇakārāpamātrameva prākṛtāpabhraṃśeṣu dṛṣṭaṃ, na ḍakārā- pattirapi |
aparāhṇe ' āgnāvaiṣṇavaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet sārasvataṃ caruṃ bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ' adharakalpāyām |
uktaṃ ca- ' ārambhagurvī kṣayiṇī krameṇa laghvī purā vṛddhimatau ca paścāt |
dinasya pūrvārdhaparārdhabhinnā chāyeva maitrī khala- sajjanānām |
( (yasmin mannādau kasya cidevatāviśeṣasya parigrahaḥ svīkāraḥ: nirdeśo nāsti tat aparimitaṃ, tacca yat pradhānaṃ tasmin gacchati tatpratipādakaṃ ityarthaḥ |
yasminnapi pakṣe naraśaṃso yajñaḥ, tasminnapi pakṣe yajñaprabhavatvādvastuno yajñasya śreṣṭhyam |

parimāṇe ca śiṣṭasya ( aparimita śiṣṭasya iti pāṭhaḥ ) 6|7|10121. ityadhikaraṇe, ādhāne 'ekā deyā, ṣaḍ deyāḥ, caturviṃśatideyāḥ, śataṃ deyaṃ, sahasraṃ deyaṃ, aparimitaṃ deyaṃ' iti ādhānadakṣiṇākalpabhedaśrutau aparimitaśabdaḥ bahulyavaktavyatā ekādaśadavat dakṣiṇā- kalpabhedaparaḥ iti nirṇītam |
' aparimitaṃ deyam' ayaṃ guṇapratiṣedhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ kṛtyarthaḥ: ādhāne (pūrvapakṣe) |
bāla. pṛ. 12 apari- mitatvaṃ nāma ādhāne dakṣiṇāyāḥ sahasrādhikatvam |
bhā. 6|7|1123-25, aparimitatvaṃ nāma dānasya ukta- saṃkhyābhyaḥ saṃkhyāntaratvaṃ ādhāne |
6|7|121-22, aparimitaśabdaḥ anekasmin aśakyaparimāṇe sati bahuṣu rūḍhaḥ |
aparimitaṃ asya dhanaṃ bahu iti gamyate yathā kuśalaḥ pravīṇaḥ iti |
aśakyaśabda- vat samudāyaprasiddhyā aparimitaśabde avayavaprasiddhiḥ bādhyate |
bhāṣyam -- ādhāne śrūyate 'ekā deyā, ṣaḍ deyāḥ, dvādaśa deyāścaturviṃśatideyāḥ, śataṃ deyaṃ, sahasraṃ deyaṃ, aparimitaṃ deyaṃ' iti |
tatra sandehaḥ kiṃ yatparimitamekā deyatvamādi, tatra dānatvamiti pratiṣedho vidhīyate, utāparimitaṃ nāma kiṃcit, tasya dānaṃ vidhīyate iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? aparimita śiṣṭasya saṃkhyāpratiṣedhaḥ : śiṣṭasyekādeḥ saṃkhye-
yathā ekā deyeti dānavikalpaḥ; evamepo- 'pi dānavikalpa eva syāt |
pūrvetra hi deyaśabdaśrutyā dānaṃ vidhīyate iti, ihāpi deya- śabdaśrutiḥ |

' ' samānamitaracchayenena ' ityādi takārā- ntapathamantapuṃsakaprayogeṣu maśakena ( nāma prācīnasāma- kalpasūtrakāreṇa ) tatratatra prayukte ' samānamitaraṃ jyoti- ṣṭomena ' , ' samānamitaraṃ gavā aikāhikena ' iti |

( chandoga- ) sūtrakāreṇāpi abhihitaṃ ' ahīne vahi- ṣpavamānaiḥ sadasi svavīran ' ( lāṭyā. 2|1|1 ) iti kartabhiprāyakriyāphalavarjite'pi ṛtvikartṛke sāvane ' yajanti yājakāḥ ' itivat parasmaipade prayoktavye vyākaraṇamanepekṣya ātmanepadaṃ prayuktam |
tathā āśralāya- nena ' pratyasitvā prāyaścittaṃ juhuyuḥ ' ( 8|12|14 ) iti samāse'pi lyap na prayuktaḥ , ' ājyenādhiṣṇya ājya ' ( -5|9|16 ) iti asamāse'pi prayuktaḥ |
kartā, vasantādiḥ kālaśca iti- ) guṇadvayavidhānācca vākyabhedaḥ sthita eva |
bārhaspatyaṃ gavāmayane samāmnāyate, amīvatoṃ jyotiṣṭome, pārdhurasaṃ aśvamedhe |
bhāṣyaṃ-- naitadevaṃ śūdrasya agnyabhāvāt anadhi- kāraḥ |
asti hi śūdrasya ādhānaṃ ‘ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte’ iti śāstraṃ sāmānyena |
bhāṣyaṃ-- atha yaduktaṃ abrahmasāmakaṃ abratakaṃ aprakramakaṃ ca śūdrasya karma prayuktamapi phalaṃ na sādhayet viguṇamiti, tat parihartavyam |
kāma- yiṣyate śūdraḥ amīvatoṃ nāma brahmasāma |
vrate- 'pi ‘mastu śūdrasya’ iti saṃbandhadarśanāt adhyavasī- yate |
mastu evaṃ śūdrasya ( dadhimatho mandaḥ mastu ) |
kimato yat puruṣapradhānatā ? etadato bhavati, puruṣapradhānaḥ saṃskāro na śaknoti anupasaṃhīyamānaḥ tasyādhikāraṃ vyāvarttayitum |
tat kathamipi ? yajeta iti hi svargakāme abhīyamāne tatkāmaḥ śūdro nābhipretaḥ iti kathaṃ gamyate ? kiṃ hi sa yāgasya puruṣanirvartyaṃ na nirvartayati |
vratabhīte cet, na, sāmarthyaṃ jananāya hi tat |
yasyaivocyeta, tasyaiva tena vinā na sāmarthyaṃ, nānyasya |
evameva hi vratasyābhāvaḥ, yat kartāraṃ samarthaṃ karoti |
yasya tu tena na prayojanaṃ, sa tadanapekṣayaiva yāgamabhinirvartayati |
naimittike'pyapi teṣu śakya eva śūdra- paryudāso vaktumiti na tadāhatam |
evamapi sati naimittike- 'pi brāhmaṇādiśravaṇe sati apaśūdrāṇāmevādhikāraḥ |
vede hi trayāṇāṃ nirdeśo bhavati ‘vasante brāhmaṇamupanayīta, grīṣme rājanyaṃ, śaradi vaiśyaṃ’ iti |
dup-- ‘vasante garbhāgme brāhmaṇamupanayīta’ iti vasanto garbhāgmalaṃ anye ca niyamā adhyayanaṅgam |
puruṣasya ca ‘svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ’ ityadhyayanaṃ vidhīyate, na kratoḥ ( śrutyābhāvāt ) |
ata īdṛśyā viśiṣṭe- tikartavyatayā vedopādānaṃ puruṣārtham |
ataḥ sa vedādhyayanaṃ prayojanam prasaṅgāt nirākāṅkṣīkriyate |
ato yādṛśa- madhyayanaṃ tādṛśena ( kratunā ) nirākāṅkṣatvāt, śūdrasya adhyayanābhāvāt anadhikāraḥ ityantarṇītābhiprāyaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ-- ( nanu ) guṇenādhyayanena arthī śūdraḥ anupanītaḥ svayamupetya adhyeṣyate |
dup-- itarastu aviditābhiprāya āha, guṇārtha- tvācceti cet |
vidyārthe upādhyāyasya samīpamānīyata, nādṛṣṭārthe, nāpi kaṣṭaṃ kuḍyaṃ vā kartum |
kathaṃ punaḥ nayatiḥ ācāryakaraṇe vartate ? tadarthasaṃśravāt |
ataḥ avettvāt asamarthaḥ śūdro nādhikriyeta iti |
vidyā ca puruṣārthā ityatra pūrva eva nyāyo draṣṭavyaḥ |

( varṇitaṃ hyetat yathā arthajñānaparyantamadhyayanaṃ svādhyāyādhyayanavidhinā vidhīyate, na tu tadvāreṇa kratupūrvaparyantaṃ, tanmātraparyavasānenāpi prayojanāvāteḥ, na tadatilaṅghanena dūrasthaṃ kratupūrva yāvada- ntavyam |
śūdrasya tu svādhyāya- vidhiprayuktavidyābhāvāt anadhikāra iti ) |
bhāṣyaṃ-- iti cet paśyasi avaidyatvādasāmarthyāt anadhikṛtaḥ śūdra iti |
dup-- yasya upanayanādayaḥ saṃskārā vihitāstasya te bhaveyuḥ |
adhīyāna- syāpi adhyayanaphalaṃ na bhavati, doṣaśca jāyate |
athāpi vaidyatvena sidhyet tathāpi anagnibhāvāt karmaṇi syāt |
atha kathamagnirite ? prāpakāṇi hi brāhmaṇādīnāmādhāne vākyāni |
nanu ‘ya evaṃ vidvāna- gnimādhatte’ iti ādhānasya vidhāyakaṃ, tatra ‘brāhmaṇo 'gnimādhīta’ iti śrutyā vidhānaṃ gamyate |
kathaṃ ? ‘svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ’ iti yamanīyamādibhiḥ adhya- yanaṃ puruṣārthatvena avagataṃ tādṛśameva prasaṅgāt kratu- rgrahṇāti |
na ca anyā''nupapattyā ākṣipyate, anyā''pi upapadyamānatvāt |
ato viśiṣṭena adhyayanena nirākā- ṅkṣīkṛtatvāt anyādeśamabhyayanaṃ na gṛhyate |
yathā godo- hanaṃ darśapūrṇamāsāṅgapraṇayanena nairākāṅkṣyāt vahiḥpraṇaya- nena viguṇaṃ bhavati, evamapi aniyatādhyayanena viguṇo bhavati ( kratuḥ ) |
ata āha- ‘adhīyā- nasyāpi adhyayanaphalaṃ na bhavati’ iti ( bhāṣyam ) |
( yathā agni- vidhe vidyante'sati, na kratuvidhibhiḥ prayujyate, tathā dravyamapi puruṣārthatvena arjitaṃ kratuvidhibhiḥ aṅgīkriyate, na tu tairākṣipyate iti ) |
bhāṣyaṃ-- anyārthadarśanaṃ ca bhavati yathā na śūdrā- dhyayanamiti |
kiṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati ? ‘paśu vā etat śmaśānaṃ yacchūdraḥ, tasmācchūdrasamīpe nādhyetavyaṃ’ iti anadhyayanaṃ śūdrasya darśayati |
nanu āhavanīyāt vinā'pi yāgo vacanaprāmā- ṇyāt śūdrasya vidhīyate |
kiṃ tarhi ? svargaphalatā viśi- ṣyate yāgasya |
śā-- kiṃ agnihotrādiṣu caturṇāmapi varṇānāmadhi- kāraḥ, uta apaśūdrāṇāṃ trayāṇām iti |
tadarthaṃ idaṃ vica- ryate, kiṃ kāmaśrutiprayuktaṃ vidyā'rjanaṃ, uta svādhyāya- vidhisiddhavidyopajīvinyaḥ kāmaśrutaya iti |
tadvataḥ kratavo lupyantā na turthāsthipanti tām |
soma-- yajamānavidhayā anuṣṭhānasiddheḥ kriyā vidyā''kṣepāt mantravatkarmakartṛtvātsaṃbhedapi, śūdrasya vidyā''kṣepasaṃbhavāt astu adhikāraḥ iti pratyavasthā-
vi- 'śūdro'pi yajñā no vā, syādvaidhādhyayane vā |
nākṣipanti catu- rthasya vidyāṃ tadyaṣṭā kutaḥ ||

' bhāṭṭa- yadyapi kāmaśrutyaḥ aviśeṣeṇa pravṛttāḥ, tathāpi tāsāṃ lāghavāya ādhānādhyayanavidhisiddhāvidhidho- pajīvakatvasya dvitīye sādhitātvāt śūdrasya tadākṣepakalpa- nā'nupapatteḥ tasya vedākṣaraśravaṇapratiṣedhāt apaśūdrāṇāṃ trayāṇāmevādhikāraḥ, na śūdrasya agnisādhye tadāsādhye ca vaidike karmaṇi |
ata eva sarvatra vede trayā- ṇāmeva varṇānāmukīrtanam |
yattu 'payo vrataṃ brāhmaṇasya' ityādi- varṇatrayamanukīrya 'mastu śūdrasya' iti kīrtanaṃ tat mastu śūdrasya anadhikāriṇo bhakṣyamucitaṃ na tu brāhma- ṇādeḥ iti tadindriyā payaādisrutiḥ |
(vastutastu rathakārasya ādhāne, niṣādasya raudre, avaidike śāntyā- dikarmaṇi ca śūdrasāmānyāsya adhikārasattvāt tatraiva 'mastu śūdrasya' iti vākyaṃ sārthakaṃ bhaviṣyati iti vaktuṃ yuktam |
apaśūdrādhikaraṇaṃ karmādhikāraniṣedhakavacanā- bhāve'pi agnisādhyeṣu karmasu agnyābhāve anadhikāra- pratipādanārtham |

apaśūdrādhikaraṇe uktaṃ svādhyāyavidhiḥ anirdiṣṭa- kartṛkatvena kartāramapekṣamāṇaḥ prakṛtopanayanasaṃskṛtān 'kimarthaṃ vacanādyenikṛtaṃ nītāḥ' ityevaṃ prayojanamapekṣa- māṇān brāhmaṇādīneva svīkṛtya teṣāmevādhyayanaṃ vidhatte, na śūdrasya iti |
(apaśūdrāṇāṃ śūdraminnānāṃ traivarṇikānāmeva vaidikakarmādhikāraḥ adhyayanādhikāraḥ vedārthajñānādhikāra ityasyārthasya pratipādakaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ apaśūdrādhikaraṇam |
ke.) śā. 1|3|1 pṛ.6. adhyayanaṃ akṣarāvāptilakṣaṇatayā apaśūdrādhikaraṇe pratipāditam |
ābharaṇaṃ. 3|4|1122 brasū. na caivaṃ śūdrasyādhyāpanaṃ śakyam |

'akṣarāṇāṃ janayataḥ purogāṃ', 'darśamahaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajñaṃ yathā yajñe' ityādimantravarṇāt ādhānasya yathārthatvāvagamāt, 'tasmā- cchūdro yajñe'navalakṣataḥ' iti tasya yajñapratiṣedhāt, śūdrasya adhyayanavidhivyabhāvāt, 'na śūdro'vedamīdhīyātāṃ' iti tasya vidyāpratiṣedhācca iti paṣṭhe apaśūdrādhikaraṇe spaṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati |
ku. 2|3|14. aviduṣaḥ karmakartṛttvena avidhānātapaśūdrādhi- karaṇavakṣyamāṇahetukyathartavyā nahi iti sūtrāvayavaṃ vyākhyāya |
bhūtalāt apasā- rite'pi agnī tatra uṣṇatā upalabhyate tadvat |

'apahṛtapāpmāna ṛtavaḥ; asau khalu vāvāditya ugryeṣāṃ pāpamānamapahanti, tasmādahareraivenaṃ śradopanaget athādhīta atha yajeta' iti vacane atha yajeta itya- nena ādhānānantaryaṃ saume vidhīyate, yajeta ityanena soma- syaiva parāmarśāt |
ata eva athādhīta ityanena ādhāne eva kālavyādha iti vakṣyate |
bhāṭṭa. 5|4|3. apādāne pañcamī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 45. apādānatvaṃ kriyānāśraye sati kriyā- janyavibhāgāśrayatvam |
udāsīne ghaṃṭe parṇe ca atiprasaṅga- vāraṇāya daladvayam |
vibhāgahetu- kriyānāśraye sati vibhāgāśrayatvaṃ iti tadarthaḥ |
apāpaślokaśravaṇādīnāṃ 509 apivā nāmadheyaṃ tādṛśakriyājanyanirūpakatvaṃ tādṛśakriyānirūpakatvaṃ ca iti niṣkarṣaḥ |
maṇi pṛ. 140. apāpaślokaśravaṇādīnāṃ praśaṃsārthatvena upāttānāṃ phalatvābhāvaḥ parṇamayatvadhikaraṇe vakṣyate |
(10|8|1|4) atra punarśrayanti yathepa pratiṣedhaḥ ( na prathamayajñe pravṛ- jyāt iti ) tat evaṃ syāt |
paryudāsāstu evaṃvidhāḥ iti daśame vakṣyate 'api tu0' iti |
vā. 3|3| 12|33 pṛ. 878. apitu vākyaśeṣaḥ syāt ( anadhyāyatvāt vikalpasya vidhīnāmekadeśaḥ syāt |
10|8|1|4) ityanena nyāyena 'na kesariṇo dadāti' ityayaṃ paryu- dāsaḥ |
śā. 6|7|4. daśamāṣṭamapādādhyāyyanayena paryudāsa- tvena kesarivyatireke sarvasvaṃ dadāti iti tadvākyaśeṣa- tvāt niyamena adārna kesariṇām ! soma. ( apitu iti pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttyai |
nānuyājeṣu iti naśabdaḥ vākyasya vākyaika- deśasya anuyājaśabdasya śeṣaḥ syāt |

anadhyāyatvāt vikalpasya nānuyājeṣu ityādī nam-sahitaṃ anuyājādipadaṃ vidhīnāṃ ' yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti' ityādīnāṃ ekadeśaḥ syāt ' nānuyājeṣu yajatiṣu yeyajāmaheṣu yajatiṣu ' yeyajāmahaṃ karoti iti nyāyasūtrārthaḥ |
ke.) apitu vākyaśeṣatvāditaraparyudāsaḥ syāt0 ( 10|8|7|15 ) iti siddhāntasūtreṇa paryudāsatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
'dīkṣito na dadāti, na juhoti, na pacate' iti pratiṣedhaḥ 'ahararhadātyāt', 'aharaha- rjuhuyāt' 'atithimākāṅkṣat' itivākyasya śeṣaḥ |
evaṃ vākyaśeṣatvāt itarasya dīkṣitatvasya adīkṣi- tasya paryudāsaḥ syāt |
dīkṣito na dadāti ityādiḥ adīkṣito dadāti ityādirarthaḥ |
'dīkṣito na dadāti' ityādau pratiṣedhe svīkṛte tu vihitapratiṣiddhatvāt vikalpaḥ syāt, sa cānyāyyaḥ iti |
' vā. 1|3|127 pṛ. 286. nyāyasūtrārthastu -apivā- śabdaḥ smṛtyāprāmāṇyapūrvapakṣaṃ vyāvartayati |
tathā ca anumānaṃ smṛtiḥ dharme pramāṇaṃ syāt |
kutaḥ ? kartusāmānyāt vaidika- kartṛnuṣṭhānasmṛtyoḥ kartṛṇāṃ samānatvāt ekatvāt iti |
ke. 'apivā karmapṛthakatvāta teṣāṃ tatravidhānāt sāṅgānāmupadeśaḥ syāt' ( 1|3|1316 ) ityekādaśe vakṣyamāṇapratipradhānānuvṛttinyāyābhāve'pi |
su. pṛ. 734. nyāyasūtrārthastu- apivā iti pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttyaiḥ |
darśaya paurṇamāsañca karmaṇoḥ kālabhedena pṛthaktvāt tathoraṅgānāṃ na tantraṃ kiṃtu pratipradhānamāvṛttiḥ |
pradhāna- trikadvaye tu teṣāṃ aṅgānāṃ tantreṇa vidhānāt pradhānānāṃ sāṅgānāṃ upadeśaḥ syāt |
tasmāt trikadvayasya aṅgānāṃ na tantraṃ, ekaikasmin trike tu aṅgānāṃ bhavatyeva tantram |
sa hi nyāyaḥ, yo'sāvuktaḥ : 'apivā kālamātraṃ syādadarśapūrṇamāsayoḥ' iti, ihāpi sa eva nyāyaḥ 'asomayāgakāle darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ etau puroḍāśau bhavataḥ' iti |
'purastādupasadāṃ saumena pracarati' ityādinā kālamātraṃ vihitaṃ syāt, anyebhyaḥ kālavidhānebhyo viśeṣasya bhedasya adarśanāt iti |
ke. apivā nāmadheyaṃ syād yadutpattāvapūrvama- vidhāyakatvāt |
vidhyudeśāntargatatvena sādhanānniveśe sati idamadānīṃ vicāryate kiṃ guṇavidhitvesya sādhanāṃ- śaniveśaḥ, athavā nāmadheyatvena ? iti |
tathāhi, yadyapi loke samudāyaprasiddhināsti, tathāpi 'ūrdhvaṃ minatti' iti vyutpattyā khanitrādidravyamudbhidādipadāt pratīyate eva |
tathā sati ca udbhidarthasyārthavattvaṃ bhavati, yajipadārthā- tiriktārthapratipādanāt |
evaṃ bhinnārthatvāt puruṣapravṛttā- vapi viśeṣo bhavati |
nanu guṇe vidhīyamānaḥ phale vidhātavyaḥ, karmaṇā vā ? tatra na tāvaddrohīhanavat phale, praṇayanavat prakṛtāśrayābhāvāt |
na ca durakṣajyoti- ṣṭomānudānenaivārya guṇavidhiḥ, dūrakṣahomānudādena āhava- nīyavidhivaditi vaktavyam |
na ca niṣkṛṣyaguṇānuvādāt ākāṅkṣāmapyaterguṇavidhāno- papattiriti vaktavyam |
yato'nuvādāt pūrvavigatārtha- viṣayatvāt, tadanusaṃdhāne ca guṇāntaravarodhāt ākāṅkṣā- virahasya tadavasthatvāt |
kiñca jyotiṣṭome'pi 'somena yajeta' iti somarūpaguṇaśravaṇāt udbhidityatvameva |
na caivaṃ sati guṇaviśiṣṭakarmavidhiraivamastviti vaktavyaṃ, vidhi- gauravadoṣāt, udbhideteti matvarthalakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt |
taduktaṃ ' guṇo vidhiyamāno'pi phale karmaṇā vā bhavet |
viśiṣṭavidhivadbuddhyā vā sarvathā na ca yujyate ||
na caivaṃ vidhigauravaṃ matvarthalakṣaṇā ca doṣamāvahati, sakalaviśeṣavicchedādaprasaṅgāt |
atha agatyā tatra tathā''śrayaṇaṃ, tadaprāpti samānam |
tena yathā 'daśāpavitreṇa grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' ityādipatyā'pi viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ, tathaivāpi udbhedanasamarthalanidrādiviśiṣṭa- karmavidhānameveti |
bhavedevamagatyā matvarthalakṣaṇayā viśiṣṭavidhira- vāśrayaṇaṃ, yadi nāmadheyatvena na gatirbhavet |
tathāhi, 'udbhidā' iti karaṇātvānnitīyāntapadasya karaṇībhūta- yāgasambandhamityāha tasmāt samānādhikaraṇyaṃ pratīyate |
tatya- vītamapi hīyeta, yadi vrīhisomādivat udbhidarthā- ntare niruḍhaṃ bhavet |
avayavaprasiddhiśca 'ūrdhvaṃ minatti' iti vyutpattyā yathā khanitrādidravye, tathā paśu- nāmṛddhedanamanena kriyate iti yāge'pi |
ato'vayavasiddhiyege'pi samānatvānnadisyārthatvaṃ yaduktaṃ, tat tāvat parihṛtam |
yadapi yajipadārthānatiriktātvādā- narthakyamuktaṃ, tadanyayuktaṃ, yajiviśeṣapratītihetutvena nāma- dheyasyārthavatvāt |
ata eva apravṛttiviśeṣakaratvamapi prayuktaṃ, vidhivityāgaviśeṣapratipādanenaiva pravṛtti- viśeṣakaratvāditi |
nanu arthaviśeṣapratipādane hi padāntarasya padāntaraviṣayatvaṃ bhavati |
atha nāmadheyaṃ śabda- tvasiddhayarthamātmānaṃ lakṣayatītyucyate, tadapi pañcabhiyā palāyamānasya punamanucitapatanasamānam |
sā ceyaṃ nāmadheyatve'pi svīkṛtā, kimaparāddhaṃ guṇa- vidhinā |
kiñca guṇavidhau matvarthalakṣaṇayāmāpa autsargika- matvarthatvaṃ na parihīṇaṃ, iha tu ātmalakṣaṇāyāṃ tato'pi jaghanyatvamiti guṇavidhitvameva jyāyaḥ |
ucyate - syādevaṃ yadi saṃjñā nīlādipadamiva viśeṣaṇī- bhūtasvapratipāditāthopalakṣaṇadvāreṇa saṃjñinaṃ viśinaṣṭīti bhramaḥ |
sa ca viśeṣo viśeṣaṇasya kasya cit saṃjñāpadatadupasthitatvāt etacchabdavyāvṛttena saṃjñāntaraviṣayavyāvṛttyā upalakṣito vidyamānaviśeṣaṇayogaḥ |
tenaivaṃbhūta evāyaṃ yāgaviśeṣaḥ pratīyate, na tu viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ |

atra yadyapi utpattivākyānāṃ sādhyabhūtārthatvaparatvena na guṇavidhau matvarthalakṣaṇadoṣaḥ, nāpi nāmadheyatvahetoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tathāpi adhikāravākyaikavākyatādaśāyāmudbhidā yāgena svargamityanyasaṃbhavatvādbhavasya matvarthalakṣaṇadoṣaḥ, ityanena- vābhiprāyeṇa bhāṣyakāreṇātra sakalotpattivākyagati- pradarśanārthaṃ phalapadaṃ nopanyastamiti |
prayojanaṃ - lanitrā- didravyeṇa yāgo yadi pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhānte tu 'avya- kāsu tu somasya' (jai. sū. 8|1|16) ityā- disu somadravyeṇaiva |
sūtraṃ tu - 'utpattau, prathamajñāne 'yadapūrva' na somādipadavat prasiddhamṛdbhidādi, tat ' nāmadheyaṃ syāt |
anyatrāprasiddhatvena kasya cit guṇasya ' avidhāyakatvāt ' iti |

sauryādau laukikī pārvaṇa- sthālīpāketikartavyatā āgrayaṇasthālīpākādau dṛṣṭapravṛttitvena atideśebhyā iti pūrvapakṣete vārhaspatye 'arghe vārhaspato lunāti' iti vārhaspato layanadarśanaṃ, saurye ca 'prayājeprayāje kṛṣnalaṃ juhoti' iti prayājadarśanaṃ vaidikātikartavyatā'tideśena yujyeta ityādāvukya 'apivā0' iti sūtreṇa tatra vārha- lavanaṃ pratyakṣavihitaṃ, tatra arthavidhiḥ, hotṛvaraṇaniṣedho nityānuvādaḥ, prayājavākyaṃ kṛṣnalavidhyāprayājavidhānārtha iti pūrvapakṣī parihariṣyati |
(sūtre-sauryādau vaidikī itikartavyatā na sthiyati anyāpūrvatvāt nyāyapūrvaka- liṅgaṃ yatra nityānuvādavacanāni syuḥ tatra bodhakam |
apivā paurṇamāsyāṃ syāt pradhānaśabdasaṃyogād guṇatvānmantro yathāpradhānaṃ syāt |
(10|8|13|14) iti sūtreṇa pradhānasya upāṃśuyājasya 'upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti śabdena paurṇamāsīkālasaṃyogāt paurṇamāsyāmeva upāṃśuyājaḥ kāryaḥ |
mantrastu vaiṣṇavāvyājanuvākyārūpaḥ amāvāsyākramāmnāto'pi pradhānānusārāt paurṇamāsyāmeva syāt ityuktam |
apivā'pyekadeśe syāt ( pradhāne hyarthanivṛtti- guṇamātrābhitarat tadarthatvāt ) 6|1|12 |
satyāmapi vivakṣāyāṃ 'apivā0' ityanena yathaiva aśakteḥ anyat kiṃ cidaṅgaṃ hyate tathaiva yajamānaikatvamapi kadā cit pari- hṛya dvau bahavo vā yajeran (ityuktam) |
sūtrārthastu- ajñānāṃ ekadeśe satyapi nityakarmaḥ prayogaḥ syāt |
hi yasmāt pradhāne kṛte sati arthasya phalasya nirvṛttirbhavati |
itarat pradhānadanyat ajñānāṃ tu guṇamātraṃ, tadarthatvāt pradhānārthatvāt |

apivā prayogasāmarthyāt ( mantro'bhidhāna- vācī syāt ) iti dvitīyamantrādhikaraṇasūtranyāyena ( 2|1|6|1 ) sāmarthyādhīnatvāt ṛtikalpasya, mukhyatve ca nirapekṣasāmarthyāvagateḥ; tasyaiva śruteḥ prakalpa- katvāt |
ākhyātapadaviśiṣṭo'pi mantraḥ abhidhānavācī syāt, na vidhā- yakaḥ |
ke. apivā prayogasāmarthyāt ityanena hi nyāyena abhidheye tāvat viniyogāya mantrāḥ śrutiṃ parikalpa- yanti |
vā. 3|1|1 pṛ. 750. prakaraṇavato'sya saṃnidhāne ( mantrāḥ-) yamarthamāmananti sa tasya sādhana- bhūtaḥ ityeva gamyate |
vā. 3|1|14 pṛ. 843, tadetat 'apivā prayoga0' ityatra varṇitam |
apivā yajamānāḥ syurṛtvijāmabhidhāna- saṃyogāt ( teṣāṃ syāt yajamānatvam |
satre tatra eva yajamānāḥ ṛtvijaḥ; anye vā minnāḥ iti saṃśaye, ta eveti nyāyyam |
apivā'vyatirekāt 512 apivā satvakarmaṇi nyāya: 'apivā yajamānā:' iti|
bhā. 10|6|15|54. nyāyasūtrastha- apivāśabda: ṛtvijāṃ yajamānāt anyatvaṃ vyāvartayati|
yaja- mānā eva ṛtvija: syu:; 'adhvaryurjuhapati dīkṣayitvā brahmaṇaṃ dīkṣayati' ityādau ṛtvijāṃ abhidhānai: yajamāneṣu saṃyogāt saṃbandhāt saṃbandhadarśanāt|
tasmāt teṣāṃ ṛtvijāṃ yajamānatvaṃ syāt, yajamānāmeva ca ārtvijyaṃ syāt iti|
ke. apivā'vyatirekāt rūpaśabdāvibhāgācca gotva- vadaikakarmye syānnāmadheyaṃ ca satvavat|
(6|3|12) (sūtrastha-vihitadravyapacāre pratinidhigrā: dravyabhede- 'pi yāgasya avyatirekāt bhedābhāvāt, rūpabhedā- vāt darśapūrṇamāsādiṣvabhedabhāvāt|
tasmāt pratini- dhinā kriyamāṇe'pi karmaṇa: ekakarmyaṃ syāt|
vigrahavatyo devatāstva naiva santi, agnyādyabhāve'pi apūrva- sattvādeva sauryādau uhāstitvam |
9|1|4. apūrve karma- janyā svargādiphalā śaktiḥ, svargādiphalasya prāktanī sūkṣmāvasthā vā |
ke. apūrve nāma yāgāvāntaravyāpāraḥ kiṃvā yāgajanyā kā cicchaktiḥ kartṛsamavāyinī |
vi. 2|1|2. apūrve punarasti, yata ārabhya śiṣyate— 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
itarathā hi vidhānaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt, bhañjitatvāt yāgasya |
bhā. 2|1|2|5 pṛ. 390. apūrve phalasādhanasya karmaṇaḥ avāntaravyāpārarūpaṃ ajñānāṃ ca phalanupakārasādhanā- nām |
eṣā atra prakriyā— prathamaṃ tāvat phalasādhyena karmaṇaḥ 'yāgena svargaṃ kuryāt' iti |
'kathaṃ vinaśva- reṇa phalaṃ kartavyaṃ' ityapekṣāyāṃ 'apūrva kṛtvā' ityucyate |
ataḥ pūrvopakāratvamitiḥ aṅgavyāpāraiḥ vipayīkṛtasya yāgasya apūrvasādhanatvaṃ na svarūpeṇa saṃbhavati iti apūrvāntaramapi parikalpyate |
darśapūrṇamāsa- yostu pakṣadvayavṛttimyāṃ samudāyābhyāṃ yugapat phalapūrvā- rambhayogāt ekaikaṃ prati samudāyāparva kalpyate |
tat pūrvadeva pūrvottarāṅgasahitebhyastadupapattiḥ, na svarūpeṇa saṃbhavati iti pratiriktaṃ trīṇimīṇi utpattyapūrvāṇi kalpyante |
yadi punaḥ prathamameva ṣaḍbhyo yāgebhyaḥ padapūrvāṇi kalpyerana, tataḥ apūrvārthatvādjñānāmaṅgaprakṛtebhyo yāgebhyaḥ apūrva- siddhayai punarapi ṣaḍapūrvāṇi kalpyāni syuḥ iti gauravaṃ syāt |
tathā aṅgānyapi kratūpakāraka- tvena svīkṛtāni kṣaṇikatvāt na svarūpeṇa saṃhṛtyopakartuṃ śaknuvanti iti, avāntaravyāpārarūpāṇi tāvat apūrvā- rabhyante |
tataḥ sarvāṇi saṃhatya pradhānasya sāmarthyodbo- dhanaṃ phalārambhī-mukhyarūpaṃ anugrahaṃ paramopakārāmidhānaṃ janayanti |
saṃnipatyopakārakāṇi dravyadevatāsaṃskāradvāreṇa yāgasvarūpasya śaktyatiśayaṃ dadhā- nāni tadupatyapūrvaniṣṭhau vyāpriyante, taddvāreṇa phala- pūrve |
evaṃ prakārabhede satyapi sarvāṇyaṅgāni yāgāpūrvaniṣpattau anugrāhakāṇi bhavanti ityevaṃ ekarūpeṇa itthaṃbhāvena svīkriyante |

śā. 2|1|2. soma -- nanu yathā āgneyādīnāṃ pradhānānāṃ phala- sādhanānirvahārthaṃ prathamaṃ phalāpūrvamekaṃ sarvapradhānasādhyaṃ kalpyate, paścācca aṅgasāhityasiddhayarthaṃ prātisvikāni utpattyapūrvāṇi kalpyante, tathā aṅgānāmapi sarveṣāṃ kratū- pakārajanakatvanirvahārthaṃ sarvāṅgajanmekamapūrva kalpanīyaṃ, paścācca parasparasāhityasiddhayarthaṃ avāntaravyāpārarūpāṇi utpattyapūrvāṇi kalpanīyāni iti kathaṃ sarvāṅgajanma ekama- pūrve prathakaraṇe nocyate |
yathā svargasya kāla- ntarabhāvitvaṃ evaṃ aṅgajanyasya kratūpakārasya na kālā- ntarabhāvitvaṃ, brāhmaṇasaṃtarpaṇāntāṅgānuṣṭhānottarameva tadu- tpatteḥ |

tataśca āgneyādibhiḥ kathaṃ kālāntarabhāvi svarga- rūpaṃ phalaṃ sādhanīyaṃ iti sarvasādhyaikaphalāpūrvakalpa- jijñāsāyāt iha kathaṃ sarvairaṅgaiḥ kālāntarabhāvikṛtūpakāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti jijñāsāyā abhāvena sarvasādhyamekamapūrva na kalpyate, kiṃtu kṣaṇikānāmeṣāṃ kathaṃ sāhityaṃ ityevātra jijñāsā |
pradhānameṣu tu phalakāṅkṣāyā utkaṭatvāt tasya ca kālāntarabhāvivāt tannirvāhakājijñāsaiva prathamamu- deti |
sarveṣāṃ phalasādhanatānirvāhakaṃ sarvasādhyameva prathamaṃ kalpyaṃ iti vaiṣamyam |
sa eva ca paramo- pakāraḥ sarvāṅgāparvaiva parasparaṃ saṃhatyaitadarthate ityetāvad- jñāyaiḥ |
evaṃ ca avaghātaprayājādijanyadṛṣṭāhaṣṭasaṃpā- danameva avāntaropakāraḥ iti granthakārāśayaḥ |
2|1|2. apūrve bhāvaśabdameva evāvagamyate, na dravyaguṇa- śabdamebhyaḥ |
ṭup. 2|1|5|47 pṛ. 1035. apūrve vidhyaikagamyatayā vidhimede midyate |
na prāk śabdāt anyena pramāṇena upasaṃkhyāyate |
anayaiva hi arthapattyā śakyate vaktuṃ sūkṣmāvayavarūpeṇa tat pratīyate iti |

vā. 2|1|2 pṛ. 399. sudhā - ātmādau amūrte niravayavatvadarśanāt apūrvasya amūrtatvena niravayavatvaṃ vācyaṃ, na cāmūrtatvaṃ niravayavatve prayojakaṃ mūrteṣvapi para- māṇuṣu niravayavatvadarśanāt anekaprayojakakalpanā''patteḥ |
) pṛ. 611. apūrve hi dharmāṇāṃ prayojakaṃ nimittaṃ ca |
ṭup. 6|1|9|54 pṛ. 1477. karmabhyaḥ prāgayogyasya karmaṇaḥ puruṣasya vā |
' puruṣagatā kratugatā vā yogyatā śāstre'smin apūrvamityapa- diśyate |
) sā ca śrutyarthapattivyati- riktaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ na gamyate |
yadi hi phalasaṃbandhamātraparyavasāyyeva vākyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ kadā cidapi sarvāṇi phalena saṃbadhyeran |
iha tu tācanamātrā- siddheḥ apūrvametat kalpayitavyam |
2|1|2|12 pṛ. 373-74, phalasya hi sūkṣmasāmarthyarūpāvasthā aṅkurasthānīyā pūrvotpattā utpatteḥ apūrvamityuktam |
( vā. pṛ. 395) 2|1|4|18, yanca yeṣu dharmeṣu vidhīyamāneṣu apūrvamupatiṣṭhate, tat teṣāṃ prayojakaṃ bhavati na yāvatkiṃcit |
3|1|4|10 pṛ. 670. yatra dravyadevate guṇabhūte ākhyātasya, tatra apūrvam |
yatra punaḥ dravyaṃ devatā vā pradhānaṃ, tatra tadarthatvāt ākhyātasa nāmpūrvam |
ṭup. 4|1|7|19. yadā tu sarvāṅgāni kṛtāni, tadā tajjanyā- pūrvāṇi saṃbhūya pradhānameva upakurvanti |
bhā. 11|1|10|47. apūrveṇa kriyamāṇaṃ yāgenaiva kriyate, apūrve vā kṛte phalameva kṛtaṃ bhavati |
vā. 2|1|2 pṛ. 397. apūrvasya atyanta-adṛṣṭatvāt ekakalpatayā eva vākya- syopapattau anekakalpane gaurava syāt |
brīhirūpatvaṃ ca nimittatvaṃ nāsti iti nīvāra- grahaṇe ūhaḥ kartavyaḥ |
satyāpi cāsa ( ātmanaḥ ) calanādikriyā- rahitatve kartṛsaṃbandhamātreṇa taddeśāntaraprāpaṇādikriyā- saṃbandhabhyupagamāt niṣkriyatā'nupālambhaḥ |
' hyavadānaprakṣepādīnāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ saṃkalpadvāreṇa ātmaiva kartā ityavadhāritam |
ataśca te pralīyamānāḥ tatra svargadhupabhogaśaktimādhāya pralīyante ityavirodhaḥ |
vā. 2|1|2 pṛ. 397. apūrvasya śabdaṃ prayojakatvaṃ saptame varṇitaṃ iha ( navame ) ārthikī nimittatā varṇyate |
vi. 9|1|2 varṇakaṃ 3. bhāvaśabdāḥ apūrvasya codakāḥ iti brūmaḥ |
na tu kaścicchabdaḥ sākṣāt apūrvasya vācako'sti |
bhā. 2|1|2|5 376. anyantarakāraiḥ 'apūrvābhāve'pi karmaphalasaṃbandho- papatteḥ apūrvasya niṣpramāṇakatvaṃ ityuktam |
su. pṛ. 593. kṛte karmaṇi anantaraṃ phalamanupalabhya kālāntaraphalotpādādarthaṃ apūrvakalpanam |
vā. 2|1|2 pṛ. 392. yajinimittā dharmaṃ apūrvanimitāḥ apūrva- pratyuktāḥ |
( iti siddhāntakoṭirupantyastā ) bhā. 9|1| 1|1 pṛ. 1638. phalasaṃbandho hetvaḥ, apūrvaprati- patteḥ |
sā ca bhāva- śabdaibhyaḥ prasarpantī dṛśyate na dravyaguṇaśabdebhyaḥ |
ataḥ tenaiva phalakaraṇabhūtena anyathā'nupapattyā apūrvaṃ bhāvyate ityava-
vā. 2|1|1|1 pṛ. 376. apūrvaprayuktaṃ abhidarśanaṃ caturhotṛpañcahotṛbhyāṃ na samudāyaprayuktam |
bhā. 1|1|1|11-19, apūrvaprayuktaṃ brīhiprokṣaṇaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ, na tu brīhisaṃrūpaprayuktam |
1|1|1| 11-19, agniṣṭome agnīṣomīyāt prācinatatpadārtha- janyāpūrvaprayuktaṃ upāṃśutvaṃ, na tu paramāpūrvaprayuktam |
1|1|1|20-22, 25, apūrvaprayuktaḥ evaṃjātīyako dharmaḥ, ulūkhalamusalayoḥ prokṣaṇaṃ, na hantipaniprayuktam |
1|1|1|2-3 varṇakaṃ 1, apūrvaprayuktaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ: 'trīn paridhīnsaḥ' iti mantraḥ na tu paridhitritva- prayuktaḥ, iti sakṛt paṭhanīyaḥ |
1|1|1|11- 19, apūrvaprayuktaḥ śūrpeṇa homaḥ, na śūrpapātrahetuprayuktaḥ; cāturmāsyeṣu śūrpapravāseṣu |
dup. 6|3|1|2 pṛ. 1409. apūrvaprayuktatve satyapi (saṃskārāṇāṃ auṣadhādi- dharmāṇāṃ) dṛṣṭaprayojanadvāra eva saṃbandhaḥ avakalpate |
vā. 3|1|4 pṛ. 666. apūrvabhedaḥ tatra na pratipattavyaḥ, yatra dravyikīrdhavā guṇabhāvaḥ |

(karmaṇaḥ āśutaravināśitvāt) pralīyamānakarmalakṣaṇopajanaḥ pūrvāprāpnopāditāśvāntaro deśakālāsāditāparaṇitabhedaḥ ānantaryāmapi karmaṇaḥ ativartamānaḥ ko'pi (karmaṇaḥ) atiśayaḥ kartāri (nityātmani āśritaḥ), karmaṇaḥ cirabhāvinaḥ phalasya sādhanaṃ kathyate (buddheḥ) |
svakāle vartamāno'pi karmaṇaḥ ativṛttatvāt na karmasaṃbandhitayā adhyakṣamīkṣyate |
taduktaṃ 'phalasādhana- rūpeṇa tadānīṃ yena nāstyasau' iti |
karmakāle tasya bhāvitvaṃ, tatkāle ca karmaṇaḥ abhāvaḥ |
(codayati-) kathaṃ tarhi karmaṇaḥ sādhanatvaṃ (yataḥ -) tat (apūrva) anyasamavāyi (karmaṇo'sminnu kartari samavāyi |
pari- harati-) tadāhitatvāt (tena karmaṇā karmakartari āhita- tvāt) nahi khasamavāyyeva sādhanaṃ bhavatīti kaścicci- yamaḥ |
kāryatanumeyaṃ tat (apūrva) yatra kāryāyāla tathaiva yuktam |
tadāhitatvāt tasya śaktiḥ (tena karmaṇā āhitatvāt tasya karmaṇaḥ śaktiḥ, tadapūrvam) |
na caupacārikāḥ karmaṇaḥ sādhanabhāvaḥ, kāṣṭhādiṣu tathaiva siddheḥ |
(na khalu kāṣṭhādīnāmapi sākṣāt paktisādhanatā, kintu auṣṇyāpekṣasya vahnisaṃyogaprathamedaya |
atha ca 'kāṣṭhaiḥ pacanti' iti mukhyaiva sādhanatā kāṣṭhānām |
nanu na tat (apūrva) astīti manyante pramāṇābhāvāt |
nanu ca śrutātpattiḥ pramāṇaṃ, (karmaṇaḥ ) phalasaṃbandhe codanāprāmāṇyavighātāt |

asiddho hi sa tadā (apūrvakalpanāyāḥ prāk karmaphala- saṃbandhaḥ) codanātaḥ, arthāpattiḥ siddhiṃ samāsādayati ityarthāpattikāraṇaḥ syāt (arthāpattipramāṇakaḥ syāt) anyathā (anapekṣācchabdāt) karmaphalasaṃbandhasiddheḥ arthāpattiprasaṅgaḥ |
siddhe tasmin kimantya (apū- rvāt, anupapadyamānaṃ) apekṣya tat (apūrva) upa- kalpyate |

apekṣāyāmapi yāgaphalasaṃbandhapratītī arthāntaraṃ cet ape- kṣeta, kathaṃ tadapratipattau tatyatipattiḥ : (arthāntarasyāmatītau karmaphalasaṃbandhasiddheḥ pratipattiḥ :) , nāmatipannapadārtho vākyārtho yataḥ |
api ca śrutaṃ vākyamanupapannaṃ sāpekṣatvāt 'vijñātā yajeta' itivat adhyāhāryanirdeśāt (adhyā- hāro'syāstīti adhyāhāri svargakāmapadaṃ, tasya anirdeṃ- śāt sāpekṣatvamiti |
vastutastu ) na cānupapattiḥ ('darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti (padaiḥ svārthā- bhidhānadvāreṇa vākyārthyatīteḥ) parisamāpteḥ |
vākya- śeṣānupapatteśca 'apūrva kṛtvā' iti prāgyāgāt apūrva- tpattiprasaṅgaḥ |
yāgena apūrva kṛtvā (yāgena phalaṃ kuryāt) iti dvicaraṇāt yatheḥ (prasajyeta), pūrvaśca doṣaḥ (na tāvat yenaiva yāgena apūrva kriyate tenaiva paścāt phalamapi, karmaṇo viramya vyāpārānupapatteḥ |

arthāta yāgāntareṇa, tathā ca prāgyāgāt phalasādhanāt apūrvotpa- ttiprasaṅgaḥ iti pūrvokto doṣaḥ :) uttaramapi śrutatayā cedanu- papannaḥ (vākyārtheḥ) , pūrva eva vikalpaḥ (tena saha tulyopapatvāt ) svabhāvāntareṇa anupapattau śrutisiddhārthe apūrvakalpanā ityasamīcīnaṃ (syāt) |

(asmin apūrvaviṣayake apūrvapakṣe kaṇikāyāṃ evamupasaṃhṛtaṃ- "so'yaṃ dūṣaṇagaṇo devacūḍāmaṇibhireva pariharaṇīyaḥ, iti ācā- ryeṇa [maṇḍanena ] nodaghāri, tatra ke vayaṃ te, 'tava mama' iti tatropakṣīṇāmativibhavaḥ iti) |
vici. pṛ. 230-34. apūrvaviśeṣeṇa tatkaraṇabhūtayajaviśeṣeṇa vā anvitāḥ prayājādidharmāḥ: ye yasmin prakaraṇe samāmnātāḥ, te tatraiva vyavatiṣṭhante sati prakaraṇaṃ dharmaparyanyadevati |
yāgānuṣṭhānāt pūrvaṃ abhūtaṃ anuṣṭhānottarakālaṃ jāyate iti yaugikatvādeva apūrvaśabdāmidhānaṃ sarvatra svargādiryāyopādānasāmarthyasāmānyaṃ apūrvaśabdavācyam |
su. pṛ. 352, apūrvasaṃyogaḥ bhedāpādakatvāya karma- vighyākṣepaḥ |
pṛ. 827, apūrvasaṃjñāvacchinnatāyāḥ prayojanaṃ, yadi dravyaguṇaśabdā api apūrve codayanti, dravya- guṇapācare na pratinidhiḥ: upādātvayaḥ yathā tatraivaṃ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yathā tarhi siddhāntaḥ, dravyaṃ guṇaṃ vā pratinidhidhāya prayogo'nuṣṭhātavya iti |
vā. prayojanaṃ tu yāvadiha śāstre apūrvopajīvi bhavati ajñānāmapūrvārthatvādideśādi tat sarvaṃ bodhyam |
apūrvasādhanatā na vākyasāmarthyena pratīyate iti sā prakaraṇāt
' 3|1|1|14 pṛ. 711. apūrvasādhanatvākāraḥ ( brīhīṇāṃ avaghāte ) avaśyaṃ vivakṣitavyaḥ |
vā. 3|4|8|24 pṛ. 954. apūrvākāṅkṣā pradhānavidhāveva, na nityavidhau āgneyādividhau ca |
maṇi. pṛ. 85. apūrvāntaraṃ apūrvāntaramān na gṛhṇāti |
dup. 9|1| 2|3 varṇakaṃ 2 pṛ. 1647, prābhākaravat kāryaniyogā- paraparyāyastattvāpūrvābhyupagame paroktā doṣāḥ syuḥ, nāsadidhamatathākathitapāgyayugame iti |
su. pṛ. 598. apūrvārthī dharmāḥ iti sthitaṃ saṃnipatyopakārakā ārādupakārakaśca prakaraṇe pramāṇam |
bhā. 7|1|1|3. saṃnipatyopakārakā ye dharmāḥ: te'pi apūrvārthī iti natve pratipādyate ucchidyate |
' sarvameva kāryaṃ dadhyādi kevala- yamānaṃ na sahasaiva sthūlaivāmnā upacyate |
evaṃ svargādyo'pi aṅkurādisthānīyāṃ tāvadapūrvāvasthāṃ prati- padyante |
vā. 2|1|2 pṛ. 395, yatraiva dravyādīni prati kriyāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ, tatraiva tadannimittāpūrvasiddhiḥ |
1| 2|1|1|8 pṛ. 371. aṅgāpūrvāṇāmapi ātmāśritānāmeva ekārthasama- vāyena pradhānaiḥ saṃvadanānāmapi upakurvatāṃ āśrayaśeṣatvā- bhāvāt ārādupakārakatvaprasiddhiḥ |
āgneyādayaḥ ṣaḍ yāgāḥ bhinnakṣaṇavartino vinaśvarāḥ: saṃbhūya phalapūrve janayituṃ na śaknuvanti, tataḥ tajjana- samarthāni āgneyādīnyapi ṣaṭ avāntarāpūrvāṇi kalpayanti |
na ca dharmebhyaḥ prāk siddhāni niśaṃtopāyaparimāṇāni vā |
su. pṛ. 1512. niyamāpūrve kriyākṛtaṃ na bhavati |
vā. 2|1|1 pṛ. 371. athavātenaiva tuṣavimokaḥ kartavyaḥ iti yo niyamaḥ, saḥ apūrvahetutvena vidheyaḥ |
vi. 2|1|3. yat sākṣāt phalajanakaṃ, tat phalāpūrvemiti manyate |
ke. saṃnipatyopakārakaṇi avaghātādīni dravyadevatāsaṃskāradvāreṇa yāgasvarūpasya atiśayādhānena tadupasrpyaniṣpattau prayādādīni utpattyapūrvebhyaḥ phalāpūrvaniṣpattau sākṣādeva vyāpriyante |
yadi anyadanupāya yāgo vinaśyet, phalaṃ asati nimitte na syāt |
yadi punaḥ phalavacanasāmarthyāt tadeva na vinaśyati iti kalpyate, naivaṃ śakyam |
yat āśrayaṃ deśāntaraṃ prāpayati tat 'karma' ityucyate |
satyapi bhasani astīti cet vidyamānopalambhane'pi ādarśa-
phalakriyā liṅgamiti cet, evaṃ sati adarśane samādhirbhavyam |
saukṣmyādīnāmanyatama (maṃ) bhaviṣyatīti yadi cintyate, kalpitamevaṃ sati kiṃ cidvati, tatpūrve vā kalpyeta tadvā, ityaviśeṣakalpanāyāmāsti hetuḥ, na viśiṣṭakalpanāyām (viśeṣakalpanām) |
anāśritaṃ karma bhaviṣyatīti cet, tadapi tādṛśameva |
svabhāvāntarakalpanena deśāntaraṃ na prāpyati, iti tādṛśameva |
tasmāt bhaṅgī yajiḥ; tasya bhaṅgītvāt apūrvamastīti |
kiṃ cintāyāḥ prayojanam ? yadi dravyaguṇādyapi apūrve codayanti dravyaguṇācāre na pratinidhipādātavyo yathā tarhi pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yathā tarhi siddhānto dravyaṃ guṇaṃ vā pratinidhivāya paurogo'nuṣṭhātavya iti |
vā— siddhaṃ kṛtvā apūrve tatpratipatyapāśanda-viśeṣavicāraḥ kutaḥ |
tasya siddhatvamevāprasiddha, atastadeva tāvatpratipādanīyamityata āha— 'phalāya vihitaṃ karma kṣaṇikaṃ ciramāvine |
tadyatra tāni na pravartante, tat abhāvena abhāvātmanaivāvagamyate |
nahi viśeṣataḥ sāmānyato vā asya kena citsaṃbandho'nubhūtapūrvaḥ |
'padavācyatvaṃ na caitasya vācake śṛṇumaḥ ka cit |
' āgamikatvamapyasya padena vocyamānasya syāt vākyagamyasya vā |
tatra padaṃ na tāvat kiṃ citsākṣādetasya vācakarmasti |
na ca ke citpadārthāḥ śrūyante, yeṣāṃ saṃsargo vā apūrve bhavet |
ye'pi śabdāntarādayaḥ śrutiliṅgādyasya śabdaprakārāḥ, te'pi ca svabhāvasiddhe vastuni bhede vini-yoge vā kāraṇaṃ, na saṅgāve kasya ciditi apūrve prati pramāṇam |
vidhipratiṣedhaviṣayatvācca samastasya vedasya, na ka cidvastusvarūpapratipādanārthaṃ bhavatīti nāgamagamyamapūrvam |
na ca kalpyamāno'rthaḥ kena cidvirdhyate, tadyathā 'suveṇāvacayati' ityukte na ca kathaṃ cidapi māṃsapuroḍāśādīni tenādattuṃ śakyante iti, pratyakṣa-gamyatvāt |
api ca tatrāpi pratyakṣeṇaiva kalpyate dravāṇā-miti |
na caiṣā kalpanā kena cidvirdhyate, śrutahānya-śrutaparikalpanā'bhāvāt |
apūrve tu na kadā cit phala-sādhanatvena saṃbhāvyate, yato''nyakāraṇaniṣedhe sati tadvi-pathā pariśeṣasiddhiḥ syāt |
api ca yadi tāvadapūrva yāgasya sādhyamiṣyate, tataḥ 'śrutaṃ svarga parityajya aśrutaṃ parikalpitaṃ bhavet |
atha phalaṃ prati sādhanabhūtaṃ, tataḥ śrutayāgaparityāgāt saiva gatiḥ |
yadi śāstrādeva gamyate, kiṃ bhavato virudhyate |
triyamāṇena vā phalaṃ sādhanīyamityatra kiṃ pramāṇam |
ca ākāśādīni nityāvāsthitāni kasmāt phalaṃ na sādhayanti |
yadi ca śrayamāṇātirekeṇa avasthāyāvasaṃbhavāt apūrveṇa phalaṃ sādhyate iti kalpyate, tato varamā-kāśādeva kalpitaṃ, tasya hi sthānasadbhāvo'pi tāvat prasiddho, kevalaṃ phalanimittatvamāśrayaṇīyam |
apūrve tu sadbhavāprabhṛti sarve niṣpramāṇakaṃ kalpanīyam |
atha yāgasaṃbandhinā kena cidavasthitena phalaṃ dātavyamitya-miprāyaḥ, tathā satyapi 'yaṣṭurevā''tmano yāgeḥ saṃgatasya sthitasya ca |
nimittatvaṃ varaṃ klaptaṃ lāghavaṃ hi tathā sati |
' yadi yāgasya vināśitvā-danyena tatsaṃbandhinā phalaṃ sādhyamānaṃ yāgena sādhitaṃ bhavati, tato lāghavāttikrāntayāgena ātmanaiva varaṃ sādha-yitavyam |
' vināśini hi karmaṇi codite kiṃ dṛśyate, karma ca vinaṣṭaṃ, śāstraprayāca kālāntare phalaṃ bhaviṣyatīti niścityate |
yacca yat pratyaya upajāyate, tatra tasya nimittatvamityavadhāryate |
na ca cidvastunaḥ sādhyatvaṃ kalpyate iti |
yacca śāstra- pravṛttivelāyāṃ tadantargatatvena nāpavāritaṃ, tat uttarakāla- mevāvadhāryate iti kṛta etat |
' ityetat evāntaraphalatvamalpa- kāraṇavaiguṇyaṃ iti na kālāntaraphalasiddhayarthamapūrva kalpa- nīyam |
anaikāntikī hi tadā arthāpattirguṇyameva- varmanabhūtamatapi kalpayet |
' nahi svargarakau nāma niratiśayasukhaduḥkha- svabhāvau deśaviśeṣatāmapi vā, yau ihaiva anami nānu- bhayeyātāṃ, alaukikānāṃ jihāsopāditā''nupapatteḥ |
ye- tu laukike prakṛṣṭhe sukhaduḥkhe, te karmāntarameva- saṃbhāvyate ityaviśeṣaḥ |
’ prayājādīnāmapi kṣaṇikatvāt svarūpa- saṃnidhabhāve bhavatseva pradhānopakāraḥ kartavyaḥ; iti so'pi cāpūrvābhāvāt karttṛmna eṣopakāraḥ |
tatra yena prakṛtau prayājādyaḥ kṛtāḥ, tasya vikṛtiṣu tadupakāra- saddhāvāt vinā'pi tantramapyavidhānana taphalatvāte prasaṅga- lakṣaṇamasti, iti na punaraṅgānyanuṣṭhātavyāni |
tatra ‘prayāje- prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti’ ityādīni nopacaren |
yadeva hi pratyāsannāni prati karttṛmnakaṃ tadupakārarūpamiṣyate, tadeva dūrasthāyā- mapi vikṛtau ityaviśeṣaḥ |
nivṛtteṣvapūpeṣu amāvāsyāyāṃ kriyamāṇajyāni na nirākariṣyante ityadoṣaḥ |
etayaiva ca diśā utpatti- virodhaḥ parihartavyaḥ |
anayaiva hyarthāpattyā śakyate vaktuṃ, sūkṣmavaya- rūpeṇa tat pratīyate iti |
yadā'pi atyantāsatāmanupatteḥ prāgavadhatvāstitvamabhivyajyate, tadā'pi pratipuruṣaṃ karmabhiḥ svīkaraṇāt phalābhimūkaraṇaṃ śabdādivilakṣaṇaḥ asyābhi- vyaktirbhavati |
yanenoktaṃ ( bhārate sāvitryupākhyāne ) 'aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ niṣkarpa balāyamaḥ' |
iti, tadapi kāvyaśobhārthaṃ vispaṣṭamṛtyuvyavahāraprasaṃsanārthe ca pativratāpraśaṃsāpare vākye prajāpatitvenopasadenāditavyaṃ draṣṭavyam |
na ca sarvagatatve vyomavat sarvaśaroreṣveka ātmā prāpnoti |
naiṣa doṣaḥ, śarīrabhūyastvāt, pratiśarīraṃ ca sukhaduḥkhopalabdhi-vyavasthādarśanāt |
kathaṃ punarnātve'pi sarveṣāṃ sarvaśarīraiḥ saṃbandhānya-dīyasukhaduḥkhāyupalabdhiḥ ? iti cettatrādāha : 'yathā śarīramātre'pi mātṛgarbhamātravarṇanām |
' śarīraparimāṇā-tmavādino'pi kilayaṃ tulyo doṣaḥ, tasyāpi garbhātmasamāna-deśatvāt mātṛkṣetrataḥ tadgatāni sukhādīnyupalabhyeta |
tatra yastasya parihāraḥ, sa sarvasmin sarvaśarīreṣu bhaviṣyatyeva viśeṣaḥ |
yathopalabdhiścite, na tu parapakṣasāmyāpattirevopapattiḥ, tasya ca tobhayorapyanyena paryantatvāt |
apica tasya tvindriyaparimāṇatvāt śarīrākāśe bāhyadeva ātmano'pyamāṇāttve garbhādiśarīreṇa mātṛkṣetrasya prāpti-rasti, yena tulyadoṣatā syāt |
' yadi hyatmanaḥ sukhādīnāṃ ca samānadeśatvena eva saṃbandha-upabhogakāraṇamiṣyeta, tato'yaṃ doṣaḥ syāt |
atha ( apūrve nātmasamevete, kiṃtu ) dravyadavanasamevetāsīttata āha - 'taddinaṣṭaṃ' iti |
na cāsya grahaṇapratibandhahetuḥ kaścidasti, yena na gṛhyeta |

athārthāpattyā grahaṇaprati-bandhādi kalpyeta, tathāpi sati apūrvādihyatadagraha dṛṣṭa-viparītaṃ ca kalpayitavyaṃ, tāvadavinaṣṭamāste, tathā na dṛśyate, tathā pratibandhahetuḥ, tasyāpyadarśananimittaṃ cetyevaṃ tasya-syādityanavasthā, tathā kṣaṇikatva karmaṇaḥ sthānamanupa-labdhikāraṇaṃ ca kalpyamitigauravaṃ, evamanāśritakarmāvi-sthānakalpanāyām |
atha ātmāśritameva saṃyogavibhāgādi akurvadāsīt, tatrāpi dṛṣṭaviparyayādahakalpane syātām |
mūlādhikaraṇaprayojanaṃ, dravyādīnāṃ phalasaṃbandhe teṣāma-dṛṣṭārthatvāt karmaṇāmiva pratiniyamabhāvaḥ |
karmaphalasaṃbandhe tu dravyādeḥ karmotpatyā dṛṣṭārthatvāt samānakāryatva-jñānādasti pratinidhiḥ |
samāpanīyameva karma yena kena cit dravyeṇa |
sadṛśopādāne tu na yatitavyaṃ sadṛśādapi phalaprāpteḥ, karmaṇaścāvihitasādhanaviśeṣasyeṣṭasamānadeśa-pratinidhirityucyate, anyārthatvātsāhaśyasya |
pūrvadravyaṃ hi phalāya pravṛttamāsīt, idānīmānīyāmānaṃ tu pratyayāyi-hārāya naimittikaphalāya vā pravṛttasya karmaṇaḥ siddhayarthamiti |
su- (pṛ. 621) dhātoḥ phalabhāvanākaraṇavācitve śyenādiśabdānāṃ tatsāmānādhikaraṇyāt nāmadheyatā'pi siddhāntaprayojanam |
' tasmāt yāga eva vinaṣṭe'pi phalaṃ sādhayati, sa eva
vā phalaṃ yāvadatiṣṭhate iti śāstraprāmāṇyādagantavyaṃ, nāpūrvam |
prayojanaṃ tu yāva-diha śāstre apūrvajīvi arthajñānamāpūrvāthaitvādite-hādi, tat sarvaṃ bodhyam |
bhāṭṭa- dhālpādeva apūrvamiti sthite, apūrvameva asti na veti cintāyāṃ, klaptatāgyadhaṃsadvāreṇa kṣaṇikasyāpi yāgasya svargasādhanatvopapattau nāpūrvakalpanaṃ, gauravāpatteḥ |

na ca nityatvāt dhvaṃsasya 'dharmaḥ kṣarati kīrtanāt' 'prāyaścittena naśyanti pāpāni sumahānyapi' iti kīrtanātprāyaścittanāśanopapattiḥ, kīrtanādeḥ phalatveti-pratibandhakatvātkīrtananāśakatvāt, kīrtanāttvanātmabhāva-viśiṣṭajyotiṣṭomavyatirikta kāraṇakalpanāyāṃ na kaści-doṣaḥ |
iti prāpte, yogyamapūrvameva kalpyate, gauravasa phalamukhatvena adopa-tvāt |
aṅgena ca pradhānādiphalādyanukūlayogyatā-rūpe svaphale jananīye tat avāntaravyāpāraḥ |
tadatra yatra ekameva pradhānaṃ, tatra pūrvottarāvasthā-tāt tasmāt apūrvotpatteḥ pradhānādavahitaṃ ekamapūrvapūrvaṃ, tena ca sarvāṅgānte paramāpūrvamaparaṃ, iti dve apūrve |
evaṃ pradhānabhede'pi pratipradhānaṃ utpattyapūrvabhedaḥ, paramāpūrve tu ekamiti jñeyam |

iti vākyadvayena yāgatrayakaraṇatānāṃ trikāntaranirapekṣāṇāṃ sāhityāvagateḥ sāhityasya ca ekakāryatvanirūpitaṃ vinā anupapatteḥ pratisamudāyaṃ samudāyapūrvamaparaṃ, tena ca paramā-pūrva, iti navāpūrvasiddhiḥ |
aṅgeṣu tu saṃnipatyopakā-rakāṅgeṣvanyāpūrvāṇāṃ pradhāne eva utpattyapūrvajananānukūlayogya-tājanane upayogaḥ |
yadi tu para-māpūrve na tathā kiṃcit pramāṇamasti ityāśaṅkyate, tato mā'stu tat |
ajñānāṃ tu ārādupakārakāṇāṃ utpattyapūrve eva samudāyāpūrvabhāve phalānukūlayogyatājananeva kārye-mastu |
eva tāvat siddhamapūrva tatra dhātvarthādeva ityapi, dhātvarthasya apūrvajanakatve dravyādeḥ tadarthatvaṃ ityapi ca |
kau. 2|1|4|7 pṛ. 630, apūrvādhikaraṇe kriyājanyādṛṣṭakalpanā'pekṣayā niyamahakalpane lāghavamupādāyiṣyam |
nanu kṛṣṇaviṣāṇā''karaṇe yāgakāryanāśakatva-kalpanā''patteḥ, akaraṇavādeḥ kāraṇatā'vaccheda-kalpane gauravācca ityādi kaustubhe apūrvādhikaraṇe kṣuṇṇam |
siddhe hi asminnadhikaraṇe (svargāmādhikaraṇe) katirikatvanityatve tadanyavattvādeva apūrvādhikaraṇe kriyātiriktākāryasiddhiḥ |
'samidho yajati' 'tantūnayāja yajati' ityādi arthāntaraparatvātpramāṇamedāt nāmadheyasiddhiriḥ, apūrvādhikaraṇanyāyena ca apūrvabhedasiddhiḥ |
phalasya kālāntarabhāvinaḥ kāra-ṇatvaṃ na saṃbhavati iti apūrvakalpanaṃ, parantu phala-siddhau apūrvādhikaraṇopaḥ |
( ita: paraṃ apūrvaśabda: prāya: karmapara: ) apūrva evaṃ gṛhamedhīyaṃ karma cāturmāsyeṣu |
bhā. 10|7|124-33. apūrva ca prakṛtau samānatantrā cedanityatvā- danarthakaṃ hi syāt |
prakṛti: vikṛtyā samānatantrā cet syāt, tadā prakṛtau apūrva vaikṛtaṃ tantraṃ prasajyeta anityatvāt vikṛte: |
kāme nimitte kasmiṃścit upanne sati vikṛti: prāpnoti |
yadi na bādheta anarthakaṃ hi anarthakameva syāt vaikṛtaṃ naimittikaṃ vā kāmyaṃ vā |
nāsti pūrvaṃ yasya tat karma apūrvam |
yā svayameva prakṛti:; yasyā: anyā kā cit prakṛti: nāstyeva, tādṛśaṃ karma apūrva darśapūrṇamāsarūpam |
ke. apūrva arthe vidadhat; arthavattā bhaviṣyati |
bhā. 3|1|6|12, apūrva arthe vidhāsyati, tathā pravṛttaviśeṣakaro bhaviṣyati (samāna- mitarat ityanena iti vidhi: ) |
anuvāda: san apravṛtti- viśeṣakara: anarthaka: syāt |
apūrva: padārtha: apakṛṣyamāṇa: na prācāṃ apakarṣāya kalpate iti ‘tathā'pūrva’ ( 5|1| 26|19 śā. ) ityatra avasthitam |
apūrva paśusome ‘somena yajeta’ ‘agnīṣomīyaṃ paśu- mālameta’ iti |
vi. 2|1|6, apūrva: evaṃ ādhārādaya: ‘ādhārāvāghārayati’ ‘agnihotraṃ juhoti’ iti |
apūrvasu tathāsya vikalpa: syāt sarva- sāmarthyavattvāt |
abhicayane ukhāyā: ādhunanārthā: bījavapanārthāśca mantrā vahava: paṭhitā: |
tatra satyaṃ caturdaśatvaṃ ca pāṭhakramena ādita eva grāhyamiti utsūtra: pūrva- pakṣa: |
tāsu apūrvasu saṃkhyāsu ādito vā madhyato vā yata: kutaściddhā itya vikalpa: syāt |
sarvāsāṃ ṛcāṃ sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ arthavatvaṃ evaṃ syāt |
ādita eva grahaṇe tu adhikānāmānārthyaṃ syāt |
tasmāt sarvāsāṃ marthavattvārthe vikalpa: syāt iti siddhānta: |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: ājyabhāgāṃ prakṛtya ‘na tau paśau karoti, na some’ iti śrūyate |
tatra apūrva prakṛtitve some viṣaye śrūyamāṇaṃ ‘na some’ iti vākyaṃ ‘na tau paśau karoti’ ityasya arthavāda: syāt |
yathā some ājyabhāgau na kriyete, tadvat paśau na kriyete iti paśau ājyabhāgapratiṣedhasya stuti: |
athavā apūrva darśapūrṇamāsake karmaṇi ‘na tau paśau karoti na some’ iti arthavāda: syāt |
some ājyabhāgau na kriyete na paśāvapi, darśapūrṇamāsayoskriyate, iti darśapūrṇamāsakarma praśastaṃ iti stuti: |
tatra dvipatnīke bahupatnīke vā prayoge patnīśabde vacanoha: kartavyo na veti vicāre kartavya: iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
apūrva anya- prakṛtitvena svayaṃprakṛtitvarūpe darśapūrṇamāsakarmaṇi patnīśabde adhikāra: pratīyeta na vikāra: ūha: pratīyeta |
aprade- śāt anyasya prakṛtitvarūpa pradeśasya abhāvāt |
coda- kena anyata: prāpte mantre arthānusāraṇa ūha: syāt, atra tu svayaṃ prakṛtitvāt codakena prātireva nāsti |
patnīśabdasya ākṛtivācakatvena dvayo: bahūnāṃ vā patnīnāṃ vācakatvāt ūhasya na prayojanam |
potrīyaṃ neṣṭryaṃ ityādau karmaṇi tu adhvaryu: apakṛṣyeta nityeta viśeṣasamākhyānāt |
bhā. madhye tu ‘apūrva tvapakṛṣyeta’ iti paṭhitam |
āna- ndāśramādau tu nedaṃ sūtratvena mudritaṃ, kiṃtu bhā.vyatvena |
ke. apūrvatvāt ‘vaṣaṭkartu: prathamabhakṣa:’ ityatra nānyeka- guṇavidhānaṃ duṣkaram |
apūrva- vidhiḥ- utpattividhi- viniyogavidhi- adhikāravidhi- prayogavidhibhedena - caturdhā |
karmasvarūpabodhako vidhi: utpattividhi: yathā ‘agnihotraṃ juhoti’ iti |
ajñātā- bodhako vidhi: viniyogavidhi: yathā ‘dadhnā juhoti’ iti |
phalasaṃbandhabodhako vidhi: adhikāravidhi: yathā ‘agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāma:’ iti |
sa ca nityatvayo bhinna: utpattiviniyogavidhibhyāṃ jīvakaśca |
tatra jāte: apūrvavidhiryā ‘khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kurvīta’ iti |
guṇasya apūrvavidhiryā ‘yadi kāmayeta parjanya: syāt, nīcai: sado minuyāt’ iti |
devatāvidhirapi apūrvavidhi evāntarbhūta:; devatāyā: yāgasiddhyathā adṛṣṭārthatve'pi vidhyekapramāṇatvāt |

āhava- nīyāde: homādhikaraṇabhūtasya vidhirāpi apūrvavidhiveva antarbhūta:; āhavanīyāderapi adhikaraṇatvena dṛṣṭārthatve'pi homavidhinā anākṣitatvena adṛṣṭārthatvasya adhārābhi- hotrādhikaraṇavārtike uktatvāt |
devatāvidhirapi taddhita- caturthī- mantravarṇe- dvitīyā- arthavādabhedāt pañcavidha: |
yathā balavān devadatta: iti na hastinaṃ siṃhaṃ vā apekṣya bhavati |
bhā. 111|8|38 pṛ. 2121. apekṣāsu sarvāsu prakṛtā- saṃbhavena aprakṛtagrahaṇam |
ṭup. 6|3|4|16 pṛ. 1416. apekṣābuddhi: dvitvasaṃkhyānimittaṃ utpāditadvitvā nivartamānā dvitvamapi nivartayati |
asti hi kiṃ vinnimittakāraṇamapi yadupajanitakāryaṃ nivartamānaṃ kārya- mapi nivartayati |
nahi samā- khyā kramasya bādha: saṃkoco vā, tasya yājyādikārya niveśe'pi avirodhāt |
apitu apekṣitavidhānādirūpasya nyāyasya (samākhyāyā bādha: saṃkoco vā) sa tu niyama: samākhyāto durbala eva |
yathā somavamaneṣṭi: vaidikasomasya vamane, na tu laukikasya |
bāla. pṛ. 144. § apekṣitavidhe: (iyaṃ pañcamī ) anapekṣita- vidhānadaurbalyanyāya: |
brīhibhyāṃ vaitupyathai avaghāto'pekṣita: na ājyasānābhyām, iti apekṣita 0 nyāyena avaghātasya auṣadhadravyamātraśeṣatvaṃ teṣāmarthādhi- karaṇe ( 3|1|4 ) darśitam |
parākrama: 4112. § apekṣitavānapekṣitavidhānayo: apekṣita- vidhānaṃ balavat iti nyāya: |
tassāt prathamāpekṣita- kāraṇakatvasimeva anvayavyatireko nyāyasahito kurvate |
kāryasya kāraṇāpekṣā hi prathamamutpadyate, na virodhisaṃsargā- bhāvāpekṣā |
tatrāśādinivṛttyātmā bhāva: ka iti kathya- tām ' |
ye tu āhu:--na tāvat vyāvṛttaprapāṇāṃ atyantavilakṣaṇāṃ khallakṣaṇāṃ anucchata: kaścidātmā saṃbhavati |
na ca khallakṣaṇāni avikalpa- tvāt ānanyavyabhicārāmyāṃ śabdābhidhānīyakaṃ labhante |
ata: atadavyāvṛttireva sarvānupatā śabdārtha iti yathā śābaleyasya agovyāvṛtti: evaṃ bāhuleyasyāpi iti |
yathā āhu: ‘yadrūpaṃ śābaleyasya bāhuleyasya nāsti tat tat |

eṣa ca prayoga: ‘ yadatyantavilakṣaṇānāṃ sādṛśyapāpādaka tadanya- vyāvṛttittvarūpaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā gavāśvakuñjarāṇāṃ anuṣṭhaṃ, tathā gaurayaṃ iti vikalpakāro vilakṣaṇānāṃ śābaleyādīnāṃ sādṛśyamāpādayati ' iti svabhāvahetu: |
na ca agonirvṛttirūpasya abhāvasya āśraya- bhūtaṃ bhāvāntaraṃ bhavanmate saṃbhavati ityāha- tatreti |
1|1| 15 ( ślokavārtikasya apohavādasya vistṛtatvāt, śāstradīpikāsthasya cāpohavādasya kośe ākṛtivāde saṃgṛhītatvāt noddhāro'smābhi: kṛta iti jñeyam ) |
apohavādena saugatābhimata- avasturūpatvacchānnā- pohalatve vedāprāmāṇyāpatte: ākṛte: bhāvarūpatā upāditā |
bāla. pṛ. 7. § ‘apohyamāne cābhāve bhāva evāvaśiṣyate ’ iti nyāyāt akaraṇanivṛtti: karaṇameva nānyat |
‘ autpatti- kastu śabdasyārthena saṃbandha: ’ sūtraṃ 1|1|5. apauruṣeyā vedā:, kartṛsmaraṇābhāvāt |
ṛju. pṛ. 35. apauruṣeyatvaṃ vedānāṃ dṛśyādarśanādinā kartṛbhāvanirāśayā, samā- khyāyā: pravacananimittāyā upapatteśca |
kathaṃ puna: kṛtakā vedā iti ? ke cit manyante, yata: puruṣākhyā: |
puruṣeṇa hi samākhyāyante vedā:, kāṭhakaṃ kālāpakaṃ paippalādakaṃ iti |
na ca puruṣasya anya: śabdena asti saṃbandha: |
yadata: kartā puruṣa:, kārya: śabda iti |
eka eva hi kartā, bahavo'pi pratyayu: |
‘ pada- vākyāśraya: ’ iti ( bhāṣyaṃ, tatra-) vibhāgābhidhā- nāt avibhaktakāryatvācca viveka: |

10|5|9. 'apyagniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt, apyukathye' 'atirātre brāhmaṇasya gṛhṇīyāt' ityādidhvanyaiḥ jyoti- ṣṭomāṅgatvasyāpyupapattiḥ |
