anārabhya śrūyate 'tasmāt suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhāryaṃ' iti |
idaṃ hiraṇyabharaṇaṃ kiṃ prakaraṇadharmaḥ, uta puruṣa- dharmaḥ |
kiṃ karmasu hiraṇyadhāraṇamanukiṃ suvarṇatā vidhīyate, uta viśiṣṭavidhānarūpeṇa puruṣadharmo vidhīyate iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
prakaraṇe na kasya cit prakaraṇe, anārabhya vihitaṃ suvarṇadhāraṇamidaṃ, taddharmaḥ puruṣadharmaḥ syāt |
tataḥ prakaraṇapaṭhitebhyaḥ asya anārabhyādhītatva- rūpasya viśeṣāt |
atra kutūhalaṃ—atha etadeva sūtraṃ pūrvapakṣaparamapi yojyam |
prakaraṇe āmnātamapi hiraṇya- bharaṇaṃ taddharmaḥ ṛtudharmaḥ |
puruṣārthatve vartamānā- padeśārthādātaḥ phalakalpanā'pekṣayā klaptaphalakūpakārā- rthatvāśrayaṇasya jyāyastvāt ityarthaḥ |
na kratūtthāpaka- śabdābhāvāt kathaṃ kṛtvarthatā hiraṇyabharaṇasyeti |
tasya hiraṇyabharaṇasya phalāpekṣasya aviśeṣāt vaidikakriyātvena sāmyatvāt prajājādivat kratūpakārakatvaṃ yujyate--iti |
suvarṇabharaṇaṃ kratoḥ śeṣaḥ syāt na puruṣadharmaḥ |
adravya- tvāt havirdravyeṇa devatayā ca śūnyatvāt nāyaṃ yāgaḥ kaścit |
saṃskārastu ayaṃ, sa ca ṛtuśeṣaḥ, ṛtusaṃbaddha- puruṣasya śeṣo vā syāt |
'tasmāt suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhāryaṃ' iti vihitaṃ suvarṇa- dhāraṇaṃ ṛtuśeṣaḥ ṛtusaṃyuktapuruṣaśeṣo vā, vedasaṃyogāt 'ācāryyaṃ' iti vedasaṃyogaḥ ṛtuśeṣabhūtasya yujyate |
tasmāt suvarṇadhāraṇaṃ karma- dharma iti pūrvapakṣe hetvantaram |

'suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhāryaṃ' iti vihitaṃ suvarṇadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvartha dravyasaṃyogāt, bhāryaṃ iti karmaṇi vihitakṛtva- tyena bharaṇasya hiraṇyalakṣaṇadravyapradhānakatvamenāpi dhāraṇasya dravyasaṃskāratvāttvāt |
syādvā'sya saṃyogavat phalena saṃbandha- stasmāt karmaitiśayāna |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtrayan prāṇaṃ vāśabdena vārayan prathamasūtre- goktaṃ siddhāntaṃ upasaṃharati |
saṃyogavat 'etāvatā haitasā vimukto bhavati' ityetādikaphalena prajāpativratānāṃ
saṃbandhavat asya hiraṇyadhāraṇāderapi 'durvarṇo'sya ātudhyo bhavati, rūpaṃ bibharti' ityādyavādikena phalena saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
tasmāt suvarṇadhāraṇādikaṃ karma puruṣārthaṃ karma iti etiśāyana ācāryo manyate sma |
ke. prakaraṇe tu taddharmastato viśeṣāt iti tṛtīyādhikaraṇe 'suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dhāryaṃ' ityetattulyatayā ālabhyanirvāpayorapi saṃskāratvaniṣedhena asiddhatvaṃ matvā... |
su. pṛ. 126. prakaraṇe tu yacchāstraṃ viśeṣe śrūyamāṇama- vikṛtamājyabhāgavat prākṛtapratiṣedhārtham |
aviśeṣeṇa yacchāstraṃ iti pūrvasūtre uktaṃ, tallakṣaṇārthaḥ |

prakaraṇe na kasya cit prakaraṇe anārabhya paṭhitaṃ yat śāstraṃ, tat avikṛtameva yathāpaṭhitameva vikāraprāpya viśeṣe vikṛtiyāge śrūyamāṇaṃ cet prākṛta- pratiṣedhārthaṃ prākṛtānāṃ codakaprāptānāṃ pratiṣedhārthe bhavati |

yathā anārabhya paṭhitaṃ 'satadaśa sāmidhenīranūyāt' iti śāstraṃ vikṛtiviśeṣe vaigudhyādyalpakādau śrūyate, tena codakaprāptaṃ sāmidhenībhyaṃ bhinnamajñātaṃ bādhyate 'vaigudhyādiṣu saptadaśa sāmidhenīranūyāt, nānyat prākṛtaṃ kuryāt' iti |
ājyabhāgavat yathā gṛhamedhīye uktā- bhyāmājyabhāgābhyāṃ itarājñāni bādhyante tadvat |
anārabhya paṭhitaṃ śāstraṃ viśeṣe avikṛtaṃ cet śrūyeta tadā tat prākṛtapratiṣedhārthe ityuktam |
vikāre tu vikṛtaṃ cet viśeṣe śrūyeta ityarthaḥ |
tadā tat tadarthaṃ viśeṣā- rthameva syāt |
tathāhi sātadaśye anārabhyādhīte sati kasyaciccihnitau yadi pāñcadaśyaṃ śrūyeta, tadā tat pāñcadaśyaṃ tadvikṛtyarthameva syāt nānyasyāṃ vikṛtau iti |
anārabhya- vidhānasya ṛtunā amaṇṇāt vākyaśeṣaḥ syāt ityanvayaḥ |
'saptadaśa sāmidhenīranūyāt' iti yat anārabhya- vidhānaṃ, tasya vaigudhyādyaiḥ anyena vikṛtirūpeṇa ṛtunā agraṇṇāt sātadaśyasya vaigudhyādyairvaigudhyādyakalpakādiṣu śrūyamāṇaṃ śeṣaḥ syāt |
tathā ca yāsu vikṛtiṣu sātadaśyaṃ na śrūyate punaḥ paṭhyate, tāsyeva anārabhyādhītasyāpi sātadaśyasyopasaṃhāraḥ; nānyāsu vikṛtiṣu iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. aprakṛtivikṛtyātmakakarmopadiṣṭayoḥ abhāvayo- vikalpo yathā āghāne vājasanevināṃ 'ṛtu- nakṣatra-saṃbhāra-cātuprāśya-jāgara-iṣma- pūrvāgninvā- rambha-sārparājñīḥ na vā kuryāt' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 162, aprakṛtivikṛtyātmakakarmopadiṣṭayoḥ bhāvayo- vikalpo yathā- āghāne pavamānetīnāṃ pūrṇāhutyā saha vikalpaḥ |
agniṣṭome yajñayajñīye stotre 'girāgirā ca dakṣase' ityatra girāpadasya sthāne irāpadaṃ prayoktavyaṃ iti pūrvabhava- gatam |
tat irāpadaṃ kiṃ pragītaṃ kartavyaṃ, uta apragītaṃ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
śabdādanyatve girāśabdāt anyaḥ śabdaḥ: apragāṇāt hetoḥ tathābhūtopadeśaḥ syāt |
anyaḥ śabdaḥ irāśabdaḥ, tasya bhāvaḥ śabdānyatvaṃ, tasmin śrūyamāṇe apragāṇāt hetoḥ tathābhūtopadeśaḥ syāt |
pragāṇopadeśābhāvāt tathābhūtasya gītiśrūyasya irāpadasya ayamupadeśaḥ syāt iti jñāyate |
tasmāt girāpadasthāne prayoktavyaṃ irāpadaṃ apragītaṃ syāt |
yatsthāne vā tadvritiḥ syāt, padānyatvapradhāna- tvāt |
yatsthāne yasya girāpadasya sthāne irāpadaṃ prayoktavyaṃ, tadvritiḥ tasya girāpadasya yā gītiḥ saiva irāpadasya syāt |
padasya girāpadasya yat anyatvaṃ anyarūpatvaṃ irādirūpatvaṃ tadvidhānārthaṃ idaṃ vākyaṃ padānvala- pradhānam |
gānaviṣaye tu nedaṃ vākyaṃ kimapi brūte, sthānino yā gītiḥ, tāṃ na nivartayati idaṃ vākyam |
tasmāt irāpadaṃ pragītameva prayoktavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
‘uddeyaṃ āīrā cā dākṣāsā’ iti gānasaṃyogāt gānasya saṃyo- gāt saṃyogasya vidhānāt pragītameva irāpadaṃ prayoktavyam |
pūrvapakṣī āha—nanu tarhi idaṃ gānasyaiva vacanaṃ ‘uddeyaṃ āīrā’ ityādi |
anena ca girāpade eva gānaviśeṣo nirdiṣṭaḥ, na pragītamirāpadam |
siddhāntī āha—‘uddeyaṃ āīrā’ ityādivacanena na gītervidhānaṃ, kiṃtu gītiviśiṣṭasya irāpadasya |
irāpadameva girāpadasthāne anena vākyenopadiśyate, gītistadarthaśca sthānagataḥ anucyate |
āīrā iti nirdeśo hi irāpada- syaiva |
ata eva irāpadasyaivārthavādo bhavati, ‘iramahaṃ yajamāne dadāni’ iti |
irā annaṃ tadahaṃ uddātā yajamāne saṃpādayāmi irāpada- paṭhanena ityarthavādārthaḥ |
tasmāt pragītaṃ irāpadaṃ girā- padasya sthāne prayoktavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. apratigrāhyāt pratigṛhyataḥ pāpamasti vaidike- 'pi pratigrahe |
apratipattirūpaḥ dṛṣṭārthaḥ guṇakarmavidhiḥ artha- karmavidhiḥ pratyakṣavidhiḥ yathā ‘vrīhīnavahanti’ |
bāla. pṛ. 13, apratipattirūpaḥ dṛṣṭārthobhayataḥ guṇakarmavidhiḥ pratyakṣavidhiḥ yathā paśupuroḍāśādi āśrayikarma |

‘kriyāḥ jīvati bhartari tadanumatau, proṣite mṛte vā tadanujñāṃ vinā'pi putradānapratigrahayovādhikāraḥ |
anumatiśca aprati- ṣedhe'pi bhavati, ‘apratiṣiddha0’ iti nyāyāt |
‘aprayājāstā anuyājāḥ’ iti jyoti- ṣṭome upasatsu paṭhyate |
apūrvā eva upasadaḥ, na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ |
kaścit svāṅgasyāpi aprayojakaḥ yathā tupopāpaḥ kapālasya svāṅgabhūta- syāpi aprayojakaḥ |
kaścit parāṅgasya svopakāriṇo'pi aprayojakaḥ yathā dadhyānayanasya vājinayāgaḥ |
yathā vā akṣāmyajñaṃ ekahayanīyananadhyāmapi na tasya prayo- jakam |
śaklulohitanirasana- svighkṛdyāga- cātvālāprāsanādiḥ pratipādyasya śaklulohi- tasya śeṣasya kṛṣṇaviṣāṇādeḥ aprayojakaḥ |
tathā prasaṅgī api paśupuroḍāśādiḥ paśvaṅgasya prayājādeḥ svopakāri- ṇo'pi aprayojakaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ svighkṛt iḍā caturdhākaraṇaṃ prāśitraṃ iti śeṣakāryāṇi kiṃ sarvebhyo havibhyaḥ kartavyāni, uta ekasmādeva haviṣ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
aprayojaka- tvāt prayojakatvābhāvāt śeṣakāryāṇi ekasmādeva haviṣḥ kriyeran, na sarvebhyaḥ |
svighkṛdādi prati guṇabhūtatvāt ca ekasmādeva svigh- kṛdādīni kartavyāni iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
svighkṛdādinā śeṣakāryeṇa ca pradhānasya sakṛt saṃskṛ- tattvāt punaḥ saṃskārānapekṣatvāt nāparasmādi kartavyāni śeṣakāryāṇi |
sarvebhyo vā, kāraṇāviśeṣāt saṃskārasya tadartha- tvāt |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtrabhyāṃ prāptaṃ vāśabdena pariharan siddhānta- māha |
ekasya haviṣaḥ śeṣakārya- kriyāyāṃ yat kāraṇaṃ pratipattirnāma, tat sarveṣāṃ avi- śiṣṭaṃ samānam |
samānatve hetumāha saṃskārasya pratipādana- rūpasya tadarthatvāt havirthatvāt |
tasmāt pratipatti- saṃskārasya śeṣakāryakāraṇasya sarveṣu samānatvāt sarvebhya eva śeṣakāryāṇi kartavyāni naikasmādeveti siddhāntaḥ |
svighkṛdādiśeṣakārye liṅgadarśanāt, ‘devā vai svigh- kṛtamabruvan havyaṃ no vaheti, so'bravīt varaṃ vṛṇe, bhāgo me'stīti, vṛṇīṣveti te'bruvan |
atrārthavāde sakṛtaskṛt iti vīpsāpyarūpasya liṅgasya darśanāt ca sarvebhyaḥ pradhāna- havibhyaḥ sakāśāt śeṣakāryāṇi kartavyāni iti gamyate |
ke. aprayojakādilakṣaṇaṃ bhāṣye ‘sādhāraṇaṃ bhavet tantraṃ parārthe tatraprayojakaḥ |
asyarthaḥ, sādhāraṇaṃ anekapāṃ yatra prayojakatvaśakti- rasti, tat tantraṃ, yathā prayājādeḥ sakṛdanuṣṭhānam |
parārthe tatraprayojakaḥ, atra parārthe paramātmārthe ityarthaḥ |
evamapi puroḍāśapāle avyāptiḥ ‘kapāleṣu śrapayati’ iti saptamyā parasmin śrapaṇe iva kapālānāṃ ‘puroḍāśapālena’ iti tṛtī- yayā tupopāpe'pi tādarthyāt |
‘evameva prasaṅgaḥ syāt’ ityukte kastarhi aprayojakaprasaṅgayorbhedaḥ?, ityata uktaṃ ‘vidyamāne svake vidhau’ iti |

yadyapi bhadante, paśu- puroḍāśe prasaṅgopakāraprayājādeḥ anajñatvāt tadaṃśe puro- ḍāśīyaḥ atideśaḥ prayogavacanaśca lupyate, tathāpi piṣṭa- lepaphalakaraṇayajñabhāgādisādhāraṇyena tāvat prayājādi- prayuktisamartho vidhirasti, vājinādividhistu vājinādeva vipayakaroti, na ca tasya tatra prayojakaśakti- rasti, anyan hi cinmaitrāvau viṣayīkaroti iti vaipamya- mityarthaḥ |
atrārthe dādaśādhyāyādyabhāṣyagatasya tacchukle- kavyākhyānagranthasya tātparyaṃ varṇanīyam |
vaiśyastome nāma kratau ‘kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati’ ityāmnāyate |
tatra kaṇvarathaṃtare pṛṣṭhe rathaṃtarasya vā dharmāḥ kartavyā vahato vā, uta ubhayorapi iti vicāre siddhā- ntamāha |
kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ prakṛtau jyotiṣṭome nāsti iti tat aprākṛtam |
tasmin aprākṛte kaṇvarathaṃtare tadvikārāt tadvikāratvāt tayoḥ bṛhadrathaṃtarayorubhayorapi vikāratvāt dvayorapi aviruddhā dharmāḥ kartavyāḥ |
viruddhāt virodhāt vyavatiṣṭheran vyavasthā bhaveyuḥ rathaṃtarakāryaṃ rathaṃtaradharmāḥ, bṛhatkāryaṃ ca bṛhaddharmā iti |
tasmāt aviruddhānāṃ samuccayaḥ, viruddhānāṃ ca vyavasthā iti siddhāntaḥ |
amīpomīye paśau maitrāvaruṇasya śeṣabhakṣo'sti na veti vicāre nāstīti pūrvapakṣasūtram |
tatra ca maitrāvaruṇo nāstyeva, iti sa na prākṛtaḥ |
maitrāvaruṇasya aprākṛtatvāt ati- deśābhāvāt abhakṣatvaṃ bhakṣaśūnyatvam |
vedasya atātparyāt yathāprasiddhaṃ medamādāya puṃsaḥ puruṣā- sambandhāt |

saṃskārakaraṇagṛhadveṣaprakaraṇādīnāṃ pārthakyeopanibandhāt pañcāṅgadoṣapāvadakatā kṛto nāstīti cedyucyate |
tatra hi ‘pañcāṅgasaṃśuddhadanādike ca’ iti vasiṣṭhādibhiḥ, ‘parvātyariktonnatīti śubhe'ddhi’ iti granthakṛtā'pyati-deśopanibandhaśca kṛtatvāt |
tasmādavādhenopapattau vādho na nyāya iti heto-rviyapakṣa viveke ityeva yuktaḥ pakṣaḥ ityuktaṃ jyotirvidā govindaśarmaṇā |
sāhastrī. 586. avādhena upa-pattau bādhāyogāt iti nyāyaḥ |
yat siddhāntavārtike uktaṃ tadapi parāstaṃ, avādheno |
nanu abhāvaprameyādināmāpi bhūtal- svasaṃvedanasiddhaḥ sa evābhāvavyavahārasādhanāya paryāptaḥ, grahaṇasadbhāvajñānakāraṇaṃ eṣitavyam |
na tāvat vastusadbhāvaṃ smṛtvā ca pratiyoginam' iti |
tatra na vinā ghaṭātulambhaṃ bhūtalopalabdhamātramabhāvavyavahāra- tāvat saṃsṛṣṭabhūtalagrahaṇastadvedyaḥ |
na ca bhūtalopalabdham eva tadupalambha iti saṃbhavaḥ, ghaṭasaṃsṛṣṭabhūtalasya, tatra ghaṭābhāvaniśśrayaśceti |
na khalu cāsau apratītasadbhāvavyavahārasādhanaṃ, prekṣādvyavahā- sa eva tasya heturiti sāmpratam |
tadabhāvasasādhanaṃ tu ginī ghaṭādau bhūtalmātragrahaṇaṃ ghaṭābhāvaparicchedahetuḥ bhavet, ajñātasyāpi jñānopāyadarśanād cakṣurādivat |
ityakāmenāpi ghaṭābhāvāddvaitavyaṃ kaivalyaṃ bhūtalsya svīkāra- nanvevaṃ sattāmātreṇopāyatvamabhyupetaṃ bhavati, taccānupapannaṃ, ṇīyam |
tadeva cābhāvavyavahāraninvanamiti kiṃ anta- asatyanupalambhe tadbhāvabuddhisamutpādaprasaṅgādityukam |

api tu kiṃ ayamāsīccaitraḥ' itipraśamameye tadupalambhamānaḥ sa tulyopalambhayogyasya pratiyogino'nupalambhane sati asya eva maitraḥ kathaṃ tadupalambhavān ? satyaṃ, gṛhṇāti caitraṃ, tatkāraṇatvamiṣyate |
tadāha 'smṛtvā ca pratiyoginam' na tu smaratasya prāktanīṃ tatra sattāṃ, calaratale'tha |
anena agrahaṇamātratāṃ asya sūcayati, tattve smṛtya- ca smṛtirupalambha iti tadabhāvo'pyanupalambha nupapatteḥ |
tena yathā grahaṇārhasyāgrahaṇaṃ tadabhāva- nupalambha iti sāmpratam |
nopalabdhacarasaṃsṛṣṭabhūta- vīkṣāsādhanaṃ, evaṃ satyapi samprati tasya grahaṇe lopalabdhe'pi, ghaṭānupalambhaprasaṅgāt |
tadā'pi bhūtalo- prāktanī caitrasya sattā calaratasya |
tatra madhyaṃdine smara- palambhasya bhāvāt, ghaṭānupalambhasya ca tadvyatirekāt |

ṇāīṃ na smaryate iti mārthādinsmaraṇābhāvaḥ sannidhi nanu ayaṃ anupalabdhaḥ pratīto vā sādbhāvajñāne prāktanābhāvaviṣayaṃ mārthyadinaṃ pratyarthaṃ kṣaṇa janayi- hetuḥ, apratīto vā ? na tāvat pratītaḥ, anavasthā''- tum |
makaragatasya savituḥ tītatve tu sattyā hetuḥ syāt |

tathā ca yadā ayaṃ pramā- mīnādiṣu sattāyāśca caityavandanādidharmatāyāśca darvi- ṇopalambhacaratvabhūtalapramitisabhāvāt tadā'pi apra- homāpūrvatvasya ca dhvanyāgamanamātropapatraṇaśravaṇasya tītatve caitrābhāvaṃ tu aciraprāptacaitraviśiṣṭacalaratale- sajātīyaparaṃparā'''rambhaṇasya nivāraṇābhāvāt |
pramāṇānta- palambhavān pṛcchayate 'maitra, prāk kimāsīdidaṃ caitraḥ ?' rāṇāmitra apramāṇasyāpi smaraṇasya svaviṣaye yogyalopa- iti, sa tadā tadyabhasamuditajijñāsaḥ |
pratyāntarasakalakalpakasya ca dṛśyatvasya viṣaya- hṛdayamānasya caitrasya asatāṃ tadānīmeva avadhāryottara- kārakasya eva pratyaye upapatteḥ |
tadabhāve cānumānādi- māha, 'āyuṣmannāsīdiha caitraḥ saṃprataḥ' iti |
na viṣiyāṇāṃ prameyatāṃ ca ktim abhāvaḥ |
tadabhāvaharo vā ca prāktano'nupalambhaḥ tasya samprati tarnī abhāvadhimā- viṣayātiriktraprayatnāntarasakalye saṃbhavati, tasmin sati dhātumarhati |
na khalu nimittatayanayabhūtalaḥ prācyā nayana- tadvirodhābhāvapratyayavyavahāropapatteḥ |
na ca viṣayakā- sattayā samprati rūpaṃ paśyati |
na copalambhānupalambhayorvira- nāstinimitto vā ? na tāvannāstinimittaḥ, kādācitka- rodhaḥ, asamasamayaṣṭitabhāvābhāvasādhanatayā bhinnaviṣaya- ttvānupapatteḥ |
sattāmātreṇa abhāvasādhane tu ca nāsti, bhāvavyavahārasyapi apahavaprasaṅgāt ityu- anupalambhasya dṛśyatvamasya tatheti tajjñānasiddhaye ktam |
saddvyāvṛttirūpasya tasya pratīyamānatvāt svato'vāntara- dṛśyatvasiddhaye hi sā |
bhavatu vā dṛśyatvajñānaṃ hetuṃ, śaktyādīnāmapi tadyasaṅgāt |
teṣāmapi hi na khalo bhedo bhūtalajñānavat, kimāyātamanupalambhasya ? nahi āloko |
jñeyaśaktyabhedādīnāṃ tadvedanirūpaṇamiti jñāyamānaḥ kāraṇamiti cakṣuṣā'pi tathā bhavitavyam |
na ihāpi pratiyogibhedena tadvedanirūpaṇāditi ca dhūmo'vagataḥ anumānajñānakāraṇamiti mano'pi |
tasmāt sattyā anupalabdhaḥ abhāva- jñānakāraṇamiti nānavasthā |
calaratalopalambhasya caitrānupalambhe sati tadadvaitatvāpi sattāyā abhāvāt vyāvṛtteḥ |
tadabhāvamapyavyavahāro vastusadbhāvagrahaṇa- hāsamāha) - abhāvaḥ prameyaḥ iti suvyāhṛtam |

pramīyate ca iti kathaṃ ? (upahāsakaḥ kaścit śaṅkate -) yathā satsu api tanpu kadā cit paṭaḥ prādurbhavan tada- yadā nābhāvaḥ prameyaḥ kaṇṭhakādīnāṃ, iti niraṭaṅki, kathaṃ tiriktasaṃyogabhedajenmeti |
dṛśye pratiyogini smarya- tarhi nāstīti vyavahāraḥ ? (upahāsaka āha -) viṣa- māṇe vastusadgrahaṇe sati abhāvavyavahāro'
tu anayorvirodhaḥ tajjñānasaṃtyā saha tasya ciramavasthiteḥ yatu, ya eṣa laukikānāṃ ka cit nāstīti pravṛttinivṛ- |
1) purastācca (iṣṭāniṣṭasādhanasya purastāt ttilakṣaṇo vyavahāraḥ; kimayaṃ aparicchedāt, uttānyapari- |
prakṛtamupasaṃharati-) tasmāt nānya- cchedāt, uta tadabhāvaparicchedāt ? |
pramitinivandhane, nāpi apramitinivandhane 'anabhimaṃtaṃ dāt na iṣṭatvābhāvaṃ jijñāseran, aparicchedādeva |
abhimataṃ nāsti, abhimataṃ nāsti' iti pravṛttinivṛttī |
nāstijñānasya ko viṣayo nirūpitaḥ ? (apara āha-) mānadehasya prameyabhāvasyānupamāgā
na ca anyāsaṃjñasvarūpamātragrahaṇāt, sūkṣmakaṇṭakādigoṇiti bhūtale svarūpamātreṇa gṛhīte pravṛttiprasaṅgāt, prayatnapūrvikāyā jijñāsāyā ayogāt |
tathā abhāvasya prameyatve śaśaviṣāṇādīnāmapi anu- mānaṃ nirbhādhamāsajyeta |
nanu ca bhāvapratītivat indriyasaṃyogajatvenāpi kathaṃ anindriyajā ? |
bhāvagrahaṇaṃ ca indriyeṇa, iti tadbhāvabhāvitvaṃ anyathāsiddham |
kimatra pramāṇamiti cet, gṛhītābhāvasvarūpamātrasya uparatanendriyavyāpārasyāpi deśāntaragatakāraṇāntaropajātajijñāsasya abhāvapratīti- darśanāt |
tadidaṃ abhāvākhyaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ bhāṣyenānena lakṣitaṃ iti |
bṛhatī— (ācārya āha—) kimanena pratīyate ? (pratipakṣī—) uktaṃ 'nāstītyayamarthaḥ' iti (ācāryo nirākaroti—) kiṃ ca tatrāsti ? (prati- pakṣī—) prameyamānasya prameyatā |
ṛju— nanu mā bhūt yanna pramīyate tasya prameyatvaṃ, kiṃtu tasya tu yannāstitvaṃ abhāvasaṃvandhavat bhūtalaya- dhikaraṇaṃ, tat prameyamastu iti |
yo'pi hi pṛthagbhūta- mabhāvamāha tenāpi bhūtalsyāpi pramīyamāṇatā'pi aṅgīkaraṇīyaiva |
na ca apramīyamāṇatvaiva prameyaṃ, yasmāt tadarthā saṃsṛṣṭānubhavatvaṃ ātmanaḥ tasyārthasya apramīyamāṇatā |
kiṃca yo'pi abhāvaṃ pramāṇamāha, tasyāpi tajjñānotpattau tadsaṃvandha- bhavayoga eva kāraṇam |
sa ca na cakṣurāditvat ajñāta eva sattāmātreṇa jñānajanakaḥ |
yataḥ saṃprati dṛśyamāne- ṣvapi bhūtalādiṣu kasmiṃścidasatyapi tadanupalambhena 'āsīdidaṃ prāgiha' iti pratītirdṛśyate |
ataḥ saṃprati nāstitvabuddhiḥ prāktanādeva kevalapalambhāt adhunā smṛtisamārūḍhāt upajāyate iti balādabhyupagamanīyam |
kimarthāntara- parigraheṇa ? yā ca sā kevalapalambhayogitā ātmanaḥ, sā ca kathaṃ cit arthopalambhasāmagrīvaikalyena, ka cicca sākalyena |
tatra yeyaṃ abhāvavyavahāraṃ pravartayati, tāmeva hi tādṛśīṃ daśāṃ anusaṃdadhataḥ 'kṣititale ghaṭo nāsti' iti vyavahāraḥ pravartate |

prayatnapūrvikā'pi ca jijñāsā bhūtalādiṣu sūkṣmakaṇṭakādiṣu viṣayopalambhahetusākalye'pi eṣā avasthā iti paryadhita, iti kā anupapattiḥ ? anyathā hi 'sūkṣmatvāt iyamavasthā ātmanaḥ' iti śaṅkayā niḥśaṅko nāmāvavyavahāraḥ syāt |
asyāmeva ca pratipakṣabhūtāyāṃ nāstitvamikāyāṃ siddhayāṃ anumānaṃ śaśādisaṃvandhino vipāṇādīnāṃ na pravartate iti abhāvasya prameyāntaratvaṃ nāstīti siddham |
ṛju. pṛ. 92-93. bṛhatī— lakṣaṇamapi pramāṇabhāvaḥ iti pramāṇabhāva ityeva lakṣyati |
na cāsya anyato lokattha pramāṇatā avasīyate |
ato na vidmaḥ, prasiddheḥ kiṃ bījamiti |
(siddhāntī—) kimatra na jñāyate ? granthatastāvat pramāṇabhāva eva avasīyate |
(pūrvapakṣī—) kiṃ tarhi anena lakṣitena ? pramāṇagatyarthaḥ ayārambhaḥ, tadanusāri hi arthaniścayaḥ kathaṃ syāditi |
(pūrvapakṣī—) kimanena pūrvoktānāṃ pramāṇanāṃ svarūpamavasīyate ? (siddhāntī—) yat pūrvaireva svalakṣaṇairnāvasīyate (—tadanenāvasīyate) |
nahi utpāda- mātrāt jñānasya arthe tasmin pramāṇasya pramāṇatā avasīyate |
tasmāt kāryapratyakṣatvāt 'nāsti' ityanena pūrvoktasyaiva lakṣaṇasya sādhyatā ucyate |
yadi punarvyavahārānyātvāt kāraṇānyatvaṃ manyante kiṃ kurmaḥ |
(yadi tāvat ke cinmīmāṃsakāḥ [ bhaṭṭapādāḥ [ pramāṇānyatvaṃ manyante tataśca vayaṃ kiṃ kurmaḥ |
nahi vyāmugdhān alaṃkurute puruṣa- prayatnaḥ iti teṣāmapekṣā kāryā |
sarvaṃ hi vastu sadasadātmanā dvividhaṃ, tadyadā yatra sadūpeṇa vartate tattadā tatra pratyakṣādibhirastīti pratīyate |
yatra tasadrūpeṇa vartate, tatra sadrūpeṇa bodhakānāṃ pratyakṣādīnāṃ sadrūpabodhanāyogetyut yogavatve satyapi yo'nutpādo dṛśyādarśanayogyānupalambhā- diparyayo bhāṣye pramāṇābhāvaśabdenoktaḥ |
tenaivendriyaśabdā- disyānīyena nāstīti pratīyate, bhūtale'tra ghaṭo nāstīti |
yastu nāstitvamapahantya prameyābhāvāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ pramāṇaṃ nāstītyāha, tasya dṛśyādarśanāntaraṃ 'nāstīha bhūtale ghaṭaḥ' ityevamupajāyamānasya jñānasya kimālambanam ? na bhūtalam |
tathā gavi 'yaḥ aśvo na bhavati' iti pratyayo rūpe ca 'raso na bhavati' iti, tasya kimālam

rasthe deśāntaragrahaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ' iti mataṃ, tataḥ śābleyasthitaṃ gotvaṃ dhāvalaye nāstīti vyavahiyeta, sthūṇā ntarasthitaśca vaṃśāḥ sthūṇā ntare'nusyūto'pi tatra nāstīti vyavahartavyaḥ syāt, ato'bhāva eva nāstīti vyavahārakāraṇaṃ, nānyatra sadbhāvaḥ |
saṃprayānītasya ca ghaṭasya gṛhyamāṇa- syaiva 'prāgayamiha nāsīt' iti prākālīnābhāvavyavahā- rāt |
nanu bhavanmate pramīyamāṇasya ghaṭasya kathaṃ prākālī- nābhāvajñānaṃ, bhāvapramāṇābhāvo hyabhāvajñānakāraṇam |
saṃprati pramīya- māṇo'pi ghaṭaḥ prākālasaṃbandhitayā na pramīyate, ataḥ prākālasaṃbandhaghaṭapramāṇāṇudayāt tatkālīnāmāvajñānaṃ yuktameveti cet |
nahi prākālasaṃbandho- 'dhunā pramāṇaṃ yogyaḥ, yogyapramāṇābhāvasyābhāvajñāna- kāraṇaṃ, na pramāṇābhāvamātram |
prākāle tu yogyasyaiva pramā- ṇasyānudayaḥ āsīt, nahi tadānīṃ ghaṭyābhāvaḥ sannapi pramitaḥ, pratiyogino ghaṭasyāparāmarśāt tadapekṣātvābhāva- jñānasya |
ata eva ghaṭābhāvo'dhunā smaryate iti na yuktaṃ, apramitasya smaraṇā yogāt |
yathāyaṃ prākālītaḥ pramāṇā- nudayaḥ, so'dhunā pramāṇodayena naṣṭo nābhāvānamutpādayitu- marhati, uddhṛtamātraṃ netraṃ rūpabuddhim |
atha naṣṭo'pi hyastanaḥ iva dhūmo vinaṣṭo'pi smaryamāṇo hasta- nābhiśānam |
syādevaṃ yadi pramāṇābhāvo jñāyamāna- tayā meyābhāvaṃ bodhayet liṅgamiha liṅginam |
so'pi cābhāvatvāt anye- nābhāvajñānena jñātavyaḥ; so'pyanyena na janmadahaleti ghaṭābhāvo'vadhāryate |
tasmāt sattāmātreṇa pramāṇābhāvo- 'bhāvajñānamutpādayati netrādivadityaṅgīkartavyaṃ, ataḥ pramīyamāṇasya ghaṭasya kathaṃ prākālīnābhāvapramitiriti vaktavyam |

ucyate—sattāmātreṇa jñānābhāvaṃ jñeyābhāvaṃ bodhayatīti sammagukte, asyeva tvadhunā dṛśyamānasyāpi ghaṭasya prākālasaṃbandhagocarayogyajñānānudayaḥ, sa hi prākāla- saṃvandhitayā smartuṃ yogyaḥ sannapi na smaryate |
na cāvaśyaṃ pramāṇābhāva evābhāvasya bodhakaḥ, smaraṇajñānasyāpi yogyatve sati anudayaḥ abhāvaṃ bodhayatyeva |

tena saṃprati dṛśyamāno'pi ghaṭo yadi prāgāpyāsīt tato'vaśyaṃ tatra sthitena pramitaḥ syāt, pramitaścādhunā smartavyaḥ syāt, evaṃ satyapi na smaryate, so'yaṃ sarvatathyaviṣayasmaraṇānudayaḥ saṃprati vidyamānaḥ, saṃprati tanaṃ prākālīnābhāvaviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ janayatīti na kiṃ viditupapannam |
yadvā pramāṇasya smaraṇaphalatvāttadabhāvo'pi phalataḥ pramāṇā- bhāva eveti śakyate vaktum |
nanu sattāmātreṇa yogyā- nupalabdherabhāvabodhakatvaṃ yuktaṃ, satyāmapi tasyāṃ kadā cida- bhāvabuddhayanudayāt, asatyāmapi kadā cidudayāt |

tathāhi, yo'ṅgulīkayugamubhayataḥ sasantamāpavarakadeśaṃ hastābhyāṃ sarvataḥ parāmṛśan, tasya tāvat sarvadeśaparāmarśāt vastuto yogyānupalabdhirjātaiva, atha kiṃ sarvaṃ deśaḥ parāmṛṣṭaḥ, kiṃ vā kaściddeśo na parāmṛṣṭo'pi syāditi sandihāno yogyānupalabdheraniścayāt satyāmapi tasyāṃ nāṅgulīkasyā- bhāvamavadhārayati |
kadā cittu sarvataḥ aparāmṛśyāpi sarvataḥ parāmṛṣṭati bhrāntyā yogyānupalabdhiṃ niścitya asyāmeva tasyāṃ bhrāntyā aṅgulīkasyābhāvamavadhārayati |
tasmāt khasavetyā tanmātrasaṃvideva dṛśyasya pratiyoginaḥ abhāvo na tattvāntaram |
(siddhāntī āha—) nanu cābhāvā- naṅgīkāre tanmātrabhīrā na kadā citparicchettuṃ śakyate na ca bhūtalīreva tanmātradhīḥ, saṃsṛṣṭadhiyo'pi tanmātra- tā''pātāt, tatrāpi bhūtatvabhāsāt |
ato ghaṭyādi- vedanābhāve sati yā bhūtaldhīḥ, sā tanmātradhīḥ |
yogyapramāṇānudayastasya sattāmātreṇa netrādivadoṣakaḥ, na jñātatayā, yato'navasthā syāt |
yattu satyāmapi yogyā- nupalabdhau abhāvānavadhāraṇaṃ, asatyāṃ cāvadhāraṇamiti, tattu yogyajñānakṛtam |
yogyatvaṃ jñātatayaiva kāraṇaṃ, na sattāmātreṇa, tataḥ sadaiva yogyatvaṃ kadā cidajñātaṃ nābhāvamavadhārayati, kadā cittu avidyamānameva yogyatvaṃ bhrāntyā niścitya abhāvamavadhāra- yati |
upalabdhyādisu sattāmātratayā kāraṇaṃ na jñātatayā, tena nānavasthā''pattiriti sarvamavadātam |
na ca tadaindriyakaṃ, indriyavyāpārā- bhāve'pi tajjñānotpattidarśanāt |

yo'hani prātaḥkāle gṛhe avasthite madhyadinasamaye pṛcchayate 'kimasmin gṛhe prātaḥkāle māthuraḥ kaścit puruṣaḥ śuklavāsā dīrgha- tamo lohitavarṇaḥ samāgataḥ', iti, sa tadānīmeva yogya- smaraṇānudayāt tasyābhāvaṃ prātaḥkālīnamavadhārayati vine- vendriyavyāpāreṇa |
na ca prātaravagato'bhāvastadā smaryate iti vācyam |
pratiyogino māthurasya tadānīṃ kathaṃ cidapi buddhau anarohāt, aśuddhiśca tasya pratiyogina bhāve tadabhāvajñānāsambhavāt |

evaṃ ca yatrāpi idānīme- vānupalabdhendriyavyāpāreṇa saṃnihitadeśakālavartyabhāvaḥ pratīyate, tatrāpi yogyajñānānudayasyaiva kathamasāmarthyasya kāraṇatvasaṃbhavāccendriyasya kāraṇatvaṃ kalpayituṃ śakyam |
nāpyanumeyaḥ, ajñātatena tena kasya cinliṅgasya saṃgrahagrahaṇābhāvāt |
yadatra kaiścidu- cyate 'dṛśyasya sattā darśanāvyāptā, tena vyāpakībhūta- darśananivṛtyā vyāpyasya dṛśyasya nivṛttirasīyete' iti, tanni rastam |

vyāpakanivṛtyā vyāpyanivṛttimumimānena, avaśyaṃ dṛṣṭāntadharmiṣu nivṛttidvayamavagamya tayośca niyama- mavadhārya sādhyadharmiṇi pakṣe ca sādhanabhūtā darśananivṛtti kena cidātmāneāvagatasya tato dṛśyanivṛttiranumātavyā, nivṛtteśca abhāvātmikāyā na pratyakṣatvena grahaṇaṃ saṃbhavati, nivṛttantareṇa tadanumāne, tadapi nivṛttirūpatvāccinivṛttya- ntareṇānumātavyaṃ, tadapi tathaityanavasthā''pattiḥ |
ato- 'vaśyaṃ ca cit pramāṇāntarabhūtā anupalabdhyā abhāvaḥ pratyetavyaḥ |
'vaṭaveṣṭe vaiśravaṇaḥ' ityādikaṃ caitihyaṃ pramāṇameva na bhavati, nirṇayābhāvāt |
prāti- bhāvyamapi pramāṇaṃ kaiścid 'śrutte śrutā āgantā' ityādikaṃ, tacca liṅgādyābhāsajaṃ, aniścāyakatvādevāpramā- ṇam |
ato yat kāśyapīyeḥ pratibhāgamyamuṣaṇāṃ dharmā- dharmavyāmādhivattadasāram |
tathā ca bhagavadāmāyaṇe 'rāma paṅ yukto loke yābhiḥ sarvo'nudrīyate' iti |
'nāsti' iti vyāhāravyavahārau pramāṇāntaramantareṇa nopapadyate iti cenna, bhūtalādiviśeṣādepavopapatteḥ |
nanu ca nāstitvavyavahārasya astitvavyavahāraviṣayabhūtaṃ bhūtalaṃ nālambanaṃ, astināsti- vyavahārayorviṣayatāprasaṅgāt |
naivaṃ, abhāvārthaṃ prameyama- stīti vādinā'pi tadabhāvasya astitvavyavahāraviṣayatva- maṅgīkṛtaṃ, itarathā abhāvābhāvasya nāstitvaprasaṅgāt |
tata- ścābhāvo'pi nāstitvavyavahāre viṣayo na syāt |
atha yadyapyabhāvasya sāpekṣayā astitvavyavahāraviṣayatvaṃ, tathāpi ghaṭāpekṣayā nāstitvavyavahāraviṣaya iti |
evaṃ tarhi bhūtalaṃ- mapi sāpekṣayā astitvavyavahāraviṣayaḥ, ghaṭāpekṣayā nāsti- vyavahāraviṣayaḥ iti kiṃ tattvāntaramabhyupagamyate ? bhūtalaṃ- mātasya viṣayatvāt |
atha tato'- nyat, aṅgīkṛtaṃ tarhi tattvāntaram |
athaikāki bhūtalamiti cet, ekāki cāsāhayamiti sahāyābhāvāṅgīkāraprasaṅgaḥ |
atha smaryamāṇe'pi pratiyogini bhūtalema ālambanaṃ, gṛhyamāṇe tu smaraṇābhāvādeva na nāstitvavyavahāraḥ, evaṃ tarhi deśāntaresthe gṛhyamāṇe, deśāntare tadabhāvavyavahāro na syāt |
atha tatrāpi deśāntarasaṃbandharūpasya pratiyogi- gitvāt tatsaṃbandhitayā smaraṇāsaṃbhavāt nāstitvavyavahāro syāt |
naivaṃ, priye putrādau jñāte'pi punarnajijñāsāsaṃbhavāt vyavahāraprasaṅgāt |
jijñāsāyāśca vilakṣaṇavyavahārahetutvaṃ vilakṣaṇajñānahetutayā dṛṣṭaṃ, ato ghaṭajijñāsāyāṃ nāstitvavyavahārahetutvaṃ bhūtalāti- riktaghaṭābhāvaparicchedenaiva bhavatītyaṅgīkṛtaṃ tattvāntaram |
atha tadatiriktasāmagrīviśiṣṭaṃ bhūtalālambanaṃ, saṅghaṭe tu tadabhāvācca pratyakṣa iti |
kimidaṃ tadatiriktatvam ? yadi tato'nyatvaṃ, tarhi saṃsṛṣṭavyavasāyāmāpi tatsaṃbhavāt nāsti- vyavahāraprasaṅgaḥ |
ato'pi etat bhūtalāmātravijñānaṃ na kāraṇaṃ, api tu bhūtalabuddhiviśeṣaḥ |
na cāpyabhāvajñānaṃ, amāvāvadimā- rabhāvajñānakāraṇatvena vilakṣaṇabuddhereṅgīkārāt, ato yasyābhāvajñānotādakalyamaṅgīkṛtaṃ, tenaiva vyavahāro'stīti |
naivaṃ, abhāvajñānādapakṣasya śaṃsasya na bhūtalātirikta- viṣayatvaṃ, bhūtalāmātraviṣayatve'pi na saṃsṛṣṭavyāmābhāva- jñānakatvaṃ, sahakārivaikalyāt |
ghaṭānupalabdhistu saha- kāriṇī, tena anupalabdhiviśiṣṭaṃ bhūtalāmātrajñānabhāva- jñotādakam |
evaṃ tarhi tadeva vyavahārakāraṇamastīti cet, naivaṃ, viṣayavailakṣaṇyābhāvāt |
tathāhi, bhūtalā- mātratve'pyupalambhasahakārisamavadhānatvāt jñānāntarotpāda- katvamupapadyate, yathaikasya ghaṭasya cakṣuḥsparśanemadāt jñānabhedaḥ |
tava tu bhūtalāmātra- jñānāt anupalabdhisahakṛtāt vilakṣaṇavyavahāro nopa- dyate, vilakṣaṇavyavahārasya vilakṣaṇaviṣayatvena dṛṣṭatvāt, yathā ghaṭapaṭavyavahārayoḥ |
ataḥ abhāvajñānakāraṇenaivā- bhāvavyavahāraḥ iti na prativandisiddhiḥ |
nāstitvavyavahārasya nāstijñānakāraṇatve'pi nāstitvasya kāraṇatvena tanmātrabuddhiḥ amāvāvadinā'ṅgīkṛtā, sā ca saṃsṛṣṭānābhāvaviśiṣṭajñānācca vilakṣaṇatvenāṅgīkṛtā |
ato vastusadbhāvagrahaṇarūpatanmātrabuddhiviśeṣaṇatvenaiva vilakṣaṇa- vyavahāropapattiḥ, ato na ghaṭavyatyapi prasaṅgaḥ, tatra vilakṣaṇatvamāvabuddherabhāvāt |
tathāpi viṣayakṛta eva medo vyavahāraheturiti cet, satyaṃ vilakṣaṇamātrabuddhayapekṣādau tadviṣayatāpi vaila- kṣaṇyaṃ avaśyamaṅgīkāryaṃ, viṣayaviṣayibhāvasya bhedāt |
yathā vilakṣaṇatvamātrabodhāt vilakṣaṇābhāvajñānotpattiḥ, tathā vilakṣaṇavyavahāro'smāka- miti na doṣaḥ |
yattuktaṃ, kāraṇabhedātmātra jñānabhede na vilakṣaṇavyavahāro dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā cākṣuṣasparśaneyoraika- viṣayayoḥ iti |
tadatimandaṃ, cākṣuṣapaṭhanāt 'śuklaḥ paṭaḥ' ityapi vyavahartuṃ śakyate, sparśanāt 'mṛduḥ paṭaḥ' iti, atastatrāpi vilakṣaṇavyavahāra iti |
kiṃca vilakṣaṇavyavahāro vilakṣaṇārthaparicchedādapi mandaṃ, 'ghaṭābhāvo nāsti', 'ghaṭo nāsti' iti vilakṣaṇavyava- hārayorabhāvamātraparicchedanivandhanatvena anaikāntikāt |
atha tatrāpyaikyāt vyavahāryameva nāstītyucyate, evaṃ tarhi 'bhūtalamasti' 'ghaṭo nāsti' iti vyavahārayora- pyaikyāt vailakṣaṇyaṃ na syāt |
nanu asyat pratiyogi- jijñāsāyāṃ tanmātradhiyo viśeṣaḥ, jijñāsāyāśca vilakṣaṇa- vyavahārahetutvaṃ vilakṣaṇaparicchedādeva, ato vilakṣaṇā- bhāvajñānāṅgīkāraprasaṅgaḥ |
naivaṃ, jijñāsā na vyavahāra- hetutvaṃ, kiṃtu tanmātrabuddhiviśeṣaḥ eva vyavahārahetuḥ |
ke cittanmātrabuddhiviśeṣaḥ pratiyogijijñāsā'nantarabhāvinaḥ, ke cit neti |
ye ca pratiyogijijñāsānantarabhāvino viśeṣaḥ, te vyavahārahetavaḥ |
bhavatāmapi pratiyogijijñāsāyāḥ abhāvajñānahetutvaṃ nāsti, kiṃtu tatkāraṇabhūtanmātrabuddhau upalakṣaṇatvameva, vastusadbhāvagrahaṇaṃ pratiyogismaraṇaṃ ca kāraṇamityuktatvāt |
yattuktaṃ, 'priye jñāte'pi punarnajijñāsā saṃbhavati, ata upalakṣaṇe'pi vyabhicāraḥ' iti, taddvatāmāpi samānam |
na pratiyogijijñāsāmātramupalakṣaṇaṃ, kiṃtu anyatra jñāyamāne pratiyogini jijñāseti viśeṣitavyaṃ, ato na kaściddoṣa iti |
nanu bhavatāṃ tanmātrabuddheḥ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ? na caikaṃ niyatamalapyate, ka cit mudgaraprahāraḥ, ka cit vibhakto ghaṭaḥ, ka cit kapālamāla, ka cit
cūrṇībhūto'vayavaḥ, ka vicca deśāntarasthitiḥ, ataḥ ani- yatahetukatvādekameva tanmātrajñānaṃ, asannamate tu abhāvaḥ abhāvajñānakāraṇamiti |
naivaṃ, bhavatāmapyekatra prāgabhāvaḥ, anyatra pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ, aparatretaretarābhāvaḥ abhāvajñāna- hetvitiniyatahetulamāpi samameva |
atha ghaṭapratiyogikā- bhāvatvenaivaklapte'pi avāntarabhedaṃ kalpayitvā kāraṇabhedaḥ samarthyate, tarhi askāmapi ghaṭatanmātrabuddhirūpeṇe- katve'pi avāntarabhedaḥ kalpyatām |
atha na jātibhedaḥ, abhāvānāmeva kāraṇabhūtānāṃ bhāva- virodhitvenaikatvameva, varhi bhāvānāmanyanekāṃ abhāva- virodhitvenaikatvena abhāvavidhānaṃ na saṃbhavati |
yogyā- nupalabdhirhetutvenābhimatamitā, tasyāśca rucyā kāra- ṇatvaṃ, śāyamānatayā vā ? na tāvajjñāyamānatayā, tasyā apyabhāvatvena anupalabdhyantaragrahaṇaprasaṅgena anavasthāpra- jñāt |
na ca sattvā hetutvaṃ, tadabhāve'pyabhāvajñānadarśa- nāt |
upalyamāne'pi devadatte, 'prāk nāsīdayamidaṃ' iti darśanānupalambhadevānupalambha nirastaḥ |
nānu- labdhimātrasya, atastatra tattyanupalambhasya saṃbhavadabhāva- jñānamiti, naivaṃ, tasyāpyabhāve'pi abhāvajñānadarśanāt |
tathāhi, 'madhyādine dṛṣṭo devadattaḥ prātarnāsyevāyamidaṃ' iti sāyaṃ budhyā tatra tadā madhyadinasmṛtyā smṛtyupa- lambho nirastaḥ |
atha upalambhāt tatkālīnānupalambha- bādhaḥ, na prātaranupalambhasya, ataḥ prātaranupalambhyā prāk nāsīditi nāstitvaṃ gṛhyate |
tatra, upalambhakatvena tathābhāvasvarupānupalambho'pyeka eva, ata upalambhe jāte anupalambhamātrasya nāśaḥ |
ato yāvadupalambhakṣaṇaṃ prasaktaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ upalambhādeva naśyati |
itarathā pradhvaṃse'pi mudgaraprahāra- kālīna eva ghaṭo naṣṭa iti pūrvakālīno'pi durnaśyeta, na caitad dṛṣṭamidaṃ |
nanu yadyapi upalambhodeyadanupalambha- nirāsaḥ, tathāpi prātarupalambhasyopalambhasyāpi anupa- labdhatvāt anupalabdho vartate, tataḥ abhāvagrahaṇamastviti |
naivaṃ, nityatucchatvāt tasyopalambhasya tavyāyogiko'pya- nupalambho nāsti |
tathāhi, na ca tasya prātarlapyatiḥ, na ca pūrve, na ca paścāt, ityupalambhajātīyatvameva tasya nāsti |
ataḥ anupalabdhasya sattvayā kāraṇatvamapi dūro- tsāritameva |
aṅgirasāṃ dvirāvatre 'baivānasaṃ pūrvaidyuḥ sāma bhavati, ṣoḍaśyuttare' iti śrūyate |
tatra ṣoḍaśino vidhānaṃ, uta prātassa parisaṃkhyānaṃ iti vicāre ṣoḍaśinaḥ coda- kena prāpteḥ : abhāvāt 'uttare'han dvirāmasya gṛhyate' iti vacanena sarveṣu atirātreṣu ṣoḍaśī gṛhyate |
tasmāt aprāptasya vidhānaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
athavā yadetat prākṛtaṃ atirātre ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇaṃ vaikalpikaṃ, tat vikalpe- naiva sarvaidirātreṣu prāptaṃ niyamyeta 'uttare'han dvirāmasya gṛhyate' iti |
tasya upasaṃhāre kṛte anyadirātreṣu abhā- vāt aṅgirasāṃ dvirāvatre niyato 'ṣoḍaśyuttare' iti uktatvāt |
sarvadirātreṣu uttare'ha- su ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇasya anvayaḥ syāt 'uttare'han dvirāma- sya gṛhyate' iti parisaṃkhyārthāt |
'baivānasaṃ pūrvadyuḥ sāma bhavati, ṣoḍaśyuttare' iti parisaṃkhyārthe vacanam |
'uttare'han dvirāmasya gṛhyate' ityanārabhya- vidhānena prāpte upasaṃhāraḥ kriyate |
yadetat dvirāmasya uttare gṛhyate, etat aṅgirasāṃ dvirāmasya uttare gṛhyate nānyatra iti |
sarvadirātreṣu uttare'han sāmahaṃ ṣoḍa- śinā anvayaḥ : 'uttare'han dvirāmasya gṛhyate' ityanārabhya- vidhānāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? vaivānasaṃ sāma pūrvadyurbharvāta iti vidhīyate, uttare ṣoḍaśī ityucyate anārabhyavidhānena prāptatvāt |
atra pūrvāpūrvā vyākhyā vṛttikāramatena, dvitīyā- dvitīyā tu bhāṣyakāramatena |
abhikramaṇaṃ nāma prayājahomakāle āhavanīyama- mitaḥ saṃcaraṇam (vastutastu dvitīyādiprayājahomakāle kiṃ cit kiṃ cit āhavanīyasamīpe spandanamabhikramaṇam |
ke.) vi. 3|1|10. abhikramaṇaṃ prayājeṣveva niveśite na sarvasmin darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe |
bhāṣyaṃ - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prayājavākye śrūyate 'abhikramaṇaṃ juhoti abhijitye' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ abhikramaṇaṃ prayājeṣveva niveśite, uta kṛtsne prakaraṇe iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? kartṛguṇe abhikramaṇe brūmo vākyabhedaḥ syāditi, karmaṇā karmaṇaḥ asamavāyāt |
na tat karma havanaṃ sādhayituṃ śaknoti |
nanu anenaiva hetunā anya- sminnapi na niveśyate |
juhoti iti hyanena eva śabdaḥ puruṣaprayatnaṃ vidhātuṃ śaknoti, na puruṣābhikramaṇasaṃbandham |
anyatra prakaraṇāmnānāt abhāve niśrāte prayogavacanaḥ asya kartavyatāṃ vakṣyati |
tasmāt sarvasmin prakaraṇe abhikramaṇasya niveśa iti |
idānīṃ yat karmaiva karmasaṃbandhitvena śrūyamāṇaṃ arthāt saṃskāra- tvaṃ pratipadyate tat vicāryate |
tatra abhikramaṇaṃ iti ṇamulā vīpsādyapādānāt abhikramyābhikramya kimabhikaroti ityapekṣite paraśca juhotiḥ prakṛtaprayāja- grāhī dṛśyate |
tat kiṃ abhikramaṇaṃ tenaiva saṃbadhyate, uta prakṛtamātreṇeti |
saṃśayaśravaṇe ca sati saṃśayakṣepa- parihārārthaṃ aruṇādhikaraṇavat (3|1|16|2) dravyau,
yattatra samānādhikaraṇaṃ dravyapācaṃ, tadapyaniyamyaṃ ca tatsādhyakriyāsaṃbandhasya upa- pattittvam |
nānābhūtāni ca tatra kriyāntaradravyāṇi, atra punaḥ sarvakarmasu sa evādhvaryuḥ kartā ityapunarūktatā |
' na tāvat abhi- kramaṇaṃ homaṃ karoti iti vaktuṃ śakyam |
'nanu anenaiva hetunā ' anyatrāpi anabhiniveśaḥ iti bhāṣyeṇa aruṇādhikaraṇameva |

('nanu anenaiva hetunā anyasminnapi na niveśyate ? pṛ. 730 iti bhāṣyeṇa 'atha yadi ṛṇītinā na saṃbadhyate, tasminneva vākye ekahāyanīsaṃbandhena saṃbhanyate, na bhavi- ṣyati vākyabhedaḥ iti ' aruṇādhikaraṇārthaṃ-pṛ. 685 paṃ. 4-5 - codyameva niveśitam ityarthaḥ |
) parihāraśca ākhyāte kartṛguṇabhūtatvāt balāt ( abhikramaṇasya ) homasaṃbandhāpatteḥ |
na juhotinā gṛhītena prayājādīnāṃ kartrā saṃbandhaḥ |
anyatra tu prakaraṇagṛhītasya pradhānabhūtasya kartuḥ saṃbandho na virotsyate |
bhāṣyaṃ - naitadasti yaduktaṃ abhikramaṇaṃ prakaraṇe nive- śite iti, prayājeṣveva bhavitumarhati |
yataḥ sākāṅkṣametat pūrveṇa padena asamāptaṃ vākyaṃ 'abhikramaṇaṃ juhoti' ityatra paryava- syati |
prakaraṇācca vākyaṃ balavat, iti prayājeṣveva abhi- kramaṇaṃ niveśite |
nanu abhikramaṇaṃ amūrtatvāt homanirvṛttau asamartha ityuktam |
dvayaṃ abhyupāyabhūtaṃ homasya dūrādvā abhiprāyaṃ hastaṃ juhuyāt, samāsīdedvā
vā - sarvathā tāvat abhikramaṇaṃ ityetat padaṃ na kriyā- ntaramantareṇa nirākāṅkṣī bhavati ( ṇamulo dhātusaṃbandhādhi- kāravihitatvāt ) |
nahi etat dravyasaṃbandhaṃ kathaṃ vidadhi bravīti |
tasmāt prakṛtaprayājapraṇinā juhotinā eka- vākyatvāt tādarthyaṃ vijñāyate |
evaṃ ca upa- kārarūpeṇa karmāpi karmasādhyaṃ bhavati ityetadapi siddham ( evaṃ bhāṣyamanusṛtya vyākhyātam |
yadā tu atistyatvāt naiva abhikramaṇaṃ ityetat pada- mātravicchedena pūrvapakṣaḥ kriyate |

kathaṃ tarhi ? 'yat juhoti' iti samastaprakaraṇajuhotivādena abhikramaṇa- vidhānāt avāntaraprakaraṇasya ca abhāvāt mahāprakaraṇa- viniyogāśrayaṇena pūrvapakṣamāśrayaṇaṃ, tadā 'kartṛguṇe tu' abhikramaṇe avāntaraprakaraṇapyupasthāpitaprayāja- 'karmā- samavāyāt ' tatprakaraṇaikavākyatvābhāvamātrameva 'vākya- bhedaḥ syāt ' ityuktvā 'sākāṅkṣaṃ tu' iti avāntara- prakaraṇameva prayājodanāprakṛtavākyakāṅkṣāvattvadvārā tadekavākyatvena siddhānto'bhidhīyate |
yadapi 'asmāt hi pūrveṇa ' iti, tatra vākyāsamāptyabhiprāyeṇa |
kiṃ tarhi ? 'asmāt hi ' avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ ' pūrveṇa ' prayājasvarūpavidhinā ityarthaḥ |
virodhena prayājakarmasaṃbhavāt vākyabheda: prayājavākyāna- nyāyitvaṃ syāt iti|
su—ānarthakyāpattā śrutikriyā'nvayāyogena tadaṅga- gāvatāraṃ sthite tadviśeṣacintātvena uttarādhikaraṇasya anantarasaṃgati: spaṣṭā |
pṛ. 1091. vi--'abhikramaṃ juhoti' yuktaṃ kartrā'khilasya tat|
miya: saṃbandha- rāhilyā, naivaṃ te'pi samavata: ||
atha vārtikakāramatena, 'yadvā balivacca sāṃnidhyādasti prakaraṇe tat |
bhāṭṭa—darśapūrṇamāsayo: prayājasamīpe śrutaṃ 'abhi- krāmaṃ juhoti' iti |

tatra abhikramaṇasya amūrtatvāt juhotyākhye prayājobhe anyathānupapatte: āruṇyavacca iha kartṛrūpasya dravyasya anupāttatvāt tad-dvārā'pi anvayā- nupapatte: tato vicchinnasya prākaraṇikahavirhomāṅgaṃ tadīyakartṛ: āhavanīyaprayājasattviprahakāryadvārā |
iti prāpte, anupāttasyāpi ākhyātagamyasya sadbhāvāt taddvā- daiva juhotyanvayopapatte: prayājahomāṅgatvameva iti bhāṣya- kāreṇa siddhāntitam |

tattu ṇamulantasya asya pūrvakāla- tā''disaṃbandhena juhotyanvaye nairākāṅkṣyābhāvāt, juho- teśca prayājahomamātravācitve pramāṇābhāvāt, aṣṭaṇā'dhi- karaṇena gataprayājatvāt vārtikakāreṇa anyathā vyākhyā- tam |
satyapi vākyīyahomasaṃndhe saṃkoce pramāṇābhāvāt 'vedyāṃ haviṣi' iti tadvat prākaraṇikasarvahomāṅgatvaṃ, vācinikāṅgasaṃndherupapāvantarādhikārasya vākyasaṃkocakṛtyā- nupapatte: |
yadi hi tādṛśasaṃndhe 'abhikrāmati' ityeva śrūyeta, tata: avāntaraprakaraṇe syādapi prayājāṅ- tvam |
vācinikāṅgasaṃvandhasiddhayarthaṃ ca kalpitāyā akāṅkṣāyā: tanmātragrāhakatvena abhikramaṇa- grāhakatvānupapatte: |
iti prāpte, bhāvanāsambandhena aṅga- bhāvanāsvapi krūpakāramānyakāsu itikartavyatā''kā- ṅkṣopapatte: ajñānāmapi asyaiva sā |
sā paraṃ pradhāna- gatabalavattvena pratibadhyate sannidhyānvayite |
tadā tannivṛtti: atideśena ākṣepa- lyamvakhasaṃpādanena sādhāraṇairvā ācamanādibhi: |
yatra tu vācanikāṅgasaṃvandha:, tatra athena akāṅkṣojīvanaṃ, antimena ca tatrāśa: na tu maṇyādāviva vācanikājñānāṃ pratyekamuttejakatā, tāvadabhāvakrūpatvaveśe gauravāt, tadadiha vyabhicārābhāvācca |
ato vācanikāṃśasaṃndhe śrutānāṃ avā- ntaraprakaraṇena balavatā aṅgāṅgatvameva |
prakṛte tu homā- nuvādena vihite abhikramaṇe homasvarūpe ānarthakyaprasaktī apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇatātātparyagrāhakatvayā vācanikāṅgasaṃvandha- rūpāvāntarādhikāra: eva tattvenā''śrīyate |
na tu pradhānā- dhikāra: aṅgapradhānādhikāro vā 'vedyāṃ' itivat |
asti cātra 'samānayate juhvaumāpyam' ityādyupa- kramya madhye abhikramaṇaṃ vidhāya anye 'prayājaśeṣeṇa havīṣyabhidhārayati' iti śravaṇāt sa: |
na ca prayājeṣu homābhāvāt, prakṣepa- pāṅkasyaiva tyāgasya vṛddhavyavahāreṇa yajipadārthatvātsā- yāt ākṣepeṇa śrūyamāṇayajimātre homaprāpyupapatte: |
su. pṛ. 1072. aṅgabhūtaprayājādi- śabdasaṃyuktamapyupapatitaṃ tadasaṃyukte abhikramaṇādikamapi udbhūtākāṅkṣā'nuvattau vidhānāt avāntaraprakaraṇe prayā- jāṅga iti abhikramaṇādhikaraṇe sthitam |

bāla. pṛ. 11. vākyāntaraprāptaṃ ca karma anya vākyāntareṇa rūpaṇasaṃbhave khavākyātvātastattvasyāpi karmaṇo vākyāntarato rūpalabhāt vidhinirvāhopapatte: vidhayogābhiprāyeṇa ādhāraprakaraṇanirāsāyogāt para-
sa ca abhi- kramaṇādhikaraṇe nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt ayukta: |
su. pṛ. 737, abhikramaṇādhikaraṇe darśapūrṇamāsapaṭhitānā- mapi prayājānāṃ avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ vyutpādayiṣyate |
pṛ. 764. abhikramaṃ juhoti atra juhotipadoktaṃ prayāja- homāṅgatvaṃ abhikramaṇasya |
śā. 3|1|10. 'abhikramaṃ juhoti' ayaṃ ṇamul viniyogakatrī śruti: someśvaramate |
bāla. pṛ. 48. 'abhikramaṃ juhoti' iti yajaticoditānāṃ prayājā- dīnāṃ juhotinā anuvāda: |
bhā. 3|4| 18. 'abhikramaṃ juhoti' iti sāmānyaśabdo'pi adhikāratvāt prayājaviṣayo bhavati |
vā. 3|1|10|21 pṛ. 870. abhighāraṇaṃ anvāhāryaṃ svādinne kriyate |
10|8|12| 30-31, abhighāraṇaṃ ayāgavadaṅgakriyāyā: vāso- vatsyo: na syāt |
10|3|10|38, abhighāraṇaṃ upastaraṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇalacarau na kartavyam |
saṃsarga: śuci puroḍāśacūrṇānāṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ mā bhūt iti upastaraṇena śuk snigdhīkriyate, abhighāraṇena havi: suci asaṃyuktaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yathā''sīt patediti |
10|2|12, abhighāraṇaṃ cāturmāsyeṣu vyambakeṣu ekakapāleṣu puroḍāśe kartavyameva |
'abhi- ghāryā anabhighāryā' iti mīmāṃsā tu tulyārthā |
10|1 8|18. abhighāraṇaṃ juhvājyenopastaraṇaṃ tadupari havi: tadupari puna: ājyam |
bhā. 5|4|2|3, abhighāraṇaṃ prayājaśeṣeṇa āgneyapuroḍāśasya pūrvaṃ kartavyaṃ tata: sāṃnāyyasya, pravṛtti- kramāpekṣayā mukhyakramasya balīyastvāt |
5|4|2-4, abhighāraṇaṃ prayājaśeṣeṇa prājāpatyapaśānāṃ nāsti vāja- peye |
4|1|4|13-30. abhighāraṇaṃ prayājaśeṣeṇa haviṣāṃ havi:saṃskāraśca pratipattiśca iti upayuktapayokṣya- māṇobhayasaṃskāra: |
ke. abhighāraṇasya upastaraṇasya ca lepe'pi darśapūrṇamāsayorpāśyājye havipa eva caturavattasaṃpatti: |

vājapeye ṛtupaśava: prājāpatyapaśavaśca prāta:savane sahaiva prakramyante, daśamaprayājottaraṃ ca prājāpatyapaśunāma- ṣṭhānaṃ paryabhikaraṇānte viramya mādhyaṃdine savane brāhmaṇa- ācchaṃsisāmakāle punarupakramya ālabhamādi kriyate |
prāta:savane tāvat paśuprayājaśeṣeṇa ṛtupaśuyāgānāṃ abhighāraṇaṃ kṛtam |

atha mādhyaṃdine prājāpatyapaśuyāpānāmabhighāraṇaṃ yadi kartavyaṃ, tadā prāta:saṃnikaprayājaśeṣapadhāraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt, juhavāśca anyatra vyāpatattvāt tatra prayājaśeṣadhāraṇasya kartumaśakyatvāt pātrāntaraṃ grāhyaṃ syāt |
tatra prājāpatya- vapā'bhighāraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ na vā, kartavyatve prayājaśeṣadhāra- ṇārthe pātrāntaraṃ kartavyaṃ na vā iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |

prayājaśeṣeṇa prājāpatyapaśūnāṃ abhighāraṇe abhighā- raṇārthe abhighāraṇasādhanaprayājaśeṣasya dhāraṇāryai pātrabheda: syāt juhavā: prāta:savane eva ājyabhāgādyarthe riktvāt taddipātraṃ vinā prayājaśeṣadhāraṇāsaṃbhavāt |
anuyājāvat, cāturmāsyeṣu anuyājā: pṛṣṭhadājyena gṛhyanthā bhavanti, tatra anuyājīyapṛṣṭhadājyathā- raṇārthaṃ pṛṣṭadājyadhānī yathā ājyadhānyā: |
prayājārthe viniyuktasya juhuṣasya ājyasya ekadeśo'yaṃ śeṣaḥ |
tathā ca taduttaraṃ śeṣatvenābhāvat kasya dhāraṇārthe pātrāntaraṃ syāt ? ato na pātrabhedaḥ kartavyaḥ |
sahaprayogasya ṛtupaśūnāṃ prājāpatyapaśūnāṃ ca sahānuṣṭhānasya abhicāraṇābhāvahetutvāt |
'tīrthe vai prātaḥ- savanaṃ, yat prātaḥsavanaṃ paśava ālabhyante tīrthe vaitānā- labhante sayoninlāya, atho vapānāmabhibhūtalāya' iti vātapeye prājāpatyapaśau vapā'bhighāraṇaṃ nāstīti darśayati |
ataśca śeṣāpekṣeva nāsti iti kimarthaṃ pātram |
brahma vai brahmasāmni yat brahmasāmni ālabhate, tena asyāḥ, tenāmighṛtāḥ |
anena vacanena brahmasāmnaiva abhighṛtatvāt prayājaśeṣāmighāraṇābhāvaḥ sūyate |
evaṃ prayājaśeṣā- mighāraṇābhāvasya darśanāt na pātrabhedaḥ |
'sati savyavacanaṃ' iti cet, na tasya' iti sūtrayoḥ padānamānvayaḥ |
tatra cedato bhāgaḥ śaṅkā, na tasyetyuttaram |
nanu satyeva abhicāraṇe 'savyā vā etārhi vapā' iti savyavacanaṃ bhavet |
'upastṛṇāti ājyaṃ, hiraṇyaśakala, vapā, hiraṇyaśakala, tato'bhighāra- yati' iti vapā'vadānakāle yatpañcāvattalam, tatrāsti abhighāraṇam |
asminnabhighāraṇe satyeva punaḥ 'savyā vā etārhi vapā' iti savyatā uktā |
tathā ca tādṛśasavyatānirāsārthe prayājaśeṣeṇa abhighāraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, kartavyaṃ ca śeṣadhāraṇārthe pātrāntaraṃ iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
tasya pūrvapakṣiṇā uktābhicāraṇasya na savyatānirākaraṇasāmarthyaṃ, vihitasya vapā'vadhāvasyalasādhakatvāt |
nanu vapā'rukṣatvanirākaraṇasāmarthyaṃ yadi avadānagatā- mighāraṇasya na syāt, tadā prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇasyāpi na syāt |

tasya prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇasya rūkṣatva- nirākaraṇasāmarthyaṃ syādeva tasya haviḥsaṃskāratvāt, ava- dānagatāmighāraṇasya rūkṣatvanirākaraṇe mukhyatvābhāvāt, prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇasya ca tatra mukhyatvāt |

prakṛte tu yadyapi prājāpatyapaśūnāṃ rūkṣatānirāsārthe prayājaśeṣāmi- ghāraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, tathāpi brahmasāmasambandhena rūkṣatvanirā- sasyoktatvāt prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ, tadarthaṃ ca pṛthak pātramāpi na grahītavyamiti |
atra 'sati savyavacanaṃ' ityādi sūtradvayaṃ kathaṃ yojanīyaṃ iti durjñeyameva |
bhāṣyaṃ ca subodhini ca na manaḥ samādhāpayati |
kutūhalavṛttau tu 'sati savyavacanaṃ' iti sūtraṃ nāstyeva |
'na tasyeti cet' ityasya ca cedantvāt uttarasūtreṇa ekīkaraṇam |
tadarthastu, tasya siddhāntinā uktasya prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇasyādarśanasya na liṅkatvam |
tasya prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇasyaiva snehena mukhya- tvāt iti |
abhi- cāraḥ tāvat adhikāraviśeṣatathā adhikāraṃ kāraṇam |
vairiniṣṭho maraṇānukūlavyāpāra eva abhicārapadārthaḥ iti kaścit |
abhicārārthaṃ karma pāpaṃ, tasya tāmasadharmatva- saraṇāt |
abhijanasaṃstavena abhijātaḥ suto bhavati yathā asmakābhijano devadattaḥ asmakeṣu stūyamāneṣu stuta- mānatvaṃ manyate |
bhā. 2|4|12 pṛ. 325. 'abhijitā yajeta' atra saumiko vidhvantaḥ adhyaktodanatvāt |
vi. 8|1|9. abhijitā yajeta iti abhi- jitśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyam |
'abhito divākīrtyaṃ trayaḥ kharasāmānaḥ' iti gavāmayane śrūyate |
divākīrtyasya viṣuvataḥ abhitaḥ pura- stāt parastācca trayastrayaḥ kharasāmānaḥ nāma yāgā bhavanti iti śrutivākyārthaḥ |
yadīyā mantrā divaiva kīrtanīyā bhavanti, na rātrau |
'abhi tvā śūra' itīyanuk chandogranthye ratha- tarasya yonitvena paṭhitā |
vi. 9|2|5. 'abhi tvā śūra' ityādimantrān stotrasādhanabhūtān 'pṛṣṭheṣṭhapatite' iti pṛṣṭhaśabdeo lakṣyati |
7|1|14. 'abhi tvā śūra' ityeṣā bhṛthau prathamā stotrīyā |
'abhi tvā śūra' jyotiṣṭome mādhyaṃdine pṛṣṭhastome idaṃ pragātharūpaṃ prathamaṃ sūktam |
tatra pūrvā bṛhatī, uttarā sato- bṛhatī |
'abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ' iti sūkte saptadaśa- stomatāmāpadya rathaṃtaraṃ stotraṃ gīyate |
abhighātrī śrutiḥ kā cit 'prakṛtipratyaya- śloḥ svasvārthābhighātṛtvam |
abhighātrī śrutiḥ pañcavidhā dhātuḥ, prātipadikaṃ, kṛdādipratyayaḥ, upasargaḥ, nipātaśceti |
dhāturpi dvividhaḥ : 'bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ' itivihitadhātusaṃgraḥ : 'sadācantā dhātavaḥ' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 41. abhidhātrī śrutiḥ vrīhyā- diśrutiḥ|

vā. 313|4|11 pṛ. 817. abhidhānaṃ hi prātipadikenaiva rūpeṇa vyaktigataṃ, tadyathā akṣatrayaṃ ekāpavarakasya ekāpavarakasthityaiva upalabhya kaścit ke cidāha, 'ye etasminnapavarake sthitāḥ', te akṣaśabdāmidheyāḥ' iti|
tatra yadyapi vyutpattisamaye apavarakasthitīnāma ekamupalakṣaṇaṃ labhyate, tathāpi śabdaḥ tadanādareṇa vyaktimātrameva svarūpeṇābhidhatte, iti bhavati śaktinayam|
tasmāt caturhotrā mantrena, pañcahotrā ca pradhāna- havirmātramabhimaṣṭavyam |
bhāṣyaṃ—yaduktaṃ pradhānanāmatvāt paurṇamāsīśabdasya amāvāsyāśabdasya ca, pradhānahaviṣābhimarśanamiti, naita- deyam |
katamat tadabhidhānaṃ, yadguṇaḥ abhimarśanamiti brūte ? paurṇamāsī amāvāsyā iti dvitīyāntaṃ paurṇa- māsyarthamabhimarśanaṃ kartavyaṃ, amāvāsyārthamabhimarśanaṃ kartavya- miti |
ato yatrayatra kriyamāṇaṃ paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāyāṃ vā upakaroti, tatratatra kartavyam |
yadyat paurṇamāsyāmā- vāsyāyāṃ vā abhimarṣyate sākṣāt pradhānādvā, tatratatra kriyamāṇaṃ tayorupakaroti |
tasmāt pradhānahaviṣāṃ aṅga- haviṣāṃ ca kartavyamiti |
vā—dvitīyā yasāt guṇabhūtamimarśanaṃ vijñāyate, tasmāt sarvārthe ityarthavam |
sthite eva guṇatve tadvi- śeṣacintyaṃ prastutā |
yacca paurṇamāsyarthe amāvāsyārthe, iti coktaṃ ( bhāṣye ) tadapi pūrvapakṣameva sādhayati |
tena evaṃ vaktavyam—‘paurṇamāsīmabhimṛśet’ ityatra kālakarma- tatsamudāyānāṃ anabhimraṣṭavyatvāt paurṇamāsī iti gauṇena bhavitavyam |

tatra prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ yadyapi pratyayārthasya prādhānyāt prātipadikaṃ gauṇaṃ ityapyate, tathāpi atra tāvatā'pi abhimraṣṭavyaviśeṣaṇatvagamāt samastalavādi- viṣayasaṃśayopagrahe sati viśeṣaḥ anyata eva labhyavyaḥ; iti sākāṅkṣatvāt asaṃdigdhaparihārārthe prathamapratītatvena ca prātipadikārthe mukhyamātre vibhaktiḥ saptamyarthe ava- kalpate paurṇamāsyāmiti |
tadeva cātra ākāṅkṣitaṃ, āsannahavirādirvidhanā abhimraṣṭavyaviśeṣasya ava- dhāritatvāt |
ataḥ kāladvāreṇa prayogadvāreṇa vā vyava- syā'thamevedaṃ śravaṇaṃ, iti havirmātrābhimarśanam |
paurṇamāsāsyāvāsāpadānāṃ paurṇamāsā- diprayogasya adhikaraṇatvavidhau ca ubhayana prātipadike pratyaye ca lakṣaṇāprasaṅgo vākyabhedaśca tadavastha eva |
prayogasya nimittatvasvīkāre ca lakṣaṇāprasaṅgo vikṛtau aprāptyāpattiśca |

ato lāghavāt prātipadikenaiva paurṇa- māsyādipradhānamātrasaṃbandhivilakṣaṇatvāt taduddeśena mantra- viśiṣṭamabhimarśanaṃ viniyujyate, mantramātraṃ vā taduddeśena vidhīyate, abhimarśanaṃ tu prakaraṇaprāptānuvādaḥ |
utpatti- vākye ca haviḥśabdena pradhānamāhravirāpādanaṃ upasaṃhāra- vidhayā na virudhyate, ataḥ pradhānamātrārthau mantrau |
satyaṃ paurṇamāsyādiṣvabhyāṃ pradhānasaṃbandhivilakṣaṇatvā, tathāpi saṃbandho nāṅgasyāsya; tathātve vākyasaṃkocāpatteḥ; api tu upakārakatvāt ityaṅgapradhānārthāyaiva mantrau |
bhā. 8|1|9|24, abhiyuktāḥ praṇīte mantravākye sāmaśabdamupadiśanti, ‘sāmāni adhīmahe’ ‘sāmāni adhyāpyāmaḥ’ ‘sāmāni vartante’ iti |
2|1|1|136, abhiyuktāḥ yaṃ śabdamupadiśanti eṣa eva sādhuḥ, anyaḥ asādhuḥ ityavagantavyam |
dṛśyate cābhiyuktānāṃ guṇayatāmavisaraṇaṃ, upa- pannaṃ pratyakṣaṃ chatvaṃ guṇamamānaṃ na śravyate iti |
ye tu agnindriyaviṣayāḥ, teṣu abhiyuktaḥ na pramāṇam |
2|1|1|136, abhiyuktopadeśāt hastaḥ karaḥ pāṇiḥ ityevādiṣu anādirarthena saṃbandhaḥ |
dīkṣitasya śarīre ekakālaṃ anekāvāraṃ parjanyābhivarṣaṇe'pi sakṛdeva mantrapāṭhaḥ, na pratyabhivarṣaṇa- māvṛttiḥ |
abhivāsanaṃ kapāleṣu śrapitasya puroḍāśasyā- cchādanaṃ ‘bhasanā'mivāsayati’ iti āmnātam |
vi. 5|1|16, abhivāsanantena adhiśrayaṇadinā kāṇḍena anusamayaḥ vāruṇacatuṣkapālapuroḍāśeṣu |
śāstrātteṣu kartavyaḥ, śabdeṣu na tadu- ktiṣu |
sāhasrī. 70. abhivyakta- padārthā ye ityanena gauṇalakṣaṇikāvyāvṛttiḥ |
‘śabdeṣu na taduktiṣu’ artha ślokaḥ : ‘gauṇamukhyayormadhye kāryasaṃpratyayaḥ’ iti- nyāyamūlakaḥ |
atideśe jñāpakaṃ tu ‘yattedetebhyaḥ parimāṇe’ (pā0 5|1|39) iti sautranirdeśaḥ |
nahi atra atideśaḥ vinā tadā- calaṃ labhyate |
śabdakaustubhe ṛlka-sūtre. abhivyañjakānāṃ anekaviṣayā śaktiḥ, yathā dīpasya |
yathā 'sarvasmin ātmā'sti, tileṣu taila- masti' iti |
upahavyo'nikttasena abhi- śasyamānaṃ yājayet 'agniṣṭomo yajñaḥ pañcadaśastomo rathaṃtara- sāmā, aśvaḥ śvetò dakṣiṇā' |
bhā. 10|3|1|8|9. yasmin puruṣe prāyaścittahau doṣaḥ karṇopakarṇayā āro- pitaḥ nāthāpi nirṇītaḥ, saḥ abhiśasyamānaḥ |
ke. abhibhavaḥ uttaravedyāḥ pratīcīne, sadasaḥ prācīne maṇḍape bhavati |
vi. 3|1|11, abhibhavaḥ somasya havirdhānamaṇḍapagatahavirdhānaśakaṭamadhye dakṣiṇaśakaṭa- samīpe bhavati (śakaṭasthācchatāt) |
3|1|7. abhibhavaḥ somanādīnāṃ daśamuṣṭiparimitāṃ dadhmau grāmirbhigrātaḥ, tena ca rasanotpādanam (6|4|7|24) |
ke. abhi- bhavaḥ homaśca bhakṣe ekaṃ nimittam |
'aparamapi kāraṇaṃ homā- mibhavau', ye abhiṣupavanti juhvati ca te bhakṣyanti' |
bhā. 3|1|11|132, abhibhavaśca homārthatvaṃ homasya ca phalārthatvam |
3|1|1|132. abhibhave eva 'tisro yahasya' iti mantraḥ prayojyaḥ ||
'tisro yahasya samidha iti' somaṃ karoti' iti somagrahasaṃnidhau śrūyate |
iha karoteraiva bhāvanārthatayā tatra somasya bhāvyatayā ṛcaḥ karaṇatvena cānyau māsa- māno'pi na yuktaḥ |
siddhadravyasya sādhanānākāṅkṣatvenā- sādhitamiti nyāyena yāgakriyayaiva tena svabhābhyakabhāvanā- 'ntarāṇākṣepāt |
ato viniyogabhavena somakaraṇabhāvanā- yāmeva mantravidhānāśravaṇāt prākṛtamantravādhāya yāge mantra- vidhiḥ |

yattu bhāṣyakāraiḥ asatkaryāvadhinirāsena saṃskā- rātmanaḥ sataḥ svarūpātmanā satkāryavād samarthya somasya svarūpo'pi satvena tatra mantrasya karaṇatvena vidhānā- yogatāt somagrahāt ayaṃ mantra utkṛṣyatetyuktaṃ, tatra somotpādane yāgāntare'pi viniyogāsaṃbhavena 'sāgaraṃ tatreta' ityādibhireva aprāmāṇyāpadātklādapekṣatam |

iti prāpte, utāyacikāyādimedena bhāvyasya anekavidhatayā hiraṇyakāraḥ ityādivyavahārasamarthanārthamā- vaśyakatayā pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyenopacitto somadasya rasātmakavikāraparatvena tadanuvādena mantravidhyupapatteḥ abhibhave evārthaṃ karaṇam |
vi. 3|6|15. abhiṣutaśabdaḥ 'yāni caivābhipūyante puṣpamūlaphalaiḥ śumaiḥ' iti miśrīkaraṇe abhiṣuṇotiprayogadarśanāt miśrīkṛtavācī |
su. pṛ. 805. 'abhiṣutya hutvā bhakṣyanti' ityatra samudāye vākyaparisamāptiḥ |
bhā. 3|6|12 pṛ. 697. kriyāprādhānye tu tadaśrīkṛtaviṣaṣaṇasamudāye vākyapari- samāptiḥ : gargāśatadaṇḍanahomāmibhavabhavat |
vi. 5|2|60, abhiṣekaḥ rājasūyatābhiṣecanīyākhya- somayāge mādhyādine savane māhendrastotrāt bhavati |
bhā. 5|2|10|21. abhiṣekasya rāja- sūyatābhiṣecanīye apakṛṣṭatvāt videvanādīnāmapi prāgapakarṣaḥ |
vi. 5|2|10. abhiṣekò'pi (rājyābhiṣekaḥ) dharmataḥ kṣatriya- syaiva paṭhyate |
sa hāsau rājaśabdena tena nākṣatriye mataḥ ||
4|4|1. abhiṣecanīyasya dvātriṃśaḥ pava- mānāḥ tatra nava rājasāmāni, ekādaśa rājasāmāni, balaughaśravase, vaśiṣṭhasya janitritre ca sākaṃ pravedanā- nyāhuḥ |
ke. abhi- ṣecanīyasya saṃnidhau paṭhitānāmapi videvanādīnāṃ prakaraṇa- balena sarvarājasūyāṅgatvam |
vi. 3|1|10, abhi- ṣecanīyasya somakrayopasaṃvādena daśapeyayāgakrayopa- saṃvādasya sāhityaṃ 'saha somau krīṇāti' ityuktam |
abhiṣecanīyaḥ saṃsapāmyaḥ prāgeva kriyate, daśapeyastu saṃjñottareti viśeṣaḥ |
1|1|2|14, abhiṣeca- nīye māhendrastotre ābhrāk nivedanāthaḥ apa- karṣeṇa kartavyaḥ |
tatra abhiṣecanīyasya daśame'- hani daśapeyaḥ saṃpadyate |
daśapeye krayapratiṣkṛtaḥ pratikarṣastataḥ prācāṃ, tat samānaṃ tantraṃ syāt |
tatra cintyate kiṃ tayoḥ tantraprayogaḥ, athavā medeneti |
kutaḥ ? daśapeyasya krayaḥ pratikṛṣyate 'saha somaṃ krīṇāti abhiṣecanīya- daśapeyayoḥ' iti |
abhiṣecanīyasya pūrvakālī natvāt takrayakāle daśapeyakrayasya pratikarṣaḥ |
sa pratikṛṣya- māṇaḥ, tataḥ prāgbhāvin padārthān pratikarṣati 'tadādi vā'bhiśravantāt tadantamapakarṣa syāt' iti (5|1|3| 12|24) |
ta tantra- prakāntayoḥ pravṛttisaḥ tantrameva samāptiyuktā |
bhāṣyaṃ--'samāno vā eṣa yajño yad daśapeyaścā- bhiṣecanīyaśca' iti tantrasya samānatvāt yajñayoḥ samā- natvaṃ, ātmanā bhinnatvāt |
yat prāk ṛtupravṛtteḥ yajñasādhanopārjanakāle somavikrayeṇa saha saṃvādaḥ somasya parikrayaṇaṃ mūlyapari- cchedaḥ, saḥ arthādavaśyaṃ karaṇīyaḥ |
kutaḥ ? ṛtukale kadā cit somo na syāt vikretā vā asya (na syāt ), nārdheṇa vā dadyāt, tathā ṛtareva na saṃvarteta |
tatraiva ca krayo nirvṛttakalpaḥ, mūlyārpaṇamātraṃ paridhiham |
yadanyat tatra 'kalayā te krīṇāmi' ityevamādi tat dharmamātraṃ, paratantratvādeva vikretuḥ |
evaṃ ca sati bhinna- kālayoḥ yathākālameva aṅgāni bhaviṣyanti |
dṛṣṭaśca tasminnupasaṃvāde krayārthe krīṇāteḥ prayogaḥ 'devadattena saha asābhirdhanyaṃ krītaṃ upaśā saṃvṛttā' iti |
kathaṃ ? 'samānaṃ vā etad yajñaṃ vicchindanti, yadabhiṣecanīyasya avabhṛthamabhyavadyanti' iti |
tadevaṃ avabhṛthadarśanaṃ pūrvasmin upapadyeta, yadi medena tantra- pravṛttiḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ--daśapeyasya ca pṛthak dīkṣāṇāṃ darśanaṃ 'tathā abhiṣecanīyasya dīkṣā vardhayeyuḥ, yathā daśame'hani daśa- peyaḥ saṃpadyate, sadyo dīkṣayati, sadyaḥ somaṃ krīṇāti' iti |
itarathā abhiṣecanīye eva daśapeyasyāpi dīkṣāḥ syuḥ, tatra etat darśanaṃ nopapadyeta |
ekasmin ṛtau etau somau vartate, tata uttare saṃva- tsaradvayam |
etakālasāmyamapekṣya tat samānavacanaṃ anyathā upapadyate iti |
soma--- pūrvetra ālabhbhotkarṣaviṣayasaṃbhavāt prati- saṃvatsaraṃ paryabhikaraṇāntātkalāpātpatvāt ihābhiṣecanīya- daśapeyayoḥ samānatantratvābhāvāttu ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |

atra (somavikrayeṇa saha saṃvādaḥ iti yaduktaṃ tatra ) saṃvādaśabdena 'kalayā te krīṇāmi' 'bhūyo vā ataḥ somo rājā''hati' ityevaṃpraḥ kṣetravikretroḥ saṃvādaḥ somakrayakāle kartavyatā vihitaḥ, sa na vivakṣitaḥ,

tathā sati tasyākhyādeva tadapakarṣe sahopakrama- tasyāvarjanīyatvāpatteḥ; kiṃtu kratukāle yadi somavikrayī na labhyeta labdho'pi vā adhikamarthe yācyeta, tadā krureva na saṃvartata iti buddhyā ṛtuprayogāddhiraiva sādha- nāntarasaṃpadānavat vikretrā saha laukiko yo mūlya- niścayaḥ, sa vivakṣitaḥ, tasya cāndratvāt na sahaprayogāpā- dakatvamiti |
' bhāṭṭa— rājasūye iṣṭipuśusomayāgāḥ sarve bhinnatantrāḥ; ka cit kālabhedāt ka cidabhedāt ka cidakṣaṇā- bhedāt iti vakṣyate |
tatrābhiṣecanīyo nāma somayāgaḥ; tataḥ, ' saṃsṛpāṃ havīṃṣi, ' tataśca punardaśapeyaḥ somayāgaḥ śrutaḥ |
tāvimau abhiṣecanīyadaśapeyayo samānatantrau bhinnatantrau veti cintāyāṃ ' saha somaṃ krīṇātyabhiṣecanī
eva dadyāt, kāle na dadyāt' iti|
atra kāle dāridyavasthārūpe na dadyāt iti abhyanujñaiva, adadataḥ īṣadoṣāt|
bāla. pṛ. 33. oṃ abhyanujñāvidhibhedā: vidhibande vālapranthe draṣṭavyāḥ|
yathā vṛkṣaḥ prabalan sahāyavayavaiḥ pracalati, tathā prakṛte- 'pi bodhyam|
sāhasī. 828. oṃ abhyantaro hi samudāye'vayava iti nyāyaḥ|
tadyathā vṛkṣaḥ pracalanahavayavaiḥ pracalatīti 'ekāco dve prathamasya' (pā06|1|1) iti sūtramahābhāṣye'bhihitaḥ|
tathā 'lakṣaṇaśloke vyākaraṇam' iti vārtikamahā- bhāṣye prakārāntareṇa dhvanitaḥ|
tadyathā 'samudāye hi śabdāḥ pravṛttā avayaveṣvapi vartante|
tadyathā pūrve pañcālāḥ, uttare pañcālāḥ, taile bhuktaṃ, ghṛtaṃ bhuktaṃ, śuklaḥ, nīlaḥ, kṛṣṇa iti|
evaṃ samudāye vyākaraṇa- śabdaḥ pravṛtto'vayave'pi pravartate'|
sāhasī. 445. oṃ abhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ iti nyāyaḥ|
tat dvaṃdvasamāse pūrvaṃ prayojyaṃ yathā kṛṣṇā'rjunau ityādi|
oṃ abhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ iti nyāyaṃ āśritya tantraprasaṅgapratipādakayoḥ ekādaśadvādaśādhyāyayoḥ pūrvottarabhāva utpāditaḥ|
yadyapi sāmidhenīḥ pūrvamuktā anuṣṭheyāḥ, tathāpi 'abhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ' iti vyākaraṇanyāyena prayājayājyānāṃ prītihetūnāṃ abhyarhitatvāt tā eva ādhīḥ prathamaṃ vidhatte|
taisaṃsa. 5|1|8. oṃ abhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ iti nyāyaḥ|
utpatti- śiṣṭaguṇavarudve tadvirodhitvaguṇāntaravidhisaṃbhavo vaiśva- devādhikaraṇe (1|4|11|16-22) vyutpādayiṣya- māṇaḥ atra hetvantarasamuccayārthe uktaḥ|
vākyabhedaprasaṅga eva tu atra guṇopadeśaśabdoktaḥ pradhānahetuḥ iti 'abhya- rhitaṃ pūrvaṃ' iti nyāyena sūcanīyaḥ|
pṛ. 419, ādhārāgnihotrayoḥ aṅgāṅgisaṃbandhābhāvena 'abhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ nipatati' ityasya aviṣayatvāt atvāccaratvena ādhāraśabdasya pūrvanipāto yukta ādhārāgnihotraṃ (2|1|13 sū.) ityatra sūve|

pṛ. 788. paśusomayoḥ (2|1|17 sū.) ityatra paśu-śabdasya vyantatve 'lakṣaṇahetoḥ kriyāyāḥ' (pā0 3|1|26) ityādi dhvantasya pūrvanipātamyabhicārāt somasya prādhānyena abhyarhitatvāt paśoḥ pūrvatarābhidhānamayuktaṃ ityāśaṅkya nyāyaniṣṭhe śāstre nyāyatulyādanādaraviṣayasya abhyarhitatvāt paśoḥ pūrvanipāto yuktaḥ ityāha|
vi. 8|4|4, abhyātānahomāḥ 'agnirbhūtānāṃ patiḥ' ityādimantraiḥ kriyamāṇā homāḥ|
3|4|13. abhyātānahomāḥ vaidikakarmaṇāṃ śeṣabhūtāḥ, na laukikānāṃ kṛṣyādīnām|
maṇi. pṛ. 13. abhyāsaḥ avaghātādīnāṃ dṛṣṭārthānāṃ prayojananiṣpattiparyantam|
11|1|16 28, abhyāsaḥ triḥ sāmidhenyāṃ prathamottamayodharmo na ṛgdharmaḥ|
oṃ abhyāsaḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ prāthamyāt sthāna- dharmaḥ syāt|
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sāmidhenīḥ prakṛtya 'triḥ prathamā-manvāha triruttamāṃ' iti śrūyate|
tatra kiṃ trirvacanaṃ ṛgdharmaḥ, 'pra vo vājā' iti ṛk yatra vartamānā'pi trirvyasitavyetyetā iti, kiṃvā sthānadharmaḥ yā anyā'pi prathamamucyate sā trirvacanyā iti vicāre siddhāntamāha|
sāmidhenīnāṃ prathamāyāḥ yo'yamabhyāsa uktaḥ, sa sthāna-dharmaḥ sthānasya dharmaḥ syāt|
prathamasthāne yā ṛk ucyate, sā trirvaktavyā iti|
prāthamyāt 'triḥ prathamānvāha' iti abhyasanīyatvā ṛcaḥ prāthamyoktvāt|
tasmā-nyāyaṃ ṛco dharmaḥ, kiṃtu prathamasya sthānasyeti|
tena yatra ekaiva sāmidhenī syāt, sā'pi pravovājīyāyāḥ bhinnā, sā'pi trirvaktavyā|
ke. oṃ abhyāsaḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ prāthamyāt sthānadharmaḥ syāt|

'triḥ prathamānvāha triruttamāṃ' iti prathamottama- śabdayoḥ prathamavāgatvānthanasthānaparatvātkimetanmahatvāt na tadupalakṣitapravovājā- ājuhoteti ṛkparatā iti su. pṛ. 469. abhyāsaḥ sāmnāṃ viruddhastomakatau vahiṣpavamāne|
bhā. 10|5|126, abhyāsaḥ sthānavi- vṛddhyā gavāyamane tryanīkāsu|
10|5|2|83-87. oṃ abhyāsena tu saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ sāmidhenīṣvabhyāsa- prakṛtitvāt|
'ekaviṃśatimanubrūyāt pratiṣṭhākāmasya', 'caturvi-śatimanubrūyāt brahmavarcasa- kāmasya' ityādibhyaḥ kāmyāḥ sāmidhenīkalpāḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyante|
tatra ekā-daśabhyaḥ adhikā saṃkhyā ṛgāgamanena pūrayitavyā, uta prathamottamayorāvṛttaḥ abhyāsena, athavā yāva-duktamabhyasya śeṣāṇāṃ ṣaḍādīnā- māgamaḥ|
atra mūlataḥ ekādaśasaṃkhyā, tatra daśādīnāmāgamanena saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ iti prathamaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ|
sāmidhenīṣu kāmyāsu, abhyāsena prathamottamayoreva yāva-tsaṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ abhyāsena, saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ syāt|
abhyāsaḥ prakṛtau yāsāṃ tā abhyāsaprakṛtayaḥ iti vyadhikaraṇo bahuvrīhiḥ|
tathā sati sāmidhenīnāṃ abhyāsaprakṛtitvāt ekaviṃśa-tyādikalpeṣu saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ prathamottamayorabhyā- senaiva syāt|
ekādaśānāṃ prathamottamayoḥ trirvirāmasena pañca-daśatvaṃ, ṣaḍvāraṃ ṣaḍvāramabhyāsena ekaviṃśatitvaṃ, pratha-māyāḥ ṣaḍvāraṃ uttamāyāśca navavāraṃ abhyāsena caturvi-śativaṃ ityādi|

darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ekaviṃśatyādiṣu kāmyeṣu sāmidhenī-kalpeṣu saṃkhyā- pūraṇaṃ abhyāsena kartavyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣiṇā ukte, aniśeṣāt prakṛtau vikṛtau ca aviśeṣaprasaṅgāt nāmyāsena saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ iti cet kaścit brūyāt|
tasmāt ā saṃkhyāpūraṇāt abhyasyet, prathamottamayoḥ yāvatkṛtvaḥ abhyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ|
prakṛtivat yathā prakṛtau ā pañcadaśasaṃkhyāpūraṇāt abhyasyate tadvat|
yāvaduktaṃ abhyasya ekādaśānāṃ ṛcāṃ 'triḥ prathamā- manvāha triruttamām' iti uktvā raulyā pañcadaśatvaṃ saṃpadya tato'dhikā saṃkhyā ṛgāgamanena pūrayitavyā|
'triḥ prathamānvāha triruttamām' iti uktvā parimāṇaṃ abhyā-sasya|
satadaśasāmidhenīke agnī-ṣomīye paśau 'pṛthupājāḥ' taṃ sravāḥ' iti ṛcoḥ adhikayoḥ āgamanitāḥ darśanāt anyātrāpi adhika-saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ ṛgāgamaneti gamyate|
kāmyeṣu ekaviṃśatyādiṣu sāmidhenīkalpeṣu yadi āgamanena saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ syāt, tadā gāyatraviśeṣarūpeṣu dhurisāmakarmasvapi abhyāsa mā bhūt |
dhurisāmakarmasu ‘āvṛttaṃ dhuryu stavate’ iti abhyāsasya coditatvāt yukto'bhyāsaḥ |
tasmāt ekaviṃśatyādiṣu kāmyeṣu sāmi- dhenīkalpeṣu ‘triḥ prathamamanvāha triruttamāṃ’ iti yāva- duktaṃ anyasya tato'dhikā saṃkhyā ṛgāgamaneaiva pūra- yitavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. abhyāsena sāmidhenīnāṃ nityā pañcadaśasaṃkhyā ( āyantyorabhyāsena ) vihitā ‘triḥ prathamamanvāha triruttamāṃ’ iti, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
bhā. 10|1|8|27. abhyāsāt bhāvanābhedaḥ tena ca karmabhedaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|16. abhyāsasya punarvidhānalakṣaṇasya bhedakatvaṃ yuktaṃ vidheḥ apravṛttatvasambhavāt anyataḥ prāpteḥ vidhivyākhyātāpateḥ |
su. pṛ. 820. abhyāse ca tadabhyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ punaḥprayo- gāt |
dvādaśāha śrutaṃ ‘saṃsthite pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe mavvāśa- yet ghṛtaṃ vā’ iti, tat codakena prāptam |
tatra ṣaḍahasya abhyāse pratipad‌hantaṃ madhubhojanasyābhyāsaḥ syāt |
karmaṇaḥ ṣaḍahakarmaṇa eva punaḥprayogāt punaḥ- punaḥprayogāt |
tasmāt ṣaḍahavṛttau pratipad‌hantaṃ madhubhojanaṃ iti pūrva- pakṣaḥ |
‘saṃsthite pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe mavvāśayet ghṛtaṃ vā’ iti dvādaśāha vihitaṃ bhojanaṃ codakena prāptaṃ ānantyena kṛtānāṃ ṣaḍahānāṃ ante sakṛdeva kāryaṃ, na tu pratipad‌hante |
kṛto hi bhojanasya kālo niścitaḥ : ‘saṃsthite paḍahe’ iti |
na ca punaḥpaḍahaṃ kurvāṇaḥ ṣaḍahagatāt vyāpārāt uparata ityucyate |
tasmāt ānantyeṇa kṛtānāṃ ṣaḍahānāṃ sarveṣāmante sakṛdeva madhyāhnaśaṃ, na pratipad‌hante iti siddhāntaḥ |
vā-- śabdāntarādhikaraṇaprayudāharaṇarūpeṇa abhyāsasya pūrvapakṣaḥ sulabhamabhidhīyate, iti tadanantaramārambhaḥ |
tatra ‘samidho yajati, tanūnapātaṃ yajati’ ityādiṣu samidhā- diśabdān apodapulya ‘yajati’ ityetat pañcakṛto- bhihitaṃ kimekasya karmaṇo vācakaṃ, athānekasya ityudā- hṛtam |
‘guṇo vā nāmadheyaṃ vā sami- dādipadaṃ bhavet |
tābhyāmeva ca bhedo'tra kima- bhyāsaḥ : kariṣyati ||
svasāmarthyamātrāpalāphalaḥ darśayitavyāḥ; tat yāvadatra guṇanāmadheyobhedakatvaṃ nāpanīyate, na tāvadabhyāsasya paramābhalābhaḥ asti, ityanudāhartavyam |
kutaḥ ? ‘prayujyate hi vedeṣu nākhyātaṃ kevalaṃ kaṃ cit |
nāma kiṃ cit prayuktaṃ cet tasya coktaṃ gatidvayam ||
’ ‘aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti’ ityeva- mādīni hi sarvāṇi parasparasaṃgātyā autpattikaguṇayogāt bhidyante |
‘bhinne juhoti’ ‘skanne juhoti’ ityādīnyapi ‘phalaṃ cākarmasaṃnidhau’ ityanena nyāyena ( 2|3|12| 25 ) nimittaṃ prati upādīyamānatvāt bhidyante |
ye tu pañcaśarādīyeṣu ‘tān paryagnikṛtān, tān paryagnikṛtān’ ityevaṃ abhyāsamudāharanti, teṣāṃ prākṛtaparyagnikaraṇānuvāda- prasaraṇasāmarthyaṃ tat |
na vā atra yajatiḥ śrūyate, yasyā- bhyāsāt bhedaḥ syāt, iti na kiṃ cidudāharaṇam |
’ yāni upādeyārthāni nāmapadāni, tāni tāvat ākhyātaparatantratvāt tadanusārāṇi santi tadvṛtti pratīkṣante |
taccet prakṛte niviṣṭaṃ, nāmapadamapi tasyaiva guṇavidhinimittameva vā |
atha tena apūrve pari- kalpitaṃ atastadāmi nāmapadaṃ, ityevaṃ medābhedayoragatayoḥ paścāt āgacchat samidādipadaṃ akiṃcikkaratvādāste, tena tat apodapulya ākhyātamātraṃ vicāryate |
tatra tau bhedakau, yatra ākhyātapadaṃ na vyāpriyate |
jyotirādau api ākhyātasya guṇaphalasaṃbandhavyāpāreṇa prakṛtaniveśasaṃbhave sati tataḥ pūrvapravṛttyā saṃśayeva bhedo bhaviṣyati |
yatrāpi ākhyātasya svarasena prakṛtakarmaniveśopapade sati tatrāsaṃbhavan guṇo vidhīyate, tatrāpyasau bhedakaḥ : yathā'- traiva abhyupetavāde vakṣyati ‘sa eṣa devatāyāsaṃbandho vidhīyamānaḥ’ ityādi |
tacca ākhyātasya bhedaśaktau vihitāyāṃ bhavati, iti tadeva tāvat prathamaṃ parīkṣyate |
yadā kimekaṃ karma apūrvaṃ codayati, uta padmāpi karmāṇi apūrvāṇi iti |
’ api ca ‘pūrvaṃ tenaiva śabdena buddhau karma niveśitam |
’ yathaiva yajatiśabdaḥ sakṛdyatasevaṇāgataḥ, punaḥ- ruccāraṇe sa eveti pratyabhijñānāt na bhidyate, tathā tadartho'pi |
yathā caitraiva buddhaudhanakṛtaṃ pratyakṣaṃ anarthakamapi bhavat na śaknoti śabdāntaraṃ kartuṃ, evaṃ punaḥśrutiḥ arthāntaravam |
nahi anarthakathaṃ nāma ca cittapramāṇavargaṃ antarbhavati |
tadiha eka- śabdena abhede vedenāvagamite yo'nyatvaṃ kalpayati, tena veda eva aprāmāṇyīkṛtaḥ syāt |
asti ceyamapi gatiḥ, prayogavacana- saṃspṛṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ arthamavadattvaṃ svayaṃ prayogitvena gṛhyate iti |
asti hi loke dvivaṃcanāt atirekeṇāpi yāvatkulaḥ abhyaste vivakṣitārthaprakāśane bhavati, tāvatkulaḥ abhyāsaḥ |
tathā ca pañcendrapākhyāne buddhakumāraprārthane ‘patiṃ me dehi’ iti pañcakṛtvaḥ abhyāsaḥ śrūyate |
na ca yathā tatra devatāyāḥ chalagrāhitvaṃ, evamiha kasya cit, yena pañcakṛtvaḥ ( yudhiṣṭhirādipañcaka ) pañcayāga- kalpanā syāt |
athavā sarveṣvapi uccāraṇeṣu vidhau āśrīyamāṇe karmaikatvaṃ vijñāyate yathā śāstrāntarīyeṣu mī. ko. 72
tena tulyārthānāṃ vaikalpikatvāt tadeva karma kadā cit samidādyanyanābhidhāsyate, kadā cit tanūnapādākhyena |
nahi samānakāryatvena vrīhiyavayoḥ ekasthānārthakatvāt arthāntarasādhakatvaṃ vijñāyate |
karma- vidhāne hi sati nāmadheyatvaṃ bhavet, anuvāde tu nāma- dheyavidhinaṃ saṃbhavati iti guṇavidhitvam |

yatrāpi ca pradeśāntare tāveva śabdārthau pratyabhi- jñāyate, tatrāpi hi yajñāgnirgatasya punarjanmanapratyabhijñā- yāmica arthāntaratvamaśakyaṃ vaktuṃ, kimuta iha anantara- viparivṛtyā balīyasyā avaruddhāyāṃ buddhau |
yadi ca pratyuccāraṇamarthānyatvaṃ bhavet, tadā anityavyaktiśabdārthatva- prasaṅgaḥ |
kiṃca ' gatvādibanna caiteṣu yāgattvaṃ vyati- ricyate |
tathyaktvatve niruḍhe ca kathaṃ karmāntaraṃ bhavet ||
tadekatvāt tadartho'pi na bhedaṃ pratipa- dyate |
' tasmādeko yāgaḥ, tadekatvācca bhāvanā'pūrvayo- rapi ekatvam |
' tasmāt yāgabhedāt bhāvanā- bhedaḥ, tadumedācca apūrvabhedaḥ |
su— dhātvarthabhedāt bhāvanāyā apyabhedaḥ iti pratya- dāharaṇarūpeṇa pūrvapakṣasaukaryāt anantarasaṃgatiḥ |
soma— sūtrārthastu, ekasya punaḥ śrutirapi evaṃ śabdā- ntaravat bhedikā, aviśeṣāt dadhyādivat vidheyaviśeṣā- bhāvāt |
vidhitvaṃ śrutite bhāti saṃnidheranuvādā (bhāti, sā ca śruti to durbalā) |
svāhākāraṃ yajati' ityādau yāgasyāpi pratyabhijñāmānatvena abhedācca bhāvanā- bhedaḥ |
na ca vidhipunaḥ śravaṇarūpasyāsya vidheyatvādibhedakatvaṃ, 'dadhnā juhoti' itivat vidhe- devatāpurupaṇasaṃkrāntaśaktivena yāgaviṣayatvāt |
na ca yāgotpattivākyasthaguṇavarodhāt notpannavākyena guṇavidhiḥ, agatyā prāthamikavākyasthasamidapadasya tadavya- nyāyena nāmadheyatvīkārāt |
vastutastu, yadi yājyā mantravarṇāt samidhāsiḥ, tadā sā tadanupādādīnāma- pyaviśiṣṭā |
ataḥ upāṃśuyājānuvādena viddhadākyavihita- karmānuvādena vā pañcasvapi devatāvidhiḥ |
na ca saṃbhava- yāstikatā, yājyā mantravat anumantraṇamantrebhyo'pi vikalpena vasantādidevatāprāptisaṃbhavena eteṣāṃ niyama- vidhilopapatteḥ |
iti prāpte, ubhayākāṅkṣabalamantravyājā- mantrāṇāmeva devatākalpakatvasya puraḥsphūrtikatvena anyatarā- kāṅkṣābalamantraṇamantrebhyo devatākalpakatvānupapatteḥ na samidādipādānāṃ devatāniyāmakatvam |
ataścopapadā- rthasya saṃbhavatprāptikātvāt padaśrutyādinā vidheyatvārthabhāva- nāviṣayatvapratītervihitavidhānāyogāt vidheyatā'vaccheda- katayā vaijatyasiddhiḥ |

na caivaṃ tatprakhyanyāyena samidādi- pādānāṃ nāmadheyatvāt saṃśayaiva medasiddhiḥ, tadakhyanyāyena guṇavidhitvanirākaraṇaṃ nāmadheyakāryasyaikaiva ekasmin karmaṇi siddhe anekeṣāṃ nāmadheyānāṃ vaiyarthyaprasaṅgena sami- dādipādānāṃ guṇānuvādakatvenaiva upapatternāmanirṇayāt |
siddhe tvabhyāsena karmabhede ekaikkakarmaṇaḥ ekaikaṃ nāmadheyaṃ sārthakayamiti nāmatvanirṇayaḥ |
kau— devatāvidhipūrvapakṣe tāvat dṛṣṭārthatvena vikalpāt sakṛdeva karmānuṣṭhānam |

āvṛttividhipūrvapakṣe tu yatra vikṛtiviśeṣe apūrvārthe samidhāguṇaḥ, tatrāpi tanupadādisāṃsiddhikāḥ āvṛtteḥ samidhāgāṅgatvena prāpteḥ pañcakṛto'nuṣṭhānaṃ, tathā samidāgāśritasya phalorthasya guṇasya pañcānāmapi anuṣṭhānam |
vikṛtiviśeṣe ca punaḥ śrutasya samidhāmātrasyaivānuṣṭhānaṃ, kāmyaśca guṇastatrānujñeyaḥ iti |

saṃśāntarasyāpi guṇopavandhāt phalopavandhādā vidhāya- kasya guṇe phalecchāvyāpṛtatvena yajyarthaṃ vyāpārābhāvāt abhyāsādhyāyena aryāntare dharyayogāt kathaṃ tadupa- bhūto yāgaḥ ? saṃśāntarasya saṃjñī syāt ityāśaṅkya |
su. pṛ. 822-823. saṃjñāyāḥ vidheyaviśeṣapratipatyartha- tvāt bhāvananirapekṣasya ca dhātvarthasya vidheyatvādyogāt vidheyabhāvanābhedaṃ vinā anarthakatvāpatteḥ |
abhyāsādhyāyena bhāvanābhedakatvaṃ bhaviṣyati ityāśaṅkya uktaṃ, vidhe- apravṛttapravartanasvabhāvāt anyataḥ prāptervidheyatvadhā- tāpatteḥ punarvidhānalakṣaṇasyāsya bhedakatvaṃ yuktam |
vākyatayā tatraṃśārthe kevalamāvāsyāvākyamevānuvādaḥ iti viśeṣagrahamaṇāt vidhipunaḥśravaṇābhāvācca nāmyāsā- nyāyāvatāraḥ |
kau. 2|1 720 pṛ. 232. abhyāsādhikaraṇe yajisamabhi- vyāhṛtā saṃjñā na medikā iti cet |
ucyate, ananyaparā- khyātasamabhivyāhṛtā hi saṃjñā satyaṃ na medikā |
tautā. 2|3|4|1 pūrvapakṣe. abhyāsādhikaraṇanyāyena: ananyaparapunaḥśravaṇasya bhedakatvāvaśyakaṃ iti nyāya- svarūpam |
atra 'samidho yajati, tannūnapātaṃ yajati, iḍo yajati, barhiryajati, svāhākāraṃ yajati' iti yajati- padasya abhyāsāt karmabhedo'bhidhīyate |
yadyapi abhyā- sāt yāgabhedavat bhāvanābhedo'pi śakyate vaktuṃ, tathāpi śabdāntareṇāpi tatsaṃbhavāt asādhāraṇabhāvanā nopanyastaḥ |
medaśca na vyaktimātrasya, api tu tadgatajāterapi, vidheyabhede vidheyatā'vacchedakabhedasya autsargikatvāt |

1|3|6|12 pṛ. 90. 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'- māvāsyāyāṃ bhavati' ityatra kiṃ kāladvayayuktavihiteme- yāgāt yāgāntaraṃ vidhīyate, uta sa eva yāgo vidhīyate iti saṃśaye abhyāsādhikaraṇanyāyena karmabhedaḥ sidhyati iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
abhyāse hi upādeyatāṃ atantrīkṛtya pariśeṣeṇa dhātvarthe vidheyatvā- pādanameva vyāpāraḥ |
ata eva tatra saṃnidhiḥ prativandhaḥ, na tu prakaraṇāntare iṣa pratibandhakaḥ |
prakaraṇāntaresthale tu na pariśeṣeṇa vidheyatvāpādanaṃ vyāpāraḥ |
agnihotrasya yāvajjīvikasya yāvajjīvaṃ iti padena yo'bhyāsa uktaḥ, sa puruṣārtho vidhīyate |
tasya akarma- śeṣatvāt anyasya kasya cit karmaṇaḥ śeṣatvaṃ asya nāsti |
tasmāt sātatyena homaḥ kartavyaḥ, na kevalaṃ sāyaṃprātareva iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
kutūhale tu abhyāso vā, karmaśeṣatvāt akarmaśeṣa- tvāt ityapi cchedaḥ, sāyaṃprātaḥkālyoḥ kāmyaprayoga- viṣayatvāt, naimittikaprayogaviṣayatvāvāt ca iti vyākhyātam |
vāśabdo niṣedhe, nāyamabhyāsaḥ akarma- śeṣatvāt, kiṃtu niyamaḥ puruṣārthaḥ tataśca sātatyenānuṣṭhānaṃ iti somanāthena vyākhyātam |
paraṃtu tasmin satate kāle nidrāsnānāhārādiprāptyā satataṃ hotavyaṃ na śakyate |
arthāt, tyalope pañcamī nidrāsnānāhārādi rūpa arthe parityajya avaśiṣṭe satate kāle hotavyam |
arthāt arthāpatyā nidrādikālātirikta kāle satataṃ hotavyam |
yāvajjīvamihotraṃ nidrādikālaṃ parityajya satataṃ hotavyaṃ iti sūtrābhyāṃ prāptaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ niṣidhya siddhāntaṃ sūtrayati |
na nidrāsnānāhārādīnāṃ kālebhyaḥ anyatra satataṃ hotavyam |
athavā nidrāsnānādikālāt parityajya itarasmin kāle satataṃ na hotavyam |
kutaḥ ? yataḥ: ‘pradoṣamagnihotraṃ hotavyaṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ prātaḥ’ iti kāla- viśeṣaḥ upadiśyante |
kiṃca yathā agnihotrakālā upa- diśyante tathā 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta, amā- vāsyāyāṃ amāvāsyā yajeta' 'yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityapi kālā upadiśyante |
na ca ekasmin kāle bhinnakarmānuṣṭhānaṃ saṃbhavati |
tasmāt sāyaṃprātaḥkālyoḥ yāvajjīvaṃ prayogaḥ agnihotrasya, paurṇamā'māvāsyayoḥ yāvajjīvaṃ prayogaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
‘kālo hyupadiśyate’ iti sūtraṃ kutūhale paṭhi- tam |
hi yasmāt kālaḥ kālaviśeṣaḥ upadiśyate tasmāt na satataṃ homaḥ |
kālaliṅgānāṃ kāla- viśeṣabodhakaliṅgānāṃ darśanāt kālavidhānaṃ sāyaṃprātarādi- kālastha homādyarthaṃ vidhānamiti jñeyam |
'apa vā epa svargāllokāccyavate yo darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ san pūrṇa- māsīmāmāvāsyāṃ vā'tipātayet' iti |
yadi sattte kāle homaḥ syāt, tadā kasyātipattiḥ syāt ? tasmādapi na satatamprayāsaḥ kintu vihite kāle |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ āśvinasārasvatendreṣu paśuṣu aindra- sāvitravāruṇānāṃ paśudevatānāṃ saṃskārakatvāyogāmāśāṅkya tannirāsārthe abhyāso' |
iti sūtre 'tathā paśau pañcānāṃ prayājānāṃ codakena prātānāṃ ekādaśasaṃkhyā vidhīyate, sā ca antareṇābhyāsaṃ nāvakalpate, iti abhyasyante prayājāḥ' ityabhyāsena sarvavyāpūrvaṃ bhāṣyakṛt vakṣyati |
su. pṛ. 808. abhyuccayaḥ nāma ( atra ) na kiṃ cit vastu- svarūpaṃ vidyate, kintu upahomaḥ anuyājā na bādhyante iti bādhābhāvamātraṃ abhyuccayaḥ ityucyate |
11 | 1|1|9 pṛ. 2096. abhyuccayaḥ nāma yat 'idamiha bhavati iti vijñāte aparamapi bhavati' iti viśānam |
śākalame tu śāko'pyāhartavyaḥ na tu śākārthe pṛthak kālayāpana- mabhiprete iti ) |
7|1|1|1 pṛ. 1523. abhyudaye kālāparādhādyācodanā syād yathā pañcaśarāve |
candrābhyuditehau vicāraḥ kiṃ kālāparādhanimittaṃ yāgāntaraṃ codyate, kiṃvā darśakarmaṇaiva naimittikaḥ prākṛta- devatā'panayaḥ iti |
atraiva yāga- kāla iti matvā darśaiṣṭeḥ ārambhaḥ kṛtaḥ, taduttaraṃ ca candrasya abhyudaye sati kālasya aparādho bhavati |

hetoḥ 'sa nedhā taṇḍulān vibhajet, ye madhyamāḥ sthū- tānamaye dātre puroḍāśamaṣṭakapālaṃ nirvapet, ye sthavi- ṣṭhāstānindrāya pradātre dadhaścaruṃ, ye kṣodiṣṭhāstān viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śṛte caruṃ' ityanena ijyācodanā ijyāyāḥ darśāt yāgāntarasya codanā vidhiḥ syāt |
yathā havi- rāteṃ aindre pañcaśarāve odane dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena ijyā- codanā karmāntaraṃ vihitaṃ tadat |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ bādhabandena nirasya siddhāntāha |
nātra karmāntaravidhiḥ prākṛtadevatā'varuddheṣu haviḥṣu deva- tā'ntaravidhānāsaṃbhavāt |
tasmāt atra prākṛtīnāṃ deva- tānāṃ apanayaḥ kriyate |
apanayaṃ ca kṛtvā teṣveva haviḥṣu devatā'ntarāṇi vidhīyante prākṛtānāṃ haviṣāṃ vidyamānatvāt |
'ye madhyamāḥ sthūstānamaye dātre'ṣṭakapālaṃ nirvapet' ityādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ tadupatvāt pūrvadevatā'panayapūrvakadevatā'ntaravidhirupatvāt |
dadhibhāvāyai payasi pūrvasiddhasya dadhnaḥ prakṣepaḥ ātaghnam |
tasya yo'- bhyāsaḥ āvṛttiḥ, tasya darśanāt abhyuditeṣṭivaikyaiḥ karmāntaraṃ na vidhīyate, kintu teṣveva haviḥṣu devatā'ntaraṃ vidhīyate |
'yadi bibhīyāt abhi modeṣyatīti mahā- rātre havīṃṣi nirvapet |
phalīkṛtastaṇḍulairupāsīta, ardha dadhi havirātaghnārthe nirvayāt ardha na, yadi abhyudi- yāt tena ātaghnasya pracaret |
yadi na, prātaretena brāhma- ṇān bhojayet' ityanena ātaghnasya āvṛttiruktā |
yadi naimittikaḥ prākṛtadevatā'panayaḥ, tatastasmin prākṛte dadhani caruḥ kṛtaḥ, iti punaḥ āmāvāsye dohe āta- ghnena kāryam |
evaṃ ātaghnasyāsya darśanaṃ devatā- vidhāne yujyate, na karmāntaravidhāne |
thulyasthi somanāthenoktaḥ-- yajamāno yadi kiṃ caturdaśyāmeva mayā darśayāgaḥ prakāntaḥ, tataḥ candramāḥ māṃ abhi māmilakṣya udeṣyati iti vimi-
yāt, tadā mahārātre tribhāgaviśaṣṭāyāṃ rātrau buddhayā prayogaṃ prakramya phalīkaraṇaparyantaṃ kṛtvā candrodayadabhāvau pratīkṣamāṇa āsīt |
tadā sāyaṃdehiniṣṭhaṃ yadyadhi, tat dvedhā vibhajya ardha pratipadi svakāle kartavyadaśārthe yaddhaviḥ tadātanārthaṃ nidadhyāt, arthāntaraṃ ca nātaghna- nāthai nidadhyāt, kintu tūṣṇīṃ paripālayet |
tadevaṃ sati yadi candramā abhyudiyāt, tadā ātaghnārthe nihitena dadhnā prātardohamātaghnya tanniṣvena navīnadadhnā pracaret yāgaṃ kuryāt |
yadi candro nāmyudiyāt, tadā ātaghnārthe nihitenārthena dadhnā brāhmaṇān bhojayet iti |
ardha na, kiṃtu tat abhyuditehaviṣe viniñjīta, na ca tat sānāyya- yāge eva |
etena āta- ghnārthe sthāpitanaiva iti vyākhyātam |

nanu, yathā 'yaḥ paśukāmaḥ syāt so'māvāsyāmiṣṭvā vastānapākuryāt, ye sthaviṣṭhāstānamaye dātre'ṣṭakapālaṃ kuryāt, ye madhyamāstānamaye viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śṛte caruṃ, ye'ṇḍiṣṭhāstānamaye pradātre dadhaścarum' iti karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate tathā prakṛte'pi karmāntarameva syāditi |
tatrāha-- paśukāmaṣṭyā apūrvatvāt apūrva- yāgavidhānāt karmāntarasya vidhānaṃ syāt |
prakṛte tu darśayāgaḥ prakṛta eva bhavati, tatra ca siddhasyaiva dravyasya prakṛtamidadevatāsaṃbandhamātraṃ vidhīyate iti na karmāntara- tvam |
payodoṣāt payaso dadhno vā doṣāt nāśādirūpasya doṣasyotpannatvāt pañcaśarāve karmāntaravidhānaṃ yuktam |
itarat prakṛtaṃ tu candrābhyuditeṣṭiśca prākṛtaṃ dadhi śṛtaṃ ca aduṣṭaṃ na duṣṭam |
hi yasmāt adṛṣṭaṃ, tasmāt dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyāt nātra karmāntaravidhiḥ |
athavā tuśabdasthāne hi śabdaḥ, aduṣṭaṃ hi aduṣṭaṃ tu itarat iti |
yadi havirdoṣāt pañcaśarāve karmāntaravidhiḥ saṃbhavati, tarhi prakṛte'pi karmāntaraṃ syāt |
dadhani śṛte ca candrodayadoṣat duṣṭatva- mutpannam |
tasmādatrāpi karmāntaraṃ syāt, iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
dadhiśṛta rūpasānāyyasyāpi pañcaśarāveodāharaṇasyamiva, candrodayadoṣeṇa doṣe duṣṭaṃ iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā, tanna |
pañcaśarāve tu dravyaṃ svarūpeṇa duṣṭameva bhavati, iha tu na tathā |
abhyudaye prāyaścittavidhānaṃ duṣṭe'pi upapadyate, kālāparādhena abhyudaye'pi tadupapadyate |
paraṃtu akāle pravṛttasya syate devatāvidhānaṃ, na tu pañcaśarāve vina- esya |
candrābhyuditeṣṭau prākṛtadravyoddeśena devatā'vidhiḥ iti siddhāntā yaduktaṃ tadayuktam |
abhyudayakāle śrapa- ṇasya akṛtatvena prākṛtasya śṛtatvābhāvāt uddeśyatvāsaṃbha- vāt iti cenna |
śrapaṇasahacaritatvātpākaraṇārthidharma- viśiṣṭapayasaḥ lakṣaṇārtho śrutaśrutiḥ iti nānuppattiḥ śṛta- śabdasya |
sarvathā'pi abhyuditeṣṭiḥ na karmāntaraṃ, kintu prākṛtadevatā'panayapūrvakaṃ anyadevatāsaṃbandhavidhānamātram |
ke. abhyudaye dohāpanayaḥ svadharmā syāt pravṛtta- tvāt |

'vi vā enaṃ prajāyā paśubhirarthayati, vardhayatyasya bhrātṛvyaṃ, yasya havirnirgataṃ purastāt candramā abhyudeti, sa tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajet, ye madhyamāstānamaye dātre puroḍāśamaṣṭakapālaṃ nirvapet, ye sthaviṣṭhāstānindrāya pradātre dadhaścaruṃ, ye kṣodiṣṭhāstān viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śṛte carum' iti candrābhyuditeṣṭiruktā |
yasya yajamānasya haviḥ dārśikaṃ niruptaṃ tadā ca purastāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi candramā abhi niruptaṃ haviramiśrya udeti, nirvāpottaraṃ ca uditaścandro dṛṣṭaḥ ityarthaḥ |
tādṛśaścandramāḥ enaṃ yajamānaṃ prajayā paśubhiśca vyayutaṃ viyuktaṃ karoti |
kiṃca asya ātravyaṃ śatruṃ vardhayati prajayā paśubhiśca |
tathā sati yajamānasya akālakaraṇajanyadoṣanirāsārtha prāya- ścittamidaṃ kartavyam |
tadāha-sa yajamānaḥ avahananādinā saṃpāditān taṇḍulān tredhā haviṣ-madhyama-aniṣṭha- rūpeṇa vibhajet vakṣyamāṇarītyā devatāntarebhyo vibhaktān kuryāt |
tadyathā ye taṇḍulā madhyamaparimāṇāḥ syuḥ tān dātulguṇāyā abhye apsu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet kuryāt |
madhyamapaṇḍulānāṃ puroḍāśaḥ kartavyaḥ, sa ca abhye dātre |
evaṃ svaviṣṭhānāṃ sthūlatamānāṃ taṇḍu- lānāṃ caruṃ pradātuguṇāte indrāya nirvapet |
evaṃ aṇiyāṇāṃ aṇutamamānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ caruṃ viṣṇave śipiviṣṭaguṇakāya nirvapet |
ayaṃ ca caruḥ śrute saṃskṛte payasi śrapaṇīyaḥ iti śrūyate |
tatra śrute dadhan iti dadhipayasoḥ pradānadharmāḥ kartavyā na veti vicāre siddhāntenopakramate |
candrasya abhyudaye nimitte sati yo'yaṃ śrutyukto doṣāpanayaḥ daśīdevatābhyaḥ sakā- śāt apanayo vibhāgo doṣasya, so'yaṃ apanīto doṣaḥ dadhipayorūpaḥ |
svadharmā svasya doṣasya dharmāḥ yasmin, tādṛśaḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? svadharmāt ? pravṛttatvāt ityārthameva dadhiśrutyoḥ pravṛttatvāt |
tasmāt abhyudaye'pi dadhiśrutyoḥ pradānadharmāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
candrābhyuditeṣṭau śrute dadhani ca pradānadharmā vatsāpā- karaṇadāyaḥ kartavya iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
'śrute caruṃ' iti śrutasya siddhavat upadeśāt dadhipayasoḥ ijyārthā dharmāḥ kartavyā iti jñāyate |

yadyapi (41-42) idaṃ sūtradvayaṃ tuśabdavācyavakṣyamāṇatve pūrvapakṣapratipādakaṃ, uttaraṃ ca sūtra- dvayaṃ bādhavyuttvāt siddhāntapratipādakaṃ iti catuḥsūtraka- mekamadhikaraṇamiti bhāti, tathāpi bhāṣyakāraiḥ adhikaraṇa- bhedamālabhya sūtracatuṣṭayaṃ vyākhyātam |
yadyapi ca śloka- vārtike codanāsūtre tat dūṣitaṃ, tathāpi atra pāṣṭhādhi- karaṇāvirodhāt tadeva ḍupaṭīkāyāṃ sādhitamiti dhyeyam |
ke. abhyuditeṣṭauḥ darśaśruti dvayoḥ karmaṇobhedādavayaṃ- bhāvāt dve eva yajeta na kevalaṃ abhyuditeṣṭau iti pakṣa eva āśrayaṇīyaḥ |
1|2|9. abhyuditeṣṭiḥ darśasyaiva candrodayanaimittikaḥ prayogaḥ, na tu darśalopaprāya- ścittam |
ato naimittikaṃ darśaprayogamabhyudaye'pimanu- ṣṭhāya paścāt svātme nitye darśaprayogo'nuṣṭhātavyaḥ |
vi. 6|5|1, abhyuditeṣṭiḥ darśakarmaṇi pravṛtte candrodayaṃ nimittīkṛtya tadeva darśakarma abhyuditeṣṭitvena naimittika- tvena kartavyaṃ bhavati, na tu tat karmāntaram |
6|5|1, abhyuditeṣṭiḥ dadhaukrame sati nirvāpāt prāgapi candrodaye sati kartavyā avahitakāle karmopakramāt |
bhāṣyam-- aya prārabdhe caturmuṣṭirnirvāpe aparisamāpte bhavati saṃśayaḥ |
yanniṣṭaṃ tanniṣṭameva, avaśiṣṭaṃ kiṃ prākṛtamyo nirvatavyaṃ, kiṃ vaikṛtībhyaḥ, uta tūṣṇīmeveti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? vinirukte sāmi nirupte ityarthaḥ |
abhyāsa- mātraṃ kartavyaṃ, tacca abhyāsāmātraṃ punaḥ kriyate |
pūrva- meva kṛte tasminnirvāpe na devatā apanītā |
sa evāyaṃ punaḥ kriyate punarapi kriyamāṇasya anapanītaiva devatā bhavitumarhati iti prākṛtamya eva nirvatavyam |
na cottaro muṣṭiḥ pṛthak padārthaḥ, yena devatā'panayo bhavet |
tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajet iti prākṛ- tīmya ācchidya vaikṛtībhyo nirvāpamyo vidhīyate |
tasmāt vinirukte nivṛttā devatāḥ, anyā anyāścopajātāḥ |
tasmāt vaikṛtīnāṃ saṃyogena nirvāpaśeṣaḥ kartavya iti |
