bhāṣyaṃ-- abhāvāccetarasya arthasya devatāsaṃyuktsya, na nirvāpo bhavati devatāsaṃyuktḥ |
yadi nirvāpe ardhaḥ anyadevatyaḥ, ardho'pi anyasyai devatāyai, naiva nirvāpaḥ itaradevatākaḥ prākṛtaḥ, itaradevatāko vā (vaikṛtaḥ) |
apica prākṛtīmyo nirvāpapadārthamāśritya prathame muṣṭau saṃyogo nirvṛttaḥ |
tasyā- bhyudaye nimitte vibhajet iti vibhāga ucyate |
padārtha iti kṛtvā saṃyuktaḥ pūrvaṃ (prākṛtīmirdevatābhiḥ nirvāpaḥ), idānīṃ ekadeśo viyojyate |
na ca anyā devatā saṃyogaḥ śakyate kartuṃ, padārthaśrayatvāt tasya |
tasmāt prākṛtanivṛtteḥ vaikṛtā- saṃyogācca tūṣṇīṃ nirvāpaḥ |
anyatrāpi yadyavayave padārtha aya- meva nyāyaḥ |
jñā--prākṛtīmyo'panītaḥ : vaikṛtīmiśra asaṃyuktaḥ avaśiṣṭo nirvāpaḥ, tūṣṇīṃ kartavyaḥ |
soma--iha pravṛtte'pi haviṣi abhyudayena pūrvadevatā'- panayaḥ devatā'ntarayogo vā iti pratyavasthānaṃ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-vinirukte sāminiṣṭe caturmuṣṭīnāmekadeśasya na pūrvadevatā'panayaḥ, kurtanirvāpasya devatāguṇatvādeka- deśapanayāsaṃbhavāditi |
' bhāṭṭa--arthaniṣṭe candrāmyudaye jñāte avaśiṣṭe'muṣyaḥ na tāvat prākṛtīmyo nirvatavyaḥ |
nāpi vaikṛtīmyaḥḥ padārthaikadeśasya avihitatvena tatra devatā'ntarasaṃyogā- pravṛtteḥ |
yathaiva hi 'phalaṃ na bhakṣayet' ityādi niṣedhāḥ avayavaviṣayāsādhāraṇyena pravartante, evaṃ apanayātmako niṣedho'pi |
yathaiva ca 'phalaṃ dadyāt' ityādi vidhayo avayavinyeva pravartante evaṃ devatā'ntarasaṃyogo'pi |
yājñikāstu padārthaika- deśasyāpi arthikavicihivitatvamaṅgīkṛtya vaikṛtīmya evā- nutiṣṭhanti |
bhāṣyaṃ-- tasminneva (candrasa) abhyudaye saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ upāṃśuyāje'pi devatā'panayaḥ bhavet, neti |
yathā amīṣu vacanaṃ, madhyamanāṃ amye dātre puroḍāśaḥ, svaviṣṭhānāmindrāya pradātre dadhani caruḥ, kṣodiṣṭhānāṃ viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śrute caruḥ iti, naitadu- pāṃśuyāje asti |
ḍupa--upāṃśuyājaḥ paurṇamāsyameva nāmāvāsāyāṃ iti vakṣyati (10|8|1754) na ceyaṃ kulācintā iti vṛttikāro'milaṣati |
yuktto vā, bahuvacanabrāhmaṇe (kauṣītakibrāhmaṇe 3|6) spaṣṭaṃ vākyena vihitatvādupāṃśuyājasya |
kathaṃ tarhi dāśamika- napekṣaṃ vacanaṃ ? nyāyamātrametat |
kutaḥ ? nahi atra abhyudite haviṣā vibhāga ucyate abhyudayena aparā- hṇeti |
evaṃ ca sati na tadviḥ taṇḍulaiḥ śakyaṃ viśeṣam |
' tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajet ' iti hi anena vākyena devatā'panayaḥ kriyate |
kathamiti vibhāga- viśeṣaparāṇi uttarāṇi vākyāni, idamitaṃ ca dravyaṃ asya devatāye, idamitaṃ cāsyai iti |
yasya dravyasya viśeṣavibhāgo nāsti, tasyāpi vibhajet iti sāmānyavibhāgaḥ |
dharmasaṃbandhe uddeśyasya apūrvaśeṣatvamapi prayojakaṃ, gaura- vāt, api tu śāstrasa mahāviṣayatvasiddhaye apūrva- saṃbandhitvameva |
sa ca saṃbandhaḥ prakṛte śrapaṇa- sādhanatvātsyaḥ |
nanu dadhiśritayoḥ taṇḍula- śrapaṇasādhanatve'pi na praṇītādharmaprāptiḥ, praṇītānāṃ hi saṃyavanārthatvena viniyogāt, prakṛte ca saṃyavanābhāvena tadanupapatteḥ |
ata eva sauryādicaruṣu bahirhṛṣmaṇā pākābhāvāt kapāladvarminiścitavat saṃyavanābhāvāt praṇītādharmanivṛttireva |
iti cet, praṇītānāṃ vākyena piṇḍasaṃyavanasādhanatvāgame'pi ānuṣaṅgikapākāsādhanatva- syāpi sattāt sauryādicarau prakṛte ca praṇītādharmopapatteḥ |

iyaṃ ca praṇītādharma- prāptiḥ satyapi akarmāntaratve dadhiśritayoḥ : āgneyahaviḥ- śrapaṇasādhanatvasya naimittikatulyatvāt phaladhamasamāyena ( 3|5|15 ) sthānāpatyaiva, na tu brīhiyavanyāyeneti ( 12|3|4|10 ) dhyeyam |
abhyudaye doṣāpanayaḥ svadharmā syāt, pravṛtta- tvāt |

bhāṣyaṃ — idaṃ samāmnāyate 'vi vā enaṃ prajayā paśu- bhirarthayati, vardhayatyasya bhrātṛvyaṃ, yasya havirnirastaṃ pura- stāccandramā abhyudeti, sa tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajet, ye madhyamāstānagnaye dātre puroḍāśamapālaṃ nirvapet, ye sthaviṣṭhāstānandrāya dadhaśruṃ, ye'viṣṭhāstānviṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śṛte caruṃ' iti |
tatra eṣo'rthaḥ : sāṃśayikaḥ kiṃ śṛte dadhani ca iṣyārthāḥ payodharmāḥ kartavyāḥ, uta neti |
kutaḥ ? apradānārthatvāt praṇītārthe vidhā- nāt atulyatvācca caruṇā na saṃsargaḥ |
abhyudaye nimitte yo'yaṃ dohaḥ devatāyā apanītaḥ sa svadharmā syāt |
kutaḥ ? ijyārthameva hi tat payo dadhi ca pravṛ- tam |
yataśca ijyārthe, ato'sya ijyārthāḥ pravṛttā eva dharmāḥ |
taddharmāṇāṃ pravṛttau asti kāraṇaṃ, nivṛttau nāsti |
vākyaṃ hi tadā bhidyeta yadi devatārthe carvartha- yośca dadhipayasoḥ |
āha, nanu coropi devatāsaṃbandho dadhipayasorapi tathā, na bhaviṣyati vākyabhedaḥ iti |
vibhāgaḥ kartavya iti pūrva- vākyaṃ vṛttaṃ 'tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajet' iti |
tada- nantaraṃ vibhāgaviśeṣaparaṃ idaṃ vākyaṃ, 'ye sthavi- ṣṭhāstānandrāya pradātre dadhaśruṃ, ye'viṣṭhāstāna viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śṛte caruṃ' iti |
atra aviśeṣāt dadhi- payorapi vibhāgo vaktavyaḥ |
yadi ca dadhipayasī vibha- kanye satī praṇītārthe api ucyeyātāṃ, tato bhidyeta vākyam |
avidhīya- māne ca tasminnarthe prātipadikārtho devatāyā saṃbandhaste, vākyasāmarthyāt ubhe ca dadhipayasī devatāyā saṃbandhaste caruṇā saha |
dadhani caruḥ : eko bhāgaḥ indrāya pradātre bhavati iti |
yathā vibhajyamāneṣu nānādravyeṣu ucyeta, 'rukmapātryāṃ samāhārā maṇayaḥ eko bhāgo devadattasya |
rajatapātryāṃ suvarṇe nihitaṃ aparo bhāgo viṣṇumitrasya' iti saha pātryāṃ dvau bhāgau gamyete vibhāgaviśeṣaparatvāt vākyasya |
evamihāpi vibhāga- paratvādeva vākyasya vibhaktatvācca dadhipayasoḥ : eko bhāga iti gamyate |
bhāṣyaṃ — itaśca pradānārthe dadhi payasi ca ijyārthā dharmāḥ kartavyā iti |
kutaḥ ? siddhavat śrutopadeśo bhavati 'śṛte caruṃ' 'dadhaśruṃ' iti, sa satsu dharmeṣu upapadyate |
ityatra śrapaṇaṃ na kriyata, iti tatra siddhavat śrutopadeśo nāvakalpeta |
tasmādapi dadhipayasī, ijyārthā dadhipayodharmāḥ kartavyā iti |

ṭup — ( ekādhikaraṇyaṃ sūtrasvarasaprāptaṃ vihāya kimiti adhikaraṇabhedo bhāṣyakāreṇa āśritaḥ ? ata āha, satyaṃ — ) ete dve sūtre ( abhyudaye0 śruto0 ) tuśabda-vāśabdarahite ( satī kharakhataḥ ) pūrvapakṣe ( pūrvapakṣatayā ) dharmavatī dadhipayasī pratipā- dayataḥ |
uttare ( tu apanayo vā0 lakṣaṇārthā0 iti ) dve sūtre vāśabdena etaṃ pakṣaṃ vyāvartya na pradānadharmaiḥ yujyate dadhipayasī iti ( siddhāntaṃ ) sthāpayataḥ ( kharakhena ) |
evaṃ ( tu ) sūtrakāraprasthānamapāsya ( tataḥ pratipannai- kādhikaraṇyamapāsya praṣṭhaviṣadam ) vṛttikāraḥ ( bhāṣyakāra eva ) ṣaṣṭhāvirodhiniṃ vyākhyāṃ cakāra |
tatra hi uktaṃ tadevedaṃ āmāvāsyaṃ karma, kevalaṃ tu dravyaṃ ( pūrva- ) devatātaḥ apanītaṃ devatā'ntareṇa yujyate nāpanītayārtha- tvameva sat |
( śrayaiva ca sūtrakāreṇa carusaṃskārādyathāṃ dohayornirasya pradānārtha- taiva nirṇītā 'nātatsaṃskāratvāt' 6|5|1642 iti ) |
ataḥ pūrvādhikaraṇasiddhāntena ( saptamīśrutā śrapaṇādyai dadhipayasī iti ) pūrvapakṣasya ( dve ) ete siddhāntasūtre |
( tathā uttare api ( sūtre ) evameva ( anena siddhāntena kṛtasya pūrvapakṣasya siddhāntasūtre ) |
evaṃ pūrvapakṣapūrvasya nyāyasya apavādatayā uttarasūtramadhikaraṇaṃ iti ( saṃgatatvāt ) yuktatara ārambhaḥ |
( atha kasmāt ādāveva paśukāmeṣṭivākyaṃ nodāhiyate, tathā sati pāṭho- 'pi nyāyo na virudhyate sūtrāṇi ca ekavākyatāyā yathā- śruti vyākhyātāni bhavanti |
ata āha — ) itarathā ( adhikaraṇamedānāśrayaṇe ) abhyudayodāharaṇaṃ ( sūtraṃ ) heyameva syāt |
( prakṛtādhikaraṇasiddhāntamāha — ) nyāyastu sa eveti ( yaḥ ṣaṣṭhe ) |
soma — ( dṛṣṭāntarūpā avāntarasaṃgatiḥ ) na ca asyārthasya ṣaṣṭhe eva vyutpādanenāsyādhikaraṇasya vaiyarthya- miti vācyam |
tathāpi pūrvādhikaraṇaraṇītayā saptamīśravaṇāt praṇītārthatvamiti kasya cit vyāmohaḥ syāditi tanni- rākaraṇārthatvena avaiyārthyāt |
sūtrārthastu- abhyudaye dohāpanayaḥ apanītadevatāko dohaḥ pradeyadharmaḥ syāt pradeyatvena dohameṣṭeḥ iti |
vi — 'payodabhoramyudite na te syurvā, puraiva no |
11. bhāṭṭa — abhyuditeṣṭau tarhi ( prāyaṇīyaṣṭivat ) saptamīnirdeśāt dadhiśritayoḥ : adhikaraṇatvāt pradeyadharmā bhaveyuḥ; 'saha śrapayati' ityasyāpi pūrvadeva nitya- nuvādatvopapatteḥ |
na ca kṣodrādidravyoddeśena tatra devatā- mātravidhānāt dadhyādyādhikaraṇatvasyāpi vidhau vākyabhedā- patteḥ : tasya pradeyatvaṃ iti vācyam |
tat varaṃ saptamīśrutā vidheyāne- kalanimittavākyabhedatayaiva aṅgīkāraḥ |
vastutastu bhāva- nā'ntarasyaiva tatra pakṣe aṅgīkārāta adhikaraṇatvasyāpi vidhau na vākyabhedaḥ |

iti prāpte, 'yadi gṛhītaṃ haviḥ abhi udiyāt atho tarhi etāneva taṇḍulān suphalī- kṛtān dadhi payaśca' ityādicchruta apanayaviśeṣa prakṛtayāgīyayoreva dadhipayasoḥ : bhāvanā'ntare'pi pradeyatvenaiva upādeyatvasya pakṣe vyavasthāpitatvāt adhikaraṇatvavivakṣā- 'nupapatteḥ : bhavantyeva pradeyadharmāḥ |
■ abhyuditeṣṭau darśamṛcyuttaraṃ nirvāpāt prāgapi candrabhyudaye eva devatābhyo nirvāpaḥ |
naimi- ttikastu devatā'panayo devatā'ntarasaṃyogaśca kiṃ nirvā- pottarakālaṃ taṇḍulatvasya haviṣi kartavyaḥ : nirvāpastu prākṛ- tībhya eva syāt jñāte abhyudaye, uta vaikṛtībhya eva iti saṃśayaḥ |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? aniraste abhyudite prākṛ- tībhyo nirvapet ityāśramya ācāryo manyate sma |
tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajet' iti abhyudayāvagamānantaraṃ taṇḍulavibhāgamāha |
tasmāt aniṣṭe taṇḍulābhāvāt apananītā devatāḥ prākṛtyaḥ iti prākṛtya eva nirvapediti |
vyūhya ( candrodayādvyūhya ) yā bhajante karma, tāmyo nirvapeta iti ālekhana ācāryo manyate sma |
yassāt akāle tatrapravṛttikā- rito devatāpanayaḥ, tasmāt apanītā devatā iti vyūhya- bhāgamyo nirvatayaḥ |
( asmin sūtre vyūhyabhāgamya- ityeva pāṭhaḥ sarvatra dṛśyate |
ya-pustake kutastulyau ca vyūhyabhāgamyaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ spaṣṭaḥ |
āpastambaśrautasūtrāṇāṃ rudradattīyāṃ ca vyūhyabhāgamyaḥ ityeva pāṭhaḥ
athocyeta, payasaḥ pūrvamava- dāya tatra carvvadānaṃ nikṣipyate, evaṃ payasi dadhani ca ( caruḥ ) bhaviṣyati |
na ca vacanamantareṇa dadhi payo vā caroḥ śakyaṃ pūrvamavadātum |
tasmādevametat vijñeyaṃ, abhyudi- teṣṭyadhikaraṇe sahaśravaṇavidhātṛ vākyamasti ' saha śrapa- yati ' iti |
' saviṣṭān, indrāya, pradāne, dadhani, caruṃ ' iti pañcapadaviśiṣṭā bhāvanā vidhīyate |
yadi saṃnihito na syāt, kamrmāntaraṃ bhavet |
evaṃ bhāṣyakāraiṇa nāṅgīkṛtaṃ, baharthatvāt vākyabhedasrūpameva iti kṛtvā |

vibhāgena niṣpacena caruṇā, indreṇa, pradātutvena ca viśiṣṭā bhāvanā ), payaḥ ṣoḍaśadravyaviśiṣṭayā ( payasā ca ṣoḍaśadaṇḍalabhāmagasiddhacaruṇā ca viṣṇunā ca ādiśabdo'śiśapivatvena ca viśiṣṭā bhāvanā vidhī- yate ), madhyamādidravaṇāt ( madhyamādidravyairityarthaḥ ) |
evaṃ ca ( bhāvanāvidhānāt bahūnāṃ ) arthānāṃ avi- bhāgaḥ ( ekenaiva vidhinā vidhānaṃ sidhyati iti ) |
atra ( bhāṣyamate ) prakṛteṣu yāgeṣu dravye cāvibhakte ( vibhajet iti ) devatāvibhāgamātraṃ vidhī- yate ( devatābhyaḥ dravyaṃ taṇḍulādi vibhajediti |
nanu evaṃ sati carutā saptamyarthā kathamanyīyate, ata āha bhāṣyakāraḥ- ) tatra arthaprāptā śrapaṇe sati carutā ( saha saptamyarthena arthaprāptenaiva asmin vākye anyate iti |
codayati-) satyametat ( śrapaṇe sati carutā prāpteveti |
ucyate, vacanāt śrapaṇaṃ ( bhaviṣyati ) saha śrapayati iti |
anena tu ( vacanena ) dadhnaḥ eva śrapaṇaṃ ( anyataḥ aprāptaṃ ) vidhīyate |
katham ? evaṃ śrūyate 'yadi cimīyādimi modeṣyatīti mahārātre havīṃṣi nirvapet |
arthe dadhi havirātañcanārthe nidadhyāt, arthe na |
yadi karmāntaramupādeyatvena, tadā taṇḍulā dadhi ghṛtaṃ ca |
tatrācinaṣṭe dadhani, aparedyurāmāvāsye kriyamāṇe vidhyate dadhīti nātañcanamāvartate |
tasyāmevābhyuditeṣṭī dadhi vidhyate, iti nātañcanaṃ syāt |
atha nimitte devatā''panayaḥ, tatastasmin dadhani caruḥ kṛta iti, punarāmāvāsye dohe ātañcanena kāryam |
evamātañcanābhyāsasya darśanaṃ devatā- vidhāne yujyate iti |
bhāṣyaṃ-- atha yaduktaṃ, yathā paśukāmeṣṭyāṃ karmāntaraṃ 'yaḥ paśukāmaḥ syāt so'māvāsyāmiṣṭvā
tvena vṛthāceṣṭārūpatvāt vihitānanuṣṭhānaniṣiddhānuṣṭhāna- prayuktadoṣābhāvena tannirghātārthatvānupapatteḥ aṣṭārthatvameva eteṣāṃ naimittikānāṃ iti vibhāvyate, tadā astu samuccayaḥ |
yattu agreḥ āyatanāt bahiryanayaprayuktaḥ praṇayanapakṣe doṣaḥ, nāsau darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ iti na tamādāyāpi asya doṣanirghātārthatvam |
na ca vākyabhedā- pādako guṇaḥ; dravyadeśena devatāmātravidhānena tasya vākya- bhedānāpādakatvāt |
devatāyāśca upapādakībhūtayāgā- pekṣayāṃ aindrayāyavādivat prakṛtānāmeva upapādakalopapatteḥ bhavaduktarītyaiva catvādhikaraṇayoḥ arthaprāptatvāt anu- vādaḥ |
devākārasya ekatvāt paraspara- viśeṣaviśeṣaṇabhāvena abhipadasya tātparyagrāhakatvamaṅgī- kṛtya ekapadopādānena vā viśiṣṭasya vyutpattatvā
tat devataikyāt dadhi- svaviṣṭayoḥ, śrutāgniṣṭoyaśca sahapākaṃ vidhatte |
tataśca arthataḥ prāptaṃ carutvaṃ dadhiśrutayośca adhikaraṇatvaṃ anu- dyate |
kevalaṃ tu devatākārakaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate prakṛte darśa, iti vākyamedābhāvāt na karmāntaravidhiḥ iti |
dadhivākye śrutavākye ca pratidravyaṃ devatāsaṃbandhabodhanāt vākyabhedo duṣvariharaḥ iti karmāntaravupapakṣo duṣpari- haraḥ |
aṅgīkṛtaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhe eva (6|1|22-23) vākyabhedaprasaṅgaparihārāya prakṛtatāgrāhakena karmāntaravidhi- paratvam |

yathā 'yasyobhayaṃ havirārtimācchet aindraṃ pañca- śarāvamodanaṃ nirvapet' ityatra odanasyavidhānāt, pañcaśarāvaparimāṇavidhānāt, mahendrasya ca saha vikalpataḥ prāsasya indrasya nityavidhānāt, vākyabhedamidaiva prakṛta- karmahāntena karmāntarasya dohatinimittakasya vidhiḥ siddhā- ntaḥ |
anyathā abhyudaye vākyabhedaṃ soḍhvā devatā- 'ntaramātravidhivat yasyobhayaṃ ityatrāpi ārtadohaprati- nidhividhiḥ iti pūrvapakṣa eva parāvartata iti |
ata eva śrutyādīnāmapi 'ānarthakyapratihatānāṃ viparītaṃ balābalaṃ' ityuktam |
tadiha vidhyantaraika- vākyatvābhāvāt 'saha śrapayati' iti sahapākavidhiḥ, abhyudayavākyasya karmāntaravidhitve 'dadhiśrutaṃ' 'śrute caruṃ' ityata eva sahapākāprāpteḥ anarthakaḥ |

na ca 'prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ' iti pradhānavidhau 'ghṛte śrapayati' iti guṇavidhiprāsa- ghṛtānuvādavat karmāntare'pi abhyudayavākye sahaśrapaṇa- vidhisiddhacarutvādanuvādaḥ syāt iti vācyam |
ubhaya- prāptau anubhayaprāptau vā saṃśravavidhiḥ iti hi jāghanyādhi- karaṇe (3|1|10) uktam |
ataḥ sahapāka- vidhānārthakyaparihārāya tadvalenaiva tātparyagrahāt nirvapet ityasyānupadeśena svaviṣṭayościdiśrutayorupyanyatasye'pi
devatā'nvayavidhānārthatvāt pratidravyaṃ vākyabhedameva abhyu- petya na prakṛtakarmahānaṃ aprakṛtakarmavidhānaṃ ca yuktam |
taduktaṃ 'gauṇaṃ lākṣaṇikaṃ vā'pi vākyabhedena vā svayam |
vedo yamāśrayatyeva ko nu tatpratikūlayet' iti |
gauṇatvo- dāharaṇaṃ tu 'yathā vai dyenau nipalādatte' iti |
ārtavākye tu sahapāka- vidhivat ānarthakyena tātparyagrāhakasya abhāvāt vākya- bhedaparijihīrṣayā karmāntaravidhivaiva nyāyyaḥ iti vaiṣamyam |
abhyuditeṣṭyanuṣṭhānaṃ darśapūrṇavatyuttaraṃ nirvā- pāt prāgapi candrodaye ||
bhāṣyaṃ-- asminneva udāharaṇe saṃśayaḥ kiṃ yadi nipte abhyudayo'vagamyate tadā abhyuditeṣṭiḥ, uta aniṣṭe'pīti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? nipte, avagate (candro- daye), abhyuditeṣṭiḥ syāt |
prāptaṃ hi tāvatyeva nimittaṃ, yasya havirabhyudeti iti havirgrahaṇaṃ lakṣaṇatvena |
yasya haviḥ ami udeti iti havirlakṣitaḥ udayaḥ nimittaṃ, pravṛttaṃ havirlakṣyati, nodāsīnam |
tasmāt havirabhyudeti ityucyamāne pravṛttaṃ haviḥ abhyudeti iti gamyate |
nahi tat niruptaṃ ityetana śakyaṃ viśeṣayitum |
yasya haviḥ niruptaṃ ityetana anapekṣyamāṇam, haviḥ ami udeti iti śakyate vidhātum |
bhāṣyaṃ-- atha yaduktaṃ, nisatsaṃyogo bhavati 'yasya havirnirvṛtaṃ' iti, lakṣaṇamātraṃ etat nisamiti |
kasmina- ścit padārthe tasya pravṛtte ityarthaḥ |

bhāṣyaṃ-- anyārtho'pi caitamarthaṃ darśayati 'sa yadi agṛhītaṃ havirabhyudiyāt prajñātameva, tadaiṣā vratacaryā, yat pūrvairyurdurbha dadhi havirātajñaṃ tat kurvanti, prati- muhanti vasānaṃ, tāneva tat punarākurvanti, tānaparāhṇe parṇaśākhayā apākaroti, yathaivādyaḥ prajñātamāmāvāsyaṃ haviḥ evameva tat, yatha vratacaryā vā nodāṃśeta gṛhīta vā havirabhyudiyāt itarathā tarhi kuryāt, etāmeva taṇḍulān suphalīkṛtān' iti agṛhīte haviṣī anyaṃ vidhiṃ bruvan gṛhīte'pi aniṣṭe vā abhyudaye prāyaścittaṃ darśayati |
śā-- akālapravṛttimātraṃ nimittaṃ iti prāgapi nirvāpāt abhyudaye jñāte kartavyameva naimittikam |
soma -- upasthāpyāsye ihāpi akriyā iti pratyavasānāt saṃgatiḥ |
'amirāme' (pā0 1|4|19) iti lakṣaṇe amiḥ karmapravacanīyatvena tayornimitta- dvitīyāntapadapratipādyaṃ haviḥ lakṣaṇatvena candrāmyudayasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati |

bhāṭṭa-- 'yasya havirnirvṛtaṃ' iti śravaṇāt nirvāpo- ttarakālīnacandrābhyudayasya nimittatvāt amāvāsyāyāṃ ca sūryodayāt prāgeva iṣṭyārambhavidhānāt nirvāpāt prāk candrābhyudayaśane naidaṃ prāyaścittam |
iti prāpte, 'havira- bhyudiyāt' ityetadavacchinnadinaprārambhasyaiva nimittatvaṃ lāghavāt |
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca nityatvādeva nimitta- tvānupapatteḥ pariśeṣādeva darśaviṣayatvam |
ata eva 'yadyagṛhītaṃ havirabhyudiyāt' iti liṅgamapi upapadyate |
abhyupagamāttrāt nahi hetoradṛṣṭasyāpi duṣṭatā śakyate vaktum |
saurye carau tat codakena prāptaṃ kartavyaṃ na veti vicāre kartavyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntasūtram |
saurye carau abhyūhaḥ 'vedena saha bhasmānā ajhārān abhyūhati' ityanena uktaḥ na kartavyaḥ |
pākasāmīcīnyāya puroḍāśasya upari bhasmasahitā- nāmajhārāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ kriyate saḥ abhyūho nāma |
sa ca carau nā'vaśyakaḥ, iti na kāryaḥ |
ke. aśrāntaṃ ca cānyamidhānaṃ amādapi pāpīyaḥ |
abhyādānamantrāṇāṃ samuccayānte karmasaṃni- pātataḥ, na pratimantraṃ vikalpaḥ |
tatra prathamamantrāṇāṃ karaṇatvaṃ saṃskāradvārā, anyasya sākṣāt |
amādi- paurṇamāsyantā yā eva śaśinaḥ kalāḥ |
tatra pakṣāvubhau māsaḥ śuklakṛṣṇau krameṇa hi |
pakṣatyākhyāstva tithayaḥ kramāt pañca- daśaiva tāḥ |

kalāyatirikttacandrakalānāṃ madhye ekaikasyā: kalāyā: sūryamaṇḍalena ādyāvayavaviprakarṣadārabhya anyāvayavavipra- karṣa:, ādyāvayavasaṃnikarṣadārabhya anyāvayavasaṃnikarṣo vā yāvatā kālena jāyate, tāvān kāle yathākramaṃ śukla- kṛṣṇapakṣagata: pratipadadvitīyādiśabdapratipādya: |
ata eva tithiśabda: pratipadādiśabdaśca kalāsveva śaktā: |
bhāṭṭa. 5|4|7. amā- vāsyā uttareṣu: vedi: pūrvaidyu: ityaṅgapradhānayo: kāla- bhedo vacanāt |
bhā. 1|3|12|1. amāvāsyā guruṃ hanti śiṣyaṃ hanti caturdaśīṃ |
candrādarśa- nasya jyoti:śāstrāt niyataparimāṇena amāvāsyā- kālena avinābhāva: |
āpa iva dvīpaṃ, dadhati prayāṃsi annādyāni |
vākyārthe tu prathama- tṛtīyādvitīyācaturthyo padānāṃ saṃbandhaḥ |
tatra sāṅkhyata- dākṣitaḥ ( sā iti tacchabdena āśritaḥ ) yacchabdaḥ tṛtīyāpāde kalpyate |
śuṣkatṛṇe dīto'gniriva yā lakṣyate tava sahacārīṇī nityaṃ ṛṣṭiḥ tava vaddhamā, sā tāvat tvatprasādena asmākameva |
ye'pi amī ( marutaḥ ) purāṇaṃ jalaṃ vṛṣṭirūpeṇa vikṣipantaḥ āpa iva dvīpaṃ annā- dyāni dhārayanti tava priyasavaḥ |
sa tvamevaṃ sādhāraṇadvayaḥ san amaratvaṃ na kevalaṃ dehi ( kiṃtu dhanamapi dehi ) |
vā. 1|2|4|14 pṛ. 1|7-1|8. ayaṃ yajamānaḥ ' iti pāṭhasya savanīyapaśu codakaprāpte maitrāvaruṇapreṣamantre ' ayaṃ sutāsutī yaja- mānaḥ ' iti pāṭhavikāraḥ pratyakṣamāmnāyate |
ayaṃ sahasramānavaḥ iti ṛcā pragītayaiva dvādaśāhasya daśame'hni āhavanīyopasthānaṃ karta- vyam |
( dvādaśāhe daśame'hni patnī- saṃyājottaraṃ mānasastotrāt prāk āhavanīyopasthāne |
‘ patnīḥ saṃyāja prājña udetya ayaṃ sahasramānava iyati- cchandā āhavanīyamupatiṣṭhate ' tāṇḍya. 4|9|1 ) ka cit karmaviśeṣe śrūyate ' ayaṃ sahasramānava ityetayā āhavanīyamupatiṣṭhate ' iti |
atrāyamarthaḥ : sāṃśayikaḥ kiṃ apragītayā upasthātavyaṃ, uta pragītayeti |
pragītāpsyo iyamena ṛk, apragītāpsi iya- meva |
na cedviśeṣaḥ stutiratvāt ṛksāmayo- vikalpa iti |
dup-- ' ayaṃ sahasramānavaḥ ityetayā āhavanīya- mupatiṣṭhate ' iti pragītāyāmāpi saṃpratyayaḥ : apragītāyā- mapi |
upasthānaṃ stutiṃ vā pragītā'pi nirvartayet apra- gītā'pi |
kiṃ vacanaṃ ? ' ayaṃ sahasramānava ityetayā ' iti prakṛtavacanaḥ śabdaḥ |
nahi apragītāyāṃ pragāṇaṃ śakyate kartuṃ iti |
tasmādeva sāmavede upatiṣṭhate vā stoti vā ityukte pragītāyāmeva ṛci saṃpratyayo bhavati, nāpragītāyām |
āha, yadi pragītāyāṃ saṃpratyayaḥ : prakaraṇāt, vacanādapragītāyām |
' ayaṃ sahasramānava ityetayā' iti punaḥ prakṛtayā ṛco vācako mukhyaḥ ṛkśabdaḥ |
śrutilakṣaṇā- virāye ca śrutirnyāyā na lakṣaṇā |
yadyapi apragītā'pi saṃnihitā, tathāpi pragītaiva grāhyā |
nanu apragītā'pi śāstreṣu paṭhyate, sā vākyena gṛhyate |
etayā ityeva naiva saṃnihitavacanaḥ ( śabdaḥ ) bādhyate |
soma-- pūrvatra vikalpābhāve'pi iha vikalpaḥ ityucyate : saṃprati |
apragītāyāḥ saṃhitāyānte ( sāma. 4|9 ) paṭhitatvena pragāṇārtha eva pāṭhaḥ, saṃhitā- granthasya ṛksavarūpadhāraṇadvārā pragāṇārthatvāt |
vi-- ' gānasya niyamo nota, vidyate vahnyupa- sthitau |
bhāṭṭa-- ka cit karmaviśeṣe ( gavāmayanagate dvāda- śāhe daśame'hani ) ' ayaṃ sahasramānavaḥ ' itīyaṃ ṛk pragītā apragītā ca paṭhitā |
punaśca ( patnīḥ saṃyājya prājña udetya-- ) ' ayaṃ sahasramānava ityetayā ( ityati- cchandasā ) āhavanīyamupatiṣṭhate ' ( tāṇḍya. 4|9|1 ) ityanena viniyuktā |
sā dvividhayā ( dvayyā vidhayā ) paṭhitatvād dvividhā'pi vikalpena viniyujyate |
iti prāpte, apragītāyāḥ pragāṇārtha eva pāṭhaḥ |
nahi anavadhārita- svarūpāyāṃ sulaṃ gānaṃ arthāvabodho vā saṃbhavati |
pragītā tu ananyathā prayojanamapekṣamāṇā upasthāne viniyujyate iti saivā grāhyā |
yaḥ pragītāyā eva śāstrā'ntare pāṭhaḥ, so'pi tadrūpān prati ṛksavarūpajñānārtha eva, iti na śāstrā- 'ntarīyapragāṇasyasaṃskāravirodhaḥ |
' śaṃkara-- ' pragītaiva ca sahasyeti ' artha mantraḥ |
ayujuṣā vatsānapākaroti ' ' apavitravatī gāṃ doṣigha ' iti prātavatsāpākaraṇavādena yajurādi- paryudāsavidhiraiva iti pūrvapakṣe uktam |
' ayajñiyā vai māṣāḥ varakāḥ kodravāḥ ' ityatra ayajñiyāḥ iti anarhārthaprayatnena sādhanatvamātraniṣedhāt viśeṣavihitātiriktasthale sarvatraiva māṣādipratiṣedhapratīteḥ |
' ayajñiyā vai māṣāścakāḥ kodravāḥ ' ' maudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet saukāmaḥ ' ityatra mṛdā- bhāve māṣādyāḥ pratinidhirbhavantīti mṛdākārye caruniṣṭhā- dane samarthatvāt |
' ayajñiyā vai 0 ' iti māṣādidhānyatrayā- yajñiyatvavacanasya tanniṣedhe paryavasānāt |
tena karmaṇa eva sādhanatvāvagamāt kathaṃ guṇasya phale |
nyeva tāni vacanāni teṣāmeva phalasaṃbandhaṃ pratipādayanti |
tathāhi, na tāvat prakṛtaṃ karma phale viniyujyate, 'sarvebhyo |
karmaṇo viniyogāsaṃbhavāt viśeṣaṇameva guṇaḥ phale vidhī- |
viśiṣṭāni vilakṣaṇāni, kiṃtu tulyānyeva taistānī dākṣā- |
ata eva ‘yadayāḍ devānāmājyapānāmiti, tat prayājānuyājā- nām’ iti śāstrāntarīyaṃ vacanaṃ nyāyasiddhānuvādakamupa- padyate |
‘ayugvā yugvā muṣṭīrlunāti’ ityanena darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ barhirlavanamuktam |
tatra pratimuṣṭi ‘barhirdeva- sadanaṃ dāmi’ iti lavanamantrāvṛttiḥ, na tu sakṛt paṭhanam |
( ayuk viṣamasaṃkhyākān, yuk samasaṃkhyākān darbha- muṣṭīn ) |
ci. 11|4|15. ayutaṃ gavāṃ abhiṣekanīye ( rājasūyagate soma- yāgaviśeṣe ) dadāti |
bhā. 11|4|13, ayutaṃ gavāṃ aśvasahasraṃ ca pauṇḍarīke yāge sakṛdeyam |
‘ayomukhaṃ piṇḍacchedanaṃ’ iyukta na sarvāṃsaṃ pratīyate ( kiṃtu mukhaṃ agrameva kṛṣṇāyasamayaṃ yasya, tādṛśaṃ piṇḍasya chedakaṃ pratīyate ) |
bhā. 8|3|15. araṇī brāhmaṇikene agrau nidhāya mathilā savena mathitena gārhapatyaḥ evādheyaḥ, na tu sarvaṃ |
3|1|32, araṇīsamā- ropaṇottaraṃ paridaśyamānasya jvalanasya laukikatvameva, na vaidikatvam |
ramaṇābhāve yatra ramaṇī- yaṅgararacanā, tatrāsya saṃcāraḥ |
ata eva ‘strīṇāṃ priyālokaphale hi veṣaḥ’ ityuktiḥ saṃgacchate iti |
araṇye kṛtaṃ rodanaṃ yathā vyarthaṃ bhavati tadvat |
teṣāṃ pari- cchedya smṛtirūpaṃ brāhmaṇa bhavati ‘ye darśapūrṇamāsayo- rdharmāste sarveṣāṃ agnīṣṭomīyasya ca’ ityārabhya yāvat sarvāḥ prakṛtivikṛtayo'nukrāntāḥ iti |
bāla. pṛ. 24. aruṇā iti śabdaḥ yasmāt karaṇavācinyā vibhaktyā saṃyujya aruṇābhimānaṃ nirdiśati, tasmāt aru- ṇimā karaṇam |
su. pṛ. 1429. aruṇā ityatra dravyaparicchedadvārā krayasaṃbandho labdhaḥ |
vā. 3|2|3 pṛ. 762. ‘aruṇayā ekahāyanyā piṅgākṣyā somaṃ krīṇāti’ iti jyotiṣṭome śrutam |
tatra aruṇaśabdo aruṇaguṇavacanaḥ aruṇatvajātivacane vā, na tu viśiṣṭa- vyaktivacanaḥ |
tṛtīyā ca śakyasyaiva karaṇatvamucyate, na tu tadarthaṃ dravyalakṣaṇā |
bhāṭṭa. 3|1|6, ‘aruṇayā krīṇāti’ ityatra āruṇyasyāpūrvasādhanībhūtakāryatve pramāṇatrayaṃ ( śrutivākyaprakaraṇāni ), tatrāpi śruteraiva viniyojakatvaṃ, na tvanyasya |
3|1|7 pṛ. 255, ‘aruṇayā piṅgākṣyā krīṇāti’ ityādī vyaktiḥ naiva padāt bhāsate, jātiguṇayoreva vyaktiparicchedakatva kara- ṇatvopapatteḥ |
liṅgasaṃkhyoreva sāmānyadhikaraṇyena pārtino jātiguṇasaṃbandhaḥ, ataḥ saṃbandhavidhayeva tatra vyakti- bodhaḥ |
1|3|10. ‘aruṇā piṅgākṣyaikahāyanyā’ iti parasparaṃ asaṃyadānāmpi krīṇātinā abhisaṃbandhāt ekavākyatvam |
3|1|6|12 pṛ. 638. ‘aruṇā piṅgākṣyaikahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇāti’ iti aruṇimā kraye eva ekahāyanyā niviśate, na tu krayaṇa- prakaraṇe |
bhā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 673. ‘aruṇā piṅgākṣyaikahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇāti’ iti jyotiṣṭome
yadyapi amūrto guṇaḥ, tathāpi guṇasyaivātra tṛtīyāśrutyā sādhanatvamucyate |
tacca dravyamantareṇa na saṃbhavati, ityārpatyā dravyāvaccheda- katvaṃ kalpyate |
krayeṇa sākṣādanvitayorguṇayoḥ paścāt arthāpattyā parasparavyavacchedakatvena anvayaḥ |
śrutyā sāmānyakriyā- saṃbandhī, vākyena tadviśeṣa prasaṅga, prakaraṇena jyoti- ṣṭomikasya |
satyapi vācanikaprakaraṇasamavāye parasparānu- grahaṇamittatvāt avirodhaḥ iti balānabalavicāre na bhavati |
aruṇādhikaraṇaṃ, aruṇā- dhikaraṇanyāyaḥ, aruṇānyāyaḥ, aruṇāśabdanyāyaḥ, aṇe- kahāyananyāyaḥ |
ke. aruṇādinyāyena ( 3|1| 6|12 ) anekeṣāṃ padānāṃ ekavākyopādānāt saṃhatānāṃ phalaṃ apūrvam |
‘aruṇā’ ityatra strī- pratyayāntā prakṛtyā tāvat lakṣaṇayā tadguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ gamyate |
tatra gamyamānapi dravyāṃśaṃ lākṣaṇikatvāpekṣya tṛtīyā śrutaṃ guṇameva krayaṃ prati karaṇatayā abhidhatte |

vastutastu aruṇaśabdo dravyamalakṣaṇyaṃ kevalaguṇe vartate, mukhye saṃbhavati lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇasyāsaṃbhavāt ! na ca evaṃ sati ‘guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni’ iti guṇopasarja- nadravyapratipādakānāmeva śuklādiśabdānāṃ āśrayaliṅgā- svābhimānāt ‘aruṇā’ iti strīliṅganirdeśo'nupapannaḥ iti vācyam |
‘guṇopasrjanadravyapratipādanayogyānāṃ paricchedamukhena kriyā'nvayināṃ paricchedadravyaliṅga- saṃbandhaḥ’ iti hi tadarthaḥ |
bhavati ca ‘aruṇākṣaḥ’ ityādau aruṇaśabdaḥ avaśayaṃ tadguṇadravyavacanaḥ, iti tasyaiva kevalaguṇavacanatve'pi paricchedakahāyanyādvārā liṅganvayaḥ |
rūpādi śabdāṃnā tu matuvādi vinā kadā'pi dravye prayogābhāvāt na paricchedyaliṅgatvaṃ iti ‘baṭro rūpaḥ’
‘jale śuklo'sti’ ityatra paricchedamukhena kriyā'nvayinaḥ śukladiśabdāḥ na guṇiliṅgakāḥ |
paricchedyamukhena kriyā'nvayinastu guṇi- liṅgakāḥ yathā ‘śuklā sāmānya’ ityādī ityarthaḥ |
tat siddhaṃ aruṇāśabdasya strīpratyayāntasyāpi kevalaguṇa- vacanatvam |
sā cābhidadhānā āruṇyaguṇasāmyatatvāt sākṣāt kriyā- sādhanatāśaktimapadyantī guṇasya svābhāvikīṃ dravya- paricchedakatāśaktiṃ paryāyeṇaiva paricchedyamukhena kriyā- sādhanatve viśrāmyati |
śaknoti ca āruṇyaguṇaḥ eka- hāyanyāṃ paricchedyatvam |
ityavacchadyatayā dravyasya pratīti- viśeṣo hi paricchedaḥ |
tadevaṃ ekavākyatve sati tṛtīyā gamyamānaṃ karaṇatvaṃ śrautaprakṛ- tyārpyaṇagataṃ vidheyatayā āśritaṃ bhavati |
vākyabhede tu ‘aruṇā’ iti tṛtīyā lākṣaṇikamakṛtyarthadravyagata- karaṇatvānuvādinī syāt |
na ca ekahāyanī- paricchedakatvayaiva āruṇyasya kutaḥ kraye niveśaḥ ? iti yatkiṃ- ciddravyadvārā'pi krayasādhanatvopapatteḥ iti vācyam |
paricchedakatvāpekṣayā ekahāyanyāḥ ekavākyatvena guṇena, paricchedyāpekṣaśca ca guṇasya svavākyatvayā ekahāyanyā ākāṅkṣāśāntisaṃbhave guṇāntareṇa dravyāntareṇa ca tacchā- ntivarṇanasyāvaśyakatvāt |
etadabhiprāyeṇaiva sūtre ( 6|1| 12|12 ) niyamapadamupapāttam ( ekaikammāccitryaḥ syāt iti ) |
na ca ekārthatvāt dravyaguṇayoḥ brīhi- yavavat vikalpaḥ syāt iti vācyam |
nahi ekārthala- mātraṃ vikalpe vījaṃ, dvārakye satyeva tasya tatrayojaka- tvāt |
anyathā puroḍāśe kāryaṃ kapāla-śūrpa-uddhvala- musalādīnāmapi vikalpyapatteḥ |
asti hi brīhīṇāṃ yavānāṃ ca yāge kāryaṃ dvāramekaṃ puroḍāśādipādanarūpam |
prakṛte ca dravyasya vikraituḥ ānatisaṃpādanadvārā, guṇasya ca dravyaparicchedadvārā krayasādhanatvāt ubhayordravyadāra-
nanu evamapi ‘aruṇā krīṇāti’ ‘aruṇaikāhayanyā’ ityayaṃ na yugapadubhayama aruṇāpa- syānyasaṃbhavaḥ, sakṛcchrutasyaikasya padasya yugapadubhayā- nvayayogāt |
nahi āruṇyasya ekāhayanyāṃ niveśaḥ śābdaḥ; kiṃtu ārthikaḥ |

prathamaṃ hi tāvat āruṇyaguṇaikahāyanī- dravyobhayakaraṇikāyāṃ krayabhāvanāyāṃ śabdamaryādayā ava- gatāyāṃ āruṇyasya sākṣāt krayasādhanatvakathanābhāvaṃ paryā- locya ekāhayanīdravyaparicchedamukhena kriyāsādhanatvamarthā- nniveśayati |
tathā ca āruṇyasya ekāhayanyāṃ pārthikā- nvayasyārthikatvāt na viruddhatrikadvayado'pi |
na ca eva- mapi āruṇyasya kathamekāhayanyāmeva niveśaḥ ? |
na ca pārthikaparasparānvayatā sāmarthyamupapādyaṃ, tasyaiva durghaṭatvāt |
nahi pārthika: parasparānvayabodhaḥ śabdaḥ, sakṛduccāritasya guṇaśabdasya kriyāyāṃ dravye ca paryavasānanyāyasaṃbhavāt, śabdabuddhikarmaṇāṃ viramya vyāpārābhāvāt |
na ca prathamaṃ śābdamaryādayā guṇaguṇinoḥ kriyā'nvaye''vagate paścāt tayoḥ paricchedaparicchedyākāṅkṣāvaśāt parasparānvayānusaṃdhānaṃ mānasikaṃ kalpyate iti vācyam |
guṇaguṇinoḥ parasparānvayo hi samāsaprayojakaḥ, tathāvidhaśabdayoreva samāsavidhānāt |
ataḥ kalpitayorevaḥ pārthikānvayatvāt śrūyamāṇayoreva sāmarthyaṃ vaktavyam |
tatra hi guṇaguṇinorvācakayoḥ śabdayoḥ vibhaktyantayoreva kalpanaṃ, na tu vibhaktarahitayoḥ; kiṃvā samasyayoḥ ? nādyaḥ: vibhaktyantayoḥ kārakaviśiṣṭapratipādakayoḥ stayoḥ mithaḥ saṃbandhayogāt |
na dvitīyaḥ; vibhaktarahitayoḥ tayoḥ prayogānarhatvāt samāsānupayuktatvāt, ‘sup supā’ ityādidhikṛta vihitasya karmadhārayasamāsasya nīlaghaṭaśabdayoḥ ayujyatayoranupapatteḥ |
na tṛtīyaḥ; samastapadā'nusaṃdhānena parasparānvayarūpaṃ sāmarthyaṃ jñeyaṃ, sāmarthyajñānādhīnaśca samāsaḥ ityanyonyāśrayāt |

apica sarvatra tādṛśabodhadhayakalpane tadanurodhena kāryakāraṇabhāvakalpane punaḥkalpitaśabdatoranusaṃdhānakalpane ca mahat gauravam, iti aruṇāśabdasyāpi śaktivyutpattirūpā guṇāviśiṣṭaparatvaṃ svīkṛtya ṛtvanuvādena viśiṣṭakārakasya vidhānāt na ko'pi doṣaḥ |
na ca aruṇāśabdasya guṇaviśiṣṭaparatve kathaṃ etadadhikaraṇapravṛttiḥ iti vācyam |
tathāhi, aruṇāśabdasya guṇaviśiṣṭe dravye lākṣaṇikatvābhāvāt pūrvapakṣe pūrvavedavopapādyā, śaktivyulakṣaṇasādhanena siddhāntapravṛttiḥ |
sūtraṃ tu evaṃ yojyam — aikakarmyāt kriyāpadasyaikatvāt arthaikye ekavākyatve sati vākyabhedo na nyāyyaḥ |
ato dravyaguṇayoḥ dravyapradhānasya ekahāyanivacchabdasya guṇopasarjanārṇaśabdasya ca niyamaḥ sāmānyādhikaraṇyena viśiṣṭakāryapratipādakayoḥ kraye anvayaḥ syāt |
‘aruṇāyā piṅgākṣyā somaṃ krīṇāti’ iti vākye dravyānukteḥ āruṇyasya svākyopāttadravye eva anvayapratipādakaṃ aruṇādhikaraṇam |
bhūṣaṇasāre dhātvarthanirṇaye kārikā 2. aruṇādhikaraṇe (3|1|6|2) guṇasya viniyogaḥ kathyate |
vā. 3|1|4|7 pṛ. 665. aruṇādhikaraṇe guṇānāṃ śrutaśeṣasaṃyogena vyavasthā abhihitā |
ke. aruṇādhikaraṇe niyamyamānasya svaśabdenopādānaṃ na nyāyarāddhāntagatam |
bāla. pṛ. 167. uktaṃ ca bhavadevena aruṇādhikaraṇe abhidhānasyaiva abhidheyāvinābhāvopatāpārthatātparyavyāḥ lakṣaṇayākhilaṃ iti |
bhāṭṭālaṃkāre pṛ. 31. nanu aruṇādhikaraṇe daṇḍa-vidhānamuktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa ‘upasarjanārtho vidhīyate’ iti ucyate |
prakaraṇāt sarvatraiva prāpte'nuvacanayornirdiṣṭasyate, evaṃ nāsti virodhaḥ |
vā. 4|1|6|8 pṛ. 1237. nanu āgneyatā iti bhāvapratyayāt saṃbandhasyāpi avibhaktatā uktā pratibhāti |
sā ca saṃbandhavācyatvasya aruṇā'dhikaraṇe niṣedhasamānatvāt ayuktā ityāśaṅkayā |
su. pṛ. 462. nahi vidhīyamānāvalambaḥ krayaḥ guṇena saṃbadhyamānaṃ dravyaṃ viśinaṣṭi ityuktaṃ aruṇādhikaraṇe |

su. 3|7 pṛ. 70, pañcamaprayogataḥ : ‘tadviśeṣaṇaiḥ saṃbandhamanatvāt’ iti hetuḥ, jātiguṇaśabdānāṃ ‘goḥ śuklaḥ, aruṇā strī’ iti vyaktidravyaviśeṣaguṇajñānavināmapi ākṛtiruṇādhikaraṇayoḥ vyaktidravyavācilanirāsāt anaikāntikaḥ |
pṛ. 1460. yadyapi gamyamānasya viśeṣasaṃbandho nāsti atastatsaṃbandhadarśanāt abhidhānamiti tadapi ākṛtiruṇādhikaraṇayoḥ ubhayathā'pi darśanāt nirākṛtam |
vā. 3|1|4|13 pṛ. 940, saṃbandhaśravaṇe sati saṃśayakṣaparihārau aruṇādhikaraṇavat (adhikaraṇe 3|1|10|19-20) draṣṭavyau, krameṇo'mūrtvāt vākyena
3|1|10|19 pṛ. 729. aruṇādhikaraṇavārtike bahuvrīheranyapadārthe śaktireva, na tu lakṣaṇā iti vyavasthāpitam |
soma. 3|1|20. viśeṣaṇavibhakteḥ sādhutvārthatvaṃ ityapi asaṃbaddhaṃ, amedāryakalpya naiyāyikaiḥ, pratyeka manvayasya mīmāṃsakaiḥ aruṇādhikaraṇasiddhastyābhyupagamāt |
na cāruṇādhikaraṇanyāyo'tra ( khare ), svāntarasya svādhyāyasiddhasya dvitīyasya ahaṣṭārthatā-prasaṅgāt |
dup. 1|2|8|21. aruṇādhikaraṇanyāyena ‘aikakarmyaniyamaḥ syāt’ ( arthakatve dravyaguṇayorekakarmyaniyamaḥ syāt 3|1|6|2 ) ityanena āruṇyasya ekahāyanaikasaṃkhyayośca anyonyaniyamāt samuccayaḥ |
dup. 1|2|1|1 pṛ. 1627. ekahāyanipiṅgākṣīśabdābhyāṃ yaugikābhyāṃ uktasya dravyasya gośabdoktāyāśca jāteḥ aruṇādhikaraṇanyāyena samuccayaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 167. śabdavastusāmarthyayorvirodhe aruṇādhikaraṇanyāyena śabdasāmarthyānugṛhītāt nirṇayo yuktaḥ (pūrvapakṣe) |
kau. 1|4|20|30 pṛ. 299. sāmanādhikaraṇyaṃ ca dvayorapi ekaviṣayatve kalpyeta, tena yadi hi devadattādayaḥ sāmānyataḥ pacatāśabdena abhihitāḥ, tatastaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ labhyate |
lakṣaṇayā ākṛtyaruṇādhikaraṇoktanyāyena bhaviṣyati iti cet na, taṇḍulasthena pākena lakṣayitumaśakyatvāt |
